Yunus:26 - لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا الْحُسْنَى وَزِيَادَةٌ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
lilladhīna aḥsanū l-ḥus'nā waziyādatun walā yarhaqu wujūhahum qatarun walā dhillatun ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna
For those who do good (is) the best and more And not (will) cover their faces dust and not humiliation Those (are the) companions (of) Paradise they in it (will) abide forever

item.title: Yunus:27
item.description:
Yunus:27 - وَالَّذِينَ كَسَبُوْۤا السَّيِّئَاتِ جَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا وَتَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ مَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مُظْلِمًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
wa-alladhīna kasabū l-sayiāti jazāu sayyi-atin bimith'lihā watarhaquhum dhillatun mā lahum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin ka-annamā ugh'shiyat wujūhuhum qiṭaʿan mina al-layli muẓ'liman ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna
And those who earned the evil deeds (the) recompense (of) an evil deed (is) like it and (will) cover them humiliation They will not have They will not have from Allah any defender As if had been covered their faces (with) pieces from the darkness (of) night the darkness (of) night Those (are the) companions (of) the Fire they in it (will) abide forever

item.title: Yunus:28
item.description:
Yunus:28 - وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا مَكَانَكُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَشُرَكَاؤُكُمْ فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَقَالَ شُرَكَاؤُهُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ إِيَّانَا تَعْبُدُونَ wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū makānakum antum washurakāukum fazayyalnā baynahum waqāla shurakāuhum mā kuntum iyyānā taʿbudūna And (the) Day We will gather them all together then We will say to those who associate partners (with Allah) (Remain in) your place you and your partners Then We will separate [between] them and (will) say their partners Not you used (to) worship us worship us
  • [1] That is, the false gods whom the polytheists associated with Allah.

item.title: Yunus:29
item.description:
Yunus:29 - فَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ إِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ عِبَادَتِكُمْ لَغَافِلِينَ
fakafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynanā wabaynakum in kunnā ʿan ʿibādatikum laghāfilīna
So sufficient (is) Allah (as) a witness between us and between you that we were of your worship certainly unaware

item.title: Yunus:30
item.description:
Yunus:30 - هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُوْۤا كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا أَسْلَفَتْ وَرُدُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ
hunālika tablū kullu nafsin mā aslafat waruddū ilā l-lahi mawlāhumu l-ḥaqi waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna
There will be put to trial every soul (for) what it did previously and they will be returned to Allah their Lord the true and will be lost from them what they used (to) invent

item.title: Yunus:31
item.description:
Yunus:31 - قُلْ مَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَمَّنْ يَمْلِكُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَمَنْ يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَمَنْ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ فَسَيَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ فَقُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi amman yamliku l-samʿa wal-abṣāra waman yukh'riju l-ḥaya mina l-mayiti wayukh'riju l-mayita mina l-ḥayi waman yudabbiru l-amra fasayaqūlūna l-lahu faqul afalā tattaqūna
Say Who provides for you from the sky and the earth Or who controls the hearing and the sight And who brings out the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living And who disposes the affairs Then they will say Allah Then say Then will not you fear (Him)

item.title: Yunus:32
item.description:
Yunus:32 - فَذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَاذَا بَعْدَ الْحَقِّ إِلَّا الضَّلَالُ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ
fadhālikumu l-lahu rabbukumu l-ḥaqu famādhā baʿda l-ḥaqi illā l-ḍalālu fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna
For that (is) Allah your Lord the true So what (can be) after the truth except the error So how (are) you turned away

item.title: Yunus:33
item.description:
Yunus:33 - كَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
kadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna fasaqū annahum lā yu'minūna
Thus (is) proved true (the) Word (of) your Lord upon those who defiantly disobeyed that they (will) not believe

item.title: Yunus:34
item.description:
Yunus:34 - قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ
qul hal min shurakāikum man yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu quli l-lahu yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu fa-annā tu'fakūna
Say Is (there) of your partners (any) who originates the creation then repeats it Say Allah originates the creation then repeats it So how you are deluded

item.title: Yunus:35
item.description:
Yunus:35 - قُلْ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَائِكُمْ مَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ قُلِ اللَّهُ يَهْدِي لِلْحَقِّ أَفَمَنْ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يُتَّبَعَ أَمَّنْ لَا يَهِدِّي إِلَّا أَنْ يُهْدَى فَمَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
qul hal min shurakāikum man yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi quli l-lahu yahdī lil'ḥaqqi afaman yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi aḥaqqu an yuttabaʿa amman lā yahiddī illā an yuh'dā famā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna
Say Is (there) of your partners (any) who guides to the truth Say Allah guides to the truth Is then (he) who guides to the truth more worthy that he should be followed or (he) who (does) not guide unless that he is guided Then what (is) for you how you judge

item.title: Yunus:36
item.description:
Yunus:36 - وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ إِلَّا ظَنًّا إِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
wamā yattabiʿu aktharuhum illā ẓannan inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūna
And not follow most of them except assumption Indeed the assumption (does) not avail against the truth anything Indeed Allah (is) All-Knower of what they do

item.title: Yunus:37
item.description:
Yunus:37 - وَمَا كَانَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ أَنْ يُفْتَرٰی مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā kāna hādhā l-qur'ānu an yuf'tarā min dūni l-lahi walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla l-kitābi lā rayba fīhi min rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And not is this the Quran that (it could be) produced by other than Allah other than Allah but (it is) a confirmation (of that) which (was) before it (was) before it and a detailed explanation (of) the Book (there is) no doubt in it from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Yunus:38
item.description:
Yunus:38 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِسُورَةٍ مِثْلِهِ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū bisūratin mith'lihi wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Or (do) they say He has invented it Say Then bring a Surah like it and call whoever you can besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah if you are truthful

item.title: Yunus:39
item.description:
Yunus:39 - بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوْۤا بِعِلْمِهِ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُ كَذٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظَّالِمِينَ
bal kadhabū bimā lam yuḥīṭū biʿil'mihi walammā yatihim tawīluhu kadhālika kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-ẓālimīna
Nay they denied what not they could encompass (of) its knowledge and not has come (to) them its interpretation Thus denied those before them before them then see how was (the) end (of) the wrongdoers

item.title: Yunus:40
item.description:
Yunus:40 - وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُفْسِدِينَ
wamin'hum man yu'minu bihi wamin'hum man lā yu'minu bihi warabbuka aʿlamu bil-muf'sidīna
And of them (is one) who believes in it and of them (is one) who (does) not believe in it And your Lord (is) All-Knower of the corrupters

item.title: Yunus:41
item.description:
Yunus:41 - وَإِنْ كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُلْ لِي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ أَنْتُمْ بَرِيءُونَ مِمَّا أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
wa-in kadhabūka faqul lī ʿamalī walakum ʿamalukum antum barīūna mimmā aʿmalu wa-anā barīon mimmā taʿmalūna
And if they deny you then say For me (are) my deeds and for you (are) your deeds You (are) disassociated from what I do and I am disassociated from what you do

item.title: Yunus:42
item.description:
Yunus:42 - وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
wamin'hum man yastamiʿūna ilayka afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma walaw kānū lā yaʿqilūna
And among them (are some) who listen to you But (can) you cause the deaf to hear cause the deaf to hear even though they [were] (do) not use reason

item.title: Yunus:43
item.description:
Yunus:43 - وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْكَ أَفَأَنْتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
wamin'hum man yanẓuru ilayka afa-anta tahdī l-ʿum'ya walaw kānū lā yub'ṣirūna
And among them (are some) who look at you But (can) you guide the blind even though they [were] (do) not see

item.title: Yunus:44
item.description:
Yunus:44 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ النَّاسَ شَيْئًا وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
inna l-laha lā yaẓlimu l-nāsa shayan walākinna l-nāsa anfusahum yaẓlimūna
Indeed Allah (does) not wrong the people (in) anything but the people wrong themselves wrong themselves

item.title: Yunus:45
item.description:
Yunus:45 - وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَنْ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنَ النَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُهْتَدِينَ
wayawma yaḥshuruhum ka-an lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan mina l-nahāri yataʿārafūna baynahum qad khasira alladhīna kadhabū biliqāi l-lahi wamā kānū muh'tadīna
And the Day He will gather them as if they had not remained they had not remained except an hour of the day they will recognize each other between them Certainly (will have) lost those who denied the meeting (with) Allah and not they were the guided ones

item.title: Yunus:46
item.description:
Yunus:46 - وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَى مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
wa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma l-lahu shahīdun ʿalā mā yafʿalūna
And whether We show you some (of) that which We promised them or We cause you to die then to Us (is) their return then Allah (is) a Witness over what they do

item.title: Yunus:47
item.description:
Yunus:47 - وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسُولٌ فَإِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ walikulli ummatin rasūlun fa-idhā jāa rasūluhum quḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And for every nation (is) a Messenger So when comes their Messenger it will be judged between them in justice and they (will) not be wronged
  • [1] Or 'There is a messenger.'

item.title: Yunus:48
item.description:
Yunus:48 - وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And they say When (will) this the promise (be fulfilled) if you are truthful

item.title: Yunus:49
item.description:
Yunus:49 - قُلْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
qul lā amliku linafsī ḍarran walā nafʿan illā mā shāa l-lahu likulli ummatin ajalun idhā jāa ajaluhum falā yastakhirūna sāʿatan walā yastaqdimūna
Say Not I have power for myself (for) any harm and not (for) any profit except what Allah wills Allah wills For every nation (is) a term When comes their term then not they remain behind an hour and not they can precede (it)

item.title: Yunus:50
item.description:
Yunus:50 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَاتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ
qul ara-aytum in atākum ʿadhābuhu bayātan aw nahāran mādhā yastaʿjilu min'hu l-muj'rimūna
Say Do you see if comes to you His punishment (by) night or (by) day what (portion) of it would (wish to) hasten of it would (wish to) hasten the criminals

item.title: Yunus:51
item.description:
Yunus:51 - أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِهِ ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
athumma idhā mā waqaʿa āmantum bihi āl'āna waqad kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna
Is (it) then when when (it had) occurred you (will) believe in it Now And certainly you were seeking to hasten it seeking to hasten it

item.title: Yunus:52
item.description:
Yunus:52 - ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
thumma qīla lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-khul'di hal tuj'zawna illā bimā kuntum taksibūna
Then it will be said to those who wronged Taste punishment the everlasting Are you (being) recompensed Are you (being) recompensed except for what you used (to) earn

item.title: Yunus:53
item.description:
Yunus:53 - وَيَسْتَنْبِئُونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ
wayastanbiūnaka aḥaqqun huwa qul ī warabbī innahu laḥaqqun wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna
And they ask you to inform Is it true Is it true Say Yes by my Lord Indeed, it (is) surely the truth and not you (can) escape (it)

item.title: Yunus:54
item.description:
Yunus:54 - وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لَافْتَدَتْ بِهِ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
walaw anna likulli nafsin ẓalamat mā fī l-arḍi la-if'tadat bihi wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba waquḍiya baynahum bil-qis'ṭi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna
And if that for every soul (that) wronged whatever (is) in the earth it (would) seek to ransom with it and they (will) confide the regret when they see the punishment But will be judged between them in justice and they (will) not (be) wronged

item.title: Yunus:55
item.description:
Yunus:55 - أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
alā inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alā inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
No doubt indeed for Allah (is) whatever (is) in the heavens and the earth No doubt indeed (the) Promise of Allah (the) Promise of Allah (is) true But most of them (do) not know

item.title: Yunus:56
item.description:
Yunus:56 - هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
He gives life and causes death and to Him you will be returned

item.title: Yunus:57
item.description:
Yunus:57 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُمْ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāatkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum washifāon limā fī l-ṣudūri wahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna
O mankind O mankind Verily has come to you an instruction from your Lord and a healing for what (is) in your breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers

item.title: Yunus:58
item.description:
Yunus:58 - قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
qul bifaḍli l-lahi wabiraḥmatihi fabidhālika falyafraḥū huwa khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna
Say In the Bounty (of) Allah and in His Mercy so in that let them rejoice It (is) better than what they accumulate

item.title: Yunus:59
item.description:
Yunus:59 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَالًا قُلْ ءَاللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ أَمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
qul ara-aytum mā anzala l-lahu lakum min riz'qin fajaʿaltum min'hu ḥarāman waḥalālan qul āllahu adhina lakum am ʿalā l-lahi taftarūna
Say Have you seen what (has been) sent down (by) Allah for you of (the) provision and you have made of it unlawful and lawful Say Has Allah permitted [to] you or about Allah you invent (lies)

item.title: Yunus:60
item.description:
Yunus:60 - وَمَا ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
wamā ẓannu alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna
And what (will be the) assumption (of) those who invent against Allah the lie (on) the Day (of) the Judgment Indeed Allah (is) surely Full (of) Bounty (is) surely Full (of) Bounty to the mankind but most of them (are) not grateful

item.title: Yunus:61
item.description:
Yunus:61 - وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوْۤا مِنْهُ مِنْ قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْ رَبِّكَ مِنْ مِثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَا أَصْغَرَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
wamā takūnu fī shanin wamā tatlū min'hu min qur'ānin walā taʿmalūna min ʿamalin illā kunnā ʿalaykum shuhūdan idh tufīḍūna fīhi wamā yaʿzubu ʿan rabbika min mith'qāli dharratin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi walā aṣghara min dhālika walā akbara illā fī kitābin mubīnin
And not you are in any situation and not you recite of it from (the) Quran and not you do any deed except We are over you witnesses when you are engaged in it And not escapes from your Lord of (the) weight (of) an atom in the earth and not in the heavens and not smaller than that and not greater but (is) in a Record clear

item.title: Yunus:62
item.description:
Yunus:62 - أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
alā inna awliyāa l-lahi lā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
No doubt Indeed (the) friends (of) Allah (there will be) no fear upon then and not they will grieve

item.title: Yunus:63
item.description:
Yunus:63 - اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ
alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna
Those who believe and are conscious (of Allah)

item.title: Yunus:64
item.description:
Yunus:64 - لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
lahumu l-bush'rā fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati lā tabdīla likalimāti l-lahi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu
For them (are) the glad tidings in the life (of) the world and in the Hereafter No change (is there) in the Words (of) Allah That is the success the great

item.title: Yunus:65
item.description:
Yunus:65 - وَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ الْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
walā yaḥzunka qawluhum inna l-ʿizata lillahi jamīʿan huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu
And (let) not grieve you their speech Indeed the honor (belongs) to Allah all He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower

item.title: Yunus:66
item.description:
Yunus:66 - أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
alā inna lillahi man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi wamā yattabiʿu alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi shurakāa in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-in hum illā yakhruṣūna
No doubt Indeed to Allah (belongs) whoever (is) in the heavens and whoever (is) in the earth And not follow those who invoke other than Allah other than Allah other than Allah partners Not they follow but the assumption and not they but guess

item.title: Yunus:67
item.description:
Yunus:67 - هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yasmaʿūna
He (is) the One Who made for you the night that you may rest in it and the day giving visibility Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for a people (who) listen

item.title: Yunus:68
item.description:
Yunus:68 - قَالُوْا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنْ عِنْدَكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بِهَذَا أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
qālū ittakhadha l-lahu waladan sub'ḥānahu huwa l-ghaniyu lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi in ʿindakum min sul'ṭānin bihādhā ataqūlūna ʿalā l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna
They say Allah has taken Allah has taken a son Glory be to Him He (is) the Self-sufficient To Him (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth Not you have any authority for this Do you say about Allah what not you know

item.title: Yunus:69
item.description:
Yunus:69 - قُلْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
qul inna alladhīna yaftarūna ʿalā l-lahi l-kadhiba lā yuf'liḥūna
Say Indeed those who invent against Allah the lie they will not succeed they will not succeed

item.title: Yunus:70
item.description:
Yunus:70 - مَتَاعٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ الْعَذَابَ الشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْفُرُونَ
matāʿun fī l-dun'yā thumma ilaynā marjiʿuhum thumma nudhīquhumu l-ʿadhāba l-shadīda bimā kānū yakfurūna
An enjoyment in the world then to Us (is) their return then We will make them taste the punishment the severe because they used to disbelieve

item.title: Yunus:71
item.description:
Yunus:71 - وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ نُوحٍ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَقَامِي وَتَذْكِيرِي بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَعَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ فَأَجْمِعُوا أَمْرَكُمْ وَشُرَكَاءَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُنْ أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً ثُمَّ اقْضُوْۤا إِلَيَّ وَلَا تُنْظِرُونِ wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a nūḥin idh qāla liqawmihi yāqawmi in kāna kabura ʿalaykum maqāmī watadhkīrī biāyāti l-lahi faʿalā l-lahi tawakkaltu fa-ajmiʿū amrakum washurakāakum thumma lā yakun amrukum ʿalaykum ghummatan thumma iq'ḍū ilayya walā tunẓirūni And recite to them the news (of) Nuh when he said to his people O my people If is hard on you my stay and my reminding the Signs of Allah the Signs of Allah then on Allah I put my trust So you all resolve your plan and your partners Then let not be let not be (in) your plan for you any doubt Then carry (it out) upon me and (do) not give me respite
  • [1] That is, the false deities whom you worship besides Allah.

item.title: Yunus:72
item.description:
Yunus:72 - فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَمَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
fa-in tawallaytum famā sa-altukum min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna
But if you turn away then not I have asked you any reward Not (is) my reward but on Allah and I have been commanded that I be of the Muslims

item.title: Yunus:73
item.description:
Yunus:73 - فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ خَلَائِفَ وَأَغْرَقْنَا الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ fakadhabūhu fanajjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki wajaʿalnāhum khalāifa wa-aghraqnā alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna But they denied him so We saved him and (those) who (were) with him in the ship and We made them successors and We drowned those who denied Our Signs Then see how was (the) end (of) those who were warned
  • [1] That is, of those who perished in the Flood, and heirs to all that belonged to them.

item.title: Yunus:74
item.description:
Yunus:74 - ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رُسُلًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا كَانُوْۤا لِيُؤْمِنُوا بِمَا كَذَّبُوْۤا بِهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ كَذٰلِكَ نَطْبَعُ عَلَى قُلُوبِ الْمُعْتَدِينَ
thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihi rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāūhum bil-bayināti famā kānū liyu'minū bimā kadhabū bihi min qablu kadhālika naṭbaʿu ʿalā qulūbi l-muʿ'tadīna
Then We sent after him after him Messengers to their people and they came to them with clear proofs But not they were to believe what they had denied it before before Thus We seal on the hearts (of) the transgressors

item.title: Yunus:75
item.description:
Yunus:75 - ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ
thumma baʿathnā min baʿdihim mūsā wahārūna ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi biāyātinā fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman muj'rimīna
Then We sent after them after them Musa and Harun to Firaun and his chiefs with Our Signs but they were arrogant and were a people criminal

item.title: Yunus:76
item.description:
Yunus:76 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا إِنَّ هَذَا لَسِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
falammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu min ʿindinā qālū inna hādhā lasiḥ'run mubīnun
So when came to them the truth from Us from Us they said Indeed this (is) surely, a magic clear

item.title: Yunus:77
item.description:
Yunus:77 - قَالَ مُوسٰی أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَكُمْ أَسِحْرٌ هَذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُونَ
qāla mūsā ataqūlūna lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāakum asiḥ'run hādhā walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥirūna
Musa said Musa said Do you say about the truth when it has come to you Is this magic Is this magic But (will) not succeed the magicians

item.title: Yunus:78
item.description:
Yunus:78 - قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَلْفِتَنَا عَمَّا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَنَا وَتَكُونَ لَكُمَا الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكُمَا بِمُؤْمِنِينَ qālū aji'tanā litalfitanā ʿammā wajadnā ʿalayhi ābāanā watakūna lakumā l-kib'riyāu fī l-arḍi wamā naḥnu lakumā bimu'minīna They said Have you come to us to turn us away from that we found on it our forefathers and you two (may) have and you two (may) have the greatness in the land And we (are) not And we (are) not (in) you two believers
  • [1] That is, Moses and Aaron ('a).

item.title: Yunus:79
item.description:
Yunus:79 - وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ائْتُونِي بِكُلِّ سَاحِرٍ عَلِيمٍ
waqāla fir'ʿawnu i'tūnī bikulli sāḥirin ʿalīmin
And Firaun said And Firaun said Bring to me every magician learned

item.title: Yunus:80
item.description:
Yunus:80 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ
falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna
So when came the magicians said to them Musa Throw whatever you (wish to) throw

item.title: Yunus:81
item.description:
Yunus:81 - فَلَمَّا أَلْقَوْا قَالَ مُوسٰی مَا جِئْتُمْ بِهِ السِّحْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيُبْطِلُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُصْلِحُ عَمَلَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
falammā alqaw qāla mūsā mā ji'tum bihi l-siḥ'ru inna l-laha sayub'ṭiluhu inna l-laha lā yuṣ'liḥu ʿamala l-muf'sidīna
Then when they (had) thrown Musa said Musa said What you have brought it (is) the magic Indeed Allah will nullify it Indeed Allah (does) not amend the work (of) the corrupters

item.title: Yunus:82
item.description:
Yunus:82 - وَيُحِقُّ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ
wayuḥiqqu l-lahu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi walaw kariha l-muj'rimūna
And Allah will establish And Allah will establish the truth by His words even if dislike it the criminals

item.title: Yunus:83
item.description:
Yunus:83 - فَمَا اٰمَنَ لِمُوسٰی إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَلَى خَوْفٍ مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِيهِمْ أَنْ يَفْتِنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
famā āmana limūsā illā dhurriyyatun min qawmihi ʿalā khawfin min fir'ʿawna wamala-ihim an yaftinahum wa-inna fir'ʿawna laʿālin fī l-arḍi wa-innahu lamina l-mus'rifīna
But none believed Musa except (the) offspring among his people for fear of Firaun and their chiefs lest they persecute them And indeed Firaun (was) a tyrant in the earth and indeed, he (was) of the ones who commit excesses

item.title: Yunus:84
item.description:
Yunus:84 - وَقَالَ مُوسٰی يَاقَوْمِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ ءَامَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ فَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلُوا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُسْلِمِينَ
waqāla mūsā yāqawmi in kuntum āmantum bil-lahi faʿalayhi tawakkalū in kuntum mus'limīna
And Musa said And Musa said O my people If you have believed in Allah then on Him put your trust if you are Muslims

item.title: Yunus:85
item.description:
Yunus:85 - فَقَالُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
faqālū ʿalā l-lahi tawakkalnā rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fit'natan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna
Then they said Upon Allah we put our trust Our Lord (Do) not make us a trial for the people the wrongdoers

item.title: Yunus:86
item.description:
Yunus:86 - وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
wanajjinā biraḥmatika mina l-qawmi l-kāfirīna
And save us by Your Mercy from the people the disbelievers

item.title: Yunus:87
item.description:
Yunus:87 - وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی وَأَخِيهِ أَنْ تَبَوَّءَا لِقَوْمِكُمَا بِمِصْرَ بُيُوتًا وَاجْعَلُوا بُيُوتَكُمْ قِبْلَةً وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā wa-akhīhi an tabawwaā liqawmikumā bimiṣ'ra buyūtan wa-ij'ʿalū buyūtakum qib'latan wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata wabashiri l-mu'minīna And We inspired to Musa and his brother that Settle your people in Egypt (in) houses and make your houses (as) places of worship and establish the prayer And give glad tidings (to) the believers
  • [1] That is, Bayt al-Maqdis, in accordance with a tradition of Imam al-Ṣādiq ('a) (Tafsīr al-Qummī). Alternatively, 'Provide houses for your people in Egypt.'
  • [2] Or 'Make your homes places of worship.'

item.title: Yunus:88
item.description:
Yunus:88 - وَقَالَ مُوسٰی رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ ءَاتَيْتَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَأَهُ زِينَةً وَأَمْوَالًا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِكَ رَبَّنَا اطْمِسْ عَلَى أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَاشْدُدْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُوْۤا حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
waqāla mūsā rabbanā innaka ātayta fir'ʿawna wamala-ahu zīnatan wa-amwālan fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā rabbanā liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlika rabbanā iṭ'mis ʿalā amwālihim wa-ush'dud ʿalā qulūbihim falā yu'minū ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma
And Musa said And Musa said Our Lord Indeed, You have given Firaun and his chiefs splendor and wealth in the life (of) the world Our Lord That they may lead astray from Your way Our Lord Destroy on their wealth and harden on their hearts so (that) not they believe until they see the punishment the painful

item.title: Yunus:89
item.description:
Yunus:89 - قَالَ قَدْ أُجِيبَتْ دَعْوَتُكُمَا فَاسْتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَانِّ سَبِيلَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ qāla qad ujībat daʿwatukumā fa-is'taqīmā walā tattabiʿānni sabīla alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna He said Verily has been answered (the) invocation of both of you So you two (keep to the) straight way And (do) not follow (the) way (of) those who (do) not know
  • [1] That is, of Moses and Aaron ('a).

item.title: Yunus:90
item.description:
Yunus:90 - وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ وَجُنُودُهُ بَغْيًا وَعَدْوًا حَتّٰی إِذَا أَدْرَكَهُ الْغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَنْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الَّذِي اٰمَنَتْ بِهِ بَنُوْۤا إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
wajāwaznā bibanī is'rāīla l-baḥra fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu wajunūduhu baghyan waʿadwan ḥattā idhā adrakahu l-gharaqu qāla āmantu annahu lā ilāha illā alladhī āmanat bihi banū is'rāīla wa-anā mina l-mus'limīna
And We took across (the) Children (of) Israel the sea and followed them Firaun and his hosts (in) rebellion and enmity until when overtook him the drowning he said I believe that (there is) no god except the One in Whom believe in Whom believe the Children of Israel the Children of Israel and I am of the Muslims

item.title: Yunus:91
item.description:
Yunus:91 - ءَالْءَانَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
āl'āna waqad ʿaṣayta qablu wakunta mina l-muf'sidīna
Now And verily you (had) disobeyed before and you were of the corrupters

item.title: Yunus:92
item.description:
Yunus:92 - فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ اٰیَةً وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَاتِنَا لَغَافِلُونَ
fal-yawma nunajjīka bibadanika litakūna liman khalfaka āyatan wa-inna kathīran mina l-nāsi ʿan āyātinā laghāfilūna
So today We will save you in your body that you may be for (those) who succeed you a sign And indeed many among the mankind of Our Signs (are) surely heedless

item.title: Yunus:93
item.description:
Yunus:93 - وَلَقَدْ بَوَّأْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مُبَوَّأَ صِدْقٍ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
walaqad bawwanā banī is'rāīla mubawwa-a ṣid'qin warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti famā ikh'talafū ḥattā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna
And verily We settled (the) Children (of) Israel (in) a settlement honorable and We provided them with the good things and not they differ until came to them the knowledge Indeed your Lord will judge between them (on) the Day (of) the Resurrection concerning what they used (to) in it differ

item.title: Yunus:94
item.description:
Yunus:94 - فَإِنْ كُنْتَ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ فَسْءَلِ الَّذِينَ يَقْرَءُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَقَدْ جَاءَكَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ
fa-in kunta fī shakkin mimmā anzalnā ilayka fasali alladhīna yaqraūna l-kitāba min qablika laqad jāaka l-ḥaqu min rabbika falā takūnanna mina l-mum'tarīna
So if you are in doubt of what We have revealed to you then ask those who (have been) reading the Book before you before you Verily has come to you the truth from your Lord so (do) not be among the doubters

item.title: Yunus:95
item.description:
Yunus:95 - وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
walā takūnanna mina alladhīna kadhabū biāyāti l-lahi fatakūna mina l-khāsirīna
And (do) not be of those who deny (the) Signs of Allah (the) Signs of Allah then you will be among the losers

item.title: Yunus:96
item.description:
Yunus:96 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِمْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
inna alladhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimatu rabbika lā yu'minūna
Indeed those [whom] has become due on them (the) Word (of) your Lord will not believe

item.title: Yunus:97
item.description:
Yunus:97 - وَلَوْ جَاءَتْهُمْ كُلُّ اٰیَةٍ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
walaw jāathum kullu āyatin ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma
Even if comes to them every Sign until they see the punishment the painful

item.title: Yunus:98
item.description:
Yunus:98 - فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ اٰمَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَا إِيمَانُهَا إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا اٰمَنُوْا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ
falawlā kānat qaryatun āmanat fanafaʿahā īmānuhā illā qawma yūnusa lammā āmanū kashafnā ʿanhum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin
So why not was any town that believed and benefited it its faith except the people (of) Yunus When they believed We removed from them (the) punishment (of) the disgrace in the life of the world and We granted them enjoyment for a time

item.title: Yunus:99
item.description:
Yunus:99 - وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَءَامَنَ مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كُلُّهُمْ جَمِيعًا أَفَأَنْتَ تُكْرِهُ النَّاسَ حَتّٰی يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ
walaw shāa rabbuka laāmana man fī l-arḍi kulluhum jamīʿan afa-anta tuk'rihu l-nāsa ḥattā yakūnū mu'minīna
And if (had) willed your Lord surely, (would) have believed who (are) in the earth all of them together Then, will you compel the mankind until they become believers

item.title: Yunus:100
item.description:
Yunus:100 - وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَيَجْعَلُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
wamā kāna linafsin an tu'mina illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi wayajʿalu l-rij'sa ʿalā alladhīna lā yaʿqilūna
And not is for a soul to believe except by (the) permission (of) Allah And He will place the wrath on those who (do) not use reason

item.title: Yunus:101
item.description:
Yunus:101 - قُلِ انْظُرُوْۤا مَاذَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُغْنِي الْآيَاتُ وَالنُّذُرُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
quli unẓurū mādhā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā tugh'nī l-āyātu wal-nudhuru ʿan qawmin lā yu'minūna
Say See what (is) in the heavens and the earth But not will avail the Signs and the warners to a people (who do) not believe

item.title: Yunus:102
item.description:
Yunus:102 - فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ قُلْ فَانْتَظِرُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَظِرِينَ
fahal yantaẓirūna illā mith'la ayyāmi alladhīna khalaw min qablihim qul fa-intaẓirū innī maʿakum mina l-muntaẓirīna
Then do they wait except like the days (of) those who passed away before them before them Say Then wait indeed, I (am) with you among the ones who wait

item.title: Yunus:103
item.description:
Yunus:103 - ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نُنْجِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
thumma nunajjī rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū kadhālika ḥaqqan ʿalaynā nunji l-mu'minīna
Then We will save Our Messengers and those who believe Thus (it is) an obligation upon Us (that) We save the believers

item.title: Yunus:104
item.description:
Yunus:104 - قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ دِينِي فَلَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ أَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī shakkin min dīnī falā aʿbudu alladhīna taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi walākin aʿbudu l-laha alladhī yatawaffākum wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mu'minīna
Say O mankind O mankind If you are in doubt of my religion then not I worship those whom you worship besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah but I worship Allah the One Who causes you to die And I am commanded that I be of the believers

item.title: Yunus:105
item.description:
Yunus:105 - وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
wa-an aqim wajhaka lilddīni ḥanīfan walā takūnanna mina l-mush'rikīna
And that Direct your face to the religion upright and (do) not be of the polytheists

item.title: Yunus:106
item.description:
Yunus:106 - وَلَا تَدْعُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ فَإِنْ فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
walā tadʿu min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuka walā yaḍurruka fa-in faʿalta fa-innaka idhan mina l-ẓālimīna
And (do) not invoke besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah what (will) not benefit you and not harm you But if you did so indeed, you then (will be) of the wrongdoers

item.title: Yunus:107
item.description:
Yunus:107 - وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِنْ يُرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رَادَّ لِفَضْلِهِ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-in yamsaska l-lahu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahu illā huwa wa-in yurid'ka bikhayrin falā rādda lifaḍlihi yuṣību bihi man yashāu min ʿibādihi wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
And if Allah touches you Allah touches you with adversity (there is) no remover of it except Him and if He intends for you any good then (there is) no repeller (of) His Bounty He causes it to reach He causes it to reach whom He wills of His slaves And He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Yunus:108
item.description:
Yunus:108 - قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِوَكِيلٍ
qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu qad jāakumu l-ḥaqu min rabbikum famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anā ʿalaykum biwakīlin
Say O mankind O mankind Verily has come to you the truth from your Lord So whoever (is) guided then only (he is) guided for his soul and whoever goes astray then only he strays against it And I am not And I am not over you a guardian

item.title: Yunus:109
item.description:
Yunus:109 - وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَاصْبِرْ حَتّٰی يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ
wa-ittabiʿ mā yūḥā ilayka wa-iṣ'bir ḥattā yaḥkuma l-lahu wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna
And follow what is revealed to you and be patient until Allah gives judgment Allah gives judgment And He (is) the Best (of) the Judges

item.title: 11. هود (Hud)
item.description:
The surah that mentions an ancient prophet after Noah named Hūd, whom God sent to the mighty people of 'Ād, the dwellers of a great pillared city called Iram. It is named after Hūd, whose account is given in verse 50 ff. The surah begins by announcing that the Prophet is sent both to warn and to give good news, and the body of the surah focuses on the warning aspect: God watches over everything and is aware of all that people do (verse 5 ff., verse 111 ff. and verse 123). The many stories of past prophets, which serve to warn the disbelievers, also strengthen the heart of the Prophet (verse 120).
The surah is also known as Hood, Hud (The Messenger), The Prophet Hud

11:1
الر كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ
alif-lam-ra kitābun uḥ'kimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīrin
Alif Lam Ra (This is) a Book are perfected its Verses moreover explained in detail from (he One Who) from (he One Who) (is) All-Wise All-Aware

11:2
أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنِي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ
allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innanī lakum min'hu nadhīrun wabashīrun
That "Not you worship but Allah Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bearer of glad tidings

11:3
وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ
wa-ani is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿ'kum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa-in tawallaw fa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīrin
And that Seek forgiveness (of) your Lord and turn in repentance to Him He will let you enjoy a good for a term appointed And give (to) every owner (of) grace His Grace But if you turn away then indeed, I fear for you (the) punishment (of) a Great Day (of) a Great Day

item.title: Hud:1
item.description:
Hud:1 - الر كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ alif-lam-ra kitābun uḥ'kimat āyātuhu thumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakīmin khabīrin Alif Lam Ra (This is) a Book are perfected its Verses moreover explained in detail from (he One Who) from (he One Who) (is) All-Wise All-Aware
  • [1] Cf. (Q 3:7).
  • [2] Or 'articulated.'

item.title: Hud:2
item.description:
Hud:2 - أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنِي لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ
allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innanī lakum min'hu nadhīrun wabashīrun
That "Not you worship but Allah Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bearer of glad tidings

item.title: Hud:3
item.description:
Hud:3 - وَأَنِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُمَتِّعْكُمْ مَتَاعًا حَسَنًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِي فَضْلٍ فَضْلَهُ وَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ كَبِيرٍ
wa-ani is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yumattiʿ'kum matāʿan ḥasanan ilā ajalin musamman wayu'ti kulla dhī faḍlin faḍlahu wa-in tawallaw fa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin kabīrin
And that Seek forgiveness (of) your Lord and turn in repentance to Him He will let you enjoy a good for a term appointed And give (to) every owner (of) grace His Grace But if you turn away then indeed, I fear for you (the) punishment (of) a Great Day (of) a Great Day

item.title: Hud:4
item.description:
Hud:4 - إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ilā l-lahi marjiʿukum wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
To Allah (is) your return and He (is) on every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Hud:5
item.description:
Hud:5 - أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ يَثْنُونَ صُدُورَهُمْ لِيَسْتَخْفُوا مِنْهُ أَلَا حِينَ يَسْتَغْشُونَ ثِيَابَهُمْ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ alā innahum yathnūna ṣudūrahum liyastakhfū min'hu alā ḥīna yastaghshūna thiyābahum yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri No doubt They fold up their breasts that they may hide from Him Surely when they cover (themselves) (with) their garments He knows what they conceal and what they reveal Indeed, He (is) All-Knower of what (is in) the breasts
  • [1] 'To fold up one's breast' is an idiomatic phrase, meaning to conceal one's spite within one's heart.
  • [2] So that they may not be recognized. Cf. (Q 71:7).

item.title: Hud:6
item.description:
Hud:6 - وَمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
wamā min dābbatin fī l-arḍi illā ʿalā l-lahi riz'quhā wayaʿlamu mus'taqarrahā wamus'tawdaʿahā kullun fī kitābin mubīnin
And not any moving creature in the earth but on Allah (is) its provision And He knows its dwelling place and its place of storage All (is) in a Record clear

item.title: Hud:7
item.description:
Hud:7 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَكَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَلَئِنْ قُلْتَ إِنَّكُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْمَوْتِ لَيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
wahuwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin wakāna ʿarshuhu ʿalā l-māi liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wala-in qul'ta innakum mabʿūthūna min baʿdi l-mawti layaqūlanna alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun
And He (is) the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six epochs and His throne was and His throne was on the water that He might test [you] which of you (is) best (in) deed But if you say Indeed, you (will be) resurrected after after [the] death surely would say those who disbelieved This is not This is not but a magic clear

item.title: Hud:8
item.description:
Hud:8 - وَلَئِنْ أَخَّرْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِلَى أُمَّةٍ مَعْدُودَةٍ لَيَقُولُنَّ مَا يَحْبِسُهُ أَلَا يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمْ لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
wala-in akharnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba ilā ummatin maʿdūdatin layaqūlunna mā yaḥbisuhu alā yawma yatīhim laysa maṣrūfan ʿanhum waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And if We delay from them the punishment for a time determined they will surely say What detains it No doubt (On) the Day it comes to them not (will be) averted from them and will surround them what they used (to) mock at [it] mock at [it]

item.title: Hud:9
item.description:
Hud:9 - وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعْنَاهَا مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَئُوسٌ كَفُورٌ
wala-in adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan thumma nazaʿnāhā min'hu innahu layaūsun kafūrun
And if We give man a taste We give man a taste (of) Mercy from Us (of) Mercy from Us then We withdraw it from him indeed, he (is) despairing (and) ungrateful

item.title: Hud:10
item.description:
Hud:10 - وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
wala-in adhaqnāhu naʿmāa baʿda ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna dhahaba l-sayiātu ʿannī innahu lafariḥun fakhūrun
But if We give him a taste (of) favor after hardship (has) touched him surely, he will say Have gone the evils from me Indeed, he (is) exultant (and) boastful

item.title: Hud:11
item.description:
Hud:11 - إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
illā alladhīna ṣabarū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun
Except those who (are) patient and do the good deeds those for them (will be) forgiveness and a reward great

item.title: Hud:12
item.description:
Hud:12 - فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌ بَعْضَ مَا يُوحَى إِلَيْكَ وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ مَلَكٌ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ نَذِيرٌ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
falaʿallaka tārikun baʿḍa mā yūḥā ilayka waḍāiqun bihi ṣadruka an yaqūlū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi kanzun aw jāa maʿahu malakun innamā anta nadhīrun wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun
Then possibly you (may) give up a part (of) what is revealed to you and straitened by it your breast because they say Why not is sent down for him a treasure or has come with him an Angel Only you (are) a warner And Allah (is) on every thing a Guardian

item.title: Hud:13
item.description:
Hud:13 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ فَأْتُوْۤا بِعَشْرِ سُوَرٍ مِثْلِهِ مُفْتَرَيَاتٍ وَادْعُوْۤا مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul fatū biʿashri suwarin mith'lihi muf'tarayātin wa-id'ʿū mani is'taṭaʿtum min dūni l-lahi in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Or they say He has fabricated it Say Then bring ten Surahs like it fabricated and call whoever you can besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah if you are truthful

item.title: Hud:14
item.description:
Hud:14 - فَإِلَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ بِعِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
fa-illam yastajībū lakum fa-iʿ'lamū annamā unzila biʿil'mi l-lahi wa-an lā ilāha illā huwa fahal antum mus'limūna
Then if not they respond to you then know that it was sent down with the knowledge of Allah with the knowledge of Allah and that (there is) no god except Him Then, would you (be) Muslims

item.title: Hud:15
item.description:
Hud:15 - مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيهَا وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يُبْخَسُونَ
man kāna yurīdu l-ḥayata l-dun'yā wazīnatahā nuwaffi ilayhim aʿmālahum fīhā wahum fīhā lā yub'khasūna
Whoever [is] Whoever [is] desires the life (of) the world and its adornments We will repay in full to them (for) their deeds therein and they in it will not be lessened will not be lessened

item.title: Hud:16
item.description:
Hud:16 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِلَّا النَّارُ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْۤا فِيهَا وَبَاطِلٌ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
ulāika alladhīna laysa lahum fī l-ākhirati illā l-nāru waḥabiṭa mā ṣanaʿū fīhā wabāṭilun mā kānū yaʿmalūna
Those (are) the ones who (is) not for them in the Hereafter except the Fire And (has) gone in vain what they did therein and (is) worthless what they used (to) do

item.title: Hud:17
item.description:
Hud:17 - أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِنْهُ وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَمَنْ يَكْفُرْ بِهِ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُ فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatlūhu shāhidun min'hu wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan ulāika yu'minūna bihi waman yakfur bihi mina l-aḥzābi fal-nāru mawʿiduhu falā taku fī mir'yatin min'hu innahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna Then is he who is on a clear proof from his Lord and recites it a witness from Him and before it and before it (was) a Book (of) Musa (as) a guide and (as) mercy Those believe in it But whoever disbelieves in it among the sects then the Fire (will be) his promised (meeting) place So (do) not be in doubt about it Indeed, it (is) the truth from your Lord but most (of) the people (do) not believe
  • [1] Ellipsis. That is, is such a person like someone who is not such? Or, can such a one be deterred by the denial of the ignorant?
  • [2] Or 'before it,' that is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: Hud:18
item.description:
Hud:18 - وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا اُولٰٓئِكَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ وَيَقُولُ الْأَشْهَادُ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ
waman aẓlamu mimmani if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban ulāika yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalā rabbihim wayaqūlu l-ashhādu hāulāi alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā rabbihim alā laʿnatu l-lahi ʿalā l-ẓālimīna
And who (is) more unjust than (he) who invents against Allah a lie Those will be presented before their Lord and will say the witnesses These (are) those who lied against their Lord No doubt (The) curse of Allah (The) curse of Allah (is) on the wrongdoers

item.title: Hud:19
item.description:
Hud:19 - اَلَّذِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
alladhīna yaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna
Those who hinder from (the) way (of) Allah and seek (in) it crookedness while they in the Hereafter they (are) disbelievers

item.title: Hud:20
item.description:
Hud:20 - اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ السَّمْعَ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يُبْصِرُونَ
ulāika lam yakūnū muʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā kāna lahum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa yuḍāʿafu lahumu l-ʿadhābu mā kānū yastaṭīʿūna l-samʿa wamā kānū yub'ṣirūna
Those not will be (able to) escape in the earth and not is for them besides besides Allah any protectors And will be doubled for them the punishment Not they were able (to) hear and not they used (to) see

item.title: Hud:21
item.description:
Hud:21 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ
ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūna
Those (are) the ones who (have) lost their souls and lost from them (is) what they used (to) invent

item.title: Hud:22
item.description:
Hud:22 - لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ
lā jarama annahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūna
No doubt that they in the Hereafter they (will be) the greatest losers

item.title: Hud:23
item.description:
Hud:23 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَأَخْبَتُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wa-akhbatū ilā rabbihim ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati hum fīhā khālidūna
Indeed those who believe and do good deeds and humble themselves before their Lord those (are the) companions (of) Paradise they in it (will) abide forever

item.title: Hud:24
item.description:
Hud:24 - مَثَلُ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ كَالْأَعْمَى وَالْأَصَمِّ وَالْبَصِيرِ وَالسَّمِيعِ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
mathalu l-farīqayni kal-aʿmā wal-aṣami wal-baṣīri wal-samīʿi hal yastawiyāni mathalan afalā tadhakkarūna
(The) example (of) the two parties (is) like the blind and the deaf and the seer and the hearer Are they equal (in) comparison Then, will not you take heed

item.title: Hud:25
item.description:
Hud:25 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun
And verily We sent Nuh to his people Indeed, I am to you a warner clear

item.title: Hud:26
item.description:
Hud:26 - أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
an lā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin alīmin
That (do) not worship except Allah Indeed, I [I] fear for you (the) punishment (of) a Day painful

item.title: Hud:27
item.description:
Hud:27 - فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا نَرَاكَ إِلَّا بَشَرًا مِثْلَنَا وَمَا نَرَاكَ اتَّبَعَكَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّأْيِ وَمَا نَرٰی لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ فَضْلٍ بَلْ نَظُنُّكُمْ كَاذِبِينَ
faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā narāka illā basharan mith'lanā wamā narāka ittabaʿaka illā alladhīna hum arādhilunā bādiya l-rayi wamā narā lakum ʿalaynā min faḍlin bal naẓunnukum kādhibīna
So said the chiefs (of) those who disbelieved from his people Not we see you but a man like us and not we see you followed [you] except those who they (are) the lowest of us immature in opinion immature in opinion And not we see in you over us any merit nay we think you (are) liars

item.title: Hud:28
item.description:
Hud:28 - قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَعُمِّيَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنُلْزِمُكُمُوهَا وَأَنْتُمْ لَهَا كَارِهُونَ
qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī raḥmatan min ʿindihi faʿummiyat ʿalaykum anul'zimukumūhā wa-antum lahā kārihūna
He said O my people Do you see if I was on (the) clear proof from my Lord while He has given me mercy from Himself but (it) has been obscured from you should We compel you (to accept) it while you (are) averse to it averse to it

item.title: Hud:29
item.description:
Hud:29 - وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مَالًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّهُمْ مُلَاقُوْۤا رَبِّهِمْ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
wayāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi mālan in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wamā anā biṭāridi alladhīna āmanū innahum mulāqū rabbihim walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna
And O my people not I ask (of) you for it any wealth Not (is) my reward except from Allah And not I am going to drive away those who believed Indeed, they (will) be meeting their Lord but I see you (are) a people ignorant

item.title: Hud:30
item.description:
Hud:30 - وَيَاقَوْمِ مَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ طَرَدْتُهُمْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
wayāqawmi man yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ṭaradttuhum afalā tadhakkarūna
And O my people Who would help me against Allah if I drove them away Then, will not you take heed

item.title: Hud:31
item.description:
Hud:31 - وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ اِنِّیْ مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَنْ يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ اِنِّیْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
walā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāinu l-lahi walā aʿlamu l-ghayba walā aqūlu innī malakun walā aqūlu lilladhīna tazdarī aʿyunukum lan yu'tiyahumu l-lahu khayran l-lahu aʿlamu bimā fī anfusihim innī idhan lamina l-ẓālimīna
And not I say to you (that) with me (are the) treasures (of) Allah and not I know the unseen and not I say that I am an Angel and not I say for those whom look down upon your eyes never will Allah give them will Allah give them any good Allah knows best what (is) in their souls Indeed, I then (will be) surely of the wrongdoers

item.title: Hud:32
item.description:
Hud:32 - قَالُوْا يَانُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
qālū yānūḥu qad jādaltanā fa-aktharta jidālanā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna
They said O Nuh Indeed you disputed with us and you (have been) frequent (in) dispute with us So bring us what you threaten us (with) if you are of the truthful

item.title: Hud:33
item.description:
Hud:33 - قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُمْ بِهِ اللَّهُ إِنْ شَاءَ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ
qāla innamā yatīkum bihi l-lahu in shāa wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna
He said Only will bring it (on) you will bring it (on) you Allah if He wills and not you (are) one who (can) escape (it)

item.title: Hud:34
item.description:
Hud:34 - وَلَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَنْصَحَ لَكُمْ إِنْ كَانَ اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُغْوِيَكُمْ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
walā yanfaʿukum nuṣ'ḥī in aradttu an anṣaḥa lakum in kāna l-lahu yurīdu an yugh'wiyakum huwa rabbukum wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
And (will) not benefit you my advice (even) if I wish to [I] advise [to] you if it was Allah's it was Allah's will to let you go astray He (is) your Lord and to Him you will be returned

item.title: Hud:35
item.description:
Hud:35 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ
am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu faʿalayya ij'rāmī wa-anā barīon mimmā tuj'rimūna
Or (do) they say He has invented it Say If I have invented it then on me (is) my crime but I am innocent of what crimes you commit

item.title: Hud:36
item.description:
Hud:36 - وَأُوحِيَ إِلَى نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ مِنْ قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَنْ قَدْ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْعَلُونَ
waūḥiya ilā nūḥin annahu lan yu'mina min qawmika illā man qad āmana falā tabta-is bimā kānū yafʿalūna
And it was revealed to Nuh That will never believe from your people except (those) who have already believed So (do) not (be) distressed by what they have been doing

item.title: Hud:37
item.description:
Hud:37 - وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ
wa-iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna
And construct the ship under Our Eyes and Our inspiration and (do) not address Me concerning those who wronged indeed, they (are) the ones (to be) drowned

item.title: Hud:38
item.description:
Hud:38 - وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوْۤا مِنْهُ قَالَ إِنْ تَسْخَرُوْۤا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنْكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ
wayaṣnaʿu l-ful'ka wakullamā marra ʿalayhi mala-on min qawmihi sakhirū min'hu qāla in taskharū minnā fa-innā naskharu minkum kamā taskharūna
And he was constructing the ship and every time passed by him (the) chiefs of his people they ridiculed [of] him He said If you ridicule us then we can ridicule you as you ridicule

item.title: Hud:39
item.description:
Hud:39 - فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ
fasawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun
And soon you will know (on) whom will come a punishment (that) will disgrace him and will descend on him a punishment lasting

item.title: Hud:40
item.description:
Hud:40 - حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَمَا اٰمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ ḥattā idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru qul'nā iḥ'mil fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu waman āmana wamā āmana maʿahu illā qalīlun Till when came Our command and overflowed the oven We said Load in it of every kind a pair two and your family except who has preceded against him the word and whoever believed And not believed with him except a few
  • [1] That is, male and female. Cf. (Q 23:27).

item.title: Hud:41
item.description:
Hud:41 - وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوْۤا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِيهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
waqāla ir'kabū fīhā bis'mi l-lahi majrahā wamur'sāhā inna rabbī laghafūrun raḥīmun
And he said Embark in it in the name of Allah (is) its course and its anchorage Indeed my Lord (is) certainly Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Hud:42
item.description:
Hud:42 - وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَى نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَابُنَيَّ ارْكَبْ مَعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنْ مَعَ الْكَافِرِينَ
wahiya tajrī bihim fī mawjin kal-jibāli wanādā nūḥun ib'nahu wakāna fī maʿzilin yābunayya ir'kab maʿanā walā takun maʿa l-kāfirīna
And it sailed with them on the waves like mountains and Nuh called out and Nuh called out (to) his son and he was in apart O my son Embark with us and (do) not be with the disbelievers

item.title: Hud:43
item.description:
Hud:43 - قَالَ سَءَاوِي إِلَى جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ
qāla saāwī ilā jabalin yaʿṣimunī mina l-māi qāla lā ʿāṣima l-yawma min amri l-lahi illā man raḥima waḥāla baynahumā l-mawju fakāna mina l-mugh'raqīna
He said I will betake myself to a mountain (that) will save me from the water He said (There is) no protector today from the Command of Allah the Command of Allah except (on) whom He has mercy And came (in) between them the waves so he was among the drowned

item.title: Hud:44
item.description:
Hud:44 - وَقِيلَ يَاأَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَاسَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ waqīla yāarḍu ib'laʿī māaki wayāsamāu aqliʿī waghīḍa l-māu waquḍiya l-amru wa-is'tawat ʿalā l-jūdiyi waqīla buʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna And it was said O earth Swallow your water and O sky Withhold And subsided the water and was fulfilled the Command And it rested on the Judi And it was said Away with the people the wrongdoers
  • [1] That is, the Ark of Noah.

item.title: Hud:45
item.description:
Hud:45 - وَنَادَى نُوحٌ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ
wanādā nūḥun rabbahu faqāla rabbi inna ib'nī min ahlī wa-inna waʿdaka l-ḥaqu wa-anta aḥkamu l-ḥākimīna
And Nuh called And Nuh called (to) his Lord and said O my Lord Indeed my son (is) of my family and indeed Your promise (is) true and You (are) the Most Just (of) the judges

item.title: Hud:46
item.description:
Hud:46 - قَالَ يَانُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ فَلَا تَسْءَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ اِنِّیْ أَعِظُكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ
qāla yānūḥu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu ʿamalun ghayru ṣāliḥin falā tasalni mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun innī aʿiẓuka an takūna mina l-jāhilīna
He said O Nuh Indeed, he (is) not of your family indeed, [he] (his) deed (is) other than righteous so (do) not ask Me (about) what not you have of it any knowledge Indeed, I admonish you lest you be among the ignorant

item.title: Hud:47
item.description:
Hud:47 - قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْءَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
qāla rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an asalaka mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-illā taghfir lī watarḥamnī akun mina l-khāsirīna
He said O my Lord Indeed, I seek refuge in You that I (should) ask You what not I have of it knowledge And unless You forgive me and You have mercy on me I will be among the losers

item.title: Hud:48
item.description:
Hud:48 - قِيلَ يَانُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى أُمَمٍ مِمَّنْ مَعَكَ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ مِنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
qīla yānūḥu ih'biṭ bisalāmin minnā wabarakātin ʿalayka waʿalā umamin mimman maʿaka wa-umamun sanumattiʿuhum thumma yamassuhum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun
It was said O Nuh Go down with peace from Us and blessings on you and on the nations from those with you But (to other) nations We will grant enjoyment then will touch them from Us a punishment painful

item.title: Hud:49
item.description:
Hud:49 - تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
til'ka min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhā ilayka mā kunta taʿlamuhā anta walā qawmuka min qabli hādhā fa-iṣ'bir inna l-ʿāqibata lil'muttaqīna
This (is) from the news (of) the unseen (which) We reveal to you Not you were knowing it you and not your people from before this So be patient indeed the end (is) for the God fearing

item.title: Hud:50
item.description:
Hud:50 - وَإِلَى عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
wa-ilā ʿādin akhāhum hūdan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu in antum illā muf'tarūna
And to Aad (We sent) their brother Hud He said O my people Worship Allah not (is) for you any god other than Him Not you (are) but inventors

item.title: Hud:51
item.description:
Hud:51 - يَاقَوْمِ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
yāqawmi lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran in ajriya illā ʿalā alladhī faṭaranī afalā taʿqilūna
O my people Not I ask you for it any reward Not (is) my reward except from the One Who created me Then will not you use reason

item.title: Hud:52
item.description:
Hud:52 - وَيَاقَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَى قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ
wayāqawmi is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran wayazid'kum quwwatan ilā quwwatikum walā tatawallaw muj'rimīna
And O my people Ask forgiveness (of) your Lord then turn in repentance to Him He will send (from) the sky (rain) upon you (in) abundance and increase you (in) strength (added) to your strength And (do) not turn away (as) criminals

item.title: Hud:53
item.description:
Hud:53 - قَالُوْا يَاهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَنْ قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
qālū yāhūdu mā ji'tanā bibayyinatin wamā naḥnu bitārikī ālihatinā ʿan qawlika wamā naḥnu laka bimu'minīna
They said O Hud You have not brought us You have not brought us clear proofs and not we (will) leave our gods on your saying and not we (are) in you believers

item.title: Hud:54
item.description:
Hud:54 - إِنْ نَقُولُ إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ قَالَ اِنِّیْ أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
in naqūlu illā iʿ'tarāka baʿḍu ālihatinā bisūin qāla innī ush'hidu l-laha wa-ish'hadū annī barīon mimmā tush'rikūna
Not we say except (that) have seized you some (of) our gods with evil He said Indeed, I [I] call Allah to witness [I] call Allah to witness and (you) bear witness that I am innocent of what you associate

item.title: Hud:55
item.description:
Hud:55 - مِنْ دُونِهِ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنْظِرُونِ
min dūnihi fakīdūnī jamīʿan thumma lā tunẓirūni
Other than Him Other than Him So plot against me all together then (do) not give me respite

item.title: Hud:56
item.description:
Hud:56 - اِنِّیْ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
innī tawakkaltu ʿalā l-lahi rabbī warabbikum mā min dābbatin illā huwa ākhidhun bināṣiyatihā inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
Indeed, I [I] put my trust upon Allah my Lord and your Lord (There is) not of a moving creature of a moving creature but He has grasp of its forelock Indeed my Lord (is) on a path straight

item.title: Hud:57
item.description:
Hud:57 - فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
fa-in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbī qawman ghayrakum walā taḍurrūnahu shayan inna rabbī ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓun
So if you turn away then verily I have conveyed to you what I was sent with [it] to you And my Lord will give succession And my Lord will give succession (to) a people other than you and not you will harm Him (in) anything Indeed my Lord (is) on all things a Guardian

item.title: Hud:58
item.description:
Hud:58 - وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā hūdan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wanajjaynāhum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin
And when came Our command We saved Hud and those who believed with him by a Mercy from Us and We saved them from a punishment severe

item.title: Hud:59
item.description:
Hud:59 - وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
watil'ka ʿādun jaḥadū biāyāti rabbihim waʿaṣaw rusulahu wa-ittabaʿū amra kulli jabbārin ʿanīdin
And this (was) Aad they rejected (the) Signs (of) their Lord and disobeyed His Messengers and followed (the) command (of) every tyrant obstinate

item.title: Hud:60
item.description:
Hud:60 - وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ
wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati alā inna ʿādan kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan liʿādin qawmi hūdin
And they were followed in this world (with) a curse and (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection No doubt Indeed Aad disbelieved their Lord So away with Aad (the) people (of) Hud

item.title: Hud:61
item.description:
Hud:61 - وَإِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ هُوَ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ
wa-ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu huwa ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-is'taʿmarakum fīhā fa-is'taghfirūhu thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī qarībun mujībun
And to Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih He said O my people Worship Allah not you have any god other than Him He produced you from the earth and settled you in it So ask forgiveness of Him then turn in repentance to Him Indeed my Lord (is) near All-Responsive

item.title: Hud:62
item.description:
Hud:62 - قَالُوْا يَاصَالِحُ قَدْ كُنْتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَذَا أَتَنْهَانَا أَنْ نَعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ
qālū yāṣāliḥu qad kunta fīnā marjuwwan qabla hādhā atanhānā an naʿbuda mā yaʿbudu ābāunā wa-innanā lafī shakkin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi murībin
They said O Salih Verily you were among us the one in whom hope was placed before this Do you forbid us that we worship what our forefathers worshipped our forefathers worshipped And indeed we surely (are) in doubt about what you call us to it suspicious

item.title: Hud:63
item.description:
Hud:63 - قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَءَاتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ
qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī waātānī min'hu raḥmatan faman yanṣurunī mina l-lahi in ʿaṣaytuhu famā tazīdūnanī ghayra takhsīrin
He said O my people Do you see if I am on a clear proof from my Lord and He has given me from Him a Mercy then who (can) help me against Allah if I (were to) disobey Him So not you would increase me but (in) loss

item.title: Hud:64
item.description:
Hud:64 - وَيَاقَوْمِ هَذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ اٰیَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ
wayāqawmi hādhihi nāqatu l-lahi lakum āyatan fadharūhā takul fī arḍi l-lahi walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābun qarībun
And O my people This she-camel (of) Allah (is) for you a Sign so leave her to eat in the earth (of) Allah and (do) not touch her with harm lest will seize you a punishment impending

item.title: Hud:65
item.description:
Hud:65 - فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ذٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ
faʿaqarūhā faqāla tamattaʿū fī dārikum thalāthata ayyāmin dhālika waʿdun ghayru makdhūbin
But they hamstrung her So he said Enjoy (yourselves) in your home(s) (for) three days That (is) a promise not (to) be belied

item.title: Hud:66
item.description:
Hud:66 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
falammā jāa amrunā najjaynā ṣāliḥan wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wamin khiz'yi yawmi-idhin inna rabbaka huwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu
So when came Our command We saved Salih and those who believed with him by a Mercy from Us and from (the) disgrace (of) that Day Indeed your Lord He (is) All-Strong All-Mighty

item.title: Hud:67
item.description:
Hud:67 - وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
wa-akhadha alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna
And seized those who wronged the thunderous blast then they became in their homes fallen prone

item.title: Hud:68
item.description:
Hud:68 - كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّهُمْ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِثَمُودَ
ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā inna thamūdā kafarū rabbahum alā buʿ'dan lithamūda
As if not they (had) prospered therein No doubt indeed Thamud disbelieved (in) their Lord so away with Thamud

item.title: Hud:69
item.description:
Hud:69 - وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ بِالْبُشْرَى قَالُوْا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَنْ جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ
walaqad jāat rusulunā ib'rāhīma bil-bush'rā qālū salāman qāla salāmun famā labitha an jāa biʿij'lin ḥanīdhin
And certainly came Our messengers (to) Ibrahim with glad tidings they said Peace He said Peace and not he delayed and not he delayed to bring a calf roasted

item.title: Hud:70
item.description:
Hud:70 - فَلَمَّا رَءَا أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
falammā raā aydiyahum lā taṣilu ilayhi nakirahum wa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmi lūṭin
But when he saw their hands not reaching to it he felt unfamiliar of them and felt apprehension from them a fear They said (Do) not fear Indeed, we [we] have been sent to (the) people (of) Lut

item.title: Hud:71
item.description:
Hud:71 - وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ
wa-im'ra-atuhu qāimatun faḍaḥikat fabasharnāhā bi-is'ḥāqa wamin warāi is'ḥāqa yaʿqūba
And his wife (was) standing and she laughed Then We gave her glad tidings of Isaac and after and after Isaac (of) Yaqub

item.title: Hud:72
item.description:
Hud:72 - قَالَتْ يَاوَيْلَتَى ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
qālat yāwaylatā a-alidu wa-anā ʿajūzun wahādhā baʿlī shaykhan inna hādhā lashayon ʿajībun
She said Woe to me Shall I bear a child while I am an old woman and this my husband (is) an old man Indeed this (is) surely a thing amazing

item.title: Hud:73
item.description:
Hud:73 - قَالُوْا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
qālū ataʿjabīna min amri l-lahi raḥmatu l-lahi wabarakātuhu ʿalaykum ahla l-bayti innahu ḥamīdun majīdun
They said Are you amazed at (the) decree of Allah (the) decree of Allah The Mercy of Allah The Mercy of Allah and His blessings (be) upon you people (of) the house Indeed, He (is) All-Praiseworthy All-Glorious

item.title: Hud:74
item.description:
Hud:74 - فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَى يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
falammā dhahaba ʿan ib'rāhīma l-rawʿu wajāathu l-bush'rā yujādilunā fī qawmi lūṭin
And when (had) gone away from Ibrahim the fright and had reached him the glad tidings he argued with Us concerning the people of Lut

item.title: Hud:75
item.description:
Hud:75 - إِنَّ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ
inna ib'rāhīma laḥalīmun awwāhun munībun
Indeed Ibrahim (was) certainly forbearing imploring and oft-returning

item.title: Hud:76
item.description:
Hud:76 - يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ
yāib'rāhīmu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā innahu qad jāa amru rabbika wa-innahum ātīhim ʿadhābun ghayru mardūdin
O Ibrahim Turn away from this Indeed, it certainly has come (the) Command (of) your Lord and indeed, [they] (will) come (for) them a punishment (which) cannot (be) repelled

item.title: Hud:77
item.description:
Hud:77 - وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ
walammā jāat rusulunā lūṭan sīa bihim waḍāqa bihim dharʿan waqāla hādhā yawmun ʿaṣībun
And when came Our messengers (to) Lut he was distressed for them and felt straitened for them (and) uneasy and said This (is) a day distressful

item.title: Hud:78
item.description:
