Hud:78 - وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي أَلَيْسَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَشِيدٌ wajāahu qawmuhu yuh'raʿūna ilayhi wamin qablu kānū yaʿmalūna l-sayiāti qāla yāqawmi hāulāi banātī hunna aṭharu lakum fa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni fī ḍayfī alaysa minkum rajulun rashīdun And came (to) him his people rushing to him and before and before they (had) been doing the evil deeds He said O my people These (are) my daughters they (are) purer for you So fear Allah and (do) not disgrace me concerning my guests Is (there) not among you a man right-minded
  • [1] That is, it would be purer for you to get married to them.

item.title: Hud:79
item.description:
Hud:79 - قَالُوْا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
qālū laqad ʿalim'ta mā lanā fī banātika min ḥaqqin wa-innaka lataʿlamu mā nurīdu
They said Verily you know (that) not we have concerning your daughters any right And indeed, you surely know what we want

item.title: Hud:80
item.description:
Hud:80 - قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِي إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
qāla law anna lī bikum quwwatan aw āwī ilā ruk'nin shadīdin
He said If that I had over you power or I could take refuge in a support strong

item.title: Hud:81
item.description:
Hud:81 - قَالُوْا يَالُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنْ يَصِلُوْۤا إِلَيْكَ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ
qālū yālūṭu innā rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilū ilayka fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun illā im'ra-ataka innahu muṣībuhā mā aṣābahum inna mawʿidahumu l-ṣub'ḥu alaysa l-ṣub'ḥu biqarībin
They said O Lut Indeed, we (are) messengers (of) your Lord never they will reach you So travel with your family in a part of the night and (let) not look back anyone of you anyone of you except your wife Indeed, it will strike her what will strike them Indeed their appointed time (is) morning Is not the morning near

item.title: Hud:82
item.description:
Hud:82 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ مَنْضُودٍ falammā jāa amrunā jaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhā ḥijāratan min sijjīlin manḍūdin So when came Our Command We made its upside its downside and We rained upon them stones of baked clay (in) layers
  • [1] That is, of the city of Sodom.

item.title: Hud:83
item.description:
Hud:83 - مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika wamā hiya mina l-ẓālimīna bibaʿīdin Marked from your Lord And not it (is) from the wrongdoers far
  • [1] Or 'targeted.'
  • [2] Cf. (Q 51:34).

item.title: Hud:84
item.description:
Hud:84 - وَإِلَى مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ وَلَا تَنْقُصُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ اِنِّیْ أَرَاكُمْ بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُحِيطٍ
wa-ilā madyana akhāhum shuʿayban qāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu walā tanquṣū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna innī arākum bikhayrin wa-innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin muḥīṭin
And to Madyan their brother Shuaib He said O my people Worship Allah not (is) for you any god other than Him And (do) not decrease (from) the measure and the scale Indeed, I see you in prosperity but indeed, I fear for you punishment (of) a Day all-encompassing

item.title: Hud:85
item.description:
Hud:85 - وَيَاقَوْمِ أَوْفُوْۤا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوْۤا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ wayāqawmi awfū l-mik'yāla wal-mīzāna bil-qis'ṭi walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna And O my people Give full measure and weight in justice and (do) not deprive the people (of) their things and (do) not act wickedly in the earth spreading corruption
  • [1] That is, by employing short weights and measures.

item.title: Hud:86
item.description:
Hud:86 - بَقِيَّتُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَفِيظٍ baqiyyatu l-lahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mu'minīna wamā anā ʿalaykum biḥafīẓin (What) remains (from) Allah (is) best for you if you are believers And not I am over you a guardian
  • [1] That is, of your lawful earnings.

item.title: Hud:87
item.description:
Hud:87 - قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ نَتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا أَوْ أَنْ نَفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ إِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ
qālū yāshuʿaybu aṣalatuka tamuruka an natruka mā yaʿbudu ābāunā aw an nafʿala fī amwālinā mā nashāu innaka la-anta l-ḥalīmu l-rashīdu
They said O Shuaib Does your prayer command you that we leave what worship our forefathers or that we do concerning our wealth what we will Indeed you surely you (are) the forbearing the right-minded

item.title: Hud:88
item.description:
Hud:88 - قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَى مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ qāla yāqawmi ara-aytum in kuntu ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbī warazaqanī min'hu riz'qan ḥasanan wamā urīdu an ukhālifakum ilā mā anhākum ʿanhu in urīdu illā l-iṣ'lāḥa mā is'taṭaʿtu wamā tawfīqī illā bil-lahi ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību He said O my people Do you see if I am on a clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me from Himself a good provision a good provision And not I intend that I differ from you in what I forbid you from it Not I intend except the reform as much as I am able as much as I am able And not (is) my success except with Allah Upon Him I trust and to Him I turn
  • [1] That is, 'If I stand on a clear proof from my Lord, who has provided me with lawful means of livelihood, is it a right thing for you to reject my call to faith in Allah and fair dealing?'

item.title: Hud:89
item.description:
Hud:89 - وَيَاقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي أَنْ يُصِيبَكُمْ مِثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِنْكُمْ بِبَعِيدٍ
wayāqawmi lā yajrimannakum shiqāqī an yuṣībakum mith'lu mā aṣāba qawma nūḥin aw qawma hūdin aw qawma ṣāliḥin wamā qawmu lūṭin minkum bibaʿīdin
And O my people (Let) not cause you to sin (Let) not cause you to sin my dissension lest befalls you similar (to) what befell (the) people of Nuh (the) people of Nuh or (the) people of Hud (the) people of Hud or people of Salih people of Salih And not (are the) people of Lut (are the) people of Lut from you far off

item.title: Hud:90
item.description:
Hud:90 - وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ
wa-is'taghfirū rabbakum thumma tūbū ilayhi inna rabbī raḥīmun wadūdun
And ask forgiveness (of) your Lord then turn in repentance to Him Indeed my Lord (is) Most Merciful Most Loving

item.title: Hud:91
item.description:
Hud:91 - قَالُوْا يَاشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ
qālū yāshuʿaybu mā nafqahu kathīran mimmā taqūlu wa-innā lanarāka fīnā ḍaʿīfan walawlā rahṭuka larajamnāka wamā anta ʿalaynā biʿazīzin
They said O Shuaib Not we understand much of what you say and indeed, we surely [we] see you among us weak And if not for your family surely we would have stoned you and you are not and you are not against us mighty

item.title: Hud:92
item.description:
Hud:92 - قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
qāla yāqawmi arahṭī aʿazzu ʿalaykum mina l-lahi wa-ittakhadhtumūhu warāakum ẓih'riyyan inna rabbī bimā taʿmalūna muḥīṭun
He said O my people Is my family mightier on you than Allah And you have taken Him behind your backs Indeed my Lord of what you do (is) All-Encompassing

item.title: Hud:93
item.description:
Hud:93 - وَيَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ وَارْتَقِبُوا اِنِّیْ مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ
wayāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun sawfa taʿlamūna man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi waman huwa kādhibun wa-ir'taqibū innī maʿakum raqībun
And O my people Work (according) to your position indeed, I am working Soon you will know (on) whom will come a punishment (that will) disgrace him and who he (is) a liar And watch indeed, I am with you a watcher

item.title: Hud:94
item.description:
Hud:94 - وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ
walammā jāa amrunā najjaynā shuʿayban wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu biraḥmatin minnā wa-akhadhati alladhīna ẓalamū l-ṣayḥatu fa-aṣbaḥū fī diyārihim jāthimīna
And when came Our Command We saved Shuaib and those who believed with him by a Mercy from Us And seized those who wronged the thunderous blast then they became in their homes fallen prone

item.title: Hud:95
item.description:
Hud:95 - كَأَنْ لَمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا أَلَا بُعْدًا لِمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ
ka-an lam yaghnaw fīhā alā buʿ'dan limadyana kamā baʿidat thamūdu
As if not they (had) prospered therein So away with Madyan as was taken away the Thamud

item.title: Hud:96
item.description:
Hud:96 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin
And certainly We sent Musa with Our Signs and an authority clear

item.title: Hud:97
item.description:
Hud:97 - إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ
ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-ittabaʿū amra fir'ʿawna wamā amru fir'ʿawna birashīdin
To Firaun and his chiefs but they followed (the) command of Firaun (the) command of Firaun and not (the) command of Firaun (the) command of Firaun was right

item.title: Hud:98
item.description:
Hud:98 - يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ yaqdumu qawmahu yawma l-qiyāmati fa-awradahumu l-nāra wabi'sa l-wir'du l-mawrūdu He will precede his people (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection and lead them (into) the Fire And wretched (is) the place to which (they are) led
  • [1] Or 'an evil watering place for the thirsty.'

item.title: Hud:99
item.description:
Hud:99 - وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ
wa-ut'biʿū fī hādhihi laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati bi'sa l-rif'du l-marfūdu
And they were followed in this (by) a curse and (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection Wretched (is) the gift which (will) be given

item.title: Hud:100
item.description:
Hud:100 - ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْقُرٰی نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ
dhālika min anbāi l-qurā naquṣṣuhu ʿalayka min'hā qāimun waḥaṣīdun
That (is) from (the) news (of) the cities (which) We relate to you of them some are standing and (some) mown

item.title: Hud:101
item.description:
Hud:101 - وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَمَا أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ لَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin ẓalamū anfusahum famā aghnat ʿanhum ālihatuhumu allatī yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi min shayin lammā jāa amru rabbika wamā zādūhum ghayra tatbībin And not We wronged them but they wronged themselves So not availed them their gods which they invoked other than Allah other than Allah other than Allah any thing when came (the) command (of) your Lord (the) command (of) your Lord And not they increased them other than ruin
  • [1] That is, their false gods.

item.title: Hud:102
item.description:
Hud:102 - وَكَذٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرٰی وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ اَلِیْمٌ شَدِيدٌ
wakadhālika akhdhu rabbika idhā akhadha l-qurā wahiya ẓālimatun inna akhdhahu alīmun shadīdun
And thus (is) the seizure (of) your Lord (is) the seizure (of) your Lord when He seizes the cities while they (are) doing wrong Indeed His seizure (is) painful (and) severe

item.title: Hud:103
item.description:
Hud:103 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْاٰخِرَةُ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan liman khāfa ʿadhāba l-ākhirati dhālika yawmun majmūʿun lahu l-nāsu wadhālika yawmun mashhūdun
Indeed in that (is) surely a Sign for (those) who fear (the) punishment (of) the Hereafter That (is) a Day (will) be gathered on it the mankind and that (is) a Day witnessed

item.title: Hud:104
item.description:
Hud:104 - وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَعْدُودٍ
wamā nu-akhiruhu illā li-ajalin maʿdūdin
And not We delay it except for a term limited

item.title: Hud:105
item.description:
Hud:105 - يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ
yawma yati lā takallamu nafsun illā bi-idh'nihi famin'hum shaqiyyun wasaʿīdun
(The) Day (it) comes not will speak a soul except by His leave Then among them (will be the) wretched and (the) glad

item.title: Hud:106
item.description:
Hud:106 - فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوْۤا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ
fa-ammā alladhīna shaqū fafī l-nāri lahum fīhā zafīrun washahīqun
As for those who were wretched then (they will be) in the Fire For them therein (is) sighing and wailing

item.title: Hud:107
item.description:
Hud:107 - خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ
khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka inna rabbaka faʿʿālun limā yurīdu
(Will be) abiding therein as long as remain as long as remain the heavens and the earth except what your Lord wills what your Lord wills what your Lord wills Indeed your Lord (is) All-Accomplisher of what He intends

item.title: Hud:108
item.description:
Hud:108 - وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوْۤا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ
wa-ammā alladhīna suʿidū fafī l-janati khālidīna fīhā mā dāmati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu illā mā shāa rabbuka ʿaṭāan ghayra majdhūdhin
And as for those who were glad then (they will be) in Paradise (will be) abiding therein as long as remains as long as remains the heavens and the earth except what your Lord wills what your Lord wills what your Lord wills a bestowal not interrupted

item.title: Hud:109
item.description:
Hud:109 - فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَؤُلَاءِ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنْقُوصٍ falā taku fī mir'yatin mimmā yaʿbudu hāulāi mā yaʿbudūna illā kamā yaʿbudu ābāuhum min qablu wa-innā lamuwaffūhum naṣībahum ghayra manqūṣin So (do) not be in doubt as to what worship these (polytheists) Not they worship except as what worshipped their forefathers before before And indeed, We will surely pay them in full their share without being diminished
  • [1] That is, the idolaters of Arabia.

item.title: Hud:110
item.description:
Hud:110 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin
And verily We gave Musa the Book but differences arose therein And if not (for) a Word (that) preceded from your Lord surely would have been judged between them And indeed, they surely (are) in doubt concerning it suspicious

item.title: Hud:111
item.description:
Hud:111 - وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
wa-inna kullan lammā layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka aʿmālahum innahu bimā yaʿmalūna khabīrun
And indeed to each [when] to each [when] surely will pay them in full your Lord their deeds Indeed, He of what they do (is) All-Aware

item.title: Hud:112
item.description:
Hud:112 - فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَنْ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
fa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta waman tāba maʿaka walā taṭghaw innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
So stand firm as you are commanded and (those) who turn (in repentance) with you and (do) not transgress Indeed, He of what you do (is) All-Seer

item.title: Hud:113
item.description:
Hud:113 - وَلَا تَرْكَنُوْۤا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ
walā tarkanū ilā alladhīna ẓalamū fatamassakumu l-nāru wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min awliyāa thumma lā tunṣarūna
And (do) not incline to those who do wrong lest touches you the Fire and not (is) for you besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah any protectors then not you will be helped

item.title: Hud:114
item.description:
Hud:114 - وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ذٰلِكَ ذِكْرٰی لِلذَّاكِرِينَ wa-aqimi l-ṣalata ṭarafayi l-nahāri wazulafan mina al-layli inna l-ḥasanāti yudh'hib'na l-sayiāti dhālika dhik'rā lildhākirīna And establish the prayer (at the) two ends (of) the day and (at) the approach of the night Indeed the good deeds remove the evil deeds That (is) a reminder for those who remember
  • [1] That is, at dawn and sunset.
  • [2] Or 'Indeed good deeds remove ills,' or 'Indeed virtues efface vices.'

item.title: Hud:115
item.description:
Hud:115 - وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
wa-iṣ'bir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna
And be patient for indeed Allah (does) not let go waste (the) reward (of) the good-doers

item.title: Hud:116
item.description:
Hud:116 - فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُوْۤا بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّنْ أَنْجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا أُتْرِفُوْۤا فِیْهِ وَكَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ
falawlā kāna mina l-qurūni min qablikum ulū baqiyyatin yanhawna ʿani l-fasādi fī l-arḍi illā qalīlan mimman anjaynā min'hum wa-ittabaʿa alladhīna ẓalamū mā ut'rifū fīhi wakānū muj'rimīna
So why not had been of the generations before you before you those possessing a remnant those possessing a remnant forbidding from the corruption in the earth except a few of those We saved among them But followed those who did wrong what luxury they were given therein and they were criminals

item.title: Hud:117
item.description:
Hud:117 - وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰی بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ
wamā kāna rabbuka liyuh'lika l-qurā biẓul'min wa-ahluhā muṣ'liḥūna
And not would your Lord destroy the cities unjustly while its people (were) reformers

item.title: Hud:118
item.description:
Hud:118 - وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ
walaw shāa rabbuka lajaʿala l-nāsa ummatan wāḥidatan walā yazālūna mukh'talifīna
And if your Lord (had) willed your Lord (had) willed surely He (could) have made the mankind one community one community but not they will cease to differ

item.title: Hud:119
item.description:
Hud:119 - إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ illā man raḥima rabbuka walidhālika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika la-amla-anna jahannama mina l-jinati wal-nāsi ajmaʿīna Except (on) whom your Lord has bestowed Mercy your Lord has bestowed Mercy and for that He created them And will be fulfilled (the) Word of your Lord (the) Word of your Lord Surely I will fill Hell with the Jinn and the men all together
  • [1] That is, all of those who are followers of Satan. See (Q 38:85).

item.title: Hud:120
item.description:
Hud:120 - وَكُلًّا نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَى لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wakullan naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi l-rusuli mā nuthabbitu bihi fuādaka wajāaka fī hādhihi l-ḥaqu wamawʿiẓatun wadhik'rā lil'mu'minīna
And each We relate to you of (the) news (of) the Messengers (for) that We may make firm with it your heart And has come to you in this the truth and an admonition and a reminder for the believers

item.title: Hud:121
item.description:
Hud:121 - وَقُلْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ
waqul lilladhīna lā yu'minūna iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innā ʿāmilūna
And say to those who (do) not believe Work (according) to your position indeed, we (are also) working

item.title: Hud:122
item.description:
Hud:122 - وَانْتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنْتَظِرُونَ
wa-intaẓirū innā muntaẓirūna
And wait indeed, we (are) ones who wait

item.title: Hud:123
item.description:
Hud:123 - وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
walillahi ghaybu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilayhi yur'jaʿu l-amru kulluhu fa-uʿ'bud'hu watawakkal ʿalayhi wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
And for Allah (is the) unseen (of) the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter all (of) it so worship Him and put your trust upon Him And your Lord is not And your Lord is not unaware of what you do

item.title: 12. يوسف (Yusuf)
item.description:
The surah that narrates the edifying and enthralling life experience of the noble prophet and interpreter of dreams, Joseph—son of Jacob, son of Isaac, son of Abraham—calling it "the fairest of stories," an inspirational triumph of morality and faith. "Yūsuf" is the Arabic for "Joseph", whose well-known story is told in this surah. Even though the surah primarily deals with the story of Joseph, it is framed by a three-verse introduction about the Quran and a ten-verse epilogue about the Meccans" response, the punishment met by earlier disbelievers, and encouragement for the Prophet.

12:1
الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni
Alif Laam Ra These (are the) Verses (of) the Book [the] clear

12:2
إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
innā anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna
Indeed, We We have sent it down (as) a Quran in Arabic (as) a Quran in Arabic so that you may understand

12:3
نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ
naḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka aḥsana l-qaṣaṣi bimā awḥaynā ilayka hādhā l-qur'āna wa-in kunta min qablihi lamina l-ghāfilīna
We relate to you the best of the narrations in what We have revealed to you (of) this the Quran although you were before it before it surely among the unaware

item.title: Yusuf:1
item.description:
Yusuf:1 - الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni
Alif Laam Ra These (are the) Verses (of) the Book [the] clear

item.title: Yusuf:2
item.description:
Yusuf:2 - إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
innā anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna
Indeed, We We have sent it down (as) a Quran in Arabic (as) a Quran in Arabic so that you may understand

item.title: Yusuf:3
item.description:
Yusuf:3 - نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ naḥnu naquṣṣu ʿalayka aḥsana l-qaṣaṣi bimā awḥaynā ilayka hādhā l-qur'āna wa-in kunta min qablihi lamina l-ghāfilīna We relate to you the best of the narrations in what We have revealed to you (of) this the Quran although you were before it before it surely among the unaware
  • [1] Or 'We will tell you a story in the best style of narration.'

item.title: Yusuf:4
item.description:
Yusuf:4 - إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ idh qāla yūsufu li-abīhi yāabati innī ra-aytu aḥada ʿashara kawkaban wal-shamsa wal-qamara ra-aytuhum lī sājidīna When said Yusuf to his father O my father Indeed, I I saw eleven eleven stars and the sun and the moon I saw them to me prostrating
  • [1] Or 'stars.'

item.title: Yusuf:5
item.description:
Yusuf:5 - قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَى إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ
qāla yābunayya lā taqṣuṣ ru'yāka ʿalā ikh'watika fayakīdū laka kaydan inna l-shayṭāna lil'insāni ʿaduwwun mubīnun
He said O my son (Do) not relate your vision to your brothers lest they plan against you a plot Indeed the Shaitaan (is) to man an enemy open

item.title: Yusuf:6
item.description:
Yusuf:6 - وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا أَتَمَّهَا عَلَى أَبَوَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wakadhālika yajtabīka rabbuka wayuʿallimuka min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wayutimmu niʿ'matahu ʿalayka waʿalā āli yaʿqūba kamā atammahā ʿalā abawayka min qablu ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa inna rabbaka ʿalīmun ḥakīmun And thus will choose you your Lord and will teach you of (the) interpretation (of) the narratives and complete His Favor on you and on (the) family (of) Yaqub as He completed it on your two forefathers before before Ibrahim and Isaac Indeed your Lord (is) All-Knower All-Wise
  • [1] Or 'the interpretation of visions.'

item.title: Yusuf:7
item.description:
Yusuf:7 - لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ
laqad kāna fī yūsufa wa-ikh'watihi āyātun lilssāilīna
Certainly were in Yusuf and his brothers signs for those who ask

item.title: Yusuf:8
item.description:
Yusuf:8 - إِذْ قَالُوْا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اَبِیْنَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ idh qālū layūsufu wa-akhūhu aḥabbu ilā abīnā minnā wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun inna abānā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin When they said Surely Yusuf and his brother (are) more beloved to our father than we while we (are) a group Indeed our father (is) surely in an error clear
  • [1] That is, the brothers of Joseph ('a).
  • [2] That is, Benjamin.

item.title: Yusuf:9
item.description:
Yusuf:9 - اُقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ قَوْمًا صَالِحِينَ
uq'tulū yūsufa awi iṭ'raḥūhu arḍan yakhlu lakum wajhu abīkum watakūnū min baʿdihi qawman ṣāliḥīna
Kill Yusuf or cast him (to) a land so will be free for you (the) face (of) your father and you will be after that after that a people righteous

item.title: Yusuf:10
item.description:
Yusuf:10 - قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوْۤا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السَّيَّارَةِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
qāla qāilun min'hum lā taqtulū yūsufa wa-alqūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi yaltaqiṭ'hu baʿḍu l-sayārati in kuntum fāʿilīna
Said a speaker among them (Do) not kill Yusuf but throw him in the bottom (of) the well will pick him some [the] caravan if you are doing

item.title: Yusuf:11
item.description:
Yusuf:11 - قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ
qālū yāabānā mā laka lā tamannā ʿalā yūsufa wa-innā lahu lanāṣiḥūna
They said O our father Why (do) you not trust us with Yusuf while indeed, we (are) for him surely well-wishers

item.title: Yusuf:12
item.description:
Yusuf:12 - أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
arsil'hu maʿanā ghadan yartaʿ wayalʿab wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna
Send him with us tomorrow (to) enjoy and play And indeed, we for him (will) surely (be) guardians

item.title: Yusuf:13
item.description:
Yusuf:13 - قَالَ اِنِّیْ لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَنْ تَذْهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَأَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ غَافِلُونَ
qāla innī layaḥzununī an tadhhabū bihi wa-akhāfu an yakulahu l-dhi'bu wa-antum ʿanhu ghāfilūna
He said Indeed, [I] it surely saddens me that you should take him you should take him and I fear that would eat him a wolf while you of him (are) unaware

item.title: Yusuf:14
item.description:
Yusuf:14 - قَالُوْا لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّا إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ
qālū la-in akalahu l-dhi'bu wanaḥnu ʿuṣ'batun innā idhan lakhāsirūna
They said If eats him the wolf while we (are) a group indeed, we then surely (would be) losers

item.title: Yusuf:15
item.description:
Yusuf:15 - فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوْۤا بِهِ وَاَجْمَعُوْۤا أَنْ يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَبَتِ الْجُبِّ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
falammā dhahabū bihi wa-ajmaʿū an yajʿalūhu fī ghayābati l-jubi wa-awḥaynā ilayhi latunabbi-annahum bi-amrihim hādhā wahum lā yashʿurūna
So when they took him they took him and agreed that they put him in (the) bottom (of) the well But We inspired to him Surely, you will inform them about this affair about this affair while they (do) not perceive

item.title: Yusuf:16
item.description:
Yusuf:16 - وَجَآءُوْ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ
wajāū abāhum ʿishāan yabkūna
And they came (to) their father early at night weeping

item.title: Yusuf:17
item.description:
Yusuf:17 - قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِنْدَ مَتَاعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَادِقِينَ
qālū yāabānā innā dhahabnā nastabiqu wataraknā yūsufa ʿinda matāʿinā fa-akalahu l-dhi'bu wamā anta bimu'minin lanā walaw kunnā ṣādiqīna
They said O our father Indeed, we [we] went racing each other and we left Yusuf with our possessions and ate him the wolf But not you (will) believe us even if we are truthful

item.title: Yusuf:18
item.description:
Yusuf:18 - وَجَآءُوْ عَلَى قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ
wajāū ʿalā qamīṣihi bidamin kadhibin qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun wal-lahu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna
And they brought upon his shirt with false blood with false blood He said Nay has enticed you has enticed you your souls (to) a matter so patience (is) beautiful And Allah (is) the One sought for help against what you describe

item.title: Yusuf:19
item.description:
Yusuf:19 - وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَاَدْلٰی دَلْوَهُ قَالَ يَابُشْرَى هَذَا غُلَامٌ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
wajāat sayyāratun fa-arsalū wāridahum fa-adlā dalwahu qāla yābush'rā hādhā ghulāmun wa-asarrūhu biḍāʿatan wal-lahu ʿalīmun bimā yaʿmalūna
And there came a caravan and they sent their water drawer then he let down his bucket He said O good news This (is) a boy And they hid him (as) a merchandise And Allah (is) All-Knower of what they do

item.title: Yusuf:20
item.description:
Yusuf:20 - وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ
washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darāhima maʿdūdatin wakānū fīhi mina l-zāhidīna
And they sold him for a price very low dirhams few and they were about him of those keen to give up

item.title: Yusuf:21
item.description:
Yusuf:21 - وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِنْ مِصْرَ لِامْرَاَتِهٖۤ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ وَاللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَى أَمْرِهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ waqāla alladhī ish'tarāhu min miṣ'ra li-im'ra-atihi akrimī mathwāhu ʿasā an yanfaʿanā aw nattakhidhahu waladan wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fī l-arḍi walinuʿallimahu min tawīli l-aḥādīthi wal-lahu ghālibun ʿalā amrihi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna And said the one who bought him of Egypt to his wife Make comfortable his stay Perhaps that (he) will benefit us or we will take him (as) a son And thus We established Yusuf in the land that We might teach him (the) interpretation of (the) interpretation of the events And Allah (is) Predominant over His affairs but most (of) the people (do) not know
  • [1] Or 'Keep him in a respectable manner.'

item.title: Yusuf:22
item.description:
Yusuf:22 - وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
walammā balagha ashuddahu ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wakadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
And when he reached his maturity We gave him wisdom and knowledge And thus We reward the good-doers

item.title: Yusuf:23
item.description:
Yusuf:23 - وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ warāwadathu allatī huwa fī baytihā ʿan nafsihi waghallaqati l-abwāba waqālat hayta laka qāla maʿādha l-lahi innahu rabbī aḥsana mathwāya innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūna And sought to seduce him she who he (was) in her house from his self And she closed the doors and she said Come on you He said I seek refuge in Allah I seek refuge in Allah Indeed, he (is) my lord (who has) made good my stay Indeed not will succeed the wrongdoers
  • [1] Or 'Indeed he is my master; he has kept me in a nice manner.'

item.title: Yusuf:24
item.description:
Yusuf:24 - وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَنْ رَءَا بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
walaqad hammat bihi wahamma bihā lawlā an raā bur'hāna rabbihi kadhālika linaṣrifa ʿanhu l-sūa wal-faḥshāa innahu min ʿibādinā l-mukh'laṣīna
And certainly she did desire him and he would have desired her if not that he saw the proof (of) his Lord Thus that We might avert from him the evil and the immorality Indeed, he (was) of Our slaves the sincere

item.title: Yusuf:25
item.description:
Yusuf:25 - وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِنْ دُبُرٍ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الْبَابِ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءًا إِلَّا أَنْ يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
wa-is'tabaqā l-bāba waqaddat qamīṣahu min duburin wa-alfayā sayyidahā ladā l-bābi qālat mā jazāu man arāda bi-ahlika sūan illā an yus'jana aw ʿadhābun alīmun
And they both raced (to) the door and she tore his shirt from the back and they both found her husband at the door She said What (is) the recompense (of one) who intended for your wife evil except that he be imprisoned or a punishment painful

item.title: Yusuf:26
item.description:
Yusuf:26 - قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
qāla hiya rāwadatnī ʿan nafsī washahida shāhidun min ahlihā in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min qubulin faṣadaqat wahuwa mina l-kādhibīna
He said She sought to seduce me about myself And testified a witness of her family If is his shirt (is) torn from the front then she has spoken the truth and he (is) of the liars

item.title: Yusuf:27
item.description:
Yusuf:27 - وَإِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
wa-in kāna qamīṣuhu qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa mina l-ṣādiqīna
But if is his shirt (is) torn from (the) back then she has lied and he (is) of the truthful

item.title: Yusuf:28
item.description:
Yusuf:28 - فَلَمَّا رَءَا قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِنْ دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِنْ كَيْدِكُنَّ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ
falammā raā qamīṣahu qudda min duburin qāla innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna ʿaẓīmun
So when he saw his shirt torn from (the) back he said Indeed, it (is) of your plot Indeed your plot (is) great

item.title: Yusuf:29
item.description:
Yusuf:29 - يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَذَا وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنْبِكِ إِنَّكِ كُنْتِ مِنَ الْخٰطِـِٕیْنَ۠
yūsufu aʿriḍ ʿan hādhā wa-is'taghfirī lidhanbiki innaki kunti mina l-khāṭiīna
Yusuf turn away from this And ask forgiveness for your sin Indeed, you are of the sinful

item.title: Yusuf:30
item.description:
Yusuf:30 - وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا إِنَّا لَنَرَاهَا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
waqāla nis'watun fī l-madīnati im'ra-atu l-ʿazīzi turāwidu fatāhā ʿan nafsihi qad shaghafahā ḥubban innā lanarāhā fī ḍalālin mubīnin
And said women in the city The wife of Aziz (is) seeking to seduce her slave boy about himself indeed he has impassioned her (with) love Indeed, we [we] surely see her in an error clear

item.title: Yusuf:31
item.description:
Yusuf:31 - فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَءًا وَءَاتَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُ أَكْبَرْنَهُ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ مَا هَذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ
falammā samiʿat bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa-aʿtadat lahunna muttaka-an waātat kulla wāḥidatin min'hunna sikkīnan waqālati ukh'ruj ʿalayhinna falammā ra-aynahu akbarnahu waqaṭṭaʿna aydiyahunna waqul'na ḥāsha lillahi mā hādhā basharan in hādhā illā malakun karīmun
So when she heard of their scheming she sent for them and she prepared for them a banquet and she gave each one of them a knife and she said Come out before them Then when they saw him they greatly admired him and cut their hands they said Forbid Allah not (is) this a man not (is) this but an angel noble

item.title: Yusuf:32
item.description:
Yusuf:32 - قَالَتْ فَذَلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِیْهِ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدْتُهُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ وَلَئِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا اٰمُرُهٗ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ
qālat fadhālikunna alladhī lum'tunnanī fīhi walaqad rāwadttuhu ʿan nafsihi fa-is'taʿṣama wala-in lam yafʿal mā āmuruhu layus'jananna walayakūnan mina l-ṣāghirīna
She said That (is) the one you blamed me about him And certainly I sought to seduce him from himself but he saved himself and if not he does what I order him surely, he will be imprisoned and certainly will be of those who are disgraced

item.title: Yusuf:33
item.description:
Yusuf:33 - قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُنْ مِنَ الْجٰهِلِیْنَ
qāla rabbi l-sij'nu aḥabbu ilayya mimmā yadʿūnanī ilayhi wa-illā taṣrif ʿannī kaydahunna aṣbu ilayhinna wa-akun mina l-jāhilīna
He said My Lord the prison (is) dearer to me than what they invite me to it And unless You turn away from me their plot I might incline towards them and [I] be of the ignorant

item.title: Yusuf:34
item.description:
Yusuf:34 - فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ فَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ كَيْدَهُنَّ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
fa-is'tajāba lahu rabbuhu faṣarafa ʿanhu kaydahunna innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu
So responded to him his Lord and turned away from him their plot Indeed, [He] He (is) All-Hearer All-Knower

item.title: Yusuf:35
item.description:
Yusuf:35 - ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ حَتّٰی حِينٍ thumma badā lahum min baʿdi mā ra-awū l-āyāti layasjununnahu ḥattā ḥīnin Then (it) appeared to them after after what they had seen the signs surely they should imprison him until a time
  • [1] That is, the menfolk.

item.title: Yusuf:36
item.description:
Yusuf:36 - وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا اِنِّیْ أَرَانِي أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا وَقَالَ الْءَاخَرُ اِنِّیْ أَرَانِي أَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِي خُبْزًا تَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ نَبِّئْنَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
wadakhala maʿahu l-sij'na fatayāni qāla aḥaduhumā innī arānī aʿṣiru khamran waqāla l-ākharu innī arānī aḥmilu fawqa rasī khub'zan takulu l-ṭayru min'hu nabbi'nā bitawīlihi innā narāka mina l-muḥ'sinīna
And entered with him (in) the prison two young men Said one of them Indeed, I [I] see myself pressing wine And said the other Indeed, I [I] see myself [I am] carrying over my head bread (were) eating the birds from it Inform us of its interpretation indeed, we [we] see you of the good-doers

item.title: Yusuf:37
item.description:
Yusuf:37 - قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمَا ذَلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّي اِنِّیْ تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
qāla lā yatīkumā ṭaʿāmun tur'zaqānihi illā nabbatukumā bitawīlihi qabla an yatiyakumā dhālikumā mimmā ʿallamanī rabbī innī taraktu millata qawmin lā yu'minūna bil-lahi wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna
He said Not (will) come to both of you food you are provided with but I will inform both of you of its interpretation before that [it] comes to both of you That (is) of what has taught me my Lord Indeed, I [I] abandon (the) religion (of) a people not they believe in Allah and they in the Hereafter they (are) disbelievers

item.title: Yusuf:38
item.description:
Yusuf:38 - وَاتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ ءَابَاءِي اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ مَا كَانَ لَنَا أَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
wa-ittabaʿtu millata ābāī ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba mā kāna lanā an nush'rika bil-lahi min shayin dhālika min faḍli l-lahi ʿalaynā waʿalā l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yashkurūna
And I follow (the) religion (of) my forefathers Ibrahim and Isaac and Yaqub Not was for us that we associate with Allah any thing That (is) from (the) Grace (of) Allah upon us and upon the mankind but most (of) the men (are) not grateful

item.title: Yusuf:39
item.description:
Yusuf:39 - يَاصَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ ءَأَرْبَابٌ مُتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
yāṣāḥibayi l-sij'ni a-arbābun mutafarriqūna khayrun ami l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru
O my two companions (of) the prison Are lords separate better or Allah the One the Irresistible

item.title: Yusuf:40
item.description:
Yusuf:40 - مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءً سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ ذٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
mā taʿbudūna min dūnihi illā asmāan sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā anzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin ini l-ḥuk'mu illā lillahi amara allā taʿbudū illā iyyāhu dhālika l-dīnu l-qayimu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
Not you worship besides Him besides Him but names which you have named them you and your forefathers not (has) sent down Allah for it any authority Not (is) the command but for Allah He has commanded that not you worship but Him Alone That (is) the religion the right but most [the] men (do) not know

item.title: Yusuf:41
item.description:
Yusuf:41 - يَاصَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَمَّا أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِي رَبَّهُ خَمْرًا وَأَمَّا الْءَاخَرُ فَيُصْلَبُ فَتَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِنْ رَأْسِهِ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ الَّذِي فِیْهِ تَسْتَفْتِيَانِ
yāṣāḥibayi l-sij'ni ammā aḥadukumā fayasqī rabbahu khamran wa-ammā l-ākharu fayuṣ'labu fatakulu l-ṭayru min rasihi quḍiya l-amru alladhī fīhi tastaftiyāni
O my two companions (of) the prison As for one of you he will give drink (to) his master wine and as for the other he will be crucified and will eat the birds from his head Has been decreed the matter about which about which you both inquire

item.title: Yusuf:42
item.description:
Yusuf:42 - وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ نَاجٍ مِنْهُمَا اذْكُرْنِي عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ فَأَنْسَاهُ الشَّيْطَانُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ
waqāla lilladhī ẓanna annahu nājin min'humā udh'kur'nī ʿinda rabbika fa-ansāhu l-shayṭānu dhik'ra rabbihi falabitha fī l-sij'ni biḍ'ʿa sinīna
And he said to the one whom he thought that he (would be) saved of both of them Mention me to your master But made him forget the Shaitaan (the) mention (to) his master so he remained in the prison several years

item.title: Yusuf:43
item.description:
Yusuf:43 - وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی سَبْعَ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعَ سُنْبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي رُءْيَايَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لِلرُّءْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ
waqāla l-maliku innī arā sabʿa baqarātin simānin yakuluhunna sabʿun ʿijāfun wasabʿa sunbulātin khuḍ'rin wa-ukhara yābisātin yāayyuhā l-mala-u aftūnī fī ru'yāya in kuntum lilrru'yā taʿburūna
And said the king Indeed, I [I] have seen seven cows fat eating them seven lean ones and seven ears (of corn) green and others dry O chiefs Explain to me about my vision if you can of visions interpret

item.title: Yusuf:44
item.description:
Yusuf:44 - قَالُوْا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلَامِ بِعَالِمِينَ
qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmin wamā naḥnu bitawīli l-aḥlāmi biʿālimīna
They said Confused dreams and not we (are) in the interpretation (of) the dreams learned

item.title: Yusuf:45
item.description:
Yusuf:45 - وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ أَنَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِتَأْوِيلِهِ فَأَرْسِلُونِ
waqāla alladhī najā min'humā wa-iddakara baʿda ummatin anā unabbi-ukum bitawīlihi fa-arsilūni
But said the one who was saved of the two and remembered after a period I [I] will inform you of its interpretation so send me forth

item.title: Yusuf:46
item.description:
Yusuf:46 - يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنْبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ لَعَلِّي أَرْجِعُ إِلَى النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
yūsufu ayyuhā l-ṣidīqu aftinā fī sabʿi baqarātin simānin yakuluhunna sabʿun ʿijāfun wasabʿi sunbulātin khuḍ'rin wa-ukhara yābisātin laʿallī arjiʿu ilā l-nāsi laʿallahum yaʿlamūna
Yusuf O the truthful one Explain to us about (the) seven cows fat eating them seven lean ones and seven ears (of corn) green and other dry that I may return to the people so that they may know

item.title: Yusuf:47
item.description:
Yusuf:47 - قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبًا فَمَا حَصَدْتُمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنْبُلِهِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ
qāla tazraʿūna sabʿa sinīna da-aban famā ḥaṣadttum fadharūhu fī sunbulihi illā qalīlan mimmā takulūna
He said You will sow (for) seven years as usual and that which you reap so leave it in its ears except a little from which you (will) eat

item.title: Yusuf:48
item.description:
Yusuf:48 - ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدَادٌ يَأْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ
thumma yatī min baʿdi dhālika sabʿun shidādun yakul'na mā qaddamtum lahunna illā qalīlan mimmā tuḥ'ṣinūna
Then will come after after that seven hard (years) (which will) consume what you advanced for them except a little of what you (will) store

item.title: Yusuf:49
item.description:
Yusuf:49 - ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِیْهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ thumma yatī min baʿdi dhālika ʿāmun fīhi yughāthu l-nāsu wafīhi yaʿṣirūna Then will come after after that a year in it will be given abundant rain the people and in it they will press
  • [1] The translation given here is in accordance with the reading yu'ṣarūn narrated from al-Imam al-Ṣādiq; see Majma' al-Bayān and Tafsīr al-Qummī; see also Lisān al-'Arab, under 'aṣr. The same reading is attributed to al-A'raj and 'Īsā al-Baṣrī (Mu'jam al-Qirā'āt al-Qur'āniyyah). However, in accordance with the reading ya'ṣirūn, the meaning will be 'they will press [i.e. grapes or oil seeds, for juice and oil] therein.'

item.title: Yusuf:50
item.description:
Yusuf:50 - وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ قَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَى رَبِّكَ فَسْءَلْهُ مَا بَالُ النِّسْوَةِ اللَّاتِي قَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِكَيْدِهِنَّ عَلِیْمٌ waqāla l-maliku i'tūnī bihi falammā jāahu l-rasūlu qāla ir'jiʿ ilā rabbika fasalhu mā bālu l-nis'wati allātī qaṭṭaʿna aydiyahunna inna rabbī bikaydihinna ʿalīmun And said the king Bring him to me Bring him to me But when came to him the messenger he said Return to your lord and ask him what (is the) case (of) the women who cut their hands Indeed my Lord of their plot (is) All-Knower
  • [1] That is, to Joseph ('a).

item.title: Yusuf:51
item.description:
Yusuf:51 - قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَاوَدْتُنَّ يُوسُفَ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ قُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سُوءٍ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ الْءَانَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ أَنَا رَاوَدْتُهُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
qāla mā khaṭbukunna idh rāwadttunna yūsufa ʿan nafsihi qul'na ḥāsha lillahi mā ʿalim'nā ʿalayhi min sūin qālati im'ra-atu l-ʿazīzi l-āna ḥaṣḥaṣa l-ḥaqu anā rāwadttuhu ʿan nafsihi wa-innahu lamina l-ṣādiqīna
He said What (was) your affair when you sought to seduce Yusuf from himself They said Allah forbid Allah forbid Not we know about him any evil Said (the) wife (of) Aziz Now (is) manifest the truth I sought to seduce him from himself and indeed, he (is) surely of the truthful

item.title: Yusuf:52
item.description:
Yusuf:52 - ذٰلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ أَنِّي لَمْ أَخُنْهُ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي كَيْدَ الْخَائِنِينَ dhālika liyaʿlama annī lam akhun'hu bil-ghaybi wa-anna l-laha lā yahdī kayda l-khāinīna That he may know that I not [I] betray him in secret and that Allah (does) not guide (the) plan (of) the betrayers
  • [1] That is, the Egyptian nobleman in whose house Joseph ('a) was living.

item.title: Yusuf:53
item.description:
Yusuf:53 - وَمَا أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِي إِنَّ النَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّي إِنَّ رَبِّي غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
wamā ubarri-u nafsī inna l-nafsa la-ammāratun bil-sūi illā mā raḥima rabbī inna rabbī ghafūrun raḥīmun
And not I absolve myself Indeed the soul (is) a certain enjoiner of evil unless that bestows Mercy my Lord Indeed my Lord (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Yusuf:54
item.description:
Yusuf:54 - وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِي فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُ قَالَ إِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌ
waqāla l-maliku i'tūnī bihi astakhliṣ'hu linafsī falammā kallamahu qāla innaka l-yawma ladaynā makīnun amīnun
And said the king Bring him to me Bring him to me I will select him for myself Then when he spoke to him he said Indeed, you (are) today with us firmly established (and) trusted

item.title: Yusuf:55
item.description:
Yusuf:55 - قَالَ اجْعَلْنِي عَلَى خَزَائِنِ الْأَرْضِ اِنِّیْ حَفِيظٌ عَلِیْمٌ
qāla ij'ʿalnī ʿalā khazāini l-arḍi innī ḥafīẓun ʿalīmun
He said Appoint me over (the) treasuries (of) the land Indeed, I (will be) a guardian knowing

item.title: Yusuf:56
item.description:
Yusuf:56 - وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ نُصِيبُ بِرَحْمَتِنَا مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَلَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
wakadhālika makkannā liyūsufa fī l-arḍi yatabawwa-u min'hā ḥaythu yashāu nuṣību biraḥmatinā man nashāu walā nuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna
And thus We established [to] Yusuf in the land to settle therein where ever he willed We bestow Our Mercy (on) whom We will And not We let go waste (the) reward (of) the good-doers

item.title: Yusuf:57
item.description:
Yusuf:57 - وَلَأَجْرُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ
wala-ajru l-ākhirati khayrun lilladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna
And surely (the) reward (of) the Hereafter (is) better for those who believe and are God conscious

item.title: Yusuf:58
item.description:
Yusuf:58 - وَجَاءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ
wajāa ikh'watu yūsufa fadakhalū ʿalayhi faʿarafahum wahum lahu munkirūna
And came (the) brothers (of) Yusuf and they entered upon him and he recognized them but they knew him not knew him not

item.title: Yusuf:59
item.description:
Yusuf:59 - وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمْ بِجَهَازِهِمْ قَالَ ائْتُونِي بِأَخٍ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَبِيكُمْ أَلَا تَرَوْنَ أَنِّي أُوفِي الْكَيْلَ وَأَنَا خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ
walammā jahhazahum bijahāzihim qāla i'tūnī bi-akhin lakum min abīkum alā tarawna annī ūfī l-kayla wa-anā khayru l-munzilīna
And when he had furnished them with their supplies he said Bring to me a brother of yours from your father Do not you see that I [I] give full [the] measure and that I am (the) best (of) the hosts

item.title: Yusuf:60
item.description:
Yusuf:60 - فَإِنْ لَمْ تَأْتُونِي بِهِ فَلَا كَيْلَ لَكُمْ عِنْدِي وَلَا تَقْرَبُونِ
fa-in lam tatūnī bihi falā kayla lakum ʿindī walā taqrabūni
But if not you bring him to me you bring him to me then (there will be) no measure for you from me and not you will come near me

item.title: Yusuf:61
item.description:
Yusuf:61 - قَالُوْا سَنُرَاوِدُ عَنْهُ أَبَاهُ وَإِنَّا لَفَاعِلُونَ
qālū sanurāwidu ʿanhu abāhu wa-innā lafāʿilūna
They said We will try to get permission for him (from) his father and indeed we surely will do

item.title: Yusuf:62
item.description:
Yusuf:62 - وَقَالَ لِفِتْيَانِهِ اجْعَلُوْۤا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ فِي رِحَالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهَا إِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلَى أَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
waqāla lifit'yānihi ij'ʿalū biḍāʿatahum fī riḥālihim laʿallahum yaʿrifūnahā idhā inqalabū ilā ahlihim laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
And he said to his servants Put their merchandise in their saddlebags so that they may recognize it when they go back to their people so that they may return

item.title: Yusuf:63
item.description:
Yusuf:63 - فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوْۤا إِلَى أَبِيهِمْ قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الْكَيْلُ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا أَخَانَا نَكْتَلْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
falammā rajaʿū ilā abīhim qālū yāabānā muniʿa minnā l-kaylu fa-arsil maʿanā akhānā naktal wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna
So when they returned to their father they said O our father Has been denied to us the measure so send with us our brother (that) we will get measure And indeed, we for him (will) surely (be) guardians

item.title: Yusuf:64
item.description:
Yusuf:64 - قَالَ هَلْ ءَامَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَا أَمِنْتُكُمْ عَلَى أَخِيهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
qāla hal āmanukum ʿalayhi illā kamā amintukum ʿalā akhīhi min qablu fal-lahu khayrun ḥāfiẓan wahuwa arḥamu l-rāḥimīna
He said Should I entrust you with him except as I entrusted you with his brother before before But Allah (is) the best Guardian and He (is the) Most Merciful (of) the merciful

item.title: Yusuf:65
item.description:
Yusuf:65 - وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوْۤا مَتَاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوْۤا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِي هَذِهِ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنَا وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ ذٰلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
walammā fataḥū matāʿahum wajadū biḍāʿatahum ruddat ilayhim qālū yāabānā mā nabghī hādhihi biḍāʿatunā ruddat ilaynā wanamīru ahlanā wanaḥfaẓu akhānā wanazdādu kayla baʿīrin dhālika kaylun yasīrun
And when they opened their baggage they found their merchandise returned to them They said O our father What (could) we desire This (is) our merchandise returned to us And we will get provision (for) our family and we will protect our brother and get an increase measure (of) a camel's (load) That (is) a measurement easy

item.title: Yusuf:66
item.description:
Yusuf:66 - قَالَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُ مَعَكُمْ حَتّٰی تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِي بِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُحَاطَ بِكُمْ فَلَمَّا ءَاتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ
qāla lan ur'silahu maʿakum ḥattā tu'tūni mawthiqan mina l-lahi latatunnanī bihi illā an yuḥāṭa bikum falammā ātawhu mawthiqahum qāla l-lahu ʿalā mā naqūlu wakīlun
He said Never will I send him with you until you give to me a promise by Allah that surely you will bring him to me that surely you will bring him to me unless that you are surrounded you are surrounded And when they had given him their promise he said Allah over what we say (is) a Guardian

item.title: Yusuf:67
item.description:
Yusuf:67 - وَقَالَ يَابَنِيَّ لَا تَدْخُلُوْۤا مِنْ بَابٍ وَاحِدٍ وَادْخُلُوا مِنْ أَبْوَابٍ مُتَفَرِّقَةٍ وَمَا أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
waqāla yābaniyya lā tadkhulū min bābin wāḥidin wa-ud'khulū min abwābin mutafarriqatin wamā ugh'nī ʿankum mina l-lahi min shayin ini l-ḥuk'mu illā lillahi ʿalayhi tawakkaltu waʿalayhi falyatawakkali l-mutawakilūna
And he said O my sons (Do) not enter from one gate one gate but enter from gates different And not I can avail you against Allah any thing Not (is) the decision except with Allah upon Him I put my trust and upon Him let put (their) trust the ones who put trust

item.title: Yusuf:68
item.description:
Yusuf:68 - وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُمْ مَا كَانَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا حَاجَةً فِي نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَاهَا وَإِنَّهُ لَذُو عِلْمٍ لِمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
walammā dakhalū min ḥaythu amarahum abūhum mā kāna yugh'nī ʿanhum mina l-lahi min shayin illā ḥājatan fī nafsi yaʿqūba qaḍāhā wa-innahu ladhū ʿil'min limā ʿallamnāhu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
And when they entered from where ordered them their father not it avail(ed) them against Allah any thing but (it was) a need of Yaqub's soul Yaqub's soul which he carried out And indeed, he (was) a possessor (of) knowledge because We had taught him but most (of) the people (do) not know

item.title: Yusuf:69
item.description:
Yusuf:69 - وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى يُوسُفَ ءَاوَى إِلَيْهِ أَخَاهُ قَالَ اِنِّیْ أَنَا أَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
walammā dakhalū ʿalā yūsufa āwā ilayhi akhāhu qāla innī anā akhūka falā tabta-is bimā kānū yaʿmalūna
And when they entered upon Yusuf he took to himself his brother He said Indeed, I [I] am your brother so (do) not grieve for what they used (to) do

item.title: Yusuf:70
item.description:
Yusuf:70 - فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمْ بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِي رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا الْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ
falammā jahhazahum bijahāzihim jaʿala l-siqāyata fī raḥli akhīhi thumma adhana mu-adhinun ayyatuhā l-ʿīru innakum lasāriqūna
So when he had furnished them with their supplies he put the drinking cup in the bag (of) his brother Then called out an announcer O you (in) the caravan Indeed, you surely (are) thieves

item.title: Yusuf:71
item.description:
Yusuf:71 - قَالُوْا وَأَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ مَاذَا تَفْقِدُونَ
qālū wa-aqbalū ʿalayhim mādhā tafqidūna
They said turning towards them What (is it) you miss

item.title: Yusuf:72
item.description:
Yusuf:72 - قَالُوْا نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِكِ وَلِمَنْ جَاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَأَنَا بِهِ زَعِيمٌ
qālū nafqidu ṣuwāʿa l-maliki waliman jāa bihi ḥim'lu baʿīrin wa-anā bihi zaʿīmun
They said We are missing (the) cup (of) the king And for (one) who brings it (is) a load (of) a camel and I for it (is) responsible

item.title: Yusuf:73
item.description:
Yusuf:73 - قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَا جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كُنَّا سَارِقِينَ
qālū tal-lahi laqad ʿalim'tum mā ji'nā linuf'sida fī l-arḍi wamā kunnā sāriqīna
They said By Allah certainly you know not we came that we cause corruption in the land and not we are thieves

item.title: Yusuf:74
item.description:
Yusuf:74 - قَالُوْا فَمَا جَزَاؤُهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ كَاذِبِينَ
qālū famā jazāuhu in kuntum kādhibīna
They said Then what (will be the) recompense (of) it if you are liars

item.title: Yusuf:75
item.description:
Yusuf:75 - قَالُوْا جَزَاؤُهُ مَنْ وُجِدَ فِي رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزَاؤُهُ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ
qālū jazāuhu man wujida fī raḥlihi fahuwa jazāuhu kadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīna
They said Its recompense (is that one) who it is found in his bag then he (will be) his recompense Thus (do) we recompense the wrongdoers

item.title: Yusuf:76
item.description:
Yusuf:76 - فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِنْ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ كَذٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِیْمٌ fabada-a bi-awʿiyatihim qabla wiʿāi akhīhi thumma is'takhrajahā min wiʿāi akhīhi kadhālika kid'nā liyūsufa mā kāna liyakhudha akhāhu fī dīni l-maliki illā an yashāa l-lahu narfaʿu darajātin man nashāu wafawqa kulli dhī ʿil'min ʿalīmun So he began with their bags before (the) bag (of) his brother then he brought it out from (the) bag (of) his brother Thus (did) We plan for Yusuf He could not He could not take his brother by the law (of) the king except that Allah willed Allah willed We raise (in) degrees whom We will but over every possessor (of) knowledge (is) the All-Knower
  • [1] Or 'above every man of knowledge is one who knows better.'

item.title: Yusuf:77
item.description:
Yusuf:77 - قَالُوْا إِنْ يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ قَالَ أَنْتُمْ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ
qālū in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu fa-asarrahā yūsufu fī nafsihi walam yub'dihā lahum qāla antum sharrun makānan wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā taṣifūna
They said If he steals then verily stole a brother of his before before But Yusuf kept it secret But Yusuf kept it secret within himself and (did) not reveal it to them He said You (are the) worse (in) position and Allah knows best of what you describe

item.title: Yusuf:78
item.description:
Yusuf:78 - قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabīran fakhudh aḥadanā makānahu innā narāka mina l-muḥ'sinīna
They said O Aziz Indeed he has a father old great so take one of us (in) his place Indeed, we [we] see you of the good-doers

item.title: Yusuf:79
item.description:
Yusuf:79 - قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ أَنْ نَأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَنْ وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَظَالِمُونَ
qāla maʿādha l-lahi an nakhudha illā man wajadnā matāʿanā ʿindahu innā idhan laẓālimūna
He said Allah forbid Allah forbid that we take except (one) who we found our possession with him Indeed, we then surely (would be) wrongdoers

item.title: Yusuf:80
item.description:
Yusuf:80 - فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْئَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوْۤا نَجِيًّا قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَوْثِقًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَمِنْ قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطْتُمْ فِي يُوسُفَ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ الْأَرْضَ حَتّٰی يَأْذَنَ لِي أَبِي أَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ لِي وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ
falammā is'tayasū min'hu khalaṣū najiyyan qāla kabīruhum alam taʿlamū anna abākum qad akhadha ʿalaykum mawthiqan mina l-lahi wamin qablu mā farraṭtum fī yūsufa falan abraḥa l-arḍa ḥattā yadhana lī abī aw yaḥkuma l-lahu lī wahuwa khayru l-ḥākimīna
So when they despaired of him they secluded themselves (in) private consultation Said the eldest among them Do not you know that your father has taken has taken upon you a promise by Allah and before and before that you failed concerning Yusuf So never will I leave the land until permits me my father or Allah decides Allah decides for me and He (is) the Best (of) the judges

item.title: Yusuf:81
item.description:
Yusuf:81 - اِرْجِعُوْۤا إِلَى أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوْۤا يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ ir'jiʿū ilā abīkum faqūlū yāabānā inna ib'naka saraqa wamā shahid'nā illā bimā ʿalim'nā wamā kunnā lil'ghaybi ḥāfiẓīna Return to your father and say 'O our father Indeed your son has stolen and not we testify except of what we knew And not we were of the unseen guardians
  • [1] That is, concerning the penalty for theft according to the custom of the Canaanites.

item.title: Yusuf:82
item.description:
Yusuf:82 - وَسْءَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
wasali l-qaryata allatī kunnā fīhā wal-ʿīra allatī aqbalnā fīhā wa-innā laṣādiqūna
And ask the town where we were in it and the caravan which we returned in it And indeed, we surely (are) truthful.'

item.title: Yusuf:83
item.description:
Yusuf:83 - قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ عَسٰۤی اللَّهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ qāla bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran faṣabrun jamīlun ʿasā l-lahu an yatiyanī bihim jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu He said Nay have enticed you your souls something so patience (is) beautiful Perhaps Allah will bring them to me will bring them to me will bring them to me all Indeed, He He (is) the All-Knower All-Wise
  • [1] That is, Jacob ('a), after hearing what his sons had told him.

item.title: Yusuf:84
item.description:
Yusuf:84 - وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَاأَسَفَى عَلَى يُوسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
watawallā ʿanhum waqāla yāasafā ʿalā yūsufa wa-ib'yaḍḍat ʿaynāhu mina l-ḥuz'ni fahuwa kaẓīmun
And he turned away from them and said Alas, my grief over Yusuf And became white his eyes from the grief and he (was) a suppressor

item.title: Yusuf:85
item.description:
Yusuf:85 - قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتّٰی تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ
qālū tal-lahi tafta-u tadhkuru yūsufa ḥattā takūna ḥaraḍan aw takūna mina l-hālikīna
They said By Allah you will not cease remembering Yusuf until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish

item.title: Yusuf:86
item.description:
Yusuf:86 - قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُوْۤا بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
qāla innamā ashkū bathī waḥuz'nī ilā l-lahi wa-aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna
He said Only I complain (of) my suffering and my grief to Allah and I know from Allah what not you know

item.title: Yusuf:87
item.description:
Yusuf:87 - يَابَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوْۤا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِنْ يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَايْءَسُوْۤا مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يَايْءَسُ مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
yābaniyya idh'habū fataḥassasū min yūsufa wa-akhīhi walā tāy'asū min rawḥi l-lahi innahu lā yāy'asu min rawḥi l-lahi illā l-qawmu l-kāfirūna
O my sons Go and inquire about Yusuf and his brother and not despair of (the) Mercy of Allah (the) Mercy of Allah Indeed none despairs of (the) Mercy of Allah (the) Mercy of Allah except the people the disbelievers

item.title: Yusuf:88
item.description:
Yusuf:88 - فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوْا يَاأَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ
falammā dakhalū ʿalayhi qālū yāayyuhā l-ʿazīzu massanā wa-ahlanā l-ḍuru waji'nā bibiḍāʿatin muz'jātin fa-awfi lanā l-kayla wataṣaddaq ʿalaynā inna l-laha yajzī l-mutaṣadiqīna
So when they entered upon him they said O Aziz O Aziz Has touched us and our family the adversity and we have come with goods (of) little value but pay (in) full to us the measure and be charitable to us Indeed Allah rewards the charitable

item.title: Yusuf:89
item.description:
Yusuf:89 - قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنْتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ
qāla hal ʿalim'tum mā faʿaltum biyūsufa wa-akhīhi idh antum jāhilūna
He said Do you know what you did with Yusuf and his brother when you were ignorant

item.title: Yusuf:90
item.description:
Yusuf:90 - قَالُوْا أَءِنَّكَ لَأَنْتَ يُوسُفُ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَذَا أَخِي قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
qālū a-innaka la-anta yūsufu qāla anā yūsufu wahādhā akhī qad manna l-lahu ʿalaynā innahu man yattaqi wayaṣbir fa-inna l-laha lā yuḍīʿu ajra l-muḥ'sinīna
They said Are you indeed surely you Yusuf He said I am Yusuf and this (is) my brother Indeed Allah has been gracious Allah has been gracious to us Indeed, he who fears Allah and (is) patient then indeed Allah (does) not let go waste (the) reward (of) the good-doers

item.title: Yusuf:91
item.description:
Yusuf:91 - قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَخَاطِءِينَ
qālū tal-lahi laqad ātharaka l-lahu ʿalaynā wa-in kunnā lakhāṭiīna
They said By Allah certainly Allah has preferred you Allah has preferred you over us and indeed we have been sinners

item.title: Yusuf:92
item.description:
Yusuf:92 - قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
qāla lā tathrība ʿalaykumu l-yawma yaghfiru l-lahu lakum wahuwa arḥamu l-rāḥimīna
He said No blame upon you today Allah will forgive Allah will forgive you and He (is) the Most Merciful (of) those who show mercy

item.title: Yusuf:93
item.description:
Yusuf:93 - اِذْهَبُوْۤا بِقَمِيصِي هَذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِي بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
idh'habū biqamīṣī hādhā fa-alqūhu ʿalā wajhi abī yati baṣīran watūnī bi-ahlikum ajmaʿīna
Go with this shirt of mine with this shirt of mine and cast it over (the) face (of) my father he will regain sight he will regain sight And bring to me your family all together

item.title: Yusuf:94
item.description:
Yusuf:94 - وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ اِنِّیْ لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ لَوْلَا أَنْ تُفَنِّدُونِ
walammā faṣalati l-ʿīru qāla abūhum innī la-ajidu rīḥa yūsufa lawlā an tufannidūni
And when departed the caravan their father said their father said Indeed, I [I] find (the) smell (of) Yusuf if not that you think me weakened in mind

item.title: Yusuf:95
item.description:
Yusuf:95 - قَالُوْا تَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِیْ ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ
qālū tal-lahi innaka lafī ḍalālika l-qadīmi
They said By Allah indeed, you surely (are) in your error old

item.title: Yusuf:96
item.description:
Yusuf:96 - فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكُمْ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ falammā an jāa l-bashīru alqāhu ʿalā wajhihi fa-ir'tadda baṣīran qāla alam aqul lakum innī aʿlamu mina l-lahi mā lā taʿlamūna Then when that arrived the bearer of glad tidings he cast it over his face then returned (his) sight then returned (his) sight He said Did not I say to you indeed, I [I] know from Allah what not you know
  • [1] That is, the shirt of Joseph ('a).

item.title: Yusuf:97
item.description:
Yusuf:97 - قَالُوْا يَاأَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِءِينَ
qālū yāabānā is'taghfir lanā dhunūbanā innā kunnā khāṭiīna
They said O our father Ask forgiveness for us (of) our sins Indeed, we have been sinners

item.title: Yusuf:98
item.description:
Yusuf:98 - قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
qāla sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbī innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
He said Soon I will ask forgiveness for you (from) my Lord Indeed, He He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Yusuf:99
item.description:
Yusuf:99 - فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى يُوسُفَ ءَاوَى إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوْۤا مِصْرَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ
falammā dakhalū ʿalā yūsufa āwā ilayhi abawayhi waqāla ud'khulū miṣ'ra in shāa l-lahu āminīna
Then when they entered upon Yusuf he took to himself his parents and said Enter Egypt if Allah wills Allah wills safe

item.title: Yusuf:100
item.description:
Yusuf:100 - وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوْۤا لَهُ سُجَّدًا وَقَالَ يَاأَبَتِ هَذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُءْيَايَ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُمْ مِنَ الْبَدْوِ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ نَزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِمَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
warafaʿa abawayhi ʿalā l-ʿarshi wakharrū lahu sujjadan waqāla yāabati hādhā tawīlu ru'yāya min qablu qad jaʿalahā rabbī ḥaqqan waqad aḥsana bī idh akhrajanī mina l-sij'ni wajāa bikum mina l-badwi min baʿdi an nazagha l-shayṭānu baynī wabayna ikh'watī inna rabbī laṭīfun limā yashāu innahu huwa l-ʿalīmu l-ḥakīmu
And he raised his parents upon the throne and they fell down to him prostrate And he said O my father This (is the) interpretation (of) my dream (of) before (of) before Verily has made it my Lord true And indeed He was good to me when He took me out of the prison and brought you from the bedouin life after after that had caused discord the Shaitaan between me and between my brothers Indeed my Lord (is) Most Subtle to what He wills Indeed, He He (is) the All-Knower the All-Wise

item.title: Yusuf:101
item.description:
Yusuf:101 - رَبِّ قَدْ ءَاتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ الْاَحَادِیْثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
rabbi qad ātaytanī mina l-mul'ki waʿallamtanī min tawīli l-aḥādīthi fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi anta waliyyī fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati tawaffanī mus'liman wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna
My Lord indeed you have given me of the sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of the events Creator (of) the heavens and the earth You (are) my Protector in the world and the Hereafter Cause me to die (as) a Muslim and join me with the righteous

item.title: Yusuf:102
item.description:
Yusuf:102 - ذٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا كُنْتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوْۤا أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ
dhālika min anbāi l-ghaybi nūḥīhi ilayka wamā kunta ladayhim idh ajmaʿū amrahum wahum yamkurūna
That (is) from the news (of) the unseen which We reveal to you And not you were with them when they put together their plan while they (were) plotting

item.title: Yusuf:103
item.description:
Yusuf:103 - وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
wamā aktharu l-nāsi walaw ḥaraṣta bimu'minīna
And not most (of) the mankind even though you desire (will be) believers

item.title: Yusuf:104
item.description:
Yusuf:104 - وَمَا تَسْءَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā tasaluhum ʿalayhi min ajrin in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna And not you ask them for it any reward Not (is) it but a reminder to the worlds
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: Yusuf:105
item.description:
Yusuf:105 - وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
waka-ayyin min āyatin fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yamurrūna ʿalayhā wahum ʿanhā muʿ'riḍūna
And how many of a Sign in the heavens and the earth they pass over it while they (are) from them the ones who turn away

item.title: Yusuf:106
item.description:
Yusuf:106 - وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُمْ مُشْرِكُونَ
wamā yu'minu aktharuhum bil-lahi illā wahum mush'rikūna
And not believe most of them in Allah except while they associate partners with Him

item.title: Yusuf:107
item.description:
Yusuf:107 - أَفَأَمِنُوا أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
afa-aminū an tatiyahum ghāshiyatun min ʿadhābi l-lahi aw tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna
Do they then feel secure (against) that comes to them an overwhelming of punishment (of) Allah or comes to them the Hour suddenly while they (do) not perceive

item.title: Yusuf:108
item.description:
Yusuf:108 - قُلْ هَذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ عَلَى بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
qul hādhihi sabīlī adʿū ilā l-lahi ʿalā baṣīratin anā wamani ittabaʿanī wasub'ḥāna l-lahi wamā anā mina l-mush'rikīna
Say This (is) my way I invite to Allah with insight I and whoever follows me And Glory be (to) Allah and not I am of the polytheists

item.title: Yusuf:109
item.description:
Yusuf:109 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرٰی أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
wamā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim min ahli l-qurā afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim waladāru l-ākhirati khayrun lilladhīna ittaqaw afalā taʿqilūna
And not We sent before you before you but men We revealed to them from (among) (the) people (of) the townships So have not they traveled in the earth and seen how was (the) end (of) those who (were) before them (were) before them And surely the home (of) the Hereafter (is) best for those who fear Allah Then will not you use reason

item.title: Yusuf:110
item.description:
Yusuf:110 - حَتّٰی إِذَا اسْتَيْئَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوْۤا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَنْ نَشَاءُ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ḥattā idhā is'tayasa l-rusulu waẓannū annahum qad kudhibū jāahum naṣrunā fanujjiya man nashāu walā yuraddu basunā ʿani l-qawmi l-muj'rimīna Until when gave up hope the Messengers and thought that they certainly were denied then came to them Our help and was saved whom We willed And not (can) be repelled Our punishment from the people (who are) criminals
  • [1] That is, when the apostles lost hopes of bringing their people to the right path.
  • [2] That is, the people to whom the apostles had been sent thought that the apostles had been told lies concerning the impending punishment of the infidels.

item.title: Yusuf:111
item.description:
Yusuf:111 - لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرٰی وَلَكِنْ تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ laqad kāna fī qaṣaṣihim ʿib'ratun li-ulī l-albābi mā kāna ḥadīthan yuf'tarā walākin taṣdīqa alladhī bayna yadayhi watafṣīla kulli shayin wahudan waraḥmatan liqawmin yu'minūna Verily (there) is in their stories a lesson for men (of) understanding Not (it) is a narration invented but a confirmation (of that) which (was) before it (was) before it and a detailed explanation (of) all things and a guidance and mercy for a people who believe
  • [1] Or 'unravelling.'

item.title: 13. الرعد (Ar-Ra'd)
item.description:
The surah that translates into human experience the overpowering meaning of what Thunder says when it resounds through the sky and God sends bolts to the earth. It takes its name from thunder (al-ra'd), mentioned in verse 13. The surah is distinguished by its moving description of God's power and knowledge. Muḥammad's place in a long tradition of prophets, none of whom could produce miracles on request, is stressed, and his role emphasized: it is only to deliver the message. God is the One who will call people to account for their deeds, and He is the witness for the truth of the message.

13:1
المر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ الْحَقُّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
alif-lam-meem-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi wa-alladhī unzila ilayka min rabbika l-ḥaqu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna
Alif Laam Mim Ra These (are) the Verses (of) the Book And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord (is) the truth but most (of) the mankind (do) not believe

13:2
اَللَّهُ الَّذِي رَفَعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ
al-lahu alladhī rafaʿa l-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman yudabbiru l-amra yufaṣṣilu l-āyāti laʿallakum biliqāi rabbikum tūqinūna
Allah (is) the One Who raised the heavens without pillars that you see then He established on the Throne and subjected the sun and the moon each running for a term appointed He arranges the matter He details the Signs so that you may in the meeting (with) your Lord believe with certainty

13:3
وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَدَّ الْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْهَارًا وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
