wahuwa alladhī madda l-arḍa wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya wa-anhāran wamin kulli l-thamarāti jaʿala fīhā zawjayni ith'nayni yugh'shī al-layla l-nahāra inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna
And He (is) the One Who spread the earth and placed in it firm mountains and rivers and from all (of) the fruits He made in it pairs two He covers the night (with) the day Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for a people who ponder

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:1
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:1 - المر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ الْحَقُّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
alif-lam-meem-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi wa-alladhī unzila ilayka min rabbika l-ḥaqu walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna
Alif Laam Mim Ra These (are) the Verses (of) the Book And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord (is) the truth but most (of) the mankind (do) not believe

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:2
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:2 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي رَفَعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ al-lahu alladhī rafaʿa l-samāwāti bighayri ʿamadin tarawnahā thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman yudabbiru l-amra yufaṣṣilu l-āyāti laʿallakum biliqāi rabbikum tūqinūna Allah (is) the One Who raised the heavens without pillars that you see then He established on the Throne and subjected the sun and the moon each running for a term appointed He arranges the matter He details the Signs so that you may in the meeting (with) your Lord believe with certainty
  • [1] Or 'until a specified time.'
  • [2] Or 'unravels.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:3
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:3 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَدَّ الْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْهَارًا وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ wahuwa alladhī madda l-arḍa wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya wa-anhāran wamin kulli l-thamarāti jaʿala fīhā zawjayni ith'nayni yugh'shī al-layla l-nahāra inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna And He (is) the One Who spread the earth and placed in it firm mountains and rivers and from all (of) the fruits He made in it pairs two He covers the night (with) the day Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for a people who ponder
  • [1] Or 'a pair,' or 'two mates.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:4
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:4 - وَفِي الْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ مُتَجَاوِرَاتٌ وَجَنَّاتٌ مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَزَرْعٌ وَنَخِيلٌ صِنْوَانٌ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ يُسْقَى بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الْأُكُلِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
wafī l-arḍi qiṭaʿun mutajāwirātun wajannātun min aʿnābin wazarʿun wanakhīlun ṣin'wānun waghayru ṣin'wānin yus'qā bimāin wāḥidin wanufaḍḍilu baʿḍahā ʿalā baʿḍin fī l-ukuli inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna
And in the earth are tracks neighboring and gardens of grapevines and crops and date-palms trees (growing) from a single root and not trees (growing) from a single root watered with water one but We cause to exceed some of them over others in the fruit Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for a people who use reason

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:5
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:5 - وَإِنْ تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌ قَوْلُهُمْ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا أَءِنَّا لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ wa-in taʿjab faʿajabun qawluhum a-idhā kunnā turāban a-innā lafī khalqin jadīdin ulāika alladhīna kafarū birabbihim wa-ulāika l-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim wa-ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna And if you (are) astonished then astonishing (is) their saying When we are dust will we (be) indeed, in a creation new Those (are) the ones who disbelieved in their Lord and those the iron chains (will be) in their necks those (are the) companions (of) the Fire they in it (will) abide forever
  • [1] That is, odd, astonishing.

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:6
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:6 - وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَاتُ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى ظُلْمِهِمْ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-sayi-ati qabla l-ḥasanati waqad khalat min qablihimu l-mathulātu wa-inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin lilnnāsi ʿalā ẓul'mihim wa-inna rabbaka lashadīdu l-ʿiqābi And they ask you to hasten the evil before the good and verily has occurred from before them [the] similar punishments And indeed your Lord (is) full (of) forgiveness for mankind for their wrongdoing and indeed your Lord (is) severe (in) the penalty
  • [1] That is, they ask you to bring about the Divine punishment with which you have threatened them, instead of pleading for Divine mercy and forgiveness.

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:7
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:7 - وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرٌ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ
wayaqūlu alladhīna kafarū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi innamā anta mundhirun walikulli qawmin hādin
And say those who disbelieved Why not has been sent down to him a sign from his Lord Only you (are) a warner and for every people (is) a guide

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:8
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:8 - اَللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ al-lahu yaʿlamu mā taḥmilu kullu unthā wamā taghīḍu l-arḥāmu wamā tazdādu wakullu shayin ʿindahu bimiq'dārin Allah knows what carries every female and what fall short the womb and what they exceed And every thing with Him (is) in due proportion
  • [1] That is, what the wombs reduce or increase of the embryo or the foetus or the time of gestation.

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:9
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:9 - عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ
ʿālimu l-ghaybi wal-shahādati l-kabīru l-mutaʿāli
Knower (of) the unseen and the witnessed the Most Great the Most High

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:10
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:10 - سَوَاءٌ مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَنْ جَهَرَ بِهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍ بِاللَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌ بِالنَّهَارِ sawāon minkum man asarra l-qawla waman jahara bihi waman huwa mus'takhfin bi-al-layli wasāribun bil-nahāri (It is) same (to Him) of you (one) who conceals the speech or (one) who publicizes it and (one) who he (is) hidden by night or goes freely by day
  • [1] Or 'marches in daytime.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:11
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:11 - لَهُ مُعَقِّبَاتٌ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتّٰی يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ مِنْ وَالٍ
lahu muʿaqqibātun min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi yaḥfaẓūnahu min amri l-lahi inna l-laha lā yughayyiru mā biqawmin ḥattā yughayyirū mā bi-anfusihim wa-idhā arāda l-lahu biqawmin sūan falā maradda lahu wamā lahum min dūnihi min wālin
For him (are) successive (Angels) from (before) (him) and from and behind him who guard him by (the) command (of) Allah Indeed Allah (does) not change (the condition) of a people until they change what (is) in themselves And when wills Allah for a people misfortune then (there is) no turning away of it and not for them from besides Him any protector

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:12
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:12 - هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنْشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ
huwa alladhī yurīkumu l-barqa khawfan waṭamaʿan wayunshi-u l-saḥāba l-thiqāla
He (is) the One Who shows you the lightning a fear and a hope and brings up the clouds the heavy

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:13
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:13 - وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ wayusabbiḥu l-raʿdu biḥamdihi wal-malāikatu min khīfatihi wayur'silu l-ṣawāʿiqa fayuṣību bihā man yashāu wahum yujādilūna fī l-lahi wahuwa shadīdu l-miḥāli And glorifies the thunder with his praise and the Angels for fear of Him And He sends the thunderbolts and strikes with it whom He wills yet they dispute about Allah And He (is) Mighty (in) Strength
  • [1] Or 'though He is severe in punishment.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:14
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:14 - لَهُ دَعْوَةُ الْحَقِّ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُمْ بِشَيْءٍ إِلَّا كَبَاسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَالِغِهِ وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ lahu daʿwatu l-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yastajībūna lahum bishayin illā kabāsiṭi kaffayhi ilā l-māi liyablugha fāhu wamā huwa bibālighihi wamā duʿāu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin To Him (is) supplication (of) the truth And those whom they invoke besides Him besides Him not they respond to them with a thing except like one who stretches his hands towards water to reach his mouth but not it reaches it And not (is) the supplication (of) the disbelievers but in error
  • [1] Or 'His is the invitation to the truth,' or 'His is the true invitation.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:15
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:15 - وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَظِلَالُهُمْ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْءَاصَالِ
walillahi yasjudu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ṭawʿan wakarhan waẓilāluhum bil-ghuduwi wal-āṣāli
And to Allah prostrates whoever (is) in the heavens and the earth willingly or unwillingly and (so do) their shadows in the mornings and in the afternoons

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:16
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:16 - قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلِ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَاتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِي الظُّلُمَاتُ وَالنُّورُ أَمْ جَعَلُوْۤا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ خَلَقُوْۤا كَخَلْقِهِ فَتَشَابَهَ الْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ قُلِ اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
qul man rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi quli l-lahu qul afa-ittakhadhtum min dūnihi awliyāa lā yamlikūna li-anfusihim nafʿan walā ḍarran qul hal yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru am hal tastawī l-ẓulumātu wal-nūru am jaʿalū lillahi shurakāa khalaqū kakhalqihi fatashābaha l-khalqu ʿalayhim quli l-lahu khāliqu kulli shayin wahuwa l-wāḥidu l-qahāru
Say Who (is) the Lord (of) the heavens and the earth Say Allah Say Have you then taken from besides Him protectors not they have power for themselves (to) benefit and not (to) harm Say Is equal the blind and the seeing Or is equal the darkness[es] and the light Or they attribute to Allah partners who created like His creation so that seemed alike the creation to them Say Allah (is) the Creator of all things and He (is) the One the Irresistible

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:17
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:17 - أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَابِيًا وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ ابْتِغَاءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَاعٍ زَبَدٌ مِثْلُهُ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ وَالْبَاطِلَ فَأَمَّا الزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً وَأَمَّا مَا يَنْفَعُ النَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ
anzala mina l-samāi māan fasālat awdiyatun biqadarihā fa-iḥ'tamala l-saylu zabadan rābiyan wamimmā yūqidūna ʿalayhi fī l-nāri ib'tighāa ḥil'yatin aw matāʿin zabadun mith'luhu kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu l-ḥaqa wal-bāṭila fa-ammā l-zabadu fayadhhabu jufāan wa-ammā mā yanfaʿu l-nāsa fayamkuthu fī l-arḍi kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu l-amthāla
He sends down from the sky water and flows the valleys according to their measure and carries the torrent a foam rising And from what they heat [on] it in the fire in order to make ornaments or utensils a foam like it Thus sets forth Allah the truth and the falsehood Then as for the foam it passes away (as) scum and as for what benefits the mankind remains in the earth Thus Allah sets forth Allah sets forth the examples

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:18
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:18 - لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمُ الْحُسْنَى وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ lilladhīna is'tajābū lirabbihimu l-ḥus'nā wa-alladhīna lam yastajībū lahu law anna lahum mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi ulāika lahum sūu l-ḥisābi wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-mihādu For those who responded to their Lord (is) the bliss And for those who (did) not respond to Him if that they had whatever (is) in the earth all and like of it with it surely they would offer ransom with it Those for them (is) a terrible reckoning and their abode (is) Hell and wretched (is) the resting place
  • [1] Cf. (Q 5:36) & (Q 39:47).

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:19
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:19 - أَفَمَنْ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ الْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَى إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ
afaman yaʿlamu annamā unzila ilayka min rabbika l-ḥaqu kaman huwa aʿmā innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albābi
Then is (he) who knows that which has been revealed to you from your Lord (is) the truth like (one) who he (is) blind Only pay heed men (of) understanding

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:20
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:20 - اَلَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يَنْقُضُونَ الْمِيثَاقَ
alladhīna yūfūna biʿahdi l-lahi walā yanquḍūna l-mīthāqa
Those who fulfill the covenant (of) Allah and not they break the contract

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:21
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:21 - وَالَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ
wa-alladhīna yaṣilūna mā amara l-lahu bihi an yūṣala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhāfūna sūa l-ḥisābi
And those who join what (has been) commanded (by) Allah for it to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid (of) the evil the account

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:22
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:22 - وَالَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبٰی الدَّارِ
wa-alladhīna ṣabarū ib'tighāa wajhi rabbihim wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan wayadraūna bil-ḥasanati l-sayi-ata ulāika lahum ʿuq'bā l-dāri
And those who (are) patient seeking (the) Face (of) their Lord and establish the prayer and spend from what We have provided them secretly and publicly and they repel with the good the evil those for them (is) the final attainment (of) the Home

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:23
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:23 - جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بَابٍ
jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim wal-malāikatu yadkhulūna ʿalayhim min kulli bābin
Gardens of Eden they will enter them and whoever (were) righteous among their fathers and their spouses and their offsprings And the Angels will enter upon them from every gate

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:24
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:24 - سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبٰی الدَّارِ
salāmun ʿalaykum bimā ṣabartum faniʿ'ma ʿuq'bā l-dāri
(Saying), "Peace (be) upon you for what you patiently endured And excellent (is) the final attainment (of) the Home

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:25
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:25 - وَالَّذِينَ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
wa-alladhīna yanquḍūna ʿahda l-lahi min baʿdi mīthāqihi wayaqṭaʿūna mā amara l-lahu bihi an yūṣala wayuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi ulāika lahumu l-laʿnatu walahum sūu l-dāri
And those who break the covenant (of) Allah from after contracting it and sever what (has been) commanded (by) Allah for it to be joined and spread corruption in the earth Those for them (is) the curse and for them (is) an evil home

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:26
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:26 - اَللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَفَرِحُوْۤا بِالْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ
al-lahu yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru wafariḥū bil-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fī l-ākhirati illā matāʿun
Allah extends the provision for whom He wills and restricts And they rejoice in the life (of) the world and nothing (is) the life of the world in (comparison to) the Hereafter except an enjoyment

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:27
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:27 - وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ
wayaqūlu alladhīna kafarū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi āyatun min rabbihi qul inna l-laha yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man anāba
And say those who disbelieved Why has not been sent down upon him a Sign from his Lord Say Indeed Allah lets go astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:28
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:28 - اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُمْ بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
alladhīna āmanū wataṭma-innu qulūbuhum bidhik'ri l-lahi alā bidhik'ri l-lahi taṭma-innu l-qulūbu
Those who believed and find satisfaction their hearts in the remembrance (of) Allah No doubt in the remembrance (of) Allah find satisfaction the hearts

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:29
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:29 - اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ طُوبٰی لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَءَابٍ
alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ṭūbā lahum waḥus'nu maābin
Those who believed and did righteous deeds blessedness (is) for them and a beautiful place of return

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:30
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:30 - كَذٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ فِي أُمَّةٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا أُمَمٌ لِتَتْلُوَا عَلَيْهِمُ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِالرَّحْمَنِ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ
kadhālika arsalnāka fī ummatin qad khalat min qablihā umamun litatluwā ʿalayhimu alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wahum yakfurūna bil-raḥmāni qul huwa rabbī lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi matābi
Thus We have sent you to a nation verily have passed away from before it nations so that you might recite to them what We revealed to you while they disbelieve in the Most Gracious Say He (is) my Lord (there is) no god except Him Upon Him I put my trust and to Him (is) my return

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:31
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:31 - وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْآنًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ الْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتٰی بَلْ لِلَّهِ الْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا أَفَلَمْ يَايْءَسِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنْ لَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا تُصِيبُهُمْ بِمَا صَنَعُوْۤا قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًا مِنْ دَارِهِمْ حَتّٰی يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ walaw anna qur'ānan suyyirat bihi l-jibālu aw quṭṭiʿat bihi l-arḍu aw kullima bihi l-mawtā bal lillahi l-amru jamīʿan afalam yāy'asi alladhīna āmanū an law yashāu l-lahu lahadā l-nāsa jamīʿan walā yazālu alladhīna kafarū tuṣībuhum bimā ṣanaʿū qāriʿatun aw taḥullu qarīban min dārihim ḥattā yatiya waʿdu l-lahi inna l-laha lā yukh'lifu l-mīʿāda And if that was any Quran could be moved by it the mountains or could be cloven asunder by it the earth or could be made to speak by it the dead Nay with Allah (is) the command all Then do not know those who believe that if had willed Allah surely, He would have guided all all of the mankind And not will cease those who disbelieve to strike them for what they did a disaster or it settles close from their homes until comes (the) promise (of) Allah Indeed Allah (will) not fail (in) the Promise
  • [1] Or 'Even if it were a Qur'ān.'
  • [2] Or 'the ground could be split,' i.e., for making springs and wells.
  • [3] Ellipsis. The phrase omitted is 'all unbelievers would have embraced the faith.' Or 'still they would not have embraced the faith.' Cf. (Q 6:111).
  • [4] That is, the disasters.

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:32
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:32 - وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
walaqadi us'tuh'zi-a birusulin min qablika fa-amlaytu lilladhīna kafarū thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi
And certainly were mocked Messengers from before you but I granted respite to those who disbelieved then I seized them and how was My penalty

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:33
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:33 - أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَجَعَلُوْۤا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ أَمْ تُنَبِّئُونَهُ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ بِظَاهِرٍ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوْۤا عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ afaman huwa qāimun ʿalā kulli nafsin bimā kasabat wajaʿalū lillahi shurakāa qul sammūhum am tunabbiūnahu bimā lā yaʿlamu fī l-arḍi am biẓāhirin mina l-qawli bal zuyyina lilladhīna kafarū makruhum waṣuddū ʿani l-sabīli waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Is then He Who (He) (is) a Maintainer of every soul for what it has earned Yet they ascribe to Allah partners Say Name them Or (do) you inform Him of what not He knows in the earth or of the apparent of the words Nay (is) made fair-seeming to those who disbelieve their plotting and they are hindered from the Path And whoever (by) Allah Allah lets go astray then not for him any guide
  • [1] Or 'Is He who maintains every soul in spite of what it earns.' Or 'Is He who is vigilant over every soul as to what it earns.' See (Q 9:25), where bimā is used in the sense of 'in spite of.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:34
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:34 - لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَشَقُّ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَاقٍ
lahum ʿadhābun fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati ashaqqu wamā lahum mina l-lahi min wāqin
For them (is) a punishment in the life (of) the world and surely the punishment (of) the Hereafter (is) harder And not for them against Allah any defender

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:35
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:35 - مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ أُكُلُهَا دَائِمٌ وَظِلُّهَا تِلْكَ عُقْبٰی الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَعُقْبٰی الْكَافِرِينَ النَّارُ
mathalu l-janati allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru ukuluhā dāimun waẓilluhā til'ka ʿuq'bā alladhīna ittaqaw waʿuq'bā l-kāfirīna l-nāru
The example of Paradise which (is) promised (to) the righteous flows from underneath it the rivers Its food (is) everlasting and its shade This (is the) end of those who (are) righteous and (the) end (of) the disbelievers (is) the Fire

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:36
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:36 - وَالَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ مَنْ يُنْكِرُ بَعْضَهُ قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَلَا أُشْرِكَ بِهِ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُوْۤا وَإِلَيْهِ مَءَابِ wa-alladhīna ātaynāhumu l-kitāba yafraḥūna bimā unzila ilayka wamina l-aḥzābi man yunkiru baʿḍahu qul innamā umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha walā ush'rika bihi ilayhi adʿū wa-ilayhi maābi And those (to) whom We have given them the Book rejoice at what has been revealed to you but among the groups (those) who deny a part of it Say Only I have been commanded that I worship Allah and not I associate partners with Him To Him I call and to Him (is) my return
  • [1] That is, the Jews and the Christians, or the faithful who followed the Prophet (ṣ).
  • [2] That is, from among those belonging to Jewish and Christian sects, or the Arab polytheists.

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:37
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:37 - وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ بَعْدَمَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا وَاقٍ wakadhālika anzalnāhu ḥuk'man ʿarabiyyan wala-ini ittabaʿta ahwāahum baʿdamā jāaka mina l-ʿil'mi mā laka mina l-lahi min waliyyin walā wāqin And thus We have revealed it (to be) a judgment of authority (in) Arabic And if you follow their desires after what came to you of the knowledge not for you against Allah any protector and not defender
  • [1] Cf. (Q 2:120), (Q 2:145); (Q 5:48), (Q 5:49); (Q 23:71); (Q 42:15).

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:38
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:38 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِاٰیَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ
walaqad arsalnā rusulan min qablika wajaʿalnā lahum azwājan wadhurriyyatan wamā kāna lirasūlin an yatiya biāyatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi likulli ajalin kitābun
And certainly We sent Messengers from before you and We made for them wives and offspring And not was for a Messenger that he comes with a sign except by the leave (of) Allah For everything (is) a time prescribed

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:39
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:39 - يَمْحُوْۤا اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ yamḥū l-lahu mā yashāu wayuth'bitu waʿindahu ummu l-kitābi (Is) eliminated (by) Allah what He wills and confirms and with Him (is) the Mother (of) the Book (is) the Mother (of) the Book
  • [1] Cf. (Q 43:4).

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:40
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:40 - وَإِنْ مَا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ wa-in mā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-innamā ʿalayka l-balāghu waʿalaynā l-ḥisābu And whether (what) We show you a part (of) what We have promised them or We cause you to die so only on you (is) the conveyance and on Us (is) the reckoning
  • [1] That is, the punishment.

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:41
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:41 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَأْتِي الْأَرْضَ نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا وَاللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
awalam yaraw annā natī l-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā wal-lahu yaḥkumu lā muʿaqqiba liḥuk'mihi wahuwa sarīʿu l-ḥisābi
Did not they see that We come (to) the land reducing it from its borders And Allah judges (there is) no adjuster (of) His Judgment And He (is) Swift (in) the reckoning

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:42
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:42 - وَقَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّهِ الْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًا يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الْكُفَّارُ لِمَنْ عُقْبٰی الدَّارِ waqad makara alladhīna min qablihim falillahi l-makru jamīʿan yaʿlamu mā taksibu kullu nafsin wasayaʿlamu l-kufāru liman ʿuq'bā l-dāri And certainly plotted those who (were) from before them but for Allah (is) the plot all He knows what earns every soul and will know the disbelievers for whom (is) the final the home
  • [1] Ellipsis. The omitted phrase is 'but their plotting was of no avail to them.'

item.title: Ar-Ra'd:43
item.description:
Ar-Ra'd:43 - وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًا قُلْ كَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ الْكِتَابِ
wayaqūlu alladhīna kafarū lasta mur'salan qul kafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum waman ʿindahu ʿil'mu l-kitābi
And say those who disbelieve You are not a Messenger Say Sufficient (is) Allah (as) a Witness between me and between you and whoever [he] has knowledge (of) the Book

item.title: 14. إبراهيم (Ibrahim)
item.description:
The surah that records the prayer of Abraham for the security and perpetual godliness of the barren valley of Mecca, when, at God's command, he settled his beloved wife Hagar and first son Ishmael there, in order to establish the perennial rites of the prayer, as well as other forms of worship, for all time on earth. It is named after Abraham, whose prayer appears in verse 35 ff. Throughout the surah the ungrateful are condemned, and the grateful commended. Abraham also asks that he and his descendants may be protected from idol-worship. This serves to remind the Meccans that they should shun the worship of idols.

14:1
الر كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
alif-lam-ra kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka litukh'rija l-nāsa mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'ni rabbihim ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi
Alif Laam Ra A Book which We have revealed to you so that you may bring out the mankind from the darkness[es] to the light by the permission (of) their Lord to the Path (of) the All-Mighty the Praiseworthy

14:2
اَللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
al-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wawaylun lil'kāfirīna min ʿadhābin shadīdin
Allah (is) the One to Him (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth And woe to the disbelievers from the punishment severe

14:3
اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةُ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ
alladhīna yastaḥibbūna l-ḥayata l-dun'yā ʿalā l-ākhirati wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan ulāika fī ḍalālin baʿīdin
Those who love more the life (of) the world than the Hereafter and hinder from (the) Path (of) Allah and seek in it crookedness those in (are) far astray (are) far astray

item.title: Ibrahim:1
item.description:
Ibrahim:1 - الر كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
alif-lam-ra kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka litukh'rija l-nāsa mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri bi-idh'ni rabbihim ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi
Alif Laam Ra A Book which We have revealed to you so that you may bring out the mankind from the darkness[es] to the light by the permission (of) their Lord to the Path (of) the All-Mighty the Praiseworthy

item.title: Ibrahim:2
item.description:
Ibrahim:2 - اَللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
al-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wawaylun lil'kāfirīna min ʿadhābin shadīdin
Allah (is) the One to Him (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth And woe to the disbelievers from the punishment severe

item.title: Ibrahim:3
item.description:
Ibrahim:3 - اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةُ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ
alladhīna yastaḥibbūna l-ḥayata l-dun'yā ʿalā l-ākhirati wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wayabghūnahā ʿiwajan ulāika fī ḍalālin baʿīdin
Those who love more the life (of) the world than the Hereafter and hinder from (the) Path (of) Allah and seek in it crookedness those in (are) far astray (are) far astray

item.title: Ibrahim:4
item.description:
Ibrahim:4 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ فَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
wamā arsalnā min rasūlin illā bilisāni qawmihi liyubayyina lahum fayuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
And not We sent any Messenger except with the language (of) his people so that he might make clear for them Then Allah lets go astray Then Allah lets go astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills And He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Ibrahim:5
item.description:
Ibrahim:5 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā an akhrij qawmaka mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wadhakkir'hum bi-ayyāmi l-lahi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
And verily We sent Musa with Our Signs that Bring out your people from the darkness[es] to the light And remind them of the days (of) Allah Indeed in that surely (are) the signs for everyone patient and thankful

item.title: Ibrahim:6
item.description:
Ibrahim:6 - وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِقَوْمِهِ اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنْجَاكُمْ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ وَفِي ذَلِكُمْ بَلَاءٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
wa-idh qāla mūsā liqawmihi udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum idh anjākum min āli fir'ʿawna yasūmūnakum sūa l-ʿadhābi wayudhabbiḥūna abnāakum wayastaḥyūna nisāakum wafī dhālikum balāon min rabbikum ʿaẓīmun
And when said Musa to his people Remember (the) Favor of Allah (the) Favor of Allah upon you when He saved you from (the) people (of) Firaun they were afflicting you (with) evil torment and were slaughtering your sons and letting live your women And in that (was) a trial from your Lord great

item.title: Ibrahim:7
item.description:
Ibrahim:7 - وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ وَلَئِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ
wa-idh ta-adhana rabbukum la-in shakartum la-azīdannakum wala-in kafartum inna ʿadhābī lashadīdun
And when proclaimed your Lord If you are thankful surely I will increase you but if you are ungrateful indeed My punishment (is) surely severe

item.title: Ibrahim:8
item.description:
Ibrahim:8 - وَقَالَ مُوسٰی إِنْ تَكْفُرُوْۤا أَنْتُمْ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ
waqāla mūsā in takfurū antum waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan fa-inna l-laha laghaniyyun ḥamīdun
And said Musa If you disbelieve you and whoever (is) in the earth all then indeed Allah certainly (is) Free of need Praiseworthy

item.title: Ibrahim:9
item.description:
Ibrahim:9 - أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّهُ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَرَدُّوْۤا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ وَإِنَّا لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَنَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ alam yatikum naba-u alladhīna min qablikum qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-alladhīna min baʿdihim lā yaʿlamuhum illā l-lahu jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti faraddū aydiyahum fī afwāhihim waqālū innā kafarnā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi wa-innā lafī shakkin mimmā tadʿūnanā ilayhi murībin Has not come to you (the) news (of) those who (were) before you (were) before you the people of Nuh and Aad and Thamud and those who (were) after them (were) after them None knows them except Allah Came to them their Messengers with clear proofs but they returned their hands in their mouths and they said Indeed we [we] disbelieve in what you have been sent with [it] and indeed, we (are) surely in doubt about what you invite us to it suspicious
  • [1] Literally, 'they put their hands into their mouths,' an idiomatic expression that has been interpreted variously. See Ṭabrisī and Ṭabarī.

item.title: Ibrahim:10
item.description:
Ibrahim:10 - قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِي اللَّهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى قَالُوْا إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ qālat rusuluhum afī l-lahi shakkun fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yadʿūkum liyaghfira lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhirakum ilā ajalin musamman qālū in antum illā basharun mith'lunā turīdūna an taṣuddūnā ʿammā kāna yaʿbudu ābāunā fatūnā bisul'ṭānin mubīnin Said their Messengers Can (there) be about Allah any doubt (the) Creator (of) the heavens and the earth He invites you so that He may forgive for you of your sins and give you respite for a term appointed They said Not you (are) but a human like us you wish to hinder us from what used to worship our forefathers So bring us an authority clear
  • [1] Or 'for a specified term.'

item.title: Ibrahim:11
item.description:
Ibrahim:11 - قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِنْ نَحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا أَنْ نَأْتِيَكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
qālat lahum rusuluhum in naḥnu illā basharun mith'lukum walākinna l-laha yamunnu ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi wamā kāna lanā an natiyakum bisul'ṭānin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna
Said to them their Messengers Not we (are) but a human like you but Allah bestows His Grace on whom He wills of His slaves And not is for us that we bring you an authority except by the permission of Allah by the permission of Allah And upon Allah so let put (their) trust the believers

item.title: Ibrahim:12
item.description:
Ibrahim:12 - وَمَا لَنَا أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَى مَا ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
wamā lanā allā natawakkala ʿalā l-lahi waqad hadānā subulanā walanaṣbiranna ʿalā mā ādhaytumūnā waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mutawakilūna
And what (is) for us that not we put our trust upon Allah while certainly He has guided us to our ways And surely we will bear with patience on what harm you may cause us And upon Allah so let put (their) trust the ones who put (their) trust

item.title: Ibrahim:13
item.description:
Ibrahim:13 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَا أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَا فَأَوْحَى إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lirusulihim lanukh'rijannakum min arḍinā aw lataʿūdunna fī millatinā fa-awḥā ilayhim rabbuhum lanuh'likanna l-ẓālimīna
And said those who disbelieved to their Messengers Surely we will drive you out of our land or surely you should return to our religion So inspired to them their Lord We will surely destroy the wrongdoers

item.title: Ibrahim:14
item.description:
Ibrahim:14 - وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ
walanus'kinannakumu l-arḍa min baʿdihim dhālika liman khāfa maqāmī wakhāfa waʿīdi
And surely We will make you dwell (in) the land after them after them That (is) for whoever fears standing before Me and fears My Threat

item.title: Ibrahim:15
item.description:
Ibrahim:15 - وَاسْتَفْتَحُوا وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ wa-is'taftaḥū wakhāba kullu jabbārin ʿanīdin And they sought victory and disappointed every tyrant obstinate
  • [1] That is, the apostles.
  • [2] Or 'verdict;' that is, the verdict of Allah against the unbelievers.

item.title: Ibrahim:16
item.description:
Ibrahim:16 - مِنْ وَرَائِهِ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَى مِنْ مَاءٍ صَدِيدٍ min warāihi jahannamu wayus'qā min māin ṣadīdin of him Ahead (is) Hell and he will be made to drink of water purulent
  • [1] That is, with hell waiting for him.

item.title: Ibrahim:17
item.description:
Ibrahim:17 - يَتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ وَيَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ
yatajarraʿuhu walā yakādu yusīghuhu wayatīhi l-mawtu min kulli makānin wamā huwa bimayyitin wamin warāihi ʿadhābun ghalīẓun
He will sip it but not he will be near (to) swallowing it And will come to him the death from every side but not he will die And ahead of him And ahead of him (is) a punishment harsh

item.title: Ibrahim:18
item.description:
Ibrahim:18 - مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِرَبِّهِمْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ اشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ لَا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْۤا عَلَى شَيْءٍ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَالُ الْبَعِيدُ
mathalu alladhīna kafarū birabbihim aʿmāluhum karamādin ish'taddat bihi l-rīḥu fī yawmin ʿāṣifin lā yaqdirūna mimmā kasabū ʿalā shayin dhālika huwa l-ḍalālu l-baʿīdu
(The) example (of) those who disbelieve in their Lord their deeds (are) like ashes blows furiously on it the wind in a day stormy No control (they have) of what they have earned on anything That it (is) the straying far

item.title: Ibrahim:19
item.description:
Ibrahim:19 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
alam tara anna l-laha khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayati bikhalqin jadīdin
Do not you see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth If He wills He can remove you and bring a creation new

item.title: Ibrahim:20
item.description:
Ibrahim:20 - وَمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
wamā dhālika ʿalā l-lahi biʿazīzin
And not (is) that on Allah great

item.title: Ibrahim:21
item.description:
Ibrahim:21 - وَبَرَزُوْۤا لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا فَقَالَ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ قَالُوْا لَوْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَاكُمْ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَجَزِعْنَا أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِنْ مَحِيصٍ
wabarazū lillahi jamīʿan faqāla l-ḍuʿafāu lilladhīna is'takbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mugh'nūna ʿannā min ʿadhābi l-lahi min shayin qālū law hadānā l-lahu lahadaynākum sawāon ʿalaynā ajaziʿ'nā am ṣabarnā mā lanā min maḥīṣin
And they will come forth before Allah all together then will say the weak to those who were arrogant Indeed we we were your followers so can you (be) the one who avails us from (the) punishment (of) Allah anything anything They will say If Allah had guided us Allah had guided us surely we would have guided you (It is) same for us whether we show intolerance or we are patient not (is) for us any place of escape

item.title: Ibrahim:22
item.description:
Ibrahim:22 - وَقَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدْتُكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا أَنْ دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِي فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مَا أَنَا بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُصْرِخِيَّ اِنِّیْ كَفَرْتُ بِمَا أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
waqāla l-shayṭānu lammā quḍiya l-amru inna l-laha waʿadakum waʿda l-ḥaqi wawaʿadttukum fa-akhlaftukum wamā kāna liya ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin illā an daʿawtukum fa-is'tajabtum lī falā talūmūnī walūmū anfusakum mā anā bimuṣ'rikhikum wamā antum bimuṣ'rikhiyya innī kafartu bimā ashraktumūni min qablu inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmun
And will say the Shaitaan when has been decided the matter Indeed Allah promised you a promise (of) truth And I promised you but I betrayed you But not I had I had over you any authority except that I invited you and you responded to me So (do) not blame me but blame yourselves Not (can) I (be) your helper and not you (can) (be) my helper Indeed, I deny of what your association of me (with Allah) before before Indeed the wrongdoers for them (is) a punishment painful

item.title: Ibrahim:23
item.description:
Ibrahim:23 - وَأُدْخِلَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ
wa-ud'khila alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā bi-idh'ni rabbihim taḥiyyatuhum fīhā salāmun
And will be admitted those who believed and did righteous deeds (to) Gardens flows from underneath it the rivers (will) abide forever in it by the permission (of) their Lord their greetings therein (will be) peace

item.title: Ibrahim:24
item.description:
Ibrahim:24 - أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
alam tara kayfa ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan kalimatan ṭayyibatan kashajaratin ṭayyibatin aṣluhā thābitun wafarʿuhā fī l-samāi
Do not you see how Allah sets forth Allah sets forth the example a word good (is) like a tree good its root (is) firm and its branches (are) in the sky

item.title: Ibrahim:25
item.description:
Ibrahim:25 - تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
tu'tī ukulahā kulla ḥīnin bi-idh'ni rabbihā wayaḍribu l-lahu l-amthāla lilnnāsi laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
Giving its fruit all time by the permission of its Lord And Allah sets forth And Allah sets forth the examples for mankind so that they may remember

item.title: Ibrahim:26
item.description:
Ibrahim:26 - وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ اجْتُثَّتْ مِنْ فَوْقِ الْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِنْ قَرَارٍ
wamathalu kalimatin khabīthatin kashajaratin khabīthatin uj'tuthat min fawqi l-arḍi mā lahā min qarārin
And (the) example (of) a word evil (is) like a tree evil uprooted from the surface (of) the earth not for it (is) any stability

item.title: Ibrahim:27
item.description:
Ibrahim:27 - يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الظَّالِمِينَ وَيَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ
yuthabbitu l-lahu alladhīna āmanū bil-qawli l-thābiti fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati wayuḍillu l-lahu l-ẓālimīna wayafʿalu l-lahu mā yashāu
Allah keeps firm Allah keeps firm those who believe with the firm word with the firm word in the life (of) the world and in the Hereafter And Allah lets go astray And Allah lets go astray the wrongdoers And Allah does And Allah does what He wills

item.title: Ibrahim:28
item.description:
Ibrahim:28 - أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ الْبَوَارِ
alam tara ilā alladhīna baddalū niʿ'mata l-lahi kuf'ran wa-aḥallū qawmahum dāra l-bawāri
Have not you seen to those who (have) changed (the) Favor (of) Allah (for) disbelief and they led their people (to the) house (of) destruction

item.title: Ibrahim:29
item.description:
Ibrahim:29 - جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا وَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
jahannama yaṣlawnahā wabi'sa l-qarāru
Hell (in) it they will burn and a wretched place to settle

item.title: Ibrahim:30
item.description:
Ibrahim:30 - وَجَعَلُوْۤا لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا لِيُضِلُّوا عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى النَّارِ
wajaʿalū lillahi andādan liyuḍillū ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿū fa-inna maṣīrakum ilā l-nāri
And they set up to Allah equals so that they mislead from His Path Say Enjoy but indeed your destination (is) to the Fire

item.title: Ibrahim:31
item.description:
Ibrahim:31 - قُلْ لِعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يُقِيمُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَيُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا بَيْعٌ فِیْهِ وَلَا خِلَالٌ
qul liʿibādiya alladhīna āmanū yuqīmū l-ṣalata wayunfiqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā bayʿun fīhi walā khilālun
Say to My slaves those who believe (to) establish the prayers and (to) spend from what We have provided them secretly and publicly before before that comes a Day not any trade in it and not any friendship

item.title: Ibrahim:32
item.description:
Ibrahim:32 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَكُمْ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِيَ فِي الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْهَارَ
al-lahu alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa-anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhraja bihi mina l-thamarāti riz'qan lakum wasakhara lakumu l-ful'ka litajriya fī l-baḥri bi-amrihi wasakhara lakumu l-anhāra
Allah (is) the One Who created the heavens and the earth and sent down from the sky water then brought forth from it of the fruits (as) a provision for you and subjected for you the ships so that they may sail in the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers

item.title: Ibrahim:33
item.description:
Ibrahim:33 - وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ دَائِبَيْنِ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ
wasakhara lakumu l-shamsa wal-qamara dāibayni wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra
And He subjected for you the sun and the moon both constantly pursuing their courses and subjected for you the night and the day

item.title: Ibrahim:34
item.description:
Ibrahim:34 - وَءَاتَاكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ وَإِنْ تَعُدُّوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ waātākum min kulli mā sa-altumūhu wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-insāna laẓalūmun kaffārun And He gave you of all what you asked of Him And if you count (the) Favor of Allah (the) Favor of Allah not you will (be able to) count them Indeed the mankind (is) surely unjust (and) ungrateful
  • [1] That is, He provided you with everything demanded by your nature and your original capacities.

item.title: Ibrahim:35
item.description:
Ibrahim:35 - وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا الْبَلَدَ اٰمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَنْ نَعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu rabbi ij'ʿal hādhā l-balada āminan wa-uj'nub'nī wabaniyya an naʿbuda l-aṣnāma
And when said Ibrahim My Lord Make this city safe and keep me away and my sons that we worship the idols

item.title: Ibrahim:36
item.description:
Ibrahim:36 - رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ النَّاسِ فَمَنْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
rabbi innahunna aḍlalna kathīran mina l-nāsi faman tabiʿanī fa-innahu minnī waman ʿaṣānī fa-innaka ghafūrun raḥīmun
My Lord Indeed, they have led astray many among the mankind So whoever follows me then indeed, he (is) of me and whoever disobeys me then indeed, You (are) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Ibrahim:37
item.description:
Ibrahim:37 - رَبَّنَا اِنِّیْ أَسْكَنْتُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِنْدَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
rabbanā innī askantu min dhurriyyatī biwādin ghayri dhī zarʿin ʿinda baytika l-muḥarami rabbanā liyuqīmū l-ṣalata fa-ij'ʿal afidatan mina l-nāsi tahwī ilayhim wa-ur'zuq'hum mina l-thamarāti laʿallahum yashkurūna
Our Lord Indeed, I [I] have settled (some) of my offsprings in a valley not with cultivation near Your Sacred House Your Sacred House our Lord That they may establish the prayers So make hearts of the men incline towards them and provide them with the fruits so that they may be grateful

item.title: Ibrahim:38
item.description:
Ibrahim:38 - رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
rabbanā innaka taʿlamu mā nukh'fī wamā nuʿ'linu wamā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min shayin fī l-arḍi walā fī l-samāi
Our Lord Indeed, You You know what we conceal and what we proclaim And not (is) hidden from Allah any thing in the earth and not in the heaven

item.title: Ibrahim:39
item.description:
Ibrahim:39 - اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى الْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī wahaba lī ʿalā l-kibari is'māʿīla wa-is'ḥāqa inna rabbī lasamīʿu l-duʿāi
All the Praise (is) for Allah the One Who has granted me in the old age Ishmael and Isaac Indeed my Lord (is) All-Hearer (of) the prayer

item.title: Ibrahim:40
item.description:
Ibrahim:40 - رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
rabbi ij'ʿalnī muqīma l-ṣalati wamin dhurriyyatī rabbanā wataqabbal duʿāi
My Lord Make me an establisher (of) the prayer and from my offsprings Our Lord and accept my prayer

item.title: Ibrahim:41
item.description:
Ibrahim:41 - رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
rabbanā igh'fir lī waliwālidayya walil'mu'minīna yawma yaqūmu l-ḥisābu
Our Lord Forgive me and my parents and the believers (on) the Day will (be) established the account

item.title: Ibrahim:42
item.description:
Ibrahim:42 - وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ غَافِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُونَ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِیْهِ الْأَبْصَارُ
walā taḥsabanna l-laha ghāfilan ʿammā yaʿmalu l-ẓālimūna innamā yu-akhiruhum liyawmin tashkhaṣu fīhi l-abṣāru
And (do) not think (that) Allah (is) unaware of what do the wrongdoers Only He gives them respite to a Day will stare in it the eyes

item.title: Ibrahim:43
item.description:
Ibrahim:43 - مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ وَأَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَاءٌ
muh'ṭiʿīna muq'niʿī ruūsihim lā yartaddu ilayhim ṭarfuhum wa-afidatuhum hawāon
Racing ahead raised up their heads not returning towards them their gaze and their hearts (are) empty

item.title: Ibrahim:44
item.description:
Ibrahim:44 - وَأَنْذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ الْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا رَبَّنَا أَخِّرْنَا إِلَى أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا أَقْسَمْتُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ زَوَالٍ wa-andhiri l-nāsa yawma yatīhimu l-ʿadhābu fayaqūlu alladhīna ẓalamū rabbanā akhir'nā ilā ajalin qarībin nujib daʿwataka wanattabiʿi l-rusula awalam takūnū aqsamtum min qablu mā lakum min zawālin And warn the mankind (of) a Day (when) will come to them the punishment then will say those who did wrong Our Lord Respite us for a term short we will answer Your call and we will follow the Messengers Had not you sworn before before not for you any end
  • [1] The appeal for respite made by the wrongdoers indicates that the punishment mentioned here is one that will befall them in the life of this world.

item.title: Ibrahim:45
item.description:
Ibrahim:45 - وَسَكَنْتُمْ فِي مَسَاكِنِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْأَمْثَالَ
wasakantum fī masākini alladhīna ẓalamū anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faʿalnā bihim waḍarabnā lakumu l-amthāla
And you dwelt in the dwellings (of) those who wronged themselves and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them and We put forth for you the examples

item.title: Ibrahim:46
item.description:
Ibrahim:46 - وَقَدْ مَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ waqad makarū makrahum waʿinda l-lahi makruhum wa-in kāna makruhum litazūla min'hu l-jibālu And indeed they planned their plan but with Allah (was) their plan even if was their plan that should be moved by it the mountains
  • [1] According to an alternate reading (with la-tazūlu), the meaning will be 'their schemes are indeed such as to dislodge (or annihilate) [even] the mountains.'

item.title: Ibrahim:47
item.description:
Ibrahim:47 - فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو انْتِقَامٍ
falā taḥsabanna l-laha mukh'lifa waʿdihi rusulahu inna l-laha ʿazīzun dhū intiqāmin
So (do) not think (that) Allah will fail (to) keep His Promise (to) His Messengers Indeed Allah (is) All-Mighty Owner (of) Retribution Owner (of) Retribution

item.title: Ibrahim:48
item.description:
Ibrahim:48 - يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
yawma tubaddalu l-arḍu ghayra l-arḍi wal-samāwātu wabarazū lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri
(On the) Day will be changed the earth (to) other (than) the earth and the heavens and they will come forth before Allah the One the Irresistible

item.title: Ibrahim:49
item.description:
Ibrahim:49 - وَتَرٰی الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ
watarā l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi
And you will see the criminals (on) that Day bound together in the chains

item.title: Ibrahim:50
item.description:
Ibrahim:50 - سَرَابِيلُهُمْ مِنْ قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشٰی وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ sarābīluhum min qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu l-nāru Their garments of tar and will cover their faces the Fire
  • [1] Or 'of molten copper.'

item.title: Ibrahim:51
item.description:
Ibrahim:51 - لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ liyajziya l-lahu kulla nafsin mā kasabat inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi So that Allah may recompense So that Allah may recompense each soul (for) what it earned Indeed Allah (is) Swift (in) the reckoning
  • [1] Or, perhaps preferably, 'so that Allah may requite every soul with what it has earned,' which implies that deeds are identical with their recompense, or that deeds are their own recompense.

item.title: Ibrahim:52
item.description:
Ibrahim:52 - هَذَا بَلَاغٌ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنْذَرُوا بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ
hādhā balāghun lilnnāsi waliyundharū bihi waliyaʿlamū annamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ulū l-albābi
This (is) a Message for the mankind that they may be warned with it and that they may know that only He (is) One God (is) One God and that may take heed men (of) understanding

item.title: 15. الحجر (Al-Hijr)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the ancient and might people of Thamūd that lived in a place or region named Ḥijr, and whom God destroyed because they belied with extreme prejudice His miraculous signs and messengers. It takes its name from Ḥijr (mentioned in verse 80). The people of Thamūd are an example of the many who disbelieved and rejected their prophets. Each has its own time for punishment so the Prophet should bear patiently, not grieve over what the disbelievers say, and continue with his worship.
The surah is also known as Stoneland, The Rocky Tract, The Stone Valley

15:1
الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُبِينٍ
alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīnin
Alif Laam Ra These (are) the Verses (of) the Book and Quran clear

15:2
رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْ كَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ
rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīna
Perhaps will wish those who disbelieved if they had been Muslims

15:3
ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوْۤا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūna
Leave them (to) eat and enjoy and diverted them the hope then soon they will come to know

item.title: Al-Hijr:1
item.description:
Al-Hijr:1 - الر تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُبِينٍ
alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīnin
Alif Laam Ra These (are) the Verses (of) the Book and Quran clear

item.title: Al-Hijr:2
item.description:
Al-Hijr:2 - رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْ كَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ
rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīna
Perhaps will wish those who disbelieved if they had been Muslims

item.title: Al-Hijr:3
item.description:
Al-Hijr:3 - ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوْۤا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūna
Leave them (to) eat and enjoy and diverted them the hope then soon they will come to know

item.title: Al-Hijr:4
item.description:
Al-Hijr:4 - وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَعْلُومٌ
wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmun
And not We destroyed any town but (there was) for it a decree known

item.title: Al-Hijr:5
item.description:
Al-Hijr:5 - مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ
mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna
Not (can) advance any nation its term and not (can) delay it

item.title: Al-Hijr:6
item.description:
Al-Hijr:6 - وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnun
And they say O you (to) whom has been sent down on him the Reminder indeed, you (are) surely mad

item.title: Al-Hijr:7
item.description:
Al-Hijr:7 - لَوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna
Why not you bring to us the Angels if you are of the truthful

item.title: Al-Hijr:8
item.description:
Al-Hijr:8 - مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا إِذًا مُنْظَرِينَ
mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīna
Not We send down the Angels except with the truth and not they would be then given respite

item.title: Al-Hijr:9
item.description:
Al-Hijr:9 - إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna Indeed, We We have sent down the Reminder and indeed, We of it (are) surely Guardians
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: Al-Hijr:10
item.description:
Al-Hijr:10 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīna
And certainly We (had) sent before you before you in the sects (of) the former (people)

item.title: Al-Hijr:11
item.description:
Al-Hijr:11 - وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And not came to them any Messenger but they did at him mock

item.title: Al-Hijr:12
item.description:
Al-Hijr:12 - كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna
Thus We let it enter in (the) hearts (of) the criminals

item.title: Al-Hijr:13
item.description:
Al-Hijr:13 - لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīna
Not they believe in it and verily have passed the way(s) (of) the former (people)

item.title: Al-Hijr:14
item.description:
Al-Hijr:14 - وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوْۤا فِیْهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūna
And (even) if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to continue therein (to) ascend

item.title: Al-Hijr:15
item.description:
Al-Hijr:15 - لَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَسْحُورُونَ
laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūna
They would surely say Only have been dazzled our eyes Nay we (are) a people bewitched

item.title: Al-Hijr:16
item.description:
Al-Hijr:16 - وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīna And verily We have placed in the heavens constellations and We have beautified it for the observers
  • [1] House: One of the 12 parts into which the heavens are divided in astrology. Cf. (Q 25:61); (Q 85:1).

item.title: Al-Hijr:17
item.description:
Al-Hijr:17 - وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ
waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmin
And We have protected it from every devil accursed

item.title: Al-Hijr:18
item.description:
Al-Hijr:18 - إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnun Except (one) who steals the hearing then follows him a burning flame clear
  • [1] Or 'meteor.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:19
item.description:
Al-Hijr:19 - وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَوْزُونٍ
wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūnin
And the earth We have spread it and [We] cast therein firm mountains and [We] caused to grow therein of every thing well-balanced

item.title: Al-Hijr:20
item.description:
Al-Hijr:20 - وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ
wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīna
And We have made for you therein means of living and whom you are not for him providers

item.title: Al-Hijr:21
item.description:
Al-Hijr:21 - وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ
wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmin
And not (is) any thing but with Us (are) its treasures and not We send it down except in a measure known

item.title: Al-Hijr:22
item.description:
Al-Hijr:22 - وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ
wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīna
And We have sent the winds fertilizing and We sent down from the sky water and We gave it to you to drink And not you of it (are) retainers

item.title: Al-Hijr:23
item.description:
Al-Hijr:23 - وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ
wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūna
And indeed, We surely [We] We give life and We cause death and We (are) the Inheritors

item.title: Al-Hijr:24
item.description:
Al-Hijr:24 - وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَءْخِرِينَ
walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīna
And verily We know the preceding ones among you and verily We know the later ones

item.title: Al-Hijr:25
item.description:
Al-Hijr:25 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِیْمٌ۠ عَلِیْمٌ
wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun
And indeed your Lord He will gather them Indeed, He (is) All-Wise All-Knowing

item.title: Al-Hijr:26
item.description:
Al-Hijr:26 - وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin And verily We created humankind (out) of sounding clay from black mud altered
  • [1] Or 'clinking clay,' that is, giving a clinking sound due to being hard and dry. Cf. (Q 15:28).

item.title: Al-Hijr:27
item.description:
Al-Hijr:27 - وَالْجَانَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَارِ السَّمُومِ
wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūmi
And the jinn We created it before before from fire scorching

item.title: Al-Hijr:28
item.description:
Al-Hijr:28 - وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ
wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin
And when your Lord said your Lord said to the Angels Indeed, I (will) create a human being (out) of clay from black mud altered

item.title: Al-Hijr:29
item.description:
Al-Hijr:29 - فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ
fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna
So, when I have fashioned him and [I] breathed into him of My spirit then fall down to him prostrating

item.title: Al-Hijr:30
item.description:
Al-Hijr:30 - فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna
So prostrated the Angels all of them together

item.title: Al-Hijr:31
item.description:
Al-Hijr:31 - إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبٰی أَنْ يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ
illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīna
Except Iblis He refused to be with those who prostrated

item.title: Al-Hijr:32
item.description:
Al-Hijr:32 - قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ
qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīna
He said O Iblis What (is) for you that not you are with those who prostrated

item.title: Al-Hijr:33
item.description:
Al-Hijr:33 - قَالَ لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِنْ حَمَإٍ مَسْنُونٍ
qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin
He said I am not I am not (one) to prostrate to a human whom You created (out) of clay from black mud altered

item.title: Al-Hijr:34
item.description:
Al-Hijr:34 - قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun
He said Then get out of it for indeed, you (are) expelled

item.title: Al-Hijr:35
item.description:
Al-Hijr:35 - وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīni And indeed upon you (will be) the curse till (the) Day (of) [the] Judgment
  • [1] Or 'the Day of Judgement.'

item.title: Al-Hijr:36
item.description:
Al-Hijr:36 - قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna
He said O my Lord Then give me respite till (the) Day they are raised

item.title: Al-Hijr:37
item.description:
Al-Hijr:37 - قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ
qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna
He said Then indeed you (are) of the ones given respite

item.title: Al-Hijr:38
item.description:
Al-Hijr:38 - إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ
ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi
Till the Day (of) the time well-known

item.title: Al-Hijr:39
item.description:
Al-Hijr:39 - قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna
He said My Lord Because You misled me surely, I will make (evil) fair-seeming to them in the earth and I will mislead them all

item.title: Al-Hijr:40
item.description:
Al-Hijr:40 - إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna
Except Your slaves among them the ones who are sincere

item.title: Al-Hijr:41
item.description:
Al-Hijr:41 - قَالَ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīmun He said This (is) the way to Me straight
  • [1] Read alternatively as hādhā ṣirāṭun 'alīyyun mustaqīm, meaning 'this is an exalted straight path.' This reading is narrated from al-Imam al-Ṣādiq (Majma' al-Bayān) and from thirteen other authorities, among them Ya'qūb, al-Ḍaḥḥāk, Mujāhid, Qatādah, and Ibn Sīrīn. (See Mu'jam al-Qirā'āt al-Qur'āniyyah).

item.title: Al-Hijr:42
item.description:
Al-Hijr:42 - إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ
inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīna
Indeed My slaves not you have over them any authority except those who follow you of the ones who go astray

item.title: Al-Hijr:43
item.description:
Al-Hijr:43 - وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīna
And indeed Hell (is) surely the promised place for them all

item.title: Al-Hijr:44
item.description:
Al-Hijr:44 - لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَقْسُومٌ
lahā sabʿatu abwābin likulli bābin min'hum juz'on maqsūmun
For it (are) seven gates for each gate among them (is) a portion assigned

item.title: Al-Hijr:45
item.description:
Al-Hijr:45 - إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin
Indeed the righteous (will be) in Gardens and water springs

item.title: Al-Hijr:46
item.description:
Al-Hijr:46 - اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīna
Enter it in peace secure

item.title: Al-Hijr:47
item.description:
Al-Hijr:47 - وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِمْ مِنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَانًا عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ
wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna
And We (will) remove what (is) in their breasts of rancor (they will be) brothers on thrones facing each other

item.title: Al-Hijr:48
item.description:
Al-Hijr:48 - لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُمْ مِنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīna
Not will touch them therein fatigue and not they from it will be removed

item.title: Al-Hijr:49
item.description:
Al-Hijr:49 - نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
Inform My slaves that I I am the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Hijr:50
item.description:
Al-Hijr:50 - وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ
wa-anna ʿadhābī huwa l-ʿadhābu l-alīmu
And that My punishment it (is) the punishment the most painful

item.title: Al-Hijr:51
item.description:
Al-Hijr:51 - وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ
wanabbi'hum ʿan ḍayfi ib'rāhīma
And inform them about (the) guests (of) Ibrahim

item.title: Al-Hijr:52
item.description:
Al-Hijr:52 - إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla innā minkum wajilūna
When they entered upon him and said Peace He said Indeed, we (are) of you afraid

item.title: Al-Hijr:53
item.description:
Al-Hijr:53 - قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ
qālū lā tawjal innā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīmin
They said (Do) not be afraid indeed, we [we] bring glad tidings to you of a boy learned

item.title: Al-Hijr:54
item.description:
Al-Hijr:54 - قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَى أَنْ مَسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā an massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūna
He said Do you give me glad tidings Do you give me glad tidings although has overtaken me old age Then about what you give glad tidings

item.title: Al-Hijr:55
item.description:
Al-Hijr:55 - قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِنَ الْقَانِطِينَ
qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takun mina l-qāniṭīna
They said We give you glad tidings in truth so (do) not be of the despairing

item.title: Al-Hijr:56
item.description:
Al-Hijr:56 - قَالَ وَمَنْ يَقْنَطُ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ
qāla waman yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi illā l-ḍālūna
He said And who despairs of (the) Mercy (of) his Lord except those who are astray

item.title: Al-Hijr:57
item.description:
Al-Hijr:57 - قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ
qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna
He said Then what (is) your business O messengers O messengers

item.title: Al-Hijr:58
item.description:
Al-Hijr:58 - قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ
qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna
They said Indeed, we [we] have been sent to a people criminals

item.title: Al-Hijr:59
item.description:
Al-Hijr:59 - إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīna
Except the family of Lut indeed, we surely will save them all

item.title: Al-Hijr:60
item.description:
Al-Hijr:60 - إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ
illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīna
Except his wife We have decreed that she (is) surely of those who remain behind

item.title: Al-Hijr:61
item.description:
Al-Hijr:61 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ اٰلَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ
falammā jāa āla lūṭin l-mur'salūna
And when came (to the) family (of) Lut the messengers

item.title: Al-Hijr:62
item.description:
Al-Hijr:62 - قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ
qāla innakum qawmun munkarūna
He said Indeed, you (are) a people unknown

item.title: Al-Hijr:63
item.description:
Al-Hijr:63 - قَالُوْا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūna
They said Nay we have come to you with what they were in it disputing

item.title: Al-Hijr:64
item.description:
Al-Hijr:64 - وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūna
And we have come to you with the truth and indeed, we surely (are) truthful

item.title: Al-Hijr:65
item.description:
Al-Hijr:65 - فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوْۤا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūna
So travel with your family in a portion of the night and follow their backs and not let look back among you anyone and go on where you are ordered

item.title: Al-Hijr:66
item.description:
Al-Hijr:66 - وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُصْبِحِينَ waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿun muṣ'biḥīna And We conveyed to him that the matter that (the) root (of) these would be cut off (by) early morning
  • [1] That is, the people of Sodom.

item.title: Al-Hijr:67
item.description:
Al-Hijr:67 - وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūna
And came (the) people (of) the city rejoicing

item.title: Al-Hijr:68
item.description:
Al-Hijr:68 - قَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūni
He said Indeed these (are) my guests so (do) not shame me

item.title: Al-Hijr:69
item.description:
Al-Hijr:69 - وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni
And fear Allah and (do) not disgrace me

item.title: Al-Hijr:70
item.description:
Al-Hijr:70 - قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīna They said Did not we forbid you from the world
  • [1] Or, from entertaining.

item.title: Al-Hijr:71
item.description:
Al-Hijr:71 - قَالَ هَؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīna
He said These (are) my daughters if you would be doers

item.title: Al-Hijr:72
item.description:
Al-Hijr:72 - لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūna
By your life indeed, they were in their intoxication wandering blindly

item.title: Al-Hijr:73
item.description:
Al-Hijr:73 - فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīna
So, seized them the awful cry at sunrise

item.title: Al-Hijr:74
item.description:
Al-Hijr:74 - فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min sijjīlin And We made its highest (part) its lowest and We rained upon them stones of baked clay
  • [1] That is, of the city of Sodom.

item.title: Al-Hijr:75
item.description:
Al-Hijr:75 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'mutawassimīna
Indeed in that (are) the Signs for those who discern

item.title: Al-Hijr:76
item.description:
Al-Hijr:76 - وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُقِيمٍ
wa-innahā labisabīlin muqīmin
And indeed, it (is) on a road established

item.title: Al-Hijr:77
item.description:
Al-Hijr:77 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely (is) a Sign for the believers

item.title: Al-Hijr:78
item.description:
Al-Hijr:78 - وَإِنْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīna And were And were (the) companions (of) the wood surely wrongdoers
  • [1] Apparently, one of the towns to which the prophet Shu'ayb ('a) was sent. Cf. (Q 26:176); (Q 38:13); (Q 50:14).

item.title: Al-Hijr:79
item.description:
Al-Hijr:79 - فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmin mubīnin So We took retribution from them and indeed, they both (were) on a highway clear
  • [1] That is, Sodom and Aykah.

item.title: Al-Hijr:80
item.description:
Al-Hijr:80 - وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīna
And certainly denied (the) companions (of) the Rocky Tract the Messengers

item.title: Al-Hijr:81
item.description:
Al-Hijr:81 - وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فَكَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna
And We gave them Our Signs but they were from them turning away

item.title: Al-Hijr:82
item.description:
Al-Hijr:82 - وَكَانُوْۤا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīna
And they used (to) carve from the mountains houses secure

item.title: Al-Hijr:83
item.description:
Al-Hijr:83 - فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīna
But seized them the awful cry (at) early morning

item.title: Al-Hijr:84
item.description:
Al-Hijr:84 - فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ
famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna
And not availed them what they used (to) earn

item.title: Al-Hijr:85
item.description:
Al-Hijr:85 - وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ
wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi l-ṣafḥa l-jamīla
And not We created the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them except in truth And indeed the Hour (is) surely coming So overlook (with) forgiveness gracious

item.title: Al-Hijr:86
item.description:
Al-Hijr:86 - إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ
inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu
Indeed your Lord He (is) the Creator the All-Knower

item.title: Al-Hijr:87
item.description:
Al-Hijr:87 - وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīma And certainly We have given you seven of the oft-repeated and the Quran Great
