But as for (one) who believes and does righteous (deeds) then for him (is) a reward good And we will speak to him from our command (with) ease

item.title: Al-Kahf:89
item.description:
Al-Kahf:89 - ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
thumma atbaʿa sababan
Then he followed (a) course

item.title: Al-Kahf:90
item.description:
Al-Kahf:90 - حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ الشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِهَا سِتْرًا
ḥattā idhā balagha maṭliʿa l-shamsi wajadahā taṭluʿu ʿalā qawmin lam najʿal lahum min dūnihā sit'ran
Until when he reached (the) rising place (of) the sun and he found it rising on a community not We made for them against it against it any shelter

item.title: Al-Kahf:91
item.description:
Al-Kahf:91 - كَذٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًا
kadhālika waqad aḥaṭnā bimā ladayhi khub'ran
Thus And verily We encompassed of what (was) with him (of the) information

item.title: Al-Kahf:92
item.description:
Al-Kahf:92 - ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
thumma atbaʿa sababan
Then he followed a course

item.title: Al-Kahf:93
item.description:
Al-Kahf:93 - حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ السَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًا لَا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًا
ḥattā idhā balagha bayna l-sadayni wajada min dūnihimā qawman lā yakādūna yafqahūna qawlan
Until when he reached between the two mountains he found besides them besides them a community not who would almost understand (his) speech

item.title: Al-Kahf:94
item.description:
Al-Kahf:94 - قَالُوْا يَاذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا
qālū yādhā l-qarnayni inna yajūja wamajūja muf'sidūna fī l-arḍi fahal najʿalu laka kharjan ʿalā an tajʿala baynanā wabaynahum saddan
They said O Dhul-qarnain O Dhul-qarnain Indeed Yajuj and Majuj (are) corrupters in the land So may we make for you an expenditure on that you make between us and between them a barrier

item.title: Al-Kahf:95
item.description:
Al-Kahf:95 - قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّي فِیْهِ رَبِّي خَيْرٌ فَأَعِينُونِي بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
qāla mā makkannī fīhi rabbī khayrun fa-aʿīnūnī biquwwatin ajʿal baynakum wabaynahum radman
He said What has established me in it my Lord (is) better but assist me with strength I will make between you and between them a barrier

item.title: Al-Kahf:96
item.description:
Al-Kahf:96 - ءَاتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ حَتّٰی إِذَا سَاوَى بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انْفُخُوْۤا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ ءَاتُونِي أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا
ātūnī zubara l-ḥadīdi ḥattā idhā sāwā bayna l-ṣadafayni qāla unfukhū ḥattā idhā jaʿalahu nāran qāla ātūnī uf'righ ʿalayhi qiṭ'ran
Bring me sheets (of) iron until when he (had) leveled between the two cliffs he said Blow until when he made it fire he said Bring me I pour over it molten copper

item.title: Al-Kahf:97
item.description:
Al-Kahf:97 - فَمَا اسْطَاعُوْۤا أَنْ يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا لَهُ نَقْبًا
famā is'ṭāʿū an yaẓharūhu wamā is'taṭāʿū lahu naqban
So not they were able to scale it and not they were able in it (to do) any penetration

item.title: Al-Kahf:98
item.description:
Al-Kahf:98 - قَالَ هَذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّي فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي حَقًّا qāla hādhā raḥmatun min rabbī fa-idhā jāa waʿdu rabbī jaʿalahu dakkāa wakāna waʿdu rabbī ḥaqqan He said This (is) a mercy from my Lord But when comes (the) Promise (of) my Lord He will make it level And is (the) Promise (of) my Lord true
  • [1] Or, 'He will make it crumble.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:99
item.description:
Al-Kahf:99 - وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَمُوجُ فِي بَعْضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا
wataraknā baʿḍahum yawma-idhin yamūju fī baʿḍin wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fajamaʿnāhum jamʿan
And We (will) leave some of them (on) that Day to surge over others and (will be) blown in the trumpet then We (will) gather them all together

item.title: Al-Kahf:100
item.description:
Al-Kahf:100 - وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَرْضًا
waʿaraḍnā jahannama yawma-idhin lil'kāfirīna ʿarḍan
And We (will) present Hell (on) that Day to the disbelievers (on) display

item.title: Al-Kahf:101
item.description:
Al-Kahf:101 - اَلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِي غِطَاءٍ عَنْ ذِكْرِي وَكَانُوْۤا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
alladhīna kānat aʿyunuhum fī ghiṭāin ʿan dhik'rī wakānū lā yastaṭīʿūna samʿan
Those had been their eyes within a cover from My remembrance and were not able (to) hear

item.title: Al-Kahf:102
item.description:
Al-Kahf:102 - أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنْ يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِنْ دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا
afaḥasiba alladhīna kafarū an yattakhidhū ʿibādī min dūnī awliyāa innā aʿtadnā jahannama lil'kāfirīna nuzulan
Do then think those who disbelieve that they (can) take My servants besides Me besides Me (as) protectors Indeed, We We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers (as) a lodging

item.title: Al-Kahf:103
item.description:
Al-Kahf:103 - قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِالْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَالًا
qul hal nunabbi-ukum bil-akhsarīna aʿmālan
Say Shall We inform you of the greatest losers (as to their) deeds

item.title: Al-Kahf:104
item.description:
Al-Kahf:104 - اَلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
alladhīna ḍalla saʿyuhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wahum yaḥsabūna annahum yuḥ'sinūna ṣun'ʿan
Those is lost their effort in the life (of) the world while they think that they (were) acquiring good (in) work

item.title: Al-Kahf:105
item.description:
Al-Kahf:105 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَائِهِ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا
ulāika alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim waliqāihi faḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum falā nuqīmu lahum yawma l-qiyāmati waznan
Those (are) the ones who disbelieve in the Verses (of) their Lord and the meeting (with) Him So (are) vain their deeds so not We will assign for them (on) the Day (of) the Resurrection any weight

item.title: Al-Kahf:106
item.description:
Al-Kahf:106 - ذٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوْۤا وَاتَّخَذُوا ءَايَاتِي وَرُسُلِي هُزُوًا
dhālika jazāuhum jahannamu bimā kafarū wa-ittakhadhū āyātī warusulī huzuwan
That (is) their recompense Hell because they disbelieved and took My Verses and My Messengers (in) ridicule

item.title: Al-Kahf:107
item.description:
Al-Kahf:107 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kānat lahum jannātu l-fir'dawsi nuzulan Indeed those who believed and did righteous deeds for them will be for them will be Gardens (of) the Paradise (as) a lodging
  • [1] Said to be the highest and choicest part of paradise. See Ṭabarī, Baḥrānī and Qummī.
  • [2] Or 'hospitality.'

item.title: Al-Kahf:108
item.description:
Al-Kahf:108 - خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًا
khālidīna fīhā lā yabghūna ʿanhā ḥiwalan
Abiding forever in it Not they will desire from it any transfer

item.title: Al-Kahf:109
item.description:
Al-Kahf:109 - قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا
qul law kāna l-baḥru midādan likalimāti rabbī lanafida l-baḥru qabla an tanfada kalimātu rabbī walaw ji'nā bimith'lihi madadan
Say If were the sea ink for (the) Words (of) my Lord surely (would be) exhausted the sea before that (were) exhausted (the) Words (of) my Lord even if We brought (the) like (of) it (as) a supplement

item.title: Al-Kahf:110
item.description:
Al-Kahf:110 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوْۤا لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا
qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun faman kāna yarjū liqāa rabbihi falyaʿmal ʿamalan ṣāliḥan walā yush'rik biʿibādati rabbihi aḥadan
Say Only I (am) a man like you Has been revealed to me that your God (is) God One So whoever is hoping (for the) meeting (with) his Lord let him do deeds righteous and not associate in (the) worship (of) his Lord anyone

item.title: 19. مريم (Maryam)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the miracle-filled story of Mary and how, though an untouched virgin, she gave birth to Jesus, the true Messiah and a human messenger of God to the Children of Israel. It takes its names from the story of Mary told in verse 16 ff. It recounts the grace given by God to a number of prophets and tells aspects of their stories. The claim that Jesus is the son of God is firmly denied, as is the assertion of the pagans of Mecca that the angels are God's daughters. From verse 66 ff. the surah discusses the arrogant assertions of the disbelievers of Mecca. The Prophet is told that God's punishment is coming to them and exhorted not to be impatient for it to arrive or to receive the revelation (verse 64).

19:1
كهيعص
kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad
Kaaf Ha Ya Ain Sad

19:2
ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا
dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā
(A) mention (of the) Mercy (of) your Lord (to) His servant Zakariya

19:3
إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا
idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyan
When he called (to) his Lord a call secret

item.title: Maryam:1
item.description:
Maryam:1 - كهيعص
kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad
Kaaf Ha Ya Ain Sad

item.title: Maryam:2
item.description:
Maryam:2 - ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّا dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā (A) mention (of the) Mercy (of) your Lord (to) His servant Zakariya
  • [1] Or 'a mention,' 'a reminder,' or 'a recollection.'

item.title: Maryam:3
item.description:
Maryam:3 - إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا
idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyan
When he called (to) his Lord a call secret

item.title: Maryam:4
item.description:
Maryam:4 - قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala l-rasu shayban walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyyan
He said My Lord Indeed, [I] (have) weakened my bones my bones and flared (my) head (with) white and not I have been in (my) supplication (to) You my Lord unblessed

item.title: Maryam:5
item.description:
Maryam:5 - وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِنْ وَرَاءِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ وَلِيًّا
wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya min warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī min ladunka waliyyan
And indeed, I [I] fear the successors after me after me and is my wife barren So give [to] me from Yourself an heir

item.title: Maryam:6
item.description:
Maryam:6 - يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan
Who will inherit me and inherit from (the) family (of) Yaqub And make him my Lord pleasing

item.title: Maryam:7
item.description:
Maryam:7 - يَازَكَرِيَّا إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَى لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyyan
O Zakariya Indeed, We [We] give you glad tidings of a boy his name (will be) Yahya not We (have) assigned [for] it before before (this) name

item.title: Maryam:8
item.description:
Maryam:8 - قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyyan
He said My Lord How can I have a boy while is my wife barren and indeed I have reached of the old age extreme

item.title: Maryam:9
item.description:
Maryam:9 - قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْئًا
qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan
He said Thus said your Lord 'It (is) easy for Me (is) easy for Me and certainly I (have) created you before before while not you were anything.'

item.title: Maryam:10
item.description:
Maryam:10 - قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِي اٰیَةً قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima l-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyan
He said My Lord Make for me a sign He said Your sign (is) that not you will speak (to) the people (for) three nights sound

item.title: Maryam:11
item.description:
Maryam:11 - فَخَرَجَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَى إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ سَبِّحُوْۤا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'ratan waʿashiyyan
Then he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and he signaled to them to glorify (Allah) (in) the morning and (in) the evening

item.title: Maryam:12
item.description:
Maryam:12 - يَايَحْيَى خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatin waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyyan
O Yahya Hold the Scripture with strength And We gave him [the] wisdom (when he was) a child

item.title: Maryam:13
item.description:
Maryam:13 - وَحَنَانًا مِنْ لَدُنَّا وَزَكَوةً وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
waḥanānan min ladunnā wazakatan wakāna taqiyyan
And affection from Us and purity and he was righteous

item.title: Maryam:14
item.description:
Maryam:14 - وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyan
And dutiful to his parents and not he was a tyrant disobedient

item.title: Maryam:15
item.description:
Maryam:15 - وَسَلَامٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayyan
And peace be upon him (the) day he was born and (the) day he dies and (the) day he will be raised alive

item.title: Maryam:16
item.description:
Maryam:16 - وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyan
And mention in the Book Maryam when she withdrew from her family (to) a place eastern

item.title: Maryam:17
item.description:
Maryam:17 - فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyan Then she took from them from them a screen Then We sent to her Our Spirit then he assumed for her the likeness then he assumed for her the likeness (of) a man well-proportioned
  • [1] That is, Gabriel ('a).

item.title: Maryam:18
item.description:
Maryam:18 - قَالَتْ اِنِّیْ أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ مِنْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِيًّا
qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyan
She said Indeed, I [I] seek refuge with the Most Gracious from you if you are God fearing

item.title: Maryam:19
item.description:
Maryam:19 - قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا
qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyan
He said Only I am a Messenger (from) your Lord that I (may) bestow on you a son pure

item.title: Maryam:20
item.description:
Maryam:20 - قَالَتْ أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmun walam yamsasnī basharun walam aku baghiyyan
She said How can be for me a son when not has touched me a man and not I am unchaste

item.title: Maryam:21
item.description:
Maryam:21 - قَالَ كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُ اٰیَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَقْضِيًّا
qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinun walinajʿalahu āyatan lilnnāsi waraḥmatan minnā wakāna amran maqḍiyyan
He said Thus said your Lord 'It (is) for Me easy and so that We will make him a sign for the mankind and a Mercy from Us And (it) is a matter decreed.'

item.title: Maryam:22
item.description:
Maryam:22 - فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyan
So she conceived him and she withdrew with him (to) a place remote

item.title: Maryam:23
item.description:
Maryam:23 - فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَالَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَذَا وَكُنْتُ نَسْيًا مَنْسِيًّا
fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi l-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan
Then drove her the pains of childbirth to (the) trunk (of) the date-palm She said O! I wish I (had) died before this and I was (in) oblivion forgotten

item.title: Maryam:24
item.description:
Maryam:24 - فَنَادَاهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyan So cried to her from beneath her That (do) not grieve verily (has) placed your Lord beneath you a stream
  • [1] That is, the angel Gabriel, or the baby Jesus, whom she was carrying in her belly.

item.title: Maryam:25
item.description:
Maryam:25 - وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi l-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyan
And shake towards you (the) trunk (of) the date-palm it will drop upon you fresh dates ripe

item.title: Maryam:26
item.description:
Maryam:26 - فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنْسِيًّا
fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyyan
So eat and drink and cool (your) eyes And if you see from human being anyone then say Indeed, I [I] have vowed to the Most Gracious a fast so not I will speak today (to any) human being

item.title: Maryam:27
item.description:
Maryam:27 - فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ قَالُوْا يَامَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا
fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyyan
Then she came with him (to) her people carrying him They said O Maryam Certainly you (have) brought an amazing thing an amazing thing

item.title: Maryam:28
item.description:
Maryam:28 - يَاأُخْتَ هَارُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ امْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawin wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyan
O sister (of) Harun Not was your father an evil man an evil man and not was your mother unchaste

item.title: Maryam:29
item.description:
Maryam:29 - فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ قَالُوْا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyyan
Then she pointed to him They said How (can) we speak (to one) who is in the cradle a child

item.title: Maryam:30
item.description:
Maryam:30 - قَالَ اِنِّیْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ءَاتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا
qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyan
He said Indeed, I am a slave (of) Allah He gave me the Scripture and made me a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:31
item.description:
Maryam:31 - وَجَعَلَنِي مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُ وَأَوْصَانِي بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayyan
And He (has) made me blessed wherever wherever I am and has enjoined (on) me [of] the prayer and zakah as long as I am as long as I am alive

item.title: Maryam:32
item.description:
Maryam:32 - وَبَرًّا بِوَالِدَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِي جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyan
And dutiful to my mother and not He (has) made me insolent unblessed

item.title: Maryam:33
item.description:
Maryam:33 - وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدْتُ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayyan
And peace (be) on me (the) day I was born and (the) day I will die and (the) Day I will be raised alive

item.title: Maryam:34
item.description:
Maryam:34 - ذٰلِكَ عِيسٰی ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūna
That (was) Isa (the) son (of) Maryam a statement (of) truth that which about it they dispute

item.title: Maryam:35
item.description:
Maryam:35 - مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَلَدٍ سُبْحَانَهُ إِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu
Not (it) is for Allah that He should take any son any son Glory be to Him When He decrees a matter then only He says to it Be and it is

item.title: Maryam:36
item.description:
Maryam:36 - وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun
And indeed Allah (is) my Lord and your Lord so worship Him This (is) a path straight

item.title: Maryam:37
item.description:
Maryam:37 - فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ مَشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin
But differed the sects from among them from among them so woe to those who disbelieve from (the) witnessing (of) a Day great

item.title: Maryam:38
item.description:
Maryam:38 - أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا لَكِنِ الظَّالِمُونَ الْيَوْمَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīnin
How they will hear How they will hear and how (they will) see (the) Day they will come to Us but the wrongdoers today (are) in error clear

item.title: Maryam:39
item.description:
Maryam:39 - وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūna And warn them (of the) Day (of) the Regret when has been decided the matter And they (are) in heedlessness and they (do) not believe
  • [1] Another name for the Day of Judgement.

item.title: Maryam:40
item.description:
Maryam:40 - إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna
Indeed, We We [We] will inherit the earth and whoever (is) on it and to Us they will be returned

item.title: Maryam:41
item.description:
Maryam:41 - وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا
wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan
And mention in the Book Ibrahim Indeed, he was a man of truth a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:42
item.description:
Maryam:42 - إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَاأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْكَ شَيْئًا
idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayan
When he said to his father O my father Why (do) you worship that which not hears and not sees and not benefits [to] you (in) anything

item.title: Maryam:43
item.description:
Maryam:43 - يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ قَدْ جَاءَنِي مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِي أَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِيًّا
yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan
O my father Indeed, [I] verily (has) come to me of the knowledge what not came to you so follow me I will guide you (to) the path even

item.title: Maryam:44
item.description:
Maryam:44 - يَاأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ عَصِيًّا
yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan
O my father (Do) not worship the Shaitaan Indeed the Shaitaan is to the Most Gracious disobedient

item.title: Maryam:45
item.description:
Maryam:45 - يَاأَبَتِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيًّا
yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan
O my father Indeed, I [I] fear that will touch you a punishment from the Most Gracious so you would be to the Shaitaan a friend

item.title: Maryam:46
item.description:
Maryam:46 - قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنْتَ عَنْ آلِهَتِي يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَاهْجُرْنِي مَلِيًّا qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyan He said Do you hate Do you hate (from) my gods O Ibrahim Surely, if not you desist surely, I will stone you so leave me (for) a prolonged time
  • [1] That is, 'Go away. Stop annoying me.'

item.title: Maryam:47
item.description:
Maryam:47 - قَالَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِي حَفِيًّا
qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyan
He said Peace (be) on you I will ask forgiveness for you (from) my Lord Indeed, He is to me Ever Gracious

item.title: Maryam:48
item.description:
Maryam:48 - وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي عَسٰۤی أَلَّا أَكُونَ بِدُعَاءِ رَبِّي شَقِيًّا
wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyan
And I will leave you and what you invoke besides besides Allah and I will invoke my Lord May be that not I will be in invocation (to) my Lord unblessed

item.title: Maryam:49
item.description:
Maryam:49 - فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan
So when he left them and what they worshipped besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah [and] We bestowed [to] him Isaac and Yaqub and each (of them) We made a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:50
item.description:
Maryam:50 - وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyan
And We bestowed to them of Our Mercy and We made for them a truthful mention a truthful mention high

item.title: Maryam:51
item.description:
Maryam:51 - وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسٰی إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا
wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan
And mention in the Book Musa Indeed, he was chosen and was a Messenger a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:52
item.description:
Maryam:52 - وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا
wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan
And We called him from (the) side (of) the Mount the right and brought him near (for) conversation

item.title: Maryam:53
item.description:
Maryam:53 - وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِنَا أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ نَبِيًّا
wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyan
And We bestowed [to] him from Our Mercy his brother Harun a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:54
item.description:
Maryam:54 - وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَبِيًّا
wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan
And mention in the Book Ishmael Indeed, he was true (to his) promise and was a Messenger a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:55
item.description:
Maryam:55 - وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَوةِ وَكَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا
wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan
And he used (to) enjoin (on) his people the prayer and zakah and was near his Lord pleasing

item.title: Maryam:56
item.description:
Maryam:56 - وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا
wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan
And mention in the Book Idris Indeed, he was truthful a Prophet

item.title: Maryam:57
item.description:
Maryam:57 - وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan
And We raised him (to) a position high

item.title: Maryam:58
item.description:
Maryam:58 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اٰدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْرَاءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَا إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُ الرَّحْمَنِ خَرُّوْۤا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyyan
Those (were) the ones whom Allah bestowed favor Allah bestowed favor upon them from (among) the Prophets of (the) offspring (of) Adam and of those We carried with Nuh and of (the) offspring (of) Ibrahim and Israel and of (those) whom We guided and We chose When were recited to them (the) Verses (of) the Most Gracious they fell prostrating and weeping

item.title: Maryam:59
item.description:
Maryam:59 - فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan
Then succeeded after them after them successors who neglected the prayer and they followed the lusts so soon they will meet evil

item.title: Maryam:60
item.description:
Maryam:60 - إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا
illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayan
Except (one) who repented and believed and did good (deeds) Then those will enter Paradise and not they will be wronged (in) anything

item.title: Maryam:61
item.description:
Maryam:61 - جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا
jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyan
Gardens (of) Eden which promised the Most Gracious (to) His slaves in the unseen Indeed, [it] is His promise sure to come

item.title: Maryam:62
item.description:
Maryam:62 - لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyyan
Not they will hear therein vain talk but peace And for them (is) their provision therein morning and evening

item.title: Maryam:63
item.description:
Maryam:63 - تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِيًّا
til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan
This (is) Paradise which We give (as) inheritance [of] (to) Our slaves (the one) who is righteous

item.title: Maryam:64
item.description:
Maryam:64 - وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan
And not we descend except by (the) Command (of) your Lord To Him (belongs) what (is) before us (is) before us and what (is) behind us and what (is) between that And not is your Lord forgetful

item.title: Maryam:65
item.description:
Maryam:65 - رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا
rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan
Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between both of them so worship Him and be constant in His worship Do you know for Him any similarity

item.title: Maryam:66
item.description:
Maryam:66 - وَيَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyan
And says [the] man What! When What! When I am dead surely will I be brought forth alive

item.title: Maryam:67
item.description:
Maryam:67 - أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا
awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayan
Does not remember [the] man that We We created him before before while not he was anything

item.title: Maryam:68
item.description:
Maryam:68 - فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan So by your Lord surely, We will gather them and the devils then surely, We will bring them around Hell bent (on) knees
  • [1] Or 'in groups.'

item.title: Maryam:69
item.description:
Maryam:69 - ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَنِ عِتِيًّا
thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan
Then surely, We will drag out from every sect those of them (who were) worst against the Most Gracious (in) rebellion

item.title: Maryam:70
item.description:
Maryam:70 - ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَى بِهَا صِلِيًّا
thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyan
Then surely, We know best [of] those who they (are) most worthy therein (of) being burnt

item.title: Maryam:71
item.description:
Maryam:71 - وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyyan And (there is) not (any) of you but (will be) passing over it (This) is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed
  • [1] That is, they will approach it, without entering it.

item.title: Maryam:72
item.description:
Maryam:72 - ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan
Then We will deliver those who feared (Allah) and We will leave the wrongdoers therein bent (on) knees

item.title: Maryam:73
item.description:
Maryam:73 - وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan And when are recited to them Our Verses clear say those who disbelieved to those who believed Which (of) the two groups (is) better (in) position and best (in) assembly
  • [1] Or 'superior with respect to dwelling.'
  • [2] Or 'better with respect to gatherings.'

item.title: Maryam:74
item.description:
Maryam:74 - وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِءْيًا
wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'yan
And how many We destroyed before them of a generation they (were) better (in) possessions and appearance

item.title: Maryam:75
item.description:
Maryam:75 - قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ مَدًّا حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا
qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan
Say Whoever is in [the] error then surely will extend for him the Most Gracious an extension until when they see what they were promised either the punishment or the Hour then they will know who he (is) worst (in) position and weaker (in) forces

item.title: Maryam:76
item.description:
Maryam:76 - وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَرَدًّا
wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maraddan
And Allah increases And Allah increases those who accept guidance (in) guidance And the everlasting good deeds (are) better near your Lord (for) reward and better (for) return

item.title: Maryam:77
item.description:
Maryam:77 - أَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawaladan
Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our Verses and said Surely, I will be given wealth and children

item.title: Maryam:78
item.description:
Maryam:78 - أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا
aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan
Has he looked (into) the unseen or has he taken from the Most Gracious a promise

item.title: Maryam:79
item.description:
Maryam:79 - كَلَّا سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddan
Nay We will record what he says and We will extend for him from the punishment extensively

item.title: Maryam:80
item.description:
Maryam:80 - وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardan And We will inherit (from) him what he says and he will come to Us alone
  • [1] That is, 'He will depart unaccompanied from the world, leaving in Our possession the wealth and children that he talks about.'

item.title: Maryam:81
item.description:
Maryam:81 - وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا
wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizzan
And they have taken besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah gods that they may be for them an honor

item.title: Maryam:82
item.description:
Maryam:82 - كَلَّا سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan
Nay they will deny their worship (of them) and they will be against them opponents

item.title: Maryam:83
item.description:
Maryam:83 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzan
Do not you see that We [We] have sent the devils upon the disbelievers inciting them (with) incitement

item.title: Maryam:84
item.description:
Maryam:84 - فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan So (do) not make haste against them Only We count for them a number
  • [1] That is, the number of their breaths.

item.title: Maryam:85
item.description:
Maryam:85 - يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ وَفْدًا yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafdan (The) Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Gracious (as) a delegation
  • [1] Or 'as incoming guests.

item.title: Maryam:86
item.description:
Maryam:86 - وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dan
And We will drive the criminals to Hell thirsty

item.title: Maryam:87
item.description:
Maryam:87 - لَا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ عَهْدًا
lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan
Not they will have the power (of) the intercession except (he) who has taken from the Most Gracious a covenant

item.title: Maryam:88
item.description:
Maryam:88 - وَقَالُوْۤا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا
waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan
And they say Has taken the Most Gracious a son

item.title: Maryam:89
item.description:
Maryam:89 - لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا
laqad ji'tum shayan iddan
Verily you have put forth a thing atrocious

item.title: Maryam:90
item.description:
Maryam:90 - تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddan
Almost the heavens get torn therefrom and splits asunder the earth and collapse the mountain (in) devastation

item.title: Maryam:91
item.description:
Maryam:91 - أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدًا
an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladan
That they invoke to the Most Gracious a son

item.title: Maryam:92
item.description:
Maryam:92 - وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَنِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha waladan
And not is appropriate for the Most Gracious that He should take a son

item.title: Maryam:93
item.description:
Maryam:93 - إِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا ءَاتِي الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدًا
in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabdan
Not all who (are) in the heavens and the earth but (will) come (to) the Most Gracious (as) a slave

item.title: Maryam:94
item.description:
Maryam:94 - لَقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan
Verily He has enumerated them and counted them a counting

item.title: Maryam:95
item.description:
Maryam:95 - وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا
wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardan
And all of them (will) come (to) Him (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection alone

item.title: Maryam:96
item.description:
Maryam:96 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ وُدًّا
inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wuddan
Indeed those who believed and did good deeds will bestow for them the Most Gracious affection

item.title: Maryam:97
item.description:
Maryam:97 - فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُدًّا
fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman luddan
So, only We (have) made it easy in your tongue that you may give glad tidings with it (to) the righteous and warn with it a people hostile

item.title: Maryam:98
item.description:
Maryam:98 - وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا
wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zan
And how many We (have) destroyed before them of a generation Can you perceive of them any one or hear from them a sound

item.title: 20. طه (Taa-Haa)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the discrete Arabic letters Ṭā Hā. Like "Yā Sīn" (surah 36), "Ṭā Hā" is said to be one of the names of the Prophet Muḥammad. The surah both begins and ends with mention of the Quran: it was not sent to the Prophet to cause him grief but is a clear proof from his Lord. The example of Moses is given as a lengthy account in order to encourage the Prophet and show the end of the disbelievers. The destruction of earlier generations is cited as a lesson from which the disbelievers should learn. The Prophet is ordered to be patient and to persevere with his worship.
The surah is also known as Ta-Ha, Taa Haa

20:1
طه
tta-ha
Ta Ha

20:2
مَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَى
mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashqā
Not We (have) sent down to you the Quran that you be distressed

20:3
إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشٰی
illā tadhkiratan liman yakhshā
(But) (as) a reminder for (those) who fear

item.title: Taa-Haa:1
item.description:
Taa-Haa:1 - طه tta-ha Ta Ha
  • [1] Like Yā Sīn, Ṭā Hā is said to be one of the names of the Prophet (ṣ). Ma'ānī al-akhbār, p. 22.

item.title: Taa-Haa:2
item.description:
Taa-Haa:2 - مَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَى
mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashqā
Not We (have) sent down to you the Quran that you be distressed

item.title: Taa-Haa:3
item.description:
Taa-Haa:3 - إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشٰی
illā tadhkiratan liman yakhshā
(But) (as) a reminder for (those) who fear

item.title: Taa-Haa:4
item.description:
Taa-Haa:4 - تَنْزِيلًا مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى
tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿulā
A revelation from (He) Who created the earth and the heavens [the] high

item.title: Taa-Haa:5
item.description:
Taa-Haa:5 - اَلرَّحْمَنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَى
al-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'tawā
The Most Gracious over the Throne is established

item.title: Taa-Haa:6
item.description:
Taa-Haa:6 - لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الثَّرٰی
lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta l-tharā
To Him (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth and whatever (is) between them and whatever (is) under the soil

item.title: Taa-Haa:7
item.description:
Taa-Haa:7 - وَإِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu l-sira wa-akhfā
And if you speak aloud the word then indeed, He knows the secret and the more hidden

item.title: Taa-Haa:8
item.description:
Taa-Haa:8 - اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى
al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā
Allah (there is) no god except Him To Him (belong) the Names the Most Beautiful

item.title: Taa-Haa:9
item.description:
Taa-Haa:9 - وَهَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ مُوسٰی
wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūsā
And has come to you the narration (of) Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:10
item.description:
Taa-Haa:10 - إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوْۤا اِنِّیْ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَعَلِّي ءَاتِيكُمْ مِنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى
idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā l-nāri hudan
When he saw a fire then he said to his family Stay here indeed, I [I] perceived a fire perhaps I (can) bring you therefrom a burning brand or I find at the fire guidance

item.title: Taa-Haa:11
item.description:
Taa-Haa:11 - فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ يَامُوسٰی
falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūsā
Then when he came to it he was called O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:12
item.description:
Taa-Haa:12 - اِنِّیْ أَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwan
Indeed, [I] I Am your Lord so remove your shoes Indeed, you (are) in the valley the sacred (of) Tuwa

item.title: Taa-Haa:13
item.description:
Taa-Haa:13 - وَأَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَى
wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥā
And I (have) chosen you so listen to what is revealed

item.title: Taa-Haa:14
item.description:
Taa-Haa:14 - إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلاةَ لِذِكْرِي
innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi l-ṣalata lidhik'rī
Indeed, [I] I Am Allah (There is) no god but I so worship Me and establish the prayer for My remembrance

item.title: Taa-Haa:15
item.description:
Taa-Haa:15 - إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا تَسْعَى
inna l-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿā
Indeed the Hour (will be) coming I almost [I] hide it that may be recompensed every soul for what it strives

item.title: Taa-Haa:16
item.description:
Taa-Haa:16 - فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَنْ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ فَتَرْدَى
falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatardā
So (do) not (let) avert you from it (one) who (does) not believe in it and follows his desires lest you perish

item.title: Taa-Haa:17
item.description:
Taa-Haa:17 - وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَامُوسٰی
wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūsā
And what (is) that in your right hand O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:18
item.description:
Taa-Haa:18 - قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَى غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَءَارِبُ أُخْرٰی
qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'rā
He said It (is) my staff I lean upon it and I bring down leaves with it for my sheep and for me in it (are) uses other

item.title: Taa-Haa:19
item.description:
Taa-Haa:19 - قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَامُوسٰی
qāla alqihā yāmūsā
He said Throw it down O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:20
item.description:
Taa-Haa:20 - فَأَلْقَاهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَى
fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿā
So he threw it down and behold It (was) a snake moving swiftly

item.title: Taa-Haa:21
item.description:
Taa-Haa:21 - قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا الْأُولَى
qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūlā
He said Seize it and (do) not fear We will return it (to) its state the former

item.title: Taa-Haa:22
item.description:
Taa-Haa:22 - وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَى جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ اٰیَةً أُخْرٰی
wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'rā
And draw near your hand to your side it will come out white without any without any disease (as) a sign another

item.title: Taa-Haa:23
item.description:
Taa-Haa:23 - لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَاتِنَا الْكُبْرٰی
linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'rā
That We may show you of Our Signs the Greatest

item.title: Taa-Haa:24
item.description:
Taa-Haa:24 - اِذْهَبْ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَى
idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā
Go to Firaun Indeed, he (has) transgressed

item.title: Taa-Haa:25
item.description:
Taa-Haa:25 - قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي
qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadrī
He said My Lord Expand for me my breast

item.title: Taa-Haa:26
item.description:
Taa-Haa:26 - وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
wayassir lī amrī
And ease for me my task

item.title: Taa-Haa:27
item.description:
Taa-Haa:27 - وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datan min lisānī And untie (the) knot from my tongue
  • [1] That is, 'Grant me clarity of speech.'

item.title: Taa-Haa:28
item.description:
Taa-Haa:28 - يَفْقَهُوْۤا قَوْلِي
yafqahū qawlī
That they may understand my speech

item.title: Taa-Haa:29
item.description:
Taa-Haa:29 - وَاجْعَلْ لِي وَزِيرًا مِنْ أَهْلِي
wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīran min ahlī
And appoint for me a minister from my family

item.title: Taa-Haa:30
item.description:
Taa-Haa:30 - هَارُونَ أَخِي
hārūna akhī
Harun my brother

item.title: Taa-Haa:31
item.description:
Taa-Haa:31 - اُشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي ush'dud bihi azrī Reinforce through him my strength
  • [1] That is, 'reinforce my strength through him.'

item.title: Taa-Haa:32
item.description:
Taa-Haa:32 - وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي
wa-ashrik'hu fī amrī
And make him share in my task

item.title: Taa-Haa:33
item.description:
Taa-Haa:33 - كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
kay nusabbiḥaka kathīran
That we may glorify You much

item.title: Taa-Haa:34
item.description:
Taa-Haa:34 - وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
wanadhkuraka kathīran
And [we] remember You much

item.title: Taa-Haa:35
item.description:
Taa-Haa:35 - إِنَّكَ كُنْتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
innaka kunta binā baṣīran
Indeed, [You] You are of us All-Seer

item.title: Taa-Haa:36
item.description:
Taa-Haa:36 - قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَامُوسٰی
qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūsā
He said Verily you are granted your request O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:37
item.description:
Taa-Haa:37 - وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرٰی
walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'rā
And indeed We conferred a favor on you another time another time

item.title: Taa-Haa:38
item.description:
Taa-Haa:38 - إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَى
idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥā
When We inspired to your mother what is inspired

item.title: Taa-Haa:39
item.description:
Taa-Haa:39 - أَنِ اقْذِفِيهِ فِي التَّابُوتِ فَاقْذِفِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ الْيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِي وَعَدُوٌّ لَهُ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِنِّي وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَى عَيْنِي ani iq'dhifīhi fī l-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwun lī waʿaduwwun lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatan minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿaynī That cast him in the chest then cast it in the river then let cast it the river on the bank will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him And I cast over you love from Me and that you may be brought up under My eye
  • [1] That is, 'I made you endearing' (to people, or to Allah).

item.title: Taa-Haa:40
item.description:
Taa-Haa:40 - إِذْ تَمْشِي أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى مَنْ يَكْفُلُهُ فَرَجَعْنَاكَ إِلَى أُمِّكَ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَاكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُونًا فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِي أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَى قَدَرٍ يَامُوسٰی
idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadarin yāmūsā
When was going your sister and she said Shall I show you to (one) who will nurse and rear him So We returned you to your mother that may be cooled her eyes and not she grieves And you killed a man but We saved you from the distress and We tried you (with) a trial Then you remained (some) years with (the) people (of) Madyan Then you came at the decreed (time) O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:41
item.description:
Taa-Haa:41 - وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafsī
And I (have) chosen you for Myself

item.title: Taa-Haa:42
item.description:
Taa-Haa:42 - اِذْهَبْ أَنْتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِءَايَاتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكْرِي
idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'rī
Go you and your brother with My Signs and (do) not slacken in My remembrance

item.title: Taa-Haa:43
item.description:
Taa-Haa:43 - اِذْهَبَا إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَى
idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā
Go, both of you to Firaun Indeed, he (has) transgressed

item.title: Taa-Haa:44
item.description:
Taa-Haa:44 - فَقُولَا لَهُ قَوْلًا لَيِّنًا لَعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشٰی
faqūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhshā
And speak to him a word gentle perhaps he may take heed or fear

item.title: Taa-Haa:45
item.description:
Taa-Haa:45 - قَالَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَنْ يَطْغَى
qālā rabbanā innanā nakhāfu an yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw an yaṭghā
They said Our Lord Indeed, we fear that he will hasten against us or that he will transgress

item.title: Taa-Haa:46
item.description:
Taa-Haa:46 - قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرٰی
qāla lā takhāfā innanī maʿakumā asmaʿu wa-arā
He said (Do) not fear Indeed, I Am with you both I hear and I see

item.title: Taa-Haa:47
item.description:
Taa-Haa:47 - فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ قَدْ جِئْنَاكَ بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَى
fatiyāhu faqūlā innā rasūlā rabbika fa-arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla walā tuʿadhib'hum qad ji'nāka biāyatin min rabbika wal-salāmu ʿalā mani ittabaʿa l-hudā
So go to him and say Indeed, we both (are) Messengers (of) your Lord so send with us (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel and (do) not torment them Verily we came to you with a Sign from your Lord And peace on (one) who follows the Guidance

item.title: Taa-Haa:48
item.description:
Taa-Haa:48 - إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْنَا أَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلَى مَنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى
innā qad ūḥiya ilaynā anna l-ʿadhāba ʿalā man kadhaba watawallā
Indeed, we verily it has been revealed to us that the punishment (will be) on (one) who denies and turns away

item.title: Taa-Haa:49
item.description:
Taa-Haa:49 - قَالَ فَمَنْ رَبُّكُمَا يَامُوسٰی
qāla faman rabbukumā yāmūsā
He said Then who (is) your Lord O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:50
item.description:
Taa-Haa:50 - قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَى
qāla rabbunā alladhī aʿṭā kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hadā
He said Our Lord (is) the One Who gave (to) every thing its form then He guided (it)

item.title: Taa-Haa:51
item.description:
Taa-Haa:51 - قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ الْأُولَى
qāla famā bālu l-qurūni l-ūlā
He said Then what (is the) case (of) the generations (of) the former

item.title: Taa-Haa:52
item.description:
Taa-Haa:52 - قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنْسٰی
qāla ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī fī kitābin lā yaḍillu rabbī walā yansā
He said Its knowledge (is) with my Lord in a Record Not errs my Lord and not forgets

item.title: Taa-Haa:53
item.description:
Taa-Haa:53 - اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْ نَبَاتٍ شَتَّى
alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wasalaka lakum fīhā subulan wa-anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi azwājan min nabātin shattā
The One Who made for you the earth (as) a bed and inserted for you therein ways and sent down from the sky water then We (have) brought forth with it pairs of plants diverse

item.title: Taa-Haa:54
item.description:
Taa-Haa:54 - كُلُوْۤا وَارْعَوْا أَنْعَامَكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِأُولِي النُّهَى
kulū wa-ir'ʿaw anʿāmakum inna fī dhālika laāyātin li-ulī l-nuhā
Eat and pasture your cattle Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for possessors (of) intelligence

item.title: Taa-Haa:55
item.description:
Taa-Haa:55 - مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرٰی
min'hā khalaqnākum wafīhā nuʿīdukum wamin'hā nukh'rijukum tāratan ukh'rā
From it We created you and in it We will return you and from it We will bring you out time another

item.title: Taa-Haa:56
item.description:
Taa-Haa:56 - وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَاهُ ءَايَاتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبٰی
walaqad araynāhu āyātinā kullahā fakadhaba wa-abā
And verily We showed him Our Signs all of them but he denied and refused

item.title: Taa-Haa:57
item.description:
Taa-Haa:57 - قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَامُوسٰی
qāla aji'tanā litukh'rijanā min arḍinā bisiḥ'rika yāmūsā
He said Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:58
item.description:
Taa-Haa:58 - فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِثْلِهِ فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَا نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلَا أَنْتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى falanatiyannaka bisiḥ'rin mith'lihi fa-ij'ʿal baynanā wabaynaka mawʿidan lā nukh'lifuhu naḥnu walā anta makānan suwan Then we will surely produce for you magic like it So make between us and between you an appointment not we will fail it we and not you (in) a place even
  • [1] Or 'at a neutral location,' or 'on a level ground.'

item.title: Taa-Haa:59
item.description:
Taa-Haa:59 - قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ وَأَنْ يُحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى
qāla mawʿidukum yawmu l-zīnati wa-an yuḥ'shara l-nāsu ḍuḥan
He said Your appointment (is on the) day (of) the festival and that will be assembled the people (at) forenoon

item.title: Taa-Haa:60
item.description:
Taa-Haa:60 - فَتَوَلَّى فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُ ثُمَّ أَتٰی
fatawallā fir'ʿawnu fajamaʿa kaydahu thumma atā
Then went away Firaun and put together his plan then came

item.title: Taa-Haa:61
item.description:
Taa-Haa:61 - قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ بِعَذَابٍ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرٰی
qāla lahum mūsā waylakum lā taftarū ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fayus'ḥitakum biʿadhābin waqad khāba mani if'tarā
Said to them Musa Woe to you (Do) not invent against Allah a lie lest He will destroy you with a punishment And verily he failed who invented

item.title: Taa-Haa:62
item.description:
Taa-Haa:62 - فَتَنَازَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى
fatanāzaʿū amrahum baynahum wa-asarrū l-najwā
Then they disputed (in) their affair among them and they kept secret the private conversation

item.title: Taa-Haa:63
item.description:
Taa-Haa:63 - قَالُوْا إِنْ هَذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ يُرِيدَانِ أَنْ يُخْرِجَاكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَى qālū in hādhāni lasāḥirāni yurīdāni an yukh'rijākum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihimā wayadhhabā biṭarīqatikumu l-muth'lā They said Indeed these two [two] magicians they intend that they drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your way the exemplary
  • [1] Cf. (Q 40:26).

item.title: Taa-Haa:64
item.description:
Taa-Haa:64 - فَأَجْمِعُوا كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ائْتُوْۤا صَفًّا وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْيَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلَى
fa-ajmiʿū kaydakum thumma i'tū ṣaffan waqad aflaḥa l-yawma mani is'taʿlā
So put together your plan then come (in) a line And verily (will be) successful today who overcomes

item.title: Taa-Haa:65
item.description:
Taa-Haa:65 - قَالُوْا يَامُوسٰی إِمَّا أَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ نَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَى
qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an nakūna awwala man alqā
They said O Musa Either that you throw or that we will be the first who throws

item.title: Taa-Haa:66
item.description:
Taa-Haa:66 - قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوْۤا فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَى
qāla bal alqū fa-idhā ḥibāluhum waʿiṣiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min siḥ'rihim annahā tasʿā
He said Nay you throw Then behold Their ropes and their staffs seemed to him by their magic that they (were) moving

item.title: Taa-Haa:67
item.description:
Taa-Haa:67 - فَأَوْجَسَ فِي نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةً مُوسٰی
fa-awjasa fī nafsihi khīfatan mūsā
So sensed in himself a fear Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:68
item.description:
Taa-Haa:68 - قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْاَعْلٰی
qul'nā lā takhaf innaka anta l-aʿlā
We said (Do) not fear Indeed, you you (will be) superior

item.title: Taa-Haa:69
item.description:
Taa-Haa:69 - وَأَلْقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوْۤا إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوْۤا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتٰی
wa-alqi mā fī yamīnika talqaf mā ṣanaʿū innamā ṣanaʿū kaydu sāḥirin walā yuf'liḥu l-sāḥiru ḥaythu atā
And throw what (is) in your right hand it will swallow up what they have made Only they (have) made a trick (of) a magician and not will be successful the magician wherever he comes

item.title: Taa-Haa:70
item.description:
Taa-Haa:70 - فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَارُونَ وَمُوسٰی
fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sujjadan qālū āmannā birabbi hārūna wamūsā
So were thrown down the magicians prostrating They said We believe in (the) Lord (of) Harun and Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:71
item.description:
Taa-Haa:71 - قَالَ ءَامَنْتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِي جُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَا أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَى
qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra fala-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum fī judhūʿi l-nakhli walataʿlamunna ayyunā ashaddu ʿadhāban wa-abqā
He said You believe [to] him before that I gave permission to you Indeed, he (is) your chief the one who taught you the magic So surely I will cut off your hands and your feet of opposite sides and surely I will crucify you on (the) trunks (of) date-palms and surely you will know which of us (is) more severe (in) punishment and more lasting

item.title: Taa-Haa:72
item.description:
Taa-Haa:72 - قَالُوْا لَنْ نُؤْثِرَكَ عَلَى مَا جَاءَنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالَّذِي فَطَرَنَا فَاقْضِ مَا أَنْتَ قَاضٍ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِي هَذِهِ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
qālū lan nu'thiraka ʿalā mā jāanā mina l-bayināti wa-alladhī faṭaranā fa-iq'ḍi mā anta qāḍin innamā taqḍī hādhihi l-ḥayata l-dun'yā
They said Never we will prefer you over what has come to us of the clear proofs and the One Who created us So decree whatever you (are) decreeing Only you can decree (for) this life (of) the world

item.title: Taa-Haa:73
item.description:
Taa-Haa:73 - إِنَّا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَايَانَا وَمَا أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى
innā āmannā birabbinā liyaghfira lanā khaṭāyānā wamā akrahtanā ʿalayhi mina l-siḥ'ri wal-lahu khayrun wa-abqā
Indeed, [we] we believe in our Lord that He may forgive for us our sins and what you compelled us on it of the magic And Allah (is) Best and Ever Lasting

item.title: Taa-Haa:74
item.description:
Taa-Haa:74 - إِنَّهُ مَنْ يَأْتِ رَبَّهُ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَى
innahu man yati rabbahu muj'riman fa-inna lahu jahannama lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥyā
Indeed, he who comes (to) his Lord (as) a criminal then indeed for him (is) Hell Not he will die in it and not live

item.title: Taa-Haa:75
item.description:
Taa-Haa:75 - وَمَنْ يَأْتِهِ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصَّالِحَاتِ فَأُولَئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجَاتُ الْعُلَى
waman yatihi mu'minan qad ʿamila l-ṣāliḥāti fa-ulāika lahumu l-darajātu l-ʿulā
But whoever comes to Him (as) a believer verily he has done the righteous deeds then those for them (will be) the ranks [the] high

item.title: Taa-Haa:76
item.description:
Taa-Haa:76 - جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ مَنْ تَزَكَّى
jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wadhālika jazāu man tazakkā
Gardens (of) Eden flows from underneath them the rivers abiding forever in it And that (is) the reward (for him) who purifies himself

item.title: Taa-Haa:77
item.description:
Taa-Haa:77 - وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِي الْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَا تَخَافُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشٰی
walaqad awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī fa-iḍ'rib lahum ṭarīqan fī l-baḥri yabasan lā takhāfu darakan walā takhshā
And verily We inspired to Musa that Travel by night with My slaves and strike for them a path in the sea dry not fearing to be overtaken and not being afraid

item.title: Taa-Haa:78
item.description:
Taa-Haa:78 - فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُمْ مِنَ الْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu bijunūdihi faghashiyahum mina l-yami mā ghashiyahum
Then followed them Firaun with his forces but covered them from the sea what covered them

item.title: Taa-Haa:79
item.description:
Taa-Haa:79 - وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُ وَمَا هَدَى
wa-aḍalla fir'ʿawnu qawmahu wamā hadā
And led astray Firaun his people and (did) not guide them

item.title: Taa-Haa:80
item.description:
Taa-Haa:80 - يَابَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ قَدْ أَنْجَيْنَاكُمْ مِنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَاعَدْنَاكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَى
yābanī is'rāīla qad anjaynākum min ʿaduwwikum wawāʿadnākum jāniba l-ṭūri l-aymana wanazzalnā ʿalaykumu l-mana wal-salwā
O Children of Israel O Children of Israel Verily We delivered you from your enemy and We made a covenant with you on (the) side (of) the Mount the right and We sent down to you the Manna and the quails

item.title: Taa-Haa:81
item.description:
Taa-Haa:81 - كُلُوْۤا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا فِیْهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِي وَمَنْ يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدْ هَوَى kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum walā taṭghaw fīhi fayaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabī waman yaḥlil ʿalayhi ghaḍabī faqad hawā Eat of (the) good things which We have provided you and (do) not transgress therein lest should descend upon you My Anger And whoever on whom descends on whom descends My Anger indeed he (has) perished
  • [1] Or 'falls' (that is, into hell).

item.title: Taa-Haa:82
item.description:
Taa-Haa:82 - وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِمَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدَى
wa-innī laghaffārun liman tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan thumma ih'tadā
But indeed, I Am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteous (deeds) then remains guided

item.title: Taa-Haa:83
item.description:
Taa-Haa:83 - وَمَا أَعْجَلَكَ عَنْ قَوْمِكَ يَامُوسٰی
wamā aʿjalaka ʿan qawmika yāmūsā
And what made you hasten from your people O Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:84
item.description:
Taa-Haa:84 - قَالَ هُمْ أُولَاءِ عَلَى أَثَرِي وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَى
qāla hum ulāi ʿalā atharī waʿajil'tu ilayka rabbi litarḍā
He said They (are) close upon my tracks and I hastened to you my Lord that You be pleased

item.title: Taa-Haa:85
item.description:
Taa-Haa:85 - قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ qāla fa-innā qad fatannā qawmaka min baʿdika wa-aḍallahumu l-sāmiriyu He said But indeed, We verily We (have) tried your people after you after you and has led them astray the Samiri
  • [1] Apparently one of the Israelites accompanying Moses ('a).

item.title: Taa-Haa:86
item.description:
Taa-Haa:86 - فَرَجَعَ مُوسٰی إِلَى قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدْتُمْ أَنْ يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُمْ مَوْعِدِي
farajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla yāqawmi alam yaʿid'kum rabbukum waʿdan ḥasanan afaṭāla ʿalaykumu l-ʿahdu am aradttum an yaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabun min rabbikum fa-akhlaftum mawʿidī
Then Musa returned Then Musa returned to his people angry (and) sorrowful He said O my people Did not promise you your Lord a promise good Then, did seem long to you the promise or did you desire that descend upon you (the) Anger of your Lord so you broke (the) promise to me

item.title: Taa-Haa:87
item.description:
Taa-Haa:87 - قَالُوْا مَا أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَا أَوْزَارًا مِنْ زِينَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَاهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ أَلْقَى السَّامِرِيُّ
qālū mā akhlafnā mawʿidaka bimalkinā walākinnā ḥummil'nā awzāran min zīnati l-qawmi faqadhafnāhā fakadhālika alqā l-sāmiriyu
They said Not we broke promise to you by our will but we [we] were made to carry burdens from ornaments (of) the people so we threw them and thus threw the Samiri

item.title: Taa-Haa:88
item.description:
Taa-Haa:88 - فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوْۤا هَذَا إِلَهُكُمْ وَإِلَهُ مُوسٰی فَنَسِيَ fa-akhraja lahum ʿij'lan jasadan lahu khuwārun faqālū hādhā ilāhukum wa-ilāhu mūsā fanasiya Then he brought forth for them a calf's body it had a lowing sound and they said This (is) your god and the god (of) Musa but he forgot
  • [1] The pronoun may be taken to refer either to the Sāmirī, concerning whom Allah says that he forgot Moses' teaching about the worship of the true God, or to Moses, who is said by the Sāmirī to have forgotten and left behind his god—the Golden Calf—and gone out in search of him.

item.title: Taa-Haa:89
item.description:
Taa-Haa:89 - أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
afalā yarawna allā yarjiʿu ilayhim qawlan walā yamliku lahum ḍarran walā nafʿan
Then, did not they see that not it (could) return to them a word and not possess for them any harm and not any benefit

item.title: Taa-Haa:90
item.description:
Taa-Haa:90 - وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَارُونُ مِنْ قَبْلُ يَاقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ فَاتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوا أَمْرِي
walaqad qāla lahum hārūnu min qablu yāqawmi innamā futintum bihi wa-inna rabbakumu l-raḥmānu fa-ittabiʿūnī wa-aṭīʿū amrī
And verily (had) said to them Harun before before O my people Only you are being tested by it and indeed your Lord (is) the Most Gracious so follow me and obey my order

item.title: Taa-Haa:91
item.description:
Taa-Haa:91 - قَالُوْا لَنْ نَبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِينَ حَتّٰی يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسٰی
qālū lan nabraḥa ʿalayhi ʿākifīna ḥattā yarjiʿa ilaynā mūsā
They said Never we will cease being devoted to it being devoted to it until returns to us Musa

item.title: Taa-Haa:92
item.description:
Taa-Haa:92 - قَالَ يَاهَارُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوْۤا
qāla yāhārūnu mā manaʿaka idh ra-aytahum ḍallū
He said O Harun What prevented you when you saw them going astray

item.title: Taa-Haa:93
item.description:
Taa-Haa:93 - أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِي
allā tattabiʿani afaʿaṣayta amrī
That not you follow me Then, have you disobeyed my order

item.title: Taa-Haa:94
item.description:
Taa-Haa:94 - قَالَ يَاابْنَأُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأْسِي اِنِّیْ خَشِيتُ أَنْ تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِي
qāla yabna-umma lā takhudh biliḥ'yatī walā birasī innī khashītu an taqūla farraqta bayna banī is'rāīla walam tarqub qawlī
He said O son of my mother (Do) not seize (me) by my beard and not by my head Indeed, I [I] feared that you would say You caused division between (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel and not you respect my word

item.title: Taa-Haa:95
item.description:
Taa-Haa:95 - قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَاسَامِرِيُّ
qāla famā khaṭbuka yāsāmiriyyu
He said Then what (is) your case O Samiri

item.title: Taa-Haa:96
item.description:
Taa-Haa:96 - قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوْۤا بِهِ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِنْ أَثَرِ الرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِي نَفْسِي
qāla baṣur'tu bimā lam yabṣurū bihi faqabaḍtu qabḍatan min athari l-rasūli fanabadhtuhā wakadhālika sawwalat lī nafsī
He said I perceived what not they perceive in it so I took a handful from (the) track (of) the Messenger then threw it and thus suggested to me my soul

item.title: Taa-Haa:97
item.description:
Taa-Haa:97 - قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي الْحَيَوةِ أَنْ تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَنْ تُخْلَفَهُ وَانْظُرْ إِلَى إِلَهِكَ الَّذِي ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَنَنْسِفَنَّهُ فِي الْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
qāla fa-idh'hab fa-inna laka fī l-ḥayati an taqūla lā misāsa wa-inna laka mawʿidan lan tukh'lafahu wa-unẓur ilā ilāhika alladhī ẓalta ʿalayhi ʿākifan lanuḥarriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fī l-yami nasfan
He said Then go And indeed for you in the life that you will say (Do) not touch And indeed for you (is) an appointment never you will fail to (keep) it And look at your god that which you have remained to it devoted Surely we will burn it then certainly we will scatter it in the sea (in) particles

item.title: Taa-Haa:98
item.description:
Taa-Haa:98 - إِنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
innamā ilāhukumu l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa wasiʿa kulla shayin ʿil'man
Only your God (is) Allah the One (there is) no god but He He has encompassed all things (in) knowledge

item.title: Taa-Haa:99
item.description:
Taa-Haa:99 - كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنْبَاءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَاكَ مِنْ لَدُنَّا ذِكْرًا
kadhālika naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi mā qad sabaqa waqad ātaynāka min ladunnā dhik'ran
Thus We relate to you from (the) news (of) what has preceded has preceded And certainly We have given you from Us a Reminder

item.title: Taa-Haa:100
item.description:
Taa-Haa:100 - مَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وِزْرًا
man aʿraḍa ʿanhu fa-innahu yaḥmilu yawma l-qiyāmati wiz'ran
Whoever turns away from it then indeed, he will bear (on the) Day (of) Resurrection a burden

item.title: Taa-Haa:101
item.description:
Taa-Haa:101 - خَالِدِينَ فِیْهِ وَسَاءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حِمْلًا
khālidīna fīhi wasāa lahum yawma l-qiyāmati ḥim'lan
Abiding forever in it and evil for them (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection (as) a load

item.title: Taa-Haa:102
item.description:
Taa-Haa:102 - يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri wanaḥshuru l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin zur'qan (The) Day will be blown in the Trumpet and We will gather the criminals that Day blue-eyed
  • [1] Literally, 'with blued eyes.' Cf. (Q 17:72), (Q 17:97); (Q 20:124) - (Q 20:125).

item.title: Taa-Haa:103
item.description:
Taa-Haa:103 - يَتَخَافَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
yatakhāfatūna baynahum in labith'tum illā ʿashran
They are murmuring among themselves Not you remained except (for) ten

item.title: Taa-Haa:104
item.description:
Taa-Haa:104 - نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna idh yaqūlu amthaluhum ṭarīqatan in labith'tum illā yawman
We know best what they will say when will say (the) best of them (in) conduct Not you remained except (for) a day

item.title: Taa-Haa:105
item.description:
Taa-Haa:105 - وَيَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنْسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسْفًا
wayasalūnaka ʿani l-jibāli faqul yansifuhā rabbī nasfan
And they ask you about the mountains so say Will blast them my Lord (into) particles

item.title: Taa-Haa:106
item.description:
Taa-Haa:106 - فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا fayadharuhā qāʿan ṣafṣafan Then He will leave it a level plain
  • [1] That is, the earth.

item.title: Taa-Haa:107
item.description:
Taa-Haa:107 - لَا تَرٰی فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا
lā tarā fīhā ʿiwajan walā amtan
Not you will see in it any crookedness and not any curve

item.title: Taa-Haa:108
item.description:
Taa-Haa:108 - يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُ وَخَشَعَتِ الْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا
yawma-idhin yattabiʿūna l-dāʿiya lā ʿiwaja lahu wakhashaʿati l-aṣwātu lilrraḥmāni falā tasmaʿu illā hamsan
On that Day they will follow the caller no deviation from it And (will be) humbled the voices for the Most Gracious so not you will hear except a faint sound

item.title: Taa-Haa:109
item.description:
Taa-Haa:109 - يَوْمَئِذٍ لَا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُ قَوْلًا
yawma-idhin lā tanfaʿu l-shafāʿatu illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waraḍiya lahu qawlan
(On) that Day not will benefit the intercession except (to) whom has given permission to him the Most Gracious and He has accepted for him a word

item.title: Taa-Haa:110
item.description:
Taa-Haa:110 - يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْمًا
yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bihi ʿil'man
He knows what (is) before them (is) before them and what (is) behind them while not they encompass it (in) knowledge

item.title: Taa-Haa:111
item.description:
Taa-Haa:111 - وَعَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
waʿanati l-wujūhu lil'ḥayyi l-qayūmi waqad khāba man ḥamala ẓul'man
And (will be) humbled the faces before the Ever-Living the Self-Subsisting And verily will have failed (he) who carried wrongdoing

item.title: Taa-Haa:112
item.description:
Taa-Haa:112 - وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
waman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā yakhāfu ẓul'man walā haḍman
But (he) who does of the righteous deeds while he (is) a believer then not he will fear injustice and not deprivation

item.title: Taa-Haa:113
item.description:
Taa-Haa:113 - وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِیْهِ مِنَ الْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
wakadhālika anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan waṣarrafnā fīhi mina l-waʿīdi laʿallahum yattaqūna aw yuḥ'dithu lahum dhik'ran
And thus We have sent it down (the) Quran (in) Arabic and We have explained in it of the warnings that they may fear or it may cause [for] them remembrance

item.title: Taa-Haa:114
item.description:
Taa-Haa:114 - فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُقْضَى إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُ وَقُلْ رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu walā taʿjal bil-qur'āni min qabli an yuq'ḍā ilayka waḥyuhu waqul rabbi zid'nī ʿil'man
So high (above all) (is) Allah the King the True And (do) not hasten with the Quran before before that is completed to you its revelation and say My Lord Increase me (in) knowledge

item.title: Taa-Haa:115
item.description:
Taa-Haa:115 - وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَا إِلَى اٰدَمَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًا
walaqad ʿahid'nā ilā ādama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu ʿazman
And verily We made a covenant with Adam before before but he forgot and not We found in him determination

item.title: Taa-Haa:116
item.description:
Taa-Haa:116 - وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبٰی
wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa abā
And when We said to the Angels Prostrate to Adam then they prostrated except Iblis he refused

item.title: Taa-Haa:117
item.description:
Taa-Haa:117 - فَقُلْنَا يَاءَادَمُ إِنَّ هَذَا عَدُوٌّ لَكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَى
faqul'nā yāādamu inna hādhā ʿaduwwun laka walizawjika falā yukh'rijannakumā mina l-janati fatashqā
Then We said O Adam Indeed this (is) an enemy to you and to your wife So not (let) him drive you both from Paradise so (that) you would suffer

item.title: Taa-Haa:118
item.description:
Taa-Haa:118 - إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرٰی
inna laka allā tajūʿa fīhā walā taʿrā
Indeed for you that not you will be hungry therein and not you will be unclothed

item.title: Taa-Haa:119
item.description:
Taa-Haa:119 - وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَى
wa-annaka lā taẓma-u fīhā walā taḍḥā
And that you not will suffer from thirst therein and not exposed to the sun's heat

item.title: Taa-Haa:120
item.description:
