Taa-Haa:120 - فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ قَالَ يَاءَادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَا يَبْلَى
fawaswasa ilayhi l-shayṭānu qāla yāādamu hal adulluka ʿalā shajarati l-khul'di wamul'kin lā yablā
Then whispered to him Shaitaan he said O Adam Shall I direct you to (the) tree (of) the Eternity and a kingdom not (that will) deteriorate

item.title: Taa-Haa:121
item.description:
Taa-Haa:121 - فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَاتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَعَصَى اٰدَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوَى
fa-akalā min'hā fabadat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā min waraqi l-janati waʿaṣā ādamu rabbahu faghawā
Then they both ate from it so became apparent to them their shame and they began (to) fasten on themselves from (the) leaves (of) Paradise And Adam disobeyed And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred

item.title: Taa-Haa:122
item.description:
Taa-Haa:122 - ثُمَّ اجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَى
thumma ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fatāba ʿalayhi wahadā
Then chose him his Lord and turned to him and guided (him)

item.title: Taa-Haa:123
item.description:
Taa-Haa:123 - قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِنِّي هُدًى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَى qāla ih'biṭā min'hā jamīʿan baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun fa-immā yatiyannakum minnī hudan famani ittabaʿa hudāya falā yaḍillu walā yashqā He said Go down from it all some of you to others (as) enemy Then if comes to you from Me guidance then whoever follows My guidance then not he will go astray and not suffer
  • [1] That is, Adam and Eve, or Adam and Iblīs.

item.title: Taa-Haa:124
item.description:
Taa-Haa:124 - وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةً ضَنْكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَعْمَى
waman aʿraḍa ʿan dhik'rī fa-inna lahu maʿīshatan ḍankan wanaḥshuruhu yawma l-qiyāmati aʿmā
And whoever turns away from My remembrance then indeed for him (is) a life straitened and We will gather him (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection blind

item.title: Taa-Haa:125
item.description:
Taa-Haa:125 - قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِي أَعْمَى وَقَدْ كُنْتُ بَصِيرًا
qāla rabbi lima ḥashartanī aʿmā waqad kuntu baṣīran
He will say My Lord Why You raised me blind while [verily] I had sight

item.title: Taa-Haa:126
item.description:
Taa-Haa:126 - قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ آيَاتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ تُنْسٰی
qāla kadhālika atatka āyātunā fanasītahā wakadhālika l-yawma tunsā
He will say Thus came to you Our Signs but you forgot them and thus today you will be forgotten

item.title: Taa-Haa:127
item.description:
Taa-Haa:127 - وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنْ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِ وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَى
wakadhālika najzī man asrafa walam yu'min biāyāti rabbihi walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati ashaddu wa-abqā
And thus We recompense (he) who transgresses and not believes in (the) Signs (of) his Lord And surely (the) punishment (of) the Hereafter (is) more severe and more lasting

item.title: Taa-Haa:128
item.description:
Taa-Haa:128 - أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِأُولِي النُّهَى
afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātin li-ulī l-nuhā
Then has not it guided [for] them how many We (have) destroyed before them of the generations (as) they walk in their dwellings Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for possessors (of) intelligence

item.title: Taa-Haa:129
item.description:
Taa-Haa:129 - وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى
walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakāna lizāman wa-ajalun musamman
And if not (for) a Word (that) preceded from your Lord surely (would) have been an obligation and a term determined

item.title: Taa-Haa:130
item.description:
Taa-Haa:130 - فَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا وَمِنْ آنَاءِ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَى
fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla ghurūbihā wamin ānāi al-layli fasabbiḥ wa-aṭrāfa l-nahāri laʿallaka tarḍā
So be patient over what they say and glorify with praise (of) your Lord before (the) rising (of) the sun and before its setting and from (the) hours (of) the night and glorify (at the) ends (of) the day so that you may be satisfied

item.title: Taa-Haa:131
item.description:
Taa-Haa:131 - وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى
walā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum zahrata l-ḥayati l-dun'yā linaftinahum fīhi wariz'qu rabbika khayrun wa-abqā
And (do) not extend your eyes towards what We have given for enjoyment with it pairs of them (the) splendor (of) the life (of) the world that We may test them in it And (the) provision (of) your Lord (is) better and more lasting

item.title: Taa-Haa:132
item.description:
Taa-Haa:132 - وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا لَا نَسْءَلُكُ رِزْقًا نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَى
wamur ahlaka bil-ṣalati wa-iṣ'ṭabir ʿalayhā lā nasaluka riz'qan naḥnu narzuquka wal-ʿāqibatu lilttaqwā
And enjoin (on) your family the prayer and be steadfast therein Not We ask you (for) provision We provide (for) you and the outcome (is) for the righteous[ness]

item.title: Taa-Haa:133
item.description:
Taa-Haa:133 - وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِاٰیَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِمْ بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَى
waqālū lawlā yatīnā biāyatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu mā fī l-ṣuḥufi l-ūlā
And they say Why not he brings us a sign from his Lord Has not come to them evidence (of) what (was) in the Scriptures the former

item.title: Taa-Haa:134
item.description:
Taa-Haa:134 - وَلَوْ أَنَّا أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ لَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا لَوْلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَاتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَذِلَّ وَنَخْزَى walaw annā ahlaknāhum biʿadhābin min qablihi laqālū rabbanā lawlā arsalta ilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhzā And if We (had) destroyed them with a punishment before him before him surely they (would) have said Our Lord why not You sent to us a Messenger so we (could) have followed Your signs before before that we were humiliated and disgraced
  • [1] That is, before the revelation of the Qur'ān.

item.title: Taa-Haa:135
item.description:
Taa-Haa:135 - قُلْ كُلٌّ مُتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَابُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهْتَدَى
qul kullun mutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣū fasataʿlamūna man aṣḥābu l-ṣirāṭi l-sawiyi wamani ih'tadā
Say Each (is) waiting so await Then you will know who (are the) companions (of) the way [the] even and who is guided

item.title: 21. الأنبياء (Al-Anbiyaa)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the names of sixteen of The Prophets and Mary, illustrating the unity of the divine message. Accounts of several prophets (anbiyā') appear in this surah from verse 48 ff., hence its name. The surah stresses that fact that Muḥammad is a man like earlier prophets, and has been given the same message to declare the unity of God. It warns the disbelievers of the approaching Judgement from which there is no escape.

21:1
اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُعْرِضُونَ
iq'taraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatin muʿ'riḍūna
(Has) approached for [the] mankind their account while they (are) in heedlessness turning away

21:2
مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
mā yatīhim min dhik'rin min rabbihim muḥ'dathin illā is'tamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūna
Not comes to them of a Reminder from their Lord anew except they listen to it while they (are at) play

21:3
لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا هَلْ هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ السِّحْرَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
lāhiyatan qulūbuhum wa-asarrū l-najwā alladhīna ẓalamū hal hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum afatatūna l-siḥ'ra wa-antum tub'ṣirūna
Distracted their hearts And they conceal the private conversation those who [they] wronged Is this except a human being like you So would you approach the magic while you see (it)

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:1
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:1 - اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُعْرِضُونَ
iq'taraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatin muʿ'riḍūna
(Has) approached for [the] mankind their account while they (are) in heedlessness turning away

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:2
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:2 - مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
mā yatīhim min dhik'rin min rabbihim muḥ'dathin illā is'tamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūna
Not comes to them of a Reminder from their Lord anew except they listen to it while they (are at) play

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:3
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:3 - لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا هَلْ هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ السِّحْرَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
lāhiyatan qulūbuhum wa-asarrū l-najwā alladhīna ẓalamū hal hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum afatatūna l-siḥ'ra wa-antum tub'ṣirūna
Distracted their hearts And they conceal the private conversation those who [they] wronged Is this except a human being like you So would you approach the magic while you see (it)

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:4
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:4 - قَالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
qāla rabbī yaʿlamu l-qawla fī l-samāi wal-arḍi wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu
He said My Lord knows the word in the heavens and the earth And He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:5
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:5 - بَلْ قَالُوْا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ بَلِ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِاٰیَةٍ كَمَا أُرْسِلَ الْأَوَّلُونَ
bal qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmin bali if'tarāhu bal huwa shāʿirun falyatinā biāyatin kamā ur'sila l-awalūna
Nay they say Muddled dreams nay he (has) invented it nay he (is) a poet So let him bring us a sign like what was sent (to) the former

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:6
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:6 - مَا اٰمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā afahum yu'minūna Not believed before them any town which We destroyed so will they believe
  • [1] That is, they did not believe even after miracles were shown to them.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:7
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:7 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْءَلُوْۤا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ wamā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūna And not We sent before you except men We revealed to them So ask (the) people (of) the Reminder if you (do) not know
  • [1] Cf. (Q 16:43).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:8
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:8 - وَمَا جَعَلْنَاهُمْ جَسَدًا لَا يَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا خَالِدِينَ
wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadan lā yakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wamā kānū khālidīna
And not We made them bodies not eating the food and not they were immortals

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:9
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:9 - ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَاهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُمْ وَمَنْ نَشَاءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِينَ
thumma ṣadaqnāhumu l-waʿda fa-anjaynāhum waman nashāu wa-ahlaknā l-mus'rifīna
Then We fulfilled (for) them the promise and We saved them and whom We willed and We destroyed the transgressors

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:10
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:10 - لَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَابًا فِیْهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
laqad anzalnā ilaykum kitāban fīhi dhik'rukum afalā taʿqilūna
Indeed We (have) sent down to you a Book in it (is) your mention Then will not you use reason

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:11
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:11 - وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنْشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
wakam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimatan wa-anshanā baʿdahā qawman ākharīna
And how many We (have) shattered of a town (that) was unjust and We produced after them another people another people

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:12
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:12 - فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوْۤا بَأْسَنَا إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
falammā aḥassū basanā idhā hum min'hā yarkuḍūna
Then when they perceived Our torment behold they from it were fleeing

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:13
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:13 - لَا تَرْكُضُوْۤا وَارْجِعُوا إِلَى مَا أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِیْهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْءَلُونَ
lā tarkuḍū wa-ir'jiʿū ilā mā ut'rif'tum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tus'alūna
Flee not Flee not but return to what you were given luxury in it and to your homes so that you may be questioned

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:14
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:14 - قَالُوْا يَاوَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīna
They said O woe to us Indeed, [we] we were wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:15
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:15 - فَمَا زَالَتْ تِلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتّٰی جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَامِدِينَ
famā zālat til'ka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīna
Then not ceased this their cry until We made them reaped extinct

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:16
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:16 - وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ
wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna
And not We created the heavens and the earth and what (is) between them (for) playing

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:17
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:17 - لَوْ أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَاتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِنْ لَدُنَّا إِنْ كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ
law aradnā an nattakhidha lahwan la-ittakhadhnāhu min ladunnā in kunnā fāʿilīna
If We intended that We take a pastime surely We (could have) taken it from Us if We were doers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:18
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:18 - بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ الْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
bal naqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿalā l-bāṭili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhā huwa zāhiqun walakumu l-waylu mimmā taṣifūna
Nay We hurl the truth against [the] falsehood and it breaks its head behold it (is) vanishing And for you (is) destruction for what you ascribe

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:19
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:19 - وَلَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِنْدَهُ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waman ʿindahu lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi walā yastaḥsirūna
And to Him (belongs) whoever (is) in the heavens and the earth And (those) who (are) near Him not they are arrogant to worship Him and not they tire

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:20
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:20 - يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
yusabbiḥūna al-layla wal-nahāra lā yafturūna
They glorify (Him) [the] night and [the] day not they slacken

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:21
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:21 - أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا آلِهَةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنْشِرُونَ
ami ittakhadhū ālihatan mina l-arḍi hum yunshirūna
Or (have) they taken gods from the earth they raise (the dead)

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:22
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:22 - لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ law kāna fīhimā ālihatun illā l-lahu lafasadatā fasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna If (there) were in both of them gods besides Allah surely they (would) have been ruined So glorified (is) Allah Lord (of) the Throne (above) what they attribute
  • [1] That is, in the heavens and the earth.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:23
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:23 - لَا يُسْءَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْءَلُونَ
lā yus'alu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yus'alūna
Not He (can) be questioned about what He does but they will be questioned

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:24
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:24 - أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُوْۤا بُرْهَانَكُمْ هَذَا ذِكْرُ مَنْ مَعِيَ وَذِكْرُ مَنْ قَبْلِي بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْحَقَّ فَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ
ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan qul hātū bur'hānakum hādhā dhik'ru man maʿiya wadhik'ru man qablī bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna l-ḥaqa fahum muʿ'riḍūna
Or (have) they taken besides Him besides Him gods Say Bring your proof This (is) a Reminder (for those) who (are) with me and a Reminder (for those) who (were) before me But most of them (do) not know the truth so they (are) averse

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:25
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:25 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِ
wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin illā nūḥī ilayhi annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'budūni
And not We sent before you before you any Messenger but We reveal(ed) to him that [He] (There is) no god except Me so worship Me

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:26
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:26 - وَقَالُوْۤا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُكْرَمُونَ
waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan sub'ḥānahu bal ʿibādun muk'ramūna
And they say Has taken the Most Gracious a son Glorified is He Nay (they are) slaves honored

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:27
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:27 - لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
lā yasbiqūnahu bil-qawli wahum bi-amrihi yaʿmalūna
Not they (can) precede Him in word and they by His command act

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:28
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:28 - يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَى وَهُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ
yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna illā limani ir'taḍā wahum min khashyatihi mush'fiqūna
He knows what (is) before them (is) before them and what (is) behind them and not they (can) intercede except for whom He approves And they from fear of Him stand in awe

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:29
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:29 - وَمَنْ يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّیْ إِلَهٌ مِنْ دُونِهِ فَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ
waman yaqul min'hum innī ilāhun min dūnihi fadhālika najzīhi jahannama kadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīna
And whoever says of them Indeed, I am a god besides Him besides Him Then that We will recompense (with) Hell Thus We recompense the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:30
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:30 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
awalam yara alladhīna kafarū anna l-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā wajaʿalnā mina l-māi kulla shayin ḥayyin afalā yu'minūna
Do not see those who disbelieved that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity then We parted them and We made from [the] water every living thing living thing Then will not they believe

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:31
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:31 - وَجَعَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَنْ تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
wajaʿalnā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulan laʿallahum yahtadūna
And We (have) placed in the earth firmly set mountains lest it (should) shake with them and We made therein broad passes (as) ways so that they may (be) guided

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:32
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:32 - وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَاءَ سَقْفًا مَحْفُوظًا وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَاتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
wajaʿalnā l-samāa saqfan maḥfūẓan wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿ'riḍūna
And We made the sky a roof protected But they from its Signs turn away

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:33
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:33 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
wahuwa alladhī khalaqa al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna
And He (is) the One Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon each in an orbit floating

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:34
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:34 - وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ أَفَإِينْ مِتَّ فَهُمُ الْخَالِدُونَ
wamā jaʿalnā libasharin min qablika l-khul'da afa-in mitta fahumu l-khālidūna
And not We made for any man before you before you [the] immortality so if you die then (would) they live forever

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:35
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:35 - كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَنَبْلُوكُمْ بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wanablūkum bil-shari wal-khayri fit'natan wa-ilaynā tur'jaʿūna
Every soul (will) taste [the] death And We test you with [the] bad and [the] good (as) a trial and to Us you will be returned

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:36
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:36 - وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَذَا الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَهُمْ بِذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
wa-idhā raāka alladhīna kafarū in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī yadhkuru ālihatakum wahum bidhik'ri l-raḥmāni hum kāfirūna
And when they see you those who disbelieve not they take you except (in) ridicule Is this the one who mentions your gods And they at (the) mention (of) the Most Gracious they (are) disbelievers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:37
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:37 - خُلِقَ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُورِيكُمْ ءَايَاتِي فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
khuliqa l-insānu min ʿajalin sa-urīkum āyātī falā tastaʿjilūni
Is created the man of haste I will show you My Signs so (do) not ask Me to hasten

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:38
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:38 - وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And they say When (will be fulfilled) this promise if you are truthful

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:39
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:39 - لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَنْ وُجُوهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ law yaʿlamu alladhīna kafarū ḥīna lā yakuffūna ʿan wujūhihimu l-nāra walā ʿan ẓuhūrihim walā hum yunṣarūna If knew those who disbelieved (the) time (when) not they will avert from their faces the Fire and not from their backs and not they will be helped
  • [1] That is, had the faithless known their state in hell, they would not ask for the punishment to be hastened.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:40
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:40 - بَلْ تَأْتِيهِمْ بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ
bal tatīhim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falā yastaṭīʿūna raddahā walā hum yunẓarūna
Nay it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them then not they will be able to repel it and not they will be given respite

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:41
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:41 - وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
walaqadi us'tuh'zi-a birusulin min qablika faḥāqa bi-alladhīna sakhirū min'hum mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And verily were mocked Messengers before you before you then surrounded those who mocked from them what they used at it (to) mock

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:42
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:42 - قُلْ مَنْ يَكْلَؤُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ بَلْ هُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ
qul man yakla-ukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri mina l-raḥmāni bal hum ʿan dhik'ri rabbihim muʿ'riḍūna
Say Who (can) protect you in the night and the day from the Most Gracious Yet they from (the) remembrance (of) their Lord turn away

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:43
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:43 - أَمْ لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِنْ دُونِنَا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ مِنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
am lahum ālihatun tamnaʿuhum min dūninā lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra anfusihim walā hum minnā yuṣ'ḥabūna
Or have they gods (to) defend them from Us Not they are able (to) help themselves and not they from Us can be protected

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:44
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:44 - بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَؤُلَاءِ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِي الْأَرْضَ نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا أَفَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ bal mattaʿnā hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimu l-ʿumuru afalā yarawna annā natī l-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā afahumu l-ghālibūna Nay We gave provision (to) these and their fathers until grew long for them the life Then do not they see that We We come (to) the land We reduce it from its borders So is (it) they (who will be) overcoming
  • [1] Cf. (Q 13:41).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:45
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:45 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُنْذِرُكُمْ بِالْوَحْيِ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا مَا يُنْذَرُونَ
qul innamā undhirukum bil-waḥyi walā yasmaʿu l-ṣumu l-duʿāa idhā mā yundharūna
Say Only I warn you by the revelation But not hear the deaf the call when when they are warned

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:46
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:46 - وَلَئِنْ مَسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَاوَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
wala-in massathum nafḥatun min ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīna
And if touches them a whiff of (the) punishment (of) your Lord surely they will say O woe to us Indeed, we [we] were wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:47
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:47 - وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِينَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَإِنْ كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَى بِنَا حَاسِبِينَ
wanaḍaʿu l-mawāzīna l-qis'ṭa liyawmi l-qiyāmati falā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan wa-in kāna mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin ataynā bihā wakafā binā ḥāsibīna
And We set the scales (of) the justice for (the) Day (of) the Resurrection so not will be wronged any soul (in) anything And if (there) be weight (of) a seed of a mustard We will bring [with] it And sufficient (are) We (as) Reckoners

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:48
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:48 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَاءً وَذِكْرًا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
walaqad ātaynā mūsā wahārūna l-fur'qāna waḍiyāan wadhik'ran lil'muttaqīna
And verily We gave Musa and Harun the Criterion and a light and a Reminder for the righteous

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:49
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:49 - اَلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُمْ مِنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum mina l-sāʿati mush'fiqūna
Those who fear their Lord in the unseen and they of the Hour (are) afraid

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:50
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:50 - وَهَذَا ذِكْرٌ مُبَارَكٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ أَفَأَنْتُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ
wahādhā dhik'run mubārakun anzalnāhu afa-antum lahu munkirūna
And this (is) a Reminder blessed which We (have) revealed Then are you of it rejecters

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:51
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:51 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ رُشْدَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
walaqad ātaynā ib'rāhīma rush'dahu min qablu wakunnā bihi ʿālimīna
And verily We gave Ibrahim his guidance before before and We were about him Well-Knowing

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:52
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:52 - إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنْتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā hādhihi l-tamāthīlu allatī antum lahā ʿākifūna
When he said to his father and his people What (are) these [the] statues which you to it (are) devoted

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:53
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:53 - قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ
qālū wajadnā ābāanā lahā ʿābidīna
They said We found our forefathers of them worshippers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:54
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:54 - قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
qāla laqad kuntum antum waābāukum fī ḍalālin mubīnin
He said Verily you are you and your forefathers (were) in an error manifest

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:55
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:55 - قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنْتَ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ qālū aji'tanā bil-ḥaqi am anta mina l-lāʿibīna They said Have you come to us with the truth or you (are) of those who play
  • [1] Or 'Are you speaking seriously.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:56
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:56 - قَالَ بَلْ رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَى ذَلِكُمْ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
qāla bal rabbukum rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alladhī faṭarahunna wa-anā ʿalā dhālikum mina l-shāhidīna
He said Nay your Lord (is the) Lord (of) the heavens and the earth the One Who created them and I am to that of the witnesses

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:57
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:57 - وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ أَنْ تُوَلُّوْۤا مُدْبِرِينَ
watal-lahi la-akīdanna aṣnāmakum baʿda an tuwallū mud'birīna
And by Allah surely, I will plan (against) your idols after that you go away turning (your) backs

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:58
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:58 - فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
fajaʿalahum judhādhan illā kabīran lahum laʿallahum ilayhi yarjiʿūna
So he made them (into) pieces except a large (one) of them so that they may to it return

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:59
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:59 - قَالُوْا مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
qālū man faʿala hādhā biālihatinā innahu lamina l-ẓālimīna
They said Who (has) done this to our gods Indeed, he (is) of the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:60
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:60 - قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ
qālū samiʿ'nā fatan yadhkuruhum yuqālu lahu ib'rāhīmu
They said We heard a youth mention them he is called he is called Ibrahim

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:61
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:61 - قَالُوْا فَأْتُوْۤا بِهِ عَلَى أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
qālū fatū bihi ʿalā aʿyuni l-nāsi laʿallahum yashhadūna
They said Then bring him before (the) eyes (of) the people so that they may bear witness

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:62
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:62 - قَالُوْا ءَأَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هَذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ
qālū a-anta faʿalta hādhā biālihatinā yāib'rāhīmu
They said Have you done this to our gods O Ibrahim

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:63
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:63 - قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَذَا فَسْءَلُوهُمْ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا يَنْطِقُونَ
qāla bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā fasalūhum in kānū yanṭiqūna
He said Nay (some doer) did it Their chief (is) this So ask them if they (can) speak

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:64
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:64 - فَرَجَعُوْۤا إِلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّكُمْ أَنْتُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
farajaʿū ilā anfusihim faqālū innakum antumu l-ẓālimūna
So they returned to themselves and said Indeed, you you (are) the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:65
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:65 - ثُمَّ نُكِسُوْۤا عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَؤُلَاءِ يَنْطِقُونَ
thumma nukisū ʿalā ruūsihim laqad ʿalim'ta mā hāulāi yanṭiqūna
Then they were turned on their heads Verily you know not these (can) speak

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:66
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:66 - قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
qāla afataʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayan walā yaḍurrukum
He said Then do you worship besides besides Allah what (does) not benefit you (in) anything and not harms you

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:67
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:67 - أُفٍّ لَكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
uffin lakum walimā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi afalā taʿqilūna
Uff to you and to what you worship besides besides Allah Then will not you use reason

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:68
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:68 - قَالُوْا حَرِّقُوهُ وَانْصُرُوا آلِهَتَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
qālū ḥarriqūhu wa-unṣurū ālihatakum in kuntum fāʿilīna
They said Burn him and support your gods if you are doers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:69
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:69 - قُلْنَا يَانَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَلَى اِبْرَاهِیْمَ
qul'nā yānāru kūnī bardan wasalāman ʿalā ib'rāhīma
We said O fire Be cool[ness] and safe[ty] for Ibrahim

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:70
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:70 - وَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَخْسَرِينَ
wa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-akhsarīna
And they intended for him a plan but We made them the greatest losers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:71
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:71 - وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَالَمِينَ wanajjaynāhu walūṭan ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā lil'ʿālamīna And We delivered him and Lut to the land which We (had) blessed in it for the worlds
  • [1] That is, Canaan.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:72
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:72 - وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَالِحِينَ wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilatan wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīna And We bestowed on him Isaac and Yaqub (in) addition and all We made righteous
  • [1] In a tradition of al-Imam al-Ṣādiq ('a), nāfilatan here is interpreted as meaning walad al-walad nāfilatan. Cf. Ma'ānī al-akhbār, p. 225.

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:73
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:73 - وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَوةِ وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ
wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma l-ṣalati waītāa l-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīna
And We made them leaders they guide by Our Command And We inspired to them (the) doing (of) good deeds and establishment (of) the prayer and giving (of) zakah and they were of Us worshippers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:74
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:74 - وَلُوطًا اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ الْخَبَائِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاسِقِينَ
walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīna
And (to) Lut We gave him judgment and knowledge and We saved him from the town which was doing wicked deeds Indeed, they were a people evil defiantly disobedient

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:75
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:75 - وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna
And We admitted him into Our Mercy Indeed, he (was) of the righteous

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:76
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:76 - وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَى مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ
wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi
And Nuh when he called before before so We responded to him and We saved him and his family from the affliction [the] great

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:77
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:77 - وَنَصَرْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna
And We helped him from the people who denied Our Signs Indeed, they were a people evil so We drowned them all

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:78
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:78 - وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِیْهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَاهِدِينَ
wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīna
And Dawud and Sulaiman when they judged concerning the field when pastured in it sheep (of) a people and We were to their judgment witness

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:79
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:79 - فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا اٰتَیْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُدَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ
fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'man waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīna
And We gave understanding of it (to) Sulaiman and (to) each We gave judgment and knowledge And We subjected with Dawud the mountains (to) glorify Our praises and the birds And We were the Doers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:80
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:80 - وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِنْ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ شَاكِرُونَ
waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsin lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūna
And We taught him (the) making (of) coats of armor for you to protect you from your battle Then will you (be) grateful

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:81
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:81 - وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَالِمِينَ
walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīna
And to Sulaiman the wind forcefully blowing by his command to the land which We blessed in it And We are of every thing Knowers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:82
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:82 - وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَافِظِينَ
wamina l-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīna
And of the devils (were some) who would dive for him and would do work other than that And We were of them Guardians

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:83
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:83 - وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna
And Ayub when he called (to) his Lord Indeed, [I] has touched me the adversity and You (are) Most Merciful (of) the Merciful

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:84
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:84 - فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَذِكْرٰی لِلْعَابِدِينَ
fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīna
So We responded to him and We removed what (was) on him of (the) adversity And We gave him his family and (the) like thereof with them (as) Mercy from Ourselves from Ourselves and a reminder for the worshippers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:85
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:85 - وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullun mina l-ṣābirīna
And Ishmael and Idris and Dhul-Kifl and Dhul-Kifl all (were) of the patient ones

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:86
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:86 - وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina l-ṣāliḥīna
And We admitted them in Our Mercy Indeed, they (were) of the righteous

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:87
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:87 - وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَى فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّیْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
wadhā l-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna an lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī l-ẓulumāti an lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīna
And Dhun-Nun And Dhun-Nun when he went (while) angry and thought that never We would decree upon him Then he called in the darkness(es) that (There is) no god except You Glory be to You Indeed, [I] I am of the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:88
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:88 - فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīna
So We responded to him and We saved him from the distress And thus We save the believers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:89
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:89 - وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-anta khayru l-wārithīna
And Zakariya when he called (to) his Lord My Lord (Do) not leave me alone while You (are) [the] Best (of) the inheritors

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:90
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:90 - فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَى وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوْۤا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ
fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīna
So We responded to him and We bestowed on him Yahya and We cured for him his wife Indeed, they used (to) hasten in good deeds and they supplicate to Us (in) hope and fear and they were to Us humbly submissive

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:91
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:91 - وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا اٰیَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wa-allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhā min rūḥinā wajaʿalnāhā wa-ib'nahā āyatan lil'ʿālamīna And she who guarded her chastity so We breathed into her of Our Spirit and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds
  • [1] Or 'of Our spirit.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:92
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:92 - إِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ
inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-uʿ'budūni
Indeed this (is) your religion religion one and I Am your Lord so worship Me

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:93
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:93 - وَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ wataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynā rājiʿūna But they cut off their affair among themselves all to Us (will) return
  • [1] That is, the earlier religious communities, such as Jews and Christians. Cf. (Q 23:53).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:94
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:94 - فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَإِنَّا لَهُ كَاتِبُونَ
faman yaʿmal mina l-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā kuf'rāna lisaʿyihi wa-innā lahu kātibūna
Then whoever does of [the] righteous deeds while he (is) a believer then not (will be) rejected [of] his effort And indeed, We of it (are) Recorders

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:95
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:95 - وَحَرَامٌ عَلَى قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
waḥarāmun ʿalā qaryatin ahlaknāhā annahum lā yarjiʿūna
And (there is) prohibition upon a city which We have destroyed that they not will return

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:96
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:96 - حَتّٰی إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ ḥattā idhā futiḥat yajūju wamajūju wahum min kulli ḥadabin yansilūna Until when has been opened (for) the Yajuj and Majuj and they from every elevation descend
  • [1] Or, according to a less familiar reading (jadath, for ḥadab), 'they will be scrambling out of every grave.' Cf. (Q 36:51).

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:97
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:97 - وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
wa-iq'taraba l-waʿdu l-ḥaqu fa-idhā hiya shākhiṣatun abṣāru alladhīna kafarū yāwaylanā qad kunnā fī ghaflatin min hādhā bal kunnā ẓālimīna
And has approached the promise [the] true then behold it (are) staring (the) eyes (of) those who disbelieved O woe to us Verily we had been in heedlessness of this nay we were wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:98
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:98 - إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ
innakum wamā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi ḥaṣabu jahannama antum lahā wāridūna
Indeed, you and what you worship besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah (are) firewood (of) Hell You to it will come

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:99
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:99 - لَوْ كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ آلِهَةً مَا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
law kāna hāulāi ālihatan mā waradūhā wakullun fīhā khālidūna
If were these gods not they (would) have come to it And all therein will abide forever

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:100
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:100 - لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
lahum fīhā zafīrun wahum fīhā lā yasmaʿūna
For them therein (is) sighing and they therein not will hear

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:101
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:101 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِنَّا الْحُسْنَى اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
inna alladhīna sabaqat lahum minnā l-ḥus'nā ulāika ʿanhā mub'ʿadūna
Indeed those has gone forth for them from Us the good those from it (will be) removed far

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:102
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:102 - لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِي مَا اشْتَهَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ خَالِدُونَ
lā yasmaʿūna ḥasīsahā wahum fī mā ish'tahat anfusuhum khālidūna
Not they will hear (the) slightest sound of it and they in what desire their souls will abide forever

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:103
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:103 - لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ هَذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
lā yaḥzunuhumu l-fazaʿu l-akbaru watatalaqqāhumu l-malāikatu hādhā yawmukumu alladhī kuntum tūʿadūna
Not will grieve them the terror [the] greatest and will meet them the Angels This (is) your Day which you were promised

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:104
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:104 - يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ
yawma naṭwī l-samāa kaṭayyi l-sijili lil'kutubi kamā badanā awwala khalqin nuʿīduhu waʿdan ʿalaynā innā kunnā fāʿilīna
(The) Day We will fold the heaven like (the) folding (of) a scroll for records As We began (the) first creation We will repeat it a promise upon Us Indeed, We We are (the) Doers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:105
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:105 - وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ
walaqad katabnā fī l-zabūri min baʿdi l-dhik'ri anna l-arḍa yarithuhā ʿibādiya l-ṣāliḥūna
And verily We have written in the Scripture after after the mention that the earth will inherit it My slaves the righteous

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:106
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:106 - إِنَّ فِي هَذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ
inna fī hādhā labalāghan liqawmin ʿābidīna
Indeed in this surely is a Message for a people worshippers

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:107
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:107 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ wamā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan lil'ʿālamīna And not We have sent you but (as) a mercy for the worlds
  • [1] Or 'to all the worlds.'

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:108
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:108 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fahal antum mus'limūna
Say Only it is revealed to me that your god (is) God One so will you submit (to Him)

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:109
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:109 - فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ ءَاذَنْتُكُمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ أَمْ بَعِيدٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ
fa-in tawallaw faqul ādhantukum ʿalā sawāin wa-in adrī aqarībun am baʿīdun mā tūʿadūna
But if they turn away then say I (have) announced to you equally equally And not I know whether is near or far what you are promised

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:110
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:110 - إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra mina l-qawli wayaʿlamu mā taktumūna
Indeed, He knows the declared of [the] speech and He knows what you conceal

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:111
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:111 - وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَى حِينٍ
wa-in adrī laʿallahu fit'natun lakum wamatāʿun ilā ḥīnin
And not I know perhaps it may be a trial for you and an enjoyment for a time

item.title: Al-Anbiyaa:112
item.description:
Al-Anbiyaa:112 - قَالَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَى مَا تَصِفُونَ qāla rabbi uḥ'kum bil-ḥaqi warabbunā l-raḥmānu l-mus'taʿānu ʿalā mā taṣifūna He said My Lord judge in truth And our Lord (is) the Most Gracious the One Whose help is sought against what you attribute
  • [1] Or 'Say,' according to an alternate reading (qul instead of qāla).

item.title: 22. الحج (Al-Hajj)
item.description:
The surah wherein God commands Abraham to proclaim to all humanity the obligation of The Pilgrimage to the Ancient House of God—The Ka'bah—in Mecca. Verse 26 ff. of this surah relate the ḥajj pilgrimage, after which it is named. This theme is introduced by the condemnation of those who bar the believers from access to the Sacred Mosque and is followed by permission to fight when attacked. It begins with the Day of Judgement and castigates those who worship useless idols, describing them later as powerless to create even a fly. The surah ends by urging the Muslims to persevere in following the faith of Abraham.
The surah is also known as The Hajj-Pilgrimage, Tile Pilgrimage

22:1
يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum inna zalzalata l-sāʿati shayon ʿaẓīmun
O mankind O mankind Fear your Lord Indeed (the) convulsion (of) the Hour (is) a thing great

22:2
يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرٰی النَّاسَ سُكَارٰی وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارٰی وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu mur'ḍiʿatin ʿammā arḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā watarā l-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāba l-lahi shadīdun
(The) Day you will see it will forget every nursing mother that which she was nursing and will deliver every pregnant woman pregnant woman her load and you will see [the] mankind intoxicated while not they (are) intoxicated but (the) punishment (of) Allah (will be) severe

22:3
وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ
wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānin marīdin
And among the mankind (is he) who disputes concerning Allah without knowledge and follows every devil rebellious

item.title: Al-Hajj:1
item.description:
Al-Hajj:1 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu ittaqū rabbakum inna zalzalata l-sāʿati shayon ʿaẓīmun
O mankind O mankind Fear your Lord Indeed (the) convulsion (of) the Hour (is) a thing great

item.title: Al-Hajj:2
item.description:
Al-Hajj:2 - يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرٰی النَّاسَ سُكَارٰی وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارٰی وَلَكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ
yawma tarawnahā tadhhalu kullu mur'ḍiʿatin ʿammā arḍaʿat wataḍaʿu kullu dhāti ḥamlin ḥamlahā watarā l-nāsa sukārā wamā hum bisukārā walākinna ʿadhāba l-lahi shadīdun
(The) Day you will see it will forget every nursing mother that which she was nursing and will deliver every pregnant woman pregnant woman her load and you will see [the] mankind intoxicated while not they (are) intoxicated but (the) punishment (of) Allah (will be) severe

item.title: Al-Hajj:3
item.description:
Al-Hajj:3 - وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ
wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min wayattabiʿu kulla shayṭānin marīdin
And among the mankind (is he) who disputes concerning Allah without knowledge and follows every devil rebellious

item.title: Al-Hajj:4
item.description:
Al-Hajj:4 - كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَى عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ
kutiba ʿalayhi annahu man tawallāhu fa-annahu yuḍilluhu wayahdīhi ilā ʿadhābi l-saʿīri
It has been decreed for him that he who befriends him then indeed, he will misguide him and will guide him to (the) punishment (of) the Blaze

item.title: Al-Hajj:5
item.description:
Al-Hajj:5 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُضْغَةٍ مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا وَتَرٰی الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ yāayyuhā l-nāsu in kuntum fī raybin mina l-baʿthi fa-innā khalaqnākum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma min muḍ'ghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fī l-arḥāmi mā nashāu ilā ajalin musamman thumma nukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffā waminkum man yuraddu ilā ardhali l-ʿumuri likaylā yaʿlama min baʿdi ʿil'min shayan watarā l-arḍa hāmidatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat wa-anbatat min kulli zawjin bahījin O mankind O mankind If you are in doubt about the Resurrection then indeed, We We created you from dust then from a semen-drop then from a clinging substance then from an embryonic lump formed and not formed that We may make clear to you And We cause to remain in the wombs what We will for a term appointed then We bring you out (as) a child then that you may reach [your] maturity And among you (is he) who dies and among you (is he) who is returned to the most abject age so that not he knows after after having known anything And you see the earth barren then when We send down on it water it gets stirred and it swells and grows of every kind beautiful
  • [1] That is, an embryo; cf. (Q 23:13) - (Q 23:14); (Q 40:67); (Q 75:38).
  • [2] That is, the fetus in the early stages of its development; cf. (Q 23:13).

item.title: Al-Hajj:6
item.description:
Al-Hajj:6 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَأَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-annahu yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wa-annahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
That (is) because Allah He (is) the Truth And that He [He] gives life (to) the dead and that He (is) over every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Al-Hajj:7
item.description:
Al-Hajj:7 - وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ
wa-anna l-sāʿata ātiyatun lā rayba fīhā wa-anna l-laha yabʿathu man fī l-qubūri
And that the Hour will come (there is) no doubt about it and that Allah will resurrect (those) who (are) in the graves

item.title: Al-Hajj:8
item.description:
Al-Hajj:8 - وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ
wamina l-nāsi man yujādilu fī l-lahi bighayri ʿil'min walā hudan walā kitābin munīrin
And among mankind (is he) who disputes concerning Allah without any knowledge and not any guidance and not a Book enlightening

item.title: Al-Hajj:9
item.description:
Al-Hajj:9 - ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ
thāniya ʿiṭ'fihi liyuḍilla ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahu fī l-dun'yā khiz'yun wanudhīquhu yawma l-qiyāmati ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi
Twisting his neck to mislead from (the) way (of) Allah For him in the world (is) disgrace and We will make him taste (on the) Day (of) Resurrection (the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire

item.title: Al-Hajj:10
item.description:
Al-Hajj:10 - ذٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ dhālika bimā qaddamat yadāka wa-anna l-laha laysa biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi That (is) for what have sent forth your hands and that Allah is not unjust to His slaves
  • [1] Or 'prepared,' or 'committed.'

item.title: Al-Hajj:11
item.description:
Al-Hajj:11 - وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انْقَلَبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ
wamina l-nāsi man yaʿbudu l-laha ʿalā ḥarfin fa-in aṣābahu khayrun iṭ'ma-anna bihi wa-in aṣābathu fit'natun inqalaba ʿalā wajhihi khasira l-dun'yā wal-ākhirata dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu
And among the mankind (is he) who worships Allah on an edge And if befalls him good he is content with it and if befalls him a trial he turns on his face He has lost the world and the Hereafter That it (is) the loss clear

item.title: Al-Hajj:12
item.description:
Al-Hajj:12 - يَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُ وَمَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَالُ الْبَعِيدُ
yadʿū min dūni l-lahi mā lā yaḍurruhu wamā lā yanfaʿuhu dhālika huwa l-ḍalālu l-baʿīdu
He calls besides besides Allah what not harms him and what not benefits him That it (is) the straying far away

item.title: Al-Hajj:13
item.description:
Al-Hajj:13 - يَدْعُوْۤا لَمَنْ ضَرُّهُ أَقْرَبُ مِنْ نَفْعِهِ لَبِئْسَ الْمَوْلَى وَلَبِئْسَ الْعَشِيرُ
yadʿū laman ḍarruhu aqrabu min nafʿihi labi'sa l-mawlā walabi'sa l-ʿashīru
He calls (one) who his harm (is) closer than his benefit Surely, an evil protector and surely an evil friend

item.title: Al-Hajj:14
item.description:
Al-Hajj:14 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru inna l-laha yafʿalu mā yurīdu
Indeed Allah will admit those who believe and do the righteous deeds (to) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers Indeed Allah does what He intends

item.title: Al-Hajj:15
item.description:
Al-Hajj:15 - مَنْ كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَنْ لَنْ يَنْصُرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنْظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُ مَا يَغِيظُ
man kāna yaẓunnu an lan yanṣurahu l-lahu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati falyamdud bisababin ilā l-samāi thumma l'yaqṭaʿ falyanẓur hal yudh'hibanna kayduhu mā yaghīẓu
Whoever is thinks that not Allah will help him Allah will help him in the world and the Hereafter then let him extend a rope to the sky then let him cut off then let him see whether will remove his plan what enrages

item.title: Al-Hajj:16
item.description:
Al-Hajj:16 - وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يُرِيدُ
wakadhālika anzalnāhu āyātin bayyinātin wa-anna l-laha yahdī man yurīdu
And thus We sent it down (as) clear Verses (as) clear Verses and that Allah guides whom He intends

item.title: Al-Hajj:17
item.description:
Al-Hajj:17 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوْۤا وَالصَّابِءِينَ وَالنَّصَارَى وَالْمَجُوسَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوْۤا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
inna alladhīna āmanū wa-alladhīna hādū wal-ṣābiīna wal-naṣārā wal-majūsa wa-alladhīna ashrakū inna l-laha yafṣilu baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun
Indeed those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabians and the Christians and the Magians and those who (are) polytheists indeed Allah will judge between them (on) the Day (of) the Resurrection Indeed Allah over every thing (is) a Witness

item.title: Al-Hajj:18
item.description:
Al-Hajj:18 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالنُّجُومُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَابُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابُ وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ
alam tara anna l-laha yasjudu lahu man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi wal-shamsu wal-qamaru wal-nujūmu wal-jibālu wal-shajaru wal-dawābu wakathīrun mina l-nāsi wakathīrun ḥaqqa ʿalayhi l-ʿadhābu waman yuhini l-lahu famā lahu min muk'rimin inna l-laha yafʿalu mā yashāu
Do not you see that (to) Allah prostrates to Him whoever (is) in the heavens and whoever (is) in the earth and the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the moving creatures and many of the people But many (is) justly due on him the punishment And whoever Allah humiliates Allah humiliates then not for him any bestower of honor Indeed Allah does what He wills

item.title: Al-Hajj:19
item.description:
Al-Hajj:19 - هَذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِنْ نَارٍ يُصَبُّ مِنْ فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيمُ
hādhāni khaṣmāni ikh'taṣamū fī rabbihim fa-alladhīna kafarū quṭṭiʿat lahum thiyābun min nārin yuṣabbu min fawqi ruūsihimu l-ḥamīmu
These two opponents dispute concerning their Lord But those who disbelieved will be cut out for them garments of fire Will be poured over over their heads [the] scalding water

item.title: Al-Hajj:20
item.description:
Al-Hajj:20 - يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ
yuṣ'haru bihi mā fī buṭūnihim wal-julūdu
Will be melted with it what (is) in their bellies and the skins

item.title: Al-Hajj:21
item.description:
Al-Hajj:21 - وَلَهُمْ مَقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ
walahum maqāmiʿu min ḥadīdin
And for them (are) hooked rods of iron

item.title: Al-Hajj:22
item.description:
Al-Hajj:22 - كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوْۤا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوْۤا مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوْۤا فِيهَا وَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ
kullamā arādū an yakhrujū min'hā min ghammin uʿīdū fīhā wadhūqū ʿadhāba l-ḥarīqi
Every time they want to come out from it from anguish they will be returned therein Taste (the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire

item.title: Al-Hajj:23
item.description:
Al-Hajj:23 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun
Indeed Allah will admit those who believe and do the righteous deeds (to) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl and their garments therein (will be of) silk

item.title: Al-Hajj:24
item.description:
Al-Hajj:24 - وَهُدُوْۤا إِلَى الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوْۤا إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْحَمِيدِ
wahudū ilā l-ṭayibi mina l-qawli wahudū ilā ṣirāṭi l-ḥamīdi
And they were guided to the good of the speech and they were guided to (the) path (of) the Praiseworthy

item.title: Al-Hajj:25
item.description:
Al-Hajj:25 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِي جَعَلْنَاهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَاءً الْعَاكِفُ فِیْهِ وَالْبَادِ وَمَنْ يُرِدْ فِیْهِ بِإِلْحَادٍ بِظُلْمٍ نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
inna alladhīna kafarū wayaṣuddūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi wal-masjidi l-ḥarāmi alladhī jaʿalnāhu lilnnāsi sawāan l-ʿākifu fīhi wal-bādi waman yurid fīhi bi-il'ḥādin biẓul'min nudhiq'hu min ʿadhābin alīmin
Indeed those who disbelieved and hinder from (the) way (of) Allah and Al-Masjid Al-Haraam and Al-Masjid Al-Haraam which We made it for the mankind equal (are) the resident therein and the visitor and whoever intends therein of deviation (or) wrongdoing We will make him taste of a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Hajj:26
item.description:
Al-Hajj:26 - وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِاِبْرَاهِیْمَ مَكَانَ الْبَيْتِ أَنْ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِي شَيْئًا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْقَائِمِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ
wa-idh bawwanā li-ib'rāhīma makāna l-bayti an lā tush'rik bī shayan waṭahhir baytiya lilṭṭāifīna wal-qāimīna wal-rukaʿi l-sujūdi
And when We assigned to Ibrahim (the) site (of) the House That (do) not associate with Me anything and purify My House for those who circumambulate and those who stand and those who bow (and) those who prostrate

item.title: Al-Hajj:27
item.description:
Al-Hajj:27 - وَأَذِّنْ فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَى كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِنْ كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
wa-adhin fī l-nāsi bil-ḥaji yatūka rijālan waʿalā kulli ḍāmirin yatīna min kulli fajjin ʿamīqin
And proclaim to [the] mankind [of] the Pilgrimage they will come to you (on) foot and on every lean camel they will come from every mountain highway distant

item.title: Al-Hajj:28
item.description:
Al-Hajj:28 - لِيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ عَلَى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ فَكُلُوْۤا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا الْبَائِسَ الْفَقِيرَ
liyashhadū manāfiʿa lahum wayadhkurū is'ma l-lahi fī ayyāmin maʿlūmātin ʿalā mā razaqahum min bahīmati l-anʿāmi fakulū min'hā wa-aṭʿimū l-bāisa l-faqīra
That they may witness benefits for them and mention (the) name (of) Allah on days known over what He has provided them of (the) beast (of) cattle So eat of them and feed the miserable the poor

item.title: Al-Hajj:29
item.description:
Al-Hajj:29 - ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوْۤا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوْۤا نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ thumma l'yaqḍū tafathahum walyūfū nudhūrahum walyaṭṭawwafū bil-bayti l-ʿatīqi Then let them end their prescribed duties and fulfil their vows and circumambulate the House [the] Ancient
  • [1] According to the commentators, the phrase li yaqḍū tafathahum implies egress from the state of iḥrām (after the shortening of the hair or the nails, and the bath), and relief from its restrictions. Or it means 'let them perform their rites.'
  • [2] Or, 'the Free House,' that is, free from bondage of anyone's ownership.

item.title: Al-Hajj:30
item.description:
Al-Hajj:30 - ذٰلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَاتِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْأَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوا قَوْلَ الزُّورِ
dhālika waman yuʿaẓẓim ḥurumāti l-lahi fahuwa khayrun lahu ʿinda rabbihi wa-uḥillat lakumu l-anʿāmu illā mā yut'lā ʿalaykum fa-ij'tanibū l-rij'sa mina l-awthāni wa-ij'tanibū qawla l-zūri
That and whoever honors (the) sacred rites (of) Allah then it (is) best for him near his Lord And are made lawful to you the cattle except what is recited to you So avoid the abomination of the idols and avoid (the) word false

item.title: Al-Hajj:31
item.description:
Al-Hajj:31 - حُنَفَاءَ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِ وَمَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ
ḥunafāa lillahi ghayra mush'rikīna bihi waman yush'rik bil-lahi faka-annamā kharra mina l-samāi fatakhṭafuhu l-ṭayru aw tahwī bihi l-rīḥu fī makānin saḥīqin
Being upright to Allah not associating partners with Him And whoever associates partners with Allah then (it is) as though he had fallen from the sky and (had) snatched him the birds or had blown him the wind to a place far off

item.title: Al-Hajj:32
item.description:
Al-Hajj:32 - ذٰلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ
dhālika waman yuʿaẓẓim shaʿāira l-lahi fa-innahā min taqwā l-qulūbi
That and whoever honors (the) Symbols (of) Allah then indeed, it (is) from (the) piety (of) the hearts

item.title: Al-Hajj:33
item.description:
Al-Hajj:33 - لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ lakum fīhā manāfiʿu ilā ajalin musamman thumma maḥilluhā ilā l-bayti l-ʿatīqi For you therein (are) benefits for a term appointed then their place of sacrifice (is) at the House the Ancient
  • [1] That is, you may benefit from the sacrificial animals, such as by using them as mounts or milking them, until they arrive at the place where they are to be sacrificed.

item.title: Al-Hajj:34
item.description:
Al-Hajj:34 - وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا لِيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ فَإِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَلَهُ أَسْلِمُوْۤا وَبَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِينَ
walikulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakan liyadhkurū is'ma l-lahi ʿalā mā razaqahum min bahīmati l-anʿāmi fa-ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun falahu aslimū wabashiri l-mukh'bitīna
And for every nation We have appointed a rite that they may mention (the) name (of) Allah over what He (has) provided them of (the) beast (of) cattle And your God (is) God One so to Him submit And give glad tidings (to) the humble ones

item.title: Al-Hajj:35
item.description:
Al-Hajj:35 - اَلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ عَلَى مَا أَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيمِي الصَّلَاةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ
alladhīna idhā dhukira l-lahu wajilat qulūbuhum wal-ṣābirīna ʿalā mā aṣābahum wal-muqīmī l-ṣalati wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
Those when is mentioned Allah fear their hearts and those who are patient over whatever has afflicted them and those who establish the prayer and out of what We have provided them they spend

item.title: Al-Hajj:36
item.description:
Al-Hajj:36 - وَالْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَاهَا لَكُمْ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَافَّ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوْۤا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَاهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
wal-bud'na jaʿalnāhā lakum min shaʿāiri l-lahi lakum fīhā khayrun fa-udh'kurū is'ma l-lahi ʿalayhā ṣawāffa fa-idhā wajabat junūbuhā fakulū min'hā wa-aṭʿimū l-qāniʿa wal-muʿ'tara kadhālika sakharnāhā lakum laʿallakum tashkurūna
And the camels and cattle We have made them for you among (the) Symbols (of) Allah for you therein (is) good So mention (the) name (of) Allah over them (when) lined up and when are down their sides then eat from them and feed the needy who do not ask and the needy who ask Thus We have subjected them to you so that you may be grateful

item.title: Al-Hajj:37
item.description:
Al-Hajj:37 - لَنْ يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَكِنْ يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَى مِنْكُمْ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ عَلَى مَا هَدَاكُمْ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
lan yanāla l-laha luḥūmuhā walā dimāuhā walākin yanāluhu l-taqwā minkum kadhālika sakharahā lakum litukabbirū l-laha ʿalā mā hadākum wabashiri l-muḥ'sinīna
Will not reach Allah their meat and not their blood but reaches Him the piety from you Thus He subjected them to you so that you may magnify Allah for what He has guided you And give glad tidings (to) the good-doers

item.title: Al-Hajj:38
item.description:
Al-Hajj:38 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدَافِعُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
inna l-laha yudāfiʿu ʿani alladhīna āmanū inna l-laha lā yuḥibbu kulla khawwānin kafūrin
Indeed Allah defends defends those who believe Indeed Allah (does) not like every treacherous ungrateful

item.title: Al-Hajj:39
item.description:
Al-Hajj:39 - أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوْۤا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
udhina lilladhīna yuqātalūna bi-annahum ẓulimū wa-inna l-laha ʿalā naṣrihim laqadīrun
Permission is given to those who are being fought because they were wronged And indeed Allah for their victory (is) surely Able

item.title: Al-Hajj:40
item.description:
Al-Hajj:40 - اَلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوْۤا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّا أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللَّهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَهُدِّمَتْ صَوَامِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَاتٌ وَمَسَاجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا اسْمُ اللَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَلَيَنْصُرَنَّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
alladhīna ukh'rijū min diyārihim bighayri ḥaqqin illā an yaqūlū rabbunā l-lahu walawlā dafʿu l-lahi l-nāsa baʿḍahum bibaʿḍin lahuddimat ṣawāmiʿu wabiyaʿun waṣalawātun wamasājidu yudh'karu fīhā us'mu l-lahi kathīran walayanṣuranna l-lahu man yanṣuruhu inna l-laha laqawiyyun ʿazīzun
Those who have been evicted from their homes without right except that they said Our Lord (is) Allah And if not Allah checks Allah checks the people some of them by others surely (would) have been demolished monasteries and churches and synagogues and masajid is mentioned in it (the) name of Allah (the) name of Allah much And surely Allah will help And surely Allah will help (those) who help Him Indeed Allah (is) surely All-Strong All-Mighty

item.title: Al-Hajj:41
item.description:
Al-Hajj:41 - اَلَّذِينَ إِنْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَءَاتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَمَرُوْۤا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَلِلَّهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ
alladhīna in makkannāhum fī l-arḍi aqāmū l-ṣalata waātawū l-zakata wa-amarū bil-maʿrūfi wanahaw ʿani l-munkari walillahi ʿāqibatu l-umūri
Those who if We establish them in the land they establish the prayer and they give zakah and they enjoin the right and forbid from the wrong And for Allah (is the) end (of) the matters

item.title: Al-Hajj:42
item.description:
Al-Hajj:42 - وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wathamūdu
And if they deny you so verily denied before them (the) people (of) Nuh and Aad and Thamud

item.title: Al-Hajj:43
item.description:
Al-Hajj:43 - وَقَوْمُ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
waqawmu ib'rāhīma waqawmu lūṭin
And (the) people (of) Ibrahim and (the) people (of) Lut

item.title: Al-Hajj:44
item.description:
Al-Hajj:44 - وَأَصْحَابُ مَدْيَنَ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسٰی فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَافِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
wa-aṣḥābu madyana wakudhiba mūsā fa-amlaytu lil'kāfirīna thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna nakīri
And the inhabitants (of) Madyan And Musa was denied And Musa was denied so I granted respite to the disbelievers then I seized them and how was My punishment

item.title: Al-Hajj:45
item.description:
Al-Hajj:45 - فَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَى عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَشِيدٍ
faka-ayyin min qaryatin ahlaknāhā wahiya ẓālimatun fahiya khāwiyatun ʿalā ʿurūshihā wabi'rin muʿaṭṭalatin waqaṣrin mashīdin
And how many of a township We have destroyed it while it was doing wrong so it fell on its roofs and well abandoned and castle lofty

item.title: Al-Hajj:46
item.description:
Al-Hajj:46 - أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَا أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى الْأَبْصَارُ وَلَكِنْ تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ الَّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ
afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fatakūna lahum qulūbun yaʿqilūna bihā aw ādhānun yasmaʿūna bihā fa-innahā lā taʿmā l-abṣāru walākin taʿmā l-qulūbu allatī fī l-ṣudūri
So have not they traveled in the land and is for them hearts (to) reason with it or ears (to) hear with it For indeed, [it] not (are) blinded the eyes but (are) blinded the hearts which (are) in the breasts

item.title: Al-Hajj:47
item.description:
Al-Hajj:47 - وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَنْ يُخْلِفَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walan yukh'lifa l-lahu waʿdahu wa-inna yawman ʿinda rabbika ka-alfi sanatin mimmā taʿuddūna
And they ask you to hasten the punishment But never will fail/violate Allah (in) His Promise And indeed a day with your Lord (is) like a thousand year(s) of what you count

item.title: Al-Hajj:48
item.description:
Al-Hajj:48 - وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ
waka-ayyin min qaryatin amlaytu lahā wahiya ẓālimatun thumma akhadhtuhā wa-ilayya l-maṣīru
And how many of a township I gave respite to it while it (was) doing wrong Then I seized it and to Me (is) the destination

item.title: Al-Hajj:49
item.description:
Al-Hajj:49 - قُلْ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā anā lakum nadhīrun mubīnun
Say O mankind O mankind Only I am to you a warner clear

item.title: Al-Hajj:50
item.description:
Al-Hajj:50 - فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
fa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun
So those who believe and do righteous deeds for them (is) forgiveness and a provision noble

item.title: Al-Hajj:51
item.description:
Al-Hajj:51 - وَالَّذِينَ سَعَوْا فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ
wa-alladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi
And those who strove against Our Verses (to) cause failure those (are the) companions (of) the Hellfire

item.title: Al-Hajj:52
item.description:
Al-Hajj:52 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّى أَلْقَى الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنْسَخُ اللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠
wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin walā nabiyyin illā idhā tamannā alqā l-shayṭānu fī um'niyyatihi fayansakhu l-lahu mā yul'qī l-shayṭānu thumma yuḥ'kimu l-lahu āyātihi wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
And not We sent before you before you any Messenger and not a Prophet but when he recited threw the Shaitaan in his recitation But Allah abolishes But Allah abolishes what throws the Shaitaan then Allah will establish Allah will establish His Verses And Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: Al-Hajj:53
item.description:
Al-Hajj:53 - لِيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَفِیْ شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ
liyajʿala mā yul'qī l-shayṭānu fit'natan lilladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-qāsiyati qulūbuhum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lafī shiqāqin baʿīdin
That He may make what the Shaitaan throws the Shaitaan throws a trial for those in their hearts (is) a disease and (are) hardened their hearts And indeed the wrongdoers (are) surely, in schism far

item.title: Al-Hajj:54
item.description:
Al-Hajj:54 - وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهَادِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
waliyaʿlama alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma annahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika fayu'minū bihi fatukh'bita lahu qulūbuhum wa-inna l-laha lahādi alladhīna āmanū ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
And that may know those who have been given the knowledge that it (is) the truth from your Lord and they believe in it and may humbly submit to it their hearts And indeed Allah (is) surely (the) Guide (of) those who believe to a Path Straight

item.title: Al-Hajj:55
item.description:
Al-Hajj:55 - وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْهُ حَتّٰی تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
walā yazālu alladhīna kafarū fī mir'yatin min'hu ḥattā tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan aw yatiyahum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaqīmin
And not will cease those who disbelieve (to be) in doubt of it until comes to them the Hour suddenly or comes to them (the) punishment (of) a Day barren

item.title: Al-Hajj:56
item.description:
Al-Hajj:56 - اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
al-mul'ku yawma-idhin lillahi yaḥkumu baynahum fa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī jannāti l-naʿīmi
The Sovereignty (on) that Day (will be) for Allah He will judge between them So those who believe and did righteous deeds (will be) in Gardens (of) Delight

item.title: Al-Hajj:57
item.description:
Al-Hajj:57 - وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَأُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ
wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā fa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun
And those who disbelieved and denied Our Verses then those for them (will be) a punishment humiliating

item.title: Al-Hajj:58
item.description:
Al-Hajj:58 - وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوْۤا أَوْ مَاتُوْۤا لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
wa-alladhīna hājarū fī sabīli l-lahi thumma qutilū aw mātū layarzuqannahumu l-lahu riz'qan ḥasanan wa-inna l-laha lahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna
And those who emigrated in (the) way (of) Allah then were killed or died surely, Allah will provide them surely, Allah will provide them a provision good And indeed Allah surely, He (is the) Best (of) the Providers

item.title: Al-Hajj:59
item.description:
Al-Hajj:59 - لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ مُدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَلِیْمٌ حَلِيمٌ
layud'khilannahum mud'khalan yarḍawnahu wa-inna l-laha laʿalīmun ḥalīmun
