Surely, He will admit them (to) an entrance they will be pleased (with) it And indeed Allah surely, (is) All-Knowing Most Forbearing

item.title: Al-Hajj:60
item.description:
Al-Hajj:60 - ذٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنْصُرَنَّهُ اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
dhālika waman ʿāqaba bimith'li mā ʿūqiba bihi thumma bughiya ʿalayhi layanṣurannahu l-lahu inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun
That and whoever has retaliated with the like (of) that he was made to suffer by it then he was oppressed on him Allah will surely help him Allah will surely help him Indeed Allah (is) surely Oft-Pardoning Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Al-Hajj:61
item.description:
Al-Hajj:61 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
dhālika bi-anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wa-anna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun
That (is) because Allah causes to enter the night in (to) the day and causes to enter the day in (to) the night And indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Seer

item.title: Al-Hajj:62
item.description:
Al-Hajj:62 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ هُوَ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ
dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi huwa l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīru
That (is) because Allah He (is) the Truth and that what they invoke besides Him besides Him it (is) the falsehood And that Allah He (is) the Most High the Most Great

item.title: Al-Hajj:63
item.description:
Al-Hajj:63 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَتُصْبِحُ الْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fatuṣ'biḥu l-arḍu mukh'ḍarratan inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīrun
Do not you see that Allah sends down from the sky water then becomes the earth green Indeed Allah (is) surely Subtle All-Aware

item.title: Al-Hajj:64
item.description:
Al-Hajj:64 - لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu
For Him (is) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth And indeed Allah surely, He (is) Free of need the Praiseworthy

item.title: Al-Hajj:65
item.description:
Al-Hajj:65 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَيُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
alam tara anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-arḍi wal-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri bi-amrihi wayum'siku l-samāa an taqaʿa ʿalā l-arḍi illā bi-idh'nihi inna l-laha bil-nāsi laraūfun raḥīmun
Do not you see that Allah (has) subjected to you what (is) in the earth and the ships that sail through the sea by His Command And He withholds the sky lest it falls on the earth except by His permission Indeed Allah to mankind (is) Full of Kindness Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Hajj:66
item.description:
Al-Hajj:66 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ
wahuwa alladhī aḥyākum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum inna l-insāna lakafūrun
And He (is) the One Who gave you life then He will cause you to die then He will give you life (again) Indeed man (is) surely ungrateful

item.title: Al-Hajj:67
item.description:
Al-Hajj:67 - لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ فَلَا يُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَادْعُ إِلَى رَبِّكَ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَى هُدًى مُسْتَقِيمٍ likulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakan hum nāsikūhu falā yunāziʿunnaka fī l-amri wa-ud'ʿu ilā rabbika innaka laʿalā hudan mus'taqīmin For every nation We have made rite(s) they perform it So let them not dispute with you So let them not dispute with you in the matter but invite (them) to your Lord Indeed, you (are) surely on guidance straight
  • [1] Or 'the Law.'

item.title: Al-Hajj:68
item.description:
Al-Hajj:68 - وَإِنْ جَادَلُوكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
wa-in jādalūka faquli l-lahu aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna
And if they argue (with) you then say Allah (is) most knowing of what you do

item.title: Al-Hajj:69
item.description:
Al-Hajj:69 - اَللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كُنْتُمْ فِیْهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
al-lahu yaḥkumu baynakum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna
Allah will judge between you (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection concerning what you used (to) in it differ

item.title: Al-Hajj:70
item.description:
Al-Hajj:70 - أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
alam taʿlam anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāi wal-arḍi inna dhālika fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun
Do not you know that Allah knows what (is) in the heaven and the earth Indeed that (is) in a Record indeed that (is) for Allah easy

item.title: Al-Hajj:71
item.description:
Al-Hajj:71 - وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ
wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wamā laysa lahum bihi ʿil'mun wamā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīrin
And they worship besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah what not He (has) sent down for it any authority and what not they have of it any knowledge And not (will be) for the wrongdoers any helper

item.title: Al-Hajj:72
item.description:
Al-Hajj:72 - وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا الْمُنْكَرَ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِالَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَاتِنَا قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِشَرٍّ مِنْ ذَلِكُمُ النَّارُ وَعَدَهَا اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin taʿrifu fī wujūhi alladhīna kafarū l-munkara yakādūna yasṭūna bi-alladhīna yatlūna ʿalayhim āyātinā qul afa-unabbi-ukum bisharrin min dhālikumu l-nāru waʿadahā l-lahu alladhīna kafarū wabi'sa l-maṣīru
And when are recited to them Our Verses clear you will recognize on (the) faces (of) those who disbelieve the denial They almost attack those who recite to them Our Verses Say Then shall I inform you of worse than that The Fire Allah (has) promised it Allah (has) promised it (for) those who disbelieve and wretched (is) the destination

item.title: Al-Hajj:73
item.description:
Al-Hajj:73 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَنْ يَخْلُقُوْۤا ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ وَإِنْ يَسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْئًا لَا يَسْتَنْقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu ḍuriba mathalun fa-is'tamiʿū lahu inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lan yakhluqū dhubāban walawi ij'tamaʿū lahu wa-in yaslub'humu l-dhubābu shayan lā yastanqidhūhu min'hu ḍaʿufa l-ṭālibu wal-maṭlūbu
O mankind O mankind Is set forth an example so listen to it Indeed those whom you invoke besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah will never create a fly even if they gathered together for it And if snatched away from them the fly a thing not they (could) take it back from it So weak (are) the seeker and the one who is sought

item.title: Al-Hajj:74
item.description:
Al-Hajj:74 - مَا قَدَرُوْۤا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
mā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi inna l-laha laqawiyyun ʿazīzun
Not they (have) estimated Allah (with) due [His] estimation Indeed Allah (is) surely All-Strong All-Mighty

item.title: Al-Hajj:75
item.description:
Al-Hajj:75 - اَللَّهُ يَصْطَفِي مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ النَّاسِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
al-lahu yaṣṭafī mina l-malāikati rusulan wamina l-nāsi inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun
Allah chooses from the Angels Messengers and from the mankind Indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Seer

item.title: Al-Hajj:76
item.description:
Al-Hajj:76 - يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ
yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru
He knows what (is) before them (is) before them and what (is) after them And to Allah return all the matters

item.title: Al-Hajj:77
item.description:
Al-Hajj:77 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا ارْكَعُوْۤا وَاسْجُدُوا وَاعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُوا الْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ir'kaʿū wa-us'judū wa-uʿ'budū rabbakum wa-if'ʿalū l-khayra laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna
O you those who(believe) believe Bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do [the] good so that you may be successful

item.title: Al-Hajj:78
item.description:
Al-Hajj:78 - وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ مِلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَفِي هَذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ wajāhidū fī l-lahi ḥaqqa jihādihi huwa ij'tabākum wamā jaʿala ʿalaykum fī l-dīni min ḥarajin millata abīkum ib'rāhīma huwa sammākumu l-mus'limīna min qablu wafī hādhā liyakūna l-rasūlu shahīdan ʿalaykum watakūnū shuhadāa ʿalā l-nāsi fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-iʿ'taṣimū bil-lahi huwa mawlākum faniʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīru And strive for Allah (with the) striving due (to) Him (with the) striving due (to) Him He (has) chosen you and not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty (The) religion (of) your father Ibrahim He named you Muslims before before and in this that may be the Messenger a witness over you and you may be witnesses on the mankind So establish the prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah He (is) your Protector so an Excellent [the] Protector and an Excellent [the] Helper
  • [1] That is, in the earlier scriptures and in the present one, that is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: 23. المؤمنون (Al-Muminoon)
item.description:
The surah that declares the ultimate success of the faithful - the believers in One God, without partner, and that describes the irreproachable of their spiritual and moral virtues. It takes its name from verse 1 which mentions the faithful (mu'minūn). The surah stresses that the believers are the ones who will succeed, whereas the disbelievers will be punished for their arrogance and derision. Several proofs are given of God's Oneness and His power, and the inevitability of the Resurrection is emphasized.
The surah is also known as The Believers, The True Believers

23:1
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūna
Indeed successful (are) the believers

23:2
اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna
Those who they during their prayers (are) humbly submissive

23:3
وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūna
Those who they from the vain talk turn away

item.title: Al-Muminoon:1
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:1 - قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūna
Indeed successful (are) the believers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:2
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:2 - اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna
Those who they during their prayers (are) humbly submissive

item.title: Al-Muminoon:3
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:3 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūna
Those who they from the vain talk turn away

item.title: Al-Muminoon:4
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:4 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوةِ فَاعِلُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūna
Those who they of purification works (are) doers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:5
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:5 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna And those who they of their modesty (are) guardians
  • [1] That is, those who refrain from unlawful sexual relations and cover their private parts properly, except in the state of privacy with their spouses.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:6
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:6 - إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna
Except from their spouses or what possess their right hands then indeed, they (are) not blameworthy

item.title: Al-Muminoon:7
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:7 - فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna
Then whoever seeks beyond that then those they (are) the transgressors

item.title: Al-Muminoon:8
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:8 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna
And those who they of their trusts and their promise(s) (are) observers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:9
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:9 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūna
And those who they over their prayers they guard

item.title: Al-Muminoon:10
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:10 - اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ
ulāika humu l-wārithūna
Those they (are) the inheritors

item.title: Al-Muminoon:11
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:11 - اَلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūna Who will inherit the Paradise They therein (will) abide forever
  • [1] Cf. (Q 70:22) - (Q 70:35).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:12
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:12 - وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ طِينٍ
walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīnin
And indeed We created the humankind from an essence of clay

item.title: Al-Muminoon:13
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:13 - ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ
thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārin makīnin
Then We placed him (as) a semen-drop in a resting place firm

item.title: Al-Muminoon:14
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:14 - ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
thumma khalaqnā l-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīna
Then We created the semen-drop (into) a clinging substance then We created the clinging substance (into) an embryonic lump then We created the embryonic lump (into) bones then We clothed the bones (with) flesh then We produce it (as) a creation another So blessed is Allah (the) Best (of) the Creators

item.title: Al-Muminoon:15
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:15 - ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūna
Then indeed, you after that surely (will) die

item.title: Al-Muminoon:16
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:16 - ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūna
Then indeed, you (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection will be resurrected

item.title: Al-Muminoon:17
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:17 - وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīna And indeed We (have) created above you seven paths and not We are of the creation unaware
  • [1] Apparently, a reference to the seven heavens. Or, 'seven tracks.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:18
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:18 - وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ
wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūna
And We send down from the sky water in (due) measure then We cause it to settle in the earth And indeed, We on taking it away taking it away surely (are) Able

item.title: Al-Muminoon:19
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:19 - فَأَنْشَأْنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna
Then We produced for you by it gardens of date-palms of date-palms and grapevines for you in it (are) fruits abundant and from them you eat

item.title: Al-Muminoon:20
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:20 - وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلْءَاكِلِينَ
washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghin lil'ākilīna
And a tree (that) springs forth from Mount Sinai Mount Sinai (which) produces oil and a relish for those who eat

item.title: Al-Muminoon:21
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:21 - وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna
And indeed for you in the cattle surely, (is) a lesson We give you drink from what (is) in their bellies and for you in them (are) benefits many and of them you eat

item.title: Al-Muminoon:22
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:22 - وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūna
And on them and on [the] ships you are carried

item.title: Al-Muminoon:23
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:23 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna
And verily We sent Nuh to his people and he said O my people Worship Allah not for you (is) any god other than Him Then will not you fear

item.title: Al-Muminoon:24
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:24 - فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي ءَابَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ
faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yurīdu an yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatan mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīna
But said the chiefs (of) those who disbelieved among his people This is not This is not but a man like you he wishes to assert (his) superiority over you and if Allah had willed Allah had willed surely He (would have) sent down Angels Not we heard of this from our forefathers our forefathers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:25
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:25 - إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتّٰی حِينٍ
in huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīnin
Not he (is) but a man in him (is) madness so wait concerning him until a time

item.title: Al-Muminoon:26
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:26 - قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni
He said My Lord Help me because they deny me

item.title: Al-Muminoon:27
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:27 - فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna So We inspired to him That construct the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration then when comes Our Command and gushes forth the oven then put into it of every (kind) (of) mates two and your family except those (has) preceded against whom the Word thereof And (do) not address Me concerning those who wronged indeed, they (are) the ones to be drowned
  • [1] Or 'bring into it, of every kind [of animal], two mates.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:28
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:28 - فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
fa-idhā is'tawayta anta waman maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna
And when you (have) boarded you and whoever (is) with you on the ship then say Praise (be) to Allah Who (has) saved us from the people the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:29
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:29 - وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ
waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalan mubārakan wa-anta khayru l-munzilīna
And say My Lord cause me to land (at) a landing place blessed and You (are) the Best (of) those who cause to land.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:30
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:30 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyātin wa-in kunnā lamub'talīna
Indeed in that surely (are) Signs and indeed We are surely testing

item.title: Al-Muminoon:31
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:31 - ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna
Then We produced after them after them a generation another

item.title: Al-Muminoon:32
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:32 - فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna
And We sent among them a Messenger from themselves that Worship Allah not for you (is) any god other than Him Then will not you fear

item.title: Al-Muminoon:33
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:33 - وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūna
And said the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied (the) meeting (of) the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the life (of) the world Not (is) this but a man like you He eats of what you eat from it and he drinks of what you drink

item.title: Al-Muminoon:34
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:34 - وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ
wala-in aṭaʿtum basharan mith'lakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūna
And surely if you obey a man like you indeed, you then surely (will be) losers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:35
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:35 - أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ
ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūna
Does he promise you that you when you are dead and you become dust and bones that you (will be) brought forth

item.title: Al-Muminoon:36
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:36 - هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūna
Far-(fetched) far-(fetched) is what you are promised

item.title: Al-Muminoon:37
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:37 - إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna
Not it (is) but our life (of) the world we die and we live and not we (will be) resurrected

item.title: Al-Muminoon:38
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:38 - إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
in huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīna
Not (is) he but a man who (has) invented about Allah a lie and not we (in) him (are) believers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:39
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:39 - قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni
He said My Lord Help me because they deny me

item.title: Al-Muminoon:40
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:40 - قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ
qāla ʿammā qalīlin layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīna
He said After a little while After a little while surely they will become regretful

item.title: Al-Muminoon:41
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:41 - فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً فَبُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna
So seized them the awful cry in truth and We made them (as) rubbish of dead leaves So away with the people the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:42
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:42 - ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīna
Then We produced after them after them a generation another

item.title: Al-Muminoon:43
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:43 - مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَءْخِرُونَ
mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna
Not can precede any nation its term and not they (can) delay (it)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:44
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:44 - ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِقَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatan rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūna
Then We sent Our Messengers (in) succession Every time Every time came (to) a nation its Messenger they denied him so We made (them) follow some of them others and We made them narrations So away with a people not they believe

item.title: Al-Muminoon:45
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:45 - ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin
Then We sent Musa and his brother Harun with Our Signs and an authority clear

item.title: Al-Muminoon:46
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:46 - إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīna
To Firaun and his chiefs but they behaved arrogantly and they were a people haughty

item.title: Al-Muminoon:47
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:47 - فَقَالُوْۤا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ
faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūna
Then they said Shall we believe (in) two men like ourselves while their people for us (are) slaves

item.title: Al-Muminoon:48
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:48 - فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ
fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīna
So they denied them and they became of those who were destroyed

item.title: Al-Muminoon:49
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:49 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūna
And verily We gave Musa the Scripture so that they may be guided

item.title: Al-Muminoon:50
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:50 - وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ اٰیَةً وَءَاوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyatan waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīnin
And We made (the) son (of) Maryam and his mother a Sign and We sheltered them to a high ground of tranquility of tranquility and water springs

item.title: Al-Muminoon:51
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:51 - يَاأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْۤا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِیْمٌ
yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun
O Messengers O Messengers Eat of the good things and do righteous (deeds) Indeed, I Am of what you do All-Knower

item.title: Al-Muminoon:52
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:52 - وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ
wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūni
And indeed this your religion (is) religion one And I Am your Lord so fear Me

item.title: Al-Muminoon:53
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:53 - فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna
But they cut off their affair (of unity) between them (into) sects each faction in what they have rejoicing

item.title: Al-Muminoon:54
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:54 - فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ
fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīnin
So leave them in their confusion until a time

item.title: Al-Muminoon:55
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:55 - أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabanīna
Do they think that what We extend to them with it of wealth and children

item.title: Al-Muminoon:56
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:56 - نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūna
We hasten to them in the good Nay not they perceive

item.title: Al-Muminoon:57
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:57 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ
inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūna
Indeed those who they from (the) fear (of) their Lord (are) cautious

item.title: Al-Muminoon:58
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:58 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūna
And those they in (the) Signs (of) their Lord believe

item.title: Al-Muminoon:59
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:59 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūna
And those they with their Lord (do) not associate partners

item.title: Al-Muminoon:60
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:60 - وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا ءَاتَوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ
wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūna
And those who give what they give while their hearts (are) fearful because they to their Lord (will) return

item.title: Al-Muminoon:61
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:61 - اُولٰٓئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūna
(It is) those who hasten in the good (deeds) and they in them (are) foremost

item.title: Al-Muminoon:62
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:62 - وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna
And not We burden any soul except (to) its capacity and with Us (is) a Record (which) speaks with the truth and they (will) not be wronged

item.title: Al-Muminoon:63
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:63 - بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ
bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum aʿmālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūna
Nay their hearts (are) in confusion over this and for them (are) deeds besides besides that they for it (are) doers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:64
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:64 - حَتّٰی إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْءَرُونَ
ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūna
Until when We seize their affluent ones with the punishment behold They cry for help

item.title: Al-Muminoon:65
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:65 - لَا تَجْءَرُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُونَ
lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūna
(Do) not cry for help today Indeed, you from Us not will be helped

item.title: Al-Muminoon:66
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:66 - قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُونَ
qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūna
Verily were My Verses recited to you but you used (to) on your heels turn back

item.title: Al-Muminoon:67
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:67 - مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūna (Being) arrogant about it conversing by night speaking evil
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān. Or, 'him,' that is of the Prophet.

item.title: Al-Muminoon:68
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:68 - أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīna Then, do not they ponder the Word or has come to them what not (had) come (to) their forefathers (to) their forefathers
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān. Cf. (Q 4:82), (Q 47:24).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:69
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:69 - أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوْۤا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūna Or (do) not they recognize their Messenger so they (are) rejecting him (are) rejecting him
  • [1] That is, 'Is the Apostle a stranger of an unknown background and a person unknown to them?'
  • [2] Or 'and so they are not at home with him.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:70
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:70 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna
Or they say In him (is) madness Nay he brought them the truth but most of them to the truth (are) averse

item.title: Al-Muminoon:71
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:71 - وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ
walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūna
But if (had) followed the truth their desires surely (would) have been corrupted the heavens and the earth and whoever (is) therein Nay We have brought them their reminder but they from their reminder (are) turning away

item.title: Al-Muminoon:72
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:72 - أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna
Or you ask them (for) a payment But the payment (of) your Lord (is) best and He (is) the Best (of) the Providers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:73
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:73 - وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
And indeed, you certainly call them to (the) Path Straight

item.title: Al-Muminoon:74
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:74 - وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ
wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani l-ṣirāṭi lanākibūna
And indeed those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter from the path surely (are) deviating

item.title: Al-Muminoon:75
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:75 - وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ لَلَجُّوْۤا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna
And if We had mercy on them and We removed what (was) on them of (the) hardship surely they would persist in their transgression wandering blindly

item.title: Al-Muminoon:76
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:76 - وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūna
And verily We seized them with the punishment but not they submit to their Lord and not they supplicate humbly

item.title: Al-Muminoon:77
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:77 - حَتّٰی إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūna
Until when We opened for them a gate of a punishment of a punishment severe behold They in it (will be in) despair

item.title: Al-Muminoon:78
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:78 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ
wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna
And He (is) the One Who produced for you the hearing and the sight and the feeling little (is) what you give thanks

item.title: Al-Muminoon:79
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:79 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna
And He (is) the One Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be gathered

item.title: Al-Muminoon:80
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:80 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūna
And He (is) the One Who gives life and causes death and for Him (is the) alternation (of) the night and the day Then will not you reason

item.title: Al-Muminoon:81
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:81 - بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ
bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūna
Nay they say (the) like (of) what said the former (people)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:82
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:82 - قَالُوْا أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna
They said What! When we are dead and become dust and bones would we surely be resurrected

item.title: Al-Muminoon:83
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:83 - لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا هَذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna
Verily we have been promised we and our forefathers this before before not (is) this but (the) tales (of) the former (people)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:84
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:84 - قُلْ لِمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūna
Say To whom (belongs) the earth and whoever (is) in it if you know

item.title: Al-Muminoon:85
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:85 - سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūna
They will say To Allah Say Then will not you remember

item.title: Al-Muminoon:86
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:86 - قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
qul man rabbu l-samāwāti l-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi
Say Who (is the) Lord (of) the seven heavens (of) the seven heavens and (the) Lord (of) the Throne the Great

item.title: Al-Muminoon:87
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:87 - سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tattaqūna
They will say Allah Say Then will not you fear (Him)

item.title: Al-Muminoon:88
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:88 - قُلْ مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūna
Say Who is (it) in Whose Hand(s) (is the) dominion (of) all things and He protects and no (one) (can) be protected against Him If you know

item.title: Al-Muminoon:89
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:89 - سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّى تُسْحَرُونَ sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūna They will say Allah Say Then how are you deluded
  • [1] Or 'How are you being misled,' or 'How are you being rendered blind.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:90
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:90 - بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūna
Nay We (have) brought them the truth but indeed, they surely, (are) liars

item.title: Al-Muminoon:91
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:91 - مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
mā ittakhadha l-lahu min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna
Not Allah has taken Allah has taken any son and not is with Him any god Then surely (would have) taken away each god what he created and surely would have overpowered some of them on others Glory be (to) Allah above what they attribute

item.title: Al-Muminoon:92
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:92 - عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna
Knower (of) the unseen and the witnessed exalted is He above what they associate

item.title: Al-Muminoon:93
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:93 - قُلْ رَبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ
qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūna
Say My Lord If You should show me what they are promised

item.title: Al-Muminoon:94
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:94 - رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna
My Lord then (do) not place me among the people the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:95
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:95 - وَإِنَّا عَلَى أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ
wa-innā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūna
And indeed We on that We show you what We have promised them surely able

item.title: Al-Muminoon:96
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:96 - اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu l-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūna
Repel by that which (is) best the evil We know best of what they attribute

item.title: Al-Muminoon:97
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:97 - وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti l-shayāṭīni
And say My Lord I seek refuge in You from (the) suggestions (of) the evil ones

item.title: Al-Muminoon:98
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:98 - وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūni
And I seek refuge in You My Lord Lest they be present with me

item.title: Al-Muminoon:99
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:99 - حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ
ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūni
Until when comes (to) one of them the death he says My Lord Send me back

item.title: Al-Muminoon:100
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:100 - لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamin warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna
That I may do righteous (deeds) in what I left behind No Indeed, it (is) a word he speaks it and before them and before them (is) a barrier till (the) Day they are resurrected

item.title: Al-Muminoon:101
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:101 - فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhin walā yatasāalūna So when is blown in the trumpet then not (there) will be relationship among them that Day and not will they ask each other
  • [1] Cf. (Q 70:10).

item.title: Al-Muminoon:102
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:102 - فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna
Then (the one) whose (are) heavy his scales then those they (are) the successful

item.title: Al-Muminoon:103
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:103 - وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ
waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūna
But (the one) whose (are) light his scales then those they [who] have lost their souls in Hell they (will) abide forever

item.title: Al-Muminoon:104
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:104 - تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ
talfaḥu wujūhahumu l-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūna
Will burn their faces the Fire and they in it (will) grin with displaced lips

item.title: Al-Muminoon:105
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:105 - أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūna
Were not Were not My Verses recited to you and you used (to) deny them deny them

item.title: Al-Muminoon:106
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:106 - قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ
qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīna
They (will) say Our Lord Overcame [on] us our wretchedness and we were a people astray

item.title: Al-Muminoon:107
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:107 - رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ
rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūna
Our Lord Bring us out from it then if we return then indeed, we (would be) wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:108
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:108 - قَالَ اخْسَئُوْۤا فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūni
He (will) say Remain despised in it and (do) not speak to Me

item.title: Al-Muminoon:109
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:109 - إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
innahu kāna farīqun min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna
Indeed (there) was a party of My slaves (who) said Our Lord We believe so forgive us and have mercy on us and You (are) best (of) those who show mercy

item.title: Al-Muminoon:110
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:110 - فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتّٰی أَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūna But you took them (in) mockery until they made you forget My remembrance and you used (to) at them laugh
  • [1] That is, 'your contemptuous attitude towards them made you oblivious of Me and My reminders and warnings.'

item.title: Al-Muminoon:111
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:111 - اِنِّیْ جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ
innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūna
Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day because they were patient indeed, they they (are) the successful ones

item.title: Al-Muminoon:112
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:112 - قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīna
He will say How long did you remain in the earth (in) number (of) years

item.title: Al-Muminoon:113
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:113 - قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْءَلِ الْعَادِّينَ
qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīna
They will say We remained a day or a part (of) a day but ask those who keep count

item.title: Al-Muminoon:114
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:114 - قَالَ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
qāla in labith'tum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum taʿlamūna
He will say Not you stayed but a little if only you you knew

item.title: Al-Muminoon:115
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:115 - أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūna
Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that you to Us not will be returned

item.title: Al-Muminoon:116
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:116 - فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīmi
So exalted is Allah the King the Truth (There is) no god except Him (the) Lord (of) the Throne Honorable

item.title: Al-Muminoon:117
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:117 - وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ
waman yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūna
And whoever invokes with Allah god other no proof for him in it Then only his account (is) with his Lord Indeed, [he] not will succeed the disbelievers

item.title: Al-Muminoon:118
item.description:
Al-Muminoon:118 - وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna
And say My Lord Forgive and have mercy and You (are the) Best (of) those who show mercy

item.title: 24. النور (An-Noor)
item.description:
The surah that contains the inimitable verse that celebrates God as The Light of the heavens and earth, guiding to Himself whomever He so wills. It is named after the "Light Verse" which occurs at verse 35, where God's light is contrasted to the darkness in which the disbelievers find themselves engulfed. The surah clarifies several regulations for the Muslim community, mainly to do with marriage, modesty, obedience to the Prophet, and appropriate behaviour in the household.

24:1
سُورَةٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهَا وَفَرَضْنَاهَا وَأَنْزَلْنَا فِيهَا ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
sūratun anzalnāhā wafaraḍnāhā wa-anzalnā fīhā āyātin bayyinātin laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
A Surah We (have) sent it down and We (have) made it obligatory and We (have) revealed therein Verses clear so that you may take heed

24:2
اَلزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُمْ بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
al-zāniyatu wal-zānī fa-ij'lidū kulla wāḥidin min'humā mi-ata jaldatin walā takhudh'kum bihimā rafatun fī dīni l-lahi in kuntum tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri walyashhad ʿadhābahumā ṭāifatun mina l-mu'minīna
The fornicatress and the fornicator [then] flog each one of them (with) hundred lash(es) And (let) not withhold you pity for them pity for them concerning (the) religion of Allah (the) religion of Allah if you believe in Allah and the Day the Last And let witness their punishment a group of the believers

24:3
اَلزَّانِي لَا يَنْكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنْكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
al-zānī lā yankiḥu illā zāniyatan aw mush'rikatan wal-zāniyatu lā yankiḥuhā illā zānin aw mush'rikun waḥurrima dhālika ʿalā l-mu'minīna
The fornicator (will) not marry except a fornicatress or a polytheist woman and the fornicatress (will) not marry her except a fornicator or a polytheist man And is forbidden that to the believers

item.title: An-Noor:1
item.description:
An-Noor:1 - سُورَةٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهَا وَفَرَضْنَاهَا وَأَنْزَلْنَا فِيهَا ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
sūratun anzalnāhā wafaraḍnāhā wa-anzalnā fīhā āyātin bayyinātin laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
A Surah We (have) sent it down and We (have) made it obligatory and We (have) revealed therein Verses clear so that you may take heed

item.title: An-Noor:2
item.description:
An-Noor:2 - اَلزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُمْ بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
al-zāniyatu wal-zānī fa-ij'lidū kulla wāḥidin min'humā mi-ata jaldatin walā takhudh'kum bihimā rafatun fī dīni l-lahi in kuntum tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri walyashhad ʿadhābahumā ṭāifatun mina l-mu'minīna
The fornicatress and the fornicator [then] flog each one of them (with) hundred lash(es) And (let) not withhold you pity for them pity for them concerning (the) religion of Allah (the) religion of Allah if you believe in Allah and the Day the Last And let witness their punishment a group of the believers

item.title: An-Noor:3
item.description:
An-Noor:3 - اَلزَّانِي لَا يَنْكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنْكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
al-zānī lā yankiḥu illā zāniyatan aw mush'rikatan wal-zāniyatu lā yankiḥuhā illā zānin aw mush'rikun waḥurrima dhālika ʿalā l-mu'minīna
The fornicator (will) not marry except a fornicatress or a polytheist woman and the fornicatress (will) not marry her except a fornicator or a polytheist man And is forbidden that to the believers

item.title: An-Noor:4
item.description:
An-Noor:4 - وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوْۤا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوْۤا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
wa-alladhīna yarmūna l-muḥ'ṣanāti thumma lam yatū bi-arbaʿati shuhadāa fa-ij'lidūhum thamānīna jaldatan walā taqbalū lahum shahādatan abadan wa-ulāika humu l-fāsiqūna
And those who accuse the chaste women then not they bring four witnesses then flog them (with) eighty lashe(s) and (do) not accept their testimony ever And those they (are) the defiantly disobedient

item.title: An-Noor:5
item.description:
An-Noor:5 - إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
illā alladhīna tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun
Except those who repent after after that and reform Then indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: An-Noor:6
item.description:
An-Noor:6 - وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
wa-alladhīna yarmūna azwājahum walam yakun lahum shuhadāu illā anfusuhum fashahādatu aḥadihim arbaʿu shahādātin bil-lahi innahu lamina l-ṣādiqīna
And those who accuse their spouses and not have for them witnesses except themselves then (the) testimony (of) one of them (is) four testimonies by Allah that he (is) surely of the truthful

item.title: An-Noor:7
item.description:
An-Noor:7 - وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
wal-khāmisatu anna laʿnata l-lahi ʿalayhi in kāna mina l-kādhibīna
And the fifth that (the) curse of Allah (the) curse of Allah (be) upon him if he is of the liars

item.title: An-Noor:8
item.description:
An-Noor:8 - وَيَدْرَؤُا عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
wayadra-u ʿanhā l-ʿadhāba an tashhada arbaʿa shahādātin bil-lahi innahu lamina l-kādhibīna
But it would prevent from her the punishment that she bears witness four testimonies by Allah that he (is) surely of the liars

item.title: An-Noor:9
item.description:
An-Noor:9 - وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
wal-khāmisata anna ghaḍaba l-lahi ʿalayhā in kāna mina l-ṣādiqīna
And the fifth that the wrath of Allah the wrath of Allah (be) upon her if he is of the truthful

item.title: An-Noor:10
item.description:
An-Noor:10 - وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠ walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna l-laha tawwābun ḥakīmun And if not (for) the Grace of Allah (for) the Grace of Allah upon you and His Mercy and that Allah (is) Oft-Returning (to Mercy) All-Wise
  • [1] Ellipsis. For the omitted part of the sentence see verses (Q 24:14) & (Q 24:21) below.

item.title: An-Noor:11
item.description:
An-Noor:11 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُو بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِنْكُمْ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَكُمْ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ مَا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
inna alladhīna jāū bil-if'ki ʿuṣ'batun minkum lā taḥsabūhu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli im'ri-in min'hum mā ik'tasaba mina l-ith'mi wa-alladhī tawallā kib'rahu min'hum lahu ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
Indeed those who brought the lie (are) a group among you (Do) not think it bad for you nay it (is) good for you For every person among them (is) what he earned of the sin and the one who took upon himself a greater share of it took upon himself a greater share of it among them for him (is) a punishment great

item.title: An-Noor:12
item.description:
An-Noor:12 - لَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوْۤا هَذَا إِفْكٌ مُبِينٌ
lawlā idh samiʿ'tumūhu ẓanna l-mu'minūna wal-mu'minātu bi-anfusihim khayran waqālū hādhā if'kun mubīnun
Why not when you heard it think the believing men and the believing women good of themselves good of themselves and say This (is) a lie clear

item.title: An-Noor:13
item.description:
An-Noor:13 - لَوْلَا جَاءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوْۤا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَئِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ lawlā jāū ʿalayhi bi-arbaʿati shuhadāa fa-idh lam yatū bil-shuhadāi fa-ulāika ʿinda l-lahi humu l-kādhibūna Why (did) not they bring for it four witnesses Then when not they brought the witnesses then those near Allah near Allah they (are) the liars
  • [1] That is, those who had spread the slander accusing the Prophet's wife and one of the Companions.

item.title: An-Noor:14
item.description:
An-Noor:14 - وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِیْهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati lamassakum fī mā afaḍtum fīhi ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
And if not (for the) Grace (of) Allah upon you and His Mercy in the world and the Hereafter surely would have touched you in what you had rushed glibly concerning it a punishment great

item.title: An-Noor:15
item.description:
An-Noor:15 - إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ مَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
idh talaqqawnahu bi-alsinatikum wataqūlūna bi-afwāhikum mā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wataḥsabūnahu hayyinan wahuwa ʿinda l-lahi ʿaẓīmun
When you received it with your tongues and you said with your mouths what not for you of it any knowledge and you thought it (was) insignificant while it (was) near Allah (was) near Allah great

item.title: An-Noor:16
item.description:
An-Noor:16 - وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ
walawlā idh samiʿ'tumūhu qul'tum mā yakūnu lanā an natakallama bihādhā sub'ḥānaka hādhā buh'tānun ʿaẓīmun
And why not when you heard it you said Not it is for us that we speak of this Glory be to You This (is) a slander great

item.title: An-Noor:17
item.description:
An-Noor:17 - يَعِظُكُمَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعُودُوْۤا لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَدًا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
yaʿiẓukumu l-lahu an taʿūdū limith'lihi abadan in kuntum mu'minīna
Allah warns you Allah warns you that you return (to the) like of it ever if you are believers

item.title: An-Noor:18
item.description:
An-Noor:18 - وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠
wayubayyinu l-lahu lakumu l-āyāti wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
And Allah makes clear And Allah makes clear to you the Verses And Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: An-Noor:19
item.description:
An-Noor:19 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
inna alladhīna yuḥibbūna an tashīʿa l-fāḥishatu fī alladhīna āmanū lahum ʿadhābun alīmun fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna
Indeed those who like that (should) spread the immorality among those who believe for them (is) a punishment painful in the world and the Hereafter And Allah knows while you (do) not know

item.title: An-Noor:20
item.description:
An-Noor:20 - وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna l-laha raūfun raḥīmun
And if not (for the) Grace of Allah (for the) Grace of Allah upon you and His Mercy And that Allah (is) Full of Kindness Most Merciful

item.title: An-Noor:21
item.description:
An-Noor:21 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمَنْ يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَى مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُزَكِّي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattabiʿū khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni waman yattabiʿ khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni fa-innahu yamuru bil-faḥshāi wal-munkari walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu mā zakā minkum min aḥadin abadan walākinna l-laha yuzakkī man yashāu wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmun
O you those who(believe) believe (Do) not follow (the) footsteps (of) the Shaitaan and whoever follows (the) footsteps (of) the Shaitaan then indeed, he commands the immorality and the evil And if not (for the) Grace of Allah (for the) Grace of Allah upon you and His Mercy not (would) have been pure among you anyone anyone ever but Allah purifies whom He wills And Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Knower

item.title: An-Noor:22
item.description:
An-Noor:22 - وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُولُوْۤا الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَنْ يُؤْتُوْۤا أُولِي الْقُرْبٰی وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلْيَعْفُوا وَلْيَصْفَحُوا أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ walā yatali ulū l-faḍli minkum wal-saʿati an yu'tū ulī l-qur'bā wal-masākīna wal-muhājirīna fī sabīli l-lahi walyaʿfū walyaṣfaḥū alā tuḥibbūna an yaghfira l-lahu lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun And not let swear those of virtue those of virtue among you and the amplitude of means that they give (to) the near of kin (to) the near of kin and the needy and the emigrants in (the) way (of) Allah And let them pardon and let them overlook (Do) not you like that Allah should forgive Allah should forgive you And Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
  • [1] Or 'Let the well-to-do and the opulent among you not fail to give ….'

item.title: An-Noor:23
item.description:
An-Noor:23 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ لُعِنُوْۤا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
inna alladhīna yarmūna l-muḥ'ṣanāti l-ghāfilāti l-mu'mināti luʿinū fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
Indeed those who accuse the chaste women the unaware women (and) the believing women are cursed in the world and the Hereafter And for them (is) a punishment great

item.title: An-Noor:24
item.description:
An-Noor:24 - يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
yawma tashhadu ʿalayhim alsinatuhum wa-aydīhim wa-arjuluhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūna
(On a) Day will bear witness against them their tongues and their hands and their feet for what they used (to) do

item.title: An-Noor:25
item.description:
An-Noor:25 - يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ
yawma-idhin yuwaffīhimu l-lahu dīnahumu l-ḥaqa wayaʿlamūna anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu l-mubīnu
That Day Allah will pay them in full Allah will pay them in full their recompense the due and they will know that Allah He (is) the Truth the Manifest

item.title: An-Noor:26
item.description:
An-Noor:26 - اَلْخَبِيثَاتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَاتِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ al-khabīthātu lil'khabīthīna wal-khabīthūna lil'khabīthāti wal-ṭayibātu lilṭṭayyibīna wal-ṭayibūna lilṭṭayyibāti ulāika mubarraūna mimmā yaqūlūna lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun Evil women (are) for evil men and evil men (are) for evil women And good women (are) for good men and good men (are) for good women Those (are) innocent of what they say For them (is) forgiveness and a provision noble
  • [1] Or, 'Vicious words (or deeds) come from vicious persons, and vicious persons are worthy of vicious words (or deeds). Good words (or deeds) come from good people, and good people are worthy of good words (or deeds).' According to this interpretation, this verse is similar in meaning to (Q 17:84). This interpretation is also supported by the last part of the verse: 'They are absolved of what they say [about them].' However in accordance with the translation given above, the meaning of the verse will be similar to verse (Q 24:3), at the beginning of this sūrah.
  • [2] That is, persons of good repute among the faithful stand legally absolved of any kind of allegations against them unless there is valid evidence to the contrary.

item.title: An-Noor:27
item.description:
An-Noor:27 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَدْخُلُوْۤا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتّٰی تَسْتَأْنِسُوا وَتُسَلِّمُوا عَلَى أَهْلِهَا ذَلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tadkhulū buyūtan ghayra buyūtikum ḥattā tastanisū watusallimū ʿalā ahlihā dhālikum khayrun lakum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
O you those who(believe) believe (Do) not enter houses other (than) your houses until you have asked permission and you have greeted on its inhabitants That (is) best for you so that you may pay heed

item.title: An-Noor:28
item.description:
An-Noor:28 - فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا فِيهَا أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتّٰی يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ قِيلَ لَكُمُ ارْجِعُوْۤا فَارْجِعُوا هُوَ أَزْكَى لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِیْمٌ
fa-in lam tajidū fīhā aḥadan falā tadkhulūhā ḥattā yu'dhana lakum wa-in qīla lakumu ir'jiʿū fa-ir'jiʿū huwa azkā lakum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun
But if not you find in it anyone then (do) not enter it until permission has been given to you And if it is said to you Go back then go back it (is) purer for you And Allah of what you do (is) All-Knower

item.title: An-Noor:29
item.description:
An-Noor:29 - لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوْۤا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَاعٌ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
laysa ʿalaykum junāḥun an tadkhulū buyūtan ghayra maskūnatin fīhā matāʿun lakum wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tub'dūna wamā taktumūna
Not upon you (is) any blame that you enter houses not inhabited in it (is) a provision for you And Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal

item.title: An-Noor:30
item.description:
An-Noor:30 - قُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوْۤا مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا فُرُوجَهُمْ ذٰلِكَ أَزْكَى لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
qul lil'mu'minīna yaghuḍḍū min abṣārihim wayaḥfaẓū furūjahum dhālika azkā lahum inna l-laha khabīrun bimā yaṣnaʿūna
Say to the believing men they should lower their gaze their gaze and they should guard their chastity That (is) purer for them Indeed Allah (is) All-Aware of what they do

item.title: An-Noor:31
item.description:
An-Noor:31 - وَقُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَى جُيُوبِهِنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَائِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَائِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَائِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوْۤا عَلَى عَوْرَاتِ النِّسَاءِ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِنْ زِينَتِهِنَّ وَتُوبُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ waqul lil'mu'mināti yaghḍuḍ'na min abṣārihinna wayaḥfaẓna furūjahunna walā yub'dīna zīnatahunna illā mā ẓahara min'hā walyaḍrib'na bikhumurihinna ʿalā juyūbihinna walā yub'dīna zīnatahunna illā libuʿūlatihinna aw ābāihinna aw ābāi buʿūlatihinna aw abnāihinna aw abnāi buʿūlatihinna aw ikh'wānihinna aw banī ikh'wānihinna aw banī akhawātihinna aw nisāihinna aw mā malakat aymānuhunna awi l-tābiʿīna ghayri ulī l-ir'bati mina l-rijāli awi l-ṭif'li alladhīna lam yaẓharū ʿalā ʿawrāti l-nisāi walā yaḍrib'na bi-arjulihinna liyuʿ'lama mā yukh'fīna min zīnatihinna watūbū ilā l-lahi jamīʿan ayyuha l-mu'minūna laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna And say to the believing women (that) they should lower of their gaze and they should guard their chastity and not (to) display their adornment except what is apparent of it And let them draw their head covers over their bosoms and not (to) display their adornment except to their husbands or their fathers or fathers (of) their husbands or their sons or sons (of) their husbands or their brothers or sons (of) their brothers or sons (of) their sisters or their women or what possess their right hands or the attendants having no physical desire having no physical desire having no physical desire among [the] men or [the] children who (are) not aware of private aspects (of) the women And not let them stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment And turn to Allah altogether O believers O believers So that you may succeed
  • [1] That is, Muslim women. Hence it is not lawful for Muslim women to expose their charms before non-Muslim women, who may possibly describe what they see to their men.
  • [2] That is, boys who have not reached the age of virility.

item.title: An-Noor:32
item.description:
An-Noor:32 - وَأَنْكِحُوا الْأَيَامَى مِنْكُمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ إِنْ يَكُونُوْۤا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِیْمٌ wa-ankiḥū l-ayāmā minkum wal-ṣāliḥīna min ʿibādikum wa-imāikum in yakūnū fuqarāa yugh'nihimu l-lahu min faḍlihi wal-lahu wāsiʿun ʿalīmun And marry the single among you and the righteous among your male slaves and your female slaves If they are poor Allah will enrich them Allah will enrich them from His Bounty And Allah (is) All-Encompassing All-Knowing
  • [1] That is, those who are faithful, or honest and chaste.

item.title: An-Noor:33
item.description:
An-Noor:33 - وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتّٰی يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَالَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا وَءَاتُوهُمْ مِنْ مَالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي ءَاتَاكُمْ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوْۤا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِتَبْتَغُوا عَرَضَ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَنْ يُكْرِهُّنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِكْرَاهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
walyastaʿfifi alladhīna lā yajidūna nikāḥan ḥattā yugh'niyahumu l-lahu min faḍlihi wa-alladhīna yabtaghūna l-kitāba mimmā malakat aymānukum fakātibūhum in ʿalim'tum fīhim khayran waātūhum min māli l-lahi alladhī ātākum walā tuk'rihū fatayātikum ʿalā l-bighāi in aradna taḥaṣṣunan litabtaghū ʿaraḍa l-ḥayati l-dun'yā waman yuk'rihhunna fa-inna l-laha min baʿdi ik'rāhihinna ghafūrun raḥīmun
And let be chaste those who (do) not find (means for) marriage until Allah enriches them Allah enriches them from His Bounty And those who seek the writing from (those) whom possess your right hands then give them (the) writing if you know in them any good and give them from the wealth of Allah the wealth of Allah which He has given you And (do) not compel your slave girls to [the] prostitution if they desire chastity that you may seek temporary gain (of) the life (of) the world And whoever compels them then indeed Allah after after their compulsion (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: An-Noor:34
item.description:
An-Noor:34 - وَلَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ ءَايَاتٍ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
walaqad anzalnā ilaykum āyātin mubayyinātin wamathalan mina alladhīna khalaw min qablikum wamawʿiẓatan lil'muttaqīna
And verily We have sent down to you Verses clear and an example of those who passed away before you before you and an admonition for those who fear (Allah)

item.title: An-Noor:35
item.description:
An-Noor:35 - اَللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ نُورٌ عَلَى نُورٍ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
al-lahu nūru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi mathalu nūrihi kamish'katin fīhā miṣ'bāḥun l-miṣ'bāḥu fī zujājatin l-zujājatu ka-annahā kawkabun durriyyun yūqadu min shajaratin mubārakatin zaytūnatin lā sharqiyyatin walā gharbiyyatin yakādu zaytuhā yuḍīu walaw lam tamsashu nārun nūrun ʿalā nūrin yahdī l-lahu linūrihi man yashāu wayaḍribu l-lahu l-amthāla lilnnāsi wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
Allah (is the) Light (of) the heavens and the earth (The) example (of) His Light (is) like a niche in it (is) a lamp the lamp (is) in a glass the glass as if it were a star brilliant (which) is lit from a tree blessed an olive not (of the) east and not (of the) west would almost its oil glow even if not touched it fire Light upon Light Allah guides Allah guides to His Light whom He wills And Allah sets forth And Allah sets forth the examples for the mankind And Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower

item.title: An-Noor:36
item.description:
An-Noor:36 - فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْءَاصَالِ
fī buyūtin adhina l-lahu an tur'faʿa wayudh'kara fīhā us'muhu yusabbiḥu lahu fīhā bil-ghuduwi wal-āṣāli
In houses (which) Allah ordered (which) Allah ordered that they be raised and be mentioned in them His name Glorify [to] Him in them in the mornings and (in) the evenings

item.title: An-Noor:37
item.description:
An-Noor:37 - رِجَالٌ لَا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَوةِ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِیْهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ
rijālun lā tul'hīhim tijāratun walā bayʿun ʿan dhik'ri l-lahi wa-iqāmi l-ṣalati waītāi l-zakati yakhāfūna yawman tataqallabu fīhi l-qulūbu wal-abṣāru
Men not distracts them trade and not sale from (the) remembrance of Allah (the) remembrance of Allah and (from) establishing the prayer and giving zakah They fear a Day will turn about therein the hearts and the eyes

item.title: An-Noor:38
item.description:
An-Noor:38 - لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
liyajziyahumu l-lahu aḥsana mā ʿamilū wayazīdahum min faḍlihi wal-lahu yarzuqu man yashāu bighayri ḥisābin
That Allah may reward them That Allah may reward them (with the) best (of) what they did and increase them from His Bounty And Allah provides whom He wills without measure

item.title: An-Noor:39
item.description:
An-Noor:39 - وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْءَانُ مَاءً حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئًا وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ عِنْدَهُ فَوَفَّاهُ حِسَابَهُ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
wa-alladhīna kafarū aʿmāluhum kasarābin biqīʿatin yaḥsabuhu l-ẓamānu māan ḥattā idhā jāahu lam yajid'hu shayan wawajada l-laha ʿindahu fawaffāhu ḥisābahu wal-lahu sarīʿu l-ḥisābi
But those who disbelieve their deeds (are) like a mirage in a lowland thinks it the thirsty one (to be) water until when he comes to it not he finds it (to be) anything but he finds Allah before him He will pay him in full his due And Allah (is) swift (in) the account

item.title: An-Noor:40
item.description:
An-Noor:40 - أَوْ كَظُلُمَاتٍ فِي بَحْرٍ لُجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَا أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَاهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ نُورٍ
aw kaẓulumātin fī baḥrin lujjiyyin yaghshāhu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi saḥābun ẓulumātun baʿḍuhā fawqa baʿḍin idhā akhraja yadahu lam yakad yarāhā waman lam yajʿali l-lahu lahu nūran famā lahu min nūrin
Or (is) like (the) darkness[es] in a sea deep covers it a wave on it on it a wave on it on it a cloud darkness[es] some of it on others When he puts out his hand hardly hardly he (can) see it And (for) whom not Allah (has) made Allah (has) made for him a light then not for him (is) any light

item.title: An-Noor:41
item.description:
An-Noor:41 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صَافَّاتٍ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
alam tara anna l-laha yusabbiḥu lahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-ṭayru ṣāffātin kullun qad ʿalima ṣalātahu watasbīḥahu wal-lahu ʿalīmun bimā yafʿalūna
Do not you see that Allah glorify Him whoever (is) in the heavens and the earth and the birds (with) wings outspread Each one verily knows its prayer and its glorification And Allah (is) All-Knower of what they do

item.title: An-Noor:42
item.description:
An-Noor:42 - وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ
walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīru
And to Allah (belongs) (the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth And to Allah (is) the destination

item.title: An-Noor:43
item.description:
An-Noor:43 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا فَتَرٰی الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِنْ بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَنْ مَنْ يَشَاءُ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصَارِ alam tara anna l-laha yuz'jī saḥāban thumma yu-allifu baynahu thumma yajʿaluhu rukāman fatarā l-wadqa yakhruju min khilālihi wayunazzilu mina l-samāi min jibālin fīhā min baradin fayuṣību bihi man yashāu wayaṣrifuhu ʿan man yashāu yakādu sanā barqihi yadhhabu bil-abṣāri Do not you see that Allah drives clouds then joins between them then makes them (into) a mass then you see the rain come forth from their midst And He sends down from (the) sky from mountains within it of (is) hail and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills Nearly (the) flash (of) its lighting takes away the sight
  • [1] A metaphorical reference to the clouds.

item.title: An-Noor:44
item.description:
An-Noor:44 - يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
yuqallibu l-lahu al-layla wal-nahāra inna fī dhālika laʿib'ratan li-ulī l-abṣāri
Allah alternates Allah alternates the night and the day Indeed in that surely is a lesson for those who have vision for those who have vision

item.title: An-Noor:45
item.description:
An-Noor:45 - وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ يَخْلُقُ اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
wal-lahu khalaqa kulla dābbatin min māin famin'hum man yamshī ʿalā baṭnihi wamin'hum man yamshī ʿalā rij'layni wamin'hum man yamshī ʿalā arbaʿin yakhluqu l-lahu mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
And Allah created every moving creature from water Of them (is a kind) who walks on its belly and of them (is a kind) who walks on two legs and of them (is a kind) who walks on four Allah creates Allah creates what He wills Indeed Allah on every thing (is) All-Powerful

item.title: An-Noor:46
item.description:
An-Noor:46 - لَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا ءَايَاتٍ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
laqad anzalnā āyātin mubayyinātin wal-lahu yahdī man yashāu ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
Verily We have sent down Verses clear And Allah guides whom He wills to a path straight

item.title: An-Noor:47
item.description:
An-Noor:47 - وَيَقُولُونَ اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّى فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَمَا اُولٰٓئِكَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wayaqūlūna āmannā bil-lahi wabil-rasūli wa-aṭaʿnā thumma yatawallā farīqun min'hum min baʿdi dhālika wamā ulāika bil-mu'minīna
And they say We believe in Allah and in the Messenger and we obey Then turns away a party of them after after that And not those (are) believers

item.title: An-Noor:48
item.description:
An-Noor:48 - وَإِذَا دُعُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ
wa-idhā duʿū ilā l-lahi warasūlihi liyaḥkuma baynahum idhā farīqun min'hum muʿ'riḍūna
