And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them behold a party of them (is) averse

item.title: An-Noor:49
item.description:
An-Noor:49 - وَإِنْ يَكُنْ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
wa-in yakun lahumu l-ḥaqu yatū ilayhi mudh'ʿinīna
But if is with them the truth they come to him (as) promptly obedient

item.title: An-Noor:50
item.description:
An-Noor:50 - أَفِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتَابُوْۤا أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَحِيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ بَلْ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
afī qulūbihim maraḍun ami ir'tābū am yakhāfūna an yaḥīfa l-lahu ʿalayhim warasūluhu bal ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna
Is (there) in their hearts a disease or do they doubt or they fear that Allah will be unjust Allah will be unjust to them and His Messenger Nay those they (are) the wrongdoers

item.title: An-Noor:51
item.description:
An-Noor:51 - إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْ يَقُولُوْۤا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
innamā kāna qawla l-mu'minīna idhā duʿū ilā l-lahi warasūlihi liyaḥkuma baynahum an yaqūlū samiʿ'nā wa-aṭaʿnā wa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna
Only is (the) statement (of) the believers when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them (is) that they say We hear and we obey And those they (are) the successful

item.title: An-Noor:52
item.description:
An-Noor:52 - وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَخْشَ اللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ
waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu wayakhsha l-laha wayattaqhi fa-ulāika humu l-fāizūna
And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and (is) conscious of Him then those they (are) the successful ones

item.title: An-Noor:53
item.description:
An-Noor:53 - وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ قُلْ لَا تُقْسِمُوْۤا طَاعَةٌ مَعْرُوفَةٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in amartahum layakhrujunna qul lā tuq'simū ṭāʿatun maʿrūfatun inna l-laha khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
And they swear by Allah strong their oaths that if you ordered them surely they (would) go forth Say (Do) not swear Obedience (is) known Indeed Allah (is) All-Aware of what you do

item.title: An-Noor:54
item.description:
An-Noor:54 - قُلْ أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُمْ مَا حُمِّلْتُمْ وَإِنْ تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوْۤا وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
qul aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla fa-in tawallaw fa-innamā ʿalayhi mā ḥummila waʿalaykum mā ḥummil'tum wa-in tuṭīʿūhu tahtadū wamā ʿalā l-rasūli illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu
Say Obey Allah and obey the Messenger but if you turn away then only upon him (is) what (is) placed on him and on you (is) what (is) placed on you And if you obey him you will be guided And not (is) on the Messenger except the conveyance [the] clear

item.title: An-Noor:55
item.description:
An-Noor:55 - وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ الَّذِي ارْتَضَى لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا يَعْبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِي شَيْئًا وَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
waʿada l-lahu alladhīna āmanū minkum waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti layastakhlifannahum fī l-arḍi kamā is'takhlafa alladhīna min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum dīnahumu alladhī ir'taḍā lahum walayubaddilannahum min baʿdi khawfihim amnan yaʿbudūnanī lā yush'rikūna bī shayan waman kafara baʿda dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-fāsiqūna
Allah (has) promised Allah (has) promised those who believe among you and do righteous deeds surely He will grant them succession in the earth as He gave succession to those who (were) before them (were) before them and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them and surely He will change for them after after their fear security (for) they worship Me not they associate with Me anything But whoever disbelieved after that then those they (are) the defiantly disobedient

item.title: An-Noor:56
item.description:
An-Noor:56 - وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna
And establish the prayer and give zakah and obey the Messenger so that you may receive mercy

item.title: An-Noor:57
item.description:
An-Noor:57 - لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
lā taḥsabanna alladhīna kafarū muʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamawāhumu l-nāru walabi'sa l-maṣīru
(Do) not think those who disbelieve (can) escape in the earth And their abode (will be) the Fire and wretched is the destination

item.title: An-Noor:58
item.description:
An-Noor:58 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لِيَسْتَءْذِنكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوْۤا الْحُلُمَ مِنْكُمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ صَلَوةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُمْ مِنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنْ بَعْدِ صَلَوةِ الْعِشَاءِ ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ لَكُمْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌ بَعْدَهُنَّ طَوَّافُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū liyastadhinkumu alladhīna malakat aymānukum wa-alladhīna lam yablughū l-ḥuluma minkum thalātha marrātin min qabli ṣalati l-fajri waḥīna taḍaʿūna thiyābakum mina l-ẓahīrati wamin baʿdi ṣalati l-ʿishāi thalāthu ʿawrātin lakum laysa ʿalaykum walā ʿalayhim junāḥun baʿdahunna ṭawwāfūna ʿalaykum baʿḍukum ʿalā baʿḍin kadhālika yubayyinu l-lahu lakumu l-āyāti wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
O you those who(believe) believe Let ask your permission those whom possess your right hands and those who (have) not reached puberty among you (at) three times before before (the) prayer (of) dawn and when you put aside your garments at noon and after and after (the) prayer (of) night (These) three (are) times of privacy for you Not on you and not on them any blame after that (as) moving about among you some of you among others Thus Allah makes clear Allah makes clear for you the Verses and Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: An-Noor:59
item.description:
An-Noor:59 - وَإِذَا بَلَغَ الْأَطْفَالُ مِنْكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَءْذِنُوا كَمَا اسْتَءْذَنَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠
wa-idhā balagha l-aṭfālu minkumu l-ḥuluma falyastadhinū kamā is'tadhana alladhīna min qablihim kadhālika yubayyinu l-lahu lakum āyātihi wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
And when reach the children among you the puberty then let them ask permission as asked permission those who (were) before them (were) before them Thus Allah makes clear Allah makes clear for you His Verses And Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: An-Noor:60
item.description:
An-Noor:60 - وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَاتٍ بِزِينَةٍ وَأَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَهُنَّ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ
wal-qawāʿidu mina l-nisāi allātī lā yarjūna nikāḥan falaysa ʿalayhinna junāḥun an yaḍaʿna thiyābahunna ghayra mutabarrijātin bizīnatin wa-an yastaʿfif'na khayrun lahunna wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmun
And postmenopausal among the women who (do) not have desire (for) marriage then not is on them any blame that they put aside their (outer) garments not displaying their adornment And that they modestly refrain (is) better for them And Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Knower

item.title: An-Noor:61
item.description:
An-Noor:61 - لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَى حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوْۤا مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَائِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَانِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَامِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَالِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَالَاتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُمْ مَفَاتِحَهُ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوْۤا جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمْ بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ مُبَارَكَةً طَيِّبَةً كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ laysa ʿalā l-aʿmā ḥarajun walā ʿalā l-aʿraji ḥarajun walā ʿalā l-marīḍi ḥarajun walā ʿalā anfusikum an takulū min buyūtikum aw buyūti ābāikum aw buyūti ummahātikum aw buyūti ikh'wānikum aw buyūti akhawātikum aw buyūti aʿmāmikum aw buyūti ʿammātikum aw buyūti akhwālikum aw buyūti khālātikum aw mā malaktum mafātiḥahu aw ṣadīqikum laysa ʿalaykum junāḥun an takulū jamīʿan aw ashtātan fa-idhā dakhaltum buyūtan fasallimū ʿalā anfusikum taḥiyyatan min ʿindi l-lahi mubārakatan ṭayyibatan kadhālika yubayyinu l-lahu lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna Not is on the blind any blame and not on the lame any blame and not on the sick any blame and not on yourselves that you eat from your houses or houses (of) your fathers or houses (of) your mothers or houses (of) your brothers or houses (of) your sisters or houses (of) your paternal uncles or houses (of) your paternal aunts or houses (of) your maternal uncles or houses (of) your maternal aunts or what you possess its keys or your friend Not is on you any blame that you eat together or separately But when you enter houses then greet on yourselves a greeting from from Allah blessed (and) good Thus Allah makes clear Allah makes clear for you the Verses so that you may understand
  • [1] Or 'greet your folks.'

item.title: An-Noor:62
item.description:
An-Noor:62 - إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوْۤا مَعَهُ عَلَى أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوْۤا حَتّٰی يَسْتَءْذِنُوهُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَءْذِنُونَكَ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِذَا اسْتَءْذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَنْ لِمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-idhā kānū maʿahu ʿalā amrin jāmiʿin lam yadhhabū ḥattā yastadhinūhu inna alladhīna yastadhinūnaka ulāika alladhīna yu'minūna bil-lahi warasūlihi fa-idhā is'tadhanūka libaʿḍi shanihim fadhan liman shi'ta min'hum wa-is'taghfir lahumu l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun
Only the believers (are) those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and when they are with him for a matter (of) collective action not they go until they (have) asked his permission Indeed those who ask your permission those those who believe in Allah and His Messenger So when they ask your permission for some affair of theirs then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them (of) Allah Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: An-Noor:63
item.description:
An-Noor:63 - لَا تَجْعَلُوْۤا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُمْ بَعْضًا قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنْكُمْ لِوَاذًا فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
lā tajʿalū duʿāa l-rasūli baynakum kaduʿāi baʿḍikum baʿḍan qad yaʿlamu l-lahu alladhīna yatasallalūna minkum liwādhan falyaḥdhari alladhīna yukhālifūna ʿan amrihi an tuṣībahum fit'natun aw yuṣībahum ʿadhābun alīmun
(Do) not make (the) calling (of) the Messenger among you as (the) call (of) some of you (to) others Verily Allah knows Allah knows those who slip away among you under shelter So let beware those who oppose from his orders lest befalls them a trial or befalls them a punishment painful

item.title: An-Noor:64
item.description:
An-Noor:64 - أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
alā inna lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi qad yaʿlamu mā antum ʿalayhi wayawma yur'jaʿūna ilayhi fayunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
No doubt Indeed to Allah (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and the earth Verily He knows what you (are) on [it] And (the) Day they will be returned to Him then He will inform them of what they did And Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower

item.title: 25. الفرقان (Al-Furqaan)
item.description:
The surah proclaiming the Quran that God bestowed upon Muhammad to be, in its finality and totality, The Criterion of everlasting salvation for all humankind until the end of time. It takes its name from verse 1, which refers to the Quran as "al-Furqān" (lit. "the Distinguisher", "the Separator" or "the Differentiator", i.e. a criterion for distinguishing between truth and falsehood). The surah starts with a denunciation of polytheism, then deals with the disbelievers" arguments against the Prophet, the Quran, and the Day of Judgement. It warns them of their fate, citing examples of earlier peoples. The surah describes the power and grace of God, and ends with the qualities of true believers in verse 63 ff.
The surah is also known as Discrimination, Salvation, The Differentiator, The Standard

25:1
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
tabāraka alladhī nazzala l-fur'qāna ʿalā ʿabdihi liyakūna lil'ʿālamīna nadhīran
Blessed is He Who sent down the Criterion upon His slave that he may be to the worlds a warner

25:2
اَلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقْدِيرًا
alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun lahu sharīkun fī l-mul'ki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdīran
The One Who to Him (belongs) (the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and not He has taken a son and not He has for Him a partner in the dominion and He (has) created every thing and determined it (with) determination

25:3
وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
wa-ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūna walā yamlikūna li-anfusihim ḍarran walā nafʿan walā yamlikūna mawtan walā ḥayatan walā nushūran
Yet they have taken besides Him besides Him gods not they create anything while they are created and not they possess for themselves any harm and not any benefit and not they control death and not life and not resurrection

item.title: Al-Furqaan:1
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:1 - تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
tabāraka alladhī nazzala l-fur'qāna ʿalā ʿabdihi liyakūna lil'ʿālamīna nadhīran
Blessed is He Who sent down the Criterion upon His slave that he may be to the worlds a warner

item.title: Al-Furqaan:2
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:2 - اَلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقْدِيرًا
alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walam yattakhidh waladan walam yakun lahu sharīkun fī l-mul'ki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdīran
The One Who to Him (belongs) (the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and not He has taken a son and not He has for Him a partner in the dominion and He (has) created every thing and determined it (with) determination

item.title: Al-Furqaan:3
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:3 - وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
wa-ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūna walā yamlikūna li-anfusihim ḍarran walā nafʿan walā yamlikūna mawtan walā ḥayatan walā nushūran
Yet they have taken besides Him besides Him gods not they create anything while they are created and not they possess for themselves any harm and not any benefit and not they control death and not life and not resurrection

item.title: Al-Furqaan:4
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:4 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ افْتَرَاهُ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ فَقَدْ جَاءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
waqāla alladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā if'kun if'tarāhu wa-aʿānahu ʿalayhi qawmun ākharūna faqad jāū ẓul'man wazūran
And say those who disbelieve Not this (is) but a lie he invented it and helped him at it people other But verily they (have) produced an injustice and a lie

item.title: Al-Furqaan:5
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:5 - وَقَالُوْۤا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَى عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
waqālū asāṭīru l-awalīna ik'tatabahā fahiya tum'lā ʿalayhi buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan
And they say Tales (of) the former people which he has had written and they are dictated to him morning and evening

item.title: Al-Furqaan:6
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:6 - قُلْ أَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا
qul anzalahu alladhī yaʿlamu l-sira fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu kāna ghafūran raḥīman
Say Has sent it down the One Who knows the secret in the heavens and the earth Indeed, He is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Furqaan:7
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:7 - وَقَالُوْۤا مَالِ هَذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا
waqālū māli hādhā l-rasūli yakulu l-ṭaʿāma wayamshī fī l-aswāqi lawlā unzila ilayhi malakun fayakūna maʿahu nadhīran
And they say Why does this Messenger eat [the] food and walk in the markets Why not is sent down to him an Angel then he be with him a warner

item.title: Al-Furqaan:8
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:8 - أَوْ يُلْقَى إِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِنْ تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَسْحُورًا
aw yul'qā ilayhi kanzun aw takūnu lahu jannatun yakulu min'hā waqāla l-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulan masḥūran
Or is delivered to him a treasure or is for him a garden he may eat from it And say the wrongdoers Not you follow but a man bewitched

item.title: Al-Furqaan:9
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:9 - اُنْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوْۤا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْۤا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan
See how they set forth for you the similitudes but they have gone astray so not they are able (to find) a way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:10
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:10 - تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكَ قُصُورًا
tabāraka alladhī in shāa jaʿala laka khayran min dhālika jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wayajʿal laka quṣūran
Blessed is He Who if He willed (could have) made for you better than that gardens flow from underneath it the rivers and He (could) make for you palaces

item.title: Al-Furqaan:11
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:11 - بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
bal kadhabū bil-sāʿati wa-aʿtadnā liman kadhaba bil-sāʿati saʿīran
Nay they deny the Hour and We have prepared for (those) who deny the Hour a Blazing Fire

item.title: Al-Furqaan:12
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:12 - إِذَا رَأَتْهُمْ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا idhā ra-athum min makānin baʿīdin samiʿū lahā taghayyuẓan wazafīran When it sees them from a place far they will hear its raging and roaring
  • [1] That is, hell.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:13
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:13 - وَإِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا wa-idhā ul'qū min'hā makānan ḍayyiqan muqarranīna daʿaw hunālika thubūran And when they are thrown thereof (in) a place narrow bound in chains they will call there (for) destruction
  • [1] Cf. (Q 43:77); (Q 78:40).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:14
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:14 - لَا تَدْعُوْۤا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوْۤا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
lā tadʿū l-yawma thubūran wāḥidan wa-id'ʿū thubūran kathīran
(Do) not call this day (for) destruction one but call (for) destructions many

item.title: Al-Furqaan:15
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:15 - قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا
qul adhālika khayrun am jannatu l-khul'di allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna kānat lahum jazāan wamaṣīran
Say Is that better or Garden (of) Eternity which is promised (to) the righteous It will be for them a reward and destination

item.title: Al-Furqaan:16
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:16 - لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَسْءُولًا lahum fīhā mā yashāūna khālidīna kāna ʿalā rabbika waʿdan masūlan For them therein (is) whatever they wish they will abide forever It is on your Lord a promise requested
  • [1] Cf. (Q 3:194): 'Our Lord, grant us what You have promised us through Your apostles.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:17
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:17 - وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوْۤا السَّبِيلَ
wayawma yaḥshuruhum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi fayaqūlu a-antum aḍlaltum ʿibādī hāulāi am hum ḍallū l-sabīla
And (the) Day He will gather them and what they worship besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah and He will say Did you [you] mislead My slaves these or they went astray (from) the way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:18
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:18 - قَالُوْا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَكِنْ مَتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی نَسُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا بُورًا
qālū sub'ḥānaka mā kāna yanbaghī lanā an nattakhidha min dūnika min awliyāa walākin mattaʿtahum waābāahum ḥattā nasū l-dhik'ra wakānū qawman būran
They say Glory be to You Not it was proper it was proper for us that we take besides You besides You any protectors But You gave them comforts and their forefathers until they forgot the Message and became a people ruined

item.title: Al-Furqaan:19
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:19 - فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا وَمَنْ يَظْلِمْ مِنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
faqad kadhabūkum bimā taqūlūna famā tastaṭīʿūna ṣarfan walā naṣran waman yaẓlim minkum nudhiq'hu ʿadhāban kabīran
So verily they deny you in what you say so not you are able (to) avert and not (to) help And whoever does wrong among you We will make him taste a punishment great

item.title: Al-Furqaan:20
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:20 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
wamā arsalnā qablaka mina l-mur'salīna illā innahum layakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wayamshūna fī l-aswāqi wajaʿalnā baʿḍakum libaʿḍin fit'natan ataṣbirūna wakāna rabbuka baṣīran
And not We sent before you any Messengers but indeed, they [surely] ate food and walked in the markets And We have made some of you for others a trial will you have patience And is your Lord All-Seer

item.title: Al-Furqaan:21
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:21 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرٰی رَبَّنَا لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
waqāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāanā lawlā unzila ʿalaynā l-malāikatu aw narā rabbanā laqadi is'takbarū fī anfusihim waʿataw ʿutuwwan kabīran
And said those who (do) not expect (the) meeting with Us Why not are sent down to us the Angels or we see our Lord Indeed they have become arrogant within themselves and (become) insolent (with) insolence great

item.title: Al-Furqaan:22
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:22 - يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰی يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا yawma yarawna l-malāikata lā bush'rā yawma-idhin lil'muj'rimīna wayaqūlūna ḥij'ran maḥjūran (The) Day they see the Angels no glad tidings (will be) that Day for the criminals and they will say A partition forbidden
  • [1] That is, the angels, who will say this to the faithless. According to another interpretation, during pre-Islamic days, whenever, during one of the holy months in which warfare was prohibited by custom, an Arab felt threatened by someone belonging to a belligerent tribe, he would say, Ḥijran maḥjūrā, thus telling the member of the hostile tribe to keep distance by appealing to the sanctity of the holy month. On this basis, it is the faithless who ask the angels to keep off.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:23
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:23 - وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَى مَا عَمِلُوْۤا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا
waqadim'nā ilā mā ʿamilū min ʿamalin fajaʿalnāhu habāan manthūran
And We will proceed to whatever they did of (the) deed(s) and We will make them (as) dust dispersed

item.title: Al-Furqaan:24
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:24 - أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
aṣḥābu l-janati yawma-idhin khayrun mus'taqarran wa-aḥsanu maqīlan
(The) companions (of) Paradise that Day (will be in) a better abode and a better resting-place

item.title: Al-Furqaan:25
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:25 - وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنْزِيلًا
wayawma tashaqqaqu l-samāu bil-ghamāmi wanuzzila l-malāikatu tanzīlan
And (the) Day will split open the heavens with the clouds and (will be) sent down the Angels descending

item.title: Al-Furqaan:26
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:26 - اَلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا al-mul'ku yawma-idhin l-ḥaqu lilrraḥmāni wakāna yawman ʿalā l-kāfirīna ʿasīran The Sovereignty that Day (will be) truly for the Most Gracious And (it will) be a Day for the disbelievers difficult
  • [1] Cf. (Q 74:9).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:27
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:27 - وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
wayawma yaʿaḍḍu l-ẓālimu ʿalā yadayhi yaqūlu yālaytanī ittakhadhtu maʿa l-rasūli sabīlan
And (the) Day will bite the wrongdoer on his hands he will say O I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:28
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:28 - يَاوَيْلَتَى لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
yāwaylatā laytanī lam attakhidh fulānan khalīlan
O woe to me I wish not I had taken that one (as) a friend

item.title: Al-Furqaan:29
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:29 - لَقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُولًا
laqad aḍallanī ʿani l-dhik'ri baʿda idh jāanī wakāna l-shayṭānu lil'insāni khadhūlan
Verily he led me astray from the Reminder after when it (had) come to me And is the Shaitaan to the man a deserter

item.title: Al-Furqaan:30
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:30 - وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا
waqāla l-rasūlu yārabbi inna qawmī ittakhadhū hādhā l-qur'āna mahjūran
And said the Messenger O my Lord Indeed my people took this the Quran (as) a forsaken thing

item.title: Al-Furqaan:31
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:31 - وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwan mina l-muj'rimīna wakafā birabbika hādiyan wanaṣīran
And thus We have made for every Prophet an enemy among the criminals But sufficient is your Lord (as) a Guide and a Helper

item.title: Al-Furqaan:32
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:32 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً كَذٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi l-qur'ānu jum'latan wāḥidatan kadhālika linuthabbita bihi fuādaka warattalnāhu tartīlan
And said those who disbelieve Why not was revealed to him the Quran all at once all at once Thus that We may strengthen thereby your heart and We have recited it (with distinct) recitation

item.title: Al-Furqaan:33
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:33 - وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
walā yatūnaka bimathalin illā ji'nāka bil-ḥaqi wa-aḥsana tafsīran
And not they come to you with an example but We bring you the truth and (the) best explanation

item.title: Al-Furqaan:34
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:34 - اَلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
alladhīna yuḥ'sharūna ʿalā wujūhihim ilā jahannama ulāika sharrun makānan wa-aḍallu sabīlan
Those who will be gathered on their faces to Hell those (are the) worst (in) position and most astray (from the) way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:35
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:35 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا
walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba wajaʿalnā maʿahu akhāhu hārūna wazīran
And verily We gave Musa the Scripture and We appointed with him his brother Harun (as) an assistant

item.title: Al-Furqaan:36
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:36 - فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
faqul'nā idh'habā ilā l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā fadammarnāhum tadmīran
Then We said Go both of you to the people those who have denied Our Signs Then We destroyed them (with) destruction

item.title: Al-Furqaan:37
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:37 - وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَمَّا كَذَّبُوْۤا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰیَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
waqawma nūḥin lammā kadhabū l-rusula aghraqnāhum wajaʿalnāhum lilnnāsi āyatan wa-aʿtadnā lilẓẓālimīna ʿadhāban alīman
And (the) people (of) Nuh when they denied the Messengers We drowned them and We made them for mankind a sign And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Furqaan:38
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:38 - وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
waʿādan wathamūdā wa-aṣḥāba l-rasi waqurūnan bayna dhālika kathīran
And Ad and Thamud and (the) dwellers (of) Ar-rass and generations between that many

item.title: Al-Furqaan:39
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:39 - وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
wakullan ḍarabnā lahu l-amthāla wakullan tabbarnā tatbīran
And each We have set forth for him the examples and each We destroyed (with) destruction

item.title: Al-Furqaan:40
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:40 - وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
walaqad ataw ʿalā l-qaryati allatī um'ṭirat maṭara l-sawi afalam yakūnū yarawnahā bal kānū lā yarjūna nushūran
And verily they have come upon the town which was showered (with) a rain (of) evil Then do not they [were] see it Nay they are not expecting Resurrection

item.title: Al-Furqaan:41
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:41 - وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِنْ يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا
wa-idhā ra-awka in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī baʿatha l-lahu rasūlan
And when they see you not they take you except (in) mockery Is this the one whom Allah has sent Allah has sent (as) a Messenger

item.title: Al-Furqaan:42
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:42 - إِنْ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
in kāda layuḍillunā ʿan ālihatinā lawlā an ṣabarnā ʿalayhā wasawfa yaʿlamūna ḥīna yarawna l-ʿadhāba man aḍallu sabīlan
He would have almost He would have almost [surely] misled us from our gods if not that we had been steadfast to them And soon will know when they will see the punishment who (is) more astray (from the) way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:43
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:43 - أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنْتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
ara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu afa-anta takūnu ʿalayhi wakīlan
Have you seen (one) who takes (as) his god his own desire Then would you be over him a guardian

item.title: Al-Furqaan:44
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:44 - أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
am taḥsabu anna aktharahum yasmaʿūna aw yaʿqilūna in hum illā kal-anʿāmi bal hum aḍallu sabīlan
Or do you think that most of them hear or understand Not they (are) except like cattle Nay they (are) more astray (from the) way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:45
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:45 - أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا alam tara ilā rabbika kayfa madda l-ẓila walaw shāa lajaʿalahu sākinan thumma jaʿalnā l-shamsa ʿalayhi dalīlan Do you not see to your Lord how He extends the shadow And if He willed surely He (could) have made it stationary Then We made the sun for it an indication
  • [1] This is in accordance with a tradition of al-Imam al-Bāqir ('a) in which ẓill is explained as the light during the hours between daybreak and sunrise (see Tafsīr al-Qummī). Or 'extends the shadow.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:46
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:46 - ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
thumma qabaḍnāhu ilaynā qabḍan yasīran
Then We withdraw it to Us a withdrawal gradual

item.title: Al-Furqaan:47
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:47 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
wahuwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla libāsan wal-nawma subātan wajaʿala l-nahāra nushūran
And He (is) the One Who made for you the night (as) a covering and the sleep a rest and made the day a resurrection

item.title: Al-Furqaan:48
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:48 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا
wahuwa alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan ṭahūran
And He (is) the One Who sends the winds (as) glad tidings before before His Mercy and We send down from the sky water pure

item.title: Al-Furqaan:49
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:49 - لِنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا
linuḥ'yiya bihi baldatan maytan wanus'qiyahu mimmā khalaqnā anʿāman wa-anāsiyya kathīran
That We may give life thereby (to) a land dead and We give drink thereof (to those) We created cattle and men many

item.title: Al-Furqaan:50
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:50 - وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبٰی أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
walaqad ṣarrafnāhu baynahum liyadhakkarū fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran
And verily We have distributed it among them that they may remember but refuse most (of) the people except disbelief

item.title: Al-Furqaan:51
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:51 - وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَذِيرًا
walaw shi'nā labaʿathnā fī kulli qaryatin nadhīran
And if We willed surely, We (would) have raised in every town a warner

item.title: Al-Furqaan:52
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:52 - فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا falā tuṭiʿi l-kāfirīna wajāhid'hum bihi jihādan kabīran So (do) not obey the disbelievers and strive (against) them with it a striving great
  • [1] That is, with the help of the Qur'ān.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:53
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:53 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا
wahuwa alladhī maraja l-baḥrayni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wajaʿala baynahumā barzakhan waḥij'ran maḥjūran
And He (is) the One Who (has) released the two seas [this] (one) palatable and sweet and [this] (one) salty (and) bitter and He has made between them a barrier and a partition forbidden

item.title: Al-Furqaan:54
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:54 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
wahuwa alladhī khalaqa mina l-māi basharan fajaʿalahu nasaban waṣih'ran wakāna rabbuka qadīran
And He (is) the One Who has created from the water human being and has made (for) him blood relationship and marriage relationship And is your Lord All-Powerful

item.title: Al-Furqaan:55
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:55 - وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا
wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿuhum walā yaḍurruhum wakāna l-kāfiru ʿalā rabbihi ẓahīran
But they worship besides Allah besides Allah besides Allah what not profits them not profits them and not harms them and is the disbeliever against his Lord a helper

item.title: Al-Furqaan:56
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:56 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran
And not We sent you except (as) a bearer of glad tidings and a warner

item.title: Al-Furqaan:57
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:57 - قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin illā man shāa an yattakhidha ilā rabbihi sabīlan
Say Not I ask (of) you for it any payment except (that) whoever wills (that) whoever wills to take to his Lord a way

item.title: Al-Furqaan:58
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:58 - وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ وَكَفَى بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا
watawakkal ʿalā l-ḥayi alladhī lā yamūtu wasabbiḥ biḥamdihi wakafā bihi bidhunūbi ʿibādihi khabīran
And put your trust in the Ever-Living the One Who does not die does not die and glorify with His Praise And sufficient is He regarding the sins (of) His slaves All-Aware

item.title: Al-Furqaan:59
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:59 - اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ الرَّحْمَنُ فَسْءَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi l-raḥmānu fasal bihi khabīran The One Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them in six periods then He established Himself over the Throne the Most Gracious so ask Him (as He is) All-Aware
  • [1] Or, 'about it,' that is, about the creation of the heavens and the earth, or the meaning of the Throne.

item.title: Al-Furqaan:60
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:60 - وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْۤا لِلرَّحْمَنِ قَالُوْا وَمَا الرَّحْمَنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا
wa-idhā qīla lahumu us'judū lilrraḥmāni qālū wamā l-raḥmānu anasjudu limā tamurunā wazādahum nufūran
And when it is said to them Prostrate to the Most Gracious They say And what (is) the Most Gracious Should we prostrate to what you order us And it increases them (in) aversion

item.title: Al-Furqaan:61
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:61 - تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُنِيرًا
tabāraka alladhī jaʿala fī l-samāi burūjan wajaʿala fīhā sirājan waqamaran munīran
Blessed is He Who has placed in the skies constellations and has placed therein a lamp and a moon shining

item.title: Al-Furqaan:62
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:62 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
wahuwa alladhī jaʿala al-layla wal-nahāra khil'fatan liman arāda an yadhakkara aw arāda shukūran
And He (is) the One Who made the night and the day (in) succession for whoever desires to remember or desires to be thankful

item.title: Al-Furqaan:63
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:63 - وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوْا سَلَامًا
waʿibādu l-raḥmāni alladhīna yamshūna ʿalā l-arḍi hawnan wa-idhā khāṭabahumu l-jāhilūna qālū salāman
And (the) slaves (of) the Most Gracious (are) those who walk on the earth (in) humbleness and when address them the ignorant ones they say Peace

item.title: Al-Furqaan:64
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:64 - وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا
wa-alladhīna yabītūna lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyāman
And those who spend (the) night before their Lord prostrating and standing

item.title: Al-Furqaan:65
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:65 - وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā iṣ'rif ʿannā ʿadhāba jahannama inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāman
And those who say Our Lord Avert from us the punishment (of) Hell Indeed its punishment is inseparable

item.title: Al-Furqaan:66
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:66 - إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
innahā sāat mus'taqarran wamuqāman
Indeed, it (is) an evil abode and resting place

item.title: Al-Furqaan:67
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:67 - وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنْفَقُوْۤا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوْۤا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوْۤا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
wa-alladhīna idhā anfaqū lam yus'rifū walam yaqturū wakāna bayna dhālika qawāman
And those who when they spend (are) not extravagant (are) not extravagant and are not stingy and are not stingy but are between that moderate

item.title: Al-Furqaan:68
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:68 - وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
wa-alladhīna lā yadʿūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara walā yaqtulūna l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi walā yaznūna waman yafʿal dhālika yalqa athāman
And those who (do) not invoke with Allah god another and (do) not [they] kill the soul which Allah has forbidden Allah has forbidden except by right and (do) not commit unlawful sexual intercourse And whoever does that will meet a penalty

item.title: Al-Furqaan:69
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:69 - يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِیْهِ مُهَانًا
yuḍāʿaf lahu l-ʿadhābu yawma l-qiyāmati wayakhlud fīhi muhānan
Will be doubled for him the punishment (on the) Day (of) Resurrection and he will abide forever therein humiliated

item.title: Al-Furqaan:70
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:70 - إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ʿamalan ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yubaddilu l-lahu sayyiātihim ḥasanātin wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman Except (he) who repents and believes and does righteous deeds righteous deeds then (for) those Allah will replace Allah will replace their evil deeds (with) good ones And is Allah Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
  • [1] Or 'their vices with virtues.'

item.title: Al-Furqaan:71
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:71 - وَمَنْ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا
waman tāba waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-innahu yatūbu ilā l-lahi matāban
And whoever repents and does righteous (deeds) then indeed, he turns to Allah (with) repentance

item.title: Al-Furqaan:72
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:72 - وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوْۤا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْۤا كِرَامًا wa-alladhīna lā yashhadūna l-zūra wa-idhā marrū bil-laghwi marrū kirāman And those who (do) not bear witness (to) the falsehood and when they pass by futility they pass (as) dignified ones
  • [1] Or, 'those who do not participate in humbug.' That is, those who do not attend music parties or take part in senseless and sinful gatherings and amusements. (See Tafsīr al-Qummī, Manhaj al-Ṣādiqīn).

item.title: Al-Furqaan:73
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:73 - وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوْۤا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
wa-alladhīna idhā dhukkirū biāyāti rabbihim lam yakhirrū ʿalayhā ṣumman waʿum'yānan
And those who when they are reminded of (the) Verses (of) their Lord (do) not fall upon them deaf and blind

item.title: Al-Furqaan:74
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:74 - وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
wa-alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wadhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-ij'ʿalnā lil'muttaqīna imāman
And those who say Our Lord Grant to us from our spouses and our offspring comfort (to) our eyes and make us for the righteous a leader

item.title: Al-Furqaan:75
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:75 - اُولٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا
ulāika yuj'zawna l-ghur'fata bimā ṣabarū wayulaqqawna fīhā taḥiyyatan wasalāman
Those will be awarded the Chamber because they were patient and they will be met therein (with) greetings and peace

item.title: Al-Furqaan:76
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:76 - خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
khālidīna fīhā ḥasunat mus'taqarran wamuqāman
Will abide forever in it Good (is) the settlement and a resting place

item.title: Al-Furqaan:77
item.description:
Al-Furqaan:77 - قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا qul mā yaʿba-u bikum rabbī lawlā duʿāukum faqad kadhabtum fasawfa yakūnu lizāman Say Not will care for you my Lord if not your prayer (is to Him) But verily you have denied so soon will be the inevitable (punishment)
  • [1] Or 'were it not for your invitation.'

item.title: 26. الشعراء (Ash-Shu'araa)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the aimless meandering of unbelieving Poets in their creative effort to versify, and how their own actions belie their artistic messages, though it exempts from this censure poets who are believers and act with justice and righteousness. It takes its name from verse 224 ff. concerning the poets (shu'arā'). The surah talks about the disbelievers who belittle the Quran, and gives examples of God's power and grace in nature. It recounts several stories of earlier prophets, the reactions of their people, and punishments that afflicted them, ending by confirming the divine origin of the Quran. It is not something brought down by the jinn, nor is it poetry.

26:1
طسم
tta-seen-meem
Ta Seem Meem

26:2
تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni
These (are the) Verses (of) the Book clear

26:3
لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ
laʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīna
Perhaps you (would) kill yourself that not they become believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:1
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:1 - طسم
tta-seen-meem
Ta Seem Meem

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:2
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:2 - تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni
These (are the) Verses (of) the Book clear

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:3
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:3 - لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ
laʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka allā yakūnū mu'minīna
Perhaps you (would) kill yourself that not they become believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:4
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:4 - إِنْ نَشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ اٰیَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ
in nasha nunazzil ʿalayhim mina l-samāi āyatan faẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīna
If We will We can send down to them from the sky a Sign so would bend their necks to it (in) humility

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:5
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:5 - وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ ذِكْرٍ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
wamā yatīhim min dhik'rin mina l-raḥmāni muḥ'dathin illā kānū ʿanhu muʿ'riḍīna
And (does) not come to them any reminder from the Most Gracious new but they from it turn away

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:6
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:6 - فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْۤا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَؤُا مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
faqad kadhabū fasayatīhim anbāu mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
So verily they have denied then will come to them the news (of) what they used at it (to) mock

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:7
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:7 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
awalam yaraw ilā l-arḍi kam anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīmin
Do not they see at the earth how many We produced in it of every kind noble

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:8
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:8 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely (is) a sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:9
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:9 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely, He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:10
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:10 - وَإِذْ نَادَى رَبُّكَ مُوسٰی أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
wa-idh nādā rabbuka mūsā ani i'ti l-qawma l-ẓālimīna
And when your Lord called your Lord called Musa that Go (to) the people (who are) wrongdoers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:11
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:11 - قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
qawma fir'ʿawna alā yattaqūna
(The) people (of) Firaun Will not they fear

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:12
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:12 - قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ
qāla rabbi innī akhāfu an yukadhibūni
He said My Lord Indeed, I [I] fear that they will deny me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:13
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:13 - وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَى هَارُونَ
wayaḍīqu ṣadrī walā yanṭaliqu lisānī fa-arsil ilā hārūna
And straitens my breast and not expresses well my tongue so send for Harun

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:14
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:14 - وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ
walahum ʿalayya dhanbun fa-akhāfu an yaqtulūni
And they have against me a crime so I fear that they will kill me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:15
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:15 - قَالَ كَلَّا فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُسْتَمِعُونَ
qāla kallā fa-idh'habā biāyātinā innā maʿakum mus'tamiʿūna
He said Nay go both of you with Our Signs Indeed, We (are) with you listening

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:16
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:16 - فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
fatiyā fir'ʿawna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna
So go both of you (to) Firaun and say 'Indeed, we (are the) Messenger (of the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:17
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:17 - أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ
an arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla
That send with us (the) Children of Israel.' (the) Children of Israel.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:18
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:18 - قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdan walabith'ta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīna
He said Did not we bring you up among us (as) a child and you remained among us of your life years

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:19
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:19 - وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
wafaʿalta faʿlataka allatī faʿalta wa-anta mina l-kāfirīna
And you did your deed which you did and you (were) of the ungrateful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:20
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:20 - قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
qāla faʿaltuhā idhan wa-anā mina l-ḍālīna
He said I did it when I (was) of those who are astray

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:21
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:21 - فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
fafarartu minkum lammā khif'tukum fawahaba lī rabbī ḥuk'man wajaʿalanī mina l-mur'salīna
So I fled from you when I feared you But granted to me my Lord judgment and made me of the Messengers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:22
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:22 - وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ
watil'ka niʿ'matun tamunnuhā ʿalayya an ʿabbadtta banī is'rāīla
And this (is the) favor with which you reproach [on] me that you have enslaved (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:23
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:23 - قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
qāla fir'ʿawnu wamā rabbu l-ʿālamīna
Firaun said Firaun said And what (is the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:24
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:24 - قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ
qāla rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīna
He said Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them if you (should) be convinced

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:25
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:25 - قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
qāla liman ḥawlahu alā tastamiʿūna
He said to those around him Do not you hear

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:26
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:26 - قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
qāla rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīna
He said Your Lord and (the) Lord (of) your forefathers (of) your forefathers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:27
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:27 - قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
qāla inna rasūlakumu alladhī ur'sila ilaykum lamajnūnun
He said Indeed your Messenger who has been sent to you (is) surely mad

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:28
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:28 - قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
qāla rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamā baynahumā in kuntum taʿqilūna
He said Lord (of) the east and the west and whatever (is) between them if you were (to) reason

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:29
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:29 - قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ
qāla la-ini ittakhadhta ilāhan ghayrī la-ajʿalannaka mina l-masjūnīna
He said If you take a god other than me I will surely make you among those imprisoned

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:30
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:30 - قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُبِينٍ
qāla awalaw ji'tuka bishayin mubīnin
He said Even if I bring you something manifest

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:31
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:31 - قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
qāla fati bihi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna
He said Then bring it if you are of the truthful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:32
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:32 - فَأَلْقَى عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُبِينٌ
fa-alqā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya thuʿ'bānun mubīnun
So he threw his staff and behold It (was) a serpent manifest

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:33
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:33 - وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
wanazaʿa yadahu fa-idhā hiya bayḍāu lilnnāẓirīna
And he drew out his hand and behold It (was) white for the observers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:34
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:34 - قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌ
qāla lil'mala-i ḥawlahu inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīmun
He said to the chiefs around him Indeed this (is) surely a magician learned

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:35
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:35 - يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
yurīdu an yukh'rijakum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihi famādhā tamurūna
He wants to drive you out from your land by his magic so what (do) you advise

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:36
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:36 - قَالُوْا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
qālū arjih wa-akhāhu wa-ib'ʿath fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna
They said Postpone him and his brother and send in the cities gatherers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:37
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:37 - يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
yatūka bikulli saḥḥārin ʿalīmin
They (will) bring to you every magician learned

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:38
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:38 - فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ
fajumiʿa l-saḥaratu limīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin
So were assembled the magicians for (the) appointment (on) a day well-known

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:39
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:39 - وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُجْتَمِعُونَ
waqīla lilnnāsi hal antum muj'tamiʿūna
And it was said to the people Will you assemble

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:40
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:40 - لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ
laʿallanā nattabiʿu l-saḥarata in kānū humu l-ghālibīna
That we may follow the magicians if they are they are the victorious

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:41
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:41 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ
falammā jāa l-saḥaratu qālū lifir'ʿawna a-inna lanā la-ajran in kunnā naḥnu l-ghālibīna
So when came the magicians they said to Firaun Is there for us a reward if we are we are the victorious

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:42
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:42 - قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
qāla naʿam wa-innakum idhan lamina l-muqarabīna
He said Yes and indeed you then surely (will be) of the ones who are brought near

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:43
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:43 - قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسٰی أَلْقُوْۤا مَا أَنْتُمْ مُلْقُونَ
qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mul'qūna
Said to them Musa Throw what you (are) going to throw

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:44
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:44 - فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْۤا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ
fa-alqaw ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālū biʿizzati fir'ʿawna innā lanaḥnu l-ghālibūna
So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said By the might (of) Firaun indeed, we surely, we (are) the victorious

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:45
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:45 - فَأَلْقَى مُوسٰی عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
fa-alqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu fa-idhā hiya talqafu mā yafikūna
Then threw Musa his staff and behold It swallowed what they falsified

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:46
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:46 - فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ
fa-ul'qiya l-saḥaratu sājidīna
Then fell down the magicians prostrate

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:47
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:47 - قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
qālū āmannā birabbi l-ʿālamīna
They said We believe in (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:48
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:48 - رَبِّ مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ
rabbi mūsā wahārūna
Lord (of) Musa and Harun

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:49
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:49 - قَالَ ءَامَنْتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ مِنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra falasawfa taʿlamūna la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna
He said You believed in him before that I gave permission to you Indeed, he (is) surely your chief who has taught you the magic so surely soon you will know I will surely cut off your hands and your feet of opposite sides and I will surely crucify you all

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:50
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:50 - قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُونَ
qālū lā ḍayra innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna
They said No harm Indeed, we to our Lord (will) return

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:51
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:51 - إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَنْ كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
innā naṭmaʿu an yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwala l-mu'minīna
Indeed, we hope that will forgive us our Lord our sins because we are (the) first (of) the believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:52
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:52 - وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ
wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūna
And We inspired to Musa that Travel by night with My slaves indeed, you (will be) followed

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:53
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:53 - فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ
fa-arsala fir'ʿawnu fī l-madāini ḥāshirīna
Then sent Firaun in the cities gatherers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:54
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:54 - إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ inna hāulāi lashir'dhimatun qalīlūna Indeed these (are) certainly a band small
  • [1] That is, the Israelites.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:55
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:55 - وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ
wa-innahum lanā laghāiẓūna
And indeed, they [to] us (are) surely enraging

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:56
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:56 - وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ wa-innā lajamīʿun ḥādhirūna And indeed, we (are) surely a multitude forewarned
  • [1] Or, 'Surely we are all a well-armed host.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:57
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:57 - فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُمْ مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
fa-akhrajnāhum min jannātin waʿuyūnin
So We expelled them from gardens and springs

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:58
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:58 - وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
wakunūzin wamaqāmin karīmin
And treasures and a place honorable

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:59
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:59 - كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ
kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā banī is'rāīla
Thus And We caused to inherit them (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:60
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:60 - فَأَتْبَعُوهُمْ مُشْرِقِينَ
fa-atbaʿūhum mush'riqīna
So they followed them (at) sunrise

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:61
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:61 - فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَا الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسٰی إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
falammā tarāā l-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamud'rakūna
Then when saw each other the two hosts said (the) companions (of) Musa Indeed, we (are) surely to be overtaken

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:62
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:62 - قَالَ كَلَّا إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
qāla kallā inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīni
He said Nay indeed with me (is) my Lord He will guide me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:63
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:63 - فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی أَنِ اضْرِبْ بِعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ
fa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-baḥra fa-infalaqa fakāna kullu fir'qin kal-ṭawdi l-ʿaẓīmi
Then We inspired to Musa that Strike with your staff the sea So it parted and became each part like the mountain [the] great

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:64
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:64 - وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْءَاخَرِينَ
wa-azlafnā thamma l-ākharīna
And We brought near there the others

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:65
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:65 - وَأَنْجَيْنَا مُوسٰی وَمَنْ مَعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
wa-anjaynā mūsā waman maʿahu ajmaʿīna
And We saved Musa and who (were) with him all

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:66
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:66 - ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ
thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna
Then We drowned the others

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:67
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:67 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely (is) a Sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:68
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:68 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:69
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:69 - وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ
wa-ut'lu ʿalayhim naba-a ib'rāhīma
And recite to them (the) news (of) Ibrahim

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:70
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:70 - إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūna
When he said to his father and his people What (do) you worship

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:71
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:71 - قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ
qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīna
They said We worship idols so we will remain to them devoted

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:72
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:72 - قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
qāla hal yasmaʿūnakum idh tadʿūna
He said Do they hear you when you call

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:73
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:73 - أَوْ يَنْفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
aw yanfaʿūnakum aw yaḍurrūna
Or (do) they benefit you or they harm (you)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:74
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:74 - قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
qālū bal wajadnā ābāanā kadhālika yafʿalūna
They said Nay but we found our forefathers like that doing

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:75
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:75 - قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
qāla afara-aytum mā kuntum taʿbudūna
He said Do you see what you have been worshipping

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:76
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:76 - أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ
antum waābāukumu l-aqdamūna
You and your forefathers and your forefathers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:77
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:77 - فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
fa-innahum ʿaduwwun lī illā rabba l-ʿālamīna
Indeed, they (are) enemies to me except (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:78
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:78 - اَلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
alladhī khalaqanī fahuwa yahdīni
The One Who created me and He guides me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:79
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:79 - وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ
wa-alladhī huwa yuṭ'ʿimunī wayasqīni
And the One Who He gives me food and gives me drink

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:80
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:80 - وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
wa-idhā mariḍ'tu fahuwa yashfīni
And when I am ill then He cures me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:81
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:81 - وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
wa-alladhī yumītunī thumma yuḥ'yīni
And the One Who will cause me to die then he will give me life

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:82
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:82 - وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيءَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu an yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma l-dīni And the One Who I hope that He will forgive for me my faults (on the) Day (of) the Judgment
  • [1] Or 'the Day of Judgement.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:83
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:83 - رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
rabbi hab lī ḥuk'man wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna
My Lord Grant [for] me wisdom and join me with the righteous

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:84
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:84 - وَاجْعَلْ لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ
wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīna
And grant [for] me a mention (of) honor among the later (generations)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:85
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:85 - وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
wa-ij'ʿalnī min warathati jannati l-naʿīmi
And make me of (the) inheritors (of) Garden(s) (of) Delight

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:86
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:86 - وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
wa-igh'fir li-abī innahu kāna mina l-ḍālīna
And forgive my father Indeed, he is of those astray

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:87
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:87 - وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
walā tukh'zinī yawma yub'ʿathūna
And (do) not disgrace me (on the) Day they are resurrected

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:88
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:88 - يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun walā banūna
(The) Day not will benefit wealth and not sons

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:89
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:89 - إِلَّا مَنْ أَتٰی اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ illā man atā l-laha biqalbin salīmin Except (he) who comes (to) Allah with a heart sound
  • [1] That is, a heart that is free from the love of the world.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:90
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:90 - وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna
And (will be) brought near the Paradise for the righteous

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:91
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:91 - وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
waburrizati l-jaḥīmu lil'ghāwīna
And (will be) made manifest the Hellfire to the deviators

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:92
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:92 - وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
waqīla lahum ayna mā kuntum taʿbudūna
And it will be said to them Where (is) that you used (to) worship

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:93
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:93 - مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنْصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ
min dūni l-lahi hal yanṣurūnakum aw yantaṣirūna
Besides Allah Besides Allah Besides Allah Can they help you or help themselves

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:94
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:94 - فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ
fakub'kibū fīhā hum wal-ghāwūna
Then they will be overturned into it they and the deviators

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:95
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:95 - وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
wajunūdu ib'līsa ajmaʿūna
And (the) hosts (of) Iblis all together

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:96
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:96 - قَالُوْا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
qālū wahum fīhā yakhtaṣimūna
They (will) say while they in it (are) disputing

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:97
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:97 - تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنَّا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
tal-lahi in kunnā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin
By Allah indeed we were surely in error clear

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:98
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:98 - إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
idh nusawwīkum birabbi l-ʿālamīna
When we equated you with (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:99
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:99 - وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
wamā aḍallanā illā l-muj'rimūna
And not misguided us except the criminals

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:100
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:100 - فَمَا لَنَا مِنْ شَافِعِينَ
famā lanā min shāfiʿīna
So (now) not we have any intercessors

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:101
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:101 - وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
walā ṣadīqin ḥamīmin
And not a friend close

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:102
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:102 - فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna mina l-mu'minīna
Then if that we had a return then we could be of the believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:103
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:103 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely is a Sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:104
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:104 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:105
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:105 - كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
kadhabat qawmu nūḥin l-mur'salīna
Denied (the) people (of) Nuh the Messengers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:106
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:106 - إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūna
When said to them their brother Nuh Will not you fear (Allah)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:107
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:107 - اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
innī lakum rasūlun amīnun
Indeed, I am to you a Messenger trustworthy

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:108
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:108 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:109
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:109 - وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And not I ask (of) you for it any payment Not (is) my payment but from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:110
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:110 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:111
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:111 - قَالُوْا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ
qālū anu'minu laka wa-ittabaʿaka l-ardhalūna
They said Should we believe in you while followed you the lowest

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:112
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:112 - قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
qāla wamā ʿil'mī bimā kānū yaʿmalūna
He said And what (do) I know of what they used (to) do

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:113
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:113 - إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
in ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūna
Verily their account (is) but upon my Lord if you perceive

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:114
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:114 - وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wamā anā biṭāridi l-mu'minīna
And not I am the one to drive away the believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:115
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:115 - إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
in anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun
Not I am but a warner clear

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:116
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:116 - قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَانُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ
qālū la-in lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina l-marjūmīna
They said If not you desist O Nuh Surely you will be of those who are stoned

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:117
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:117 - قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ
qāla rabbi inna qawmī kadhabūni
He said My Lord Indeed my people have denied me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:118
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:118 - فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَنْ مَعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
fa-if'taḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥan wanajjinī waman maʿiya mina l-mu'minīna
So judge between me and between them (with decisive) judgment and save me and who (are) with me of the believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:119
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:119 - فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
fa-anjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni
So We saved him and who (were) with him in the ship laden

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:120
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:120 - ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ
thumma aghraqnā baʿdu l-bāqīna
Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:121
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:121 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely, (is) a sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:122
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:122 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely, He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:123
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:123 - كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
kadhabat ʿādun l-mur'salīna
Denied (the people) of Aad the Messengers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:124
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:124 - إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūna
When said to them their brother Hud Will not you fear (Allah)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:125
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:125 - اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
innī lakum rasūlun amīnun
Indeed, I am to you a Messenger trustworthy

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:126
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:126 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:127
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:127 - وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And not I ask you for it any payment Not (is) my payment except from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:128
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:128 - أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ اٰیَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
atabnūna bikulli rīʿin āyatan taʿbathūna
Do you construct on every elevation a sign amusing yourselves

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:129
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:129 - وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
watattakhidhūna maṣāniʿa laʿallakum takhludūna
And take for yourselves strongholds that you may live forever

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:130
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:130 - وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
wa-idhā baṭashtum baṭashtum jabbārīna
And when you seize you seize (as) tyrants

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:131
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:131 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:132
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:132 - وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
wa-ittaqū alladhī amaddakum bimā taʿlamūna
And fear the One Who has aided you with what you know

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:133
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:133 - أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ
amaddakum bi-anʿāmin wabanīna
He has aided you with cattle and children

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:134
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:134 - وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
wajannātin waʿuyūnin
And gardens and springs

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:135
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:135 - اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
Indeed, I [I] fear for you (the) punishment (of) a Day Great

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:136
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:136 - قَالُوْا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ
qālū sawāon ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takun mina l-wāʿiẓīna
They said (It is) same to us whether you advise or not you are of the advisors

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:137
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:137 - إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ in hādhā illā khuluqu l-awalīna Not (is) this but (the) custom (of) the former (people)
  • [1] Or, 'This is nothing but a fabrication of the ancients,' according to an alternate reading (khaluq, instead of khuluq).

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:138
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:138 - وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna
And not we (are) the ones to be punished

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:139
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:139 - فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
So they denied him then We destroyed them Indeed in that surely, is a sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:140
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:140 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely, He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:141
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:141 - كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
kadhabat thamūdu l-mur'salīna
Denied Thamud the Messengers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:142
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:142 - إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūna
When said to them their brother Salih Will not you fear (Allah)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:143
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:143 - اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
innī lakum rasūlun amīnun
Indeed, I am to you a Messenger trustworthy

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:144
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:144 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:145
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:145 - وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And not I ask you for it any payment Not (is) my payment except from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:146
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:146 - أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا ءَامِنِينَ
atut'rakūna fī mā hāhunā āminīna
Will you be left in what (is) here secure

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:147
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:147 - فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
fī jannātin waʿuyūnin
In gardens and springs

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:148
item.description:
