Ash-Shu'araa:148 - وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
wazurūʿin wanakhlin ṭalʿuhā haḍīmun
And cornfields and date-palms its spadix soft

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:149
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:149 - وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ watanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan fārihīna And you carve of the mountains houses skillfully
  • [1] Or, 'exultantly.'

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:150
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:150 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:151
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:151 - وَلَا تُطِيعُوْۤا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
walā tuṭīʿū amra l-mus'rifīna
And (do) not obey (the) command (of) the transgressors

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:152
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:152 - اَلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
alladhīna yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna
Those who spread corruption in the earth and (do) not reform

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:153
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:153 - قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ
qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna
They said Only you (are) of those bewitched

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:154
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:154 - مَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِاٰیَةٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
mā anta illā basharun mith'lunā fati biāyatin in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna
Not you (are) except a man like us so bring a sign if you (are) of the truthful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:155
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:155 - قَالَ هَذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ
qāla hādhihi nāqatun lahā shir'bun walakum shir'bu yawmin maʿlūmin
He said This (is) a she-camel For her (is a share of) drink and for you (is a share of) drink (on) a day known

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:156
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:156 - وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin
And (do) not touch her with harm lest seize you (the) punishment (of) a Day Great

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:157
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:157 - فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ
faʿaqarūhā fa-aṣbaḥū nādimīna
But they hamstrung her then they became regretful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:158
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:158 - فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
So seized them the punishment Indeed in that surely is a sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:159
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:159 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:160
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:160 - كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
kadhabat qawmu lūṭin l-mur'salīna
Denied (the) people (of) Lut the Messengers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:161
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:161 - إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūna
When said to them their brother Lut Will not you fear (Allah)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:162
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:162 - اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
innī lakum rasūlun amīnun
Indeed, I am to you a Messenger trustworthy

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:163
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:163 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:164
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:164 - وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And not I ask you for it any payment Not (is) my payment except from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:165
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:165 - أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ
atatūna l-dhuk'rāna mina l-ʿālamīna
Do you approach the males among the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:166
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:166 - وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum bal antum qawmun ʿādūna
And you leave what created for you your Lord of your mates Nay you (are) a people transgressing

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:167
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:167 - قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهِ يَالُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ
qālū la-in lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina l-mukh'rajīna
They said If not you desist O Lut Surely, you will be of the ones driven out

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:168
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:168 - قَالَ اِنِّیْ لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِنَ الْقَالِينَ
qāla innī liʿamalikum mina l-qālīna
He said Indeed, I am (of) your deed of those who detest

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:169
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:169 - رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
rabbi najjinī wa-ahlī mimmā yaʿmalūna
My Lord Save me and my family from what they do

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:170
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:170 - فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna
So We saved him and his family all

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:171
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:171 - إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ
illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna
Except an old woman (was) among those who remained behind

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:172
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:172 - ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ
thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna
Then We destroyed the others

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:173
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:173 - وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna
And We rained upon them a rain and evil was (was) the rain (on) those who were warned

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:174
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:174 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely is a sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:175
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:175 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely, He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:176
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:176 - كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
kadhaba aṣḥābu al'aykati l-mur'salīna
Denied (the) companions (of the) Wood the Messengers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:177
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:177 - إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūna
When said to them Shuaib Will not you fear (Allah)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:178
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:178 - اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
innī lakum rasūlun amīnun
Indeed, I am to you a Messenger trustworthy

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:179
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:179 - فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:180
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:180 - وَمَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And not I ask (of) you for it any payment Not (is) my payment except from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:181
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:181 - أَوْفُوْۤا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوْۤا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ
awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīna
Give full measure and (do) not be of those who cause loss

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:182
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:182 - وَزِنُوْۤا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ
wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīmi
And weigh with a balance [the] even

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:183
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:183 - وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna
And (do) not deprive people (of) their things and (do) not commit evil in the earth spreading corruption

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:184
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:184 - وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
wa-ittaqū alladhī khalaqakum wal-jibilata l-awalīna
And fear the One Who created you and the generations the former

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:185
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:185 - قَالُوْا إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ
qālū innamā anta mina l-musaḥarīna
They said Only you (are) of those bewitched

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:186
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:186 - وَمَا أَنْتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا وَإِنْ نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
wamā anta illā basharun mith'lunā wa-in naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīna
And not you (are) except a man like us and indeed we think you surely (are) of the liars

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:187
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:187 - فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mina l-samāi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna
Then cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky if you are of the truthful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:188
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:188 - قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
qāla rabbī aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna
He said My Lord knows best of what you do

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:189
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:189 - فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi l-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
But they denied him so seized them (the) punishment (of the) day (of) the shadow Indeed, it was (the) punishment (of) a Day Great

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:190
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:190 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna
Indeed in that surely, is a sign but not are most of them believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:191
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:191 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
And indeed your Lord surely, He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:192
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:192 - وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنْزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wa-innahu latanzīlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And indeed, it surely, is a Revelation (of the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:193
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:193 - نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ
nazala bihi l-rūḥu l-amīnu
Has brought it down Has brought it down the Spirit [the] Trustworthy

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:194
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:194 - عَلَى قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ
ʿalā qalbika litakūna mina l-mundhirīna
Upon your heart that you may be of the warners

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:195
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:195 - بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُبِينٍ
bilisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīnin
In language Arabic clear

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:196
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:196 - وَإِنَّهُ لَفِیْ زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
wa-innahu lafī zuburi l-awalīna
And indeed, it surely, (is) in (the) Scriptures (of) the former (people)

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:197
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:197 - أَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ اٰیَةً أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَؤُا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ
awalam yakun lahum āyatan an yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīla
Is it not Is it not to them a sign that know it (the) scholars (of the) Children (of) Israel

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:198
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:198 - وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ
walaw nazzalnāhu ʿalā baʿḍi l-aʿjamīna
And if We (had) revealed it to any (of) the non-Arabs

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:199
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:199 - فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīna
And he (had) recited it to them not they would in it (be) believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:200
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:200 - كَذٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
kadhālika salaknāhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna
Thus We have inserted it into (the) hearts (of) the criminals

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:201
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:201 - لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتّٰی يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma
Not they will believe in it until they see the punishment [the] painful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:202
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:202 - فَيَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna
And it will come to them suddenly while they (do) not perceive

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:203
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:203 - فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُونَ
fayaqūlū hal naḥnu munẓarūna
Then they will say Are we (to be) reprieved

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:204
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:204 - أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna
So is it for Our punishment they wish to hasten

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:205
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:205 - أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ
afara-ayta in mattaʿnāhum sinīna
Then have you seen if We let them enjoy (for) years

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:206
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:206 - ثُمَّ جَاءَهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ
thumma jāahum mā kānū yūʿadūna
Then comes to them what they were promised

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:207
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:207 - مَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يُمَتَّعُونَ
mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūna
Not (will) avail them what enjoyment they were given enjoyment they were given

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:208
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:208 - وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُونَ
wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūna
And not We destroyed any town but it had warners

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:209
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:209 - ذِكْرٰی وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
dhik'rā wamā kunnā ẓālimīna
(To) remind and not We are unjust

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:210
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:210 - وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ wamā tanazzalat bihi l-shayāṭīnu And not have brought it down have brought it down the devils
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:211
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:211 - وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
wamā yanbaghī lahum wamā yastaṭīʿūna
And not (it) suits [for] them and not they are able

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:212
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:212 - إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
innahum ʿani l-samʿi lamaʿzūlūna
Indeed, they from the hearing (are) surely banished

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:213
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:213 - فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ
falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīna
So (do) not invoke with Allah god another lest you be of those punished

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:214
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:214 - وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ
wa-andhir ʿashīrataka l-aqrabīna
And warn your kindred [the] closest

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:215
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:215 - وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna
And lower your wing to (those) who follow you of the believers

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:216
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:216 - فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّیْ بَرِيءٌ مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīon mimmā taʿmalūna
Then if they disobey you then say Indeed, I am innocent of what you do

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:217
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:217 - وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ
watawakkal ʿalā l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīmi
And put (your) trust in the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:218
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:218 - اَلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
alladhī yarāka ḥīna taqūmu
The One Who sees you when you stand up

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:219
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:219 - وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ
wataqallubaka fī l-sājidīna
And your movements among those who prostrate

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:220
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:220 - إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu
Indeed, He He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:221
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:221 - هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ
hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu l-shayāṭīnu
Shall I inform you upon whom descend the devils

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:222
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:222 - تَنَزَّلُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
tanazzalu ʿalā kulli affākin athīmin
They descend upon every liar sinful

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:223
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:223 - يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ
yul'qūna l-samʿa wa-aktharuhum kādhibūna
They pass on (what is) heard and most of them (are) liars

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:224
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:224 - وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ
wal-shuʿarāu yattabiʿuhumu l-ghāwūna
And the poets follow them the deviators

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:225
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:225 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
alam tara annahum fī kulli wādin yahīmūna
Do not you see that they in every valley [they] roam

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:226
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:226 - وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
wa-annahum yaqūlūna mā lā yafʿalūna
And that they say what not they do

item.title: Ash-Shu'araa:227
item.description:
Ash-Shu'araa:227 - إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْۤا وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا أَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَنْقَلِبُونَ
illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīran wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabin yanqalibūna
Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah much and defend themselves after after after they were wronged And will come to know those who have wronged (to) what return they will return

item.title: 27. النمل (An-Naml)
item.description:
The surah that speaks of the Valley of The Ants, through which the hosts of the prophet Solomon were once marching, wherein God miraculously enabled Solomon to hear one of them as she warned the other to flee into their homes before being crushed—a miracle of audition and understanding for which Solomon thanked God profusely. It takes its name from the story of Solomon and the ant (naml), mentioned in verse 18 ff. The surah both opens and closes by describing the Quran as joyful news for the believers and a warning for others. It gives stories of past prophets and the destruction of the communities that disbelieved in them. Illustrations are given of the nature of God's power, contrasted with the total lack of power of the "partners" they worship beside Him, and descriptions are given of the Day of Judgement for those who deny it.

27:1
طس تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
tta-seen til'ka āyātu l-qur'āni wakitābin mubīnin
Ta Seen These (are the) Verses (of) the Quran and a Book clear

27:2
هُدًى وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
hudan wabush'rā lil'mu'minīna
A guidance and glad tidings for the believers

27:3
اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūna
Those who establish the prayer and give zakah and they in the Hereafter they believe with certainty

item.title: An-Naml:1
item.description:
An-Naml:1 - طس تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
tta-seen til'ka āyātu l-qur'āni wakitābin mubīnin
Ta Seen These (are the) Verses (of) the Quran and a Book clear

item.title: An-Naml:2
item.description:
An-Naml:2 - هُدًى وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
hudan wabush'rā lil'mu'minīna
A guidance and glad tidings for the believers

item.title: An-Naml:3
item.description:
An-Naml:3 - اَلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūna
Those who establish the prayer and give zakah and they in the Hereafter they believe with certainty

item.title: An-Naml:4
item.description:
An-Naml:4 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati zayyannā lahum aʿmālahum fahum yaʿmahūna
Indeed those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter We have made fair-seeming to them their deeds so they wander blindly

item.title: An-Naml:5
item.description:
An-Naml:5 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ
ulāika alladhīna lahum sūu l-ʿadhābi wahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūna
Those (are) the ones for them (is) an evil [the] punishment and they in the Hereafter they (will be) the greatest losers

item.title: An-Naml:6
item.description:
An-Naml:6 - وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
wa-innaka latulaqqā l-qur'āna min ladun ḥakīmin ʿalīmin
And indeed, you surely, receive the Quran from [near] from [near] the All-Wise the All-Knower

item.title: An-Naml:7
item.description:
An-Naml:7 - إِذْ قَالَ مُوسٰی لِأَهْلِهِ اِنِّیْ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَءَاتِيكُمْ مِنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
idh qāla mūsā li-ahlihi innī ānastu nāran saātīkum min'hā bikhabarin aw ātīkum bishihābin qabasin laʿallakum taṣṭalūna
When said Musa to his family Indeed, I perceive a fire I will bring you from it some information or I will bring you a torch burning so that you may warm yourselves

item.title: An-Naml:8
item.description:
An-Naml:8 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنْ بُورِكَ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
falammā jāahā nūdiya an būrika man fī l-nāri waman ḥawlahā wasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
But when he came to it he was called that Blessed is who (is) at the fire and whoever (is) around it And glory be (to) Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: An-Naml:9
item.description:
An-Naml:9 - يَامُوسٰی إِنَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
yāmūsā innahu anā l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
O Musa Indeed I Am Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: An-Naml:10
item.description:
An-Naml:10 - وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَانٌّ وَلَّى مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَامُوسٰی لَا تَخَفْ اِنِّیْ لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الْمُرْسَلُونَ
wa-alqi ʿaṣāka falammā raāhā tahtazzu ka-annahā jānnun wallā mud'biran walam yuʿaqqib yāmūsā lā takhaf innī lā yakhāfu ladayya l-mur'salūna
And, "Throw your staff But when he saw it moving as if it (were) a snake he turned back (in) flight and (did) not look back O Musa (Do) not fear Indeed, [I] (do) not fear (in) My presence the Messengers

item.title: An-Naml:11
item.description:
An-Naml:11 - إِلَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًا بَعْدَ سُوءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
illā man ẓalama thumma baddala ḥus'nan baʿda sūin fa-innī ghafūrun raḥīmun
Except who wrongs then substitutes good after evil then indeed, I Am Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: An-Naml:12
item.description:
An-Naml:12 - وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ فِي تِسْعِ ءَايَاتٍ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
wa-adkhil yadaka fī jaybika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin fī tis'ʿi āyātin ilā fir'ʿawna waqawmihi innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna
And enter your hand into your bosom it will come forth white without without harm (These are) among nine signs to Firaun and his people Indeed, they are a people defiantly disobedient

item.title: An-Naml:13
item.description:
An-Naml:13 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
falammā jāathum āyātunā mub'ṣiratan qālū hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun
But when came to them Our Signs visible they said This (is) a magic manifest

item.title: An-Naml:14
item.description:
An-Naml:14 - وَجَحَدُوْۤا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
wajaḥadū bihā wa-is'tayqanathā anfusuhum ẓul'man waʿuluwwan fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muf'sidīna
And they rejected them though were convinced with them (signs) themselves (out of) injustice and haughtiness So see how was (the) end (of) the corrupters

item.title: An-Naml:15
item.description:
An-Naml:15 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا دَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
walaqad ātaynā dāwūda wasulaymāna ʿil'man waqālā l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī faḍḍalanā ʿalā kathīrin min ʿibādihi l-mu'minīna
And verily We gave Dawood and Sulaiman knowledge and they said Praise be to Allah the One Who has favored us over many of His servants the believers

item.title: An-Naml:16
item.description:
An-Naml:16 - وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ
wawaritha sulaymānu dāwūda waqāla yāayyuhā l-nāsu ʿullim'nā manṭiqa l-ṭayri waūtīnā min kulli shayin inna hādhā lahuwa l-faḍlu l-mubīnu
And inherited Sulaiman Dawood And he said O people We have been taught (the) language (of) the birds and we have been given from every thing Indeed this surely, it (is) the favor evident

item.title: An-Naml:17
item.description:
An-Naml:17 - وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
waḥushira lisulaymāna junūduhu mina l-jini wal-insi wal-ṭayri fahum yūzaʿūna
And were gathered for Sulaiman his hosts of jinn and the men and the birds and they (were) set in rows

item.title: An-Naml:18
item.description:
An-Naml:18 - حَتّٰی إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَى وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَاأَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوْۤا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ḥattā idhā ataw ʿalā wādi l-namli qālat namlatun yāayyuhā l-namlu ud'khulū masākinakum lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaymānu wajunūduhu wahum lā yashʿurūna
Until when they came to (the) valley (of) the ants said an ant O ants Enter your dwellings lest not crush you lest not crush you Sulaiman and his hosts while they (do) not perceive (do) not perceive

item.title: An-Naml:19
item.description:
An-Naml:19 - فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
fatabassama ḍāḥikan min qawlihā waqāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-adkhil'nī biraḥmatika fī ʿibādika l-ṣāliḥīna
So he smiled laughing at her speech and said My Lord Grant me (the) power that I may thank You (for) Your Favor which You have bestowed on me and on my parents and that I may do righteous (deeds) that will please You And admit me by Your Mercy among Your slaves righteous

item.title: An-Naml:20
item.description:
An-Naml:20 - وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرٰی الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ
watafaqqada l-ṭayra faqāla mā liya lā arā l-hud'huda am kāna mina l-ghāibīna
And he inspected the birds and said Why Why not I see the hoopoe or is he from the absent

item.title: An-Naml:21
item.description:
An-Naml:21 - لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
la-uʿadhibannahu ʿadhāban shadīdan aw laādh'baḥannahu aw layatiyannī bisul'ṭānin mubīnin
I will surely punish him (with) a punishment severe or I will surely slaughter him unless he brings me a reason clear

item.title: An-Naml:22
item.description:
An-Naml:22 - فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
famakatha ghayra baʿīdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihi waji'tuka min saba-in binaba-in yaqīnin
So he stayed not long and he said I have encompassed that which not you have encompassed it and I have come to you from Saba with news certain

item.title: An-Naml:23
item.description:
An-Naml:23 - اِنِّیْ وَجَدْتُ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
innī wajadttu im'ra-atan tamlikuhum waūtiyat min kulli shayin walahā ʿarshun ʿaẓīmun
Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great

item.title: An-Naml:24
item.description:
An-Naml:24 - وَجَدْتُهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
wajadttuhā waqawmahā yasjudūna lilshamsi min dūni l-lahi wazayyana lahumu l-shayṭānu aʿmālahum faṣaddahum ʿani l-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūna
And I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah instead of Allah instead of Allah and has made fair-seeming to them the Shaitaan their deeds and averted them from the Way so they (are) not guided

item.title: An-Naml:25
item.description:
An-Naml:25 - أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
allā yasjudū lillahi alladhī yukh'riju l-khaba-a fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayaʿlamu mā tukh'fūna wamā tuʿ'linūna
That not they prostrate to Allah the One Who brings forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare

item.title: An-Naml:26
item.description:
An-Naml:26 - اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi
Allah (there is) no god but He (the) Lord (of) the Throne the Great

item.title: An-Naml:27
item.description:
An-Naml:27 - قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta mina l-kādhibīna
He said We will see whether you speak (the) truth or you are of the liars

item.title: An-Naml:28
item.description:
An-Naml:28 - اِذْهَبْ بِكِتَابِي هَذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
idh'hab bikitābī hādhā fa-alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla ʿanhum fa-unẓur mādhā yarjiʿūna
Go with my letter this and deliver it to them Then turn away from them and see what they return

item.title: An-Naml:29
item.description:
An-Naml:29 - قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ اِنِّیْ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ
qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u innī ul'qiya ilayya kitābun karīmun
She said O chiefs Indeed [I] is delivered to me a letter noble

item.title: An-Naml:30
item.description:
An-Naml:30 - إِنَّهُ مِنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
innahu min sulaymāna wa-innahu bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi
Indeed, it (is) from Sulaiman and indeed it (is) In the name (of) Allah the Most Gracious the Most Merciful

item.title: An-Naml:31
item.description:
An-Naml:31 - أَلَّا تَعْلُوْۤا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
allā taʿlū ʿalayya watūnī mus'limīna
That not exalt yourselves against me but come to me (in) submission

item.title: An-Naml:32
item.description:
An-Naml:32 - قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتّٰی تَشْهَدُونِ
qālat yāayyuhā l-mala-u aftūnī fī amrī mā kuntu qāṭiʿatan amran ḥattā tashhadūni
She said O chiefs Advise me in my affair Not I would be the one to decide any matter until you are present with me

item.title: An-Naml:33
item.description:
An-Naml:33 - قَالُوْا نَحْنُ أُولُوْۤا قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُوْۤا بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانْظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatin wa-ulū basin shadīdin wal-amru ilayki fa-unẓurī mādhā tamurīna
They said We (are) possessors (of) strength and possessors (of) might great and the command (is) up to you so look what you will command

item.title: An-Naml:34
item.description:
An-Naml:34 - قَالَتْ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوْۤا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوْۤا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
qālat inna l-mulūka idhā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wajaʿalū aʿizzata ahlihā adhillatan wakadhālika yafʿalūna
She said Indeed the kings when they enter a town they ruin it and make (the) most honorable (of) its people (the) lowest And thus they do

item.title: An-Naml:35
item.description:
An-Naml:35 - وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ
wa-innī mur'silatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratun bima yarjiʿu l-mur'salūna
But indeed, I am going to send to them a gift and see with what return the messengers

item.title: An-Naml:36
item.description:
An-Naml:36 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَا ءَاتَانِ اللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا ءَاتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ falammā jāa sulaymāna qāla atumiddūnani bimālin famā ātāniya l-lahu khayrun mimmā ātākum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūna So when came (to) Sulaiman he said Will you provide me with wealth But what Allah has given me Allah has given me (is) better than what He has given you Nay you in your gift rejoice
  • [1] That is, the envoy.

item.title: An-Naml:37
item.description:
An-Naml:37 - اِرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُودٍ لَا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِنْهَا أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ
ir'jiʿ ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunūdin lā qibala lahum bihā walanukh'rijannahum min'hā adhillatan wahum ṣāghirūna
Return to them surely, we will come to them with hosts not (is) resistance for them of it and surely, we will drive them out from there (in) humiliation and they (will be) abased

item.title: An-Naml:38
item.description:
An-Naml:38 - قَالَ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
qāla yāayyuhā l-mala-u ayyukum yatīnī biʿarshihā qabla an yatūnī mus'limīna
He said O chiefs Which of you will bring me her throne before that they come to me (in) submission

item.title: An-Naml:39
item.description:
An-Naml:39 - قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ qāla ʿif'rītun mina l-jini anā ātīka bihi qabla an taqūma min maqāmika wa-innī ʿalayhi laqawiyyun amīnun Said a strong one of the jinn I will bring it to you will bring it to you before that you rise from your place And indeed, I am for it surely, strong trustworthy
  • [1] Ifrīt (noun): devil, demon, giant, rebel; (adj.) cunning, sly, wily, smart, mischievous, rebellious, defiant.

item.title: An-Naml:40
item.description:
An-Naml:40 - قَالَ الَّذِي عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا ءَاتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهُ قَالَ هَذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ qāla alladhī ʿindahu ʿil'mun mina l-kitābi anā ātīka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka ṭarfuka falammā raāhu mus'taqirran ʿindahu qāla hādhā min faḍli rabbī liyabluwanī a-ashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fa-innamā yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fa-inna rabbī ghaniyyun karīmun Said one who with him (was) knowledge of the Scripture I will bring it to you will bring it to you before that returns to you your glance Then when he saw it placed before him he said This (is) from (the) Favor (of) my Lord to test me whether I am grateful or I am ungrateful And whoever (is) grateful then only he is grateful for his own soul And whoever (is) ungrateful then indeed my Lord (is) Self-sufficient Noble
  • [1] He is said to have been Solomon's vizier and successor, Āṣif ibn Barkhiyā.

item.title: An-Naml:41
item.description:
An-Naml:41 - قَالَ نَكِّرُوْۤا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِي أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
qāla nakkirū lahā ʿarshahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu mina alladhīna lā yahtadūna
He said Disguise for her her throne we will see whether she will be guided or will be of those who are not guided are not guided

item.title: An-Naml:42
item.description:
An-Naml:42 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ falammā jāat qīla ahākadhā ʿarshuki qālat ka-annahu huwa waūtīnā l-ʿil'ma min qablihā wakunnā mus'limīna So when she came it was said Is like this your throne She said It is like it And we were given the knowledge before her before her and we have been Muslims
  • [1] That is, 'we had knowledge of Solomon's extraordinary authority even before we saw such feats and we had submitted to him.'

item.title: An-Naml:43
item.description:
An-Naml:43 - وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ
waṣaddahā mā kānat taʿbudu min dūni l-lahi innahā kānat min qawmin kāfirīna
And has averted her what she used (to) worship besides besides Allah Indeed, she was from a people who disbelieve

item.title: An-Naml:44
item.description:
An-Naml:44 - قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُمَرَّدٌ مِنْ قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
qīla lahā ud'khulī l-ṣarḥa falammā ra-athu ḥasibathu lujjatan wakashafat ʿan sāqayhā qāla innahu ṣarḥun mumarradun min qawārīra qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa-aslamtu maʿa sulaymāna lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
It was said to her Enter the palace Then when she saw it she thought it (was) a pool and she uncovered on her shins He said Indeed, it (is) a palace made smooth of glass She said My Lord indeed, I [I] have wronged myself and I submit with Sulaiman to Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: An-Naml:45
item.description:
An-Naml:45 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
walaqad arsalnā ilā thamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani uʿ'budū l-laha fa-idhā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūna
And certainly We sent to Thamud their brother Salih that Worship Allah Then behold They (became) two parties quarreling

item.title: An-Naml:46
item.description:
An-Naml:46 - قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
qāla yāqawmi lima tastaʿjilūna bil-sayi-ati qabla l-ḥasanati lawlā tastaghfirūna l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna
He said O my people Why (do) you seek to hasten the evil before the good Why not you ask forgiveness (of) Allah so that you may receive mercy

item.title: An-Naml:47
item.description:
An-Naml:47 - قَالُوْا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ
qālū iṭṭayyarnā bika wabiman maʿaka qāla ṭāirukum ʿinda l-lahi bal antum qawmun tuf'tanūna
They said We consider you a bad omen We consider you a bad omen and those with you He said Your bad omen (is) with Allah Nay you (are) a people being tested

item.title: An-Naml:48
item.description:
An-Naml:48 - وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ wakāna fī l-madīnati tis'ʿatu rahṭin yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna And were in the city nine family heads they were spreading corruption in the land and not reforming
  • [1] Or 'nine families' (or gangs).

item.title: An-Naml:49
item.description:
An-Naml:49 - قَالُوْا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
qālū taqāsamū bil-lahi lanubayyitannahu wa-ahlahu thumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihi mā shahid'nā mahlika ahlihi wa-innā laṣādiqūna
They said Swear to each other by Allah surely, we will attack him by night and his family Then we will surely say to his heir Not we witnessed (the) destruction (of) his family and indeed, we (are) surely truthful

item.title: An-Naml:50
item.description:
An-Naml:50 - وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
wamakarū makran wamakarnā makran wahum lā yashʿurūna
So they plotted a plot and We planned a plan while they (did) not perceive

item.title: An-Naml:51
item.description:
An-Naml:51 - فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum waqawmahum ajmaʿīna
Then see how was (the) end (of) their plot that We destroyed them and their people all

item.title: An-Naml:52
item.description:
An-Naml:52 - فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
fatil'ka buyūtuhum khāwiyatan bimā ẓalamū inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yaʿlamūna
So, these (are) their houses ruined because they wronged Indeed in that surely, is a sign for a people who know

item.title: An-Naml:53
item.description:
An-Naml:53 - وَأَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ
wa-anjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna
And We saved those who believed and used (to) fear (Allah)

item.title: An-Naml:54
item.description:
An-Naml:54 - وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
walūṭan idh qāla liqawmihi atatūna l-fāḥishata wa-antum tub'ṣirūna
And Lut when he said to his people Do you commit [the] immorality while you see

item.title: An-Naml:55
item.description:
An-Naml:55 - أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
a-innakum latatūna l-rijāla shahwatan min dūni l-nisāi bal antum qawmun tajhalūna
Why do you approach the men (with) lust instead of instead of the women Nay you (are) a people ignorant

item.title: An-Naml:56
item.description:
An-Naml:56 - فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا أَخْرِجُوْۤا اٰلَ لُوطٍ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
famā kāna jawāba qawmihi illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭin min qaryatikum innahum unāsun yataṭahharūna
But not was (the) answer (of) his people except that they said Drive out (the) family (of) Lut from your town Indeed, they (are) people who keep clean and pure

item.title: An-Naml:57
item.description:
An-Naml:57 - فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ
fa-anjaynāhu wa-ahlahu illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnāhā mina l-ghābirīna
So We saved him and his family except his wife We destined her (to be) of those who remained behind

item.title: An-Naml:58
item.description:
An-Naml:58 - وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna
And We rained upon them a rain and was evil (the) rain (on) those who were warned

item.title: An-Naml:59
item.description:
An-Naml:59 - قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَى ءَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
quli l-ḥamdu lillahi wasalāmun ʿalā ʿibādihi alladhīna iṣ'ṭafā āllahu khayrun ammā yush'rikūna
Say All praise (be) to Allah and peace (be) upon His slaves those whom He has chosen Is Allah better or what they associate (with Him)

item.title: An-Naml:60
item.description:
An-Naml:60 - أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُنْبِتُوْۤا شَجَرَهَا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ amman khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa-anzala lakum mina l-samāi māan fa-anbatnā bihi ḥadāiqa dhāta bahjatin mā kāna lakum an tunbitū shajarahā a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal hum qawmun yaʿdilūna Or Who has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you from the sky water And We caused to grow thereby gardens of beauty (and delight) of beauty (and delight) not it is for you that you cause to grow their trees Is there any god with Allah Nay they (are) a people who ascribe equals
  • [1] Ellipsis. The omitted phrase here and in the following verses ( (Q 27:61) - (Q 27:64)) is 'better or the partners they ascribe to Him.'

item.title: An-Naml:61
item.description:
An-Naml:61 - أَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
amman jaʿala l-arḍa qarāran wajaʿala khilālahā anhāran wajaʿala lahā rawāsiya wajaʿala bayna l-baḥrayni ḥājizan a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna
Or Who made the earth a firm abode and made (in) its midst rivers and made for it firm mountains and made between the two seas a barrier Is there any god with Allah Nay most of them (do) not know

item.title: An-Naml:62
item.description:
An-Naml:62 - أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ الْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
amman yujību l-muḍ'ṭara idhā daʿāhu wayakshifu l-sūa wayajʿalukum khulafāa l-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna
Or Who responds (to) the distressed one when he calls Him and He removes the evil and makes you inheritors (of) the earth Is there any god with Allah Little (is) what you remember

item.title: An-Naml:63
item.description:
An-Naml:63 - أَمَّنْ يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى اللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
amman yahdīkum fī ẓulumāti l-bari wal-baḥri waman yur'silu l-riyāḥa bush'ran bayna yaday raḥmatihi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi taʿālā l-lahu ʿammā yush'rikūna
Or Who guides you in (the) darkness[es] (of) the land and the sea and Who sends the winds (as) glad tidings before before His Mercy Is there any god with Allah High is Allah above what they associate (with Him)

item.title: An-Naml:64
item.description:
An-Naml:64 - أَمَّنْ يَبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَءِلَهٌ مَعَ اللَّهِ قُلْ هَاتُوْۤا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
amman yabda-u l-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhu waman yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi a-ilāhun maʿa l-lahi qul hātū bur'hānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Or Who originates the creation then repeats it and Who provides you from the heavens and the earth Is there any god with Allah Say Bring forth your proof if you are truthful

item.title: An-Naml:65
item.description:
An-Naml:65 - قُلْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
qul lā yaʿlamu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi l-ghayba illā l-lahu wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna
Say No (one) knows whoever (is) in the heavens and the earth (of) the unseen except Allah and not they perceive when they will be resurrected

item.title: An-Naml:66
item.description:
An-Naml:66 - بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْهَا بَلْ هُمْ مِنْهَا عَمُونَ
bali iddāraka ʿil'muhum fī l-ākhirati bal hum fī shakkin min'hā bal hum min'hā ʿamūna
Nay is arrested their knowledge of the Hereafter Nay they (are) in doubt about it Nay they about it (are) blind

item.title: An-Naml:67
item.description:
An-Naml:67 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَءَابَاؤُنَا أَءِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū a-idhā kunnā turāban waābāunā a-innā lamukh'rajūna
And say those who disbelieve What, when we have become dust and our forefathers will we surely be brought out

item.title: An-Naml:68
item.description:
An-Naml:68 - لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
laqad wuʿid'nā hādhā naḥnu waābāunā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna
Certainly we have been promised this we and our forefathers before before Not (is) this except tales (of) the former (people)

item.title: An-Naml:69
item.description:
An-Naml:69 - قُلْ سِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
qul sīrū fī l-arḍi fa-unẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-muj'rimīna
Say Travel in the land and see how was (the) end (of) the criminals

item.title: An-Naml:70
item.description:
An-Naml:70 - وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُنْ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
walā taḥzan ʿalayhim walā takun fī ḍayqin mimmā yamkurūna
And (do) not grieve over them and not be in distress from what they plot

item.title: An-Naml:71
item.description:
An-Naml:71 - وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And they say When (will) this promise (be fulfilled) if you are truthful

item.title: An-Naml:72
item.description:
An-Naml:72 - قُلْ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
qul ʿasā an yakūna radifa lakum baʿḍu alladhī tastaʿjilūna
Say Perhaps that is close behind you some (of) that which you seek to hasten

item.title: An-Naml:73
item.description:
An-Naml:73 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
wa-inna rabbaka ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna aktharahum lā yashkurūna
And indeed your Lord (is) full of Bounty (is) full of Bounty for the mankind but most of them (are) not grateful

item.title: An-Naml:74
item.description:
An-Naml:74 - وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
wa-inna rabbaka layaʿlamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wamā yuʿ'linūna
And indeed your Lord surely knows what conceals their breasts and what they declare

item.title: An-Naml:75
item.description:
An-Naml:75 - وَمَا مِنْ غَائِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ wamā min ghāibatin fī l-samāi wal-arḍi illā fī kitābin mubīnin And not (is) any (thing) hidden in the heavens and the earth but (is) in a Record clear
  • [1] That is, in 'the Guarded Tablet.'

item.title: An-Naml:76
item.description:
An-Naml:76 - إِنَّ هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ الَّذِي هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
inna hādhā l-qur'āna yaquṣṣu ʿalā banī is'rāīla akthara alladhī hum fīhi yakhtalifūna
Indeed this [the] Quran relates to (the) Children (of) Israel most (of) that they in it differ

item.title: An-Naml:77
item.description:
An-Naml:77 - وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wa-innahu lahudan waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna
And indeed, it (is) surely a guidance and a mercy for the believers

item.title: An-Naml:78
item.description:
An-Naml:78 - إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ
inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum biḥuk'mihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu
Indeed your Lord will judge between them by His Judgment and He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Knower

item.title: An-Naml:79
item.description:
An-Naml:79 - فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ
fatawakkal ʿalā l-lahi innaka ʿalā l-ḥaqi l-mubīni
So put your trust in Allah indeed, you (are) on the truth manifest

item.title: An-Naml:80
item.description:
An-Naml:80 - إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰی وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ
innaka lā tus'miʿu l-mawtā walā tus'miʿu l-ṣuma l-duʿāa idhā wallaw mud'birīna
Indeed, you (can) not cause to hear the dead and not can you cause to hear the deaf the call when they turn back retreating

item.title: An-Naml:81
item.description:
An-Naml:81 - وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِي الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
wamā anta bihādī l-ʿum'yi ʿan ḍalālatihim in tus'miʿu illā man yu'minu biāyātinā fahum mus'limūna
And not (can) you guide the blind from their error Not you can cause to hear except (those) who believe in Our Signs so they (are) Muslims

item.title: An-Naml:82
item.description:
An-Naml:82 - وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَابَّةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ لَا يُوقِنُونَ wa-idhā waqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim akhrajnā lahum dābbatan mina l-arḍi tukallimuhum anna l-nāsa kānū biāyātinā lā yūqinūna And when (is) fulfilled the word against them We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them that the people were of Our Signs not certain
  • [1] Or 'a beast.'

item.title: An-Naml:83
item.description:
An-Naml:83 - وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِمَّنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ wayawma naḥshuru min kulli ummatin fawjan mimman yukadhibu biāyātinā fahum yūzaʿūna And (the) Day We will gather from every nation a troop of (those) who deny Our Signs and they will be set in rows
  • [1] See (Q 20:124) - (Q 20:125) where ḥashr is used in the sense of resurrection.

item.title: An-Naml:84
item.description:
An-Naml:84 - حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِءَايَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوْۤا بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ḥattā idhā jāū qāla akadhabtum biāyātī walam tuḥīṭū bihā ʿil'man ammādhā kuntum taʿmalūna
Until when they come He will say Did you deny My Signs while not you encompassed them (in) knowledge or what you used (to) do

item.title: An-Naml:85
item.description:
An-Naml:85 - وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْۤا فَهُمْ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ
wawaqaʿa l-qawlu ʿalayhim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūna
And (will be) fulfilled the word against them because they wronged and they (will) not speak

item.title: An-Naml:86
item.description:
An-Naml:86 - أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
alam yaraw annā jaʿalnā al-layla liyaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna
Do not they see that We [We] have made the night that they may rest in it and the day giving visibility Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for a people who believe

item.title: An-Naml:87
item.description:
An-Naml:87 - وَيَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ
wayawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fafaziʿa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu wakullun atawhu dākhirīna
And (the) Day will be blown in the trumpet and will be terrified whoever (is) in the heavens and whoever (is) in the earth except whom Allah wills Allah wills And all (will) come to Him humbled

item.title: An-Naml:88
item.description:
An-Naml:88 - وَتَرٰی الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
watarā l-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidatan wahiya tamurru marra l-saḥābi ṣun'ʿa l-lahi alladhī atqana kulla shayin innahu khabīrun bimā tafʿalūna
And you see the mountains thinking them firmly fixed while they will pass (as the) passing (of) the clouds (The) Work (of) Allah Who perfected all things Indeed, He (is) All-Aware of what you do

item.title: An-Naml:89
item.description:
An-Naml:89 - مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَهُمْ مِنْ فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
man jāa bil-ḥasanati falahu khayrun min'hā wahum min fazaʿin yawma-idhin āminūna
Whoever comes with the good then for him (will be) better than it and they from (the) terror (of) that Day (will be) safe

item.title: An-Naml:90
item.description:
An-Naml:90 - وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
waman jāa bil-sayi-ati fakubbat wujūhuhum fī l-nāri hal tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
And whoever comes with the evil will be cast down their faces in the Fire Are you recompensed except (for) what you used (to) do

item.title: An-Naml:91
item.description:
An-Naml:91 - إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ innamā umir'tu an aʿbuda rabba hādhihi l-baldati alladhī ḥarramahā walahu kullu shayin wa-umir'tu an akūna mina l-mus'limīna Only I am commanded that I worship (the) Lord (of) this city the One Who made it sacred and to Him (belongs) all things And I am commanded that I be of the Muslims
  • [1] That is, the holy city of Makkah.
  • [2] Or 'sacred.'

item.title: An-Naml:92
item.description:
An-Naml:92 - وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَ الْقُرْآنَ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ
wa-an atluwā l-qur'āna famani ih'tadā fa-innamā yahtadī linafsihi waman ḍalla faqul innamā anā mina l-mundhirīna
And that I recite the Quran And whoever accepts guidance then only he accepts guidance for himself and whoever goes astray then say Only I am of the warners

item.title: An-Naml:93
item.description:
An-Naml:93 - وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
waquli l-ḥamdu lillahi sayurīkum āyātihi fataʿrifūnahā wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā taʿmalūna
And say All praise (be) to Allah He will show you His Signs and you will recognize them And your Lord is not And your Lord is not unaware of what you do

item.title: 28. القصص (Al-Qasas)
item.description:
The surah that mentions how Moses came to the wells of Midian and related to the aged believer, whose daughters he had helped, the series of events and The Story of his flight from Egypt; and that mentions, as well, the stories of Moses' call to prophethood and confrontation with Pharaoh, his Exodus with the Children of Israel, and that of Korah of Israel, whom God destroyed. It takes its name from verse 25 wherein the word "story" (qaṣaṣ) occurs. Its main theme is the bad end that comes to those who are arrogant and spread corruption—polytheism is denounced at various points throughout the surah—and a link is made between these and the disbelievers of Mecca. The Prophet is reminded that he cannot make everyone believe (verse 56) and should remain steadfast (verse 87).
The surah is also known as The History, The Narration, The Stories

28:1
طسم
tta-seen-meem
Ta Seem Meem

28:2
تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni
These (are the) Verses (of) the Book the clear

28:3
نَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسٰی وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
natlū ʿalayka min naba-i mūsā wafir'ʿawna bil-ḥaqi liqawmin yu'minūna
We recite to you from (the) news (of) Musa and Firaun in truth for a people who believe

item.title: Al-Qasas:1
item.description:
Al-Qasas:1 - طسم
tta-seen-meem
Ta Seem Meem

item.title: Al-Qasas:2
item.description:
Al-Qasas:2 - تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
til'ka āyātu l-kitābi l-mubīni
These (are the) Verses (of) the Book the clear

item.title: Al-Qasas:3
item.description:
Al-Qasas:3 - نَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسٰی وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
natlū ʿalayka min naba-i mūsā wafir'ʿawna bil-ḥaqi liqawmin yu'minūna
We recite to you from (the) news (of) Musa and Firaun in truth for a people who believe

item.title: Al-Qasas:4
item.description:
Al-Qasas:4 - إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
inna fir'ʿawna ʿalā fī l-arḍi wajaʿala ahlahā shiyaʿan yastaḍʿifu ṭāifatan min'hum yudhabbiḥu abnāahum wayastaḥyī nisāahum innahu kāna mina l-muf'sidīna
Indeed Firaun exalted himself in the land and made its people (into) sects oppressing a group among them slaughtering their sons and letting live their women Indeed, he was of the corrupters

item.title: Al-Qasas:5
item.description:
Al-Qasas:5 - وَنُرِيدُ أَنْ نَمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوَارِثِينَ
wanurīdu an namunna ʿalā alladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū fī l-arḍi wanajʿalahum a-immatan wanajʿalahumu l-wārithīna
And We wanted to bestow a favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them the inheritors

item.title: Al-Qasas:6
item.description:
Al-Qasas:6 - وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَحْذَرُونَ wanumakkina lahum fī l-arḍi wanuriya fir'ʿawna wahāmāna wajunūdahumā min'hum mā kānū yaḥdharūna And [We] establish them in the land and show Firaun and Haman and their hosts through them what they were fearing
  • [1] That is, from the Israelites.

item.title: Al-Qasas:7
item.description:
Al-Qasas:7 - وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَى أُمِّ مُوسٰی أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحْزَنِي إِنَّا رَادُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
wa-awḥaynā ilā ummi mūsā an arḍiʿīhi fa-idhā khif'ti ʿalayhi fa-alqīhi fī l-yami walā takhāfī walā taḥzanī innā rāddūhu ilayki wajāʿilūhu mina l-mur'salīna
And We inspired to (the) mother (of) Musa that Suckle him but when you fear for him then cast him in(to) the river and (do) not fear and (do) not grieve Indeed, We (will) restore him to you and (will) make him of the Messengers

item.title: Al-Qasas:8
item.description:
Al-Qasas:8 - فَالْتَقَطَهُ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَنًا إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوْۤا خَاطِءِينَ
fal-taqaṭahu ālu fir'ʿawna liyakūna lahum ʿaduwwan waḥazanan inna fir'ʿawna wahāmāna wajunūdahumā kānū khāṭiīna
Then picked him up (the) family (of) Firaun so that he might become to them an enemy and a grief Indeed Firaun and Haman and their hosts were sinners

item.title: Al-Qasas:9
item.description:
Al-Qasas:9 - وَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِي وَلَكَ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
waqālati im'ra-atu fir'ʿawna qurratu ʿaynin lī walaka lā taqtulūhu ʿasā an yanfaʿanā aw nattakhidhahu waladan wahum lā yashʿurūna
And said (the) wife (of) Firaun A comfort (of the) eye for me and for you (Do) not kill him perhaps (that) he may benefit us or we may take him (as) a son And they (did) not perceive

item.title: Al-Qasas:10
item.description:
Al-Qasas:10 - وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسٰی فَارِغًا إِنْ كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلَا أَنْ رَبَطْنَا عَلَى قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wa-aṣbaḥa fuādu ummi mūsā fārighan in kādat latub'dī bihi lawlā an rabaṭnā ʿalā qalbihā litakūna mina l-mu'minīna
And became (the) heart (of the) mother (of) Musa empty That she was near (to) disclosing about him if not that We strengthened over her heart so that she would be of the believers

item.title: Al-Qasas:11
item.description:
Al-Qasas:11 - وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِ قُصِّيهِ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِ عَنْ جُنُبٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
waqālat li-ukh'tihi quṣṣīhi fabaṣurat bihi ʿan junubin wahum lā yashʿurūna
And she said to his sister Follow him So she watched him from a distance while they (did) not perceive

item.title: Al-Qasas:12
item.description:
Al-Qasas:12 - وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَرَاضِعَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ يَكْفُلُونَهُ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ نَاصِحُونَ waḥarramnā ʿalayhi l-marāḍiʿa min qablu faqālat hal adullukum ʿalā ahli baytin yakfulūnahu lakum wahum lahu nāṣiḥūna And We had forbidden for him the wet nurses before before so she said Shall I direct you to (the) people (of) a house who will rear him for you while they to him (will be) sincere
  • [1] That is, Moses' sister.

item.title: Al-Qasas:13
item.description:
Al-Qasas:13 - فَرَدَدْنَاهُ إِلَى أُمِّهِ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
faradadnāhu ilā ummihi kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana walitaʿlama anna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
So We restored him to his mother that might be comforted her eye and not she may grieve and that she would know that the Promise of Allah the Promise of Allah (is) true But most of them (do) not know

item.title: Al-Qasas:14
item.description:
Al-Qasas:14 - وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَاسْتَوَى اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
walammā balagha ashuddahu wa-is'tawā ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wakadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
And when he reached his full strength and became mature We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge And thus We reward the good-doers

item.title: Al-Qasas:15
item.description:
Al-Qasas:15 - وَدَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَى حِينِ غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَذَا مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ وَهَذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ فَاسْتَغَاثَهُ الَّذِي مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ عَلَى الَّذِي مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ فَوَكَزَهُ مُوسٰی فَقَضَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ هَذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ عَدُوٌّ مُضِلٌّ مُبِينٌ
wadakhala l-madīnata ʿalā ḥīni ghaflatin min ahlihā fawajada fīhā rajulayni yaqtatilāni hādhā min shīʿatihi wahādhā min ʿaduwwihi fa-is'taghāthahu alladhī min shīʿatihi ʿalā alladhī min ʿaduwwihi fawakazahu mūsā faqaḍā ʿalayhi qāla hādhā min ʿamali l-shayṭāni innahu ʿaduwwun muḍillun mubīnun
And he entered the city at a time (of) inattention of its people and found therein two men fighting each other this of his party and this of his enemy And called him for help the one who (was) from his party against the one who (was) from his enemy so Musa struck him with his fist so Musa struck him with his fist and killed him and killed him He said This (is) of (the) deed (of) Shaitaan Indeed, he (is) an enemy one who misleads clearly

item.title: Al-Qasas:16
item.description:
Al-Qasas:16 - قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
qāla rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa-igh'fir lī faghafara lahu innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
He said My Lord Indeed, I [I] have wronged my soul so forgive [for] me Then He forgave [for] him Indeed He He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Qasas:17
item.description:
Al-Qasas:17 - قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ
qāla rabbi bimā anʿamta ʿalayya falan akūna ẓahīran lil'muj'rimīna
He said My Lord Because You have favored [on] me so not I will be a supporter (of) the criminals

item.title: Al-Qasas:18
item.description:
Al-Qasas:18 - فَأَصْبَحَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ خَائِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي اسْتَنْصَرَهُ بِالْأَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ قَالَ لَهُ مُوسٰی إِنَّكَ لَغَوِيٌّ مُبِينٌ
fa-aṣbaḥa fī l-madīnati khāifan yataraqqabu fa-idhā alladhī is'tanṣarahu bil-amsi yastaṣrikhuhu qāla lahu mūsā innaka laghawiyyun mubīnun
In the morning he was in the city fearful (and) was vigilant when behold The one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him for help Said to him Musa Indeed, you (are) surely a deviator clear

item.title: Al-Qasas:19
item.description:
Al-Qasas:19 - فَلَمَّا أَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْطِشَ بِالَّذِي هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَهُمَا قَالَ يَامُوسٰی أَتُرِيدُ أَنْ تَقْتُلَنِي كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا بِالْأَمْسِ إِنْ تُرِيدُ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ جَبَّارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ falammā an arāda an yabṭisha bi-alladhī huwa ʿaduwwun lahumā qāla yāmūsā aturīdu an taqtulanī kamā qatalta nafsan bil-amsi in turīdu illā an takūna jabbāran fī l-arḍi wamā turīdu an takūna mina l-muṣ'liḥīna Then when that he wanted to strike the one who [he] (was) an enemy to both of them he said O Musa Do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday Not you want but that you become a tyrant in the earth and not you want that you be of the reformers
  • [1] Although Moses wanted to help him again much against his own inclination, the Israelite thought that Moses was going to attack him.

item.title: Al-Qasas:20
item.description:
Al-Qasas:20 - وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَقْصَا الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَى قَالَ يَامُوسٰی إِنَّ الْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَاخْرُجْ اِنِّیْ لَكَ مِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ
wajāa rajulun min aqṣā l-madīnati yasʿā qāla yāmūsā inna l-mala-a yatamirūna bika liyaqtulūka fa-ukh'ruj innī laka mina l-nāṣiḥīna
And came a man from (the) farthest end (of) the city running He said O Musa Indeed the chiefs are taking counsel about you to kill you so leave indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors

item.title: Al-Qasas:21
item.description:
Al-Qasas:21 - فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَائِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
fakharaja min'hā khāifan yataraqqabu qāla rabbi najjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna
So he left from it fearing (and) vigilant He said My Lord Save me from the people the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Qasas:22
item.description:
Al-Qasas:22 - وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَاءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسٰۤی رَبِّي أَنْ يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ
walammā tawajjaha til'qāa madyana qāla ʿasā rabbī an yahdiyanī sawāa l-sabīli
And when he turned his face towards Madyan he said Perhaps my Lord that will guide me (to the) sound way

item.title: Al-Qasas:23
item.description:
Al-Qasas:23 - وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَاءَ مَدْيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةً مِنَ النَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِمُ امْرَأَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِي حَتّٰی يُصْدِرَ الرِّعَاءُ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ
walammā warada māa madyana wajada ʿalayhi ummatan mina l-nāsi yasqūna wawajada min dūnihimu im'ra-atayni tadhūdāni qāla mā khaṭbukumā qālatā lā nasqī ḥattā yuṣ'dira l-riʿāu wa-abūnā shaykhun kabīrun
And when he came (to the) water (of) Madyan he found on it a group of men watering and he found besides them besides them two women keeping back He said What (is the) matter with both of you They said We cannot water We cannot water until take away the shepherds and our father (is) a very old man (is) a very old man

item.title: Al-Qasas:24
item.description:
Al-Qasas:24 - فَسَقَى لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّى إِلَى الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
fasaqā lahumā thumma tawallā ilā l-ẓili faqāla rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīrun
So he watered for them Then he turned back to the shade and said My Lord Indeed, I am of whatever You send to me of good (in) need

item.title: Al-Qasas:25
item.description:
Al-Qasas:25 - فَجَاءَتْهُ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِي يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
fajāathu iḥ'dāhumā tamshī ʿalā is'tiḥ'yāin qālat inna abī yadʿūka liyajziyaka ajra mā saqayta lanā falammā jāahu waqaṣṣa ʿalayhi l-qaṣaṣa qāla lā takhaf najawta mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna
Then came to him one of the two women walking with shyness She said Indeed my father calls you that he may reward you (the) reward (for) what you watered for us So when he came to him and narrated to him the story he said (Do) not fear You have escaped from the people the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Qasas:26
item.description:
Al-Qasas:26 - قَالَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا يَاأَبَتِ اسْتَءْجِرْهُ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتَءْجَرْتَ الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ
qālat iḥ'dāhumā yāabati is'tajir'hu inna khayra mani is'tajarta l-qawiyu l-amīnu
Said one of them O my father Hire him Indeed (the) best whom you (can) hire (is) the strong the trustworthy

item.title: Al-Qasas:27
item.description:
Al-Qasas:27 - قَالَ اِنِّیْ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنْكِحَكَ إِحْدَى ابْنَتَيَّ هَاتَيْنِ عَلَى أَنْ تَأْجُرَنِي ثَمَانِيَ حِجَجٍ فَإِنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
qāla innī urīdu an unkiḥaka iḥ'dā ib'natayya hātayni ʿalā an tajuranī thamāniya ḥijajin fa-in atmamta ʿashran famin ʿindika wamā urīdu an ashuqqa ʿalayka satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna
He said Indeed, I [I] wish to marry you to one (of) my daughters (of) these two on that you serve me (for) eight years but if you complete ten then from you And not I wish to make it difficult for you You will find me if Allah wills Allah wills of the righteous

item.title: Al-Qasas:28
item.description:
Al-Qasas:28 - قَالَ ذٰلِكَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ أَيَّمَا الْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَانَ عَلَيَّ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ qāla dhālika baynī wabaynaka ayyamā l-ajalayni qaḍaytu falā ʿud'wāna ʿalayya wal-lahu ʿalā mā naqūlu wakīlun He said That (is) between me and between you Whichever (of) the two terms I complete then no injustice to me and Allah over what we say (is) a Witness
  • [1] Or 'it shall be no unfairness toward me.'

item.title: Al-Qasas:29
item.description:
Al-Qasas:29 - فَلَمَّا قَضَى مُوسٰی الْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِ ءَانَسَ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوْۤا اِنِّیْ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَعَلِّي ءَاتِيكُمْ مِنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
falammā qaḍā mūsā l-ajala wasāra bi-ahlihi ānasa min jānibi l-ṭūri nāran qāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā bikhabarin aw jadhwatin mina l-nāri laʿallakum taṣṭalūna
Then when Musa fulfilled Musa fulfilled the term and was traveling with his family he saw in (the) direction (of) Mount Tur a fire He said to his family Stay here indeed, I [I] perceive a fire Perhaps I will bring you from there some information or a burning wood from the fire so that you may warm yourselves

item.title: Al-Qasas:30
item.description:
Al-Qasas:30 - فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ مِنْ شَاطِئِ الْوَادِ الْأَيْمَنِ فِي الْبُقْعَةِ الْمُبَارَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ أَنْ يَامُوسٰی اِنِّیْ أَنَا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
falammā atāhā nūdiya min shāṭi-i l-wādi l-aymani fī l-buq'ʿati l-mubārakati mina l-shajarati an yāmūsā innī anā l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna
But when he came (to) it he was called from (the) side (of) the valley the right in the place even blessed from the tree that O Musa Indeed I Am Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Qasas:31
item.description:
Al-Qasas:31 - وَأَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَانٌّ وَلَّى مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَامُوسٰی أَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْءَامِنِينَ
wa-an alqi ʿaṣāka falammā raāhā tahtazzu ka-annahā jānnun wallā mud'biran walam yuʿaqqib yāmūsā aqbil walā takhaf innaka mina l-āminīna
And [that] throw your staff But when he saw it moving as if it (were) a snake he turned (in) flight and (did) not return O Musa Draw near and (do) not fear Indeed, you (are) of the secure

item.title: Al-Qasas:32
item.description:
Al-Qasas:32 - اُسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ وَاضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ فَذَانِكَ بُرْهَانَانِ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
us'luk yadaka fī jaybika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin wa-uḍ'mum ilayka janāḥaka mina l-rahbi fadhānika bur'hānāni min rabbika ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna
Insert your hand in your bosom it will come forth white without without any harm And draw to yourselves your hand against fear So these (are) two evidences from your Lord to Firaun and his chiefs Indeed, they are a people defiantly disobedient

item.title: Al-Qasas:33
item.description:
Al-Qasas:33 - قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ
qāla rabbi innī qataltu min'hum nafsan fa-akhāfu an yaqtulūni
He said My Lord Indeed I killed of them a man and I fear that they will kill me

item.title: Al-Qasas:34
item.description:
Al-Qasas:34 - وَأَخِي هَارُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانًا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِيَ رِدْءًا يُصَدِّقُنِي اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ
wa-akhī hārūnu huwa afṣaḥu minnī lisānan fa-arsil'hu maʿiya rid'an yuṣaddiqunī innī akhāfu an yukadhibūni
And my brother Harun he (is) more eloquent than me (in) speech so send him with me (as) a helper who will confirm me Indeed I fear that they will deny me

item.title: Al-Qasas:35
item.description:
Al-Qasas:35 - قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَانًا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ أَنْتُمَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الْغَالِبُونَ
qāla sanashuddu ʿaḍudaka bi-akhīka wanajʿalu lakumā sul'ṭānan falā yaṣilūna ilaykumā biāyātinā antumā wamani ittabaʿakumā l-ghālibūna
He said We will strengthen your arm through your brother and We will make for both of you an authority so not they will reach to both of you Through Our Signs you two and (those) who follow you (will) be the dominant

item.title: Al-Qasas:36
item.description:
Al-Qasas:36 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالُوْا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُفْتَرًى وَمَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي ءَابَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ
falammā jāahum mūsā biāyātinā bayyinātin qālū mā hādhā illā siḥ'run muf'taran wamā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīna
But when came to them Musa with Our Signs clear they said Not (is) this except a magic invented and not we heard of this among our forefathers our forefathers

item.title: Al-Qasas:37
item.description:
Al-Qasas:37 - وَقَالَ مُوسٰی رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ جَاءَ بِالْهُدَى مِنْ عِنْدِهِ وَمَنْ تَكُونُ لَهُ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ
waqāla mūsā rabbī aʿlamu biman jāa bil-hudā min ʿindihi waman takūnu lahu ʿāqibatu l-dāri innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-ẓālimūna
And Musa said And Musa said My Lord knows best of who has come with [the] guidance from Him from Him and who will be for him the good end in the Hereafter the good end in the Hereafter Indeed not will be successful the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Qasas:38
item.description:
Al-Qasas:38 - وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَهٍ غَيْرِي فَأَوْقِدْ لِي يَاهَامَانُ عَلَى الطِّينِ فَاجْعَلْ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَطَّلِعُ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسٰی وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu yāayyuhā l-mala-u mā ʿalim'tu lakum min ilāhin ghayrī fa-awqid lī yāhāmānu ʿalā l-ṭīni fa-ij'ʿal lī ṣarḥan laʿallī aṭṭaliʿu ilā ilāhi mūsā wa-innī la-aẓunnuhu mina l-kādhibīna And Firaun said And Firaun said O chiefs O chiefs Not I know for you any god other than me So kindle for me O Haman Upon the clay and make for me a lofty tower so that [I] I may look at (the) God (of) Musa And indeed, I [I] think that he (is) of the liars
  • [1] That is, 'Light for me kilns for baking bricks of clay to build a tower from which I may take a look at the God of Moses.' Meant as a sarcasm aimed at Moses and the Israelites, many of whom were used as forced labour to make bricks.

item.title: Al-Qasas:39
item.description:
Al-Qasas:39 - وَاسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا يُرْجَعُونَ
wa-is'takbara huwa wajunūduhu fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi waẓannū annahum ilaynā lā yur'jaʿūna
And he was arrogant And he was arrogant and his hosts in the land without right and they thought that they to Us not will be returned

item.title: Al-Qasas:40
item.description:
Al-Qasas:40 - فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظَّالِمِينَ
fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-ẓālimīna
So We seized him and his hosts and We threw them in the sea So see how was (the) end (of) the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Qasas:41
item.description:
Al-Qasas:41 - وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَدْعُونَ إِلَى النَّارِ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ
wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yadʿūna ilā l-nāri wayawma l-qiyāmati lā yunṣarūna
And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire and (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection not they will be helped

item.title: Al-Qasas:42
item.description:
Al-Qasas:42 - وَأَتْبَعْنَاهُمْ فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ هُمْ مِنَ الْمَقْبُوحِينَ
wa-atbaʿnāhum fī hādhihi l-dun'yā laʿnatan wayawma l-qiyāmati hum mina l-maqbūḥīna
And We caused to follow them in this world a curse and (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection they (will be) of the despised

item.title: Al-Qasas:43
item.description:
Al-Qasas:43 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ الْأُولَى بَصَائِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba min baʿdi mā ahlaknā l-qurūna l-ūlā baṣāira lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatan laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
And verily We gave Musa the Scripture after [what] after [what] after [what] We had destroyed the generations former (as) an enlightenment for the mankind and a guidance and mercy that they may remember

item.title: Al-Qasas:44
item.description:
Al-Qasas:44 - وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِيِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَا إِلَى مُوسٰی الْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ wamā kunta bijānibi l-gharbiyi idh qaḍaynā ilā mūsā l-amra wamā kunta mina l-shāhidīna And not you were on (the) side western when We decreed to Musa the Commandment and not you were among the witnesses
  • [1] That is, on the western side of the mountain, or valley, of Sinai.
  • [2] Or 'the Law.'
  • [3] Or, 'nor were you among those present.'

item.title: Al-Qasas:45
item.description:
Al-Qasas:45 - وَلَكِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَا قُرُونًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ وَمَا كُنْتَ ثَاوِيًا فِي أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَاتِنَا وَلَكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
walākinnā anshanā qurūnan fataṭāwala ʿalayhimu l-ʿumuru wamā kunta thāwiyan fī ahli madyana tatlū ʿalayhim āyātinā walākinnā kunnā mur'silīna
