The disbelievers of Mecca are warned through a description of the punishment that awaits them on the Day of Resurrection. Two references are made to their accusing the Prophet of madness (verse 8 and verse 46) and this charge is thoroughly refuted.
The surah is also known as The City of Saba

34:1
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ākhirati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīru
All praises (be) to Allah the One to Whom belongs the One to Whom belongs whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth and for Him (are) all praises in the Hereafter And He (is) the All-Wise the All-Aware

34:2
يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ
yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa l-raḥīmu l-ghafūru
He knows what penetrates in the earth and what comes out from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein And He (is) the Most Merciful the Oft-Forgiving

34:3
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tatīnā l-sāʿatu qul balā warabbī latatiyannakum ʿālimi l-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mith'qālu dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābin mubīnin
But say those who disbelieve Not will come to us the Hour Say Nay by my Lord surely it will come to you (He is the) Knower (of) the unseen Not escapes from Him (the) weight (of) an atom in the heavens and not in the earth and not smaller than that and not greater but (is) in a Record Clear

item.title: Saba:1
item.description:
Saba:1 - اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ
al-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi walahu l-ḥamdu fī l-ākhirati wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-khabīru
All praises (be) to Allah the One to Whom belongs the One to Whom belongs whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth and for Him (are) all praises in the Hereafter And He (is) the All-Wise the All-Aware

item.title: Saba:2
item.description:
Saba:2 - يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ
yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa l-raḥīmu l-ghafūru
He knows what penetrates in the earth and what comes out from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein And He (is) the Most Merciful the Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Saba:3
item.description:
Saba:3 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ قُلْ بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tatīnā l-sāʿatu qul balā warabbī latatiyannakum ʿālimi l-ghaybi lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu mith'qālu dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi walā aṣgharu min dhālika walā akbaru illā fī kitābin mubīnin
But say those who disbelieve Not will come to us the Hour Say Nay by my Lord surely it will come to you (He is the) Knower (of) the unseen Not escapes from Him (the) weight (of) an atom in the heavens and not in the earth and not smaller than that and not greater but (is) in a Record Clear

item.title: Saba:4
item.description:
Saba:4 - لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
liyajziya alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun
That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds Those for them (will be) forgiveness and a provision noble

item.title: Saba:5
item.description:
Saba:5 - وَالَّذِينَ سَعَوْا فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ اَلِیْمٌ wa-alladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmun But those who strive against Our Verses (to) cause failure those for them (is) a punishment of foul nature painful
  • [1] That is, owing to their inward defilement. According to an alternate reading which makes alīm the attribute of rijz, the translation will be: 'for such is the torment of a painful punishment.'

item.title: Saba:6
item.description:
Saba:6 - وَيَرٰی الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ هُوَ الْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِي إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
wayarā alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma alladhī unzila ilayka min rabbika huwa l-ḥaqa wayahdī ilā ṣirāṭi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi
And see those who have been given the knowledge (that) what is revealed to you from your Lord it (is) the Truth and it guides to (the) Path (of) the All-Mighty the Praiseworthy

item.title: Saba:7
item.description:
Saba:7 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِیْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū hal nadullukum ʿalā rajulin yunabbi-ukum idhā muzziq'tum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafī khalqin jadīdin
But say those who disbelieve Shall we direct you to a man who informs you when you have disintegrated (in) total disintegration indeed you surely (will be) in a creation new

item.title: Saba:8
item.description:
Saba:8 - أَفْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَمْ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلِ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ فِي الْعَذَابِ وَالضَّلَالِ الْبَعِيدِ
aftarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban am bihi jinnatun bali alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati fī l-ʿadhābi wal-ḍalāli l-baʿīdi
Has he invented about Allah a lie or in him (is) madness Nay those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter (will be) in the punishment and error far

item.title: Saba:9
item.description:
Saba:9 - أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنْ نَشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَةً لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ
afalam yaraw ilā mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi in nasha nakhsif bihimu l-arḍa aw nus'qiṭ ʿalayhim kisafan mina l-samāi inna fī dhālika laāyatan likulli ʿabdin munībin
Then, do not they see towards what (is) before them (is) before them and what (is) behind them of the heaven and the earth If We will We (could) cause to swallow them We (could) cause to swallow them the earth or cause to fall upon them fragments from the sky Indeed in that surely, is a Sign for every slave who turns (to Allah)

item.title: Saba:10
item.description:
Saba:10 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا دَاوُدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا يَاجِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ walaqad ātaynā dāwūda minnā faḍlan yājibālu awwibī maʿahu wal-ṭayra wa-alannā lahu l-ḥadīda And certainly We gave Dawood from Us Bounty O mountains Repeat praises with him and the birds And We made pliable for him [the] iron
  • [1] Cf. (Q 38:17) - (Q 38:19).

item.title: Saba:11
item.description:
Saba:11 - أَنِ اعْمَلْ سَابِغَاتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
ani iʿ'mal sābighātin waqaddir fī l-sardi wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
That make full coats of mail and measure precisely of the links (of armor) and work righteousness Indeed, I Am of what you do All-Seer

item.title: Saba:12
item.description:
Saba:12 - وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ وَمَنْ يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ
walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ghuduwwuhā shahrun warawāḥuhā shahrun wa-asalnā lahu ʿayna l-qiṭ'ri wamina l-jini man yaʿmalu bayna yadayhi bi-idh'ni rabbihi waman yazigh min'hum ʿan amrinā nudhiq'hu min ʿadhābi l-saʿīri
And to Sulaiman the wind its morning course (was) a month and its afternoon course (was) a month and We caused to flow for him a spring (of) molten copper And [of] the jinn who worked before him before him by the permission (of) his Lord And whoever deviated among them from Our Command We will make him taste of (the) punishment (of) the Blaze

item.title: Saba:13
item.description:
Saba:13 - يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُ مَا يَشَاءُ مِنْ مَحَارِيبَ وَتَمَاثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَاسِيَاتٍ اعْمَلُوْۤا اٰلَ دَاوُدَ شُكْرًا وَقَلِيلٌ مِنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ
yaʿmalūna lahu mā yashāu min maḥārība watamāthīla wajifānin kal-jawābi waqudūrin rāsiyātin iʿ'malū āla dāwūda shuk'ran waqalīlun min ʿibādiya l-shakūru
They worked for him what he willed of elevated chambers and statues and bowls like reservoirs and cooking-pots fixed Work O family (of) Dawood (in) gratitude But few of My slaves (are) grateful

item.title: Saba:14
item.description:
Saba:14 - فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَى مَوْتِهِ إِلَّا دَابَّةُ الْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنْسَأَتَهُ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الْجِنُّ أَنْ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ الْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوْۤا فِي الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ
falammā qaḍaynā ʿalayhi l-mawta mā dallahum ʿalā mawtihi illā dābbatu l-arḍi takulu minsa-atahu falammā kharra tabayyanati l-jinu an law kānū yaʿlamūna l-ghayba mā labithū fī l-ʿadhābi l-muhīni
Then when We decreed for him the death not indicated to them on his death except a creature (of) the earth eating his staff But when he fell down became clear (to) the jinn that if they had known the unseen not they (would have) remained in the punishment humiliating

item.title: Saba:15
item.description:
Saba:15 - لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِي مَسْكَنِهِمْ ءَايَةٌ جَنَّتَانِ عَنْ يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ كُلُوْۤا مِنْ رِزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ
laqad kāna lisaba-in fī maskanihim āyatun jannatāni ʿan yamīnin washimālin kulū min riz'qi rabbikum wa-ush'kurū lahu baldatun ṭayyibatun warabbun ghafūrun
Certainly (there) was for Saba in their dwelling place a sign: Two gardens on (the) right and (on the) left Eat from (the) provision (of) your Lord and be grateful to Him A land good and a Lord Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Saba:16
item.description:
Saba:16 - فَأَعْرَضُوا فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ الْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَاهُمْ بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَيْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَيْءٍ مِنْ سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ
fa-aʿraḍū fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim sayla l-ʿarimi wabaddalnāhum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawātay ukulin khamṭin wa-athlin washayin min sid'rin qalīlin
But they turned away so We sent upon them (the) flood (of) the dam and We changed for them their two gardens (with) two gardens producing fruit producing fruit bitter and tamarisks and (some)thing of lote trees few

item.title: Saba:17
item.description:
Saba:17 - ذٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَاهُمْ بِمَا كَفَرُوْۤا وَهَلْ نُجَازِي إِلَّا الْكَفُورَ
dhālika jazaynāhum bimā kafarū wahal nujāzī illā l-kafūra
That We recompensed them because they disbelieved And not We recompense except the ungrateful

item.title: Saba:18
item.description:
Saba:18 - وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْقُرٰی الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَاهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا السَّيْرَ سِيرُوْۤا فِيهَا لَيَالِيَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ
wajaʿalnā baynahum wabayna l-qurā allatī bāraknā fīhā quran ẓāhiratan waqaddarnā fīhā l-sayra sīrū fīhā layāliya wa-ayyāman āminīna
And We made between them and between the towns which We had blessed in it towns visible And We determined between them the journey Travel between them (by) night and (by) day safely

item.title: Saba:19
item.description:
Saba:19 - فَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا بَاعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَاهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
faqālū rabbanā bāʿid bayna asfārinā waẓalamū anfusahum fajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha wamazzaqnāhum kulla mumazzaqin inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
But they said Our Lord lengthen (the distance) between our journeys And they wronged themselves so We made them narrations and We dispersed them (in) a total dispersion Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for everyone patient (and) grateful

item.title: Saba:20
item.description:
Saba:20 - وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُ فَاتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
walaqad ṣaddaqa ʿalayhim ib'līsu ẓannahu fa-ittabaʿūhu illā farīqan mina l-mu'minīna
And certainly found true about them Iblis his assumption so they followed him except a group of the believers

item.title: Saba:21
item.description:
Saba:21 - وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِي شَكٍّ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ
wamā kāna lahu ʿalayhim min sul'ṭānin illā linaʿlama man yu'minu bil-ākhirati mimman huwa min'hā fī shakkin warabbuka ʿalā kulli shayin ḥafīẓun
And not was for him over them any authority except that We (might) make evident who believes in the Hereafter from (one) who he about it (is) in doubt And your Lord over all things (is) a Guardian

item.title: Saba:22
item.description:
Saba:22 - قُلِ ادْعُوْۤا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِنْ شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ ظَهِيرٍ quli id'ʿū alladhīna zaʿamtum min dūni l-lahi lā yamlikūna mith'qāla dharratin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi wamā lahum fīhimā min shir'kin wamā lahu min'hum min ẓahīrin Say Call upon those whom you claim besides besides Allah Not they possess (the) weight (of) an atom in the heavens and not in the earth and not for them in both of them any partnership and not for Him from them any supporter
  • [1] That is, the gods worshipped by the polytheists.

item.title: Saba:23
item.description:
Saba:23 - وَلَا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتّٰی إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوْا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوْا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ walā tanfaʿu l-shafāʿatu ʿindahu illā liman adhina lahu ḥattā idhā fuzziʿa ʿan qulūbihim qālū mādhā qāla rabbukum qālū l-ḥaqa wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīru And not benefits the intercession with Him except for (one) whom He permits for him Until when fear is removed on their hearts they will say What is that your Lord has said your Lord has said They will say The truth And He (is) the Most High the Most Great
  • [1] See Zamakhshari and Ṭabāṭabā'ī. Or 'except of those whom He permits.'

item.title: Saba:24
item.description:
Saba:24 - قُلْ مَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلِ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّا أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَى هُدًى أَوْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
qul man yarzuqukum mina l-samāwāti wal-arḍi quli l-lahu wa-innā aw iyyākum laʿalā hudan aw fī ḍalālin mubīnin
Say Who provides (for) you from the heavens and the earth Say Allah And indeed, we or you (are) surely upon guidance or in error clear

item.title: Saba:25
item.description:
Saba:25 - قُلْ لَا تُسْءَلُونَ عَمَّا أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْءَلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
qul lā tus'alūna ʿammā ajramnā walā nus'alu ʿammā taʿmalūna
Say Not you will be asked about what sins we committed and not we will be asked about what you do

item.title: Saba:26
item.description:
Saba:26 - قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَهُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ qul yajmaʿu baynanā rabbunā thumma yaftaḥu baynanā bil-ḥaqi wahuwa l-fatāḥu l-ʿalīmu Say Will gather us together our Lord then He will judge between us in truth And He (is) the Judge the All-Knowing
  • [1] Or, 'the Judge, the All-knowing.'

item.title: Saba:27
item.description:
Saba:27 - قُلْ أَرُونِيَ الَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُمْ بِهِ شُرَكَاءَ كَلَّا بَلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
qul arūniya alladhīna alḥaqtum bihi shurakāa kallā bal huwa l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
Say Show me those whom you have joined with Him (as) partners By no means Nay He (is) Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Saba:28
item.description:
Saba:28 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا كَافَّةً لِلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
wamā arsalnāka illā kāffatan lilnnāsi bashīran wanadhīran walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
And not We have sent you except comprehensively to mankind (as) a giver of glad tidings and (as) a warner But most [the] people (do) not know

item.title: Saba:29
item.description:
Saba:29 - وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And they say When (is) this promise if you are truthful

item.title: Saba:30
item.description:
Saba:30 - قُلْ لَكُمْ مِيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَا تَسْتَءْخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
qul lakum mīʿādu yawmin lā tastakhirūna ʿanhu sāʿatan walā tastaqdimūna
Say For you (is the) appointment (of) a Day not you can postpone [of] it (for) an hour and not (can) you precede (it)

item.title: Saba:31
item.description:
Saba:31 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ بِهَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِالَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ الْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا لَوْلَا أَنْتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lan nu'mina bihādhā l-qur'āni walā bi-alladhī bayna yadayhi walaw tarā idhi l-ẓālimūna mawqūfūna ʿinda rabbihim yarjiʿu baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin l-qawla yaqūlu alladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū lilladhīna is'takbarū lawlā antum lakunnā mu'minīna
And say those who disbelieve Never will we believe in this Quran and not in (that) which (was) before it (was) before it But if you (could) see when the wrongdoers will be made to stand before their Lord will throw back some of them to others the word Will say those who were oppressed to those who were arrogant If not (for) you certainly we (would) have been believers

item.title: Saba:32
item.description:
Saba:32 - قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَاكُمْ عَنِ الْهُدَى بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَكُمْ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ مُجْرِمِينَ
qāla alladhīna is'takbarū lilladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū anaḥnu ṣadadnākum ʿani l-hudā baʿda idh jāakum bal kuntum muj'rimīna
Will say those who were arrogant to those who were oppressed Did we avert you from the guidance after when it had come to you Nay you were criminals

item.title: Saba:33
item.description:
Saba:33 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا بَلْ مَكْرُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَا أَنْ نَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُ أَنْدَادًا وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا الْأَغْلَالَ فِي أَعْنَاقِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
waqāla alladhīna us'tuḍ'ʿifū lilladhīna is'takbarū bal makru al-layli wal-nahāri idh tamurūnanā an nakfura bil-lahi wanajʿala lahu andādan wa-asarrū l-nadāmata lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba wajaʿalnā l-aghlāla fī aʿnāqi alladhīna kafarū hal yuj'zawna illā mā kānū yaʿmalūna
And will say those who were oppressed to those who were arrogant Nay (it was) a plot (by) night and (by) day when you were ordering us that we disbelieve in Allah and we set up for Him equals But they will conceal the regret when they see the punishment And We will put shackles on (the) necks (of) those who disbelieved Will they be recompensed except (for) what they used to do

item.title: Saba:34
item.description:
Saba:34 - وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ
wamā arsalnā fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna
And not We sent to a town any warner but said its wealthy ones Indeed we in what you have been sent with (are) disbelievers

item.title: Saba:35
item.description:
Saba:35 - وَقَالُوْۤا نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَالًا وَأَوْلَادًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
waqālū naḥnu aktharu amwālan wa-awlādan wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna
And they say We (have) more wealth and children and not we will be punished

item.title: Saba:36
item.description:
Saba:36 - قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
qul inna rabbī yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
Say Indeed my Lord extends the provision for whom He wills and restricts but most [the] people (do) not know

item.title: Saba:37
item.description:
Saba:37 - وَمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ بِالَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِنْدَنَا زُلْفَى إِلَّا مَنْ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَاءُ الضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَهُمْ فِي الْغُرُفَاتِ ءَامِنُونَ wamā amwālukum walā awlādukum bi-allatī tuqarribukum ʿindanā zul'fā illā man āmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika lahum jazāu l-ḍiʿ'fi bimā ʿamilū wahum fī l-ghurufāti āminūna And not your wealth and not your children that will bring you close to Us (in) position but whoever believes and does righteousness then those for them (will be) reward two-fold for what they did and they (will be) in the high dwellings secure
  • [1] Cf. (Q 29:58); (Q 39:20).

item.title: Saba:38
item.description:
Saba:38 - وَالَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
wa-alladhīna yasʿawna fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika fī l-ʿadhābi muḥ'ḍarūna
And those who strive against Our Verses (to) cause failure those into the punishment (will be) brought

item.title: Saba:39
item.description:
Saba:39 - قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
qul inna rabbī yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu min ʿibādihi wayaqdiru lahu wamā anfaqtum min shayin fahuwa yukh'lifuhu wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna
Say Indeed my Lord extends the provision for whom He wills of His slaves and restricts for him But what you spend of anything then He will compensate it and He (is the) Best (of) the Providers

item.title: Saba:40
item.description:
Saba:40 - وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ أَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْبُدُونَ
wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma yaqūlu lil'malāikati ahāulāi iyyākum kānū yaʿbudūna
And (the) Day He will gather them all then He will say to the Angels Were these you Were these you they were worshipping

item.title: Saba:41
item.description:
Saba:41 - قَالُوْا سُبْحَانَكَ أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِنْ دُونِهِمْ بَلْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْبُدُونَ الْجِنَّ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِهِمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ
qālū sub'ḥānaka anta waliyyunā min dūnihim bal kānū yaʿbudūna l-jina aktharuhum bihim mu'minūna
They will say Glory be to You You (are) our Protector not them not them Nay they used (to) worship the jinn most of them in them (were) believers

item.title: Saba:42
item.description:
Saba:42 - فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
fal-yawma lā yamliku baʿḍukum libaʿḍin nafʿan walā ḍarran wanaqūlu lilladhīna ẓalamū dhūqū ʿadhāba l-nāri allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūna
But today not possess power some of you on others to benefit and not to harm and We will say to those who wronged Taste (the) punishment (of) the Fire which you used to [it] deny

item.title: Saba:43
item.description:
Saba:43 - وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالُوْا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوْۤا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ مُفْتَرًى وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qālū mā hādhā illā rajulun yurīdu an yaṣuddakum ʿammā kāna yaʿbudu ābāukum waqālū mā hādhā illā if'kun muf'taran waqāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun
And when are recited to them Our Verses clear they say Not (is) this but a man who wishes to hinder you from what used (to) worship your forefathers And they say Not (is) this except a lie invented And said those who disbelieved about the truth when it came to them Not (is) this except a magic obvious

item.title: Saba:44
item.description:
Saba:44 - وَمَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ wamā ātaynāhum min kutubin yadrusūnahā wamā arsalnā ilayhim qablaka min nadhīrin And not We (had) given them any Scriptures which they could study and not We sent to them before you any warner
  • [1] That is, the pre-Islamic Arabs.
  • [2] Cf. (Q 36:6).

item.title: Saba:45
item.description:
Saba:45 - وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوْۤا مِعْشَارَ مَا ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا رُسُلِي فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ wakadhaba alladhīna min qablihim wamā balaghū miʿ'shāra mā ātaynāhum fakadhabū rusulī fakayfa kāna nakīri And denied those who (were) before them (were) before them and not they have attained a tenth (of) what We (had) given them But they denied My Messengers so how was My rejection
  • [1] Or 'a thousandth.'
  • [2] Or 'how was my requital.'

item.title: Saba:46
item.description:
Saba:46 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَعِظُكُمْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ أَنْ تَقُومُوْۤا لِلَّهِ مَثْنَى وَفُرَادَى ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا مَا بِصَاحِبِكُمْ مِنْ جِنَّةٍ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
qul innamā aʿiẓukum biwāḥidatin an taqūmū lillahi mathnā wafurādā thumma tatafakkarū mā biṣāḥibikum min jinnatin in huwa illā nadhīrun lakum bayna yaday ʿadhābin shadīdin
Say Only I advise you for one (thing) that you stand for Allah (in) pairs and (as) individuals then reflect Not (is in) your companion any madness Not he (is) except a warner for you before before a punishment severe

item.title: Saba:47
item.description:
Saba:47 - قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
qul mā sa-altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illā ʿalā l-lahi wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun
Say Not I ask you for any payment but it (is) for you Not (is) my payment but from Allah And He (is) over all things a Witness

item.title: Saba:48
item.description:
Saba:48 - قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ qul inna rabbī yaqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿallāmu l-ghuyūbi Say Indeed my Lord projects the truth (the) All-Knower (of) the unseen
  • [1] Cf. (Q 17:81); (Q 21:18). Or 'casts the Truth;' i.e., into the hearts of His envoys.

item.title: Saba:49
item.description:
Saba:49 - قُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
qul jāa l-ḥaqu wamā yub'di-u l-bāṭilu wamā yuʿīdu
Say Has come the truth and not (can) originate the falsehood and not repeat

item.title: Saba:50
item.description:
Saba:50 - قُلْ إِنْ ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَا أَضِلُّ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَإِنِ اهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِي إِلَيَّ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
qul in ḍalaltu fa-innamā aḍillu ʿalā nafsī wa-ini ih'tadaytu fabimā yūḥī ilayya rabbī innahu samīʿun qarībun
Say If I err then only I will err against myself But if I am guided then it is by what reveals to me my Lord Indeed, He (is) All-Hearer Ever-Near

item.title: Saba:51
item.description:
Saba:51 - وَلَوْ تَرٰی إِذْ فَزِعُوْۤا فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
walaw tarā idh faziʿū falā fawta wa-ukhidhū min makānin qarībin
And if you (could) see when they will be terrified but (there will be) no escape and they will be seized from a place near

item.title: Saba:52
item.description:
Saba:52 - وَقَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِهِ وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ
waqālū āmannā bihi wa-annā lahumu l-tanāwushu min makānin baʿīdin
And they will say We believe in it But how for them (will be) the receiving from a place far off

item.title: Saba:53
item.description:
Saba:53 - وَقَدْ كَفَرُوْۤا بِهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ
waqad kafarū bihi min qablu wayaqdhifūna bil-ghaybi min makānin baʿīdin
And certainly they disbelieved in it before before And they utter conjectures about the unseen from a place far off

item.title: Saba:54
item.description:
Saba:54 - وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا فِي شَكٍّ مُرِيبٍ
waḥīla baynahum wabayna mā yashtahūna kamā fuʿila bi-ashyāʿihim min qablu innahum kānū fī shakkin murībin
And a barrier will be placed between them and between what they desire as was done with their kind before before Indeed, they were in doubt disquieting

item.title: 35. فاطر (Faatir)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the praise of God as The Originator of the heavens and the earth. It takes its name from the word "fāṭir" (orginator), which occurs in verse 1. The surah affirms God's power and Creation and contrasts this with the powerlessness and uselessness of the "partners" set up by the idolaters. The surah warns the idolaters of their punishment and comforts the Prophet through mention of previous messengers who were also rejected as liars. The great rewards that await believers are described.
The surah is also known as Sole Originator, The Bringer into Being, The Creator

35:1
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
al-ḥamdu lillahi fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jāʿili l-malāikati rusulan ulī ajniḥatin mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa yazīdu fī l-khalqi mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
All praises (be) to Allah Originator (of) the heavens and the earth (Who) makes the Angels messengers having wings having wings two or three or four He increases in the creation what He wills Indeed Allah (is) on every thing All-Powerful

35:2
مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
mā yaftaḥi l-lahu lilnnāsi min raḥmatin falā mum'sika lahā wamā yum'sik falā mur'sila lahu min baʿdihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
What Allah grants Allah grants to mankind of Mercy then none (can) withhold it And what He withholds then none (can) release it thereafter thereafter And He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise

35:3
يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum hal min khāliqin ghayru l-lahi yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna
O mankind Remember (the) Favor (of) Allah upon you Is (there) any creator other (than) Allah other (than) Allah who provides for you from the sky and the earth (There is) no god but He Then, how (are) you deluded

item.title: Faatir:1
item.description:
Faatir:1 - اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنَى وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
al-ḥamdu lillahi fāṭiri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jāʿili l-malāikati rusulan ulī ajniḥatin mathnā wathulātha warubāʿa yazīdu fī l-khalqi mā yashāu inna l-laha ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
All praises (be) to Allah Originator (of) the heavens and the earth (Who) makes the Angels messengers having wings having wings two or three or four He increases in the creation what He wills Indeed Allah (is) on every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Faatir:2
item.description:
Faatir:2 - مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِنْ رَحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ mā yaftaḥi l-lahu lilnnāsi min raḥmatin falā mum'sika lahā wamā yum'sik falā mur'sila lahu min baʿdihi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu What Allah grants Allah grants to mankind of Mercy then none (can) withhold it And what He withholds then none (can) release it thereafter thereafter And He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise
  • [1] That is, after His withholding it. Or 'no one can release it except Him.'

item.title: Faatir:3
item.description:
Faatir:3 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu udh'kurū niʿ'mata l-lahi ʿalaykum hal min khāliqin ghayru l-lahi yarzuqukum mina l-samāi wal-arḍi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna
O mankind Remember (the) Favor (of) Allah upon you Is (there) any creator other (than) Allah other (than) Allah who provides for you from the sky and the earth (There is) no god but He Then, how (are) you deluded

item.title: Faatir:4
item.description:
Faatir:4 - وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ
wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kudhibat rusulun min qablika wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru
And if they deny you then certainly were denied Messengers before you before you And to Allah return the matters

item.title: Faatir:5
item.description:
Faatir:5 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yāayyuhā l-nāsu inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun falā taghurrannakumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā walā yaghurrannakum bil-lahi l-gharūru O mankind Indeed (the) promise (of) Allah (is) true So (let) not deceive you the life (of) the world and (let) not deceive you about Allah the Deceiver
  • [1] Cf. (Q 31:33).

item.title: Faatir:6
item.description:
Faatir:6 - إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوْۤا حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُوْۤا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
inna l-shayṭāna lakum ʿaduwwun fa-ittakhidhūhu ʿaduwwan innamā yadʿū ḥiz'bahu liyakūnū min aṣḥābi l-saʿīri
Indeed the Shaitaan (is) to you an enemy so take him (as) an enemy Only he invites his party that they may be among (the) companions (of) the Blaze

item.title: Faatir:7
item.description:
Faatir:7 - اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
alladhīna kafarū lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun
Those who disbelieve for them (will be) a punishment severe and those who believe and do righteous deeds for them (will be) forgiveness and a reward great

item.title: Faatir:8
item.description:
Faatir:8 - أَفَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ afaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi faraāhu ḥasanan fa-inna l-laha yuḍillu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu falā tadhhab nafsuka ʿalayhim ḥasarātin inna l-laha ʿalīmun bimā yaṣnaʿūna Then is (he) who is made fair-seeming to him (the) evil (of) his deed so that he sees it (as) good For indeed Allah lets go astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills So (let) not go out your soul for them (in) regrets Indeed Allah (is) All-Knower of what they do
  • [1] Ellipsis. The phrase omitted is 'like one who is truly virtuous?'

item.title: Faatir:9
item.description:
Faatir:9 - وَاللَّهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَاهُ إِلَى بَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا كَذٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ
wal-lahu alladhī arsala l-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fasuq'nāhu ilā baladin mayyitin fa-aḥyaynā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā kadhālika l-nushūru
And Allah (is) the One Who sends the winds so that they raise (the) clouds and We drive them to a land dead and We revive therewith the earth after its death Thus (will be) the Resurrection

item.title: Faatir:10
item.description:
Faatir:10 - مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَكْرُ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ man kāna yurīdu l-ʿizata falillahi l-ʿizatu jamīʿan ilayhi yaṣʿadu l-kalimu l-ṭayibu wal-ʿamalu l-ṣāliḥu yarfaʿuhu wa-alladhīna yamkurūna l-sayiāti lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun wamakru ulāika huwa yabūru Whoever [is] desires [is] desires the honor then for Allah (is) the Honor all To Him ascends the words good and the deed righteous raises it But those who plot the evil for them (is) a punishment severe and (the) plotting (of) those it (will) perish
  • [1] The word 'izzah in Arabic has a composite meaning including the senses of honour, prestige, glory and might.
  • [2] Or 'righteous conduct elevates it.'

item.title: Faatir:11
item.description:
Faatir:11 - وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِنْ مُعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنْقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ wal-lahu khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma jaʿalakum azwājan wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wamā yuʿammaru min muʿammarin walā yunqaṣu min ʿumurihi illā fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun And Allah created you from dust then from a semen-drop then He made you pairs And not conceives any female and not gives birth except with His knowledge And not is granted life any aged person and not is lessened from his life but (is) in a Register Indeed that for Allah (is) easy
  • [1] That is, male and female.

item.title: Faatir:12
item.description:
Faatir:12 - وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ وَهَذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَمِنْ كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرٰی الْفُلْكَ فِیْهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ wamā yastawī l-baḥrāni hādhā ʿadhbun furātun sāighun sharābuhu wahādhā mil'ḥun ujājun wamin kullin takulūna laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijūna ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka fīhi mawākhira litabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna And not are alike the two seas This (is) fresh sweet pleasant its drink and this salty (and) bitter And from each you eat meat fresh and you extract ornaments you wear them and you see the ships in it cleaving so that you may seek of His Bounty and that you may be grateful
  • [1] That is, the body of sweet water and the body of fresh water. The word baḥr, like yamm is used for a large river as well as for the sea (cf. (Q 7:136), (Q 20:78), (Q 28:40), (Q 51:40), where it is used for the Red Sea; and (Q 20:39), (Q 28:7), where it is used for the Nile).

item.title: Faatir:13
item.description:
Faatir:13 - يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْ قِطْمِيرٍ
yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku wa-alladhīna tadʿūna min dūnihi mā yamlikūna min qiṭ'mīrin
He causes to enter the night in (to) the day and He causes to enter the day in (to) the night and He has subjected the sun and the moon each running for a term appointed That (is) Allah your Lord for Him (is) the Dominion And those whom you invoke besides Him besides Him not they possess even (as much as) the membrane of a date-seed

item.title: Faatir:14
item.description:
Faatir:14 - إِنْ تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوْۤا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوْۤا مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ
in tadʿūhum lā yasmaʿū duʿāakum walaw samiʿū mā is'tajābū lakum wayawma l-qiyāmati yakfurūna bishir'kikum walā yunabbi-uka mith'lu khabīrin
If you invoke them not they hear your call and if they heard not they (would) respond to you And (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection they will deny your association And none can inform you like (the) All-Aware

item.title: Faatir:15
item.description:
Faatir:15 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
yāayyuhā l-nāsu antumu l-fuqarāu ilā l-lahi wal-lahu huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu
O mankind You (are) those in need of Allah while Allah He (is) Free of need the Praiseworthy

item.title: Faatir:16
item.description:
Faatir:16 - إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
in yasha yudh'hib'kum wayati bikhalqin jadīdin
If He wills He (can) do away with you and bring in a creation new

item.title: Faatir:17
item.description:
Faatir:17 - وَمَا ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
wamā dhālika ʿalā l-lahi biʿazīzin
And not that (is) on Allah difficult

item.title: Faatir:18
item.description:
Faatir:18 - وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی وَإِنْ تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَى حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبٰی إِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَمَنْ تَزَكَّى فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّى لِنَفْسِهِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ
walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā wa-in tadʿu muth'qalatun ilā ḥim'lihā lā yuḥ'mal min'hu shayon walaw kāna dhā qur'bā innamā tundhiru alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata waman tazakkā fa-innamā yatazakkā linafsihi wa-ilā l-lahi l-maṣīru
And not will bear bearer of burdens burden (of) another And if calls a heavily laden to (carry) its load not will be carried of it anything even if he be near of kin near of kin Only you can warn those who fear their Lord unseen and establish the prayer And whoever purifies himself then only he purifies for his own self And to Allah (is) the destination

item.title: Faatir:19
item.description:
Faatir:19 - وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ
wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru
And not equal (are) the blind and the seeing

item.title: Faatir:20
item.description:
Faatir:20 - وَلَا الظُّلُمَاتُ وَلَا النُّورُ
walā l-ẓulumātu walā l-nūru
And not the darkness[es] and not [the] light

item.title: Faatir:21
item.description:
Faatir:21 - وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ
walā l-ẓilu walā l-ḥarūru
And not the shade and not the heat

item.title: Faatir:22
item.description:
Faatir:22 - وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا أَنْتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ
wamā yastawī l-aḥyāu walā l-amwātu inna l-laha yus'miʿu man yashāu wamā anta bimus'miʿin man fī l-qubūri
And not equal (are) the living and not the dead Indeed Allah causes to hear whom He wills and not you can make hear (those) who (are) in the graves

item.title: Faatir:23
item.description:
Faatir:23 - إِنْ أَنْتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
in anta illā nadhīrun
Not you (are) but a warner

item.title: Faatir:24
item.description:
Faatir:24 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَإِنْ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ
innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqi bashīran wanadhīran wa-in min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nadhīrun
Indeed, We [We] have sent you with the truth (as) a bearer of glad tidings and (as) a warner And not (was) any nation but had passed within it a warner

item.title: Faatir:25
item.description:
Faatir:25 - وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ
wa-in yukadhibūka faqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti wabil-zuburi wabil-kitābi l-munīri
And if they deny you then certainly denied those who (were) before them (were) before them Came to them their Messengers with clear signs and with Scriptures and with the Book [the] enlightening

item.title: Faatir:26
item.description:
Faatir:26 - ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
thumma akhadhtu alladhīna kafarū fakayfa kāna nakīri
Then I seized those who disbelieved and how was My rejection

item.title: Faatir:27
item.description:
Faatir:27 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi thamarātin mukh'talifan alwānuhā wamina l-jibāli judadun bīḍun waḥum'run mukh'talifun alwānuhā wagharābību sūdun
Do not you see that Allah sends down from the sky water then We bring forth therewith fruits (of) various [their] colors And in the mountains (are) tracts white and red (of) various [their] colors and intensely black and intensely black

item.title: Faatir:28
item.description:
Faatir:28 - وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذٰلِكَ إِنَّمَا يَخْشٰی اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَؤُا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
wamina l-nāsi wal-dawābi wal-anʿāmi mukh'talifun alwānuhu kadhālika innamā yakhshā l-laha min ʿibādihi l-ʿulamāu inna l-laha ʿazīzun ghafūrun
And among men and moving creatures and the cattle (are) various [their] colors likewise Only fear Allah among His slaves those who have knowledge Indeed Allah (is) All-Mighty Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Faatir:29
item.description:
Faatir:29 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَنْفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ
inna alladhīna yatlūna kitāba l-lahi wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirran waʿalāniyatan yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra
Indeed those who recite (the) Book (of) Allah and establish the prayer and spend out of what We have provided them secretly and openly hope (for) a commerce never it will perish

item.title: Faatir:30
item.description:
Faatir:30 - لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wayazīdahum min faḍlihi innahu ghafūrun shakūrun
That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His Bounty Indeed, He (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Appreciative

item.title: Faatir:31
item.description:
Faatir:31 - وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ
wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka mina l-kitābi huwa l-ḥaqu muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi inna l-laha biʿibādihi lakhabīrun baṣīrun
And (that) which We have revealed to you of the Book it (is) the truth confirming what (was) before it before it Indeed Allah of His slaves surely, (is) All-Aware All-Seer

item.title: Faatir:32
item.description:
Faatir:32 - ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مُقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ thumma awrathnā l-kitāba alladhīna iṣ'ṭafaynā min ʿibādinā famin'hum ẓālimun linafsihi wamin'hum muq'taṣidun wamin'hum sābiqun bil-khayrāti bi-idh'ni l-lahi dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru Then We caused to inherit the Book those whom We have chosen of Our slaves and among them (is he) who wrongs himself and among them (is he who is) moderate and among them (is he who is) foremost in good deeds by permission (of) Allah That is the Bounty the great
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: Faatir:33
item.description:
Faatir:33 - جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
jannātu ʿadnin yadkhulūnahā yuḥallawna fīhā min asāwira min dhahabin walu'lu-an walibāsuhum fīhā ḥarīrun
Gardens (of) Eternity they will enter them They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls and their garments therein (will be of) silk

item.title: Faatir:34
item.description:
Faatir:34 - وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī adhhaba ʿannā l-ḥazana inna rabbanā laghafūrun shakūrun
And they (will) say All praises (be) to Allah the One Who (has) removed from us the sorrow Indeed our Lord (is) surely Oft-Forgiving Most Appreciative

item.title: Faatir:35
item.description:
Faatir:35 - اَلَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ
alladhī aḥallanā dāra l-muqāmati min faḍlihi lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabun walā yamassunā fīhā lughūbun
The One Who has settled us (in) a Home (of) Eternity (out) of His Bounty Not touches us therein any fatigue and not touches therein weariness

item.title: Faatir:36
item.description:
Faatir:36 - وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِهَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ
wa-alladhīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannama lā yuq'ḍā ʿalayhim fayamūtū walā yukhaffafu ʿanhum min ʿadhābihā kadhālika najzī kulla kafūrin
And those who disbelieve for them (will be the) Fire (of) Hell Not is decreed for them that they die and not will be lightened for them of its torment Thus We recompense every ungrateful one

item.title: Faatir:37
item.description:
Faatir:37 - وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُمْ مَا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِیْهِ مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ فَذُوقُوْۤا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ
wahum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā rabbanā akhrij'nā naʿmal ṣāliḥan ghayra alladhī kunnā naʿmalu awalam nuʿammir'kum mā yatadhakkaru fīhi man tadhakkara wajāakumu l-nadhīru fadhūqū famā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīrin
And they will cry therein Our Lord Bring us out we will do righteous (deeds) other than (that) which we used (to) do Did not We give you life long enough that (would) receive admonition therein whoever receives admonition And came to you the warner So taste then not (is) for the wrongdoers any helper

item.title: Faatir:38
item.description:
Faatir:38 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
inna l-laha ʿālimu ghaybi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri
Indeed Allah (is the) Knower (of the) unseen (of) the heavens and the earth Indeed, He (is the) All-Knower of what (is) in the breasts of what (is) in the breasts

item.title: Faatir:39
item.description:
Faatir:39 - هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا huwa alladhī jaʿalakum khalāifa fī l-arḍi faman kafara faʿalayhi kuf'ruhu walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum ʿinda rabbihim illā maqtan walā yazīdu l-kāfirīna kuf'ruhum illā khasāran He (is) the One Who made you successors in the earth And whoever disbelieves then upon him (is) his disbelief And not increase the disbelievers their disbelief near their Lord except (in) hatred and not increase the disbelievers their disbelief except (in) loss
  • [1] That is, of the former peoples.

item.title: Faatir:40
item.description:
Faatir:40 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَى بَيِّنَتٍ مِنْهُ بَلْ إِنْ يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
qul ara-aytum shurakāakumu alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti am ātaynāhum kitāban fahum ʿalā bayyinatin min'hu bal in yaʿidu l-ẓālimūna baʿḍuhum baʿḍan illā ghurūran
Say Have you seen your partners those whom you call besides besides Allah Show Me what they have created from the earth or for them (is) a share in the heavens Or have We given them a Book so they (are) on a clear proof therefrom Nay not promise the wrongdoers some of them (to) others except delusion

item.title: Faatir:41
item.description:
Faatir:41 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولَا وَلَئِنْ زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
inna l-laha yum'siku l-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā wala-in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadin min baʿdihi innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran
Indeed Allah upholds the heavens and the earth lest they cease And if they should cease not can uphold them any one after Him after Him Indeed, He is Most Forbearing Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Faatir:42
item.description:
Faatir:42 - وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَى مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا wa-aqsamū bil-lahi jahda aymānihim la-in jāahum nadhīrun layakūnunna ahdā min iḥ'dā l-umami falammā jāahum nadhīrun mā zādahum illā nufūran And they swore by Allah (the) strongest (of) their oaths that if came to them a warner surely, they would be more guided than any (of) the nations But when came to them a warner not it increased them but (in) aversion
  • [1] That is, the idolaters of Arabia.

item.title: Faatir:43
item.description:
Faatir:43 - اِسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ فَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
is'tik'bāran fī l-arḍi wamakra l-sayi-i walā yaḥīqu l-makru l-sayi-u illā bi-ahlihi fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnata l-awalīna falan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi taḥwīlan
(Due to) arrogance in the land and plotting (of) the evil but not encompasses the plot (of) the evil except its own people Then do they wait except (the) way (of) the former (people) But never you will find in (the) way (of) Allah any change and never you will find in (the) way (of) Allah any alteration

item.title: Faatir:44
item.description:
Faatir:44 - أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوْۤا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا
awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim wakānū ashadda min'hum quwwatan wamā kāna l-lahu liyuʿ'jizahu min shayin fī l-samāwāti walā fī l-arḍi innahu kāna ʿalīman qadīran
Have they not traveled in the land and seen how was (the) end (of) those who (were) before them (were) before them And they were stronger than them (in) power But not is Allah that can escape (from) Him any thing in the heavens and not in the earth Indeed, He is All-Knower All-Powerful

item.title: Faatir:45
item.description:
Faatir:45 - وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَلَكِنْ يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا walaw yuākhidhu l-lahu l-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ʿalā ẓahrihā min dābbatin walākin yu-akhiruhum ilā ajalin musamman fa-idhā jāa ajaluhum fa-inna l-laha kāna biʿibādihi baṣīran And if Allah (were to) punish Allah (were to) punish the people for what they have earned not He would leave on its back any creature But He gives them respite till a term appointed And when comes their term then indeed Allah is of His slaves All-Seer
  • [1] That is, on the surface of the earth.

item.title: 36. يس (Yaseen)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the discrete Arabic letters Yā Sīn. "Yā Sīn" (mentioned in verse 1) is one of the names of the Prophet. The surah emphasizes the divine source of the Quran and defends it from the charge of being poetry made by man (verse 5 ff. and verse 69 ff.). It warns of the fate of men who are stubborn and always mock God's revelations. They are reminded of the punishment that befell earlier generations, and of God's power as shown in His Creation. The end of the surah gives strong arguments for the reality of the Resurrection.
The surah is also known as Ya-Sin, Yaa Siin

36:1
يس
ya-seen
Ya Seen

36:2
وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيمِ
wal-qur'āni l-ḥakīmi
By the Quran the Wise

36:3
إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
innaka lamina l-mur'salīna
Indeed, you (are) among the Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:1
item.description:
Yaseen:1 - يس
ya-seen
Ya Seen

item.title: Yaseen:2
item.description:
Yaseen:2 - وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْحَكِيمِ wal-qur'āni l-ḥakīmi By the Quran the Wise
  • [1] Or 'Definitive.'

item.title: Yaseen:3
item.description:
Yaseen:3 - إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
innaka lamina l-mur'salīna
Indeed, you (are) among the Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:4
item.description:
Yaseen:4 - عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
On a Path Straight

item.title: Yaseen:5
item.description:
Yaseen:5 - تَنْزِيلَ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ
tanzīla l-ʿazīzi l-raḥīmi
A revelation (of) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Yaseen:6
item.description:
Yaseen:6 - لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أُنْذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ litundhira qawman mā undhira ābāuhum fahum ghāfilūna That you may warn a people not were warned their forefathers so they (are) heedless
  • [1] Cf. (Q 28:46); (Q 32:3); (Q 34:44).

item.title: Yaseen:7
item.description:
Yaseen:7 - لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
laqad ḥaqqa l-qawlu ʿalā aktharihim fahum lā yu'minūna
Certainly (has) proved true the word upon most of them so they (do) not believe

item.title: Yaseen:8
item.description:
Yaseen:8 - إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ أَغْلَالًا فَهِيَ إِلَى الْأَذْقَانِ فَهُمْ مُقْمَحُونَ innā jaʿalnā fī aʿnāqihim aghlālan fahiya ilā l-adhqāni fahum muq'maḥūna Indeed, We [We] have placed on their necks iron collars and they (are up) to the chins so they (are with) heads raised up
  • [1] That is, they dwell in a state of blindness, defiance and arrogance in regard to the God-sent guidance and truth.

item.title: Yaseen:9
item.description:
Yaseen:9 - وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَاهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
wajaʿalnā min bayni aydīhim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan fa-aghshaynāhum fahum lā yub'ṣirūna
And We have made from before/between their hands/their front a barrier and from behind them a barrier and We covered them so they (do) not see

item.title: Yaseen:10
item.description:
Yaseen:10 - وَسَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
wasawāon ʿalayhim a-andhartahum am lam tundhir'hum lā yu'minūna
And it (is) same to them whether you warn them or (do) not warn them not they will believe

item.title: Yaseen:11
item.description:
Yaseen:11 - إِنَّمَا تُنْذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِالْغَيْبِ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ innamā tundhiru mani ittabaʿa l-dhik'ra wakhashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi fabashir'hu bimaghfiratin wa-ajrin karīmin Only you (can) warn (him) who follows the Reminder and fears the Most Gracious in the unseen So give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a reward noble
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān.

item.title: Yaseen:12
item.description:
Yaseen:12 - إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوْۤا وَءَاثَارَهُمْ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُبِينٍ innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī l-mawtā wanaktubu mā qaddamū waāthārahum wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu fī imāmin mubīnin Indeed, We We [We] give life (to) the dead and We record what they have sent before and their footprints and every thing We have enumerated it in a Register clear
  • [1] That is, the deeds they have done.
  • [2] That is, the good or evil heritage and imprint they leave behind in the society in which they have lived, and which outlive them.
  • [3] Or, in a manifest book.

item.title: Yaseen:13
item.description:
Yaseen:13 - وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا أَصْحَابَ الْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَاءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ
wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan aṣḥāba l-qaryati idh jāahā l-mur'salūna
And set forth to them an example (of the) companions (of) the city when came to it the Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:14
item.description:
Yaseen:14 - إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ مُرْسَلُونَ
idh arsalnā ilayhimu ith'nayni fakadhabūhumā faʿazzaznā bithālithin faqālū innā ilaykum mur'salūna
When We sent to them two (Messengers) but they denied both of them so We strengthened them with a third and they said Indeed, We to you (are) Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:15
item.description:
Yaseen:15 - قَالُوْا مَا أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُنَا وَمَا أَنْزَلَ الرَّحْمَنُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
qālū mā antum illā basharun mith'lunā wamā anzala l-raḥmānu min shayin in antum illā takdhibūna
They said Not you (are) but human beings like us and not has revealed the Most Gracious any thing Not you (are) but lying

item.title: Yaseen:16
item.description:
Yaseen:16 - قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
qālū rabbunā yaʿlamu innā ilaykum lamur'salūna
They said Our Lord knows that we to you (are) surely Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:17
item.description:
Yaseen:17 - وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ
wamā ʿalaynā illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu
And not (is) on us except the conveyance clear

item.title: Yaseen:18
item.description:
Yaseen:18 - قَالُوْا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ لَئِنْ لَمْ تَنْتَهُوْۤا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمْ مِنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum la-in lam tantahū lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun
They said Indeed, we [we] see an evil omen from you If not you desist surely, we will stone you and surely will touch you from us a punishment painful

item.title: Yaseen:19
item.description:
Yaseen:19 - قَالُوْا طَائِرُكُمْ مَعَكُمْ أَئِنْ ذُكِّرْتُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُسْرِفُونَ qālū ṭāirukum maʿakum a-in dhukkir'tum bal antum qawmun mus'rifūna They said Your evil omen (be) with you Is it because you are admonished Nay you (are) a people transgressing
  • [1] Ellipsis. The phrase omitted is 'do you take it for a bad omen?!'

item.title: Yaseen:20
item.description:
Yaseen:20 - وَجَاءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَى قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوْۤا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
wajāa min aqṣā l-madīnati rajulun yasʿā qāla yāqawmi ittabiʿū l-mur'salīna
And came from (the) farthest end (of) the city a man running He said O my People Follow the Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:21
item.description:
Yaseen:21 - اِتَّبِعُوا مَنْ لَا يَسْءَلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ
ittabiʿū man lā yasalukum ajran wahum muh'tadūna
Follow (those) who (do) not ask (of) you any payment and they (are) rightly guided

item.title: Yaseen:22
item.description:
Yaseen:22 - وَمَا لِيَ لَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
wamā liya lā aʿbudu alladhī faṭaranī wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
And what (is) for me (that) not I worship the One Who created me and to Whom you will be returned

item.title: Yaseen:23
item.description:
Yaseen:23 - ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً إِنْ يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَنُ بِضُرٍّ لَا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُنْقِذُونِ
a-attakhidhu min dūnihi ālihatan in yurid'ni l-raḥmānu biḍurrin lā tugh'ni ʿannī shafāʿatuhum shayan walā yunqidhūni
Should I take besides Him besides Him gods If intends for me the Most Gracious any harm not will avail [from] me their intercession (in) anything and not they (can) save me

item.title: Yaseen:24
item.description:
Yaseen:24 - اِنِّیْ إِذًا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
innī idhan lafī ḍalālin mubīnin
Indeed, I then surely would be in an error clear

item.title: Yaseen:25
item.description:
Yaseen:25 - اِنِّیْ ءَامَنْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ
innī āmantu birabbikum fa-is'maʿūni
Indeed, I [I] have believed in your Lord so listen to me

item.title: Yaseen:26
item.description:
Yaseen:26 - قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ قَالَ يَالَيْتَ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ
qīla ud'khuli l-janata qāla yālayta qawmī yaʿlamūna
It was said Enter Paradise He said I wish my people knew

item.title: Yaseen:27
item.description:
Yaseen:27 - بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ
bimā ghafara lī rabbī wajaʿalanī mina l-muk'ramīna
Of how has forgiven me my Lord and placed me among the honored ones

item.title: Yaseen:28
item.description:
Yaseen:28 - وَمَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى قَوْمِهِ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ مِنْ جُنْدٍ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنْزِلِينَ wamā anzalnā ʿalā qawmihi min baʿdihi min jundin mina l-samāi wamā kunnā munzilīna And not We sent down upon his people after him after him any host from the heaven and not were We (to) send down
  • [1] Or 'and what We used to send down [before];' see Ṭabrisī, Fayḍ Kāshānī.

item.title: Yaseen:29
item.description:
Yaseen:29 - إِنْ كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ
in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum khāmidūna
Not it was but a shout one then behold They (were) extinguished

item.title: Yaseen:30
item.description:
Yaseen:30 - يَاحَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
yāḥasratan ʿalā l-ʿibādi mā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna
Alas for the servants Not came to them any Messenger but they did mock at him mock at him

item.title: Yaseen:31
item.description:
Yaseen:31 - أَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
alam yaraw kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni annahum ilayhim lā yarjiʿūna
Do not they see how many We destroyed before them of the generations That they to them will not return will not return

item.title: Yaseen:32
item.description:
Yaseen:32 - وَإِنْ كُلٌّ لَمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
wa-in kullun lammā jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna
And surely all then together before Us (will be) brought

item.title: Yaseen:33
item.description:
Yaseen:33 - وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمُ الْأَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَاهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
waāyatun lahumu l-arḍu l-maytatu aḥyaynāhā wa-akhrajnā min'hā ḥabban famin'hu yakulūna
And a Sign for them (is) the earth dead We give it life and We bring forth from it grain and from it they eat

item.title: Yaseen:34
item.description:
Yaseen:34 - وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْعُيُونِ
wajaʿalnā fīhā jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin wafajjarnā fīhā mina l-ʿuyūni
And We placed therein gardens of date-palms and grapevines and We caused to gush forth in it of the springs

item.title: Yaseen:35
item.description:
Yaseen:35 - لِيَأْكُلُوا مِنْ ثَمَرِهِ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ liyakulū min thamarihi wamā ʿamilathu aydīhim afalā yashkurūna That they may eat of its fruit And not made it their hands So will not they be grateful
  • [1] Or 'and their hands did not cultivate it.' That is, it is We who produce the fruits, not their hands. Cf. (Q 27:60) and (Q 56:64).

item.title: Yaseen:36
item.description:
Yaseen:36 - سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنْبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ sub'ḥāna alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu l-arḍu wamin anfusihim wamimmā lā yaʿlamūna Glory be (to) the One Who created (in) pairs all of what grows the earth and of themselves and of what not they know
  • [1] Or, 'all the pairs.'

item.title: Yaseen:37
item.description:
Yaseen:37 - وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمُ اللَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُمْ مُظْلِمُونَ
waāyatun lahumu al-laylu naslakhu min'hu l-nahāra fa-idhā hum muẓ'limūna
And a Sign for them (is) the night We withdraw from it the day Then behold They (are) those in darkness

item.title: Yaseen:38
item.description:
Yaseen:38 - وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَهَا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarrin lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi And the sun runs to a term appointed for it That (is the) Decree (of) the All-Mighty the All-Knowing
  • [1] Or 'it has no place of rest.' This is in accordance with the alternate reading 'lā mustaqarra lahā.' Ṭabrisī in Majma' al-Bayān narrates a tradition which ascribes the reading lā mustaqarra lahā to the Imams 'Ali b. al-Ḥusayn, Muḥammad al-Bāqir, and Ja'far al-Ṣādiq, as well as to a number of the early exegetes such as Ibn 'Abbās, Ibn Mas'ūd, 'Ikrimah, and 'Aṭā' b. Abī Rabāḥ. See Mu'jam al-Qirā'āt al-Qur'āniyyah, v, 208, for further sources of this reading. The reading li mustaqarrin lahā seems to have been suggested and reinforced by the popular astronomical notions of the age.

item.title: Yaseen:39
item.description:
Yaseen:39 - وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰی عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ
wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīmi
And the moon We have ordained for it phases until it returns like the date stalk the old

item.title: Yaseen:40
item.description:
Yaseen:40 - لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
lā l-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu l-nahāri wakullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna
Not the sun is permitted for it that it overtakes the moon and not the night (can) outstrip the day but all in an orbit they are floating

item.title: Yaseen:41
item.description:
Yaseen:41 - وَاٰیَةٌ لَهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ waāyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni And a Sign for them (is) that We carried their offspring in the ship laden
  • [1] That is, in the ark of Noah.

item.title: Yaseen:42
item.description:
Yaseen:42 - وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مِثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ wakhalaqnā lahum min mith'lihi mā yarkabūna And We created for them from (the) likes of it what they ride
  • [1] Or 'board,' that is, ships which are similar to their prototype, the ark of Noah; or, alternatively, the camel, which has been called 'the ship of the desert,' and other animals and means of transport.

item.title: Yaseen:43
item.description:
Yaseen:43 - وَإِنْ نَشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْقَذُونَ
wa-in nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūna
And if We will We could drown them then not (would be) a responder to a cry for them and not they would be saved

item.title: Yaseen:44
item.description:
Yaseen:44 - إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَى حِينٍ
illā raḥmatan minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin
Except (by) Mercy from Us and provision for a time

item.title: Yaseen:45
item.description:
Yaseen:45 - وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوْۤا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna And when it is said to them Fear what (is) before you (is) before you and what (is) behind you so that you may receive mercy
  • [1] See (Q 34:9).
  • [2] Ellipsis. The omitted clause is, 'they turn away arrogantly.'

item.title: Yaseen:46
item.description:
Yaseen:46 - وَمَا تَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ مِنْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna
And not comes to them of a Sign from (the) Signs (of) their Lord but they from it turn away

item.title: Yaseen:47
item.description:
Yaseen:47 - وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنْفِقُوْۤا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنُطْعِمُ مَنْ لَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu man law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīnin
And when it is said to them Spend from what (has) provided you Allah Said those who disbelieved to those who believed Should we feed whom if Allah willed Allah willed He would have fed him Not (are) you except in an error clear

item.title: Yaseen:48
item.description:
Yaseen:48 - وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And they say When (is) this promise if you are truthful

item.title: Yaseen:49
item.description:
Yaseen:49 - مَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūna
Not they await except a shout one it will seize them while they are disputing

item.title: Yaseen:50
item.description:
Yaseen:50 - فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūna
Then not they will be able (to) make a will and not to their people they (can) return

item.title: Yaseen:51
item.description:
Yaseen:51 - وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُمْ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُونَ
wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūna
And will be blown in the trumpet and behold They from the graves to their Lord [they] will hasten

item.title: Yaseen:52
item.description:
Yaseen:52 - قَالُوْا يَاوَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ
qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada l-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūna
They [will] say O woe to us Who has raised us from our sleeping place This (is) What (had) promised the Most Gracious and told (the) truth the Messengers

item.title: Yaseen:53
item.description:
Yaseen:53 - إِنْ كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna
Not it will be but a shout single so behold They all before Us (will be) brought

item.title: Yaseen:54
item.description:
Yaseen:54 - فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
So this Day not will be wronged a soul (in) anything and not you will be recompensed except (for) what you used (to) do

item.title: Yaseen:55
item.description:
Yaseen:55 - إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ
inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūna
Indeed (the) companions (of) Paradise this Day in will be occupied (in) amusement

item.title: Yaseen:56
item.description:
Yaseen:56 - هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ
hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūna
They and their spouses in shades on [the] couches reclining

item.title: Yaseen:57
item.description:
Yaseen:57 - لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُمْ مَا يَدَّعُونَ
lahum fīhā fākihatun walahum mā yaddaʿūna
For them therein (are) fruits and for them (is) whatever they call for

item.title: Yaseen:58
item.description:
Yaseen:58 - سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِنْ رَبٍّ رَحِيمٍ
salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmin
Peace A word from a Lord Most Merciful

item.title: Yaseen:59
item.description:
Yaseen:59 - وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ
wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūna
But stand apart today O criminals O criminals

item.title: Yaseen:60
item.description:
Yaseen:60 - أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَابَنِي اٰدَمَ أَنْ لَا تَعْبُدُوْۤا الشَّيْطَانَ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ
alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama an lā taʿbudū l-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun
Did not I enjoin upon you O Children of Adam O Children of Adam That (do) not worship the Shaitaan indeed, he (is) for you an enemy clear

item.title: Yaseen:61
item.description:
Yaseen:61 - وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun
And that you worship Me This (is) a Path Straight

item.title: Yaseen:62
item.description:
Yaseen:62 - وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنْكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا تَعْقِلُونَ
walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūna
And indeed he led astray from you a multitude great Then did not you use reason

item.title: Yaseen:63
item.description:
Yaseen:63 - هَذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūna
This (is) (the) Hell which you were promised

item.title: Yaseen:64
item.description:
Yaseen:64 - اِصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūna
Burn therein today because you used to disbelieve

item.title: Yaseen:65
item.description:
Yaseen:65 - اَلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ
al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūna
This Day We will seal on their mouths and will speak to Us their hands and will bear witness their feet about what they used to earn

item.title: Yaseen:66
item.description:
Yaseen:66 - وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَى أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّى يُبْصِرُونَ walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū l-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūna And if We willed We (would have) surely obliterated over their eyes then they (would) race (to find) the path then how (could) they see
  • [1] That is, the insight to see the course of true human felicity.

item.title: Yaseen:67
item.description:
Yaseen:67 - وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūna And if We willed surely, We (would have) transformed them in their places then not they would have been able to proceed and not return
  • [1] That is, brought them to a standstill with their deformed inner state.
  • [2] That is, they would have neither been able to move ahead to make spiritual progress, nor to return to their original state of unsullied God-given nature.

item.title: Yaseen:68
item.description:
Yaseen:68 - وَمَنْ نُعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
waman nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūna
And (he) whom We grant him long life We reverse him in the creation Then will not they use intellect

item.title: Yaseen:69
item.description:
Yaseen:69 - وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنْبَغِي لَهُ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُبِينٌ
wamā ʿallamnāhu l-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'run waqur'ānun mubīnun
And not We taught him [the] poetry and not it is befitting for him Not it (is) except a Reminder and a Quran clear

item.title: Yaseen:70
item.description:
Yaseen:70 - لِيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
liyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīna
To warn (him) who is alive and may be proved true the Word against the disbelievers

item.title: Yaseen:71
item.description:
Yaseen:71 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُمْ مِمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ
awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūna
Do not they see that We [We] created for them from what have made Our hands cattle then they for them (are the) owners

item.title: Yaseen:72
item.description:
Yaseen:72 - وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūna
And We have tamed them for them so some of them they ride them and some of them they eat

item.title: Yaseen:73
item.description:
Yaseen:73 - وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūna And for them therein (are) benefits and drinks so (will) not they give thanks
  • [1] That is, milk and other drinks derived from it.

item.title: Yaseen:74
item.description:
Yaseen:74 - وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūna
But they have taken besides besides Allah gods that they may be helped

item.title: Yaseen:75
item.description:
Yaseen:75 - لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُحْضَرُونَ lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun muḥ'ḍarūna Not they are able to help them but they for them (are) hosts (who will) be brought
  • [1] That is, while the idols are unable to offer the idolaters any kind of assistance, the idolaters are ready to fight for them and defend them.

item.title: Yaseen:76
item.description:
Yaseen:76 - فَلَا يَحْزُنْكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna
So (let) not grieve you their speech Indeed, We [We] know what they conceal and what they declare

item.title: Yaseen:77
item.description:
