Yaseen:77 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُبِينٌ
awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun
Does not see [the] man that We [We] created him from a semen-drop Then behold He (is) an opponent clear

item.title: Yaseen:78
item.description:
Yaseen:78 - وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ قَالَ مَنْ يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ
waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qāla man yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmun
And he sets forth for Us an example and forgets his (own) creation He says Who will give life (to) the bones while they (are) decomposed

item.title: Yaseen:79
item.description:
Yaseen:79 - قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنْشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِیْمٌ
qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun
Say He will give them life Who produced them (the) first time and He (is) of every creation All-Knower

item.title: Yaseen:80
item.description:
Yaseen:80 - اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنْتُمْ مِنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
alladhī jaʿala lakum mina l-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūna
The One Who made for you from the tree [the] green fire and behold You from it ignite

item.title: Yaseen:81
item.description:
Yaseen:81 - أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ بَلَى وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ
awalaysa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu
Is it not (He) Who created the heavens and the earth Able to that create (the) like of them Yes, indeed and He (is) the Supreme Creator the All-Knower

item.title: Yaseen:82
item.description:
Yaseen:82 - إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan an yaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu
Only His Command when He intends a thing that He says to it Be and it is

item.title: Yaseen:83
item.description:
Yaseen:83 - فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
So glory be (to) the One who in Whose hand is (the) dominion (of) all things and to Him you will be returned

item.title: 37. الصافات (As-Saaffaat)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the angels arrayed before Him in devotional ranks, The Ranged Ones—thereafter, by other angels propelling the clouds, dispelling evil, and reciting God's praise. It takes its name from verse 1, which refers to a gropu of angels as "those ranged (ṣāffāt) in ranks". The central point of this surah is the unity of God (verse 4 and verse 180 ff.) and the refutation of the pagan belief that the angels were daughters of God and worthy of worship. The angels themselves are quoted to refute this (verse 164 ff.). The prophethood of Muḥammad, is affirmed, as is the Hereafter. There are two supporting sections: the scenes in the Hereafter (verse 19 ff.) and the stories of earlier prophets (verse 75 ff.).
The surah is also known as Devotional Ranks, Drawn Up In Ranks, Ranged in Order, Ranged in Rows, The Rangers, The Ranks, Those Ranged in Ranks, Those in Ranks, Who Stand Arrayed in Rows

37:1
وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا
wal-ṣāfāti ṣaffan
By those lined (in) rows

37:2
فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا
fal-zājirāti zajran
And those who drive strongly

37:3
فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا
fal-tāliyāti dhik'ran
And those who recite (the) Message

item.title: As-Saaffaat:1
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:1 - وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا
wal-ṣāfāti ṣaffan
By those lined (in) rows

item.title: As-Saaffaat:2
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:2 - فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا fal-zājirāti zajran And those who drive strongly
  • [1] Or 'hold back forcibly,' or 'scold severely.' Said to refer to angels who drive the clouds, or hold back (or drive away) the eavesdropping devils, or to angels (or verses of the Qur'ān) that restrain people from sins.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:3
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:3 - فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا fal-tāliyāti dhik'ran And those who recite (the) Message
  • [1] That is, the faithful, or the angels, who recite the Qur'ān or the scriptures.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:4
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:4 - إِنَّ إِلَهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ
inna ilāhakum lawāḥidun
Indeed your Lord (is) surely One

item.title: As-Saaffaat:5
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:5 - رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriqi Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and what (is) between both of them and Lord (of) each point of sunrise
  • [1] That is, the points of sunrise at the winter and summer solstices. Cf. (Q 7:137); (Q 55:17); (Q 70:40).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:6
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:6 - إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākibi Indeed, We [We] adorned the sky the world with an adornment (of) the stars
  • [1] Or 'the heaven of the earth,' or 'the nearest heaven.'
  • [2] Or 'We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment, the stars.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:7
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:7 - وَحِفْظًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَارِدٍ
waḥif'ẓan min kulli shayṭānin māridin
And (to) guard against every devil rebellious

item.title: As-Saaffaat:8
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:8 - لَا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰی وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibin
Not they may listen to the assembly [the] exalted are pelted from every side

item.title: As-Saaffaat:9
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:9 - دُحُورًا وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
duḥūran walahum ʿadhābun wāṣibun
Repelled and for them (is) a punishment perpetual

item.title: As-Saaffaat:10
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:10 - إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun Except (him) who snatches (by) theft but follows him a burning flame piercing
  • [1] That is, of celestial intelligence. See Ṭabarī for several related traditions from the Prophet (ṣ).
  • [2] Cf. (Q 15:17) - (Q 15:18).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:11
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:11 - فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمْ مَنْ خَلَقْنَا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِنْ طِينٍ لَازِبٍ fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibin Then ask them Are they a stronger creation or (those) whom We have created Indeed, We created them from a clay sticky
  • [1] Or 'more tough' (or strong), or 'more difficult.' Cf. (Q 79:27).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:12
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:12 - بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
bal ʿajib'ta wayaskharūna
Nay you wonder while they mock

item.title: As-Saaffaat:13
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:13 - وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوْۤا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
wa-idhā dhukkirū lā yadhkurūna
And when they are reminded not they receive admonition

item.title: As-Saaffaat:14
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:14 - وَإِذَا رَأَوْا اٰیَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
wa-idhā ra-aw āyatan yastaskhirūna
And when they see a Sign they mock

item.title: As-Saaffaat:15
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:15 - وَقَالُوْۤا إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun
And they say Not (is) this except a magic clear

item.title: As-Saaffaat:16
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:16 - أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna
Is it when we are dead and have become dust and bones shall we then be certainly resurrected

item.title: As-Saaffaat:17
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:17 - أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ
awaābāunā l-awalūna
Or our fathers former

item.title: As-Saaffaat:18
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:18 - قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنْتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ
qul naʿam wa-antum dākhirūna
Say Yes and you (will be) humiliated

item.title: As-Saaffaat:19
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:19 - فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ
fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna
Then only it (will be) a cry single then, behold They will see

item.title: As-Saaffaat:20
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:20 - وَقَالُوْۤا يَاوَيْلَنَا هَذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
waqālū yāwaylanā hādhā yawmu l-dīni
And they will say O woe to us This (is the) Day (of) the Recompense

item.title: As-Saaffaat:21
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:21 - هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
This (is the) Day (of) Judgment which you used to of it deny

item.title: As-Saaffaat:22
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:22 - اُحْشُرُوا۟ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْبُدُونَ uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūna Gather those who wronged and their kinds and what they used (to) worship
  • [1] Or 'their kind,' or 'their counterparts.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:23
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:23 - مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَى صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ
min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīmi
Besides Besides Allah then lead them to (the) Path (of) the Hellfire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:24
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:24 - وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْءُولُونَ
waqifūhum innahum masūlūna
And stop them indeed, they (are) to be questioned

item.title: As-Saaffaat:25
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:25 - مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ mā lakum lā tanāṣarūna What (is) for you (Why) not you help one another
  • [1] Or 'help.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:26
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:26 - بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
bal humu l-yawma mus'taslimūna
Nay they (on) that Day (will) surrender

item.title: As-Saaffaat:27
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:27 - وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna
And will approach some of them to others questioning one another

item.title: As-Saaffaat:28
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:28 - قَالُوْا إِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīni They will say Indeed, you [you] used (to) come (to) us from the right
  • [1] Or 'obligingly.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:29
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:29 - قَالُوْا بَلْ لَمْ تَكُونُوْۤا مُؤْمِنِينَ
qālū bal lam takūnū mu'minīna
They will say Nay not you were believers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:30
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:30 - وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ بَلْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ
wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna
And not was for us over you any authority Nay you were a people transgressing

item.title: As-Saaffaat:31
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:31 - فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ
faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūna
So has been proved true against us (the) Word (of) our Lord indeed, we (will) certainly taste

item.title: As-Saaffaat:32
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:32 - فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ
fa-aghwaynākum innā kunnā ghāwīna
So we led you astray indeed, we were astray

item.title: As-Saaffaat:33
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:33 - فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
fa-innahum yawma-idhin fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna
Then indeed, they that Day in the punishment (will be) sharers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:34
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:34 - إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ
innā kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna
Indeed, We thus We deal with the criminals

item.title: As-Saaffaat:35
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:35 - إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūna
Indeed, they were when it was said to them (There is) no god except Allah were arrogant

item.title: As-Saaffaat:36
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:36 - وَيَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَتَارِكُوا آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَجْنُونٍ
wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūnin
And they say Are we to leave our gods for a poet mad

item.title: As-Saaffaat:37
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:37 - بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
bal jāa bil-ḥaqi waṣaddaqa l-mur'salīna
Nay he has brought the truth and confirmed the Messengers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:38
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:38 - إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُوا الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ
innakum ladhāiqū l-ʿadhābi l-alīmi
Indeed, you (will) surely taste the punishment painful

item.title: As-Saaffaat:39
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:39 - وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna
And not you will be recompensed except what you used to do

item.title: As-Saaffaat:40
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:40 - إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna
Except (the) slaves (of) Allah the chosen ones

item.title: As-Saaffaat:41
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:41 - اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَعْلُومٌ ulāika lahum riz'qun maʿlūmun Those for them (will be) a provision determined
  • [1] That is, distinct and special.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:42
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:42 - فَوَاكِهُ وَهُمْ مُكْرَمُونَ
fawākihu wahum muk'ramūna
Fruits and they (will) be honored

item.title: As-Saaffaat:43
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:43 - فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
fī jannāti l-naʿīmi
In Gardens (of) Delight

item.title: As-Saaffaat:44
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:44 - عَلَى سُرُرٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ
ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna
On thrones facing each other

item.title: As-Saaffaat:45
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:45 - يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ
yuṭāfu ʿalayhim bikasin min maʿīnin
Will be circulated among them a cup from a flowing spring

item.title: As-Saaffaat:46
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:46 - بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ
bayḍāa ladhatin lilshāribīna
White delicious for the drinkers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:47
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:47 - لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنْزَفُونَ
lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna
Not in it (is) bad effect and not they from it will be intoxicated

item.title: As-Saaffaat:48
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:48 - وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi ʿīnun
And with them (will be) companions of modest gaze (will be) companions of modest gaze (having) beautiful eyes

item.title: As-Saaffaat:49
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:49 - كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَكْنُونٌ ka-annahunna bayḍun maknūnun As if they were eggs well protected
  • [1] That is, well reserved.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:50
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:50 - فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna
And (will) approach some of them to others questioning one another

item.title: As-Saaffaat:51
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:51 - قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّیْ كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ
qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnun
Will say a speaker among them Indeed, I had for me a companion

item.title: As-Saaffaat:52
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:52 - يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ
yaqūlu a-innaka lamina l-muṣadiqīna
Who (would) say Are you indeed surely of those who believe

item.title: As-Saaffaat:53
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:53 - أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūna
Is (it) when we have died and become dust and bones will we surely be brought to Judgment

item.title: As-Saaffaat:54
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:54 - قَالَ هَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُطَّلِعُونَ qāla hal antum muṭṭaliʿūna He (will) say Will you be looking
  • [1] That is, one of his companions in paradise.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:55
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:55 - فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ
fa-iṭṭalaʿa faraāhu fī sawāi l-jaḥīmi
Then he (will) look and see him in (the) midst (of) the Hellfire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:56
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:56 - قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِنْ كِدْتَ لَتُرْدِينِ
qāla tal-lahi in kidtta latur'dīni
He (will) say By Allah verily you almost ruined me

item.title: As-Saaffaat:57
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:57 - وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ
walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīna
And if not (for the) Grace (of) my Lord certainly, I (would) have been among those brought

item.title: As-Saaffaat:58
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:58 - أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
afamā naḥnu bimayyitīna
Then are not we (to) die

item.title: As-Saaffaat:59
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:59 - إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna
Except our death the first and not we will be punished

item.title: As-Saaffaat:60
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:60 - إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
inna hādhā lahuwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu
Indeed this surely (is) the attainment great

item.title: As-Saaffaat:61
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:61 - لِمِثْلِ هَذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ
limith'li hādhā falyaʿmali l-ʿāmilūna
For (the) like (of) this let work the workers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:62
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:62 - اَذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ
adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūmi
Is that better (as) hospitality or (the) tree (of) Zaqqum

item.title: As-Saaffaat:63
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:63 - إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِلظَّالِمِينَ
innā jaʿalnāhā fit'natan lilẓẓālimīna
Indeed, We [We] have made it a trial for the wrongdoers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:64
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:64 - إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ
innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīmi
Indeed, it (is) a tree that grows in (the) bottom (of) the Hellfire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:65
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:65 - طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ ṭalʿuhā ka-annahu ruūsu l-shayāṭīni Its emerging fruit (is) as if it (was) heads (of) the devils
  • [1] 'The devil's head' is either a purely imaginative metaphor, or a simile that likens the spathes of the Zaqqūm tree to that of an Arabian plant by this name, or to certain rocks to be found around the city of Makkah which were called 'the devils' heads' because of their hideous appearance.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:66
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:66 - فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ
fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna
And indeed, they (will) surely eat from it and fill with it (their) bellies

item.title: As-Saaffaat:67
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:67 - ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِنْ حَمِيمٍ
thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmin
Then indeed for them in it (is) a mixture of boiling water

item.title: As-Saaffaat:68
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:68 - ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ
thumma inna marjiʿahum la-ilā l-jaḥīmi
Then indeed their return (will) surely be to the Hellfire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:69
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:69 - إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا ءَابَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ
innahum alfaw ābāahum ḍāllīna
Indeed, they found their fathers astray

item.title: As-Saaffaat:70
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:70 - فَهُمْ عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
fahum ʿalā āthārihim yuh'raʿūna
So they on their footsteps they hastened

item.title: As-Saaffaat:71
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:71 - وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
walaqad ḍalla qablahum aktharu l-awalīna
And verily went astray before them most (of) the former (people)

item.title: As-Saaffaat:72
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:72 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ
walaqad arsalnā fīhim mundhirīna
And verily We sent among them warners

item.title: As-Saaffaat:73
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:73 - فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mundharīna
Then see how was (the) end (of) those who were warned

item.title: As-Saaffaat:74
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:74 - إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna
Except (the) slaves (of) Allah the chosen ones

item.title: As-Saaffaat:75
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:75 - وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ
walaqad nādānā nūḥun falaniʿ'ma l-mujībūna
And verily called Us Nuh and Best (are We as) Responders

item.title: As-Saaffaat:76
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:76 - وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ
wanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi
And We saved him and his family from the distress the great

item.title: As-Saaffaat:77
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:77 - وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ
wajaʿalnā dhurriyyatahu humu l-bāqīna
And We made his offspring they the survivors

item.title: As-Saaffaat:78
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:78 - وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ
wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna
And We left for him among the later generations

item.title: As-Saaffaat:79
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:79 - سَلَامٌ عَلَى نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ
salāmun ʿalā nūḥin fī l-ʿālamīna
Peace be upon Nuh among the worlds

item.title: As-Saaffaat:80
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:80 - إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
Indeed, We thus [We] reward the good-doers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:81
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:81 - إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna
Indeed, he (was) of Our slaves believing

item.title: As-Saaffaat:82
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:82 - ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ
thumma aghraqnā l-ākharīna
Then We drowned the others

item.title: As-Saaffaat:83
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:83 - وَإِنَّ مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ لَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ
wa-inna min shīʿatihi la-ib'rāhīma
And indeed among his kind (was) surely Ibrahim

item.title: As-Saaffaat:84
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:84 - إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ idh jāa rabbahu biqalbin salīmin When he came (to) his Lord with a heart sound
  • [1] Cf. (Q 26:89).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:85
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:85 - إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna
When he said to his father and his people What is it you worship

item.title: As-Saaffaat:86
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:86 - أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
a-if'kan ālihatan dūna l-lahi turīdūna
Is it falsehood gods other than Allah (that) you desire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:87
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:87 - فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
famā ẓannukum birabbi l-ʿālamīna
Then what (do) you think about (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: As-Saaffaat:88
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:88 - فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ fanaẓara naẓratan fī l-nujūmi Then he glanced a glance at the stars
  • [1] Or 'threw a look at the stars.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:89
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:89 - فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ سَقِيمٌ
faqāla innī saqīmun
And he said Indeed, I am sick

item.title: As-Saaffaat:90
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:90 - فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
fatawallaw ʿanhu mud'birīna
So they turned away from him departing

item.title: As-Saaffaat:91
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:91 - فَرَاغَ إِلَى آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūna
Then he turned to their gods and said Do not you eat

item.title: As-Saaffaat:92
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:92 - مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنْطِقُونَ
mā lakum lā tanṭiqūna
What (is) for you not you speak

item.title: As-Saaffaat:93
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:93 - فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ
farāgha ʿalayhim ḍarban bil-yamīni
Then he turned upon them striking with the right hand

item.title: As-Saaffaat:94
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:94 - فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
fa-aqbalū ilayhi yaziffūna
Then they advanced towards him hastening

item.title: As-Saaffaat:95
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:95 - قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
qāla ataʿbudūna mā tanḥitūna
He said Do you worship what you carve

item.title: As-Saaffaat:96
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:96 - وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
wal-lahu khalaqakum wamā taʿmalūna
While Allah created you and what you make

item.title: As-Saaffaat:97
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:97 - قَالُوْا ابْنُوْۤا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ
qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīmi
They said Build for him a structure and throw him into the blazing Fire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:98
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:98 - فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ
fa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-asfalīna
And they intended for him a plot but We made them the lowest

item.title: As-Saaffaat:99
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:99 - وَقَالَ اِنِّیْ ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīni
And he said Indeed, I am going to my Lord He will guide me

item.title: As-Saaffaat:100
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:100 - رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
rabbi hab lī mina l-ṣāliḥīna
My Lord grant me of the righteous

item.title: As-Saaffaat:101
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:101 - فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ fabasharnāhu bighulāmin ḥalīmin So We gave him the glad tidings of a boy forbearing
  • [1] That is, Ishmael, who was Abraham's first born. That it was Ishmael to whom the following episode of the sacrifice pertains is also supported by the fact that verses pertaining to the birth of Isaac follow the account of Ishmael's sacrifice.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:102
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:102 - فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَابُنَيَّ اِنِّیْ أَرٰی فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا تَرٰی قَالَ يَاأَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīna
Then when he reached the (age of) working with him the (age of) working with him he said O my son Indeed, I have seen in the dream that I am sacrificing you so look what you see He said O my father Do what you are commanded You will find me if Allah wills Allah wills of the patient ones

item.title: As-Saaffaat:103
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:103 - فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
falammā aslamā watallahu lil'jabīni
Then when both of them had submitted and he put him down upon his forehead

item.title: As-Saaffaat:104
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:104 - وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَنْ يَاإِبْرَاهِيمُ
wanādaynāhu an yāib'rāhīmu
And We called out to him that O Ibrahim

item.title: As-Saaffaat:105
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:105 - قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّءْيَا إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna Verily you have fulfilled the vision Indeed, We thus [We] reward the good-doers
  • [1] Or 'dream.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:106
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:106 - إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَؤُا الْمُبِينُ
inna hādhā lahuwa l-balāu l-mubīnu
Indeed this (was) surely [it] the trial clear

item.title: As-Saaffaat:107
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:107 - وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
wafadaynāhu bidhib'ḥin ʿaẓīmin
And We ransomed him with a sacrifice great

item.title: As-Saaffaat:108
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:108 - وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ
wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna
And We left for him among the later generations

item.title: As-Saaffaat:109
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:109 - سَلَامٌ عَلَى اِبْرَاهِیْمَ
salāmun ʿalā ib'rāhīma
Peace be on Ibrahim

item.title: As-Saaffaat:110
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:110 - كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
Thus We reward the good-doers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:111
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:111 - إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna
Indeed, he (was) of Our slaves believing

item.title: As-Saaffaat:112
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:112 - وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
wabasharnāhu bi-is'ḥāqa nabiyyan mina l-ṣāliḥīna
And We gave him glad tidings of Isaac a Prophet among the righteous

item.title: As-Saaffaat:113
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:113 - وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى إِسْحَاقَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnun
And We blessed him and [on] Isaac And of their offspring (are) good-doers and unjust to himself clear

item.title: As-Saaffaat:114
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:114 - وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَى مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ
walaqad manannā ʿalā mūsā wahārūna
And verily We conferred Favor upon Musa and Harun

item.title: As-Saaffaat:115
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:115 - وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ
wanajjaynāhumā waqawmahumā mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi
And We saved both of them and their people from the distress the great

item.title: As-Saaffaat:116
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:116 - وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُوْۤا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ
wanaṣarnāhum fakānū humu l-ghālibīna
And We helped them so became them the victors

item.title: As-Saaffaat:117
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:117 - وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمَا الْكِتَابَ الْمُسْتَبِينَ
waātaynāhumā l-kitāba l-mus'tabīna
And We gave both of them the Book the clear

item.title: As-Saaffaat:118
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:118 - وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
wahadaynāhumā l-ṣirāṭa l-mus'taqīma
And We guided both of them (to) the Path the Straight

item.title: As-Saaffaat:119
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:119 - وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ
wataraknā ʿalayhimā fī l-ākhirīna
And We left for both of them among the later generations

item.title: As-Saaffaat:120
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:120 - سَلَامٌ عَلَى مُوسٰی وَهَارُونَ
salāmun ʿalā mūsā wahārūna
Peace be upon Musa and Harun

item.title: As-Saaffaat:121
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:121 - إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
Indeed, We thus reward the good-doers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:122
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:122 - إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
innahumā min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna
Indeed, both of them (were) of Our slaves believing

item.title: As-Saaffaat:123
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:123 - وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
wa-inna il'yāsa lamina l-mur'salīna
And indeed Elijah (was) surely of the Messengers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:124
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:124 - إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
idh qāla liqawmihi alā tattaqūna
When he said to his people Will not you fear

item.title: As-Saaffaat:125
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:125 - أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ
atadʿūna baʿlan watadharūna aḥsana l-khāliqīna
Do you call Baal and you forsake (the) Best (of) Creators

item.title: As-Saaffaat:126
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:126 - اَللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
al-laha rabbakum warabba ābāikumu l-awalīna
Allah your Lord and (the) Lord (of) your forefathers (of) your forefathers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:127
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:127 - فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
fakadhabūhu fa-innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna
But they denied him so indeed, they (will) surely be brought

item.title: As-Saaffaat:128
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:128 - إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna
Except (the) slaves (of) Allah the chosen ones

item.title: As-Saaffaat:129
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:129 - وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْءَاخِرِينَ
wataraknā ʿalayhi fī l-ākhirīna
And We left for him among the later generations

item.title: As-Saaffaat:130
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:130 - سَلَامٌ عَلَى إِلْ يَاسِينَ salāmun ʿalā il-yāsīna Peace be upon Elijah
  • [1] In accordance with an alternate reading (salāmun 'alā Āl-i Yā Sīn), narrated from Nāfi', Ibn 'Āmir, Ya'qūb, Ruways, al-A'raj, Shaybah, Zayd ibn 'Alī and others (see Mu'jam al-Qirā'āt al-Qur'āniyyah, vol. 5, p. 246), the translation will be 'Peace be upon the progeny of Yā Sīn' (i.e. the Prophet, who is referred to as Yā Sīn in (Q 36:1)). Traditions narrated from Ibn 'Abbās (al-Durr al-Manthūr, vol. 5, p. 286), Imam Ja'far al-Ṣādiq (Ma'ānī al-Akhbār, p. 122) and Imam 'Alī ibn Mūsā al-Riḍā ('Uyūn Akhbār al-Riḍā, vol. 1, p.237) also support this reading.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:131
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:131 - إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
Indeed, We thus reward the good-doers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:132
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:132 - إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
innahu min ʿibādinā l-mu'minīna
Indeed, he (was) of Our slaves believing

item.title: As-Saaffaat:133
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:133 - وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
wa-inna lūṭan lamina l-mur'salīna
And indeed Lut (was) of the Messengers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:134
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:134 - إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
idh najjaynāhu wa-ahlahu ajmaʿīna
When We saved him and his family all

item.title: As-Saaffaat:135
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:135 - إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ
illā ʿajūzan fī l-ghābirīna
Except an old woman (was) among those who remained behind

item.title: As-Saaffaat:136
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:136 - ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْءَاخَرِينَ
thumma dammarnā l-ākharīna
Then We destroyed the others

item.title: As-Saaffaat:137
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:137 - وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُصْبِحِينَ
wa-innakum latamurrūna ʿalayhim muṣ'biḥīna
And indeed, you surely pass by them (in the) morning

item.title: As-Saaffaat:138
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:138 - وَبِاللَّيْلِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
wabi-al-layli afalā taʿqilūna
And at night Then will not you use reason

item.title: As-Saaffaat:139
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:139 - وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
wa-inna yūnusa lamina l-mur'salīna
And indeed Yunus (was) surely of the Messengers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:140
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:140 - إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ
idh abaqa ilā l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni
When he ran away to the ship laden

item.title: As-Saaffaat:141
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:141 - فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ
fasāhama fakāna mina l-mud'ḥaḍīna
Then he drew lots and was of the losers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:142
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:142 - فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
fal-taqamahu l-ḥūtu wahuwa mulīmun
Then swallowed him the fish while he (was) blameworthy

item.title: As-Saaffaat:143
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:143 - فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ
falawlā annahu kāna mina l-musabiḥīna
And if not that he was of those who glorify

item.title: As-Saaffaat:144
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:144 - لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna
Certainly, he (would have) remained in its belly until the Day they are resurrected

item.title: As-Saaffaat:145
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:145 - فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
fanabadhnāhu bil-ʿarāi wahuwa saqīmun
But We cast him onto the open shore while he (was) ill

item.title: As-Saaffaat:146
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:146 - وَأَنْبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِنْ يَقْطِينٍ
wa-anbatnā ʿalayhi shajaratan min yaqṭīnin
And We caused to grow over him a plant of gourd

item.title: As-Saaffaat:147
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:147 - وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūna
And We sent him to a hundred thousand or more

item.title: As-Saaffaat:148
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:148 - فَءَامَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَى حِينٍ
faāmanū famattaʿnāhum ilā ḥīnin
And they believed so We gave them enjoyment for a while

item.title: As-Saaffaat:149
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:149 - فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ fa-is'taftihim alirabbika l-banātu walahumu l-banūna Then ask them Does your Lord (have) daughters while for them (are) sons
  • [1] Cf. (Q 6:100); (Q 16:57); (Q 17:40); (Q 43:16); (Q 52:39).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:150
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:150 - أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūna Or did We create the Angels females while they (were) witnesses
  • [1] Or 'while they were witnesses.'

item.title: As-Saaffaat:151
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:151 - أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
alā innahum min if'kihim layaqūlūna
No doubt indeed, they of their falsehood [they] say

item.title: As-Saaffaat:152
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:152 - وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
walada l-lahu wa-innahum lakādhibūna
Allah has begotten Allah has begotten and indeed, they surely (are) liars

item.title: As-Saaffaat:153
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:153 - أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ
aṣṭafā l-banāti ʿalā l-banīna
Has He chosen [the] daughters over sons

item.title: As-Saaffaat:154
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:154 - مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna
What is with you What is with you How you judge

item.title: As-Saaffaat:155
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:155 - أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
afalā tadhakkarūna
Then will not you pay heed

item.title: As-Saaffaat:156
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:156 - أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُبِينٌ am lakum sul'ṭānun mubīnun Or (is) for you an authority clear
  • [1] That is, in support of what they assert.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:157
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:157 - فَأْتُوْۤا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
fatū bikitābikum in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Then bring your book if you are truthful

item.title: As-Saaffaat:158
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:158 - وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna
And they have made between Him and between the jinn a relationship but certainly know the jinn that they (will) surely be brought

item.title: As-Saaffaat:159
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:159 - سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna
Glory be (to) Allah above what they attribute

item.title: As-Saaffaat:160
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:160 - إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
illā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna
Except (the) slaves (of) Allah the chosen

item.title: As-Saaffaat:161
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:161 - فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
fa-innakum wamā taʿbudūna
So indeed, you and what you worship

item.title: As-Saaffaat:162
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:162 - مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ
mā antum ʿalayhi bifātinīna
Not you from Him can tempt away (anyone)

item.title: As-Saaffaat:163
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:163 - إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ
illā man huwa ṣāli l-jaḥīmi
Except who he (is) to burn (in) the Hellfire

item.title: As-Saaffaat:164
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:164 - وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَعْلُومٌ wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmun And not among us except for him (is) a position known
  • [1] Verses (Q 37:164) - (Q 37:166) quote the words of the angels referred to in verse (Q 37:1).

item.title: As-Saaffaat:165
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:165 - وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ
wa-innā lanaḥnu l-ṣāfūna
And indeed, we surely, [we] stand in rows

item.title: As-Saaffaat:166
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:166 - وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ
wa-innā lanaḥnu l-musabiḥūna
And indeed, we surely, [we] glorify (Allah)

item.title: As-Saaffaat:167
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:167 - وَإِنْ كَانُوْۤا لَيَقُولُونَ wa-in kānū layaqūlūna And indeed they used to say
  • [1] That is, the pagans of Makkah.

item.title: As-Saaffaat:168
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:168 - لَوْ أَنَّ عِنْدَنَا ذِكْرًا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīna
If that we had a reminder from the former (people)

item.title: As-Saaffaat:169
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:169 - لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
lakunnā ʿibāda l-lahi l-mukh'laṣīna
Certainly, we (would) have been slaves (of) Allah the chosen

item.title: As-Saaffaat:170
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:170 - فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
fakafarū bihi fasawfa yaʿlamūna
But they disbelieved in it so soon they will know

item.title: As-Saaffaat:171
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:171 - وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
walaqad sabaqat kalimatunā liʿibādinā l-mur'salīna
And verily has preceded Our Word for Our slaves the Messengers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:172
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:172 - إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنْصُورُونَ
innahum lahumu l-manṣūrūna
Indeed they surely they (would be) the victorious

item.title: As-Saaffaat:173
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:173 - وَإِنَّ جُنْدَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ
wa-inna jundanā lahumu l-ghālibūna
And indeed Our host surely, they (will be) those who overcome

item.title: As-Saaffaat:174
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:174 - فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ
fatawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin
So turn away from them until a time

item.title: As-Saaffaat:175
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:175 - وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
wa-abṣir'hum fasawfa yub'ṣirūna
And see them so soon they will see

item.title: As-Saaffaat:176
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:176 - أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
afabiʿadhābinā yastaʿjilūna
Then is (it) for Our punishment they hasten

item.title: As-Saaffaat:177
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:177 - فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ
fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīna
But when it descends in their territory then evil (will be) (the) morning (for) those who were warned

item.title: As-Saaffaat:178
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:178 - وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتّٰی حِينٍ
watawalla ʿanhum ḥattā ḥīnin
So turn away from them for a time

item.title: As-Saaffaat:179
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:179 - وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
wa-abṣir fasawfa yub'ṣirūna
And see so soon they will see

item.title: As-Saaffaat:180
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:180 - سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūna
Glory (be to) your Lord (the) Lord (of) Honor above what they attribute

item.title: As-Saaffaat:181
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:181 - وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
wasalāmun ʿalā l-mur'salīna
And peace be upon the Messengers

item.title: As-Saaffaat:182
item.description:
As-Saaffaat:182 - وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wal-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And all praise (be) to Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: 38. ص (Saad)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the single discrete Arabic letter Ṣād. It takes its name from the letter Ṣād, as mentioned in verse 1. This surah mentions previous prophets in support and encouragement for Muḥammad, and makes a clear link between the arrogance displayed by the disbelievers of Mecca, previous generations, and Iblis, the original rebel. The first and last verses assert the truth and nobility of the Quran.
The surah is also known as Saad

38:1
ص وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ
sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'ri
Saad By the Quran full (of) reminder full (of) reminder

38:2
بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqin
Nay those who disbelieve (are) in self-glory and opposition

38:3
كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin
How many We destroyed before them before them of a generation then they called out when there (was) no longer time (for) escape

item.title: Saad:1
item.description:
Saad:1 - ص وَالْقُرْاٰنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'ri Saad By the Quran full (of) reminder full (of) reminder
  • [1] Ellipsis: the omitted phrase is 'you are indeed one of the apostles, on a straight path.' Cf. (Q 36:3).

item.title: Saad:2
item.description:
Saad:2 - بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqin
Nay those who disbelieve (are) in self-glory and opposition

item.title: Saad:3
item.description:
Saad:3 - كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin
How many We destroyed before them before them of a generation then they called out when there (was) no longer time (for) escape

item.title: Saad:4
item.description:
Saad:4 - وَعَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun
And they wonder that has come to them a warner from themselves And said the disbelievers This (is) a magician a liar

item.title: Saad:5
item.description:
Saad:5 - أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābun
Has he made the gods (into) one god (into) one god Indeed this (is) certainly a thing curious

item.title: Saad:6
item.description:
Saad:6 - وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوْۤا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَى آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ
wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurādu
And went forth the chiefs among them that Continue and be patient over your gods Indeed this (is) certainly a thing intended

item.title: Saad:7
item.description:
Saad:7 - مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْاٰخِرَةُ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqun Not we heard of this in the religion the last Not (is) this but a fabrication
  • [1] That is, in the polytheistic creed prevalent in pre-Islamic Arabia.

item.title: Saad:8
item.description:
Saad:8 - أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي بَلْ لَمَّا يَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِ
a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhābi
Has been revealed to him the Message from among us Nay They (are) in doubt about My Message Nay not yet they have tasted My punishment

item.title: Saad:9
item.description:
Saad:9 - أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ
am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahābi
Or have they (the) treasures (of the) Mercy (of) your Lord the All-Mighty the Bestower

item.title: Saad:10
item.description:
Saad:10 - أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbābi Or for them (is the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them Then let them ascend by the means
  • [1] Or 'let them ascend by the contrivances.' Or 'let them ascend by the ladder,' or 'let them ascend into the heavens.'

item.title: Saad:11
item.description:
Saad:11 - جُنْدٌ مَا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzābi Soldiers there there (they will be) defeated among the companies
  • [1] A prophesy of the defeat of the Makkan army at Badr (see Ṭabarī and Ṭabrisī). Or 'from among the confederates,' that is, of Satan (cf. (Q 35:6), (Q 58:19)).

item.title: Saad:12
item.description:
Saad:12 - كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtādi Denied before them (the) people (of) Nuh and Aad and Firaun (the) owner (of) the stakes
  • [1] Lit.: 'the one of stakes.' According to several traditions, Pharaoh used to torture and execute his victims by piercing their bodies with stakes, or awtād (see Biḥār al-anwār, vol. 13, p. 136, from 'Ilal al-Sharāyi', p. 161; vol. 71, p. 13; vol. 75, p. 403). Hence the epithet 'dhi'l-awtād,' which occurs twice in the Qur'ān with reference to Pharaoh, refers to him as one who used to impale his victims. Other alternate explanations have been suggested for this epithet by the commentators, but they are not convincing.

item.title: Saad:13
item.description:
Saad:13 - وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْءَيْكَةِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzābu And Thamud and (the) people (of) Lut and (the) companions (of) the wood Those (were) the companies
  • [1] Cf. (Q 15:78).

item.title: Saad:14
item.description:
Saad:14 - إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqābi
Not all (of them) but denied the Messengers so (was) just My penalty

item.title: Saad:15
item.description:
Saad:15 - وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqin And not await these but a shout one not for it any delay
  • [1] That is, the pagans of Makkah.

item.title: Saad:16
item.description:
Saad:16 - وَقَالُوْۤا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisābi And they say Our Lord Hasten for us our share before (the) Day (of) the Account
  • [1] That is, 'our share of punishment,' said mockingly.

item.title: Saad:17
item.description:
Saad:17 - اِصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُدَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābun
Be patient over what they say and remember Our slave Dawood the possessor of strength the possessor of strength Indeed, he (was) repeatedly turning

item.title: Saad:18
item.description:
Saad:18 - إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ
innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāqi
Indeed, We subjected the mountains with him glorifying in the evening and [the] sunrise

item.title: Saad:19
item.description:
Saad:19 - وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوَّابٌ
wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābun
And the birds assembled all with him repeatedly turning

item.title: Saad:20
item.description:
Saad:20 - وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭābi
And We strengthened his kingdom and We gave him [the] wisdom and decisive speech

item.title: Saad:21
item.description:
Saad:21 - وَهَلْ أَتَىكَ نَبَؤُا الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāba And has (there) come to you (the) news (of) the litigants when they climbed over the wall (of) the chamber
  • [1] Or 'sanctum.'

item.title: Saad:22
item.description:
Saad:22 - إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَى دَاوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَى بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَى سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ
idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭi
When they entered upon Dawood and he was afraid of them they said (Do) not fear (We are) two litigants has wronged one of us to another so judge between us in truth and (do) not be unjust and guide us to an even [the] path

item.title: Saad:23
item.description:
Saad:23 - إِنَّ هَذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ
inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭābi
Indeed this (is) my brother he has ninety-nine ninety-nine ewe(s) while I have ewe one so he said Entrust her to me and he overpowered me in [the] speech

item.title: Saad:24
item.description:
Saad:24 - قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَى نِعَاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāba
He said Certainly he has wronged you by demanding your ewe to his ewes And indeed many of the partners certainly oppress some of them on another except those who believe and do righteous deeds and few (are) they (are) they And became certain Dawood that We (had) tried him and he asked forgiveness (of) his Lord and fell down bowing and turned in repentance

item.title: Saad:25
item.description:
Saad:25 - فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ
faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin
So We forgave for him that And indeed for him with Us surely is a near access and a good place of return

item.title: Saad:26
item.description:
Saad:26 - يَادَاوُدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَى فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ
yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisābi
O Dawood Indeed, We [We] have made you a vicegerent in the earth so judge between [the] men in truth and (do) not follow the desire for it will lead you astray from (the) way (of) Allah Indeed those who go astray from (the) way (of) Allah for them (is) a punishment severe because they forgot (the) Day (of) Account

item.title: Saad:27
item.description:
Saad:27 - وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنَ النَّارِ
wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nāri
And not We created the heaven and the earth and whatever (is) between them without purpose That (is the) assumption (of) those who disbelieve So woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire

item.title: Saad:28
item.description:
Saad:28 - أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujāri
Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who spread corruption in the earth Or should We treat the pious like the wicked

item.title: Saad:29
item.description:
Saad:29 - كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا اٰیٰتِهٖ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ
kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albābi
(This is) a Book We have revealed it to you blessed that they may ponder (over) its Verses and may be reminded those of understanding those of understanding

item.title: Saad:30
item.description:
Saad:30 - وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun
And We gave to Dawood Sulaiman an excellent slave Indeed, he (was) one who repeatedly turned

item.title: Saad:31
item.description:
Saad:31 - إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ
idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyādu
When were displayed to him in the afternoon excellent bred steeds excellent bred steeds

item.title: Saad:32
item.description:
Saad:32 - فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتّٰی تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ
faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijābi
And he said Indeed, I [I] preferred (the) love (of) the good over (the) remembrance (of) my Lord Until they were hidden in the veil

item.title: Saad:33
item.description:
Saad:33 - رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāqi Return them to me Then he began (to) pass (his hand) over the legs and the necks
  • [1] Or 'them.' The pronoun may be taken as referring to the sun or to the horses. However, most exegetes have taken it as referring to the sun and its setting. While Solomon was engaged in viewing the horses, the sun set, and the time of the afternoon prayer (supererogatory or obligatory) elapsed. According to a tradition narrated from al-Imām al-Ṣādiq ('a), when Solomon noticed that the sun had set, he called out to the angels to bring it back so that he could offer the afternoon prayer. Also, according to this tradition, the wiping of legs and necks mentioned in the verse refers to the performance of ablution (wuḍū') before the prayer by Solomon and his men as prescribed in their Law. (Biḥār, vol. 14, p. 101; vol. 82, p. 341).

item.title: Saad:34
item.description:
Saad:34 - وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāba
And certainly We tried Sulaiman and We placed on his throne a body then he turned

item.title: Saad:35
item.description:
Saad:35 - قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahābu He said O my Lord Forgive me and grant me a kingdom not (will) belong to anyone after me after me Indeed, You You (are) the Bestower
  • [1] Cf. (Q 35:41). Or 'a kingdom that will not befit anyone after me.'

item.title: Saad:36
item.description:
Saad:36 - فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāba
Then We subjected to him the wind to flow by his command gently wherever he directed

item.title: Saad:37
item.description:
Saad:37 - وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣin
And the devils every builder and diver

item.title: Saad:38
item.description:
Saad:38 - وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ
waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi
And others bound in chains

item.title: Saad:39
item.description:
Saad:39 - هَذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābin
This (is) Our gift so grant or withhold without account

item.title: Saad:40
item.description:
Saad:40 - وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ
wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin
And indeed for him with Us surely is a near access and a good place of return

item.title: Saad:41
item.description:
Saad:41 - وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābin
And remember Our slave Ayyub when he called his Lord That [I] (has) touched me Shaitaan with distress and suffering

item.title: Saad:42
item.description:
Saad:42 - اُرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābun
Strike with your foot This (is a spring of) water to bathe cool and a drink

item.title: Saad:43
item.description:
Saad:43 - وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi
And We granted [to] him his family and a like of them with them a Mercy from Us and a Reminder for those of understanding for those of understanding

item.title: Saad:44
item.description:
Saad:44 - وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun
And take in your hand a bunch and strike with it and (do) not break (your) oath Indeed, We [We] found him patient an excellent slave Indeed, he repeatedly turned

item.title: Saad:45
item.description:
Saad:45 - وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ
wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣāri
And remember Our slaves Ibrahim and Isaac and Ayyub possessors (of) strength and vision

item.title: Saad:46
item.description:
Saad:46 - إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرٰی الدَّارِ
innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dāri
Indeed, We [We] chose them for an exclusive (quality) remembrance (of) the Home

item.title: Saad:47
item.description:
Saad:47 - وَإِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyāri
And indeed, they to Us (are) from the chosen ones the best

item.title: Saad:48
item.description:
Saad:48 - وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyāri
And remember Ishmael and Elisha and Dhul-kifl and Dhul-kifl and all (are) from the best

item.title: Saad:49
item.description:
Saad:49 - هَذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَءَابٍ
hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābin
This (is) a Reminder And indeed for the righteous surely, is a good place of return

item.title: Saad:50
item.description:
Saad:50 - جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ
jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwābu
Gardens (of) Eternity (will be) opened for them the gates

item.title: Saad:51
item.description:
Saad:51 - مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābin
Reclining therein they will call therein for fruit many and drink

item.title: Saad:52
item.description:
Saad:52 - وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābun
And with them (will be) companions of modest gaze (will be) companions of modest gaze well-matched

item.title: Saad:53
item.description:
Saad:53 - هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisābi
This (is) what you are promised for (the) Day (of) Account

item.title: Saad:54
item.description:
Saad:54 - إِنَّ هَذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَفَادٍ
inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādin
Indeed this (is) surely Our provision not for it any depletion

item.title: Saad:55
item.description:
Saad:55 - هَذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَءَابٍ
hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābin
This (is so) And indeed for the transgressors surely (is) an evil place of return

item.title: Saad:56
item.description:
Saad:56 - جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihādu
Hell they will burn therein and wretched (is) the resting place

item.title: Saad:57
item.description:
Saad:57 - هَذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqun
This (is so) Then let them taste it boiling fluid and purulence

item.title: Saad:58
item.description:
Saad:58 - وَءَاخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ
waākharu min shaklihi azwājun
And other of its type (of various) kinds

item.title: Saad:59
item.description:
Saad:59 - هَذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوْۤا النَّارِ hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nāri This (is) a company bursting (in) with you No welcome for them Indeed, they (will) burn (in) the Fire
  • [1] Said by the angels to leaders of the faithless concerning their followers.
  • [2] Said by the leaders of the faithless concerning their followers.

item.title: Saad:60
item.description:
Saad:60 - قَالُوْا بَلْ أَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarāru They say Nay You no welcome for you You brought this upon us So wretched (is) the settlement
  • [1] That is, the followers, who respond to the unfriendly welcome of their leaders.

item.title: Saad:61
item.description:
Saad:61 - قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ
qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nāri
They will say Our Lord whoever brought upon us this increase for him a punishment double in the Fire

item.title: Saad:62
item.description:
Saad:62 - وَقَالُوْۤا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرٰی رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَشْرَارِ
waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrāri
And they (will) say What (is) for us not we see men we used to count them among the bad ones

item.title: Saad:63
item.description:
Saad:63 - أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ
attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣāru
Did we take them (in) ridicule or has turned away from them the vision

item.title: Saad:64
item.description:
Saad:64 - إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ
inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nāri
Indeed that (is) surely (the) truth (the) quarreling (of the) people (of) the Fire

item.title: Saad:65
item.description:
Saad:65 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru
Say Only I am a warner and not (is there) any god except Allah the One the Irresistible

item.title: Saad:66
item.description:
Saad:66 - رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru
Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them the All-Mighty the Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Saad:67
item.description:
Saad:67 - قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا عَظِيمٌ
qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmun
Say It (is) a news great

item.title: Saad:68
item.description:
Saad:68 - أَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūna
You from it turn away

item.title: Saad:69
item.description:
Saad:69 - مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَاِ الْاَعْلٰۤی إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūna
Not is for me any knowledge (of) the chiefs the exalted when they were disputing

item.title: Saad:70
item.description:
Saad:70 - إِنْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun
Not has been revealed to me except that only I am a warner clear

item.title: Saad:71
item.description:
Saad:71 - إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اِنِّیْ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ
idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīnin
When said your Lord to the Angels Indeed, I Am going to create a human being from clay

item.title: Saad:72
item.description:
Saad:72 - فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوْۤا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ
fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna
So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit then fall down to him prostrating

item.title: Saad:73
item.description:
Saad:73 - فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna
So prostrated the Angels all of them together

item.title: Saad:74
item.description:
Saad:74 - إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīna
Except Iblis he was arrogant and became of the disbelievers

item.title: Saad:75
item.description:
Saad:75 - قَالَ يَاإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ
qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīna
He said O Iblis What prevented you that you (should) prostrate to (one) whom I created with My Hands Are you arrogant or are you of the exalted ones

item.title: Saad:76
item.description:
Saad:76 - قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ
qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin
He said I am better than him You created me from fire and You created him from clay

item.title: Saad:77
item.description:
Saad:77 - قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun
He said Then get out of it for indeed, you (are) accursed

item.title: Saad:78
item.description:
Saad:78 - وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīni
And indeed upon you (is) My curse until (the) Day (of) Judgment

item.title: Saad:79
item.description:
Saad:79 - قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna
He said My Lord Then give me respite until (the) Day they are resurrected

item.title: Saad:80
item.description:
Saad:80 - قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ
qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna
He said Then indeed, you (are) of those given respite

item.title: Saad:81
item.description:
Saad:81 - إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ
ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi
Until (the) Day (of) the time well-known

item.title: Saad:82
item.description:
Saad:82 - قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna
He said Then by Your might I will surely mislead them all

item.title: Saad:83
item.description:
Saad:83 - إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِیْنَ
illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna
Except Your slaves among them the chosen ones

item.title: Saad:84
item.description:
Saad:84 - قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūlu
He said Then (it is) the truth and the truth I say

item.title: Saad:85
item.description:
Saad:85 - لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīna Surely I will fill Hell with you and those who follow you among them all
  • [1] Cf. (Q 7:18); (Q 11:119); (Q 32:13).

item.title: Saad:86
item.description:
Saad:86 - قُلْ مَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīna Say Not I ask of you for it any payment and not I am of the ones who pretend
  • [1] Or 'nor am I one of those who impose themselves [upon others].'

item.title: Saad:87
item.description:
Saad:87 - إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna
Not it (is) except a Reminder to the worlds

item.title: Saad:88
item.description:
Saad:88 - وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ
walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīnin
And surely you will know its information after a time

item.title: 39. الزمر (Az-Zumar)
item.description:
The surah that mentions The Throngs of the unbelievers who shall be driven to Hell in the Hereafter, and the companies of the God-fearing who shall be ushered to Paradise in honour. It takes its name from verse 71 and verse 73 in which the word "throngs" (zumar) occurs. The main focus of the surah is the contrast between those who follow the true faith, and those who ascribe partners to God. The surah emphasizes that people are free to choose whether to believe or disbelieve (verse 41), but urges them in the strongest possible terms to turn to the right path while there is still time to repent (verse 53 ff.).
The surah is also known as The Companies, The Crowds, The Multitudes, The Small Groups

39:1
تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

39:2
إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ
innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna
Indeed, We [We] have revealed to you the Book in truth so worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion

39:3
أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffārun
Unquestionably for Allah (is) the religion the pure And those who take besides Him besides Him protectors Not we worship them except that they may bring us near to Allah (in) nearness Indeed Allah will judge between them in what they in it differ Indeed Allah (does) not guide (one) who he (is) a liar and a disbeliever

item.title: Az-Zumar:1
item.description:
Az-Zumar:1 - تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Az-Zumar:2
item.description:
Az-Zumar:2 - إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ innā anzalnā ilayka l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi fa-uʿ'budi l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna Indeed, We [We] have revealed to you the Book in truth so worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion
  • [1] Or 'pure faith.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:3
item.description:
Az-Zumar:3 - أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
alā lillahi l-dīnu l-khāliṣu wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa mā naʿbuduhum illā liyuqarribūnā ilā l-lahi zul'fā inna l-laha yaḥkumu baynahum fī mā hum fīhi yakhtalifūna inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa kādhibun kaffārun
Unquestionably for Allah (is) the religion the pure And those who take besides Him besides Him protectors Not we worship them except that they may bring us near to Allah (in) nearness Indeed Allah will judge between them in what they in it differ Indeed Allah (does) not guide (one) who he (is) a liar and a disbeliever

item.title: Az-Zumar:4
item.description:
Az-Zumar:4 - لَوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصْطَفَى مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ سُبْحَانَهُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
law arāda l-lahu an yattakhidha waladan la-iṣ'ṭafā mimmā yakhluqu mā yashāu sub'ḥānahu huwa l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahāru
If Allah (had) intended Allah (had) intended to take a son surely, He (could) have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed Glory be to Him He (is) Allah the One the Irresistible

item.title: Az-Zumar:5
item.description:
Az-Zumar:5 - خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi yukawwiru al-layla ʿalā l-nahāri wayukawwiru l-nahāra ʿalā al-layli wasakhara l-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman alā huwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafāru He created the heavens and the earth in [the] truth He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night And He subjected the sun and the moon each running for a term specified Unquestionably He (is) the All-Mighty the Oft-Forgiving
  • [1] Or 'until a specified time.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:6
item.description:
Az-Zumar:6 - خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِنْ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُصْرَفُونَ khalaqakum min nafsin wāḥidatin thumma jaʿala min'hā zawjahā wa-anzala lakum mina l-anʿāmi thamāniyata azwājin yakhluqukum fī buṭūni ummahātikum khalqan min baʿdi khalqin fī ẓulumātin thalāthin dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum lahu l-mul'ku lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tuṣ'rafūna He created you from a soul single Then He made from it its mate And He sent down for you of the cattle eight kinds He creates you in (the) wombs (of) your mothers creation after after creation in darkness[es] three That (is) Allah your Lord for Him (is) the dominion (There is) no god except He Then how are you turning away
  • [1] Cf. (Q 6:143).

item.title: Az-Zumar:7
item.description:
Az-Zumar:7 - إِنْ تَكْفُرُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكُمْ وَلَا يَرْضَى لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ وَإِنْ تَشْكُرُوْۤا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ in takfurū fa-inna l-laha ghaniyyun ʿankum walā yarḍā liʿibādihi l-kuf'ra wa-in tashkurū yarḍahu lakum walā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā thumma ilā rabbikum marjiʿukum fayunabbi-ukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūna innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri If you disbelieve then indeed Allah (is) free from need of you And not He likes in His slaves ungratefulness And if you are grateful He likes it in you And not will bear bearer of burdens (the) burden (of) another Then to your Lord (is) your return then He will inform you about what you used to do Indeed, He (is) the All-Knower of what (is) in the breasts of what (is) in the breasts
  • [1] Or 'faithless.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:8
item.description:
Az-Zumar:8 - وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوْۤا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ wa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿā rabbahu munīban ilayhi thumma idhā khawwalahu niʿ'matan min'hu nasiya mā kāna yadʿū ilayhi min qablu wajaʿala lillahi andādan liyuḍilla ʿan sabīlihi qul tamattaʿ bikuf'rika qalīlan innaka min aṣḥābi l-nāri And when touches [the] man adversity he calls his Lord turning to Him then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself he forgets (for) what he used to call he used to call [to] Him before before and he sets up to Allah rivals to mislead from His Path Say Enjoy in your disbelief (for) a little Indeed, you (are) of (the) companions (of) the Fire
  • [1] Cf. (Q 6:41).
  • [2] Or 'faithlessness.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:9
item.description:
Az-Zumar:9 - أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ ءَانَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوْۤا رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ amman huwa qānitun ānāa al-layli sājidan waqāiman yaḥdharu l-ākhirata wayarjū raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawī alladhīna yaʿlamūna wa-alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna innamā yatadhakkaru ulū l-albābi Is (one) who he (is) devoutly obedient (during) hours (of) the night prostrating and standing fearing the Hereafter and hoping (for the) Mercy (of) his Lord Say Are equal those who know and those who (do) not know Only will take heed those of understanding those of understanding
  • [1] Or 'is obedient.'
  • [2] Ellipsis. The omitted phrase is, 'like someone who is not such?'

item.title: Az-Zumar:10
item.description:
Az-Zumar:10 - قُلْ يَاعِبَادِ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا فِي هَذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
qul yāʿibādi alladhīna āmanū ittaqū rabbakum lilladhīna aḥsanū fī hādhihi l-dun'yā ḥasanatun wa-arḍu l-lahi wāsiʿatun innamā yuwaffā l-ṣābirūna ajrahum bighayri ḥisābin
Say O My slaves [those] who believe Fear your Lord For those who do good in this world (is) good and the earth (of) Allah (is) spacious Only will be paid back in full the patient ones their reward without account

item.title: Az-Zumar:11
item.description:
Az-Zumar:11 - قُلْ اِنِّیْ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ الدِّينَ
qul innī umir'tu an aʿbuda l-laha mukh'liṣan lahu l-dīna
Say Indeed, I [I] am commanded that I worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion

item.title: Az-Zumar:12
item.description:
Az-Zumar:12 - وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
wa-umir'tu li-an akūna awwala l-mus'limīna
And I am commanded that I be (the) first (of) those who submit

item.title: Az-Zumar:13
item.description:
Az-Zumar:13 - قُلْ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
