qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
Say Indeed, I [I] fear if I disobey my Lord (the) punishment (of) a Day great

item.title: Az-Zumar:14
item.description:
Az-Zumar:14 - قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَهُ دِينِي
quli l-laha aʿbudu mukh'liṣan lahu dīnī
Say I worship Allah I worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) my religion

item.title: Az-Zumar:15
item.description:
Az-Zumar:15 - فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ
fa-uʿ'budū mā shi'tum min dūnihi qul inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā dhālika huwa l-khus'rānu l-mubīnu
So worship what you will besides Him besides Him Say Indeed the losers (are) those who (will) lose themselves and their families (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection Unquestionably that it (is) the loss the clear

item.title: Az-Zumar:16
item.description:
Az-Zumar:16 - لَهُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ يَاعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ
lahum min fawqihim ẓulalun mina l-nāri wamin taḥtihim ẓulalun dhālika yukhawwifu l-lahu bihi ʿibādahu yāʿibādi fa-ittaqūni
For them from above them coverings of the Fire and from below them coverings (With) that threatens Allah with it His slaves O My slaves So fear Me

item.title: Az-Zumar:17
item.description:
Az-Zumar:17 - وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
wa-alladhīna ij'tanabū l-ṭāghūta an yaʿbudūhā wa-anābū ilā l-lahi lahumu l-bush'rā fabashir ʿibādi
And those who avoid the false gods lest they worship them and turn to Allah for them (are) glad tidings So give glad tidings (to) My slaves

item.title: Az-Zumar:18
item.description:
Az-Zumar:18 - اَلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَاُولٰٓىِٕكَ هُمْ أُولُوْۤا الْأَلْبَابِ
alladhīna yastamiʿūna l-qawla fayattabiʿūna aḥsanahu ulāika alladhīna hadāhumu l-lahu wa-ulāika hum ulū l-albābi
Those who they listen (to) the Word then follow the best thereof those (are) they whom Allah has guided them Allah has guided them and those are [they] the men of understanding the men of understanding

item.title: Az-Zumar:19
item.description:
Az-Zumar:19 - أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنْتَ تُنْقِذُ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ afaman ḥaqqa ʿalayhi kalimatu l-ʿadhābi afa-anta tunqidhu man fī l-nāri Then, is (one) who became due on him the word (of) the punishment Then can you save (one) who (is) in the Fire
  • [1] Ellipsis; the omitted phrase is, 'escape his punishment?'

item.title: Az-Zumar:20
item.description:
Az-Zumar:20 - لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ
lākini alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihā ghurafun mabniyyatun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waʿda l-lahi lā yukh'lifu l-lahu l-mīʿāda
But those who fear their Lord for them (are) lofty mansions above them above them lofty mansions built high flow from beneath it the rivers (The) Promise (of) Allah Not Allah fails Allah fails (in His) promise

item.title: Az-Zumar:21
item.description:
Az-Zumar:21 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fasalakahu yanābīʿa fī l-arḍi thumma yukh'riju bihi zarʿan mukh'talifan alwānuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yajʿaluhu ḥuṭāman inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi
Do not you see that Allah sends down from the sky water and He makes it flow (as) springs in the earth then He produces with it crops (of) different colors then they wither and you see it turn yellow then He makes them debris Indeed in that surely, (is) a reminder for those of understanding for those of understanding

item.title: Az-Zumar:22
item.description:
Az-Zumar:22 - أَفَمَنْ شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَى نُورٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَوَيْلٌ لِلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ afaman sharaḥa l-lahu ṣadrahu lil'is'lāmi fahuwa ʿalā nūrin min rabbihi fawaylun lil'qāsiyati qulūbuhum min dhik'ri l-lahi ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin So is (one for) whom Allah has expanded Allah has expanded his breast for Islam so he (is) upon a light from his Lord So woe to (those are) hardened their hearts from (the) remembrance of Allah (the) remembrance of Allah Those (are) in error clear
  • [1] Ellipsis. The omitted phrase is, 'like someone who is not such?'

item.title: Az-Zumar:23
item.description:
Az-Zumar:23 - اَللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُتَشَابِهًا مَثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ al-lahu nazzala aḥsana l-ḥadīthi kitāban mutashābihan mathāniya taqshaʿirru min'hu julūdu alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum thumma talīnu julūduhum waqulūbuhum ilā dhik'ri l-lahi dhālika hudā l-lahi yahdī bihi man yashāu waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Allah has revealed (the) best (of) [the] statement a Book (its parts) resembling each other oft-repeated Shiver from it (the) skins (of) those who fear their Lord then relax their skins and their hearts at (the) remembrance (of) Allah That (is the) guidance (of) Allah He guides with it whom He wills And whoever Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray then not for him any guide
  • [1] Or 'parallel motifs.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:24
item.description:
Az-Zumar:24 - أَفَمَنْ يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوْۤا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ afaman yattaqī biwajhihi sūa l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati waqīla lilẓẓālimīna dhūqū mā kuntum taksibūna Then (is) he who will shield with his face (the) worst punishment (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection And it will be said to the wrongdoers Taste what you used to earn
  • [1] Ellipsis. The omitted phrase is, 'like someone who is secure from any kind of punishment?'

item.title: Az-Zumar:25
item.description:
Az-Zumar:25 - كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fa-atāhumu l-ʿadhābu min ḥaythu lā yashʿurūna
Denied those who (were) before them (were) before them so came upon them the punishment from where not they perceive

item.title: Az-Zumar:26
item.description:
Az-Zumar:26 - فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ
fa-adhāqahumu l-lahu l-khiz'ya fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna
So Allah made them So Allah made them the disgrace in the life (of) the world and certainly (the) punishment (of) the Hereafter (is) greater if they knew

item.title: Az-Zumar:27
item.description:
Az-Zumar:27 - وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
walaqad ḍarabnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
And indeed We have set forth for people in this Quran of every example so that they may take heed

item.title: Az-Zumar:28
item.description:
Az-Zumar:28 - قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan ghayra dhī ʿiwajin laʿallahum yattaqūna
A Quran (in) Arabic without any crookedness so that they may (become) righteous

item.title: Az-Zumar:29
item.description:
Az-Zumar:29 - ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فِیْهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan rajulan fīhi shurakāu mutashākisūna warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyāni mathalan l-ḥamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna Allah sets forth Allah sets forth an example a man about him partners quarreling and a man (belonging) exclusively to one man are they both equal (in) comparison All praise (be) to Allah Nay most of them (do) not know
  • [1] The parable compares the polytheist with the monotheist. The worshipper of multiple deities is likened to a slave trying to please several masters.

item.title: Az-Zumar:30
item.description:
Az-Zumar:30 - إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ مَيِّتُونَ
innaka mayyitun wa-innahum mayyitūna
Indeed, you will die and indeed, they (will also) die

item.title: Az-Zumar:31
item.description:
Az-Zumar:31 - ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿinda rabbikum takhtaṣimūna
Then indeed you (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection before your Lord will dispute

item.title: Az-Zumar:32
item.description:
Az-Zumar:32 - فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ
faman aẓlamu mimman kadhaba ʿalā l-lahi wakadhaba bil-ṣid'qi idh jāahu alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'kāfirīna
Then who (is) more unjust than (one) who lies against Allah and denies the truth when it comes to him Is (there) not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers

item.title: Az-Zumar:33
item.description:
Az-Zumar:33 - وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ
wa-alladhī jāa bil-ṣid'qi waṣaddaqa bihi ulāika humu l-mutaqūna
And the one who brought the truth and believed in it those they (are) the righteous

item.title: Az-Zumar:34
item.description:
Az-Zumar:34 - لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika jazāu l-muḥ'sinīna
For them (is) what they wish with their Lord That (is the) reward (of) the good-doers

item.title: Az-Zumar:35
item.description:
Az-Zumar:35 - لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوْۤا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
liyukaffira l-lahu ʿanhum aswa-a alladhī ʿamilū wayajziyahum ajrahum bi-aḥsani alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna
That Allah will remove That Allah will remove from them (the) worst (of) what they did and reward them their due for (the) best (of) what they used to do

item.title: Az-Zumar:36
item.description:
Az-Zumar:36 - أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ alaysa l-lahu bikāfin ʿabdahu wayukhawwifūnaka bi-alladhīna min dūnihi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin Is not Allah sufficient (for) His slave And they threaten you with those besides Him besides Him And whoever Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray then not for him any guide
  • [1] That is, the idolaters, who threatened the Prophet with the vengeance of their gods.

item.title: Az-Zumar:37
item.description:
Az-Zumar:37 - وَمَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُضِلٍّ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انْتِقَامٍ
waman yahdi l-lahu famā lahu min muḍillin alaysa l-lahu biʿazīzin dhī intiqāmin
And whoever Allah guides Allah guides then not for him any misleader Is not Allah All-Mighty All-Able of retribution All-Able of retribution

item.title: Az-Zumar:38
item.description:
Az-Zumar:38 - وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُلْ أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna l-lahu qul afara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi in arādaniya l-lahu biḍurrin hal hunna kāshifātu ḍurrihi aw arādanī biraḥmatin hal hunna mum'sikātu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya l-lahu ʿalayhi yatawakkalu l-mutawakilūna
And if you ask them who created the heavens and the earth Surely, they will say Allah Say Then do you see what you invoke besides besides Allah if Allah intended for me Allah intended for me harm are they removers (of) harm (from) Him or if He intended for me mercy are they withholders (of) His mercy Say Sufficient (is) Allah for me Sufficient (is) Allah for me upon Him put trust those who trust

item.title: Az-Zumar:39
item.description:
Az-Zumar:39 - قُلْ يَاقَوْمِ اعْمَلُوْۤا عَلَى مَكَانَتِكُمْ اِنِّیْ عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
qul yāqawmi iʿ'malū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmilun fasawfa taʿlamūna
Say O my people Work (according) to your position indeed, I am working then soon you will know

item.title: Az-Zumar:40
item.description:
Az-Zumar:40 - مَنْ يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُقِيمٌ
man yatīhi ʿadhābun yukh'zīhi wayaḥillu ʿalayhi ʿadhābun muqīmun
(Upon) whom will come a punishment disgracing him and descends on him a punishment everlasting

item.title: Az-Zumar:41
item.description:
Az-Zumar:41 - إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَى فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ
innā anzalnā ʿalayka l-kitāba lilnnāsi bil-ḥaqi famani ih'tadā falinafsihi waman ḍalla fa-innamā yaḍillu ʿalayhā wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin
Indeed We We revealed to you the Book for [the] mankind in truth So whoever accepts guidance then (it is) for his soul and whoever goes astray then only he strays against his (soul) And not you (are) over them a manager

item.title: Az-Zumar:42
item.description:
Az-Zumar:42 - اَللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنْفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَى عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرٰی إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
al-lahu yatawaffā l-anfusa ḥīna mawtihā wa-allatī lam tamut fī manāmihā fayum'siku allatī qaḍā ʿalayhā l-mawta wayur'silu l-ukh'rā ilā ajalin musamman inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna
Allah takes the souls (at the) time (of) their death and the one who (does) not die in their sleep Then He keeps the one whom He has decreed for them the death and sends the others for a term specified Indeed in that surely (are) signs for a people who ponder

item.title: Az-Zumar:43
item.description:
Az-Zumar:43 - أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ami ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi shufaʿāa qul awalaw kānū lā yamlikūna shayan walā yaʿqilūna
Or have they taken besides besides Allah intercessors Say Even though they were not possessing anything and not they understand

item.title: Az-Zumar:44
item.description:
Az-Zumar:44 - قُلْ لِلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
qul lillahi l-shafāʿatu jamīʿan lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi thumma ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
Say To Allah (belongs) the intercession all For Him (is the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth Then to Him you will be returned

item.title: Az-Zumar:45
item.description:
Az-Zumar:45 - وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
wa-idhā dhukira l-lahu waḥdahu ish'ma-azzat qulūbu alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati wa-idhā dhukira alladhīna min dūnihi idhā hum yastabshirūna
And when Allah is mentioned Allah is mentioned Alone shrink with aversion (the) hearts (of) those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter and when are mentioned those besides Him besides Him behold They rejoice

item.title: Az-Zumar:46
item.description:
Az-Zumar:46 - قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
quli l-lahuma fāṭira l-samāwāti wal-arḍi ʿālima l-ghaybi wal-shahādati anta taḥkumu bayna ʿibādika fī mā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna
Say O Allah Creator (of) the heavens and the earth Knower (of) the unseen and the witnessed You will judge between Your slaves in what they used to therein differ

item.title: Az-Zumar:47
item.description:
Az-Zumar:47 - وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَبَدَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوْۤا يَحْتَسِبُونَ
walaw anna lilladhīna ẓalamū mā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan wamith'lahu maʿahu la-if'tadaw bihi min sūi l-ʿadhābi yawma l-qiyāmati wabadā lahum mina l-lahi mā lam yakūnū yaḥtasibūna
And if And if those who did wrong (had) whatever (is) in the earth all and (the) like of it with it they would ransom with it from (the) evil (of) the punishment (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection And (will) appear to them from Allah what not they had taken into account

item.title: Az-Zumar:48
item.description:
Az-Zumar:48 - وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā kasabū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And will become apparent to them (the) evils (of) what they earned and will surround them what they used to in it mock

item.title: Az-Zumar:49
item.description:
Az-Zumar:49 - فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْاِنْسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
fa-idhā massa l-insāna ḍurrun daʿānā thumma idhā khawwalnāhu niʿ'matan minnā qāla innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿil'min bal hiya fit'natun walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
So when touches [the] man adversity he calls upon Us then when We bestow (on) him a favor from Us he says Only I have been given it for knowledge Nay it (is) a trial but most of them (do) not know

item.title: Az-Zumar:50
item.description:
Az-Zumar:50 - قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ
qad qālahā alladhīna min qablihim famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna
Indeed said it those before them before them but (did) not avail them what they used to earn

item.title: Az-Zumar:51
item.description:
Az-Zumar:51 - فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ
fa-aṣābahum sayyiātu mā kasabū wa-alladhīna ẓalamū min hāulāi sayuṣībuhum sayyiātu mā kasabū wamā hum bimuʿ'jizīna
Then struck them (the) evils (of) what they earned And those who have wronged of these will strike them (the) evils (of) what they earned and not they will be able to escape

item.title: Az-Zumar:52
item.description:
Az-Zumar:52 - أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
awalam yaʿlamū anna l-laha yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yu'minūna
Do not they know that Allah extends the provision for whom He wills and restricts Indeed in that surely (are) signs for a people who believe

item.title: Az-Zumar:53
item.description:
Az-Zumar:53 - قُلْ يَاعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوْۤا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْۤا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
qul yāʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati l-lahi inna l-laha yaghfiru l-dhunūba jamīʿan innahu huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
Say O My slaves Those who have transgressed against themselves (do) not despair of (the) Mercy (of) Allah Indeed Allah forgives the sins all Indeed He He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Az-Zumar:54
item.description:
Az-Zumar:54 - وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنْصَرُونَ
wa-anībū ilā rabbikum wa-aslimū lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu thumma lā tunṣarūna
And turn to your Lord and submit to Him before before that comes to you the punishment then not you will be helped

item.title: Az-Zumar:55
item.description:
Az-Zumar:55 - وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
wa-ittabiʿū aḥsana mā unzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu l-ʿadhābu baghtatan wa-antum lā tashʿurūna
And follow (the) best (of) what is revealed to you from your Lord before before that comes to you the punishment suddenly while you (do) not perceive

item.title: Az-Zumar:56
item.description:
Az-Zumar:56 - أَنْ تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَاحَسْرَتَى عَلَى مَا فَرَّطْتُ فِي جَنْبِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ
an taqūla nafsun yāḥasratā ʿalā mā farraṭtu fī janbi l-lahi wa-in kuntu lamina l-sākhirīna
Lest should say a soul Oh! My regret over what I neglected in regard (to) Allah and that I was surely, among the mockers

item.title: Az-Zumar:57
item.description:
Az-Zumar:57 - أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ
aw taqūla law anna l-laha hadānī lakuntu mina l-mutaqīna
Or it should say If that If that Allah (had) guided me surely, I (would) have been among the righteous

item.title: Az-Zumar:58
item.description:
Az-Zumar:58 - أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرٰی الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
aw taqūla ḥīna tarā l-ʿadhāba law anna lī karratan fa-akūna mina l-muḥ'sinīna
Or it should say when it sees the punishment If only for me another chance then I could be among the good-doers

item.title: Az-Zumar:59
item.description:
Az-Zumar:59 - بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ ءَايَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
balā qad jāatka āyātī fakadhabta bihā wa-is'takbarta wakunta mina l-kāfirīna
Yes verily came to you My Verses but you denied them and were arrogant and you were among the disbelievers

item.title: Az-Zumar:60
item.description:
Az-Zumar:60 - وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرٰی الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُمْ مُسْوَدَّةٌ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
wayawma l-qiyāmati tarā alladhīna kadhabū ʿalā l-lahi wujūhuhum mus'waddatun alaysa fī jahannama mathwan lil'mutakabbirīna
And (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah their faces (will be) blackened Is (there) not in Hell an abode for the arrogant

item.title: Az-Zumar:61
item.description:
Az-Zumar:61 - وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
wayunajjī l-lahu alladhīna ittaqaw bimafāzatihim lā yamassuhumu l-sūu walā hum yaḥzanūna
And Allah will deliver And Allah will deliver those who feared (Him) to their place of salvation not will touch them the evil and not they will grieve

item.title: Az-Zumar:62
item.description:
Az-Zumar:62 - اَللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
al-lahu khāliqu kulli shayin wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin wakīlun
Allah (is the) Creator (of) all things and He (is) over all things a Guardian

item.title: Az-Zumar:63
item.description:
Az-Zumar:63 - لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti l-lahi ulāika humu l-khāsirūna
For Him (are the) keys (of) the heavens and the earth And those who disbelieve in (the) Verses (of) Allah those they (are) the losers

item.title: Az-Zumar:64
item.description:
Az-Zumar:64 - قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ
qul afaghayra l-lahi tamurūnnī aʿbudu ayyuhā l-jāhilūna
Say Is (it) other than Allah you order me (to) worship O ignorant ones

item.title: Az-Zumar:65
item.description:
Az-Zumar:65 - وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
walaqad ūḥiya ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika la-in ashrakta layaḥbaṭanna ʿamaluka walatakūnanna mina l-khāsirīna
And verily it has been revealed to you and to those who (were) before you (were) before you if you associate (with Allah) surely, will become worthless your deeds and you will surely be among the losers

item.title: Az-Zumar:66
item.description:
Az-Zumar:66 - بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُنْ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
bali l-laha fa-uʿ'bud wakun mina l-shākirīna
Nay But worship Allah But worship Allah and be among the thankful ones

item.title: Az-Zumar:67
item.description:
Az-Zumar:67 - وَمَا قَدَرُوْۤا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
wamā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi wal-arḍu jamīʿan qabḍatuhu yawma l-qiyāmati wal-samāwātu maṭwiyyātun biyamīnihi sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna
And not they appraised Allah (with) true appraisal while the earth entirely (will be) in His Grip (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection and the heavens (will be) folded in His Right Hand Glory be to Him And High is He above what they associate (with Him)

item.title: Az-Zumar:68
item.description:
Az-Zumar:68 - وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِیْهِ أُخْرٰی فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنْظُرُونَ
wanufikha fī l-ṣūri faṣaʿiqa man fī l-samāwāti waman fī l-arḍi illā man shāa l-lahu thumma nufikha fīhi ukh'rā fa-idhā hum qiyāmun yanẓurūna
And (will) be blown in the trumpet then (will) fall dead whoever (is) in the heavens and whoever (is) on the earth except whom Allah wills Allah wills Then (it will) be blown in it a second time and behold They (will be) standing waiting

item.title: Az-Zumar:69
item.description:
Az-Zumar:69 - وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ وَجِاىءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ wa-ashraqati l-arḍu binūri rabbihā wawuḍiʿa l-kitābu wajīa bil-nabiyīna wal-shuhadāi waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna And (will) shine the earth with (the) light (of) its Lord and (will) be placed the Record and (will) be brought the Prophets and the witnesses and it (will) be judged between them in truth and they will not be wronged will not be wronged
  • [1] That is, the record of the people's deeds.
  • [2] Or 'the witnesses.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:70
item.description:
Az-Zumar:70 - وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
wawuffiyat kullu nafsin mā ʿamilat wahuwa aʿlamu bimā yafʿalūna
And (will) be paid in full every soul what it did and He (is the) Best-Knower of what they do

item.title: Az-Zumar:71
item.description:
Az-Zumar:71 - وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا إِلَى جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِنْكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنْذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
wasīqa alladhīna kafarū ilā jahannama zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā futiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatlūna ʿalaykum āyāti rabbikum wayundhirūnakum liqāa yawmikum hādhā qālū balā walākin ḥaqqat kalimatu l-ʿadhābi ʿalā l-kāfirīna
And (will) be driven those who disbelieve to Hell (in) groups until when they reach it (will) be opened its gates and (will) say to them its keepers Did not come to you Messengers from you reciting to you (the) Verses (of) your Lord and warning you (of the) meeting (of) your Day this They (will) say Yes But has been justified (the) word (of) punishment against the disbelievers

item.title: Az-Zumar:72
item.description:
Az-Zumar:72 - قِيلَ ادْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
qīla ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna
It will be said Enter (the) gates (of) Hell (to) abide eternally therein and wretched is (the) abode (of) the arrogant

item.title: Az-Zumar:73
item.description:
Az-Zumar:73 - وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ wasīqa alladhīna ittaqaw rabbahum ilā l-janati zumaran ḥattā idhā jāūhā wafutiḥat abwābuhā waqāla lahum khazanatuhā salāmun ʿalaykum ṭib'tum fa-ud'khulūhā khālidīna And (will) be driven those who feared their Lord to Paradise (in) groups until when they reach it and (will) be opened its gates and (will) say to them its keepers Peace be upon you you have done well so enter it (to) abide eternally
  • [1] Or 'You are excellent!' Or 'You have been pure.'

item.title: Az-Zumar:74
item.description:
Az-Zumar:74 - وَقَالُوْۤا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ
waqālū l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī ṣadaqanā waʿdahu wa-awrathanā l-arḍa natabawwa-u mina l-janati ḥaythu nashāu faniʿ'ma ajru l-ʿāmilīna
And they will say All praise (be) to Allah Who has fulfilled for us His promise and has made us inherit the earth we may settle from (in) Paradise wherever we wish So excellent (is the) reward (of) the workers

item.title: Az-Zumar:75
item.description:
Az-Zumar:75 - وَتَرٰی الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
watarā l-malāikata ḥāffīna min ḥawli l-ʿarshi yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim waquḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqi waqīla l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And you will see the Angels surrounding from around the Throne glorifying (the) praise (of) their Lord And (will) be judged between them in truth and it will be said All praise be to Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: 40. غافر (Al-Ghaafir)
item.description:
The surah that describes the Divine Being as the one and only God, who is The Forgiver of Sin, the Acceptor of Repentance, but also the Severe in Punishment. It takes its name from the phrase "forgiver of sins" (ghāfir al-dhanb) which occurs in verse 3. A surah with two recurring themes: disputing God's truth (verse 4, verse 35 and verse 69) and calling upon Him (verse 14 and verse 49 ff.). In the opening verses God is described as the Forgiver, and the Accepter of repentance, yet severe in punishment, and this dual aspect is exemplified in the surah. The central section of the surah deals with the story of Pharaoh and Moses (verse 23 ff.): the destruction of one and victory of the other are stated in verse 45 and verse 51. The Prophet is, in his turn, urged to be steadfast and to ignore the taunts of the disbelievers (verse 55 and verse 77).
The surah is also known as Forgiving, The Believer, The Forgiving (God), The Forgiving One

40:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

40:2
تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Knower

40:3
غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
ghāfiri l-dhanbi waqābili l-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī l-ṭawli lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīru
(The) Forgiver (of) the sin and (the) Acceptor (of) [the] repentance severe (in) the punishment Owner (of) the abundance Owner (of) the abundance (There is) no god except Him to Him (is) the final return

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:1
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:2
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:2 - تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Knower

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:3
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:3 - غَافِرِ الذَّنْبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
ghāfiri l-dhanbi waqābili l-tawbi shadīdi l-ʿiqābi dhī l-ṭawli lā ilāha illā huwa ilayhi l-maṣīru
(The) Forgiver (of) the sin and (the) Acceptor (of) [the] repentance severe (in) the punishment Owner (of) the abundance Owner (of) the abundance (There is) no god except Him to Him (is) the final return

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:4
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:4 - مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ
mā yujādilu fī āyāti l-lahi illā alladhīna kafarū falā yaghrur'ka taqallubuhum fī l-bilādi
Not dispute concerning (the) Verses (of) Allah except those who disbelieve so (let) not deceive you their movement in the cities

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:5
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:5 - كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَادَلُوْۤا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wal-aḥzābu min baʿdihim wahammat kullu ummatin birasūlihim liyakhudhūhu wajādalū bil-bāṭili liyud'ḥiḍū bihi l-ḥaqa fa-akhadhtuhum fakayfa kāna ʿiqābi
Denied before them (the) people (of) Nuh and the factions after them after them and plotted every nation against their Messenger to seize him and they disputed by falsehood to refute thereby the truth So I seized them Then how was My penalty

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:6
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:6 - وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ
wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalā alladhīna kafarū annahum aṣḥābu l-nāri
And thus has been justified (the) Word (of) your Lord against those who disbelieved that they (are) companions (of) the Fire

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:7
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:7 - اَلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوْۤا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
alladhīna yaḥmilūna l-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayu'minūna bihi wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanū rabbanā wasiʿ'ta kulla shayin raḥmatan waʿil'man fa-igh'fir lilladhīna tābū wa-ittabaʿū sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi
Those who bear the Throne and who (are) around it glorify (the) praises (of) their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe Our Lord You encompass all things (by Your) Mercy and knowledge so forgive those who repent and follow Your Way and save them (from) (the) punishment (of) the Hellfire

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:8
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:8 - رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ rabbanā wa-adkhil'hum jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿadttahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāihim wa-azwājihim wadhurriyyātihim innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu Our Lord And admit them (to) Gardens (of) Eden which You have promised them and whoever (was) righteous among their fathers and their spouses and their offspring Indeed You You (are) the All-Mighty the All-Wise
  • [1] Cf. (Q 13:23).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:9
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:9 - وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ waqihimu l-sayiāti waman taqi l-sayiāti yawma-idhin faqad raḥim'tahu wadhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu And protect them (from) the evils And whoever you protect (from) the evils that Day then verily You have bestowed mercy on him And that it (is) the success the great
  • [1] That is, the day of judgement.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:10
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:10 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ مَقْتِكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
inna alladhīna kafarū yunādawna lamaqtu l-lahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'ʿawna ilā l-īmāni fatakfurūna
Indeed those who disbelieved will be cried out to them Certainly Allah's hatred Certainly Allah's hatred (was) greater than your hatred (of) yourselves when you were called to the faith and you disbelieved

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:11
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:11 - قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَى خُرُوجٍ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ
qālū rabbanā amattanā ith'natayni wa-aḥyaytanā ith'natayni fa-iʿ'tarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ilā khurūjin min sabīlin
They (will) say Our Lord You gave us death twice and You gave us life twice and we confess our sins So is (there) to get out any way

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:12
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:12 - ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِنْ يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ
dhālikum bi-annahu idhā duʿiya l-lahu waḥdahu kafartum wa-in yush'rak bihi tu'minū fal-ḥuk'mu lillahi l-ʿaliyi l-kabīri
That (is) because when Allah was invoked Allah was invoked Alone you disbelieved but if (others) were associated with Him you believed So the judgment (is) with Allah the Most High the Most Great

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:13
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:13 - هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُنِيبُ
huwa alladhī yurīkum āyātihi wayunazzilu lakum mina l-samāi riz'qan wamā yatadhakkaru illā man yunību
He (is) the One Who shows you His Signs and sends down for you from the sky provision But (does) not take heed except (one) who turns

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:14
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:14 - فَادْعُوْۤا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
fa-id'ʿū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna walaw kariha l-kāfirūna
So invoke Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion even though dislike (it) the disbelievers

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:15
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:15 - رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ
rafīʿu l-darajāti dhū l-ʿarshi yul'qī l-rūḥa min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi liyundhira yawma l-talāqi
Possessor of the Highest Ranks Possessor of the Highest Ranks Owner (of) the Throne Owner (of) the Throne He places the inspiration of His Command upon whom He wills of His slaves to warn (of the) Day (of) the Meeting

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:16
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:16 - يَوْمَ هُمْ بَارِزُونَ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ لِمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
yawma hum bārizūna lā yakhfā ʿalā l-lahi min'hum shayon limani l-mul'ku l-yawma lillahi l-wāḥidi l-qahāri
(The) Day they come forth not is hidden from Allah about them anything For whom (is) the Dominion this Day For Allah the One the Irresistible

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:17
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:17 - اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
al-yawma tuj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat lā ẓul'ma l-yawma inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi
This Day will be recompensed every soul for what it earned No injustice today Indeed Allah (is) Swift (in) Account

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:18
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:18 - وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْءَازِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ wa-andhir'hum yawma l-āzifati idhi l-qulūbu ladā l-ḥanājiri kāẓimīna mā lilẓẓālimīna min ḥamīmin walā shafīʿin yuṭāʿu And warn them (of the) Day the Approaching when the hearts (are) at the throats choked Not for the wrongdoers any intimate friend and no intercessor (who) is obeyed
  • [1] Cf. 'the Imminent [Hour]' ( (Q 53:57)).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:19
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:19 - يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ yaʿlamu khāinata l-aʿyuni wamā tukh'fī l-ṣudūru He knows (the) stealthy glance (the) stealthy glance and what conceal the breasts
  • [1] That is, the sins committed with the eyes.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:20
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:20 - وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَيْءٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ wal-lahu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqi wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi lā yaqḍūna bishayin inna l-laha huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru And Allah judges in truth while those (whom) they invoke besides Him besides Him not they judge with anything Indeed Allah He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Seer
  • [1] Or 'judges justly.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:21
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:21 - أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوْۤا هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَاقٍ
awalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna kānū min qablihim kānū hum ashadda min'hum quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu bidhunūbihim wamā kāna lahum mina l-lahi min wāqin
Do not they travel in the earth and see how was (the) end (of) those who were before them before them They were they superior to them (in) strength and (in) impressions in the land but Allah seized them but Allah seized them for their sins and not was for them against Allah any protector

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:22
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:22 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَكَفَرُوْۤا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
dhālika bi-annahum kānat tatīhim rusuluhum bil-bayināti fakafarū fa-akhadhahumu l-lahu innahu qawiyyun shadīdu l-ʿiqābi
That (was) because [they] used to come to them used to come to them their Messengers with clear proofs but they disbelieved So Allah seized them So Allah seized them Indeed, He (is) All-Strong severe (in) punishment

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:23
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:23 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin
And certainly We sent Musa with Our Signs and an authority clear

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:24
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:24 - إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوْۤا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
ilā fir'ʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālū sāḥirun kadhābun
To Firaun Haman and Qarun but they said A magician a liar

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:25
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:25 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا اقْتُلُوْۤا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ falammā jāahum bil-ḥaqi min ʿindinā qālū uq'tulū abnāa alladhīna āmanū maʿahu wa-is'taḥyū nisāahum wamā kaydu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin Then when he brought to them the truth from Us they said Kill (the) sons (of) those who believe with him and let live their women And not (is the) plot (of) the disbelievers but in error
  • [1] Or 'the guile of the faithless.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:26
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:26 - وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِي أَقْتُلْ مُوسٰی وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَنْ يُظْهِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ
waqāla fir'ʿawnu dharūnī aqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbahu innī akhāfu an yubaddila dīnakum aw an yuẓ'hira fī l-arḍi l-fasāda
And said Firaun Leave me (so that) I kill Musa and let him call his Lord Indeed, I [I] fear that he will change your religion or that he may cause to appear in the land the corruption

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:27
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:27 - وَقَالَ مُوسٰی اِنِّیْ عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
waqāla mūsā innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin lā yu'minu biyawmi l-ḥisābi
And said Musa Indeed, I [I] seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one not who believes (in the) Day (of) the Account

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:28
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:28 - وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُؤْمِنٌ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَانَهُ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَنْ يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَإِنْ يَكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ وَإِنْ يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي يَعِدُكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
waqāla rajulun mu'minun min āli fir'ʿawna yaktumu īmānahu ataqtulūna rajulan an yaqūla rabbiya l-lahu waqad jāakum bil-bayināti min rabbikum wa-in yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuhu wa-in yaku ṣādiqan yuṣib'kum baʿḍu alladhī yaʿidukum inna l-laha lā yahdī man huwa mus'rifun kadhābun
And said a man believing from (the) family (of) Firaun who conceal(ed) his faith Will you kill a man because he says My Lord (is) Allah and indeed he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord And if he is a liar then upon him (is) his lie and if he is truthful (there) will strike you some (of) (that) which he threatens you Indeed Allah (does) not guide (one) who he (is) a transgressor a liar

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:29
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:29 - يَاقَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَنْ يَنْصُرُنَا مِنْ بَأْسِ اللَّهِ إِنْ جَاءَنَا قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَا أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَرٰی وَمَا أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ yāqawmi lakumu l-mul'ku l-yawma ẓāhirīna fī l-arḍi faman yanṣurunā min basi l-lahi in jāanā qāla fir'ʿawnu mā urīkum illā mā arā wamā ahdīkum illā sabīla l-rashādi O my people For you (is) the kingdom today dominant in the land but who will help us from (the) punishment (of) Allah if it came to us Said Firaun Not I show you except what I see and not I guide you except (to the) path the right
  • [1] Or 'Today the kingdom is yours.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:30
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:30 - وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِثْلَ يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ
waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum mith'la yawmi l-aḥzābi
And said (he) who believed O my people Indeed I [I] fear for you like (the) day (of) the companies

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:31
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:31 - مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ وَمَا اللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِلْعِبَادِ
mith'la dabi qawmi nūḥin waʿādin wathamūda wa-alladhīna min baʿdihim wamā l-lahu yurīdu ẓul'man lil'ʿibādi
Like (the) plight (of the) people (of) Nuh and Aad and Thamud and those after them after them And Allah (does) not And Allah (does) not want injustice for (His) slaves

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:32
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:32 - وَيَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ
wayāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum yawma l-tanādi
And O my people Indeed, I [I] fear for you (the) Day (of) Calling

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:33
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:33 - يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ
yawma tuwallūna mud'birīna mā lakum mina l-lahi min ʿāṣimin waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min hādin
A Day you will turn back fleeing not for you from Allah any protector And whoever Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray then not for him any guide

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:34
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:34 - وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِنْ قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِمَّا جَاءَكُمْ بِهِ حَتّٰی إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُرْتَابٌ
walaqad jāakum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayināti famā zil'tum fī shakkin mimmā jāakum bihi ḥattā idhā halaka qul'tum lan yabʿatha l-lahu min baʿdihi rasūlan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man huwa mus'rifun mur'tābun
And indeed came to you Yusuf before before with clear proofs but not you ceased in doubt about what he brought to you with it until when he died you said Never will Allah raise will Allah raise after him after him a Messenger Thus Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray who he (is) a transgressor a doubter

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:35
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:35 - اَلَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَعِنْدَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum kabura maqtan ʿinda l-lahi waʿinda alladhīna āmanū kadhālika yaṭbaʿu l-lahu ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbārin
Those who dispute concerning (the) Signs (of) Allah without any authority (having) come to them (it) is greatly hateful near Allah near Allah and near those who believe Thus Allah sets a seal Allah sets a seal over every heart (of) an arrogant tyrant

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:36
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:36 - وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَاهَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ waqāla fir'ʿawnu yāhāmānu ib'ni lī ṣarḥan laʿallī ablughu l-asbāba And said Firaun O Haman Construct for me a tower that I may reach the ways
  • [1] Or 'the means.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:37
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:37 - أَسْبَابَ السَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسٰی وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٍ asbāba l-samāwāti fa-aṭṭaliʿa ilā ilāhi mūsā wa-innī la-aẓunnuhu kādhiban wakadhālika zuyyina lifir'ʿawna sūu ʿamalihi waṣudda ʿani l-sabīli wamā kaydu fir'ʿawna illā fī tabābin (The) ways (to) the heavens so I may look at (the) God (of) Musa and indeed, I [I] surely think him (to be) a liar And thus was made fair-seeming to Firaun (the) evil (of) his deed and he was averted from the way And not (was the) plot (of) Firaun except in ruin
  • [1] Or 'Pharaoh's guile.'

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:38
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:38 - وَقَالَ الَّذِي اٰمَنَ يَاقَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ
waqāla alladhī āmana yāqawmi ittabiʿūni ahdikum sabīla l-rashādi
And said the one who believed O my people Follow me I will guide you (to the) way the right

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:39
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:39 - يَاقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْاٰخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ
yāqawmi innamā hādhihi l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā matāʿun wa-inna l-ākhirata hiya dāru l-qarāri
O my people Only this the life (of) the world (is) enjoyment and indeed the Hereafter it (is the) home (of) settlement

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:40
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:40 - مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
man ʿamila sayyi-atan falā yuj'zā illā mith'lahā waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa mu'minun fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata yur'zaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisābin
Whoever does an evil then not he will be recompensed but (the) like thereof and whoever does righteous (deeds) of male or female while he (is) a believer then those will enter Paradise they will be given provision in it without account

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:41
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:41 - وَيَاقَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَوةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ
wayāqawmi mā lī adʿūkum ilā l-najati watadʿūnanī ilā l-nāri
And O my people What (is) for me (that) I call you to the salvation while you call me to the Fire

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:42
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:42 - تَدْعُونَنِي لِأَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ
tadʿūnanī li-akfura bil-lahi wa-ush'rika bihi mā laysa lī bihi ʿil'mun wa-anā adʿūkum ilā l-ʿazīzi l-ghafāri
You call me that I disbelieve in Allah and (to) associate with Him what not for me of it any knowledge and I call you to the All-Mighty the Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:43
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:43 - لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ
lā jarama annamā tadʿūnanī ilayhi laysa lahu daʿwatun fī l-dun'yā walā fī l-ākhirati wa-anna maraddanā ilā l-lahi wa-anna l-mus'rifīna hum aṣḥābu l-nāri
No doubt that what you call me to it not for it a claim in the world and not in the Hereafter and that our return (is) to Allah and that the transgressors they (will be the) companions (of) the Fire

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:44
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:44 - فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
fasatadhkurūna mā aqūlu lakum wa-ufawwiḍu amrī ilā l-lahi inna l-laha baṣīrun bil-ʿibādi
And you will remember what I say to you and I entrust my affair to Allah Indeed Allah (is) All-Seer of (His) slaves

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:45
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:45 - فَوَقَاهُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِآلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ
fawaqāhu l-lahu sayyiāti mā makarū waḥāqa biāli fir'ʿawna sūu l-ʿadhābi
So Allah protected him So Allah protected him (from the) evils that they plotted and enveloped (the) people (of) Firaun (the) worst punishment

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:46
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:46 - اَلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوْۤا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ
al-nāru yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwan waʿashiyyan wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu adkhilū āla fir'ʿawna ashadda l-ʿadhābi
The Fire they are exposed to it morning and evening And (the) Day (will be) established the Hour Cause to enter (the) people (of) Firaun (in the) severest punishment

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:47
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:47 - وَإِذْ يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِنَ النَّارِ
wa-idh yataḥājjūna fī l-nāri fayaqūlu l-ḍuʿafāu lilladhīna is'takbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mugh'nūna ʿannā naṣīban mina l-nāri
And when they will dispute in the Fire then will say the weak to those who were arrogant Indeed, we [we] were for you followers so can you avert from us a portion of the Fire

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:48
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:48 - قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ
qāla alladhīna is'takbarū innā kullun fīhā inna l-laha qad ḥakama bayna l-ʿibādi
Will say those who (were) arrogant Indeed, we all (are) in it Indeed Allah certainly has judged between (His) slaves

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:49
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:49 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوْۤا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِنَ الْعَذَابِ
waqāla alladhīna fī l-nāri likhazanati jahannama id'ʿū rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawman mina l-ʿadhābi
And will say those in the Fire to (the) keepers (of) Hell Call your Lord (to) lighten for us a day of the punishment

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:50
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:50 - قَالُوْا أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوْا بَلَى قَالُوْا فَادْعُوْۤا وَمَا دُعَؤُا الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ
qālū awalam taku tatīkum rusulukum bil-bayināti qālū balā qālū fa-id'ʿū wamā duʿāu l-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalālin
They (will) say Did there not Did there not come to you your Messengers with clear proofs They (will) say Yes They (will) say Then call but not (is the) call (of) the disbelievers except in error

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:51
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:51 - إِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ
innā lananṣuru rusulanā wa-alladhīna āmanū fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wayawma yaqūmu l-ashhādu
Indeed We We will surely help Our Messengers and those who believe in the life (of) the world and (on the) Day (when) will stand the witnesses

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:52
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:52 - يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
yawma lā yanfaʿu l-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum walahumu l-laʿnatu walahum sūu l-dāri
(The) Day not will benefit the wrongdoers their excuse and for them (is) the curse and for them (is the) worst home

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:53
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:53 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْهُدَى وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ
walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-hudā wa-awrathnā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba
And certainly We gave Musa the guidance and We caused to inherit (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel the Book

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:54
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:54 - هُدًى وَذِكْرٰی لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
hudan wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi
A guide and a reminder for those (of) understanding

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:55
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:55 - فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ
fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ʿashiyi wal-ib'kāri
So be patient indeed (the) Promise of Allah (the) Promise of Allah (is) true And ask forgiveness for your sin and glorify (the) praise (of) your Lord in the evening and the morning

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:56
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:56 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ إِنْ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَا هُمْ بِبَالِغِيهِ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ
inna alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi bighayri sul'ṭānin atāhum in fī ṣudūrihim illā kib'run mā hum bibālighīhi fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru
Indeed those who dispute concerning (the) Signs (of) Allah without any authority (which) came to them not (is) in their breasts but greatness not they (can) reach it So seek refuge in Allah Indeed He He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Seer

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:57
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:57 - لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ lakhalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi akbaru min khalqi l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna Surely, (the) creation (of) the heavens and the earth (is) greater than (the) creation (of) the mankind but most (of) the people (do) not know
  • [1] Cf. (Q 37:11), (Q 79:27).

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:58
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:58 - وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ قَلِيلًا مَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
wamā yastawī l-aʿmā wal-baṣīru wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti walā l-musīu qalīlan mā tatadhakkarūna
And not (are) equal the blind and the seeing and those who believe and do righteous deeds and not the evildoer Little (is) what you take heed

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:59
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:59 - إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun lā rayba fīhā walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yu'minūna
Indeed the Hour (is) surely coming no doubt in it but most (of) the people (do) not believe

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:60
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:60 - وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
waqāla rabbukumu id'ʿūnī astajib lakum inna alladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīna
And said your Lord Call upon Me I will respond to you Indeed those who (are) proud to worship Me will enter Hell (in) humiliation

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:61
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:61 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِیْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu al-layla litaskunū fīhi wal-nahāra mub'ṣiran inna l-laha ladhū faḍlin ʿalā l-nāsi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yashkurūna
Allah (is) the One Who made for you the night that you may rest in it and the day giving visibility Indeed Allah (is) Full (of) Bounty (is) Full (of) Bounty to the people but most (of) the people (do) not give thanks

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:62
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:62 - ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّى تُؤْفَكُونَ
dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum khāliqu kulli shayin lā ilāha illā huwa fa-annā tu'fakūna
That (is) Allah your Lord (the) Creator (of) all things (there is) no god except Him So how are you deluded

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:63
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:63 - كَذٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
kadhālika yu'faku alladhīna kānū biāyāti l-lahi yajḥadūna
Thus were deluded those who were (the) Signs (of) Allah rejecting

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:64
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:64 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa qarāran wal-samāa bināan waṣawwarakum fa-aḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum mina l-ṭayibāti dhālikumu l-lahu rabbukum fatabāraka l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna
Allah (is) the One Who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a canopy and He formed you and perfected your forms and provided you of the good things That (is) Allah your Lord Then blessed (is) Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:65
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:65 - هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
huwa l-ḥayu lā ilāha illā huwa fa-id'ʿūhu mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna l-ḥamdu lillahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
He (is) the Ever-Living (there is) no god but He so call Him (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion All praise (be) to Allah (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:66
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:66 - قُلْ اِنِّیْ نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَمَّا جَاءَنِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ مِنْ رَبِّي وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
qul innī nuhītu an aʿbuda alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lammā jāaniya l-bayinātu min rabbī wa-umir'tu an us'lima lirabbi l-ʿālamīna
Say Indeed, I [I] have been forbidden to worship those whom you call besides besides Allah when have come to me the clear proofs from my Lord and I am commanded to submit to (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:67
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:67 - هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا شُيُوخًا وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّى مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا أَجَلًا مُسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
huwa alladhī khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭ'fatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma yukh'rijukum ṭif'lan thumma litablughū ashuddakum thumma litakūnū shuyūkhan waminkum man yutawaffā min qablu walitablughū ajalan musamman walaʿallakum taʿqilūna
He (is) the One Who created you from dust then from a semen-drop then from a clinging substance then He brings you out (as) a child then lets you reach your maturity then lets you become old and among you (is he) who dies before before and lets you reach a term specified and that you may use reason

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:68
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:68 - هُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ
huwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu fa-idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu
He (is) the One Who gives life and causes death And when He decrees a matter then only He says to it Be and it is

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:69
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:69 - أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ أَنَّى يُصْرَفُونَ
alam tara ilā alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyāti l-lahi annā yuṣ'rafūna
Do not you see to those who dispute concerning (the) Signs (of) Allah How they are turned away

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:70
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:70 - اَلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْكِتَابِ وَبِمَا أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
alladhīna kadhabū bil-kitābi wabimā arsalnā bihi rusulanā fasawfa yaʿlamūna
Those who deny the Book and with what We sent with it Our Messengers but soon they will know

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:71
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:71 - إِذِ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَاسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ
idhi l-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim wal-salāsilu yus'ḥabūna
When the iron collars (will be) around their necks and the chains they will be dragged

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:72
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:72 - فِي الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
fī l-ḥamīmi thumma fī l-nāri yus'jarūna
In the boiling water then in the Fire they will be burned

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:73
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:73 - ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
thumma qīla lahum ayna mā kuntum tush'rikūna
Then it will be said to them Where (is) that which you used to associate

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:74
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:74 - مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قَالُوْا ضَلُّوْۤا عَنَّا بَلْ لَمْ نَكُنْ نَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ قَبْلُ شَيْئًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الْكَافِرِينَ
min dūni l-lahi qālū ḍallū ʿannā bal lam nakun nadʿū min qablu shayan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu l-kāfirīna
Other than Other than Allah They will say They have departed from us Nay Not we used to [we] call before before anything Thus Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray the disbelievers

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:75
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:75 - ذَلِكُمْ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ
dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūna
That was because you used to rejoice in the earth without right and because you used to be insolent

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:76
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:76 - اُدْخُلُوْۤا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
ud'khulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā fabi'sa mathwā l-mutakabirīna
Enter (the) gates (of) Hell (to) abide forever in it and wretched is (the) abode (of) the arrogant

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:77
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:77 - فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
fa-iṣ'bir inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fa-immā nuriyannaka baʿḍa alladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna
So be patient indeed (the) Promise (of) Allah (is) true And whether We show you some (of) what We have promised them or We cause you to die then to Us they will be returned

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:78
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:78 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِاٰیَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ قُضِيَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ
walaqad arsalnā rusulan min qablika min'hum man qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka wamin'hum man lam naqṣuṣ ʿalayka wamā kāna lirasūlin an yatiya biāyatin illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi fa-idhā jāa amru l-lahi quḍiya bil-ḥaqi wakhasira hunālika l-mub'ṭilūna
And certainly We have sent Messengers before you before you Among them (are) who We have related to you and among them (are) who not We have related to you And not is for any Messenger that he brings a Sign except by (the) permission (of) Allah So when comes (the) Command (of) Allah it will be decided in truth and will lose there the falsifiers

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:79
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:79 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوا مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
al-lahu alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-anʿāma litarkabū min'hā wamin'hā takulūna
Allah (is) the One Who made for you the cattle that you may ride some of them and some of them you eat

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:80
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:80 - وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِي صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ walakum fīhā manāfiʿu walitablughū ʿalayhā ḥājatan fī ṣudūrikum waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūna And for you in them (are) benefits and that you may reach through them a need (that is) in your breasts and upon them and upon the ships you are carried
  • [1] That is, by riding them or by using them as beasts of burden.

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:81
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:81 - وَيُرِيكُمْ اٰیٰتِهٖ فَأَيَّ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ تُنْكِرُونَ
wayurīkum āyātihi fa-ayya āyāti l-lahi tunkirūna
And He shows you His Signs Then which (of the) Signs (of) Allah will you deny

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:82
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:82 - أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوْۤا أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ
afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim kānū akthara min'hum wa-ashadda quwwatan waāthāran fī l-arḍi famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna
Do they not travel through the land and see how was (the) end (of) those who (were) before them (were) before them They were more numerous than them and mightier (in) strength and impressions in the land but not availed them what they used to earn

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:83
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:83 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَرِحُوْۤا بِمَا عِنْدَهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
falammā jāathum rusuluhum bil-bayināti fariḥū bimā ʿindahum mina l-ʿil'mi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
Then when came to them their Messengers with clear proofs they rejoiced in what they had of the knowledge and enveloped them what they used to at it mock

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:84
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:84 - فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا قَالُوْا اٰمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِ مُشْرِكِينَ
falammā ra-aw basanā qālū āmannā bil-lahi waḥdahu wakafarnā bimā kunnā bihi mush'rikīna
So when they saw Our punishment they said We believe in Allah Alone and we disbelieve in what we used to with Him associate

item.title: Al-Ghaafir:85
item.description:
Al-Ghaafir:85 - فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنْفَعُهُمْ إِيمَانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا سُنَّتَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ فِي عِبَادِهِ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْكَافِرُونَ
falam yaku yanfaʿuhum īmānuhum lammā ra-aw basanā sunnata l-lahi allatī qad khalat fī ʿibādihi wakhasira hunālika l-kāfirūna
But did not But did not benefit them their faith when they saw Our punishment (Such is the) Way (of) Allah which (has) indeed preceded among His slaves And are lost there the disbelievers

item.title: 41. فصلت (Fussilat)
item.description:
The surah that describes the Quran as Elaborated Heavenly revelation for those who would give it heed. It takes its name from the word "elaborated" (fuṣṣilat) in verse 3 and again in verse 44. The surah deals with the obduracy of the disbelievers, the truthfulness of the Quran, the unity of God, and the inevitability of Resurrection. The surah makes several references to the senses (verse 5, verse 20 ff. and verse 44) which the disbelievers shut off from perceiving the Truth in this world, and which will then testify against their "owners" on the Day of Resurrection, and it describes the arrogance displayed by people when all is well, contrasted with their humility and despair when difficulties strike (verse 49 ff.).
The surah is also known as (Signs) Spelled Out, (Verses) Made Distinct, Adoration, Clearly Spelled Out, Distinguished, Made Plain, Revelations Well Expounded, The Lucidly Distinct, The Well-Explained

41:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

41:2
تَنْزِيلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
tanzīlun mina l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi
A revelation from the Most Gracious the Most Merciful

41:3
كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan liqawmin yaʿlamūna
A Book are detailed its Verses a Quran (in) Arabic for a people (who) know

item.title: Fussilat:1
item.description:
Fussilat:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Fussilat:2
item.description:
Fussilat:2 - تَنْزِيلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
tanzīlun mina l-raḥmāni l-raḥīmi
A revelation from the Most Gracious the Most Merciful

item.title: Fussilat:3
item.description:
Fussilat:3 - كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
kitābun fuṣṣilat āyātuhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan liqawmin yaʿlamūna
A Book are detailed its Verses a Quran (in) Arabic for a people (who) know

item.title: Fussilat:4
item.description:
Fussilat:4 - بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
bashīran wanadhīran fa-aʿraḍa aktharuhum fahum lā yasmaʿūna
A giver of glad tidings and a warner but turn away most of them so they (do) not hear

item.title: Fussilat:5
item.description:
Fussilat:5 - وَقَالُوْۤا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَفِي ءَاذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِنْ بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَامِلُونَ
waqālū qulūbunā fī akinnatin mimmā tadʿūnā ilayhi wafī ādhāninā waqrun wamin bayninā wabaynika ḥijābun fa-iʿ'mal innanā ʿāmilūna
And they say Our hearts (are) in coverings from what you call us to it and in our ears (is) deafness and between us and between us and between you (is) a screen So work indeed, we (are) working

item.title: Fussilat:6
item.description:
Fussilat:6 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحَى إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَوَيْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ
qul innamā anā basharun mith'lukum yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-is'taqīmū ilayhi wa-is'taghfirūhu wawaylun lil'mush'rikīna
Say Only I am a man like you it is revealed to me that your god (is) God One so take a Straight Path to Him and ask His forgiveness And woe to the polytheists

item.title: Fussilat:7
item.description:
Fussilat:7 - اَلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
alladhīna lā yu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum kāfirūna
Those who (do) not give the zakah and they in the Hereafter they (are) disbelievers

item.title: Fussilat:8
item.description:
Fussilat:8 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin
Indeed those who believe and do righteous deeds for them (is) a reward never ending never ending

item.title: Fussilat:9
item.description:
Fussilat:9 - قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ أَنْدَادًا ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ qul a-innakum latakfurūna bi-alladhī khalaqa l-arḍa fī yawmayni watajʿalūna lahu andādan dhālika rabbu l-ʿālamīna Say Do you indeed [surely] disbelieve in the One Who created the earth in two periods and you set up with Him rivals That (is the) Lord (of) the worlds
  • [1] That is, in two epochs of time.

item.title: Fussilat:10
item.description:
Fussilat:10 - وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَبَارَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ
wajaʿala fīhā rawāsiya min fawqihā wabāraka fīhā waqaddara fīhā aqwātahā fī arbaʿati ayyāmin sawāan lilssāilīna
And He placed therein firmly-set mountains above it above it and He blessed therein and determined therein its sustenance in four periods equal for those who ask

item.title: Fussilat:11
item.description:
Fussilat:11 - ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَا أَتَيْنَا طَائِعِينَ
thumma is'tawā ilā l-samāi wahiya dukhānun faqāla lahā walil'arḍi i'tiyā ṭawʿan aw karhan qālatā ataynā ṭāiʿīna
Then He directed (Himself) towards the heaven while it (was) smoke and He said to it and to the earth Come both of you willingly or unwillingly They both said We come willingly

item.title: Fussilat:12
item.description:
Fussilat:12 - فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَى فِي كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ faqaḍāhunna sabʿa samāwātin fī yawmayni wa-awḥā fī kulli samāin amrahā wazayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa waḥif'ẓan dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi Then He completed them (as) seven heavens in two periods and He revealed in each heaven its affair And We adorned the heaven the world with lamps and (to) guard That (is the) Decree (of) the All-Mighty the All-Knower
  • [1] Or 'law.'
  • [2] Cf. (Q 37:6) - (Q 37:7); (Q 67:5).

item.title: Fussilat:13
item.description:
Fussilat:13 - فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَقُلْ أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صَاعِقَةً مِثْلَ صَاعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ
fa-in aʿraḍū faqul andhartukum ṣāʿiqatan mith'la ṣāʿiqati ʿādin wathamūda
But if they turn away then say I have warned you (of) a thunderbolt like (the) thunderbolt (of) Aad and Thamud

item.title: Fussilat:14
item.description:
Fussilat:14 - إِذْ جَاءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ idh jāathumu l-rusulu min bayni aydīhim wamin khalfihim allā taʿbudū illā l-laha qālū law shāa rabbunā la-anzala malāikatan fa-innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna When came to them the Messengers from before them from before them from before them and from behind them (saying) "Do not worship except Allah They said If (had) willed our Lord surely, He (would have) sent down Angels So indeed, we in what you have been sent with (are) disbelievers
  • [1] That is, during the times of their forefathers and in their own time. Or 'from their front and behind,' that is, from all sides.

item.title: Fussilat:15
item.description:
Fussilat:15 - فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوْۤا مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَكَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ
fa-ammā ʿādun fa-is'takbarū fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi waqālū man ashaddu minnā quwwatan awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqahum huwa ashaddu min'hum quwwatan wakānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna
Then as for Aad they were arrogant in the land without [the] right and they said Who (is) mightier than us (in) strength Do not they see that Allah the One Who created them He (is) Mightier than them (in) strength But they used to in Our Signs deny

item.title: Fussilat:16
item.description:
Fussilat:16 - فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي أَيَّامٍ نَحِسَاتٍ لِنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَخْزَى وَهُمْ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ
fa-arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī ayyāmin naḥisātin linudhīqahum ʿadhāba l-khiz'yi fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akhzā wahum lā yunṣarūna
So We sent upon them a wind furious in (the) days (of) misfortune that We may make them taste (the) punishment (of) disgrace in the life (of) the world And surely, (the) punishment (of) the Hereafter (is) more disgracing and they will not be helped will not be helped

item.title: Fussilat:17
item.description:
Fussilat:17 - وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمَى عَلَى الْهُدَى فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ
wa-ammā thamūdu fahadaynāhum fa-is'taḥabbū l-ʿamā ʿalā l-hudā fa-akhadhathum ṣāʿiqatu l-ʿadhābi l-hūni bimā kānū yaksibūna
And as for Thamud We guided them but they preferred [the] blindness over the guidance so seized them a thunderbolt (of) the punishment humiliating for what they used to earn

item.title: Fussilat:18
item.description:
Fussilat:18 - وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْۤا يَتَّقُونَ
wanajjaynā alladhīna āmanū wakānū yattaqūna
And We saved those who believed and used to fear (Allah)

item.title: Fussilat:19
item.description:
Fussilat:19 - وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ إِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
wayawma yuḥ'sharu aʿdāu l-lahi ilā l-nāri fahum yūzaʿūna
And (the) Day will be gathered (the) enemies (of) Allah to the Fire then they will be assembled in rows

item.title: Fussilat:20
item.description:
Fussilat:20 - حَتّٰی إِذَا مَا جَاءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
ḥattā idhā mā jāūhā shahida ʿalayhim samʿuhum wa-abṣāruhum wajulūduhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūna
Until when when they come to it (will) testify against them their hearing and their sight and their skins (as) to what they used to do

item.title: Fussilat:21
item.description:
