Fussilat:21 - وَقَالُوْۤا لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُمْ عَلَيْنَا قَالُوْا أَنْطَقَنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
waqālū lijulūdihim lima shahidttum ʿalaynā qālū anṭaqanā l-lahu alladhī anṭaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
And they will say to their skins Why do you testify against us They will say Allah made us speak Allah made us speak the One Who makes speak every thing and He created you (the) first time and to Him you will be returned

item.title: Fussilat:22
item.description:
Fussilat:22 - وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
wamā kuntum tastatirūna an yashhada ʿalaykum samʿukum walā abṣārukum walā julūdukum walākin ẓanantum anna l-laha lā yaʿlamu kathīran mimmā taʿmalūna
And not you were covering yourselves lest testify against you your hearing and not your sight and not your skins but you assumed that Allah (does) not know much of what you do

item.title: Fussilat:23
item.description:
Fussilat:23 - وَذَلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِي ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَاكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
wadhālikum ẓannukumu alladhī ẓanantum birabbikum ardākum fa-aṣbaḥtum mina l-khāsirīna
And that (was) your assumption which you assumed about your Lord It has ruined you and you have become of the losers

item.title: Fussilat:24
item.description:
Fussilat:24 - فَإِنْ يَصْبِرُوْۤا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ وَإِنْ يَسْتَعْتِبُوا فَمَا هُمْ مِنَ الْمُعْتَبِينَ
fa-in yaṣbirū fal-nāru mathwan lahum wa-in yastaʿtibū famā hum mina l-muʿ'tabīna
Then if they endure the Fire (is) an abode for them and if they ask for favor then not they (will be) of those who receive favor

item.title: Fussilat:25
item.description:
Fussilat:25 - وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاءَ فَزَيَّنُوا لَهُمْ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ waqayyaḍnā lahum quranāa fazayyanū lahum mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum waḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna And We have destined for them companions (who) made fair-seeming to them what (was) before them (was) before them and what (was) behind them and (is) justified against them the Word among nations (that have) passed away (that have) passed away before them before them of the jinn and the men Indeed, they were losers
  • [1] That is, their conduct in the life of the world.
  • [2] That is, concerning the Hereafter, or the legacy they leave behind.
  • [3] Cf. (Q 7:18); (Q 11:119); (Q 17:16); (Q 23:27); (Q 27:82); (Q 28:63); (Q 32:13); (Q 36:7), (Q 36:70); (Q 38:85) (Q 41:25); (Q 46:18).

item.title: Fussilat:26
item.description:
Fussilat:26 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَسْمَعُوْۤا لِهَذَا الْقُرْءَانِ وَالْغَوْا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lā tasmaʿū lihādhā l-qur'āni wal-ghaw fīhi laʿallakum taghlibūna
And said those who disbelieve (Do) not listen to this Quran and make noise therein so that you may overcome

item.title: Fussilat:27
item.description:
Fussilat:27 - فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
falanudhīqanna alladhīna kafarū ʿadhāban shadīdan walanajziyannahum aswa-a alladhī kānū yaʿmalūna
But surely We will cause to taste those who disbelieve a punishment severe and surely We will recompense them (the) worst (of) what they used to do

item.title: Fussilat:28
item.description:
Fussilat:28 - ذٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّهِ النَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ يَجْحَدُونَ
dhālika jazāu aʿdāi l-lahi l-nāru lahum fīhā dāru l-khul'di jazāan bimā kānū biāyātinā yajḥadūna
That (is the) recompense (of the) enemies (of) Allah the Fire for them therein (is the) home (of) the eternity (as) recompense for what they used to of Our Verses reject

item.title: Fussilat:29
item.description:
Fussilat:29 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا رَبَّنَا أَرِنَا الَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ الْأَسْفَلِينَ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū rabbanā arinā alladhayni aḍallānā mina l-jini wal-insi najʿalhumā taḥta aqdāminā liyakūnā mina l-asfalīna
And (will) say those who disbelieve Our Lord Show us those who misled us of the jinn and the men (so) we may put them under our feet that they be of the lowest

item.title: Fussilat:30
item.description:
Fussilat:30 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوْۤا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوْۤا وَأَبْشِرُوا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū tatanazzalu ʿalayhimu l-malāikatu allā takhāfū walā taḥzanū wa-abshirū bil-janati allatī kuntum tūʿadūna
Indeed those who say Our Lord (is) Allah then stand firm will descend on them the Angels (Do) not fear and (do) not grieve but receive the glad tidings of Paradise which you were promised

item.title: Fussilat:31
item.description:
Fussilat:31 - نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِي أَنْفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
naḥnu awliyāukum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wafī l-ākhirati walakum fīhā mā tashtahī anfusukum walakum fīhā mā taddaʿūna
We (are) your protectors in the life (of) the world and in the Hereafter And for you therein whatever desire your souls and for you therein what you ask

item.title: Fussilat:32
item.description:
Fussilat:32 - نُزُلًا مِنْ غَفُورٍ رَحِيمٍ
nuzulan min ghafūrin raḥīmin
A hospitable gift from (the) Oft-Forgiving (the) Most Merciful

item.title: Fussilat:33
item.description:
Fussilat:33 - وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِمَّنْ دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
waman aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ilā l-lahi waʿamila ṣāliḥan waqāla innanī mina l-mus'limīna
And who (is) better (in) speech than (one) who invites to Allah and does righteous (deeds) and says Indeed, I am of those who submit

item.title: Fussilat:34
item.description:
Fussilat:34 - وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ walā tastawī l-ḥasanatu walā l-sayi-atu id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu fa-idhā alladhī baynaka wabaynahu ʿadāwatun ka-annahu waliyyun ḥamīmun And not (are) equal the good (deed) and the evil (deed) Repel by (that) which it (is) better then behold One who between you and between him (was) enmity (will become) as if he (was) a friend intimate
  • [1] Or 'virtue and vice are not equal.'

item.title: Fussilat:35
item.description:
Fussilat:35 - وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوْۤا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ
wamā yulaqqāhā illā alladhīna ṣabarū wamā yulaqqāhā illā dhū ḥaẓẓin ʿaẓīmin
And not it is granted except (to) those who (are) patient and not it is granted except (to the) owner (of) fortune great

item.title: Fussilat:36
item.description:
Fussilat:36 - وَإِمَّا يَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
wa-immā yanzaghannaka mina l-shayṭāni nazghun fa-is'taʿidh bil-lahi innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu
And if whisper comes to you from the Shaitaan an evil suggestion then seek refuge in Allah Indeed, He He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower

item.title: Fussilat:37
item.description:
Fussilat:37 - وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ لَا تَسْجُدُوْۤا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ
wamin āyātihi al-laylu wal-nahāru wal-shamsu wal-qamaru lā tasjudū lilshamsi walā lil'qamari wa-us'judū lillahi alladhī khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyāhu taʿbudūna
And of His Signs (are) the night and the day and the sun and the moon (Do) not prostrate to the sun and not to the moon but prostrate to Allah the One Who created them if you Him alone worship

item.title: Fussilat:38
item.description:
Fussilat:38 - فَإِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فَالَّذِينَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْءَمُونَ
fa-ini is'takbarū fa-alladhīna ʿinda rabbika yusabbiḥūna lahu bi-al-layli wal-nahāri wahum lā yasamūna
But if they are arrogant then those who (are) near your Lord glorify Him by night and day And they (do) not tire

item.title: Fussilat:39
item.description:
Fussilat:39 - وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ أَنَّكَ تَرٰی الْأَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ إِنَّ الَّذِي أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
wamin āyātihi annaka tarā l-arḍa khāshiʿatan fa-idhā anzalnā ʿalayhā l-māa ih'tazzat warabat inna alladhī aḥyāhā lamuḥ'yī l-mawtā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
And among His Signs (is) that you see the earth barren but when We send down upon it water it is stirred (to life) and grows Indeed the One Who gives it life (is) surely the Giver of life (to) the dead Indeed, He (is) on every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Fussilat:40
item.description:
Fussilat:40 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا أَفَمَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَمْ مَنْ يَأْتِي اٰمِنًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اعْمَلُوْۤا مَا شِئْتُمْ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
inna alladhīna yul'ḥidūna fī āyātinā lā yakhfawna ʿalaynā afaman yul'qā fī l-nāri khayrun am man yatī āminan yawma l-qiyāmati iʿ'malū mā shi'tum innahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
Indeed those who distort in Our Verses (are) not hidden from Us So, is (he) who is cast in the Fire better or (he) who comes secure (on the) Day (of) Resurrection Do what you will Indeed, He of what you do (is) All-Seer

item.title: Fussilat:41
item.description:
Fussilat:41 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُ لَكِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ inna alladhīna kafarū bil-dhik'ri lammā jāahum wa-innahu lakitābun ʿazīzun Indeed those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it comes to them And indeed, it (is) surely a Book mighty
  • [1] Ellipsis. The phrase omitted, considering the context, is, 'will face a severe punishment.'

item.title: Fussilat:42
item.description:
Fussilat:42 - لَا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ
lā yatīhi l-bāṭilu min bayni yadayhi walā min khalfihi tanzīlun min ḥakīmin ḥamīdin
Not comes to it the falsehood from before it before it and not from behind it A Revelation from (the) All-Wise (the) Praiseworthy

item.title: Fussilat:43
item.description:
Fussilat:43 - مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
mā yuqālu laka illā mā qad qīla lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka ladhū maghfiratin wadhū ʿiqābin alīmin
Not is said to you except what was said was said to the Messengers before you before you Indeed your Lord (is) Possessor (of) forgiveness and Possessor (of) penalty painful

item.title: Fussilat:44
item.description:
Fussilat:44 - وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ ءَأَعْجَمِيٌّ وَعَرَبِيٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ walaw jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan aʿjamiyyan laqālū lawlā fuṣṣilat āyātuhu āʿ'jamiyyun waʿarabiyyun qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan washifāon wa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna fī ādhānihim waqrun wahuwa ʿalayhim ʿaman ulāika yunādawna min makānin baʿīdin And if We (had) made it a Quran (in) a foreign (language) they (would have) said Why not are explained in detail its verses (Is it) a foreign (language) and an Arab Say It (is) for those who believe a guidance and a healing And those who (do) not believe in their ears (is) deafness and it (is) for them blindness Those are being called from a place far
  • [1] Or 'a barbaric Qur'ān;' that is, in a language other than articulate literary Arabic.
  • [2] That is, the Arabs.
  • [3] Or 'a barbaric scripture.'

item.title: Fussilat:45
item.description:
Fussilat:45 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوسٰی الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba fa-ukh'tulifa fīhi walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa-innahum lafī shakkin min'hu murībin
And certainly We gave Musa the Book but disputes arose therein And had it not been (for) a word (that) preceded from your Lord surely, would have been settled between them But indeed, they surely (are) in doubt about it disquieting

item.title: Fussilat:46
item.description:
Fussilat:46 - مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ
man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā wamā rabbuka biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi
Whoever does righteous deeds then it is for his soul and whoever does evil then it is against it And not (is) your Lord unjust to His slaves

item.title: Fussilat:47
item.description:
Fussilat:47 - إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنْثَى وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَاءِي قَالُوْا ءَاذَنَّاكَ مَا مِنَّا مِنْ شَهِيدٍ
ilayhi yuraddu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wamā takhruju min thamarātin min akmāmihā wamā taḥmilu min unthā walā taḍaʿu illā biʿil'mihi wayawma yunādīhim ayna shurakāī qālū ādhannāka mā minnā min shahīdin
To Him is referred (the) knowledge (of) the Hour And not comes out any fruits from their coverings and not bears any female and not gives birth except with His knowledge And (the) Day He will call them Where (are) My partners They will say We announce (to) You not among us any witness

item.title: Fussilat:48
item.description:
Fussilat:48 - وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَظَنُّوْۤا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ
waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yadʿūna min qablu waẓannū mā lahum min maḥīṣin
And lost from them what they were invoking before before and they (will) be certain (that) not for them any place of escape

item.title: Fussilat:49
item.description:
Fussilat:49 - لَا يَسْءَمُ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنْ دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
lā yasamu l-insānu min duʿāi l-khayri wa-in massahu l-sharu fayaūsun qanūṭun
(Does) not get tired man of praying (for) the good but if touches him the evil then he gives up hope (and) despairs

item.title: Fussilat:50
item.description:
Fussilat:50 - وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَذَا لِي وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِنْ رُجِعْتُ إِلَى رَبِّي إِنَّ لِي عِنْدَهُ لَلْحُسْنَى فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ
wala-in adhaqnāhu raḥmatan minnā min baʿdi ḍarrāa massathu layaqūlanna hādhā lī wamā aẓunnu l-sāʿata qāimatan wala-in rujiʿ'tu ilā rabbī inna lī ʿindahu lalḥus'nā falanunabbi-anna alladhīna kafarū bimā ʿamilū walanudhīqannahum min ʿadhābin ghalīẓin
And verily, if We let him taste mercy from Us after after an adversity (has) touched him he will surely say This (is) (due) to me and not I think the Hour (will be) established and if I am returned to my Lord indeed for me with Him (will be) the best But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did and We will surely make them taste of a punishment severe

item.title: Fussilat:51
item.description:
Fussilat:51 - وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَءَا بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ
wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu fadhū duʿāin ʿarīḍin
And when We bestow favor upon man he turns away and distances himself and distances himself but when touches him the evil then (he is) full (of) supplication lengthy

item.title: Fussilat:52
item.description:
Fussilat:52 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ
qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi thumma kafartum bihi man aḍallu mimman huwa fī shiqāqin baʿīdin
Say You see if it is from from Allah then you disbelieve in it who (is) more astray than (one) who he (is) in opposition far

item.title: Fussilat:53
item.description:
Fussilat:53 - سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَاتِنَا فِي الْءَافَاقِ وَفِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتّٰی يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ sanurīhim āyātinā fī l-āfāqi wafī anfusihim ḥattā yatabayyana lahum annahu l-ḥaqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun Soon We will show them Our Signs in the horizons and in themselves until becomes clear to them that it (is) the truth Is (it) not sufficient concerning your Lord that He (is) over all things a Witness
  • [1] Or 'until it becomes clear to them that it [i.e. the Qur'ān, or Islam] (or he) [i.e. the Apostle] is the truth.'

item.title: Fussilat:54
item.description:
Fussilat:54 - أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْ لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُحِيطٌ
alā innahum fī mir'yatin min liqāi rabbihim alā innahu bikulli shayin muḥīṭun
Unquestionably they (are) in doubt about (the) meeting (with) their Lord Unquestionably indeed, He (is) of all things encompassing

item.title: 42. الشورى (Ash-Shura)
item.description:
The surah that mentions mutual Consultation among the believers as the godly means by which to conduct their affairs and as a virtuous sign that they will gain the reward of God in the Hereafter. It takes its name from verse 38 concerning "counsel" (shūrā). The surah discusses man's habit of creating division and disharmony in matters of religion, and God's all-prevailing power, wisdom, and final decision. The unity of religion is stressed (verse 13) as is the continuity of the prophets (verse 3). The Prophet is reminded that he cannot compel people to believe, that they will be judged according to their deeds, and that he is only there to deliver the message. The nature of revelation is described in verse 51 ff.
The surah is also known as The Counsel

42:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

42:2
عسق
ain-seen-qaf
Ayn Seen Qaaf

42:3
كَذٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
Thus reveals to you and to those before you before you Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Ash-Shura:1
item.description:
Ash-Shura:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Ash-Shura:2
item.description:
Ash-Shura:2 - عسق
ain-seen-qaf
Ayn Seen Qaaf

item.title: Ash-Shura:3
item.description:
Ash-Shura:3 - كَذٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
kadhālika yūḥī ilayka wa-ilā alladhīna min qablika l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
Thus reveals to you and to those before you before you Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Ash-Shura:4
item.description:
Ash-Shura:4 - لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿaliyu l-ʿaẓīmu
To Him (belong) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth and He (is) the Most High the Most Great

item.title: Ash-Shura:5
item.description:
Ash-Shura:5 - تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wal-malāikatu yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayastaghfirūna liman fī l-arḍi alā inna l-laha huwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
Almost the heavens break up from above them and the Angels glorify (the) praise (of) their Lord and ask for forgiveness for those on the earth Unquestionably indeed Allah He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Ash-Shura:6
item.description:
Ash-Shura:6 - وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيلٍ
wa-alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa l-lahu ḥafīẓun ʿalayhim wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīlin
And those who take besides besides protectors Allah (is) a Guardian over them and not you (are) over them a manager

item.title: Ash-Shura:7
item.description:
Ash-Shura:7 - وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِتُنْذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرٰی وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan litundhira umma l-qurā waman ḥawlahā watundhira yawma l-jamʿi lā rayba fīhi farīqun fī l-janati wafarīqun fī l-saʿīri And thus We have revealed to you a Quran (in) Arabic that you may warn (the) mother (of) the towns and whoever (is) around it and warn (of the) Day (of) Assembly (there is) no doubt in it A party (will be) in Paradise and a party in the Blazing Fire
  • [1] That is, the city of Makkah.
  • [2] Cf. (Q 64:9).

item.title: Ash-Shura:8
item.description:
Ash-Shura:8 - وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِنْ يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَالظَّالِمُونَ مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
walaw shāa l-lahu lajaʿalahum ummatan wāḥidatan walākin yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimūna mā lahum min waliyyin walā naṣīrin
And if Allah willed Allah willed He could have made them a community one but He admits whom He wills in (to) His Mercy And the wrongdoers not for them any protector and not any helper

item.title: Ash-Shura:9
item.description:
Ash-Shura:9 - أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ فَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتٰی وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi awliyāa fal-lahu huwa l-waliyu wahuwa yuḥ'yī l-mawtā wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
Or have they taken besides Him besides Him protectors But Allah He (is) the Protector and He gives life (to) the dead And He (is) on every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Ash-Shura:10
item.description:
Ash-Shura:10 - وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِیْهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ذَلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
wamā ikh'talaftum fīhi min shayin faḥuk'muhu ilā l-lahi dhālikumu l-lahu rabbī ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-ilayhi unību
And whatever you differ in it of a thing then its ruling (is) to Allah That (is) Allah my Lord upon Him I put my trust and to Him I turn

item.title: Ash-Shura:11
item.description:
Ash-Shura:11 - فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِیْهِ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ fāṭiru l-samāwāti wal-arḍi jaʿala lakum min anfusikum azwājan wamina l-anʿāmi azwājan yadhra-ukum fīhi laysa kamith'lihi shayon wahuwa l-samīʿu l-baṣīru (The) Creator (of) the heavens and the earth He made for you from yourselves mates and among the cattle mates He multiplies you thereby (There) is not like Him anything and He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Seer
  • [1] In case the kāf in ka-mithlihī is not taken as redundant, the meaning will be, 'There is nothing like His likeness.'

item.title: Ash-Shura:12
item.description:
Ash-Shura:12 - لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
lahu maqālīdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yabsuṭu l-riz'qa liman yashāu wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
To Him (belongs) (the) keys (of) the heavens and the earth He extends the provision for whom He wills and restricts Indeed, He of every thing (is) All-Knower

item.title: Ash-Shura:13
item.description:
Ash-Shura:13 - شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی وَعِيسٰی أَنْ أَقِيمُوْۤا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِیْهِ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ اللَّهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُنِيبُ sharaʿa lakum mina l-dīni mā waṣṣā bihi nūḥan wa-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka wamā waṣṣaynā bihi ib'rāhīma wamūsā waʿīsā an aqīmū l-dīna walā tatafarraqū fīhi kabura ʿalā l-mush'rikīna mā tadʿūhum ilayhi l-lahu yajtabī ilayhi man yashāu wayahdī ilayhi man yunību He has ordained for you of the religion what He enjoined upon Nuh and that which We have revealed to you and what We enjoined upon Ibrahim and Musa and Isa To establish the religion and not be divided therein Is difficult on the polytheists what you call them to it Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns
  • [1] Or 'for Himself.'
  • [2] Or 'to Himself.'

item.title: Ash-Shura:14
item.description:
Ash-Shura:14 - وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
wamā tafarraqū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum walawlā kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilā ajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna alladhīna ūrithū l-kitāba min baʿdihim lafī shakkin min'hu murībin
And not they became divided until after after what came to them the knowledge (out of) rivalry among them And if not (for) a word (that) preceded from your Lord for a term specified surely, it (would have) been settled between them And indeed those who were made to inherit the Book after them after them (are) surely in doubt concerning it disquieting

item.title: Ash-Shura:15
item.description:
Ash-Shura:15 - فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَقُلْ ءَامَنْتُ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ اللَّهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ
falidhālika fa-ud'ʿu wa-is'taqim kamā umir'ta walā tattabiʿ ahwāahum waqul āmantu bimā anzala l-lahu min kitābin wa-umir'tu li-aʿdila baynakumu l-lahu rabbunā warabbukum lanā aʿmālunā walakum aʿmālukum lā ḥujjata baynanā wabaynakumu l-lahu yajmaʿu baynanā wa-ilayhi l-maṣīru
So to that then invite and stand firm as you are commanded and (do) not follow their desires but say I believe in what Allah has sent down Allah has sent down of (the) Book and I am commanded that I do justice between you Allah (is) our Lord and your Lord For us our deeds and for you your deeds (There is) no argument between us and between you Allah will assemble [between] us and to Him (is) the final return

item.title: Ash-Shura:16
item.description:
Ash-Shura:16 - وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
wa-alladhīna yuḥājjūna fī l-lahi min baʿdi mā us'tujība lahu ḥujjatuhum dāḥiḍatun ʿinda rabbihim waʿalayhim ghaḍabun walahum ʿadhābun shadīdun
And those who argue concerning Allah after after what response has been made to Him response has been made to Him their argument (is) invalid with their Lord and upon them (is) wrath and for them (is) a punishment severe

item.title: Ash-Shura:17
item.description:
Ash-Shura:17 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
al-lahu alladhī anzala l-kitāba bil-ḥaqi wal-mīzāna wamā yud'rīka laʿalla l-sāʿata qarībun
Allah (is) the One Who (has) sent down the Book in truth and the Balance And what will make you know Perhaps the Hour (is) near

item.title: Ash-Shura:18
item.description:
Ash-Shura:18 - يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ أَلَا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ yastaʿjilu bihā alladhīna lā yu'minūna bihā wa-alladhīna āmanū mush'fiqūna min'hā wayaʿlamūna annahā l-ḥaqu alā inna alladhīna yumārūna fī l-sāʿati lafī ḍalālin baʿīdin Seek to hasten [of] it those who (do) not believe in it and those who believe (are) fearful of it and know that it (is) the truth Unquestionably indeed those who dispute concerning the Hour (are) certainly in error far
  • [1] Or 'dispute the Hour.'

item.title: Ash-Shura:19
item.description:
Ash-Shura:19 - اَللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
al-lahu laṭīfun biʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashāu wahuwa l-qawiyu l-ʿazīzu
Allah (is) Subtle with His slaves He gives provision (to) whom He wills And He (is) the All-Strong the All-Mighty

item.title: Ash-Shura:20
item.description:
Ash-Shura:20 - مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةُ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةُ مِنْ نَصِيبٍ
man kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-ākhirati nazid lahu fī ḥarthihi waman kāna yurīdu ḥartha l-dun'yā nu'tihi min'hā wamā lahu fī l-ākhirati min naṣībin
Whoever is desiring (the) harvest (of) the Hereafter We increase for him in his harvest And whoever is desiring (the) harvest (of) the world We give him of it but not for him in the Hereafter any share

item.title: Ash-Shura:21
item.description:
Ash-Shura:21 - أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَنْ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ am lahum shurakāu sharaʿū lahum mina l-dīni mā lam yadhan bihi l-lahu walawlā kalimatu l-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lahum ʿadhābun alīmun Or for them (are) partners who have ordained for them of the religion what not Allah has given permission of it Allah has given permission of it Allah has given permission of it And if not (for) a word decisive surely, it (would have) been judged between them And indeed the wrongdoers for them (is a) punishment painful
  • [1] Or 'the final word.' That is, Allah's promise to provide the faithless and to grant them a respite before retribution. See (Q 2:36), (Q 2:126); (Q 9:68) - (Q 9:69); (Q 15:3); (Q 31:23) - (Q 31:24).

item.title: Ash-Shura:22
item.description:
Ash-Shura:22 - تَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْۤا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ
tarā l-ẓālimīna mush'fiqīna mimmā kasabū wahuwa wāqiʿun bihim wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī rawḍāti l-janāti lahum mā yashāūna ʿinda rabbihim dhālika huwa l-faḍlu l-kabīru
You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they earned and it (will) befall [on] them And those who believe and do righteous deeds (will be) in flowering meadows (of) the Gardens for them (is) whatever they wish with their Lord That it (is) the Bounty the Great

item.title: Ash-Shura:23
item.description:
Ash-Shura:23 - ذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ اللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ قُلْ لَا أَسْءَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبٰی وَمَنْ يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
dhālika alladhī yubashiru l-lahu ʿibādahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti qul lā asalukum ʿalayhi ajran illā l-mawadata fī l-qur'bā waman yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fīhā ḥus'nan inna l-laha ghafūrun shakūrun
That (is of) which Allah gives glad tidings Allah gives glad tidings (to) His slaves those who believe and do righteous deeds Say Not I ask you for it any payment except the love among the relatives And whoever earns any good We increase for him therein good Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving All-Appreciative

item.title: Ash-Shura:24
item.description:
Ash-Shura:24 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرٰی عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَإِنْ يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَى قَلْبِكَ وَيَمْحُ اللَّهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
am yaqūlūna if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fa-in yasha-i l-lahu yakhtim ʿalā qalbika wayamḥu l-lahu l-bāṭila wayuḥiqqu l-ḥaqa bikalimātihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri
Or (do) they say He has invented about Allah a lie But if Allah willed Allah willed He would seal over your heart And Allah eliminates And Allah eliminates the falsehood and establishes the truth by His Words Indeed, He (is) All-Knowing of what (is in) the breasts

item.title: Ash-Shura:25
item.description:
Ash-Shura:25 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
wahuwa alladhī yaqbalu l-tawbata ʿan ʿibādihi wayaʿfū ʿani l-sayiāti wayaʿlamu mā tafʿalūna
And He (is) the One Who accepts the repentance of His slaves and pardons of the evil and He knows what you do

item.title: Ash-Shura:26
item.description:
Ash-Shura:26 - وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَالْكَافِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ
wayastajību alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wayazīduhum min faḍlihi wal-kāfirūna lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun
And He answers those who believe and do righteous deeds and increases (for) them from His Bounty And the disbelievers for them (will be) a punishment severe

item.title: Ash-Shura:27
item.description:
Ash-Shura:27 - وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَكِنْ يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ
walaw basaṭa l-lahu l-riz'qa liʿibādihi labaghaw fī l-arḍi walākin yunazzilu biqadarin mā yashāu innahu biʿibādihi khabīrun baṣīrun
And if Allah extends Allah extends the provision for His slaves surely they would rebel in the earth but He sends down in (due) measure what He wills Indeed, He of His slaves (is) All-Aware All-Seer

item.title: Ash-Shura:28
item.description:
Ash-Shura:28 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْۤا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
wahuwa alladhī yunazzilu l-ghaytha min baʿdi mā qanaṭū wayanshuru raḥmatahu wahuwa l-waliyu l-ḥamīdu
And He (is) the One Who sends down the rain after after what they have despaired and spreads His mercy And He (is) the Protector the Praiseworthy

item.title: Ash-Shura:29
item.description:
Ash-Shura:29 - وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِنْ دَابَّةٍ وَهُوَ عَلَى جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ
wamin āyātihi khalqu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā batha fīhimā min dābbatin wahuwa ʿalā jamʿihim idhā yashāu qadīrun
And among His Signs (is the) creation (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever He has dispersed in both of them of (the) creatures And He (is) over their gathering when He wills All-Powerful

item.title: Ash-Shura:30
item.description:
Ash-Shura:30 - وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْۤا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ
wamā aṣābakum min muṣībatin fabimā kasabat aydīkum wayaʿfū ʿan kathīrin
And whatever befalls you of (the) misfortune (is because) of what have earned your hands But He pardons from much

item.title: Ash-Shura:31
item.description:
Ash-Shura:31 - وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
wamā antum bimuʿ'jizīna fī l-arḍi wamā lakum min dūni l-lahi min waliyyin walā naṣīrin
And not you (can) escape in the earth and not for you besides besides Allah any protector and not any helper

item.title: Ash-Shura:32
item.description:
Ash-Shura:32 - وَمِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ
wamin āyātihi l-jawāri fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi
And among His Signs (are) the ships in the sea like [the] mountains

item.title: Ash-Shura:33
item.description:
Ash-Shura:33 - إِنْ يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
in yasha yus'kini l-rīḥa fayaẓlalna rawākida ʿalā ẓahrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin likulli ṣabbārin shakūrin
If He wills He can cause the wind to become still He can cause the wind to become still then they would remain motionless on its back Indeed in that surely (are) Signs for everyone patient (and) grateful

item.title: Ash-Shura:34
item.description:
Ash-Shura:34 - أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْۤا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ
aw yūbiq'hunna bimā kasabū wayaʿfu ʿan kathīrin
Or He could destroy them for what they have earned but He pardons from much

item.title: Ash-Shura:35
item.description:
Ash-Shura:35 - وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي ءَايَاتِنَا مَا لَهُمْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ
wayaʿlama alladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātinā mā lahum min maḥīṣin
And may know those who dispute concerning Our Signs (that) not for them any place of refuge

item.title: Ash-Shura:36
item.description:
Ash-Shura:36 - فَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
famā ūtītum min shayin famatāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wamā ʿinda l-lahi khayrun wa-abqā lilladhīna āmanū waʿalā rabbihim yatawakkalūna
So whatever you are given of a thing (is) but a passing enjoyment (for) the life (of) the world But what (is) with Allah (is) better and more lasting for those who believe and upon their Lord put (their) trust

item.title: Ash-Shura:37
item.description:
Ash-Shura:37 - وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْۤا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ
wa-alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha wa-idhā mā ghaḍibū hum yaghfirūna
And those who avoid (the) greater sins and the immoralities and when and when they are angry they forgive

item.title: Ash-Shura:38
item.description:
Ash-Shura:38 - وَالَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورٰی بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ
wa-alladhīna is'tajābū lirabbihim wa-aqāmū l-ṣalata wa-amruhum shūrā baynahum wamimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūna
And those who respond to their Lord and establish prayer and their affairs (are conducted by) consultation among them and from what We have provided them they spend

item.title: Ash-Shura:39
item.description:
Ash-Shura:39 - وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنْتَصِرُونَ
wa-alladhīna idhā aṣābahumu l-baghyu hum yantaṣirūna
And those who when strikes them tyranny they defend themselves

item.title: Ash-Shura:40
item.description:
Ash-Shura:40 - وَجَزَؤُا سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ
wajazāu sayyi-atin sayyi-atun mith'luhā faman ʿafā wa-aṣlaḥa fa-ajruhu ʿalā l-lahi innahu lā yuḥibbu l-ẓālimīna
(The) recompense (of) an evil (is) an evil like it But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation then his reward (is) on Allah Indeed, He (does) not like the wrongdoers

item.title: Ash-Shura:41
item.description:
Ash-Shura:41 - وَلَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَأُولَئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ
walamani intaṣara baʿda ẓul'mihi fa-ulāika mā ʿalayhim min sabīlin
And surely whosoever defends himself after he has been wronged then those not (is) against them any way

item.title: Ash-Shura:42
item.description:
Ash-Shura:42 - إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yaẓlimūna l-nāsa wayabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun
Only the way against those who oppress the people and rebel in the earth without right Those for them (is) a punishment painful

item.title: Ash-Shura:43
item.description:
Ash-Shura:43 - وَلَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ
walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmi l-umūri
And whoever (is) patient and forgives indeed that (is) surely of matters of determination matters of determination

item.title: Ash-Shura:44
item.description:
Ash-Shura:44 - وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ وَلِيٍّ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَتَرٰی الظَّالِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَى مَرَدٍّ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ
waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min waliyyin min baʿdihi watarā l-ẓālimīna lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddin min sabīlin
And whoever Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray then not for him any protector after Him after Him And you will see the wrongdoers when they see the punishment saying Is (there) for return any way

item.title: Ash-Shura:45
item.description:
Ash-Shura:45 - وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنْظُرُونَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوْۤا أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُقِيمٍ
watarāhum yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina l-dhuli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyyin waqāla alladhīna āmanū inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā inna l-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābin muqīmin
And you will see them being exposed to it humbled by disgrace looking with a glance stealthy And will say those who believed Indeed the losers (are) those who lost themselves and their families (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection Unquestionably Indeed the wrongdoers (are) in a punishment lasting

item.title: Ash-Shura:46
item.description:
Ash-Shura:46 - وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنْصُرُونَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ
wamā kāna lahum min awliyāa yanṣurūnahum min dūni l-lahi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min sabīlin
And not will be for them any protector (who) will help them besides besides Allah And whom Allah lets go astray Allah lets go astray then not for him any way

item.title: Ash-Shura:47
item.description:
Ash-Shura:47 - اِسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ مَلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَكِيرٍ
is'tajībū lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi mā lakum min malja-in yawma-idhin wamā lakum min nakīrin
Respond to your Lord before before that comes a Day (there is) no averting for it from Allah Not (is) for you any refuge (on) that Day and not for you any denial

item.title: Ash-Shura:48
item.description:
Ash-Shura:48 - فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوْۤا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُورٌ
fa-in aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan in ʿalayka illā l-balāghu wa-innā idhā adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim fa-inna l-insāna kafūrun
Then if they turn away then not We have sent you over them (as) a guardian Not (is) on you except the conveyance And indeed when We cause to taste [the] man from Us Mercy he rejoices in it But if befalls them evil for what have sent forth their hands then indeed [the] man (is) ungrateful

item.title: Ash-Shura:49
item.description:
Ash-Shura:49 - لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ
lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yakhluqu mā yashāu yahabu liman yashāu ināthan wayahabu liman yashāu l-dhukūra
To Allah (belongs the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth He creates what He wills He grants to whom He wills females and He grants to whom He wills [the] males

item.title: Ash-Shura:50
item.description:
Ash-Shura:50 - أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِيرٌ
aw yuzawwijuhum dhuk'rānan wa-ināthan wayajʿalu man yashāu ʿaqīman innahu ʿalīmun qadīrun
Or He grants them males and females and He makes whom He wills barren Indeed, He (is) All-Knower All-Powerful

item.title: Ash-Shura:51
item.description:
Ash-Shura:51 - وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠ wamā kāna libasharin an yukallimahu l-lahu illā waḥyan aw min warāi ḥijābin aw yur'sila rasūlan fayūḥiya bi-idh'nihi mā yashāu innahu ʿaliyyun ḥakīmun And not is for any human that Allah should speak to him Allah should speak to him except (by) revelation or from behind a veil or (by) sending a messenger then he reveals by His permission what He wills Indeed, He (is) Most High Most Wise
  • [1] Or 'it does not behoove any human that Allah should speak to him.'
  • [2] As from a tree, as in the case of Moses ('a).
  • [3] That is, an angel.

item.title: Ash-Shura:52
item.description:
Ash-Shura:52 - وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْاِیْمَانُ وَلَكِنْ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ نَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥan min amrinā mā kunta tadrī mā l-kitābu walā l-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihi man nashāu min ʿibādinā wa-innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration by Our Command Not (did) you know what the Book (is) and not the faith But We have made it a light We guide with it whom We will of Our slaves And indeed, you surely guide to (the) Path Straight

item.title: Ash-Shura:53
item.description:
Ash-Shura:53 - صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ
ṣirāṭi l-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi alā ilā l-lahi taṣīru l-umūru
(The) path (of) Allah the One to Whom (belongs) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth Unquestionably To Allah reach all affairs

item.title: 43. الزخرف (Az-Zukhruf)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the Ornaments of solid gold, and other precious commodities and appointments, which God would have granted in this life to all the unbelievers—had it not been that this would have driven humankind to unite in godlessness—for the trinkets of life are the true hearts" desire of the ungodly. Yet fleeting are all the things of this world, and far finer and everlasting the joy of Paradise for the believers; and that is their true hearts" desire. It takes its name from the word "ornaments" (zukhruf) in verse 35, and alluded to again in verse 53: in both instances God is refuting the claim of the disbelievers that a true prophet would be rich. The fact that the angels are not God's daughters but His obedient servants is emphasized again and again (verse 15 ff. and verse 60). Similarly, the idea that Jesus could be the son of God is clearly denied (verse 57 ff.).
The surah is also known as Golden Ornaments, Luxury, Ornaments of Gold, The Gold Adornments, The Gold Ornaments

43:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

43:2
وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
wal-kitābi l-mubīni
By the Book the clear

43:3
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna
Indeed, We (have) made it a Quran (in) Arabic so that you may understand

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:1
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:2
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:2 - وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
wal-kitābi l-mubīni
By the Book the clear

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:3
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:3 - إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna
Indeed, We (have) made it a Quran (in) Arabic so that you may understand

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:4
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:4 - وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِیْمٌ۠
wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmun
And indeed, it (is) in (the) Mother (of) the Book with Us surely exalted full of wisdom

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:5
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:5 - أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُسْرِفِينَ
afanaḍribu ʿankumu l-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawman mus'rifīna
Then should We take away from you the Reminder disregarding (you) because you are a people transgressing

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:6
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:6 - وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ
wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fī l-awalīna
And how many We sent of a Prophet among the former (people)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:7
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:7 - وَمَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
wamā yatīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And not came to them any Prophet any Prophet but they used to mock at him mock at him

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:8
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:8 - فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَمَضَى مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīna Then We destroyed stronger than them (in) power and has passed (the) example (of) the former (people)
  • [1] That is, the Arab polytheists.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:9
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:9 - وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ
wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu
And if you ask them Who created the heavens and the earth They will surely say Created them the All-Mighty the All-Knower

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:10
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:10 - اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan laʿallakum tahtadūna
The One Who made for you the earth a bed and made for you therein roads so that you may (be) guided

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:11
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:11 - وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنْشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
wa-alladhī nazzala mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūna
And the One Who sends down from the sky water in (due) measure then We revive with it a land dead thus you will be brought forth

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:12
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:12 - وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūna And the One Who created the pairs all of them and made for you of the ships and the cattle what you ride
  • [1] Or, 'all the pairs.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:13
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:13 - لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَى ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْۤا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīna
That you may sit firmly on their backs then remember (the) favor (of) your Lord when you sit firmly on them and say Glory be (to) the One Who (has) subjected to us this and not we were of it capable

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:14
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:14 - وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna
And indeed, we to our Lord will surely return

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:15
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:15 - وَجَعَلُوْۤا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُبِينٌ wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrun mubīnun But they attribute to Him from His slaves a portion Indeed man surely (is) clearly ungrateful surely (is) clearly ungrateful
  • [1] Lit.: 'They assign to Him a portion from among His servants.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:16
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:16 - أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُمْ بِالْبَنِينَ
ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bil-banīna
Or has He taken of what He has created daughters and He has chosen (for) you sons

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:17
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:17 - وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun And when is given good news (to) one of them of what he sets up for the Most Gracious (as) a likeness becomes his face dark and he (is) filled with grief
  • [1] That is, when he is brought the news of the birth of a daughter.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:18
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:18 - أَوَمَنْ يُنَشَّؤُا فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
awaman yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin
Then (is one) who is brought up in ornaments and he in the dispute (is) not clear

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:19
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:19 - وَجَعَلُوْۤا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَاثًا أَشَهِدُوْۤا خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْءَلُونَ
wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu l-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūna
And they made the Angels those who themselves (are) slaves (of) the Most Gracious females Did they witness their creation Will be recorded their testimony and they will be questioned

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:20
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:20 - وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُمْ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ waqālū law shāa l-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūna And they say If had willed the Most Gracious we would not have worshipped them we would not have worshipped them Not they have about that any knowledge Nothing they (do) but lie
  • [1] That is, the gods worshiped by the polytheists. Cf. (Q 16:35).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:21
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:21 - أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ فَهُمْ بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
am ātaynāhum kitāban min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūna
Or have We given them a book before it before it so they to it (are) holding fast

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:22
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:22 - بَلْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُهْتَدُونَ
bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūna
Nay they say Indeed, we [we] found our forefathers upon a religion and indeed, we on their footsteps (are) guided

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:23
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:23 - وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا ءَابَاءَنَا عَلَى أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ مُقْتَدُونَ
wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūna
And thus not We sent before you before you in a town any warner except said (the) wealthy ones of it Indeed, we [we] found our forefathers on a religion and indeed, we on their footsteps (are) following

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:24
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:24 - قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِأَهْدَى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَاءَكُمْ قَالُوْا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ
qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna
He said Even if I brought you better guidance than what you found on it your forefathers They said Indeed, we with what you are sent with [it] (are) disbelievers

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:25
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:25 - فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ
fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna
So We took retribution from them Then see how was (the) end (of) the deniers

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:26
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:26 - وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāon mimmā taʿbudūna
And when Ibrahim Said Ibrahim Said to his father and his people Indeed, I (am) disassociated from what you worship

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:27
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:27 - إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ
illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīni
Except the One Who created me and indeed, He will guide me

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:28
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:28 - وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna And he made it a word lasting among his descendents so that they may return
  • [1] That is, the word of tawḥīd, 'There is no god except Allah,' the monotheistic creed of Abraham, or, in accordance with the traditions of the Imams Muḥammad al-Bāqir and Ja'far al-Ṣādiq ('a) Abraham's imamate (cf. (Q 2:124); Tafsīr al-Ṣāfī, Majma' al-Bayān).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:29
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:29 - بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَؤُلَاءِ وَءَابَاءَهُمْ حَتّٰی جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlun mubīnun Nay I gave enjoyment (to) these and their forefathers until came to them the truth and a Messenger clear
  • [1] That is, the Arabs.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:30
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:30 - وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هَذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ
walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'run wa-innā bihi kāfirūna
And when came to them the truth they said This (is) magic and indeed, we of it (are) disbelievers

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:31
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:31 - وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulin mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin And they say Why not was sent down this the Quran to a man from the two towns great
  • [1] That is, Makkah and Madinah, which were the two major towns of Arabia at that time.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:32
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:32 - أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyan waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna
Do they distribute (the) Mercy (of) your Lord We [We] distribute among them their livelihood in the life (of) the world and We raise some of them above others (in) degrees so that may take some of them others (for) service But (the) Mercy (of) your Lord (is) better than what they accumulate

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:33
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:33 - وَلَوْلَا أَنْ يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَجَعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ walawlā an yakūna l-nāsu ummatan wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan min fiḍḍatin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūna And if not that (would) become [the] mankind a community one We (would have) made for (one) who disbelieves in the Most Gracious for their houses roofs of silver and stairways upon which they mount
  • [1] That is, a monolithic community of people without faith.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:34
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:34 - وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ
walibuyūtihim abwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūna
And for their houses doors and couches upon which they recline

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:35
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:35 - وَزُخْرُفًا وَإِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْءَاخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ wazukh'rufan wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīna And ornaments of gold And not (is) all that but an enjoyment (of) the life (of) the world And the Hereafter with your Lord (is) for the righteous
  • [1] Or 'houses embellished with gold.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:36
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:36 - وَمَنْ يَعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ waman yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri l-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun And whoever turns away from (the) remembrance (of) the Most Gracious We appoint for him a devil then he (is) to him a companion
  • [1] Or 'whoever shuns.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:37
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:37 - وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani l-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna And indeed, they surely, turn them from the Path and they think that they (are) guided
  • [1] That is, the devils.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:38
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:38 - حَتّٰی إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَالَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ
ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīnu
Until when he comes to Us he says O would that between me and between you (were the) distance (of) the East and the West How wretched is the companion

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:39
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:39 - وَلَنْ يَنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ walan yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna And never will benefit you the Day when you have wronged that you (will be) in the punishment sharing
  • [1] That is, 'your desire to keep away from your evil companion.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:40
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:40 - أَفَأَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālin mubīnin
Then can you cause to hear the deaf or guide the blind and (one) who is in an error clear

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:41
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:41 - فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُنْتَقِمُونَ
fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūna
And whether We take you away We take you away then indeed, We from them (will) take retribution

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:42
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:42 - أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُقْتَدِرُونَ
aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūna
Or We show you that which We have promised them then indeed, We over them have full power

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:43
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:43 - فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ إِنَّكَ عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
So hold fast to that which is revealed to you Indeed, you (are) on a Path Straight

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:44
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:44 - وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ وَسَوْفَ تُسْءَلُونَ
wa-innahu ladhik'run laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūna
And indeed, it (is) surely, a Reminder for you and your people and soon you will be questioned

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:45
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:45 - وَسْءَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ wasal man arsalnā min qablika min rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni l-raḥmāni ālihatan yuʿ'badūna And ask (those) whom We sent before you before you of Our Messengers did We make besides besides the Most Gracious gods to be worshipped
  • [1] That is, during the cosmic journey of the Prophet (see (Q 17:1), (Q 53:8) - (Q 53:17)).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:46
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:46 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسٰی بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإيهِ فَقَالَ اِنِّیْ رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna
And certainly We sent Musa with Our Signs to Firaun and his chiefs and he said Indeed, I am a Messenger (of the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:47
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:47 - فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ إِذَا هُمْ مِنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūna
But when he came to them with Our Signs behold They at them laughed

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:48
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:48 - وَمَا نُرِيهِمْ مِنْ اٰیَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا وَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
And not We showed them of a Sign but it (was) greater than its sister and We seized them with the punishment so that they may return

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:49
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:49 - وَقَالُوْۤا يَاأَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
waqālū yāayyuha l-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūna
And they said O [the] magician Invoke for us your Lord by what He has made covenant with you Indeed, we (will) surely be guided

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:50
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:50 - فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُونَ
falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūna
But when We removed from them the punishment behold They broke (their word)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:51
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:51 - وَنَادَى فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِي أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūna
And called out Firaun among his people he said O my people Is not for me (the) kingdom (of) Egypt and these [the] rivers flowing underneath me underneath me Then do not you see

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:52
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:52 - أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ am anā khayrun min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīnu Or am I better than this one who he (is) insignificant and hardly and hardly clear
  • [1] Or 'vile.'

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:53
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:53 - فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīna
Then why not are placed on him bracelets of gold or come with him the Angels accompanying (him)

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:54
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:54 - فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna
So he bluffed his people and they obeyed him Indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:55
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:55 - فَلَمَّا ءَاسَفُونَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna
So when they angered Us We took retribution from them and We drowned them all

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:56
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:56 - فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِلْءَاخِرِينَ fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan lil'ākhirīna And We made them a precedent and an example for the later (generations)
  • [1] That is, of those who enter hell.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:57
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:57 - وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūna And when is presented (the) son (of) Maryam (as) an example behold Your people about it laughed aloud
  • [1] Or 'laughed at it.' (Ma'ānī al-akhbār, p. 220) Or 'turn away,' in accordance with an alternate reading (yaṣuddūn instead of yaṣiddūn) narrated from many authorities. (Mu'jam al-Qirā'āt al-Qur'āniyyah, vol. 6, p. 121).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:58
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:58 - وَقَالُوْۤا ءَأَالِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūna
And they said Are our gods better or he Not they present it to you except (for) argument Nay they (are) a people argumentative

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:59
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:59 - إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِبَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ
in huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan libanī is'rāīla
Not he (was) except a slave We bestowed Our favor on him and We made him an example for (the) Children of Israel for (the) Children of Israel

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:60
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:60 - وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūna
And if We willed surely We (could have) made among you Angels in the earth succeeding

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:61
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:61 - وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ wa-innahu laʿil'mun lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun And indeed, it surely (is) a knowledge of the Hour So (do) not (be) doubtful about it and follow Me This (is the) Path Straight
  • [1] That is, Jesus ('a), or 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib ('a), in accordance with traditions narrated from the Prophet (ṣ) and Imam Ja'far al-Ṣādiq ('a). (Tafsīr al-Burhān).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:62
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:62 - وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُبِينٌ
walā yaṣuddannakumu l-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun
And (let) not avert you the Shaitaan Indeed, he (is) for you an enemy clear

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:63
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:63 - وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسٰی بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِیْهِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni
And when came Isa with clear proofs he said Verily I have come to you with wisdom and that I make clear to you some (of) that which you differ in it So fear Allah and obey me

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:64
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:64 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun
Indeed Allah He (is) my Lord and your Lord so worship Him This (is) a Path Straight

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:65
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:65 - فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِنْ بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmin
But differed the factions from among them so woe to those who wronged from (the) punishment (of the) Day painful

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:66
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:66 - هَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
hal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna
Are they waiting except (for) the Hour that it should come on them suddenly while they (do) not perceive

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:67
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:67 - اَلْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ
al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīna
Friends that Day some of them to others (will be) enemies except the righteous

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:68
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:68 - يَاعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūna
O My slaves No fear on you this Day and not you will grieve

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:69
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:69 - اَلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ وَكَانُوْۤا مُسْلِمِينَ
alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīna
Those who believed in Our Verses and were submissive

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:70
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:70 - اُدْخُلُوْۤا الْجَنَّةَ أَنْتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūna
Enter Paradise you and your spouses delighted

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:71
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:71 - يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ وَأَنْتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin min dhahabin wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūna Will be circulated for them plates of gold and cups And therein (is) what desires the souls and delights the eyes and you therein will abide forever
  • [1] That is, in paradise.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:72
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:72 - وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
And this (is) the Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:73
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:73 - لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratun min'hā takulūna
For you therein (are) fruits abundant from it you will eat

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:74
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:74 - إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ
inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūna
Indeed the criminals (will be) in (the) punishment (of) Hell abiding forever

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:75
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:75 - لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mub'lisūna
Not will it subside for them and they in it (will) despair

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:76
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:76 - وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَكِنْ كَانُوْۤا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ
wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humu l-ẓālimīna
And not We wronged them but they were themselves wrongdoers

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:77
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:77 - وَنَادَوْا يَامَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَاكِثُونَ wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka qāla innakum mākithūna And they will call O Malik Let put an end to us your Lord He (will) say Indeed, you (will) remain
  • [1] The name of the angel in charge of hell.

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:78
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:78 - لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharakum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna
Certainly We have brought you the truth but most of you to the truth (are) averse

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:79
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:79 - أَمْ أَبْرَمُوْۤا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
am abramū amran fa-innā mub'rimūna
Or have they determined an affair Then indeed, We (are) determined

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:80
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:80 - أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ بَلَى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūna
Or (do) they think that We (can) not hear their secret(s) and their private counsel(s) Nay and Our Messengers with them are recording

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:81
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:81 - قُلْ إِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ
qul in kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā awwalu l-ʿābidīna
Say If had the Most Gracious a son Then, I (would be the) first (of) the worshippers

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:82
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:82 - سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
sub'ḥāna rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna
Glory be (to the) Lord (of) the heavens and the earth (the) Lord (of) the Throne above what they ascribe

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:83
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:83 - فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna
So leave them (to) converse vainly and play until they meet their Day which they are promised

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:84
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:84 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَهٌ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ
wahuwa alladhī fī l-samāi ilāhun wafī l-arḍi ilāhun wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu
And He (is) the One Who (is) in the heaven God and in the earth God And He (is) the All-Wise the All-Knower

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:85
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:85 - وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
watabāraka alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna
And blessed (is) the One Who to Whom (belongs the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between both of them and with Him (is the) knowledge (of) the Hour and to Him you will be returned

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:86
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:86 - وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
walā yamliku alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi l-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqi wahum yaʿlamūna
And not have power those whom they invoke besides Him besides Him (for) the intercession except who testifies to the truth and they know

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:87
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:87 - وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنَّى يُؤْفَكُونَ
wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna
And if you ask them who created them they will certainly say Allah Then how are they deluded

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:88
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:88 - وَقِيلِهِ يَارَبِّ إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ waqīlihi yārabbi inna hāulāi qawmun lā yu'minūna And his saying O my Lord Indeed these (are) a people (who do) not believe
  • [1] That is, of the Apostle of Allah (ṣ).

item.title: Az-Zukhruf:89
item.description:
Az-Zukhruf:89 - فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
fa-iṣ'faḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun fasawfa yaʿlamūna
So turn away from them and say Peace But soon they will know

item.title: 44. الدخان (Ad-Dukhaan)
item.description:
The surah that mentions a divine portent of an evil destiny that will come in the appearance of something unknown called the Smoke. It manifests in the sky and enveils the unbelievers on the earth, until they cry in vain to God that they shall believe in the Quran and its Messenger of only He delivers them from this torment. It takes its name from the "smoke" (dukhān) mentioned in verse 10. The surah highlights the mercy that is the Quran, addresses the obduracy of the powerful and wealthy oppressors, and draws comparisons between the people of Pharaoh, Tubba', and the Meccans. The people of Paradise will enjoy heavenly bliss while those who were mighty in this world will suffer the torments of Hell.
The surah is also known as Mist

44:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

44:2
وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
wal-kitābi l-mubīni
By the Book the clear

44:3
إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِينَ
innā anzalnāhu fī laylatin mubārakatin innā kunnā mundhirīna
Indeed, We revealed it in a Night Blessed Indeed, We [We] are (ever) warning

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:1
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:2
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:2 - وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
wal-kitābi l-mubīni
By the Book the clear

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:3
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:3 - إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِينَ
innā anzalnāhu fī laylatin mubārakatin innā kunnā mundhirīna
Indeed, We revealed it in a Night Blessed Indeed, We [We] are (ever) warning

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:4
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:4 - فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ fīhā yuf'raqu kullu amrin ḥakīmin Therein is made distinct every affair wise
  • [1] That is, on the Night of Ordainment. See (Q 97:1) - (Q 97:5).

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:5
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:5 - أَمْرًا مِنْ عِنْدِنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ amran min ʿindinā innā kunnā mur'silīna A command from Us Indeed, We [We] are (ever) sending
  • [1] Or 'edict.'

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:6
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:6 - رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
raḥmatan min rabbika innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu
As Mercy from your Lord Indeed, He He (is) the All-Hearer the All-Knower

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:7
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:7 - رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ
rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīna
Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between both of them if you are certain

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:8
item.description:
