Ad-Dukhaan:8 - لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīna
(There is) no god except Him He gives life and causes death your Lord and (the) Lord (of) your fathers the former

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:9
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:9 - بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
bal hum fī shakkin yalʿabūna
Nay they (are) in doubt playing

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:10
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:10 - فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ
fa-ir'taqib yawma tatī l-samāu bidukhānin mubīnin
Then watch (for the) Day (when) will bring the sky smoke visible

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:11
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:11 - يَغْشٰی النَّاسَ هَذَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
yaghshā l-nāsa hādhā ʿadhābun alīmun
Enveloping the people This (will be) a punishment painful

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:12
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:12 - رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
rabbanā ik'shif ʿannā l-ʿadhāba innā mu'minūna
Our Lord Remove from us the punishment indeed, we (are) believers

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:13
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:13 - أَنَّى لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَى وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ
annā lahumu l-dhik'rā waqad jāahum rasūlun mubīnun
How can (there be) for them the reminder when verily had come to them a Messenger clear

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:14
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:14 - ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوْۤا مُعَلَّمٌ مَجْنُونٌ
thumma tawallaw ʿanhu waqālū muʿallamun majnūnun
Then they turned away from him and said One taught a mad man

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:15
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:15 - إِنَّا كَاشِفُوْۤا الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ
innā kāshifū l-ʿadhābi qalīlan innakum ʿāidūna
Indeed, We (will) remove the punishment a little indeed, you (will) return

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:16
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:16 - يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرٰی إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ
yawma nabṭishu l-baṭshata l-kub'rā innā muntaqimūna
(The) Day We will seize (with) the seizure the greatest indeed, We (will) take retribution

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:17
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:17 - وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
walaqad fatannā qablahum qawma fir'ʿawna wajāahum rasūlun karīmun
And certainly We tried before them (the) people (of) Firaun and came to them a Messenger noble

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:18
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:18 - أَنْ أَدُّوْۤا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ an addū ilayya ʿibāda l-lahi innī lakum rasūlun amīnun That Deliver to me (the) servants (of) Allah Indeed, I am to you a Messenger trustworthy
  • [1] That is, the Israelites.

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:19
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:19 - وَأَنْ لَا تَعْلُوْۤا عَلَى اللَّهِ اِنِّیْ ءَاتِيكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
wa-an lā taʿlū ʿalā l-lahi innī ātīkum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin
And that (do) not exalt yourselves against Allah Indeed, I [I] have come to you with an authority clear

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:20
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:20 - وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ
wa-innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum an tarjumūni
And indeed, I [I] seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you stone me

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:21
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:21 - وَإِنْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ
wa-in lam tu'minū lī fa-iʿ'tazilūni
And if not you believe me then leave me alone

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:22
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:22 - فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُجْرِمُونَ
fadaʿā rabbahu anna hāulāi qawmun muj'rimūna
So he called his Lord That these (are) a people criminals

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:23
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:23 - فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ
fa-asri biʿibādī laylan innakum muttabaʿūna
Then "Set out with My slaves (by) night Indeed, you (will be) followed

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:24
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:24 - وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا إِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُغْرَقُونَ
wa-ut'ruki l-baḥra rahwan innahum jundun mugh'raqūna
And leave the sea at rest Indeed, they (are) an army (to be) drowned

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:25
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:25 - كَمْ تَرَكُوْۤا مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
kam tarakū min jannātin waʿuyūnin
How many (did) they leave of gardens and springs

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:26
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:26 - وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmin
And cornfields and places noble

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:27
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:27 - وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوْۤا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ
wanaʿmatin kānū fīhā fākihīna
And pleasant things they used to therein take delight

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:28
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:28 - كَذٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīna
Thus And We made it (an) inherit(ance) (for) a people another

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:29
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:29 - فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْظَرِينَ
famā bakat ʿalayhimu l-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīna
And not wept for them the heaven and the earth and not they were given respite

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:30
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:30 - وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ
walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīni
And certainly We saved (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel from the punishment the humiliating

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:31
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:31 - مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyan mina l-mus'rifīna
From Firaun Indeed, he was arrogant among the transgressors

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:32
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:32 - وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَى عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīna
And certainly We chose them by knowledge over the worlds

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:33
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:33 - وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِیْهِ بَلَؤٌا مُبِينٌ
waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāon mubīnun
And We gave them of the Signs that in it (was) a trial clear

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:34
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:34 - إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
inna hāulāi layaqūlūna
Indeed these surely, they say

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:35
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:35 - إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَى وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِينَ
in hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīna
Not it (is) but our death the first and not we (will be) raised again

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:36
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:36 - فَأْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
fatū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Then bring our forefathers if you are truthful

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:37
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:37 - أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا مُجْرِمِينَ ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿin wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīna Are they better or (the) people (of) Tubba and those before them before them We destroyed them indeed, they were criminals
  • [1] Name of a Yemenite king. Tubba' is said to be the title of a dynasty of Yemenite kings (like pharaoh, caesar and khaqan).

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:38
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:38 - وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ
wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna
And not We created the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between them (in) play

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:39
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:39 - مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
Not We created both of them but in [the] truth but most of them (do) not know

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:40
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:40 - إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
inna yawma l-faṣli mīqātuhum ajmaʿīna
Indeed (the) Day of Judgment (the) Day of Judgment (is) an appointed term for them all

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:41
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:41 - يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿan mawlan shayan walā hum yunṣarūna
(The) Day not will avail a relation for a relation anything and not they will be helped

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:42
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:42 - إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
illā man raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu
Except (on) whom Allah has mercy Allah has mercy Indeed, He He (is) the All-Mighty the Most Merciful

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:43
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:43 - إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ
inna shajarata l-zaqūmi
Indeed (the) tree (of) Zaqqum

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:44
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:44 - طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ
ṭaʿāmu l-athīmi
(Will be) food (of) the sinner(s)

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:45
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:45 - كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ
kal-muh'li yaghlī fī l-buṭūni
Like the murky oil it will boil in the bellies

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:46
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:46 - كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ
kaghalyi l-ḥamīmi
Like boiling (of) scalding water

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:47
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:47 - خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَى سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ
khudhūhu fa-iʿ'tilūhu ilā sawāi l-jaḥīmi
Seize him and drag him into (the) midst (of) the Hellfire

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:48
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:48 - ثُمَّ صُبُّوْۤا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ
thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīmi
Then pour over his head of (the) punishment (of) the scalding water

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:49
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:49 - ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ
dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīmu
Taste Indeed, you [you] (were) the mighty the noble

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:50
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:50 - إِنَّ هَذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ
inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūna
Indeed this (is) what you used to about it doubt

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:51
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:51 - إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīnin
Indeed the righteous (will be) in a place secure

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:52
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:52 - فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
fī jannātin waʿuyūnin
In gardens and springs

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:53
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:53 - يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ
yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīna
Wearing garments of fine silk and heavy silk facing each other

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:54
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:54 - كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin
Thus And We will marry them (to) companions with beautiful eyes (to) companions with beautiful eyes

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:55
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:55 - يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīna
They will call therein for every (kind) (of) fruit secure

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:56
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:56 - لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَى وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi
Not they will taste therein the death except the death the first And He will protect them (from the) punishment (of) the Hellfire

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:57
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:57 - فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu
A Bounty from your Lord That it (will be) the success the great

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:58
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:58 - فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna
Indeed We have made it easy in your tongue so that they may take heed

item.title: Ad-Dukhaan:59
item.description:
Ad-Dukhaan:59 - فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُمْ مُرْتَقِبُونَ
fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūna
So watch indeed, they (too are) watching

item.title: 45. الجاثية (Al-Jaathiya)
item.description:
The surah that mentions The Kneeling of every community around the brink of Hellfire on the Day of Doom in wait of its divine judgment. It takes its name from the word "kneeling" (jāthiyah) in verse 28. The surah addresses some of the arguments put forward by those sceptical of the truthfulness of the Quran. Emphasis is placed on the signs of God's existence discernible in nature, and on the painful punishment that awaits the doubters on the Day of Judgement. The misguided arrogance of the disbelievers (verse 8 and verse 31) is contrasted with God's true greatness (verse 37); references to God's wisdom and majesty open and close the surah.
The surah is also known as Bowing the Knee, Crouching, Hobbling, The Kneeling, The Kneeling Down

45:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

45:2
تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

45:3
إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīna
Indeed in the heavens and the earth surely (are) Signs for the believers

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:1
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:2
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:2 - تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:3
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:3 - إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَءَايَاتٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīna
Indeed in the heavens and the earth surely (are) Signs for the believers

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:4
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:4 - وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
wafī khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbatin āyātun liqawmin yūqinūna
And in your creation and what He disperses of (the) moving creatures (are) Signs for a people who are certain

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:5
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:5 - وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ رِزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min riz'qin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi āyātun liqawmin yaʿqilūna
And (in the) alternation (of) the night and the day and what Allah sends down Allah sends down from the sky of (the) provision and gives life thereby (to) the earth after its death and (in) directing (the) winds (are) Signs for a people who reason

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:6
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:6 - تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَءَايَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ
til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿda l-lahi waāyātihi yu'minūna
These (are the) Verses (of) Allah We recite them to you in truth Then in what statement after Allah and His Verses will they believe

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:7
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:7 - وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
waylun likulli affākin athīmin
Woe to every liar sinful

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:8
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:8 - يَسْمَعُ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْهَا فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
yasmaʿu āyāti l-lahi tut'lā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin
Who hears (the) Verses (of) Allah recited to him then persists arrogantly as if not he heard them So give him tidings (of) a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:9
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:9 - وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ
wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayan ittakhadhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun
And when he knows of Our Verses anything he takes them (in) ridicule Those for them (is) a punishment humiliating

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:10
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:10 - مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ مَا كَسَبُوْۤا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
min warāihim jahannamu walā yugh'nī ʿanhum mā kasabū shayan walā mā ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun
Before them Before them (is) Hell and not will avail them what they had earned anything and not what they had taken besides besides Allah (as) protectors And for them (is) a punishment great

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:11
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:11 - هَذَا هُدًى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِءَايَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ اَلِیْمٌ hādhā hudan wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmun This (is) guidance And those who disbelieve in (the) Verses (of) their Lord for them (is) a punishment of filth painful
  • [1] Cf. (Q 34:5).

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:12
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:12 - اَللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِیْهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
al-lahu alladhī sakhara lakumu l-baḥra litajriya l-ful'ku fīhi bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna
Allah (is) the One Who subjected to you the sea that may sail the ships therein by His Command and that you may seek of His Bounty and that you may give thanks

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:13
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:13 - وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَءَايَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
wasakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan min'hu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna
And He has subjected to you whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth all from Him Indeed in that surely are Signs for a people who give thought

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:14
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:14 - قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَغْفِرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ
qul lilladhīna āmanū yaghfirū lilladhīna lā yarjūna ayyāma l-lahi liyajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūna
Say to those who believe (to) forgive those who (do) not hope (for the) days (of) Allah that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:15
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:15 - مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِلَى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna
Whoever does a righteous deed then it is for his soul and whoever does evil then it (is) against it Then to your Lord you will be returned

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:16
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:16 - وَلَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
walaqad ātaynā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna
And certainly We gave (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel the Book and the wisdom and the Prophethood and We provided them of the good things and We preferred them over the worlds

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:17
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:17 - وَءَاتَيْنَاهُمْ بَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوْۤا فِیْهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
waātaynāhum bayyinātin mina l-amri famā ikh'talafū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna
And We gave them clear proofs of the matter And not they differed except after after what came to them the knowledge (out of) envy between themselves Indeed your Lord will judge between them (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection about what they used to therein differ

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:18
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:18 - ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَى شَرِيعَةٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿatin mina l-amri fa-ittabiʿ'hā walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna
Then We put you on an ordained way of the matter so follow it and (do) not follow (the) desires (of) those who (do) not know

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:19
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:19 - إِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُغْنُوْۤا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ innahum lan yugh'nū ʿanka mina l-lahi shayan wa-inna l-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wal-lahu waliyyu l-mutaqīna Indeed, they never will avail you against Allah (in) anything And indeed the wrongdoers some of them (are) allies (of) others and Allah (is the) Protector (of) the righteous
  • [1] Or 'ally.'

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:20
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:20 - هَذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
hādhā baṣāiru lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yūqinūna
This (is) enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:21
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:21 - أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَنْ نَجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
am ḥasiba alladhīna ij'taraḥū l-sayiāti an najʿalahum ka-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sawāan maḥyāhum wamamātuhum sāa mā yaḥkumūna
Do think those who commit evil deeds that We will make them like those who believed and did righteous deeds equal (in) their life and their death Evil is what they judge

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:22
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:22 - وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
wakhalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi walituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna
And Allah created And Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth and that may be recompensed every soul for what it has earned and they will not be wronged will not be wronged

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:23
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:23 - أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَى سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَى بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً فَمَنْ يَهْدِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
afara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu l-lahu ʿalā ʿil'min wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwatan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi l-lahi afalā tadhakkarūna
Have you seen (he) who takes (as) his god his desire and Allah lets him go astray and Allah lets him go astray knowingly knowingly and He sets a seal upon his hearing and his heart and puts over his vision a veil Then who will guide him after after Allah Then will not you receive admonition

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:24
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:24 - وَقَالُوْۤا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
waqālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuh'likunā illā l-dahru wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yaẓunnūna
And they say Not it (is) but our life (of) the world we die and we live and not destroys us except the time And not for them of that any knowledge not they (do) but guess

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:25
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:25 - وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوْا ائْتُوْۤا بِءَابَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālū i'tū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And when are recited to them Our Verses clear not is their argument except that they say Bring our forefathers if you are truthful

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:26
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:26 - قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِیْهِ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
quli l-lahu yuḥ'yīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna
Say Allah gives you life then causes you to die then He will gather you to (the) Day (of) the Resurrection no doubt about it But most (of) the people (do) not know

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:27
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:27 - وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ
walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yakhsaru l-mub'ṭilūna
And for Allah (is the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and (the) Day is established the Hour that Day will lose the falsifiers

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:28
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:28 - وَتَرٰی كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَى إِلَى كِتَابِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
watarā kulla ummatin jāthiyatan kullu ummatin tud'ʿā ilā kitābihā l-yawma tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna
And you will see every nation kneeling Every nation will be called to its record Today you will be recompensed (for) what you used to do

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:29
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:29 - هَذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bil-ḥaqi innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūna
This Our Record speaks about you in truth Indeed, We [We] used to transcribe what you used to do

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:30
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:30 - فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ
fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayud'khiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-mubīnu
Then as for those who believed and did [the] righteous deeds will admit them their Lord in(to) His mercy That it (is) the success clear

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:31
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:31 - وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَاتِي تُتْلَى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُجْرِمِينَ
wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū afalam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fa-is'takbartum wakuntum qawman muj'rimīna
But as for those who disbelieved Then were not Then were not My Verses recited to you but you were proud and you became a people criminals

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:32
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:32 - وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُمْ مَا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِنْ نَظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
wa-idhā qīla inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wal-sāʿatu lā rayba fīhā qul'tum mā nadrī mā l-sāʿatu in naẓunnu illā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimus'tayqinīna
And when it was said Indeed (the) Promise (of) Allah (is) true and the Hour (there is) no doubt about it you said Not we know what the Hour (is) Not we think except an assumption and not we (are) convinced

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:33
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:33 - وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And (will) appear to them (the) evil (of) what they did and (will) envelop them what they used at it (to) mock

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:34
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:34 - وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِنْ نَاصِرِينَ
waqīla l-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna
And it will be said Today We forget you as you forgot (the) meeting (of) this Day of yours (of) this Day of yours and your abode (is) the Fire and not for you any helpers

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:35
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:35 - ذَلِكُمْ بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰیٰتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
dhālikum bi-annakumu ittakhadhtum āyāti l-lahi huzuwan wagharratkumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma lā yukh'rajūna min'hā walā hum yus'taʿtabūna
That (is) because you took (the) Verses (of) Allah (in) ridicule and deceived you the life (of) the world So this Day not they will be brought forth from it and not they will be asked to appease

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:36
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:36 - فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
falillahi l-ḥamdu rabbi l-samāwāti warabbi l-arḍi rabbi l-ʿālamīna
Then for Allah (is) all the praise (the) Lord (of) the heavens and (the) Lord (of) the earth (the) lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Jaathiya:37
item.description:
Al-Jaathiya:37 - وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
walahu l-kib'riyāu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
And for Him (is) the greatness in the heavens and the earth and He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: 46. الأحقاف (Al-Ahqaf)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the fatal lesion of the ancient people of 'Ād who dwelled in the dune valley of Aḥqāf, whose prophet warned them to give up idolatry and worship only God, but to no avail. It takes its name from verse 21, where Aḥqāf is mentioned. It reflects one of the major themes of this surah: the inescapable punishment that awaits those who deny the truth and the Resurrection. Emphasis is placed on the fact that communities more established than the Meccans" have been destroyed, and that even the jinn believe in the Quran before the disbelievers of Mecca do. Finally, the Prophet is encouraged to be steadfast and await God's judgement on the disbelievers.
The surah is also known as The Dune Valleys of al-Ahqaf, The Dunes, The Sand Dunes, The Sandy Plains, Winding Sand-tracts

46:1
حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

46:2
تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

46:3
مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَمَّا أُنْذِرُوْۤا مُعْرِضُونَ
mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūna
Not We created the heavens and the earth and what (is) between both of them except in truth and (for) a term appointed But those who disbelieve from what they are warned (are) turning away

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:1
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:1 - حم
hha-meem
Ha Meem

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:2
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:2 - تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ
tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi
(The) revelation (of) the Book (is) from Allah the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:3
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:3 - مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَمَّا أُنْذِرُوْۤا مُعْرِضُونَ
mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūna
Not We created the heavens and the earth and what (is) between both of them except in truth and (for) a term appointed But those who disbelieve from what they are warned (are) turning away

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:4
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:4 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوْۤا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ هَذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
qul ara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti i'tūnī bikitābin min qabli hādhā aw athāratin min ʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Say Do you see what you call besides besides Allah Show me what they have created of the earth or for them (is) any share in the heavens Bring me a book from before this or a trace of knowledge if you are truthful

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:5
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:5 - وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوْۤا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَنْ دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ
waman aḍallu mimman yadʿū min dūni l-lahi man lā yastajību lahu ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wahum ʿan duʿāihim ghāfilūna
And who (is) more astray than (he) who calls besides besides Allah who will not respond will not respond to him until (the) Day (of) Resurrection and they of their calls (are) unaware

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:6
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:6 - وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوْۤا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوْۤا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ
wa-idhā ḥushira l-nāsu kānū lahum aʿdāan wakānū biʿibādatihim kāfirīna
And when are gathered the people they will be for them enemies and they will be of their worship deniers

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:7
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:7 - وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ
wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lil'ḥaqqi lammā jāahum hādhā siḥ'run mubīnun
And when are recited to them Our Verses clear say those who disbelieve of the truth when it comes to them This (is) a magic clear

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:8
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:8 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِیْهِ كَفَى بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
am yaqūlūna if'tarāhu qul ini if'taraytuhu falā tamlikūna lī mina l-lahi shayan huwa aʿlamu bimā tufīḍūna fīhi kafā bihi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum wahuwa l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu
Or they say He has invented it Say If I have invented it then not you have power for me against Allah anything He knows best of what you utter concerning it Sufficient is He Sufficient is He (as) a Witness between me and between you and He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:9
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:9 - قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَى إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
qul mā kuntu bid'ʿan mina l-rusuli wamā adrī mā yuf'ʿalu bī walā bikum in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya wamā anā illā nadhīrun mubīnun
Say Not I am a new (one) among the Messengers and not I know what will be done with me and not with you Not I follow but what is revealed to me and not I am but a warner clear

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:10
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:10 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُمْ بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَاءِيلَ عَلَى مِثْلِهِ فَءَامَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ qul ara-aytum in kāna min ʿindi l-lahi wakafartum bihi washahida shāhidun min banī is'rāīla ʿalā mith'lihi faāmana wa-is'takbartum inna l-laha lā yahdī l-qawma l-ẓālimīna Say Do you see if it is from Allah from Allah from Allah and you disbelieve in it and testifies a witness from (the) Children of Israel (the) Children of Israel to (the) like thereof then he believed while you are arrogant Indeed Allah (does) not guide the people the wrongdoers
  • [1] Ellipsis; the omitted phrase is, 'who will be more astray than him who is in extreme defiance.' See (Q 41:52).

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:11
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:11 - وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوْۤا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ
waqāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū law kāna khayran mā sabaqūnā ilayhi wa-idh lam yahtadū bihi fasayaqūlūna hādhā if'kun qadīmun
And say those who disbelieve of those who believe If it had been good not they (would) have preceded us to it And when not they (are) guided by it they say This (is) a lie ancient

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:12
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:12 - وَمِنْ قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسٰی إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً وَهَذَا كِتَابٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِيُنْذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا وَبُشْرٰی لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ
wamin qablihi kitābu mūsā imāman waraḥmatan wahādhā kitābun muṣaddiqun lisānan ʿarabiyyan liyundhira alladhīna ẓalamū wabush'rā lil'muḥ'sinīna
And before it And before it (was the) Scripture (of) Musa (as) a guide and a mercy And this (is) a Book confirming (in) language Arabic to warn those who do wrong and (as) glad tidings for the good-doers

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:13
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:13 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
inna alladhīna qālū rabbunā l-lahu thumma is'taqāmū falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūna
Indeed those who say Our Lord (is) Allah then remain firm then no fear on them and not they will grieve

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:14
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:14 - اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
ulāika aṣḥābu l-janati khālidīna fīhā jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna
Those (are the) companions (of) Paradise abiding forever therein a reward for what they used to do

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:15
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:15 - وَوَصَّيْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا حَتّٰی إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي اِنِّیْ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
wawaṣṣaynā l-insāna biwālidayhi iḥ'sānan ḥamalathu ummuhu kur'han wawaḍaʿathu kur'han waḥamluhu wafiṣāluhu thalāthūna shahran ḥattā idhā balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaʿīna sanatan qāla rabbi awziʿ'nī an ashkura niʿ'mataka allatī anʿamta ʿalayya waʿalā wālidayya wa-an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa-aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī innī tub'tu ilayka wa-innī mina l-mus'limīna
And We have enjoined (on) man to his parents kindness Carried him his mother (with) hardship and gave birth to him (with) hardship And (the) bearing of him and (the) weaning of him (is) thirty month(s) until when he reaches his maturity and reaches forty year(s) he says My Lord grant me (the) power that I may be grateful (for) Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and that I do righteous (deeds) which please You and make righteous for me among my offspring indeed I turn to You and indeed, I am of those who submit

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:16
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:16 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَنَتَجاوَزُ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ
ulāika alladhīna nataqabbalu ʿanhum aḥsana mā ʿamilū wanatajāwazu ʿan sayyiātihim fī aṣḥābi l-janati waʿda l-ṣid'qi alladhī kānū yūʿadūna
Those (are) the ones We will accept from them (the) best (of) what they did and We will overlook from their evil deeds among (the) companions (of) Paradise A promise true which they were promised

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:17
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:17 - وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِنْ قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ ءَامِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
wa-alladhī qāla liwālidayhi uffin lakumā ataʿidāninī an ukh'raja waqad khalati l-qurūnu min qablī wahumā yastaghīthāni l-laha waylaka āmin inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun fayaqūlu mā hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna
But the one who says to his parents Uff to both of you Do you promise me that I will be brought forth and have already passed away and have already passed away the generations before me before me And they both seek help (of) Allah Woe to you Believe Indeed (the) Promise (of) Allah (is) true But he says Not (is) this but (the) stories (of) the former (people)

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:18
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:18 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا خَاسِرِينَ
ulāika alladhīna ḥaqqa ʿalayhimu l-qawlu fī umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina l-jini wal-insi innahum kānū khāsirīna
Those (are) the ones (has) proved true against them the word among nations (that) already passed away (that) already passed away before them before them of (the) jinn and the men Indeed, they are (the) losers

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:19
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:19 - وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِمَّا عَمِلُوْۤا وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
walikullin darajātun mimmā ʿamilū waliyuwaffiyahum aʿmālahum wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna
And for all (are) degrees for what they did and that He may fully compensate them (for) their deeds and they will not be wronged will not be wronged

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:20
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:20 - وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ
wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri adhhabtum ṭayyibātikum fī ḥayātikumu l-dun'yā wa-is'tamtaʿtum bihā fal-yawma tuj'zawna ʿadhāba l-hūni bimā kuntum tastakbirūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi wabimā kuntum tafsuqūna
And (the) Day will be exposed those who disbelieved to the Fire You exhausted your good things in your life (of) the world and you took your pleasures therein So today you will be recompensed (with) a punishment humiliating because you were arrogant in the earth without [the] right and because you were defiantly disobedient

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:21
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:21 - وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنْذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا إِلَّا اللَّهَ اِنِّیْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
wa-udh'kur akhā ʿādin idh andhara qawmahu bil-aḥqāfi waqad khalati l-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi allā taʿbudū illā l-laha innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin
And mention (the) brother (of) Aad when he warned his people in the Al-Ahqaf and had already passed away and had already passed away [the] warners before him before him before him and after him and after him That not you worship except Allah Indeed, I [I] fear for you a punishment (of) a Day Great

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:22
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:22 - قَالُوْا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
qālū aji'tanā litafikanā ʿan ālihatinā fatinā bimā taʿidunā in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna
They said Have you come to us to turn us away from our gods Then bring us what you threaten us if you are of the truthful

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:23
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:23 - قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُمْ مَا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ
qāla innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-uballighukum mā ur'sil'tu bihi walākinnī arākum qawman tajhalūna
He said Only the knowledge (is) with Allah (is) with Allah and I convey to you what I am sent with it but I see you a people ignorant

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:24
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:24 - فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوْا هَذَا عَارِضٌ مُمْطِرُنَا بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُمْ بِهِ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
falammā ra-awhu ʿāriḍan mus'taqbila awdiyatihim qālū hādhā ʿāriḍun mum'ṭirunā bal huwa mā is'taʿjaltum bihi rīḥun fīhā ʿadhābun alīmun
Then when they saw it (as) a cloud approaching their valleys they said This (is) a cloud bringing us rain Nay it (is) what you were asking it to be hastened you were asking it to be hastened a wind in it (is) a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:25
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:25 - تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرٰی إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
tudammiru kulla shayin bi-amri rabbihā fa-aṣbaḥū lā yurā illā masākinuhum kadhālika najzī l-qawma l-muj'rimīna
Destroying every thing by (the) command (of) its Lord Then they became (such) not is seen except their dwellings Thus We recompense the people [the] criminals

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:26
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:26 - وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِيمَا إِنْ مَكَّنَّاكُمْ فِیْهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَفْئِدَةً فَمَا أَغْنَى عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَا أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوْۤا يَجْحَدُونَ بِءَايَاتِ اللَّهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
walaqad makkannāhum fīmā in makkannākum fīhi wajaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afidatan famā aghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum walā abṣāruhum walā afidatuhum min shayin idh kānū yajḥadūna biāyāti l-lahi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna
And certainly We had established them in what not We have established you in it and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts But not availed them their hearing and not their vision and not their hearts any thing when they were rejecting (the) Signs (of) Allah and enveloped them what they used to at it ridicule

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:27
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:27 - وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُمْ مِنَ الْقُرٰی وَصَرَّفْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
walaqad ahlaknā mā ḥawlakum mina l-qurā waṣarrafnā l-āyāti laʿallahum yarjiʿūna
And certainly We destroyed what surrounds you of the towns and We have diversified the Signs that they may return

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:28
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:28 - فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا آلِهَةً بَلْ ضَلُّوْۤا عَنْهُمْ وَذٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْتَرُونَ
falawlā naṣarahumu alladhīna ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi qur'bānan ālihatan bal ḍallū ʿanhum wadhālika if'kuhum wamā kānū yaftarūna
Then why (did) not help them those whom they had taken besides besides Allah gods as a way of approach gods as a way of approach Nay they were lost from them And that (was) their falsehood and what they were inventing

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:29
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:29 - وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوْا أَنْصِتُوْۤا فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَى قَوْمِهِمْ مُنْذِرِينَ
wa-idh ṣarafnā ilayka nafaran mina l-jini yastamiʿūna l-qur'āna falammā ḥaḍarūhu qālū anṣitū falammā quḍiya wallaw ilā qawmihim mundhirīna
And when We directed to you a party of the jinn listening (to) the Quran And when they attended it they said Listen quietly And when it was concluded they turned back to their people (as) warners

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:30
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:30 - قَالُوْا يَاقَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنْزِلَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مُوسٰی مُصَدِّقًا لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَى طَرِيقٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
qālū yāqawmanā innā samiʿ'nā kitāban unzila min baʿdi mūsā muṣaddiqan limā bayna yadayhi yahdī ilā l-ḥaqi wa-ilā ṭarīqin mus'taqīmin
They said O our people Indeed, we [we] have heard a Book revealed after after Musa confirming what (was) before it (was) before it guiding to the truth and to a Path Straight

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:31
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:31 - يَاقَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوْۤا دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
yāqawmanā ajībū dāʿiya l-lahi waāminū bihi yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayujir'kum min ʿadhābin alīmin
O our people Respond (to the) caller (of) Allah and believe in him He will forgive for you of your sins and will protect you from a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:32
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:32 - وَمَنْ لَا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
waman lā yujib dāʿiya l-lahi falaysa bimuʿ'jizin fī l-arḍi walaysa lahu min dūnihi awliyāu ulāika fī ḍalālin mubīnin
And whoever (does) not respond (to the) caller (of) Allah then not he can escape in the earth and not for him besides Him besides Him protectors Those (are) in error clear

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:33
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:33 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی بَلَى إِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa walam yaʿya bikhalqihinna biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā balā innahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
Do not they see that Allah (is) the One Who created the heavens and the earth and (was) not tired by their creation (is) able to give life to give life to give life (to) the dead Yes indeed He (is) on every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:34
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:34 - وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا عَلَى النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَذَا بِالْحَقِّ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوْۤا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
wayawma yuʿ'raḍu alladhīna kafarū ʿalā l-nāri alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqi qālū balā warabbinā qāla fadhūqū l-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūna
And (the) Day are exposed those who disbelieved to the Fire Is not this the truth They will say Yes by our Lord He will say Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve

item.title: Al-Ahqaf:35
item.description:
Al-Ahqaf:35 - فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُوْۤا الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلْ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ بَلَاغٌ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ
fa-iṣ'bir kamā ṣabara ulū l-ʿazmi mina l-rusuli walā tastaʿjil lahum ka-annahum yawma yarawna mā yūʿadūna lam yalbathū illā sāʿatan min nahārin balāghun fahal yuh'laku illā l-qawmu l-fāsiqūna
So be patient as had patience those of determination those of determination of the Messengers and (do) not seek to hasten for them As if they had (the) Day they see what they were promised not remained except an hour of a day A notification But will (any) be destroyed except the people the defiantly disobedient

item.title: 47. محمد (Muhammad)
item.description:
The surah that declares that God absolves of misdeeds, and sets right the intellects, of those who work righteousness and who believe in all that God has sent down upon His final Messenger to humankind, Muḥammad. It takes its name from verse 2, where the name of the Prophet occurs. The surah deals with issues of war, those who try to prevent conversion to Islam and the carrying out of God's commands, and the fate of the hypocrites. It specifically mentions the iniquity of those who expelled the Prophet from Mecca, it describes the futility of the disbelievers' attempts to oppose God and His Prophet, and it urges the Muslims to obey God in all matters, lest their good deeds come to nothing on the Day of Judgement like those of the disbelievers and hypocrites.
The surah is also known as Mohammad, Muhammad (the Prophet)

47:1
اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi aḍalla aʿmālahum
Those who disbelieve and turn away from (the) way of Allah (the) way of Allah He will cause to be lost their deeds

47:2
وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَءَامَنُوْۤا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyiātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bālahum
And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what is revealed to Muhammad and it (is) the truth from their Lord He will remove from them their misdeeds and improve their condition

47:3
ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ
dhālika bi-anna alladhīna kafarū ittabaʿū l-bāṭila wa-anna alladhīna āmanū ittabaʿū l-ḥaqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu lilnnāsi amthālahum
That (is) because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and that those who believe follow (the) truth from their Lord Thus Allah presents Allah presents to the people their similitudes

item.title: Muhammad:1
item.description:
Muhammad:1 - اَلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi aḍalla aʿmālahum
Those who disbelieve and turn away from (the) way of Allah (the) way of Allah He will cause to be lost their deeds

item.title: Muhammad:2
item.description:
Muhammad:2 - وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَءَامَنُوْۤا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
wa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waāmanū bimā nuzzila ʿalā muḥammadin wahuwa l-ḥaqu min rabbihim kaffara ʿanhum sayyiātihim wa-aṣlaḥa bālahum
And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what is revealed to Muhammad and it (is) the truth from their Lord He will remove from them their misdeeds and improve their condition

item.title: Muhammad:3
item.description:
Muhammad:3 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّبَعُوْۤا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَذٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ
dhālika bi-anna alladhīna kafarū ittabaʿū l-bāṭila wa-anna alladhīna āmanū ittabaʿū l-ḥaqa min rabbihim kadhālika yaḍribu l-lahu lilnnāsi amthālahum
That (is) because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and that those who believe follow (the) truth from their Lord Thus Allah presents Allah presents to the people their similitudes

item.title: Muhammad:4
item.description:
Muhammad:4 - فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتّٰی إِذَا أَثْخَنْتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوْۤا الْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتّٰی تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ذٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَا بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَنْ يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ fa-idhā laqītumu alladhīna kafarū faḍarba l-riqābi ḥattā idhā athkhantumūhum fashuddū l-wathāqa fa-immā mannan baʿdu wa-immā fidāan ḥattā taḍaʿa l-ḥarbu awzārahā dhālika walaw yashāu l-lahu la-intaṣara min'hum walākin liyabluwā baʿḍakum bibaʿḍin wa-alladhīna qutilū fī sabīli l-lahi falan yuḍilla aʿmālahum So when you meet those who disbelieve then strike the necks until when you have subdued them then bind firmly the bond then either a favor afterwards or ransom until lays down the war its burdens That And if Allah had willed Allah had willed surely, He could have taken retribution from them but to test some of you with others And those who are killed in (the) way of Allah (the) way of Allah then never He will cause to be lost their deeds
  • [1] That is, without your mediation.

item.title: Muhammad:5
item.description:
Muhammad:5 - سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ
sayahdīhim wayuṣ'liḥu bālahum
He will guide them and improve their condition

item.title: Muhammad:6
item.description:
Muhammad:6 - وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
wayud'khiluhumu l-janata ʿarrafahā lahum
And admit them (to) Paradise He has made it known to them

item.title: Muhammad:7
item.description:
Muhammad:7 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ تَنْصُرُوْۤا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in tanṣurū l-laha yanṣur'kum wayuthabbit aqdāmakum
O you those who(believe) believe If you help Allah He will help you and make firm your feet

item.title: Muhammad:8
item.description:
Muhammad:8 - وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فَتَعْسًا لَهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ wa-alladhīna kafarū fataʿsan lahum wa-aḍalla aʿmālahum But those who disbelieve destruction (is) for them and He will cause to be lost their deeds
  • [1] Or 'their lot will be wretchedness.'

item.title: Muhammad:9
item.description:
Muhammad:9 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
dhālika bi-annahum karihū mā anzala l-lahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum
That (is) because they hate what Allah has revealed Allah has revealed so He has made worthless their deeds

item.title: Muhammad:10
item.description:
Muhammad:10 - أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْثَالُهَا
afalam yasīrū fī l-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu alladhīna min qablihim dammara l-lahu ʿalayhim walil'kāfirīna amthāluhā
Do not they travel in the earth and see how was (the) end (of) those before them before them Allah destroyed Allah destroyed [over] them and for the disbelievers its likeness

item.title: Muhammad:11
item.description:
Muhammad:11 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَأَنَّ الْكَافِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَى لَهُمْ
dhālika bi-anna l-laha mawlā alladhīna āmanū wa-anna l-kāfirīna lā mawlā lahum
That (is) because Allah (is the) Protector (of) those who believe and that the disbelievers (there is) no protector for them

item.title: Muhammad:12
item.description:
Muhammad:12 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْأَنْعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَهُمْ
inna l-laha yud'khilu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru wa-alladhīna kafarū yatamattaʿūna wayakulūna kamā takulu l-anʿāmu wal-nāru mathwan lahum
Indeed Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds (to) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers but those who disbelieve they enjoy and eat as eat the cattle and the Fire (will be) an abode for them

item.title: Muhammad:13
item.description:
Muhammad:13 - وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِنْ قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
waka-ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatī akhrajatka ahlaknāhum falā nāṣira lahum
And how many of a town which (was) stronger (in) strength than your town which has driven you out We destroyed them so no helper for them

item.title: Muhammad:14
item.description:
Muhammad:14 - أَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلَى بَيِّنَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ كَمَنْ زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ
afaman kāna ʿalā bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sūu ʿamalihi wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum
Then is (he) who is on a clear proof from his Lord like (he) who is made attractive to him (the) evil (of) his deeds while they follow their desires

item.title: Muhammad:15
item.description:
Muhammad:15 - مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ غَيْرِ ءَاسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ خَمْرٍ لَذَّةٍ لِلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوْۤا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ
mathalu l-janati allatī wuʿida l-mutaqūna fīhā anhārun min māin ghayri āsinin wa-anhārun min labanin lam yataghayyar ṭaʿmuhu wa-anhārun min khamrin ladhatin lilshāribīna wa-anhārun min ʿasalin muṣaffan walahum fīhā min kulli l-thamarāti wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khālidun fī l-nāri wasuqū māan ḥamīman faqaṭṭaʿa amʿāahum
A parable (of) Paradise which is promised (to) the righteous Therein (are) rivers of water not polluted and rivers of milk not changes its taste and rivers of wine delicious for (the) drinkers and rivers of honey purified and for them therein of all fruits and forgiveness from their Lord like he who like he who (will) abide forever in the Fire and they will be given to drink water boiling so it cuts into pieces their intestines

item.title: Muhammad:16
item.description:
Muhammad:16 - وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتّٰی إِذَا خَرَجُوْۤا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًا اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ
wamin'hum man yastamiʿu ilayka ḥattā idhā kharajū min ʿindika qālū lilladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma mādhā qāla ānifan ulāika alladhīna ṭabaʿa l-lahu ʿalā qulūbihim wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum
And among them (are some) who listen to you until when they depart from you they say to those who were given the knowledge What (has) he said just now Those (are) the ones Allah has set a seal Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and they follow their desires

item.title: Muhammad:17
item.description:
Muhammad:17 - وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ
wa-alladhīna ih'tadaw zādahum hudan waātāhum taqwāhum
And those who accept guidance He increases them (in) guidance and gives them their righteousness

item.title: Muhammad:18
item.description:
Muhammad:18 - فَهَلْ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً فَقَدْ جَاءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا فَأَنَّى لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ
fahal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jāa ashrāṭuhā fa-annā lahum idhā jāathum dhik'rāhum
Then do they wait but (for) the Hour that it should come to them suddenly But indeed have come its indications Then how to them when has come to them their reminder

item.title: Muhammad:19
item.description:
Muhammad:19 - فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ
fa-iʿ'lam annahu lā ilāha illā l-lahu wa-is'taghfir lidhanbika walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-lahu yaʿlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwākum
So know that [He] (there is) no god but Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and the believing women And Allah knows your movement and your resting places

item.title: Muhammad:20
item.description:
Muhammad:20 - وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَإِذَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِيِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ فَأَوْلَى لَهُمْ wayaqūlu alladhīna āmanū lawlā nuzzilat sūratun fa-idhā unzilat sūratun muḥ'kamatun wadhukira fīhā l-qitālu ra-ayta alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun yanẓurūna ilayka naẓara l-maghshiyi ʿalayhi mina l-mawti fa-awlā lahum And say those who believe Why not has been revealed a Surah But when is revealed a Surah precise and is mentioned in it the fighting you see those who in their hearts (is) a disease looking at you a look (of) one fainting (of) one fainting from the death But more appropriate for them
  • [1] That is, the hypocrites.

item.title: Muhammad:21
item.description:
Muhammad:21 - طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَعْرُوفٌ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوْۤا اللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ ṭāʿatun waqawlun maʿrūfun fa-idhā ʿazama l-amru falaw ṣadaqū l-laha lakāna khayran lahum (Is) obedience and a word kind And when (is) determined the matter then if they had been true (to) Allah surely, it would have been better for them
  • [1] Ellipsis; the omitted phrase is 'are all that is expected of you.'

item.title: Muhammad:22
item.description:
Muhammad:22 - فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوْۤا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ
fahal ʿasaytum in tawallaytum an tuf'sidū fī l-arḍi watuqaṭṭiʿū arḥāmakum
Then would you perhaps if you are given authority that you cause corruption in the earth and cut off your ties of kinship

item.title: Muhammad:23
item.description:
Muhammad:23 - اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ
ulāika alladhīna laʿanahumu l-lahu fa-aṣammahum wa-aʿmā abṣārahum
Those (are) the ones Allah has cursed them Allah has cursed them so He made them deaf and blinded their vision

item.title: Muhammad:24
item.description:
Muhammad:24 - أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا
afalā yatadabbarūna l-qur'āna am ʿalā qulūbin aqfāluhā
Then do not they ponder (over) the Quran or upon (their) hearts (are) locks

item.title: Muhammad:25
item.description:
Muhammad:25 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّوْۤا عَلَى أَدْبَارِهِمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى الشَّيْطَانُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَى لَهُمْ inna alladhīna ir'taddū ʿalā adbārihim min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā l-shayṭānu sawwala lahum wa-amlā lahum Indeed those who return on their backs after after what (has) become clear to them (of) the guidance Shaitaan enticed [for] them and prolonged hope for them
  • [1] Or 'and He [i.e. Allah] gave them respite.'

item.title: Muhammad:26
item.description:
Muhammad:26 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوْۤا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ
dhālika bi-annahum qālū lilladhīna karihū mā nazzala l-lahu sanuṭīʿukum fī baʿḍi l-amri wal-lahu yaʿlamu is'rārahum
That (is) because they [they] said to those who hate what Allah has revealed Allah has revealed We will obey you in part (of) the matter But Allah knows their secrets

item.title: Muhammad:27
item.description:
Muhammad:27 - فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ
fakayfa idhā tawaffathumu l-malāikatu yaḍribūna wujūhahum wa-adbārahum
Then how when take them in death the Angels striking their faces and their backs

item.title: Muhammad:28
item.description:
Muhammad:28 - ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوْۤا مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهُوْۤا رِضْوَانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
dhālika bi-annahumu ittabaʿū mā askhaṭa l-laha wakarihū riḍ'wānahu fa-aḥbaṭa aʿmālahum
That (is) because they followed what angered Allah and hated His pleasure so He made worthless their deeds

item.title: Muhammad:29
item.description:
Muhammad:29 - أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَنْ لَنْ يُخْرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْ
am ḥasiba alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun an lan yukh'rija l-lahu aḍghānahum
Or do think those who in their hearts (is) a disease that never will Allah bring forth will Allah bring forth their hatred

item.title: Muhammad:30
item.description:
Muhammad:30 - وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَرَيْنَاكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِي لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَالَكُمْ walaw nashāu la-araynākahum falaʿaraftahum bisīmāhum walataʿrifannahum fī laḥni l-qawli wal-lahu yaʿlamu aʿmālakum And if We willed surely, We could show them to you and you would know them by their marks but surely, you will know them by (the) tone (of their) speech And Allah knows your deeds
  • [1] That is, the hypocrites.

item.title: Muhammad:31
item.description:
Muhammad:31 - وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّٰی نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا أَخْبَارَكُمْ
walanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum wal-ṣābirīna wanabluwā akhbārakum
And surely We will test you until We make evident those who strive among you and the patient ones and We will test your affairs

item.title: Muhammad:32
item.description:
Muhammad:32 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَشَاقُّوْۤا الرَّسُولَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى لَنْ يَضُرُّوْۤا اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi washāqqū l-rasūla min baʿdi mā tabayyana lahumu l-hudā lan yaḍurrū l-laha shayan wasayuḥ'biṭu aʿmālahum
Indeed those who disbelieve and turn away from (the) way of Allah (the) way of Allah and oppose the Messenger after after what (has been) made clear to them the guidance never will they harm Allah (in) anything and He will make worthless their deeds

item.title: Muhammad:33
item.description:
Muhammad:33 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوْۤا أَعْمَالَكُمْ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū aṭīʿū l-laha wa-aṭīʿū l-rasūla walā tub'ṭilū aʿmālakum
O you those who(believe) believe Obey Allah and obey the Messenger and (do) not make vain your deeds

item.title: Muhammad:34
item.description:
Muhammad:34 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوْۤا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ
inna alladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi thumma mātū wahum kuffārun falan yaghfira l-lahu lahum
Indeed those who disbelieve and turn away from (the) way (of) Allah then died while they (were) disbelievers never will Allah forgive will Allah forgive them

item.title: Muhammad:35
item.description:
Muhammad:35 - فَلَا تَهِنُوْۤا وَتَدْعُوْۤا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَنْ يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ
falā tahinū watadʿū ilā l-salmi wa-antumu l-aʿlawna wal-lahu maʿakum walan yatirakum aʿmālakum
So (do) not weaken and call for peace while you (are) superior and Allah (is) with you and never will deprive you (of) your deeds

item.title: Muhammad:36
item.description:
Muhammad:36 - إِنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَإِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَتَتَّقُوا يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْءَلْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ
innamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wa-in tu'minū watattaqū yu'tikum ujūrakum walā yasalkum amwālakum
Only the life (of) the world (is) play and amusement And if you believe and fear (Allah) He will give you your rewards and not will ask you (for) your wealth

item.title: Muhammad:37
item.description:
Muhammad:37 - إِنْ يَسْءَلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوْۤا وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَانَكُمْ
in yasalkumūhā fayuḥ'fikum tabkhalū wayukh'rij aḍghānakum
If He were to ask you for it and press you you will withhold and He will bring forth your hatred

item.title: Muhammad:38
item.description:
Muhammad:38 - هَاأَنْتُمْ هَؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنْفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يَبْخَلُ وَمَنْ يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَاللَّهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوْۤا أَمْثَالَكُمْ
hāantum hāulāi tud'ʿawna litunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fa-innamā yabkhalu ʿan nafsihi wal-lahu l-ghaniyu wa-antumu l-fuqarāu wa-in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma lā yakūnū amthālakum
Here you are these called to spend in (the) way (of) Allah but among you (are some) who withhold and whoever withholds then only he withholds from himself But Allah (is) Free of need while you (are) the needy And if you turn away He will replace you (with) a people other than you then not they will be (the) likes of you

item.title: 48. الفتح (Al-Fath)
item.description:
The surah that opens by acclaiming the manifest Victory or Triumph of peace that God accorded His Prophet in the truce he agreed to with the Meccans at a place called Ḥudaybiyyah. It takes its name from verse 1 wherein "victory" (fatḥ) is mentioned. The surah makes reference to the occasion when the Prophet had a vision that he and his followers would be performing pilgrimage to Mecca (verse 27). They set out, but the Meccans decided to bar them at Ḥudaybiyyah from reaching the town and sent emissaries to have discussions with the Prophet. In the end the Prophet signed a treaty that he and the believers would not enter Mecca that year, but would do so the next year. Seeing the long-term significance of this treaty, in the interests of peace he agreed to a truce often years during which time, if any Meccan went over to his side, he would return him to the Meccans, but if any of his people went over to the Meccans, they would not return them. Throughout the surah the Prophet is assured that this treaty that God has given him is a great breakthrough (verse 1ff., verse 18 ff. and verse 27). The believers are reassured that their self-restraint and obedience to the Prophet were inspired by God (verse 4 ff. and verse 24 ff.). The surah condemns both the hypocrites in Medina (verse 6) and the idolaters of Mecca (verse 6 and verse 26) and closes by praising the believers (verse 29).
The surah is also known as Conquest, The Manifest Triumph, Triumph

48:1
إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا
innā fataḥnā laka fatḥan mubīnan
Indeed We have given victory to you a victory clear

48:2
لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
liyaghfira laka l-lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbika wamā ta-akhara wayutimma niʿ'matahu ʿalayka wayahdiyaka ṣirāṭan mus'taqīman
That may forgive for you Allah what preceded of your sins and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you (to) a Path Straight

48:3
وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
wayanṣuraka l-lahu naṣran ʿazīzan
And Allah may help you And Allah may help you (with) a help mighty

item.title: Al-Fath:1
item.description:
Al-Fath:1 - إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا innā fataḥnā laka fatḥan mubīnan Indeed We have given victory to you a victory clear
  • [1] Or 'Indeed We have initiated for you a clear breakthrough.'

item.title: Al-Fath:2
item.description:
Al-Fath:2 - لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
liyaghfira laka l-lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbika wamā ta-akhara wayutimma niʿ'matahu ʿalayka wayahdiyaka ṣirāṭan mus'taqīman
That may forgive for you Allah what preceded of your sins and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you (to) a Path Straight

item.title: Al-Fath:3
item.description:
Al-Fath:3 - وَيَنْصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
wayanṣuraka l-lahu naṣran ʿazīzan
And Allah may help you And Allah may help you (with) a help mighty

item.title: Al-Fath:4
item.description:
Al-Fath:4 - هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيمَانًا مَعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
huwa alladhī anzala l-sakīnata fī qulūbi l-mu'minīna liyazdādū īmānan maʿa īmānihim walillahi junūdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakāna l-lahu ʿalīman ḥakīman
He (is) the One Who sent down [the] tranquility in(to) (the) hearts (of) the believers that they may increase (in) faith with their faith And for Allah (are the) hosts (of) the heavens and the earth and Allah and Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: Al-Fath:5
item.description:
Al-Fath:5 - لِيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
liyud'khila l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wayukaffira ʿanhum sayyiātihim wakāna dhālika ʿinda l-lahi fawzan ʿaẓīman
That He may admit the believing men and the believing women (to) Gardens flow from underneath them the rivers (to) abide forever therein and (to) remove from them their misdeeds and is that with Allah a success great

item.title: Al-Fath:6
item.description:
Al-Fath:6 - وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ الظَّانِّينَ بِاللَّهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ عَلَيْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ وَسَاءَتْ مَصِيرًا
wayuʿadhiba l-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-mush'rikīna wal-mush'rikāti l-ẓānīna bil-lahi ẓanna l-sawi ʿalayhim dāiratu l-sawi waghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim walaʿanahum wa-aʿadda lahum jahannama wasāat maṣīran
And He (may) punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women and the polytheist men and the polytheist women who assume about Allah an assumption evil Upon them (is) a turn (of) evil and Allah's wrath (is) and Allah's wrath (is) upon them and He has cursed them and prepared for them Hell and evil (is the) destination

item.title: Al-Fath:7
item.description:
Al-Fath:7 - وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
walillahi junūdu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakāna l-lahu ʿazīzan ḥakīman
And for Allah (are the) hosts (of) the heavens and the earth and Allah and Allah (is) All-Mighty All-Wise

item.title: Al-Fath:8
item.description:
Al-Fath:8 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
innā arsalnāka shāhidan wamubashiran wanadhīran
Indeed, We [We] have sent you (as) a witness and (as) a bearer of glad tidings and (as) a warner

item.title: Al-Fath:9
item.description:
Al-Fath:9 - لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watuʿazzirūhu watuwaqqirūhu watusabbiḥūhu buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan
That you may believe in Allah and His Messenger and (may) honor him and respect him and glorify Him morning and evening

item.title: Al-Fath:10
item.description:
Al-Fath:10 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ اللَّهَ يَدُ اللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَمَنْ نَكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنْكُثُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَوْفَى بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
inna alladhīna yubāyiʿūnaka innamā yubāyiʿūna l-laha yadu l-lahi fawqa aydīhim faman nakatha fa-innamā yankuthu ʿalā nafsihi waman awfā bimā ʿāhada ʿalayhu l-laha fasayu'tīhi ajran ʿaẓīman
Indeed those who pledge allegiance to you only they pledge allegiance (to) Allah (The) Hand (of) Allah (is) over their hands Then whoever breaks (his oath) then only he breaks against himself and whoever fulfils what he has covenanted (with) Allah soon He will give him a reward great

item.title: Al-Fath:11
item.description:
Al-Fath:11 - سَيَقُولُ لَكَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَا أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ قُلْ فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًا بَلْ كَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
sayaqūlu laka l-mukhalafūna mina l-aʿrābi shaghalatnā amwālunā wa-ahlūnā fa-is'taghfir lanā yaqūlūna bi-alsinatihim mā laysa fī qulūbihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina l-lahi shayan in arāda bikum ḍarran aw arāda bikum nafʿan bal kāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīran
Will say to you those who remained behind of the Bedouins Kept us busy our properties and our families so ask forgiveness for us They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts Say Then who has power for you against Allah (in) anything if He intends for you harm or He intends for you a benefit Nay is Allah of what you do All-Aware

item.title: Al-Fath:12
item.description:
Al-Fath:12 - بَلْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَنْقَلِبَ الرَّسُولُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَى أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنْتُمْ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا
bal ẓanantum an lan yanqaliba l-rasūlu wal-mu'minūna ilā ahlīhim abadan wazuyyina dhālika fī qulūbikum waẓanantum ẓanna l-sawi wakuntum qawman būran
Nay you thought that (would) never return the Messenger and the believers to their families ever that was made fair-seeming that was made fair-seeming in your hearts And you assumed an assumption evil and you became a people ruined

item.title: Al-Fath:13
item.description:
Al-Fath:13 - وَمَنْ لَمْ يُؤْمِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَعِيرًا
waman lam yu'min bil-lahi warasūlihi fa-innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna saʿīran
And whoever (has) not believed (has) not believed in Allah and His Messenger then indeed, We [We] have prepared for the disbelievers a Blazing Fire

item.title: Al-Fath:14
item.description:
Al-Fath:14 - وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا
walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yaghfiru liman yashāu wayuʿadhibu man yashāu wakāna l-lahu ghafūran raḥīman
And for Allah (is the) kingdom (of) the heavens and the earth He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills And is Allah Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Fath:15
item.description:
Al-Fath:15 - سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا انْطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَى مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلَامَ اللَّهِ قُلْ لَنْ تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَلِكُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا بَلْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
sayaqūlu l-mukhalafūna idhā inṭalaqtum ilā maghānima litakhudhūhā dharūnā nattabiʿ'kum yurīdūna an yubaddilū kalāma l-lahi qul lan tattabiʿūnā kadhālikum qāla l-lahu min qablu fasayaqūlūna bal taḥsudūnanā bal kānū lā yafqahūna illā qalīlan
