Will say those who remained behind when you set forth towards (the) spoils of war to take it Allow us (to) follow you They wish to change (the) Words (of) Allah Say Never will you follow us Thus Allah said Allah said before before Then they will say Nay you envy us Nay they were not understanding except a little

item.title: Al-Fath:16
item.description:
Al-Fath:16 - قُلْ لِلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى قَوْمٍ أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ فَإِنْ تُطِيعُوْۤا يُؤْتِكُمُ اللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا وَإِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
qul lil'mukhallafīna mina l-aʿrābi satud'ʿawna ilā qawmin ulī basin shadīdin tuqātilūnahum aw yus'limūna fa-in tuṭīʿū yu'tikumu l-lahu ajran ḥasanan wa-in tatawallaw kamā tawallaytum min qablu yuʿadhib'kum ʿadhāban alīman
Say to those who remained behind of the Bedouins You will be called to a people possessors of military might possessors of military might great you will fight them or they will submit Then if you obey Allah will give you Allah will give you a reward good but if you turn away as you turned away before before He will punish you (with) a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Fath:17
item.description:
Al-Fath:17 - لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَى حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
laysa ʿalā l-aʿmā ḥarajun walā ʿalā l-aʿraji ḥarajun walā ʿalā l-marīḍi ḥarajun waman yuṭiʿi l-laha warasūlahu yud'khil'hu jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru waman yatawalla yuʿadhib'hu ʿadhāban alīman
Not is upon the blind any blame and not on the lame any blame and not on the sick any blame And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger He will admit him (to) Gardens flow from underneath them the rivers but whoever turns away He will punish him (with) a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Fath:18
item.description:
Al-Fath:18 - لَقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنْزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
laqad raḍiya l-lahu ʿani l-mu'minīna idh yubāyiʿūnaka taḥta l-shajarati faʿalima mā fī qulūbihim fa-anzala l-sakīnata ʿalayhim wa-athābahum fatḥan qarīban
Certainly Allah was pleased Allah was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree and He knew what (was) in their hearts so He sent down the tranquility upon them and rewarded them (with) a victory near

item.title: Al-Fath:19
item.description:
Al-Fath:19 - وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
wamaghānima kathīratan yakhudhūnahā wakāna l-lahu ʿazīzan ḥakīman
And spoils of war much that they will take and is Allah All-Mighty All-Wise

item.title: Al-Fath:20
item.description:
Al-Fath:20 - وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنْكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ اٰیَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
waʿadakumu l-lahu maghānima kathīratan takhudhūnahā faʿajjala lakum hādhihi wakaffa aydiya l-nāsi ʿankum walitakūna āyatan lil'mu'minīna wayahdiyakum ṣirāṭan mus'taqīman
Allah has promised you Allah has promised you spoils of war much that you will take it and He has hastened for you this and has withheld (the) hands (of) the people from you that it may be a sign for the believers and He may guide you (to the) Path Straight

item.title: Al-Fath:21
item.description:
Al-Fath:21 - وَأُخْرٰی لَمْ تَقْدِرُوْۤا عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا
wa-ukh'rā lam taqdirū ʿalayhā qad aḥāṭa l-lahu bihā wakāna l-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin qadīran
And others not you had power over them surely Allah encompassed Allah encompassed them and is Allah over all things All-Powerful

item.title: Al-Fath:22
item.description:
Al-Fath:22 - وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
walaw qātalakumu alladhīna kafarū lawallawū l-adbāra thumma lā yajidūna waliyyan walā naṣīran
And if fight you those who disbelieve surely they would turn the backs Then not they would find any protector and not any helper

item.title: Al-Fath:23
item.description:
Al-Fath:23 - سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
sunnata l-lahi allatī qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati l-lahi tabdīlan
(The established) way (of) Allah which passed away passed away before before and never you will find in (the) way of Allah in (the) way of Allah any change

item.title: Al-Fath:24
item.description:
Al-Fath:24 - وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
wahuwa alladhī kaffa aydiyahum ʿankum wa-aydiyakum ʿanhum bibaṭni makkata min baʿdi an aẓfarakum ʿalayhim wakāna l-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīran
And He (is) the One Who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within Makkah after after that He gave you victory over them And is Allah of what you do All-Seer

item.title: Al-Fath:25
item.description:
Al-Fath:25 - هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَنْ يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُؤْمِنَاتٌ لَمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَنْ تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُمْ مِنْهُمْ مَعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لِيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا humu alladhīna kafarū waṣaddūkum ʿani l-masjidi l-ḥarāmi wal-hadya maʿkūfan an yablugha maḥillahu walawlā rijālun mu'minūna wanisāon mu'minātun lam taʿlamūhum an taṭaūhum fatuṣībakum min'hum maʿarratun bighayri ʿil'min liyud'khila l-lahu fī raḥmatihi man yashāu law tazayyalū laʿadhabnā alladhīna kafarū min'hum ʿadhāban alīman They (are) those who disbelieved and hindered you from Al-Masjid Al-Haraam Al-Masjid Al-Haraam while the offering (was) prevented from reaching its place (of sacrifice) And if not (for) men believing and women believing not you knew them that you may trample them and would befall you from them any harm without knowledge That Allah may admit That Allah may admit to His Mercy whom He wills If they had been apart surely, We would have punished those who disbelieved among them (with) a punishment painful
  • [1] Ellipsis; the omitted phrase is 'We would have given you a free hand against them.'

item.title: Al-Fath:26
item.description:
Al-Fath:26 - إِذْ جَعَلَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَى وَكَانُوْۤا أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا
idh jaʿala alladhīna kafarū fī qulūbihimu l-ḥamiyata ḥamiyyata l-jāhiliyati fa-anzala l-lahu sakīnatahu ʿalā rasūlihi waʿalā l-mu'minīna wa-alzamahum kalimata l-taqwā wakānū aḥaqqa bihā wa-ahlahā wakāna l-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīman
When had put those who disbelieved in their hearts disdain (the) disdain (of the time of) ignorance Then Allah sent down Then Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and made them adhere (to the) word (of) righteousness and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it And is Allah of every thing All-Knower

item.title: Al-Fath:27
item.description:
Al-Fath:27 - لَقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّءْيَا بِالْحَقِّ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوْۤا فَجَعَلَ مِنْ دُونِ ذٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
laqad ṣadaqa l-lahu rasūlahu l-ru'yā bil-ḥaqi latadkhulunna l-masjida l-ḥarāma in shāa l-lahu āminīna muḥalliqīna ruūsakum wamuqaṣṣirīna lā takhāfūna faʿalima mā lam taʿlamū fajaʿala min dūni dhālika fatḥan qarīban
Certainly Allah has fulfilled Allah has fulfilled His Messenger's vision in truth Surely, you will enter Al-Masjid Al-Haraam Al-Masjid Al-Haraam if Allah wills Allah wills secure having shaved your heads and shortened not fearing But He knew what not you knew and He made besides besides that a victory near

item.title: Al-Fath:28
item.description:
Al-Fath:28 - هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
huwa alladhī arsala rasūlahu bil-hudā wadīni l-ḥaqi liyuẓ'hirahu ʿalā l-dīni kullihi wakafā bil-lahi shahīdan
He (is) the One Who (has) sent His Messenger with guidance and (the) religion the true that He (may) make it prevail over the religions all And sufficient is Allah (as) a Witness

item.title: Al-Fath:29
item.description:
Al-Fath:29 - مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْءَهُ فَءَازَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَى عَلَى سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
muḥammadun rasūlu l-lahi wa-alladhīna maʿahu ashiddāu ʿalā l-kufāri ruḥamāu baynahum tarāhum rukkaʿan sujjadan yabtaghūna faḍlan mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānan sīmāhum fī wujūhihim min athari l-sujūdi dhālika mathaluhum fī l-tawrāti wamathaluhum fī l-injīli kazarʿin akhraja shaṭahu faāzarahu fa-is'taghlaẓa fa-is'tawā ʿalā sūqihi yuʿ'jibu l-zurāʿa liyaghīẓa bihimu l-kufāra waʿada l-lahu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti min'hum maghfiratan wa-ajran ʿaẓīman
Muhammad (is the) Messenger of Allah and those who (are) with him (are) firm against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves You see them bowing and prostrating seeking Bounty from Allah from Allah and pleasure Their mark (is) on their faces from (the) trace (of) the prostration That (is) their similitude in the Taurah And their similitude in the Injeel (is) like a seed (which) sends forth its shoot then strengthens it then it becomes thick and it stands upon its stem delighting the sowers that He (may) enrage by them the disbelievers Allah has promised Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a reward great

item.title: 49. الحجرات (Al-Hujuraat)
item.description:
The surah that criticized as ill-mannered and uncouth those who would stand behind the Apartments of the Prophet's wives and call him forth for discourse with raised voices. It takes its name from the word "apartments" (ḥujurāt) in verse 4. The surah guides the believers on how to behave with proper respect towards their leader (verse 1 ff.), and with mutual respect and trust towards each other (verse 9 ff.). It stresses the unity of mankind and God's intention that people should live together in harmony (verse 13). It criticizes the desert Arabs for their presumptuous attitude to their faith and to God (verse 14 ff.).
The surah is also known as The (Inner) Apartments, The Chambers, The Inner Apartments, The Private Quarters, The Private Rooms

49:1
يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuqaddimū bayna yadayi l-lahi warasūlihi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun
O you those who(believe) believe (Do) not put (yourselves) forward before Allah before Allah before Allah and His Messenger and fear Allah and fear Allah Indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Knower

49:2
يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَرْفَعُوْۤا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوْۤا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَنْ تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tarfaʿū aṣwātakum fawqa ṣawti l-nabiyi walā tajharū lahu bil-qawli kajahri baʿḍikum libaʿḍin an taḥbaṭa aʿmālukum wa-antum lā tashʿurūna
O you those who(believe) believe (Do) not raise your voices above (the) voice (of) the Prophet and (do) not be loud to him in speech like (the) loudness (of) some of you to others lest become worthless your deeds while you (do) not perceive

49:3
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
inna alladhīna yaghuḍḍūna aṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ulāika alladhīna im'taḥana l-lahu qulūbahum lilttaqwā lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun
Indeed those who lower their voices (in) presence (of the) Messenger of Allah (of the) Messenger of Allah those (are) the ones Allah has tested Allah has tested their hearts for righteousness For them (is) forgiveness and a reward great

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:1
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:1 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِیْمٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tuqaddimū bayna yadayi l-lahi warasūlihi wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha samīʿun ʿalīmun

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:2
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:2 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَرْفَعُوْۤا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوْۤا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَنْ تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

O you those who(believe) believe (Do) not raise your voices above (the) voice (of) the Prophet and (do) not be loud to him in speech like (the) loudness (of) some of you to others lest become worthless your deeds while you (do) not perceive

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:3
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:3 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَى لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
inna alladhīna yaghuḍḍūna aṣwātahum ʿinda rasūli l-lahi ulāika alladhīna im'taḥana l-lahu qulūbahum lilttaqwā lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun ʿaẓīmun
Indeed those who lower their voices (in) presence (of the) Messenger of Allah (of the) Messenger of Allah those (are) the ones Allah has tested Allah has tested their hearts for righteousness For them (is) forgiveness and a reward great

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:4
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:4 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
inna alladhīna yunādūnaka min warāi l-ḥujurāti aktharuhum lā yaʿqilūna
Indeed those who call you from behind the private chambers most of them (do) not understand

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:5
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:5 - وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوْۤا حَتّٰی تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
walaw annahum ṣabarū ḥattā takhruja ilayhim lakāna khayran lahum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun
And if they had been patient until you came out to them certainly it would be better for them And Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:6
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:6 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوْۤا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū in jāakum fāsiqun binaba-in fatabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bijahālatin fatuṣ'biḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīna
O you those who(believe) believe If comes to you a wicked person with information investigate lest you harm a people in ignorance then you become over what you have done regretful

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:7
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:7 - وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ
wa-iʿ'lamū anna fīkum rasūla l-lahi law yuṭīʿukum fī kathīrin mina l-amri laʿanittum walākinna l-laha ḥabbaba ilaykumu l-īmāna wazayyanahu fī qulūbikum wakarraha ilaykumu l-kuf'ra wal-fusūqa wal-ʿiṣ'yāna ulāika humu l-rāshidūna
And know that among you (is the) Messenger of Allah (is the) Messenger of Allah If he were to obey you in much of the matter surely you would be in difficulty but Allah has endeared to you the Faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief and defiance and disobedience Those (are) they the guided ones

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:8
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:8 - فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ حَكِیْمٌ۠
faḍlan mina l-lahi waniʿ'matan wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun
A Bounty from Allah from Allah and favor And Allah (is) All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:9
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:9 - وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنْ بَغَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرٰی فَقَاتِلُوْۤا الَّتِي تَبْغِي حَتّٰی تَفِيءَ إِلَى أَمْرِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ فَاءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ
wa-in ṭāifatāni mina l-mu'minīna iq'tatalū fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā fa-in baghat iḥ'dāhumā ʿalā l-ukh'rā faqātilū allatī tabghī ḥattā tafīa ilā amri l-lahi fa-in fāat fa-aṣliḥū baynahumā bil-ʿadli wa-aqsiṭū inna l-laha yuḥibbu l-muq'siṭīna
And if two parties among the believers fight then make peace between both of them But if oppresses one of them on the other then fight one which oppresses until it returns to (the) command (of) Allah Then if it returns then make peace between them with justice and act justly Indeed Allah loves those who act justly

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:10
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:10 - إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
innamā l-mu'minūna ikh'watun fa-aṣliḥū bayna akhawaykum wa-ittaqū l-laha laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna
Only the believers (are) brothers so make peace between your brothers and fear Allah and fear Allah so that you may receive mercy

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:11
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:11 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِنْ قَوْمٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُونُوْۤا خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَاءٌ مِنْ نِسَاءٍ عَسٰۤی أَنْ يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَتُبْ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā yaskhar qawmun min qawmin ʿasā an yakūnū khayran min'hum walā nisāon min nisāin ʿasā an yakunna khayran min'hunna walā talmizū anfusakum walā tanābazū bil-alqābi bi'sa l-s'mu l-fusūqu baʿda l-īmāni waman lam yatub fa-ulāika humu l-ẓālimūna
O you those who(believe) believe (Let) not ridicule a people of (another) people perhaps that they may be better than them and (let) not women of (other) women perhaps that they may be better than them And (do) not insult yourselves and (do) not call each other by nicknames Wretched is the name (of) disobedience after the faith And whoever (does) not repent then those they (are) the wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:12
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:12 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَبْ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَحِيمٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ij'tanibū kathīran mina l-ẓani inna baʿḍa l-ẓani ith'mun walā tajassasū walā yaghtab baʿḍukum baʿḍan ayuḥibbu aḥadukum an yakula laḥma akhīhi maytan fakarih'tumūhu wa-ittaqū l-laha inna l-laha tawwābun raḥīmun
O you those who(believe) believe Avoid much of the assumption Indeed some assumption (is) sin And (do) not spy and (do) not backbite some of you (to) others Would like one of you to eat (the) flesh (of) his brother dead Nay, you would hate it And fear Allah And fear Allah indeed Allah (is) Oft-Returning Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:13
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:13 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ وَأُنْثَى وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِیْمٌ خَبِيرٌ yāayyuhā l-nāsu innā khalaqnākum min dhakarin wa-unthā wajaʿalnākum shuʿūban waqabāila litaʿārafū inna akramakum ʿinda l-lahi atqākum inna l-laha ʿalīmun khabīrun O mankind O mankind Indeed, We created you from a male and a female and We made you nations and tribes that you may know one another Indeed (the) most noble of you near Allah (is the) most righteous of you Indeed Allah (is) All-Knower All-Aware
  • [1] Or 'the most honoured.'

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:14
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:14 - قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ اٰمَنَّا قُلْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوْۤا وَلَكِنْ قُولُوْۤا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْاِیْمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَإِنْ تُطِيعُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُمْ مِنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ qālati l-aʿrābu āmannā qul lam tu'minū walākin qūlū aslamnā walammā yadkhuli l-īmānu fī qulūbikum wa-in tuṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu lā yalit'kum min aʿmālikum shayan inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun Say the Bedouins We believe Say Not you believe but say We have submitted and has not yet entered the faith in your hearts But if you obey Allah and His Messenger not He will deprive you of your deeds anything Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful
  • [1] Or 'We have submitted.'

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:15
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:15 - إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوْۤا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصَّادِقُونَ innamā l-mu'minūna alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warasūlihi thumma lam yartābū wajāhadū bi-amwālihim wa-anfusihim fī sabīli l-lahi ulāika humu l-ṣādiqūna Only the believers (are) those who believe in Allah and His Messenger then (do) not doubt but strive with their wealth and their lives in (the) way (of) Allah Those they (are) the truthful
  • [1] Or 'the sincere.'

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:16
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:16 - قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ اللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
qul atuʿallimūna l-laha bidīnikum wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wal-lahu bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
Say Will you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows what (is) in the heavens and what (is) in the earth And Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:17
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:17 - يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوْۤا قُلْ لَا تَمُنُّوْۤا عَلَيَّ إِسْلَامَكُمْ بَلِ اللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَاكُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ yamunnūna ʿalayka an aslamū qul lā tamunnū ʿalayya is'lāmakum bali l-lahu yamunnu ʿalaykum an hadākum lil'īmāni in kuntum ṣādiqīna They consider (it) a favor to you that they have accepted Islam Say (Do) not consider a favor on me your Islam Nay Allah has conferred a favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith if you are truthful
  • [1] That is, should you be sincere in your claim of having embraced Islam.

item.title: Al-Hujuraat:18
item.description:
Al-Hujuraat:18 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
inna l-laha yaʿlamu ghayba l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu baṣīrun bimā taʿmalūna
Indeed Allah knows (the) unseen (of) the heavens and the earth And Allah (is) All-Seer of what you do

item.title: 50. ق (Qaaf)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the single discrete Arabic letter Qāf. It deals predominantly with the Resurrection and the Day of Judgement. Reference is made to previous generations of disbelievers (verse 12 ff.), both to warn the disbelievers in Mecca and to reassure the Prophet. Creation is cited as an indication of God's ability to bring the dead to life again (verse 3 ff.), and emphasis is placed on the powerlessness of man on the Day of Resurrection (verse 20). The surah both opens and closes with mention of the Quran.

50:1
ق وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيدِ
qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīdi
Qaf By the Quran the Glorious

50:2
بَلْ عَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajībun
Nay they wonder that has come to them a warner from them So say the disbelievers This (is) a thing amazing

50:3
أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ
a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun
What! When we die and have become dust That (is) a return far

item.title: Qaaf:1
item.description:
Qaaf:1 - ق وَالْقُرْاٰنِ الْمَجِيدِ
qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīdi
Qaf By the Quran the Glorious

item.title: Qaaf:2
item.description:
Qaaf:2 - بَلْ عَجِبُوْۤا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajībun
Nay they wonder that has come to them a warner from them So say the disbelievers This (is) a thing amazing

item.title: Qaaf:3
item.description:
Qaaf:3 - أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ
a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun
What! When we die and have become dust That (is) a return far

item.title: Qaaf:4
item.description:
Qaaf:4 - قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓun Certainly We know what diminishes the earth of them and with Us (is) a Book guarded
  • [1] That is, from their bodies when they disintegrate after death.

item.title: Qaaf:5
item.description:
Qaaf:5 - بَلْ كَذَّبُوْۤا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ
bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marījin
Nay they denied the truth when it came (to) them so they (are) in a state confused

item.title: Qaaf:6
item.description:
Qaaf:6 - أَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوْۤا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوجٍ
afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūjin
Then do not they look at the sky above them how We structured it and adorned it and not for it any rifts

item.title: Qaaf:7
item.description:
Qaaf:7 - وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ
wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahījin
And the earth We have spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and We made to grow therein of every kind beautiful

item.title: Qaaf:8
item.description:
Qaaf:8 - تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرٰی لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ
tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībin
Giving insight and a reminder for every slave who turns

item.title: Qaaf:9
item.description:
Qaaf:9 - وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُبَارَكًا فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ
wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīdi
And We have sent down from the sky water blessed then We made to grow thereby gardens and grain (for) the harvest

item.title: Qaaf:10
item.description:
Qaaf:10 - وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ
wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdun
And the palms trees tall for it (are) layers arranged

item.title: Qaaf:11
item.description:
Qaaf:11 - رِزْقًا لِلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا كَذٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ
riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūju
A provision for the slaves and We give life therewith (to) a land dead Thus (will be) the coming forth

item.title: Qaaf:12
item.description:
Qaaf:12 - كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūdu Denied before them (the) people (of) Nuh and (the) companions (of) Ar-Raas and Thamud
  • [1] See (Q 25:38).

item.title: Qaaf:13
item.description:
Qaaf:13 - وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ
waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭin
And Aad and Firaun and (the) brothers (of) Lut

item.title: Qaaf:14
item.description:
Qaaf:14 - وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīdi And (the) companions (of) the wood and (the) people (of) Tubba All denied the Messengers so was fulfilled My Threat
  • [1] Cf. (Q 44:37).

item.title: Qaaf:15
item.description:
Qaaf:15 - أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdin
Were We then tired with the creation the first Nay they (are) in doubt about a creation new

item.title: Qaaf:16
item.description:
Qaaf:16 - وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīdi
And certainly We created man and We know what whispers to him his soul and We (are) nearer to him than (his) jugular vein (his) jugular vein

item.title: Qaaf:17
item.description:
Qaaf:17 - إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdun
When receive the two receivers on the right and on the left seated

item.title: Qaaf:18
item.description:
Qaaf:18 - مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdun
Not he utters any word but with him (is) an observer ready

item.title: Qaaf:19
item.description:
Qaaf:19 - وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīdu And will come (the) stupor (of) death in truth That (is) what you were from it avoiding
  • [1] Or 'when the agony of death arrives with the truth.'

item.title: Qaaf:20
item.description:
Qaaf:20 - وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ
wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīdi
And will be blown in the trumpet That (is the) Day (of) the Warning

item.title: Qaaf:21
item.description:
Qaaf:21 - وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdun
And will come every soul with it a driver and a witness

item.title: Qaaf:22
item.description:
Qaaf:22 - لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdun
Certainly you were in heedlessness of this So We have removed from you your cover so your sight today (is) sharp

item.title: Qaaf:23
item.description:
Qaaf:23 - وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdun
And (will) say his companion This (is) what (is) with me ready

item.title: Qaaf:24
item.description:
Qaaf:24 - أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdin
Throw in (to) Hell every disbeliever stubborn

item.title: Qaaf:25
item.description:
Qaaf:25 - مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُرِيبٍ mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībin Forbidder of good transgressor doubter
  • [1] Or 'grudging giver.'

item.title: Qaaf:26
item.description:
Qaaf:26 - اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ
alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīdi
Who made with Allah a god another so throw him in(to) the punishment the severe

item.title: Qaaf:27
item.description:
Qaaf:27 - قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdin Will say his companion Our Lord not I made him transgress but he was in error far
  • [1] That is, Satan.

item.title: Qaaf:28
item.description:
Qaaf:28 - قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيدِ
qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīdi
He will say (Do) not dispute (in) My presence and indeed I sent forth to you the Warning

item.title: Qaaf:29
item.description:
Qaaf:29 - مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ
mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi
Not will be changed the word with Me and not I Am unjust to My slaves

item.title: Qaaf:30
item.description:
Qaaf:30 - يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ
yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdin
(The) Day We will say to Hell Are you filled And it will say Are (there) any more

item.title: Qaaf:31
item.description:
Qaaf:31 - وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdin
And will be brought near the Paradise to the righteous not far

item.title: Qaaf:32
item.description:
Qaaf:32 - هَذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓin
This (is) what you were promised for everyone who turns (and) who keeps

item.title: Qaaf:33
item.description:
Qaaf:33 - مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ
man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībin
Who feared the Most Gracious in the unseen and came with a heart returning

item.title: Qaaf:34
item.description:
Qaaf:34 - اُدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ
ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūdi
Enter it in peace That (is) a Day (of) Eternity

item.title: Qaaf:35
item.description:
Qaaf:35 - لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdun
For them whatever they wish therein and with Us (is) more

item.title: Qaaf:36
item.description:
Qaaf:36 - وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ
wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣin
And how many We destroyed before them of a generation they (were) stronger than them (in) power so they explored throughout the lands Is (there) any place of escape

item.title: Qaaf:37
item.description:
Qaaf:37 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَذِكْرٰی لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdun
Indeed in that surely, is a reminder for (one) who is for him a heart or (who) gives ear (who) gives ear while he (is) a witness

item.title: Qaaf:38
item.description:
Qaaf:38 - وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ
walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbin
And certainly We created the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between both of them in six periods and (did) not touch Us any fatigue

item.title: Qaaf:39
item.description:
Qaaf:39 - فَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ
fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūbi
So be patient over what they say and glorify (the) praise (of) your Lord before (the) rising (of) the sun and before the setting

item.title: Qaaf:40
item.description:
Qaaf:40 - وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ
wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūdi
And of the night glorify Him and after the prostration

item.title: Qaaf:41
item.description:
Qaaf:41 - وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībin
And listen (The) Day will call the caller from a place near

item.title: Qaaf:42
item.description:
Qaaf:42 - يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ
yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūji
(The) Day they will hear the Blast in truth That (is the) Day (of) coming forth

item.title: Qaaf:43
item.description:
Qaaf:43 - إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ
innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīru
Indeed, We We [We] give life and [We] cause death and to Us (is) the final return

item.title: Qaaf:44
item.description:
Qaaf:44 - يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīrun (The) Day will split the earth from them hurrying That (is) a gathering for Us easy
  • [1] Or 'resurrection.'

item.title: Qaaf:45
item.description:
Qaaf:45 - نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْءَانِ مَنْ يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīdi
We know best [of] what they say and not (are) you over them the one to compel But remind with the Quran whoever fears My threat

item.title: 51. الذاريات (Adh-Dhaariyat)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by The Scattering winds that stream far and wide bearing the rain clouds of His mercy. It takes its name from verse 1, which mentions the "scatterers" (dhāriyāt). The surah gives several signs of nature as proof of the Resurrection, among them the scattering winds. The disbelievers are reminded of the fate that befell previous rebellious generations and the Prophet is urged to carry on reminding.
The surah is also known as Scattering (Winds), The Dispersers, The Dispersing, The Scattering Winds, The Winds, The Winds That Scatter, Winnowing (Winds)

51:1
وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا
wal-dhāriyāti dharwan
By those scattering dispersing

51:2
فَالْحَامِلَاتِ وِقْرًا
fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran
And those carrying a load

51:3
فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا
fal-jāriyāti yus'ran
And those sailing (with) ease

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:1
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:1 - وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا
wal-dhāriyāti dharwan
By those scattering dispersing

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:2
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:2 - فَالْحَامِلَاتِ وِقْرًا
fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran
And those carrying a load

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:3
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:3 - فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا
fal-jāriyāti yus'ran
And those sailing (with) ease

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:4
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:4 - فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا
fal-muqasimāti amran
And those distributing Command

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:5
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:5 - إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun
Indeed, what you are promised (is) surely true

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:6
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:6 - وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَاقِعٌ wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿun And indeed the Judgment (is) surely to occur
  • [1] Or 'judgement.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:7
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:7 - وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuki By the heaven full of pathways
  • [1] Or, 'By the heaven full of tracks' (or pathways).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:8
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:8 - إِنَّكُمْ لَفِیْ قَوْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ
innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifin
Indeed, you (are) surely in a speech differing

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:9
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:9 - يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ yu'faku ʿanhu man ufika Deluded away from it (is he) who is deluded
  • [1] That is, from the Qur'ān. Or 'from him,' that is, from the Apostle of Allah.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:10
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:10 - قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ
qutila l-kharāṣūna
Cursed be the liars

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:11
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:11 - اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūna
Those who they (are) in flood (of) heedlessness

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:12
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:12 - يَسْءَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīni
They ask When (is the) Day (of) Judgment

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:13
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:13 - يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūna
A Day they over the Fire will be tried

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:14
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:14 - ذُوقُوْۤا فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna
Taste your trial This (is) what you were for it seeking to hasten

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:15
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:15 - إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin
Indeed the righteous (will be) in Gardens and springs

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:16
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:16 - ءَاخِذِينَ مَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīna
Taking what their Lord has given them their Lord has given them Indeed, they were before that good-doers

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:17
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:17 - كَانُوْۤا قَلِيلًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūna
They used to little of the night what sleep

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:18
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:18 - وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūna
And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:19
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:19 - وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ
wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi
And in their wealth (was the) right (of) those who asked and the deprived

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:20
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:20 - وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِلْمُوقِنِينَ
wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīna
And in the earth (are) signs for those who are certain

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:21
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:21 - وَفِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūna
And in yourselves Then will not you see

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:22
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:22 - وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūna
And in the heaven (is) your provision and what you are promised

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:23
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:23 - فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُونَ
fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūna
Then by (the) Lord (of) the heaven and the earth indeed, it (is) surely (the) truth (just) as what you speak

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:24
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:24 - هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ ضَيْفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ
hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīna
Has reached you (the) narration (of the) guests (of) Ibrahim the honored

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:25
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:25 - إِذْ دَخَلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْۤا سَلَامًا قَالَ سَلَامٌ قَوْمٌ مُنْكَرُونَ idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūna When they entered upon him and said Peace He said Peace a people unknown
  • [1] Cf. (Q 15:62).

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:26
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:26 - فَرَاغَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīnin
Then he went to his household and came with a calf fat

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:27
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:27 - فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūna
And he placed it near [to] them he said Will not you eat

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:28
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:28 - فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوْا لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin Then he felt from them a fear They said (Do) not fear and they gave him glad tidings of a son learned
  • [1] See (Q 11:69) - (Q 11:73) and (Q 15:51) - (Q 15:60) for parallel descriptions of the episode of Abraham's guests.

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:29
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:29 - فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun
Then came forward his wife with a loud voice and struck her face and she said An old woman barren

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:30
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:30 - قَالُوْا كَذَلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ
qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu
They said Thus said your Lord Indeed, He He (is) the All-Wise the All-Knower

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:31
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:31 - قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ
qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna
He said Then what (is) your mission O messengers O messengers

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:32
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:32 - قَالُوْا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَى قَوْمٍ مُجْرِمِينَ
qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna
They said Indeed, we [we] have been sent to a people criminal

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:33
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:33 - لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ طِينٍ
linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīnin
That we may send down upon them stones of clay

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:34
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:34 - مُسَوَّمَةً عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīna
Marked by your Lord by your Lord for the transgressors

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:35
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:35 - فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَنْ كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīna
Then We brought out (those) who were therein of the believers

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:36
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:36 - فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīna
But not We found therein other than a house of the Muslims

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:37
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:37 - وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا اٰیَةً لِلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ
wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīma
And We left therein a Sign for those who fear the punishment the painful

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:38
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:38 - وَفِي مُوسٰی إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīnin
And in Musa when We sent him to Firaun with an authority clear

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:39
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:39 - فَتَوَلَّى بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnun
But he turned away with his supporters and said A magician or a madman

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:40
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:40 - فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmun
So We took him and his hosts and threw them into the sea while he (was) blameworthy

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:41
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:41 - وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ
wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīma
And in Aad when We sent against them the wind the barren

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:42
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:42 - مَا تَذَرُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ
mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīmi
Not it left any thing it came upon it but it made it like disintegrated ruins

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:43
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:43 - وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتّٰی حِينٍ
wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīnin
And in Thamud when was said to them Enjoy (yourselves) for a time

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:44
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:44 - فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ
faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūna
But they rebelled against (the) Command (of) their Lord so seized them the thunderbolt while they were looking

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:45
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:45 - فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوْۤا مُنْتَصِرِينَ famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīna Then not they were able to of stand and not they could help themselves
  • [1] Or 'nor to guard themselves (from the punishment).'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:46
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:46 - وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna
And (the) people (of) Nuh before before indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:47
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:47 - وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūna And the heaven We constructed it with strength and indeed, We (are) surely (its) Expanders
  • [1] Or 'indeed it is We who are expanding it.'

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:48
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:48 - وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ
wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūna
And the earth We have spread it how excellent (are) the Spreaders

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:49
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:49 - وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūna
And of every thing We have created pairs so that you may remember

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:50
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:50 - فَفِرُّوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun
So flee to Allah indeed, I am to you from Him a warner clear

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:51
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:51 - وَلَا تَجْعَلُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا ءَاخَرَ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ مِنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun
And (do) not make with Allah god another Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner clear

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:52
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:52 - كَذٰلِكَ مَا أَتٰی الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ رَسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnun
Likewise not came (to) those before them before them any Messenger but they said A magician or a madman

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:53
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:53 - أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūna
Have they transmitted it to them Have they transmitted it to them Nay they (are) a people transgressing

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:54
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:54 - فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِمَلُومٍ
fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmin
So turn away from them for not you (are) to be blamed

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:55
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:55 - وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَى تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīna
And remind for indeed the reminder benefits the believers

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:56
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:56 - وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنْسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūni
And not I have created the jinn and the mankind except that they worship Me

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:57
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:57 - مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ رِزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ يُطْعِمُونِ
mā urīdu min'hum min riz'qin wamā urīdu an yuṭ'ʿimūni
Not I want from them any provision and not I want that they (should) feed Me

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:58
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:58 - إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ
inna l-laha huwa l-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīnu
Indeed Allah He (is) the All-Provider Possessor (of) Power the Strong

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:59
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:59 - فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا ذَنُوبًا مِثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūban mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūni
So indeed for those who do wrong (is) a portion like (the) portion (of) their companions so let them not ask Me to hasten so let them not ask Me to hasten

item.title: Adh-Dhaariyat:60
item.description:
Adh-Dhaariyat:60 - فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūna
Then woe to those who disbelieve from their Day which they are promised

item.title: 52. الطور (At-Tur)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by The Mount of Sinai, where the Torah was revealed to Moses. It takes its name from "the mount" (ṭūr) mentioned in verse 1. The surah which addresses many of the arguments put to the Prophet by the disbelievers of Mecca (verse 29 ff.). The bliss that will be enjoyed by the believers is contrasted to the torments of Hell, and the Prophet is urged to bide his time, to continue to deliver his message, and to wait with confidence for God's judgement. God swears by, among other things, Mount Sinai, that the Day of Judgement is inevitable.
The surah is also known as Mount Tur, The Mountain

52:1
وَالطُّورِ
wal-ṭūri
By the Mount

52:2
وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ
wakitābin masṭūrin
And by (the) Book written

52:3
فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ
fī raqqin manshūrin
In parchment unrolled

item.title: At-Tur:1
item.description:
At-Tur:1 - وَالطُّورِ
wal-ṭūri
By the Mount

item.title: At-Tur:2
item.description:
At-Tur:2 - وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ
wakitābin masṭūrin
And by (the) Book written

item.title: At-Tur:3
item.description:
At-Tur:3 - فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ
fī raqqin manshūrin
In parchment unrolled

item.title: At-Tur:4
item.description:
At-Tur:4 - وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ wal-bayti l-maʿmūri By the House frequented
  • [1] The Holy Ka'bah, or its counterpart, in the fourth (or the seventh) heaven, frequented by the angels.

item.title: At-Tur:5
item.description:
At-Tur:5 - وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ
wal-saqfi l-marfūʿi
By the roof raised high

item.title: At-Tur:6
item.description:
At-Tur:6 - وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ wal-baḥri l-masjūri By the sea filled
  • [1] Or 'the sea set afire.'

item.title: At-Tur:7
item.description:
At-Tur:7 - إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ
inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun
Indeed (the) punishment (of) your Lord (will) surely occur

item.title: At-Tur:8
item.description:
At-Tur:8 - مَا لَهُ مِنْ دَافِعٍ
mā lahu min dāfiʿin
Not for it any preventer

item.title: At-Tur:9
item.description:
At-Tur:9 - يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا
yawma tamūru l-samāu mawran
(On the) Day will shake the heaven (with violent) shake

item.title: At-Tur:10
item.description:
At-Tur:10 - وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
watasīru l-jibālu sayran
And will move away the mountains (with an awful) movement

item.title: At-Tur:11
item.description:
At-Tur:11 - فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Then woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: At-Tur:12
item.description:
At-Tur:12 - اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūna
Who they in (vain) discourse are playing

item.title: At-Tur:13
item.description:
At-Tur:13 - يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan
(The) Day they will be thrust (in)to (the) Fire (of) Hell (with) a thrust

item.title: At-Tur:14
item.description:
At-Tur:14 - هَذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūna
This (is) the Fire which you used to of it deny

item.title: At-Tur:15
item.description:
At-Tur:15 - أَفَسِحْرٌ هَذَا أَمْ أَنْتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūna
Then is this magic Then is this magic or you (do) not see

item.title: At-Tur:16
item.description:
At-Tur:16 - اِصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوْۤا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna
Burn in it then be patient or (do) not be patient (it is) same for you Only you are being recompensed (for) what you used to do

item.title: At-Tur:17
item.description:
At-Tur:17 - إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmin
Indeed the righteous (will be) in Gardens and pleasure

item.title: At-Tur:18
item.description:
At-Tur:18 - فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا ءَاتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi
Enjoying in what has given them their Lord and protected them their Lord (from the) punishment (of) Hellfire

item.title: At-Tur:19
item.description:
At-Tur:19 - كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
Eat and drink (in) satisfaction for what you used to do

item.title: At-Tur:20
item.description:
At-Tur:20 - مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin
Reclining on thrones lined up and We will marry them to fair ones (with) large eyes

item.title: At-Tur:21
item.description:
At-Tur:21 - وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِنْ عَمَلِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnun
And those who believed and followed them their offspring in faith We will join with them their offspring and not We will deprive them of their deeds (in) any thing Every person for what he earned (is) pledged

item.title: At-Tur:22
item.description:
At-Tur:22 - وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُمْ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūna
And We will provide them with fruit and meat from what they desire

item.title: At-Tur:23
item.description:
At-Tur:23 - يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmun
They will pass to one another therein a cup no ill speech therein and no sin

item.title: At-Tur:24
item.description:
At-Tur:24 - وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَكْنُونٌ
wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnun
And will circulate among them boys for them as if they (were) pearls well-protected

item.title: At-Tur:25
item.description:
At-Tur:25 - وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna
And will approach some of them to others inquiring

item.title: At-Tur:26
item.description:
At-Tur:26 - قَالُوْا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīna
They will say Indeed, we [we] were before among our families fearful

item.title: At-Tur:27
item.description:
At-Tur:27 - فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ
famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūmi
But Allah conferred favor But Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us (from the) punishment (of) the Scorching Fire

item.title: At-Tur:28
item.description:
At-Tur:28 - إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ
innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīmu
Indeed, we [we] used to before before call Him Indeed, He He (is) the Most Kind the Most Merciful

item.title: At-Tur:29
item.description:
At-Tur:29 - فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūnin
Therefore remind for not you (are) by (the) grace (of) your Lord a soothsayer and not a madman

item.title: At-Tur:30
item.description:
At-Tur:30 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ
am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūni
Or (do) they say A poet we wait for him a misfortune of time a misfortune of time

item.title: At-Tur:31
item.description:
At-Tur:31 - قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīna
Say Wait for indeed I am with you among those who wait

item.title: At-Tur:32
item.description:
At-Tur:32 - أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُمْ بِهَذَا أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūna
Or command them their minds this or they (are) a people transgressing

item.title: At-Tur:33
item.description:
At-Tur:33 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَلْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūna
Or (do) they say He has made it up Nay not they believe

item.title: At-Tur:34
item.description:
At-Tur:34 - فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِثْلِهِ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ
falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīna
Then let them bring a statement like it if they are truthful

item.title: At-Tur:35
item.description:
At-Tur:35 - أَمْ خُلِقُوْۤا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ
am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūna
Or they were created of nothing nothing or (are) they the creators

item.title: At-Tur:36
item.description:
At-Tur:36 - أَمْ خَلَقُوْۤا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بَلْ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūna
Or (did) they create the heavens and the earth Nay not they are certain

item.title: At-Tur:37
item.description:
At-Tur:37 - أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūna
Or with them (are the) treasures (of) your Lord or (are) they the controllers

item.title: At-Tur:38
item.description:
At-Tur:38 - أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِیْهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin Or for them (is) a stairway they listen therewith Then let bring their listener an authority clear
  • [1] That is, on the conversation of the angels.

item.title: At-Tur:39
item.description:
At-Tur:39 - أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūna Or for Him (are) daughters while for you (are) sons
  • [1] Cf. (Q 4:117); (Q 16:57) - (Q 16:59); (Q 17:40); (Q 37:149) - (Q 37:154); (Q 43:16) - (Q 43:19); (Q 53:21) - (Q 53:23), (Q 53:27).

item.title: At-Tur:40
item.description:
At-Tur:40 - أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ
am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna
Or (do) you ask from them a payment so they from a debt (are) overburdened

item.title: At-Tur:41
item.description:
At-Tur:41 - أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna
Or with them (is) the unseen so they write (it) down

item.title: At-Tur:42
item.description:
At-Tur:42 - أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ
am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūna
Or (do) they intend a plot But those who disbelieve themselves (are in) the plot

item.title: At-Tur:43
item.description:
At-Tur:43 - أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna
Or for them a god other than Allah Glory be (to) Allah from what they associate (with Him)

item.title: At-Tur:44
item.description:
At-Tur:44 - وَإِنْ يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوْۤا سَحَابٌ مَرْكُومٌ
wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmun
And if they were to see a portion from the sky falling they will say Clouds heaped up

item.title: At-Tur:45
item.description:
At-Tur:45 - فَذَرْهُمْ حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِیْهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūna
So leave them until they meet their Day which in it they will faint

item.title: At-Tur:46
item.description:
At-Tur:46 - يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūna
(The) Day not will avail to them their plotting (in) anything and not they will be helped

item.title: At-Tur:47
item.description:
At-Tur:47 - وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوْۤا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna
And indeed for those who do wrong (is) a punishment before that but most of them (do) not know

item.title: At-Tur:48
item.description:
At-Tur:48 - وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu
So be patient for (the) Command (of) your Lord for indeed, you (are) in Our Eyes And glorify (the) praise (of) your Lord when you arise

item.title: At-Tur:49
item.description:
At-Tur:49 - وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ
wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūmi
And of the night glorify Him and after the stars

item.title: 53. النجم (An-Najm)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by every one of The Stars, as they descend and disappear beneath the horizon, that Muḥammad is indeed God's awaited Messenger. It takes its name from verse 1, which mentions "the stars" (najm). The surah confirms the divine source of the Prophet's message and refers to his ascension to heaven during the Night Journey (verse 1 ff.). The surah refutes the claims of the disbelievers about the goddesses and the angels (verse 19 ff.), and lists several truths about God's power. It closes with a warning of the imminent Day of Judgement.
The surah is also known as The Pleiades

53:1
وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَى
wal-najmi idhā hawā
By the star when it goes down

53:2
مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَى
mā ḍalla ṣāḥibukum wamā ghawā
Not has strayed your companion and not has he erred

53:3
وَمَا يَنْطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَى
wamā yanṭiqu ʿani l-hawā
And not he speaks from the desire

item.title: An-Najm:1
item.description:
An-Najm:1 - وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَى wal-najmi idhā hawā By the star when it goes down
  • [1] Or 'falls.'

item.title: An-Najm:2
item.description:
An-Najm:2 - مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَى mā ḍalla ṣāḥibukum wamā ghawā Not has strayed your companion and not has he erred
  • [1] That is, the Apostle of Allah.

item.title: An-Najm:3
item.description:
An-Najm:3 - وَمَا يَنْطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَى
wamā yanṭiqu ʿani l-hawā
And not he speaks from the desire

item.title: An-Najm:4
item.description:
An-Najm:4 - إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْيٌ يُوحَى
in huwa illā waḥyun yūḥā
Not it (is) except a revelation revealed

item.title: An-Najm:5
item.description:
An-Najm:5 - عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَى
ʿallamahu shadīdu l-quwā
Has taught him the (one) mighty (in) power

item.title: An-Najm:6
item.description:
An-Najm:6 - ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَاسْتَوَى dhū mirratin fa-is'tawā Possessor of soundness Possessor of soundness And he rose
  • [1] Or 'possessed of strength.'
  • [2] That is, the Apostle of Allah (ṣ); or the Angel Gabriel, according to some commentators.
  • [3] Or 'stood upright.'

item.title: An-Najm:7
item.description:
An-Najm:7 - وَهُوَ بِالْأُفُقِ الْاَعْلٰی
wahuwa bil-ufuqi l-aʿlā
While he (was) in the horizon the highest

item.title: An-Najm:8
item.description:
An-Najm:8 - ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّى
thumma danā fatadallā
Then he approached and came down

item.title: An-Najm:9
item.description:
An-Najm:9 - فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى
fakāna qāba qawsayni aw adnā
And was (at) a distance (of) two bow-(lengths) or nearer

item.title: An-Najm:10
item.description:
An-Najm:10 - فَأَوْحَى إِلَى عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَى
fa-awḥā ilā ʿabdihi mā awḥā
So he revealed to His slave what he revealed

item.title: An-Najm:11
item.description:
An-Najm:11 - مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَى
mā kadhaba l-fuādu mā raā
Not lied the heart what it saw

item.title: An-Najm:12
item.description:
An-Najm:12 - أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ عَلَى مَا يَرٰی
afatumārūnahu ʿalā mā yarā
Then will you dispute with him about what he saw

item.title: An-Najm:13
item.description:
An-Najm:13 - وَلَقَدْ رَاٰهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرٰی walaqad raāhu nazlatan ukh'rā And certainly he saw him (in) descent another
  • [1] Or 'them.' To explain, the object of the pronoun hū is specified in verse (Q 53:18), 'Certainly he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.' This interpretation is also supported by a tradition of Imam 'Ali b. Mūsā al-Riḍā ('a) cited in the Uṣūl al-Kāfī, vol. 1, p. 95, ḥadīth 2.

item.title: An-Najm:14
item.description:
An-Najm:14 - عِنْدَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَى
ʿinda sid'rati l-muntahā
Near (the) Lote Tree (of) the utmost boundary

item.title: An-Najm:15
item.description:
An-Najm:15 - عِنْدَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَأْوَى
ʿindahā jannatu l-mawā
Near it (is the) Garden (of) Abode

item.title: An-Najm:16
item.description:
An-Najm:16 - إِذْ يَغْشٰی السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشٰی
idh yaghshā l-sid'rata mā yaghshā
When covered the Lote Tree what covers

item.title: An-Najm:17
item.description:
An-Najm:17 - مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَى
mā zāgha l-baṣaru wamā ṭaghā
Not swerved the sight and not it transgressed

item.title: An-Najm:18
item.description:
An-Najm:18 - لَقَدْ رَأَى مِنْ اٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرٰی
laqad raā min āyāti rabbihi l-kub'rā
Certainly he saw of (the) Signs (of) his Lord the Greatest

item.title: An-Najm:19
item.description:
An-Najm:19 - أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ اللَّاتَ وَالْعُزَّى
afara-aytumu l-lāta wal-ʿuzā
So have you seen the Lat and the Uzza

item.title: An-Najm:20
item.description:
An-Najm:20 - وَمَنَوةَ الثَّالِثَةَ الْأُخْرٰی
wamanata l-thālithata l-ukh'rā
And Manat the third the other

item.title: An-Najm:21
item.description:
An-Najm:21 - أَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْأُنْثَى
alakumu l-dhakaru walahu l-unthā
Is for you the male and for Him the female

item.title: An-Najm:22
item.description:
An-Najm:22 - تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَى
til'ka idhan qis'matun ḍīzā
This then (is) a division unfair

item.title: An-Najm:23
item.description:
An-Najm:23 - إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَءَابَاؤُكُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوٰۤی الْأَنْفُسُ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِمُ الْهُدَى
in hiya illā asmāon sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā anzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wamā tahwā l-anfusu walaqad jāahum min rabbihimu l-hudā
Not they (are) except names you have named them you and your forefathers not has Allah sent down has Allah sent down for it any authority Not they follow except assumption and what desire the(ir) souls And certainly has come to them from their Lord the guidance

item.title: An-Najm:24
item.description:
An-Najm:24 - أَمْ لِلْاِنْسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّى
am lil'insāni mā tamannā
Or (is) for man what he wishes

item.title: An-Najm:25
item.description:
An-Najm:25 - فَلِلَّهِ الْءَاخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَى
falillahi l-ākhiratu wal-ūlā
But for Allah (is) the last and the first

item.title: An-Najm:26
item.description:
An-Najm:26 - وَكَمْ مِنْ مَلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَرْضَى
wakam min malakin fī l-samāwāti lā tugh'nī shafāʿatuhum shayan illā min baʿdi an yadhana l-lahu liman yashāu wayarḍā
And how many of (the) Angels in the heavens not will avail their intercession anything except after after that Allah has given permission Allah has given permission for whom He wills and approves

item.title: An-Najm:27
item.description:
An-Najm:27 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنْثَى
inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati layusammūna l-malāikata tasmiyata l-unthā
Indeed those who (do) not believe in the Hereafter surely they name the Angels name(s) (of) female

item.title: An-Najm:28
item.description:
An-Najm:28 - وَمَا لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا
wamā lahum bihi min ʿil'min in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan
And not for them about it any knowledge Not they follow but assumption And indeed the assumption (does) not avail against the truth anything

item.title: An-Najm:29
item.description:
An-Najm:29 - فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْ مَنْ تَوَلَّى عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
fa-aʿriḍ ʿan man tawallā ʿan dhik'rinā walam yurid illā l-ḥayata l-dun'yā
So turn away from (him) who turns away from Our Reminder and not he desires except the life (of) the world

item.title: An-Najm:30
item.description:
An-Najm:30 - ذٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَى
dhālika mablaghuhum mina l-ʿil'mi inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bimani ih'tadā
That (is) their sum of knowledge Indeed your Lord (is) He (Who) knows best (he) who strays from His Path and He knows best (he) who is guided

item.title: An-Najm:31
item.description:
An-Najm:31 - وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوْۤا بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوْۤا بِالْحُسْنَى
walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi liyajziya alladhīna asāū bimā ʿamilū wayajziya alladhīna aḥsanū bil-ḥus'nā
And for Allah (is) whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth that He may recompense those who do evil with what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best

item.title: An-Najm:32
item.description:
An-Najm:32 - اَلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنْتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ فَلَا تُزَكُّوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَى
alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha illā l-lamama inna rabbaka wāsiʿu l-maghfirati huwa aʿlamu bikum idh ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-idh antum ajinnatun fī buṭūni ummahātikum falā tuzakkū anfusakum huwa aʿlamu bimani ittaqā
Those who avoid great sins and the immoralities except the small faults indeed your Lord (is) vast (in) forgiveness He (is) most knowing about you (is) most knowing about you when He produced you from the earth and when you (were) fetuses in (the) wombs (of) your mothers So (do) not ascribe purity (to) yourselves He knows best (he) who fears

item.title: An-Najm:33
item.description:
An-Najm:33 - أَفَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّى
afara-ayta alladhī tawallā
Did you see the one who turned away

item.title: An-Najm:34
item.description:
An-Najm:34 - وَأَعْطَى قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَى
wa-aʿṭā qalīlan wa-akdā
And gave a little and withheld

item.title: An-Najm:35
item.description:
An-Najm:35 - أَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرٰی
aʿindahu ʿil'mu l-ghaybi fahuwa yarā
Is with him (the) knowledge (of) the unseen so he sees

item.title: An-Najm:36
item.description:
An-Najm:36 - أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسٰی
am lam yunabba bimā fī ṣuḥufi mūsā
Or not he was informed with what (was) in (the) Scriptures (of) Musa

item.title: An-Najm:37
item.description:
An-Najm:37 - وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ الَّذِي وَفَّى
wa-ib'rāhīma alladhī waffā
And Ibrahim who fulfilled

item.title: An-Najm:38
item.description:
An-Najm:38 - أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرٰی
allā taziru wāziratun wiz'ra ukh'rā
That not will bear a bearer of burdens (the) burden (of) another

item.title: An-Najm:39
item.description:
An-Najm:39 - وَأَنْ لَيْسَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَى
wa-an laysa lil'insāni illā mā saʿā
And that is not for man except what he strives (for)

item.title: An-Najm:40
item.description:
An-Najm:40 - وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرٰی
wa-anna saʿyahu sawfa yurā
And that his striving will soon be seen

item.title: An-Najm:41
item.description:
An-Najm:41 - ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَى
thumma yuj'zāhu l-jazāa l-awfā
Then he will be recompensed for it the recompense the fullest

item.title: An-Najm:42
item.description:
An-Najm:42 - وَأَنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الْمُنْتَهَى
wa-anna ilā rabbika l-muntahā
And that to your Lord (is) the final goal

item.title: An-Najm:43
item.description:
An-Najm:43 - وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَى
wa-annahu huwa aḍḥaka wa-abkā
And that He He makes (one) laugh and makes (one) weep

item.title: An-Najm:44
item.description:
An-Najm:44 - وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
wa-annahu huwa amāta wa-aḥyā
And that He He causes death and gives life

item.title: An-Najm:45
item.description:
An-Najm:45 - وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى wa-annahu khalaqa l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unthā And that He created the pairs the male and the female
  • [1] Or 'the sexes.'

item.title: An-Najm:46
item.description:
An-Najm:46 - مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَى
min nuṭ'fatin idhā tum'nā
From a semen-drop when it is emitted

item.title: An-Najm:47
item.description:
An-Najm:47 - وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُخْرٰی
wa-anna ʿalayhi l-nashata l-ukh'rā
And that upon Him (is) the bringing forth another

item.title: An-Najm:48
item.description:
An-Najm:48 - وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَى وَأَقْنَى
wa-annahu huwa aghnā wa-aqnā
And that He He enriches and suffices

item.title: An-Najm:49
item.description:
An-Najm:49 - وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَى
wa-annahu huwa rabbu l-shiʿ'rā
And that He He (is the) Lord (of) Sirius

item.title: An-Najm:50
item.description:
An-Najm:50 - وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَى
wa-annahu ahlaka ʿādan l-ūlā
And that He destroyed Aad the first

item.title: An-Najm:51
item.description:
An-Najm:51 - وَثَمُودَ فَمَا أَبْقَى
wathamūdā famā abqā
And Thamud so not He spared

item.title: An-Najm:52
item.description:
An-Najm:52 - وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَى
waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū hum aẓlama wa-aṭghā
And (the) people (of) Nuh before before Indeed, they they were they were more unjust and more rebellious

item.title: An-Najm:53
item.description:
An-Najm:53 - وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَى wal-mu'tafikata ahwā And the overturned cities He overthrew
  • [1] That is, Sodom. Elsewhere mentioned as plural; see (Q 9:70), (Q 69:9).

item.title: An-Najm:54
item.description:
An-Najm:54 - فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّى
faghashāhā mā ghashā
So covered them what covered

item.title: An-Najm:55
item.description:
An-Najm:55 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارٰی
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbika tatamārā
Then which (of) the Favors (of) your Lord will you doubt

item.title: An-Najm:56
item.description:
An-Najm:56 - هَذَا نَذِيرٌ مِنَ النُّذُرِ الْأُولَى
hādhā nadhīrun mina l-nudhuri l-ūlā
This (is) a warner from the warners the former

item.title: An-Najm:57
item.description:
An-Najm:57 - أَزِفَتِ الْءَازِفَةُ
azifati l-āzifatu
Has approached the Approaching Day

item.title: An-Najm:58
item.description:
An-Najm:58 - لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
laysa lahā min dūni l-lahi kāshifatun
Not is for it besides besides Allah any remover

item.title: An-Najm:59
item.description:
An-Najm:59 - أَفَمِنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
afamin hādhā l-ḥadīthi taʿjabūna
Then of this statement you wonder

item.title: An-Najm:60
item.description:
An-Najm:60 - وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
wataḍḥakūna walā tabkūna
And you laugh and (do) not weep

item.title: An-Najm:61
item.description:
An-Najm:61 - وَأَنْتُمْ سَامِدُونَ
wa-antum sāmidūna
While you amuse (yourselves)

item.title: An-Najm:62
item.description:
An-Najm:62 - فَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ وَاعْبُدُوا
fa-us'judū lillahi wa-uʿ'budū
So prostrate to Allah and worship (Him)

item.title: 54. القمر (Al-Qamar)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the unnerving, cataclysmic sign of the end of the world coming and The Moon having split apart. It takes its name from verse 1 which mentions "the moon" (qamar), that here serves as a reference to the Day of Resurrection. The surah deals mainly with the punishment dealt out to previous generations of disbelievers. These are presented as a warning to the disbelievers of Mecca, with the refrain "is there anyone who will be admonished?" running throughout the surah. Finally the treatment of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgement is contrasted to the everlasting bliss the believers will enjoy.

54:1
اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru
Has come near the Hour and has split the moon

54:2
وَإِنْ يَرَوْا اٰیَةً يُعْرِضُوْۤا وَيَقُولُوْۤا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ
wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun
And if they see a Sign they turn away and say Magic continuing

54:3
