وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun
And they denied and followed their desires but (for) every matter (will be a) settlement

item.title: Al-Qamar:1
item.description:
Al-Qamar:1 - اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru
Has come near the Hour and has split the moon

item.title: Al-Qamar:2
item.description:
Al-Qamar:2 - وَإِنْ يَرَوْا اٰیَةً يُعْرِضُوْۤا وَيَقُولُوْۤا سِحْرٌ مُسْتَمِرٌّ wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun And if they see a Sign they turn away and say Magic continuing
  • [1] Or 'powerful.'

item.title: Al-Qamar:3
item.description:
Al-Qamar:3 - وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun
And they denied and followed their desires but (for) every matter (will be a) settlement

item.title: Al-Qamar:4
item.description:
Al-Qamar:4 - وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْبَاءِ مَا فِیْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajarun
And certainly has come to them of the information wherein wherein (is) deterrence

item.title: Al-Qamar:5
item.description:
Al-Qamar:5 - حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ
ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhuru
Wisdom perfect but not will avail the warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:6
item.description:
Al-Qamar:6 - فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَى شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ
fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukurin
So turn away from them (The) Day will call the caller to a thing terrible

item.title: Al-Qamar:7
item.description:
Al-Qamar:7 - خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُنْتَشِرٌ
khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashirun
(Will be) humbled their eyes they will come forth from the graves as if they (were) locusts spreading

item.title: Al-Qamar:8
item.description:
Al-Qamar:8 - مُهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun
Racing ahead towards the caller Will say the disbelievers This (is) a Day difficult

item.title: Al-Qamar:9
item.description:
Al-Qamar:9 - كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْۤا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujira Denied before them (the) people (of) Nuh and they denied Our slave and said A madman and he was repelled
  • [1] Or 'he was proscribed,' or 'he was ostracized.'

item.title: Al-Qamar:10
item.description:
Al-Qamar:10 - فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ
fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir
So he called his Lord I am one overpowered so help

item.title: Al-Qamar:11
item.description:
Al-Qamar:11 - فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ
fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamirin
So We opened (the) gates (of) heaven with water pouring down

item.title: Al-Qamar:12
item.description:
Al-Qamar:12 - وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudira
And We caused to burst the earth (with) springs so met the water(s) for a matter already predestined

item.title: Al-Qamar:13
item.description:
Al-Qamar:13 - وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusurin
And We carried him on (ark) made of planks (ark) made of planks and nails

item.title: Al-Qamar:14
item.description:
Al-Qamar:14 - تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ
tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufira
Sailing before Our eyes a reward for (he) who was denied

item.title: Al-Qamar:15
item.description:
Al-Qamar:15 - وَلَقَدْ تَرَكْنَاهَا اٰیَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakirin
And certainly We left it (as) a Sign so is (there) any who will receive admonition

item.title: Al-Qamar:16
item.description:
Al-Qamar:16 - فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri
So how was My punishment and My warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:17
item.description:
Al-Qamar:17 - وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin
And certainly We have made easy the Quran for remembrance so is (there) any who will receive admonition

item.title: Al-Qamar:18
item.description:
Al-Qamar:18 - كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri
Denied Aad so how was My punishment and My warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:19
item.description:
Al-Qamar:19 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُسْتَمِرٍّ
innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirrin
Indeed, We [We] sent upon them a wind furious on a day (of) misfortune continuous

item.title: Al-Qamar:20
item.description:
Al-Qamar:20 - تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُنْقَعِرٍ
tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿirin
Plucking out men as if they (were) trunks (of) date-palms uprooted

item.title: Al-Qamar:21
item.description:
Al-Qamar:21 - فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri
So how was My punishment and My warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:22
item.description:
Al-Qamar:22 - وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin
And certainly We have made easy the Quran for remembrance so is (there) any who will receive admonition

item.title: Al-Qamar:23
item.description:
Al-Qamar:23 - كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ
kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhuri
Denied Thamud the warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:24
item.description:
Al-Qamar:24 - فَقَالُوْۤا أَبَشَرًا مِنَّا وَاحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَفِیْ ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ
faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿurin
And said Is (it) a human being among us one (that) we should follow him Indeed, we then (will be) surely in error and madness

item.title: Al-Qamar:25
item.description:
Al-Qamar:25 - أَءُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashirun Has been sent the Reminder to him from among us Nay he (is) a liar insolent
  • [1] Or 'insolent.'

item.title: Al-Qamar:26
item.description:
Al-Qamar:26 - سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ
sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashiru
They will know tomorrow who (is) the liar the insolent one

item.title: Al-Qamar:27
item.description:
Al-Qamar:27 - إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوْۤا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ
innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir
Indeed, We (are) sending the she-camel (as) a trial for them so watch them and be patient

item.title: Al-Qamar:28
item.description:
Al-Qamar:28 - وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُحْتَضَرٌ
wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍarun
And inform them that the water (is) to be shared between them each drink attended

item.title: Al-Qamar:29
item.description:
Al-Qamar:29 - فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَى فَعَقَرَ
fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara
But they called their companion and he took and hamstrung

item.title: Al-Qamar:30
item.description:
Al-Qamar:30 - فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri
So how was My punishment and My warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:31
item.description:
Al-Qamar:31 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْۤا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓiri
Indeed, We [We] sent upon them thunderous blast single and they became like dry twig fragments (used by) a fence builder

item.title: Al-Qamar:32
item.description:
Al-Qamar:32 - وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin
And certainly We have made easy the Quran for remembrance so is (there) any who will receive admonition

item.title: Al-Qamar:33
item.description:
Al-Qamar:33 - كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ
kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhuri
Denied (the) people (of) Lut the warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:34
item.description:
Al-Qamar:34 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا اٰلَ لُوطٍ نَجَّيْنَاهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ
innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥarin
Indeed, We [We] sent upon them a storm of stones except (the) family (of) Lut We saved them by dawn

item.title: Al-Qamar:35
item.description:
Al-Qamar:35 - نِعْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ شَكَرَ
niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakara
(As) a favor from Us Thus We reward (one) who (is) grateful

item.title: Al-Qamar:36
item.description:
Al-Qamar:36 - وَلَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ
walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhuri
And certainly he warned them (of) Our seizure but they disputed the warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:37
item.description:
Al-Qamar:37 - وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri
And certainly they demanded from him they demanded from him his guests so We blinded their eyes So taste My punishment and My warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:38
item.description:
Al-Qamar:38 - وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirrun
And certainly seized them in the morning early a punishment abiding

item.title: Al-Qamar:39
item.description:
Al-Qamar:39 - فَذُوقُوْۤا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri
So taste My punishment and My warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:40
item.description:
Al-Qamar:40 - وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin
And certainly We have made easy the Quran for remembrance so is (there) any who will receive admonition

item.title: Al-Qamar:41
item.description:
Al-Qamar:41 - وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ
walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhuru
And certainly came (to the) people (of) Firaun warnings

item.title: Al-Qamar:42
item.description:
Al-Qamar:42 - كَذَّبُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadirin
They denied Our Signs all of them so We seized them (with) a seizure (of) All-Mighty (the) Powerful One

item.title: Al-Qamar:43
item.description:
Al-Qamar:43 - أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أُولَئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ
akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zuburi
Are your disbelievers better than those or for you (is) an exemption in the Scriptures

item.title: Al-Qamar:44
item.description:
Al-Qamar:44 - أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُنْتَصِرٌ
am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣirun
Or (do) they say We (are) an assembly helping (each other)

item.title: Al-Qamar:45
item.description:
Al-Qamar:45 - سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ
sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubura
Soon will be defeated (their) assembly and they will turn (their) backs

item.title: Al-Qamar:46
item.description:
Al-Qamar:46 - بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ
bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarru
Nay the Hour (is) their promised time and the Hour (will be) more grievous and more bitter

item.title: Al-Qamar:47
item.description:
Al-Qamar:47 - إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ
inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿurin
Indeed the criminals (are) in an error and madness

item.title: Al-Qamar:48
item.description:
Al-Qamar:48 - يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَى وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوْۤا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqara
(The) Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces Taste (the) touch (of) Hell

item.title: Al-Qamar:49
item.description:
Al-Qamar:49 - إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ
innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadarin
Indeed, [We] every thing We created it by a measure

item.title: Al-Qamar:50
item.description:
Al-Qamar:50 - وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ
wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣari
And not (is) Our Command but one like the twinkling (of) the eye

item.title: Al-Qamar:51
item.description:
Al-Qamar:51 - وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ
walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakirin
And certainly We destroyed your kinds so is (there) any who will receive admonition

item.title: Al-Qamar:52
item.description:
Al-Qamar:52 - وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ
wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zuburi
And every thing they did (is) in the written records

item.title: Al-Qamar:53
item.description:
Al-Qamar:53 - وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُسْتَطَرٌ
wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭarun
And every small and big (is) written down

item.title: Al-Qamar:54
item.description:
Al-Qamar:54 - إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaharin
Indeed the righteous (will be) in gardens and river

item.title: Al-Qamar:55
item.description:
Al-Qamar:55 - فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadirin In a seat (of) honor near a King Most Powerful
  • [1] Or 'in a worthy abode.'

item.title: 55. الرحمن (Ar-Rahmaan)
item.description:
The surah that crowns the Quran and opens with the chant of a single word proclaiming one of God's most beautiful names, The All-Beneficent. It takes its name from verse 1 which mentions "the All-beneficent" (al-raḥmān). The surah highlights Gods wonders in this world, describes the end of the world, and paints an evocative picture of the delights of Paradise. Hell is briefly contrasted (verse 43 ff.) with the joys that await the righteous. The surah is characterized by the refrain "So which of your Lord's bounties will you both deny?" which runs throughout. The surah divides mankind and jinn into three classes: the disbelievers (verse 41 ff.), the best of believers (verse 46 ff.), and the ordinary believers (verse 62 ff.).
The surah is also known as (God) Most Gracious, The All-Merciful, The Beneficent, The Lord of Mercy, The Merciful, The Mercy-giving, The Most Gracious

55:1
اَلرَّحْمَنُ
al-raḥmānu
The Most Gracious

55:2
عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ
ʿallama l-qur'āna
He taught the Quran

55:3
خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ
khalaqa l-insāna
He created [the] man

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:1
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:1 - اَلرَّحْمَنُ
al-raḥmānu
The Most Gracious

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:2
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:2 - عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ
ʿallama l-qur'āna
He taught the Quran

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:3
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:3 - خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ
khalaqa l-insāna
He created [the] man

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:4
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:4 - عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ
ʿallamahu l-bayāna
He taught him [the] speech

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:5
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:5 - اَلشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
al-shamsu wal-qamaru biḥus'bānin
The sun and the moon by (precise) calculation

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:6
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:6 - وَالنَّجْمُ وَالشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
wal-najmu wal-shajaru yasjudāni
And the stars and the trees both prostrate

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:7
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:7 - وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ
wal-samāa rafaʿahā wawaḍaʿa l-mīzāna
And the heaven He raised it and He has set up the balance

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:8
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:8 - أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا فِي الْمِيزَانِ
allā taṭghaw fī l-mīzāni
That not you may transgress in the balance

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:9
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:9 - وَأَقِيمُوْۤا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوْۤا الْمِيزَانَ
wa-aqīmū l-wazna bil-qis'ṭi walā tukh'sirū l-mīzāna
And establish the weight in justice and (do) not make deficient the balance

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:10
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:10 - وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
wal-arḍa waḍaʿahā lil'anāmi
And the earth He laid it for the creatures

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:11
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:11 - فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَالنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ الْأَكْمَامِ
fīhā fākihatun wal-nakhlu dhātu l-akmāmi
Therein (is) fruit and date-palms having sheaths

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:12
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:12 - وَالْحَبُّ ذُو الْعَصْفِ وَالرَّيْحَانُ
wal-ḥabu dhū l-ʿaṣfi wal-rayḥānu
And the grain having husk and scented plants

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:13
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:13 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny
  • [1] That is, the jinn and humans. The pronoun 'you' and the adjective 'your' are both dual in the Arabic.

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:14
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:14 - خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ khalaqa l-insāna min ṣalṣālin kal-fakhāri He created the man from clay like the pottery
  • [1] Cf. (Q 15:26), (Q 15:28), (Q 15:33).

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:15
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:15 - وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِنْ مَارِجٍ مِنْ نَارٍ
wakhalaqa l-jāna min mārijin min nārin
And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:16
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:16 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:17
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:17 - رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ rabbu l-mashriqayni warabbu l-maghribayni Lord (of) the two Easts and Lord (of) the two Wests
  • [1] That is, the points of sunrise and sunset at the winter and summer solstices.

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:18
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:18 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:19
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:19 - مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ maraja l-baḥrayni yaltaqiyāni He released the two seas meeting
  • [1] See the footnote at (Q 35:12).

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:20
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:20 - بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَا يَبْغِيَانِ
baynahumā barzakhun lā yabghiyāni
Between both of them (is) a barrier not they transgress

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:21
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:21 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:22
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:22 - يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ
yakhruju min'humā l-lu'lu-u wal-marjānu
Come forth from both of them the pearl and the coral

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:23
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:23 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:24
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:24 - وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنْشَءَاتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ walahu l-jawāri l-munshaātu fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi And for Him (are) the ships elevated in the sea like mountains
  • [1] Or 'the watercrafts.'

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:25
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:25 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:26
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:26 - كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ kullu man ʿalayhā fānin Everyone who (is) on it (will) perish
  • [1] That is, on the earth.

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:27
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:27 - وَيَبْقَى وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ wayabqā wajhu rabbika dhū l-jalāli wal-ik'rāmi But will remain (the) Face (of) your Lord (the) Owner (of) Majesty and Honor
  • [1] The adjectives 'majestic' and 'munificent' pertain to the Face.

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:28
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:28 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
fabi-ayyi ālāi rabbikumā tukadhibāni
So which (of the) favors (of) your Lord will you both deny

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:29
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:29 - يَسْءَلُهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ
yasaluhu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kulla yawmin huwa fī shanin
Asks Him whoever (is) in the heavens and the earth Every day He (is) in a matter

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:30
item.description:
Ar-Rahmaan:30 - فَبِأَيِّ اٰلَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

  • [1] That is, the jinn and humans, or the Qur'ān and the Prophet's Household, referred to as 'thaqalayn' in a famous tradition cited in Sunnī and Shī'ī sources.

item.title: Ar-Rahmaan:32

item.title: 56. الواقعة (Al-Waaqia)
item.description:
The surah that opens by naming the occurrence of the end of time with the title, The Imminent; for all who deny that it is coming will never belie it when finally it happens. It takes its name from verse 1, which mentions "the Imminent Hour" (al-wāqi'ah) i.e., the Day og Resurrection. The surah whose central message is stated in its opening verses: the Day of Judgement is inevitable and it will sort people into the humiliated and the richly rewarded. As in the previous surah, people are divided into three classes: those brought near to God (the best of the believers), those on the right (the ordinary believers), and those on the left (the disbelievers). Ample proof is given of God's power and consequently His ability to bring about the Resurrection (verse 57 ff.).
The surah is also known as That Which is Coming, The Indisputable Event, The Inevitable, The Inevitable Event, The Occurrence, The Terror

56:1
إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ
idhā waqaʿati l-wāqiʿatu
When occurs the Event

56:2
لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
laysa liwaqʿatihā kādhibatun
Not at its occurrence a denial

56:3
خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ
khāfiḍatun rāfiʿatun
Bringing down raising up

item.title: Al-Waaqia:1
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:1 - إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ idhā waqaʿati l-wāqiʿatu When occurs the Event
  • [1] That is, the Day of Resurrection and Judgement.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:2
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:2 - لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
laysa liwaqʿatihā kādhibatun
Not at its occurrence a denial

item.title: Al-Waaqia:3
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:3 - خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ khāfiḍatun rāfiʿatun Bringing down raising up
  • [1] That is, abasing the faithless and raising the faithful in station.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:4
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:4 - إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا

item.description:

item.title: Al-Waaqia:7

item.title: Al-Waaqia:8

item.title: Al-Waaqia:10
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:10 - وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ wal-sābiqūna l-sābiqūna And the foremost (are) the foremost
  • [1] Cf. (Q 2:148), (Q 5:48), (Q 23:61), (Q 35:32), (Q 57:21).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:11
item.description:

item.title: Al-Waaqia:12

fī jannāti l-naʿīmi

item.title: Al-Waaqia:13
item.description:

  • [1] That is, from the communities of the former prophets.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:14

waqalīlun mina l-ākhirīna

item.title: Al-Waaqia:15
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:15 - عَلَى سُرُرٍ مَوْضُونَةٍ
ʿalā sururin mawḍūnatin
On thrones decorated

item.title: Al-Waaqia:16
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:16 - مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ
muttakiīna ʿalayhā mutaqābilīna
Reclining on them facing each other

item.title: Al-Waaqia:17
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:17 - يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ
yaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna
Will circulate among them boys immortal

item.title: Al-Waaqia:18
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:18 - بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِنْ مَعِينٍ bi-akwābin wa-abārīqa wakasin min maʿīnin With vessels and jugs and a cup from a flowing stream
  • [1] Or 'flowing wine.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:19
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:19 - لَا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنْزِفُونَ
lā yuṣaddaʿūna ʿanhā walā yunzifūna
Not they will get headache therefrom and not they will get intoxicated

item.title: Al-Waaqia:20
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:20 - وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
wafākihatin mimmā yatakhayyarūna
And fruits of what they select

item.title: Al-Waaqia:21
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:21 - وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
walaḥmi ṭayrin mimmā yashtahūna
And (the) flesh (of) fowls of what they desire

item.title: Al-Waaqia:22
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:22 - وَحُورٌ عِينٌ
waḥūrun ʿīnun
And fair ones (with) large eyes

item.title: Al-Waaqia:23
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:23 - كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ
ka-amthāli l-lu'lu-i l-maknūni
Like pearls well-protected

item.title: Al-Waaqia:24
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:24 - جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
jazāan bimā kānū yaʿmalūna
A reward for what they used (to) do

item.title: Al-Waaqia:25
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:25 - لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā tathīman
Not they will hear therein vain talk and not sinful (speech)

item.title: Al-Waaqia:26
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:26 - إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا
illā qīlan salāman salāman
Except a saying Peace Peace

item.title: Al-Waaqia:27
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:27 - وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ
wa-aṣḥābu l-yamīni mā aṣḥābu l-yamīni
And (the) companions (of) the right what (are the) companions (of) the right

item.title: Al-Waaqia:28
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:28 - فِي سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ
fī sid'rin makhḍūdin
Among lote trees thornless

item.title: Al-Waaqia:29
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:29 - وَطَلْحٍ مَنْضُودٍ waṭalḥin manḍūdin And banana trees layered
  • [1] This is according to the reading wa ṭal'in manḍūd (instead of wa ṭalḥin manḍūd, meaning 'and clustered plantains') narrated from Imam 'Alī and Imam Ja'far al-Ṣādiq ('a) and Ibn 'Abbās. (Mu'jam, al-Kashshāf).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:30
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:30 - وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ waẓillin mamdūdin And shade extended
  • [1] Or 'twilight;' see the note at (Q 25:45).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:31
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:31 - وَمَاءٍ مَسْكُوبٍ
wamāin maskūbin
And water poured forth

item.title: Al-Waaqia:32
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:32 - وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ
wafākihatin kathīratin
And fruit abundant

item.title: Al-Waaqia:33
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:33 - لَا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ
lā maqṭūʿatin walā mamnūʿatin
Not limited and not forbidden

item.title: Al-Waaqia:34
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:34 - وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ
wafurushin marfūʿatin
And (on) couches raised

item.title: Al-Waaqia:35
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:35 - إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنْشَاءً
innā anshanāhunna inshāan
Indeed, We [We] have produced them (into) a creation

item.title: Al-Waaqia:36
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:36 - فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
fajaʿalnāhunna abkāran
And We have made them virgins

item.title: Al-Waaqia:37
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:37 - عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا
ʿuruban atrāban
Devoted equals in age

item.title: Al-Waaqia:38
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:38 - لِأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ
li-aṣḥābi l-yamīni
For (the) companions (of) the right

item.title: Al-Waaqia:39
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:39 - ثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ
thullatun mina l-awalīna
A company of the former people

item.title: Al-Waaqia:40
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:40 - وَثُلَّةٌ مِنَ الْءَاخِرِينَ
wathullatun mina l-ākhirīna
And a company of the later people

item.title: Al-Waaqia:41
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:41 - وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ
wa-aṣḥābu l-shimāli mā aṣḥābu l-shimāli
And (the) companions (of) the left what (are the) companions (of) the left

item.title: Al-Waaqia:42
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:42 - فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
fī samūmin waḥamīmin
In scorching fire and scalding water

item.title: Al-Waaqia:43
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:43 - وَظِلٍّ مِنْ يَحْمُومٍ
waẓillin min yaḥmūmin
And a shade of black smoke

item.title: Al-Waaqia:44
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:44 - لَا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ lā bāridin walā karīmin Not cool and not pleasant
  • [1] Cf. (Q 77:30) - (Q 77:31).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:45
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:45 - إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا قَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
innahum kānū qabla dhālika mut'rafīna
Indeed, they were before that indulging in affluence

item.title: Al-Waaqia:46
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:46 - وَكَانُوْۤا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ wakānū yuṣirrūna ʿalā l-ḥinthi l-ʿaẓīmi And were persisting in the sin the great
  • [1] That is, shirk. Cf. (Q 31:13).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:47
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:47 - وَكَانُوْۤا يَقُولُونَ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
wakānū yaqūlūna a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna
And they used (to) say When we die and become dust and bones will we surely be resurrected

item.title: Al-Waaqia:48
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:48 - أَوَاٰبَآؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ
awaābāunā l-awalūna
And also our fathers former

item.title: Al-Waaqia:49
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:49 - قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْءَاخِرِينَ
qul inna l-awalīna wal-ākhirīna
Say Indeed the former and the later people

item.title: Al-Waaqia:50
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:50 - لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ
lamajmūʿūna ilā mīqāti yawmin maʿlūmin
Surely, will be gathered for (the) appointment (of) a Day well-known

item.title: Al-Waaqia:51
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:51 - ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ
thumma innakum ayyuhā l-ḍālūna l-mukadhibūna
Then indeed you O those astray the deniers

item.title: Al-Waaqia:52
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:52 - لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِنْ زَقُّومٍ
laākilūna min shajarin min zaqqūmin
Will surely eat from (the) tree of Zaqqum

item.title: Al-Waaqia:53
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:53 - فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ
famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna
Then will fill with it the bellies

item.title: Al-Waaqia:54
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:54 - فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ
fashāribūna ʿalayhi mina l-ḥamīmi
And drink over it from the scalding water

item.title: Al-Waaqia:55
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:55 - فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ
fashāribūna shur'ba l-hīmi
And will drink (as) drinking (of) the thirsty camels

item.title: Al-Waaqia:56
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:56 - هَذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ hādhā nuzuluhum yawma l-dīni This (is) their hospitality (on the) Day (of) Judgment
  • [1] Or 'the Day of Judgement.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:57
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:57 - نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
naḥnu khalaqnākum falawlā tuṣaddiqūna
We created you so why (do) not you admit the truth

item.title: Al-Waaqia:58
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:58 - أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تُمْنُونَ
afara-aytum mā tum'nūna
Do you see what you emit

item.title: Al-Waaqia:59
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:59 - ءَأَنْتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ
a-antum takhluqūnahu am naḥnu l-khāliqūna
Is it you who create it or (are) We the Creators

item.title: Al-Waaqia:60
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:60 - نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
naḥnu qaddarnā baynakumu l-mawta wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna
We [We] have decreed among you the death and not We (are) outrun

item.title: Al-Waaqia:61
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:61 - عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنْشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ʿalā an nubaddila amthālakum wanunshi-akum fī mā lā taʿlamūna
In that We (will) change your likeness[es] and produce you in what not you know

item.title: Al-Waaqia:62
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:62 - وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَى فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
walaqad ʿalim'tumu l-nashata l-ūlā falawlā tadhakkarūna
And certainly you know the creation the first so why not you take heed

item.title: Al-Waaqia:63
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:63 - أَفَرَءَيْتُمْ مَا تَحْرُثُونَ
afara-aytum mā taḥruthūna
And do you see what you sow

item.title: Al-Waaqia:64
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:64 - ءَأَنْتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ
a-antum tazraʿūnahu am naḥnu l-zāriʿūna
Is it you (who) cause it to grow or (are) We the Ones Who grow

item.title: Al-Waaqia:65
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:65 - لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ law nashāu lajaʿalnāhu ḥuṭāman faẓaltum tafakkahūna If We willed We (would) surely, make it debris then you would remain wondering
  • [1] Or 'regretful.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:66
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:66 - إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
innā lamugh'ramūna
Indeed, we surely are laden with debt

item.title: Al-Waaqia:67
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:67 - بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
bal naḥnu maḥrūmūna
Nay we (are) deprived

item.title: Al-Waaqia:68
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:68 - أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ الْمَاءَ الَّذِي تَشْرَبُونَ
afara-aytumu l-māa alladhī tashrabūna
Do you see the water which you drink

item.title: Al-Waaqia:69
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:69 - ءَأَنْتُمْ أَنْزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنْزِلُونَ
a-antum anzaltumūhu mina l-muz'ni am naḥnu l-munzilūna
Is it you who send it down from the rain clouds or We (are) the Ones to send

item.title: Al-Waaqia:70
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:70 - لَوْ نَشَاءُ جَعَلْنَاهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
law nashāu jaʿalnāhu ujājan falawlā tashkurūna
If We willed We (could) make it salty so why no then why are you not grateful

item.title: Al-Waaqia:71
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:71 - أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ النَّارَ الَّتِي تُورُونَ
afara-aytumu l-nāra allatī tūrūna
Do you see the Fire which you ignite

item.title: Al-Waaqia:72
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:72 - ءَأَنْتُمْ أَنْشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَا أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنْشِئُونَ
a-antum anshatum shajaratahā am naḥnu l-munshiūna
Is it you who produced its tree or We (are) the Producers

item.title: Al-Waaqia:73
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:73 - نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَاهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَاعًا لِلْمُقْوِينَ
naḥnu jaʿalnāhā tadhkiratan wamatāʿan lil'muq'wīna
We have made it a reminder and a provision for the wayfarers in the desert

item.title: Al-Waaqia:74
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:74 - فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ
fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīmi
So glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most Great

item.title: Al-Waaqia:75
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:75 - فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ falā uq'simu bimawāqiʿi l-nujūmi But nay I swear by setting (of) the stars
  • [1] Or 'I will not swear.'
  • [2] Or 'by the times when.'
  • [3] Or 'by the places where the stars fall.' Or 'I swear by the orbits of the stars.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:76
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:76 - وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
wa-innahu laqasamun law taʿlamūna ʿaẓīmun
And indeed, it (is) surely an oath if you know great

item.title: Al-Waaqia:77
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:77 - إِنَّهُ لَقُرْءَانٌ كَرِيمٌ
innahu laqur'ānun karīmun
Indeed, it (is) surely, a Quran noble

item.title: Al-Waaqia:78
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:78 - فِي كِتَابٍ مَكْنُونٍ fī kitābin maknūnin In a Book well-guarded
  • [1] That is, the Preserved Tablet.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:79
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:79 - لَا يَمَسُّهُ إِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُونَ
lā yamassuhu illā l-muṭaharūna
None touch it except the purified

item.title: Al-Waaqia:80
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:80 - تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tanzīlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna
A Revelation from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Waaqia:81
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:81 - اَفَبِهٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنْتُمْ مُدْهِنُونَ
afabihādhā l-ḥadīthi antum mud'hinūna
Then is it to this statement that you (are) indifferent

item.title: Al-Waaqia:82
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:82 - وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ watajʿalūna riz'qakum annakum tukadhibūna And you make your provision that you deny
  • [1] Or 'livelihood.' According to the reading taj'alūna shukrakum, narrated from Imam 'Ali ibn Abī Ṭālib and Imam al-Ṣādiq in al-Tafsīr al-Qummī under this verse, the translation will be 'You make your denial of it your thanksgiving.' That is, instead of being grateful for it, you deny it.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:83
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:83 - فَلَوْلَا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ falawlā idhā balaghati l-ḥul'qūma Then why not when it reaches the throat
  • [1] That is, the soul, while leaving the body during the death-throes.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:84
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:84 - وَأَنْتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنْظُرُونَ
wa-antum ḥīna-idhin tanẓurūna
And you (at) that time look on

item.title: Al-Waaqia:85
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:85 - وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْكُمْ وَلَكِنْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walākin lā tub'ṣirūna And We (are) nearer to him than you but you (do) not see you (do) not see
  • [1] That is, to the dying person.

item.title: Al-Waaqia:86
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:86 - فَلَوْلَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ falawlā in kuntum ghayra madīnīna Then why not if you are not to be recompensed
  • [1] Or 'if you are not liable to retribution.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:87
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:87 - تَرْجِعُونَهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
tarjiʿūnahā in kuntum ṣādiqīna
Bring it back if you are truthful

item.title: Al-Waaqia:88
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:88 - فَأَمَّا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ fa-ammā in kāna mina l-muqarabīna Then if he was of those brought near
  • [1] That is, of 'the foremost ones' mentioned in verses (Q 56:10) - (Q 56:11).

item.title: Al-Waaqia:89
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:89 - فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ
farawḥun warayḥānun wajannatu naʿīmin
Then rest and bounty and a Garden (of) Pleasure

item.title: Al-Waaqia:90
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:90 - وَأَمَّا إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ
wa-ammā in kāna min aṣḥābi l-yamīni
And if he was of (the) companions (of) the right

item.title: Al-Waaqia:91
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:91 - فَسَلَامٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ
fasalāmun laka min aṣḥābi l-yamīni
Then, peace for you from (the) companions (of) the right

item.title: Al-Waaqia:92
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:92 - وَأَمَّا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ الضَّالِّينَ
wa-ammā in kāna mina l-mukadhibīna l-ḍālīna
But if he was of the deniers the astray

item.title: Al-Waaqia:93
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:93 - فَنُزُلٌ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ
fanuzulun min ḥamīmin
Then, hospitality of (the) scalding water

item.title: Al-Waaqia:94
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:94 - وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ wataṣliyatu jaḥīmin And burning (in) Hellfire
  • [1] Or 'roasting in hell.'

item.title: Al-Waaqia:95
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:95 - إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ
inna hādhā lahuwa ḥaqqu l-yaqīni
Indeed this surely, it (is the) truth certain

item.title: Al-Waaqia:96
item.description:
Al-Waaqia:96 - فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ
fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīmi
So glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most Great

item.title: 57. الحديد (Al-Hadid)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the heavy metallic element Iron as being sent down by God form the heavens to endow the earth itself with mighty force, and humanity with the many benefits of its malleable and structural strength, and all the great tests of faith that arise from this. It takes its name from verse 25, which mentions iron (ḥadīd). The surah urges the believers to spend in God's cause and uphold justice. The all pervasiveness of God's power, knowledge, control, and glory is affirmed to encourage the believers to right action, and the fate of the hypocrites is described. Previous prophets are mentioned (verse 26 ff.), especially Noah, Abraham, and Jesus, showing the response they received. The surah closes with a reference to the People of the Book.

57:1
سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
Glorifies [to] Allah whatever (is) in the heavens and the earth and He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise

57:2
لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yuḥ'yī wayumītu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
For Him (is the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth He gives life and causes death and He (is) over all things All-Powerful

57:3
هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْءَاخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
huwa l-awalu wal-ākhiru wal-ẓāhiru wal-bāṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
He (is) the First and the Last and the Apparent and the Unapparent and He (is) of every thing All-Knower

item.title: Al-Hadid:1
item.description:
Al-Hadid:1 - سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
Glorifies [to] Allah whatever (is) in the heavens and the earth and He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise

item.title: Al-Hadid:2
item.description:
Al-Hadid:2 - لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yuḥ'yī wayumītu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
For Him (is the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth He gives life and causes death and He (is) over all things All-Powerful

item.title: Al-Hadid:3
item.description:
Al-Hadid:3 - هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْءَاخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
huwa l-awalu wal-ākhiru wal-ẓāhiru wal-bāṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
He (is) the First and the Last and the Apparent and the Unapparent and He (is) of every thing All-Knower

item.title: Al-Hadid:4
item.description:
Al-Hadid:4 - هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
huwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun
He (is) the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six periods then He rose over the Throne He knows what penetrates in(to) the earth and what comes forth from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein and He (is) with you wherever wherever you are And Allah of what you do (is) All-seer

item.title: Al-Hadid:5
item.description:
Al-Hadid:5 - لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru For Him (is the) dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and to Allah will be returned the matters
  • [1] Cf. (Q 2:210), (Q 3:109), (Q 8:44), (Q 11:123), (Q 19:40), (Q 22:76), (Q 30:11), (Q 96:8).

item.title: Al-Hadid:6
item.description:
Al-Hadid:6 - يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَهُوَ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri
He merges the night into the day and He merges the day into the night and He (is) All-Knower of what is in the breasts of what is in the breasts

item.title: Al-Hadid:7
item.description:
Al-Hadid:7 - اَٰمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنْفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُمْ مُسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِیْهِ فَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَأَنْفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā jaʿalakum mus'takhlafīna fīhi fa-alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīrun Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend of what He has made you trustees therein And those who believe among you and spend for them (is) a reward great
  • [1] That is, of the past generations.

item.title: Al-Hadid:8
item.description:
Al-Hadid:8 - وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ
wamā lakum lā tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum litu'minū birabbikum waqad akhadha mīthāqakum in kuntum mu'minīna
And what (is) for you (that) not you believe in Allah while the Messenger calls you that you believe in your Lord and indeed He has taken your covenant if you are believers

item.title: Al-Hadid:9
item.description:
Al-Hadid:9 - هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
huwa alladhī yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wa-inna l-laha bikum laraūfun raḥīmun
He (is) the One Who sends down upon His slave Verses clear that He may bring you out from the darkness[es] into the light And indeed Allah to you (is the) Most Kind (the) Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Hadid:10
item.description:
Al-Hadid:10 - وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنْفِقُوْۤا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنْكُمْ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ مِنْ قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَنْفَقُوْۤا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُوا وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الْحُسْنَى وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ wamā lakum allā tunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā yastawī minkum man anfaqa min qabli l-fatḥi waqātala ulāika aʿẓamu darajatan mina alladhīna anfaqū min baʿdu waqātalū wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun And what (is) for you that not you spend in (the) way (of) Allah while for Allah (is the) heritage (of) the heavens and the earth Not are equal among you (those) who spent before before the victory and fought Those (are) greater (in) degree than those who spent afterwards afterwards and fought But to all Allah has promised Allah has promised the best And Allah of what you do (is) All-Aware
  • [1] That is, the Prophet's triumphant return to Makkah.

item.title: Al-Hadid:11
item.description:
Al-Hadid:11 - مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
man dhā alladhī yuq'riḍu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ajrun karīmun
Who (is) the one who the one who will loan (to) Allah a loan goodly so He will multiply it for him and for him (is) a reward noble

item.title: Al-Hadid:12
item.description:
Al-Hadid:12 - يَوْمَ تَرٰی الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَى نُورُهُمْ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ بُشْرَاكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
yawma tarā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim bush'rākumu l-yawma jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu
(On the) Day you will see the believing men and the believing women running their light before them before them and on their right Glad tidings for you this Day gardens flowing from underneath it the rivers abiding forever therein That [it] (is) the success the great

item.title: Al-Hadid:13
item.description:
Al-Hadid:13 - يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا انْظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِنْ نُورِكُمْ قِيلَ ارْجِعُوْۤا وَرَاءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُوا نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُمْ بِسُورٍ لَهُ بَابٌ بَاطِنُهُ فِیْهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَاهِرُهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ yawma yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanū unẓurūnā naqtabis min nūrikum qīla ir'jiʿū warāakum fal-tamisū nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin lahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi l-raḥmatu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi l-ʿadhābu (On the) Day will say the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women to those who believed Wait for us we may acquire of your light It will be said Go back behind you and seek light Then will be put up between them a wall for it a gate its interior in it (is) mercy but its exterior facing towards [it] facing towards [it] the punishment
  • [1] That is, go back into the world. Said mockingly to the hypocrites. Cf. (Q 2:15), (Q 11:38).

item.title: Al-Hadid:14
item.description:
Al-Hadid:14 - يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُنْ مَعَكُمْ قَالُوْا بَلَى وَلَكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنْتُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْأَمَانِيُّ حَتّٰی جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ yunādūnahum alam nakun maʿakum qālū balā walākinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbaṣtum wa-ir'tabtum wagharratkumu l-amāniyu ḥattā jāa amru l-lahi wagharrakum bil-lahi l-gharūru They will call them Were not we with you They will say Yes but you led to temptation yourselves and you awaited and you doubted and deceived you the wishful thinking until came (the) Command (of) Allah And deceived you about Allah the deceiver
  • [1] That is, waited for a reverse of fortune for Muslims. See (Q 4:141), (Q 9:50) - (Q 9:52), (Q 9:98), (Q 23:25), (Q 52:30) - (Q 52:31).
  • [2] That is, death.

item.title: Al-Hadid:15
item.description:
Al-Hadid:15 - فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
fal-yawma lā yu'khadhu minkum fid'yatun walā mina alladhīna kafarū mawākumu l-nāru hiya mawlākum wabi'sa l-maṣīru
So today not will be accepted from you any ransom and not from those who disbelieved Your abode (is) the Fire it (is) your protector and wretched is the destination

item.title: Al-Hadid:16
item.description:
Al-Hadid:16 - أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا أَنْ تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوْۤا كَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ alam yani lilladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhik'ri l-lahi wamā nazala mina l-ḥaqi walā yakūnū ka-alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu l-amadu faqasat qulūbuhum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna Has not come (the) time for those who believed that become humble their hearts at (the) remembrance (of) Allah at (the) remembrance (of) Allah and what has come down of the truth And not they become like those who were given the Book before before (and) was prolonged for them the term so hardened their hearts and many of them (are) defiantly disobedient
  • [1] That is, the Jews.

item.title: Al-Hadid:17
item.description:
Al-Hadid:17 - اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna
Know that Allah gives life (to) the earth after its death Indeed We have made clear to you the Signs so that you may understand

item.title: Al-Hadid:18
item.description:
Al-Hadid:18 - إِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَاتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
inna l-muṣadiqīna wal-muṣadiqāti wa-aqraḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ajrun karīmun
Indeed the men who give charity and the women who give charity and who lend (to) Allah a loan goodly it will be multiplied for them and for them (is) a reward noble

item.title: Al-Hadid:19
item.description:
Al-Hadid:19 - وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi ulāika humu l-ṣidīqūna wal-shuhadāu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanūruhum wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi And those who believe in Allah and His Messengers those they (are) the truthful and the martyrs (are) with their Lord For them (is) their reward and their light But those who disbelieve and deny Our Verses those (are the) companions (of) the Hellfire
  • [1] Or 'martyrs.'

item.title: Al-Hadid:20
item.description:
Al-Hadid:20 - اِعْلَمُوْۤا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةُ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ وَمَا الْحَيَوةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ iʿ'lamū annamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wazīnatun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi kamathali ghaythin aʿjaba l-kufāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman wafī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfiratun mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānun wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri Know that the life (of) the world (is) play and amusement and adornment and boasting among you and competition in increase of the wealth and the children like (the) example (of) a rain pleases the tillers its growth then it dries and you see it turning yellow then becomes debris And in the Hereafter (is) a punishment severe and forgiveness from Allah and Pleasure But not (is) the life (of) the world except (the) enjoyment (of) delusion
  • [1] Or 'rivalry.'

item.title: Al-Hadid:21
item.description:
Al-Hadid:21 - سَابِقُوْۤا إِلَى مَغْفِرَةٍ مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ذٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
sābiqū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi l-samāi wal-arḍi uʿiddat lilladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi
Race to (the) forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden its width (is) like (the) width (of) the heaven and the earth prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers That (is the) Bounty (of) Allah He gives (to) whom He wills And Allah (is) the Possessor of Bounty (is) the Possessor of Bounty the Great

item.title: Al-Hadid:22
item.description:
Al-Hadid:22 - مَا أَصَابَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ نَبْرَأَهَا إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
mā aṣāba min muṣībatin fī l-arḍi walā fī anfusikum illā fī kitābin min qabli an nabra-ahā inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun
Not strikes any disaster in the earth and not in yourselves but in a Register before before that We bring it into existence Indeed that for Allah (is) easy

item.title: Al-Hadid:23
item.description:
Al-Hadid:23 - لِكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَى مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوْۤا بِمَا ءَاتَاكُمْ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
likaylā tasaw ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥū bimā ātākum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin
So that you may not grieve over what has escaped you and (do) not exult at what He has given you And Allah (does) not love every self-deluded boaster

item.title: Al-Hadid:24
item.description:
Al-Hadid:24 - اَلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
alladhīna yabkhalūna wayamurūna l-nāsa bil-bukh'li waman yatawalla fa-inna l-laha huwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu
Those who are stingy and enjoin (on) the people stinginess And whoever turns away then indeed Allah He (is) Free of need the Praiseworthy

item.title: Al-Hadid:25
item.description:
Al-Hadid:25 - لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِیْهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ laqad arsalnā rusulanā bil-bayināti wa-anzalnā maʿahumu l-kitāba wal-mīzāna liyaqūma l-nāsu bil-qis'ṭi wa-anzalnā l-ḥadīda fīhi basun shadīdun wamanāfiʿu lilnnāsi waliyaʿlama l-lahu man yanṣuruhu warusulahu bil-ghaybi inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun Certainly We sent Our Messengers with clear proofs and We sent down with them the Scripture and the Balance that may establish the people justice And We sent down [the] iron wherein (is) power mighty and benefits for the people and so that Allah may make evident and so that Allah may make evident (he) who helps Him and His Messengers unseen Indeed Allah (is) All-Strong All-Mighty
  • [1] That is, created.

item.title: Al-Hadid:26
item.description:
Al-Hadid:26 - وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَاِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ فَمِنْهُمْ مُهْتَدٍ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
walaqad arsalnā nūḥan wa-ib'rāhīma wajaʿalnā fī dhurriyyatihimā l-nubuwata wal-kitāba famin'hum muh'tadin wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna
And certainly We sent Nuh and Ibrahim and We placed in their offspring Prophethood and the Scripture and among them (is) a guided one but most of them (are) defiantly disobediently

item.title: Al-Hadid:27
item.description:
Al-Hadid:27 - ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَى ءَاثَارِهِمْ بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسٰی ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنْجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَاهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ رِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا فَءَاتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
thumma qaffaynā ʿalā āthārihim birusulinā waqaffaynā biʿīsā ib'ni maryama waātaynāhu l-injīla wajaʿalnā fī qulūbi alladhīna ittabaʿūhu rafatan waraḥmatan warahbāniyyatan ib'tadaʿūhā mā katabnāhā ʿalayhim illā ib'tighāa riḍ'wāni l-lahi famā raʿawhā ḥaqqa riʿāyatihā faātaynā alladhīna āmanū min'hum ajrahum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna
Then We sent on their footsteps Our Messengers and We followed with Isa son (of) Maryam and We gave him the Injeel And We placed in (the) hearts (of) those who followed him compassion and mercy But monasticism they innovated not We prescribed it for them only seeking (the) pleasure (of) Allah but not they observed it (with) right observance So We gave those who believed among them their reward but most of them (are) defiantly disobediently

item.title: Al-Hadid:28
item.description:
Al-Hadid:28 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا اتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوْۤا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū l-laha waāminū birasūlihi yu'tikum kif'layni min raḥmatihi wayajʿal lakum nūran tamshūna bihi wayaghfir lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun
O you those who(believe) believe Fear Allah and believe in His Messenger He will give you double portion of His Mercy and He will make for you a light you will walk with it and He will forgive you And Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Hadid:29
item.description:
Al-Hadid:29 - لِئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ
li-allā yaʿlama ahlu l-kitābi allā yaqdirūna ʿalā shayin min faḍli l-lahi wa-anna l-faḍla biyadi l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi
So that may know (the) People (of) the Book that not they have power over anything from (the) Bounty (of) Allah and that the Bounty (is) in Allah's Hand (is) in Allah's Hand He gives it whom He wills And Allah (is) the Possessor of Bounty (is) the Possessor of Bounty the Great

item.title: 58. المجادلة (Al-Mujaadila)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the complaint of Khawlah bint Tha'labah to the Prophet as The Pleader for dignity of women against the abominable practice whereby husbands estranged their wives from intimacy on false pretext. It takes its name from the phrase "pleads with you" (tujādiluka) mentioned in verse 1. The surah disallows a specific pagan divorce practice. It goes on to state that those who oppose God and His messenger, who secretly ally themselves with Satan, who lie in their oaths and make intrigues against the Prophet, will be defeated and suffer humiliation both in this world and in the next (verse 5 and verse 20), while those on God's side will triumph (verse 22).
The surah is also known as She Who Argued, She Who Pleaded, The Disputant, The Dispute, The Disputer, The Disputing Woman, The Pleading Woman, The Woman Who Pleads

58:1
قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
qad samiʿa l-lahu qawla allatī tujādiluka fī zawjihā watashtakī ilā l-lahi wal-lahu yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun
Indeed Allah has heard Allah has heard (the) speech (of one) who disputes with you concerning her husband and she directs her complaint to Allah And Allah hears (the) dialogue of both of you Indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Seer

58:2
اَلَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ مَا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنْكَرًا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
alladhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum min nisāihim mā hunna ummahātihim in ummahātuhum illā allāī waladnahum wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mina l-qawli wazūran wa-inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun
Those who pronounce zihar among you from (to) their wives not they (are) their mothers Not (are) their mothers except those who gave them birth And indeed, they surely say an evil of [the] word and a lie But indeed Allah (is) surely, Oft-Pardoning Oft-Forgiving

58:3
وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوْا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا ذَلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
wa-alladhīna yuẓāhirūna min nisāihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālū fataḥrīru raqabatin min qabli an yatamāssā dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
And those who pronounce zihar from (to) their wives then go back on what they said then freeing (of) a slave before before that they touch each other That you are admonished to it And Allah of what you do (is) All-Aware

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:1
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:1 - قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
qad samiʿa l-lahu qawla allatī tujādiluka fī zawjihā watashtakī ilā l-lahi wal-lahu yasmaʿu taḥāwurakumā inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun
Indeed Allah has heard Allah has heard (the) speech (of one) who disputes with you concerning her husband and she directs her complaint to Allah And Allah hears (the) dialogue of both of you Indeed Allah (is) All-Hearer All-Seer

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:2
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:2 - اَلَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ مَا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنْكَرًا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ alladhīna yuẓāhirūna minkum min nisāihim mā hunna ummahātihim in ummahātuhum illā allāī waladnahum wa-innahum layaqūlūna munkaran mina l-qawli wazūran wa-inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun Those who pronounce zihar among you from (to) their wives not they (are) their mothers Not (are) their mothers except those who gave them birth And indeed, they surely say an evil of [the] word and a lie But indeed Allah (is) surely, Oft-Pardoning Oft-Forgiving
  • [1] A kind of repudiation of the marital relationship among pre-Islamic Arabs which took place on a husband's saying to his wife 'Be as my mother's back' (ẓahr; hence the derivative ẓihār).

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:3
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:3 - وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوْا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا ذَلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
wa-alladhīna yuẓāhirūna min nisāihim thumma yaʿūdūna limā qālū fataḥrīru raqabatin min qabli an yatamāssā dhālikum tūʿaẓūna bihi wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
And those who pronounce zihar from (to) their wives then go back on what they said then freeing (of) a slave before before that they touch each other That you are admonished to it And Allah of what you do (is) All-Aware

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:4
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:4 - فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ذٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
faman lam yajid faṣiyāmu shahrayni mutatābiʿayni min qabli an yatamāssā faman lam yastaṭiʿ fa-iṭ'ʿāmu sittīna mis'kīnan dhālika litu'minū bil-lahi warasūlihi watil'ka ḥudūdu l-lahi walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun alīmun
Then whoever (does) not find then fasting (for) two months consecutively before before that they both touch each other But (he) who not is able then (the) feeding (of) sixty needy one(s) That so that you may believe in Allah and His Messenger and these (are the) limits (of) Allah and for the disbelievers (is) a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:5
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:5 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُوْۤا كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا ءَايَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ
inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu kubitū kamā kubita alladhīna min qablihim waqad anzalnā āyātin bayyinātin walil'kāfirīna ʿadhābun muhīnun
Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Messenger (will) be disgraced as were disgraced those before them before them And certainly We have sent down Verses clear And for the disbelievers (is) a punishment humiliating

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:6
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:6 - يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū aḥṣāhu l-lahu wanasūhu wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun
(On the) Day (when) Allah will raise them (when) Allah will raise them all and inform them of what they did Allah has recorded it Allah has recorded it while they forgot it And Allah (is) over all things a Witness

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:7
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:7 - أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنْ نَجْوَى ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَا أَدْنَى مِنْ ذٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوْۤا ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوْۤا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
alam tara anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi mā yakūnu min najwā thalāthatin illā huwa rābiʿuhum walā khamsatin illā huwa sādisuhum walā adnā min dhālika walā akthara illā huwa maʿahum ayna mā kānū thumma yunabbi-uhum bimā ʿamilū yawma l-qiyāmati inna l-laha bikulli shayin ʿalīmun
Do not you see that Allah knows whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth Not there is any secret counsel (of) three but He (is) (the) fourth of them and not five but He (is) (the) sixth of them and not less than that and not more but He (is) with them wherever wherever they are Then He will inform them of what they did (on the) Day (of) the Resurrection Indeed Allah of every thing (is) All-Knower

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:8
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:8 - أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُوْۤا عَنِ النَّجْوَى ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوْۤا عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَاءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ alam tara ilā alladhīna nuhū ʿani l-najwā thumma yaʿūdūna limā nuhū ʿanhu wayatanājawna bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli wa-idhā jāūka ḥayyawka bimā lam yuḥayyika bihi l-lahu wayaqūlūna fī anfusihim lawlā yuʿadhibunā l-lahu bimā naqūlu ḥasbuhum jahannamu yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-maṣīru Do not you see to those who were forbidden from secret counsels then they return to what they were forbidden from [it] and they hold secret counsels for sin and aggression and disobedience (to) the Messenger And when they come to you they greet you with what not greets you therewith Allah and they say among themselves Why (does) not Allah punish us Allah punish us for what we say Sufficient (for) them (is) Hell they will burn in it and worst is the destination
  • [1] That is, the Jews and the hypocrites.
  • [2] That is, the Jews and the hypocrites who, instead of as-salāmu 'alaykum (peace be on you), would greet the Prophet (ṣ) with such words as as-sāmu 'alaykum (death to you), telling themselves that if the Prophet (ṣ) were really from God, He would punish them for it.
  • [3] Or 'in their hearts.'

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:9
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:9 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَاتَّقُوْۤا اللَّهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā tanājaytum falā tatanājaw bil-ith'mi wal-ʿud'wāni wamaʿṣiyati l-rasūli watanājaw bil-biri wal-taqwā wa-ittaqū l-laha alladhī ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna
O you those who(believe) believe When you hold secret counsel then (do) not hold secret counsel for sin and aggression and disobedience (to) the Messenger but hold secret counsel for righteousness and piety And fear Allah the One Who to Him you will be gathered

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:10
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:10 - إِنَّمَا النَّجْوَى مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَيْسَ بِضَارِّهِمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
innamā l-najwā mina l-shayṭāni liyaḥzuna alladhīna āmanū walaysa biḍārrihim shayan illā bi-idh'ni l-lahi waʿalā l-lahi falyatawakkali l-mu'minūna
Only the secret counsels (are) from the Shaitaan that he may grieve those who believe but not he (can) harm them (in) anything except by Allah's permission by Allah's permission And upon Allah let put (their) trust the believers

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:11
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:11 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَإِذَا قِيلَ انْشُزُوْۤا فَانْشُزُوا يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā qīla lakum tafassaḥū fī l-majālisi fa-if'saḥū yafsaḥi l-lahu lakum wa-idhā qīla unshuzū fa-unshuzū yarfaʿi l-lahu alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma darajātin wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun
O you those who(believe) believe When it is said to you Make room in the assemblies then make room Allah will make room Allah will make room for you And when it is said Rise up then rise up Allah will raise Allah will raise those who believe among you and those who were given the knowledge (in) degrees And Allah of what you do (is) All-Aware

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:12
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:12 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوْۤا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū idhā nājaytumu l-rasūla faqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqatan dhālika khayrun lakum wa-aṭharu fa-in lam tajidū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun
O you those who(believe) believe When you privately consult the Messenger then offer before before your private consultation charity That (is) better for you and purer But if not you find then indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:13
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:13 - ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوْۤا وَتَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
a-ashfaqtum an tuqaddimū bayna yaday najwākum ṣadaqātin fa-idh lam tafʿalū watāba l-lahu ʿalaykum fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aṭīʿū l-laha warasūlahu wal-lahu khabīrun bimā taʿmalūna
Are you afraid to offer before before your private consultation charities Then when you do not you do not and Allah has forgiven and Allah has forgiven you then establish the prayer and give the zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger And Allah (is) All-Aware of what you do

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:14
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:14 - أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ مِنْكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ alam tara ilā alladhīna tawallaw qawman ghaḍiba l-lahu ʿalayhim mā hum minkum walā min'hum wayaḥlifūna ʿalā l-kadhibi wahum yaʿlamūna Do not you see to those who take as allies a people wrath (of) Allah (is) upon them They (are) not They (are) not of you and not of them and they swear to the lie while they know
  • [1] That is, the Jews, with whom the hypocrites amongst muslims were on intimate terms.

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:15
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:15 - أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَعْمَلُونَ
aʿadda l-lahu lahum ʿadhāban shadīdan innahum sāa mā kānū yaʿmalūna
Allah has prepared Allah has prepared for them a punishment severe Indeed, [they] evil is what they used to do

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:16
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:16 - اِتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوْۤا عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ
ittakhadhū aymānahum junnatan faṣaddū ʿan sabīli l-lahi falahum ʿadhābun muhīnun
They have taken their oaths (as) a cover so they hinder from (the) way of Allah (the) way of Allah so for them (is) a punishment humiliating

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:17
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:17 - لَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
lan tugh'niya ʿanhum amwāluhum walā awlāduhum mina l-lahi shayan ulāika aṣḥābu l-nāri hum fīhā khālidūna
Never will avail them their wealth and not their children against Allah (in) anything Those (will be) companions (of) the Fire they in it will abide forever

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:18
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:18 - يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ
yawma yabʿathuhumu l-lahu jamīʿan fayaḥlifūna lahu kamā yaḥlifūna lakum wayaḥsabūna annahum ʿalā shayin alā innahum humu l-kādhibūna
(On the) Day Allah will raise them Allah will raise them all then they will swear to Him as they swear to you And they think that they (are) on something No doubt Indeed, they they (are) the liars

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:19
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:19 - اِسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَنْسَاهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَانِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ
is'taḥwadha ʿalayhimu l-shayṭānu fa-ansāhum dhik'ra l-lahi ulāika ḥiz'bu l-shayṭāni alā inna ḥiz'ba l-shayṭāni humu l-khāsirūna
Has overcome them the Shaitaan so he made them forget (the) remembrance (of) Allah Those (are the) party (of) the Shaitaan No doubt Indeed (the) party (of) the Shaitaan they (will be) the losers

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:20
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:20 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ
inna alladhīna yuḥāddūna l-laha warasūlahu ulāika fī l-adhalīna
Indeed those who oppose Allah and His Messenger those (will be) among the most humiliated

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:21
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:21 - كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ
kataba l-lahu la-aghlibanna anā warusulī inna l-laha qawiyyun ʿazīzun
Allah has decreed Allah has decreed Surely, I will overcome I and My Messengers Indeed Allah (is) All-Strong All-Mighty

item.title: Al-Mujaadila:22
item.description:
Al-Mujaadila:22 - لَا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْاٰخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَوْ كَانُوْۤا ءَابَاءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَانَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ اُولٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَأَيَّدَهُمْ بِرُوحٍ مِنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوْۤا عَنْهُ اُولٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اللَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
lā tajidu qawman yu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri yuwāddūna man ḥādda l-laha warasūlahu walaw kānū ābāahum aw abnāahum aw ikh'wānahum aw ʿashīratahum ulāika kataba fī qulūbihimu l-īmāna wa-ayyadahum birūḥin min'hu wayud'khiluhum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu ulāika ḥiz'bu l-lahi alā inna ḥiz'ba l-lahi humu l-muf'liḥūna
You will not find You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Day the Last loving (those) who oppose Allah and His Messenger even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred Those He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with a spirit from Him And He will admit them (to) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers will abide forever in it Allah is pleased Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him Those (are the) party (of) Allah No doubt Indeed (the) party (of) Allah they (are) the successful ones

item.title: 59. الحشر (Al-Hashr)
item.description:
The surah that mentions The Banishment, God's expulsion, of the clan of Banū al-Naḍīr from their prodigious fortress-settlement near Medina, in the mustering it calls the first of its kind: for they had betrayed their covenant of mutual defence by aiding idolaters against monotheistic believers. It takes its name from the "banishment" or "gathering of forces" (ḥashr) of the Jewish tribe from Medina, which is mentioned in verse 2. The Banū al-Naḍīr, who originally agreed with the Prophet that they would fight neither for nor against him, yet, after the Meccan defeat of the Muslims in the Battle of Uḥud (year 3/625), made an alliance with the Meccans. They also tried to kill the Prophet while he was in their area. He asked them to leave and they agreed, but Ibn Ubayy, the head of the "hypocrites" of Medina, promised them that, if they fought the Muslims, he and his camp would fight with them (verse 11 ff.), and, if they had to leave Medina, he and his camp would leave with them. Because the Banū al-Naḍīr had repeatedly broken their agreements, the Muslims besieged them in Medina (in year 4/626), Ibn Ubayy did not keep his promise, and the Banū al-Naḍīr agreed to leave, some going to Syria and some to Khaybar. In this surah, God stresses that any gains were His doing and so should be distributed in accordance with His instructions (verse 6 ff.). The end of the surah, consequently, emphasizes obedience and awe towards God (verse 21 ff.).
The surah is also known as Confrontation, Exile, The Fathering, The Gathering, The Gathering (of Forces), The Mustering

59:1
سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu
Glorifies [to] Allah whatever (is) in the heavens and whatever (is) in the earth And He (is) the All-Mighty the All-Wise

59:2
هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ مَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ يَخْرُجُوْۤا وَظَنُّوْۤا أَنَّهُمْ مَانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَأَتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُمْ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَاأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
huwa alladhī akhraja alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi min diyārihim li-awwali l-ḥashri mā ẓanantum an yakhrujū waẓannū annahum māniʿatuhum ḥuṣūnuhum mina l-lahi fa-atāhumu l-lahu min ḥaythu lam yaḥtasibū waqadhafa fī qulūbihimu l-ruʿ'ba yukh'ribūna buyūtahum bi-aydīhim wa-aydī l-mu'minīna fa-iʿ'tabirū yāulī l-abṣāri
He (is) the One Who expelled those who disbelieved from (the) People (of) the Scripture from their homes at (the) first gathering Not you think that they would leave and they thought that [they] would defend them their fortresses against Allah But came to them Allah from where not they expected and He cast into their hearts [the] terror they destroyed their houses with their hands and the hands (of) the believers So take a lesson O those endowed (with) insight

59:3
