  • [2] Ellipsis. The omitted phrase is, 'it will be better for you.'

item.title: At-Tahrim:5
item.description:
At-Tahrim:5 - عَسٰۤی رَبُّهُ إِنْ طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِنْكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا
ʿasā rabbuhu in ṭallaqakunna an yub'dilahu azwājan khayran minkunna mus'limātin mu'minātin qānitātin tāibātin ʿābidātin sāiḥātin thayyibātin wa-abkāran
Perhaps his Lord if he divorced you that He will substitute for him wives better than you submissive faithful obedient repentant who worship who fast previously married and virgins

item.title: At-Tahrim:6
item.description:
At-Tahrim:6 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا قُوْۤا أَنْفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū qū anfusakum wa-ahlīkum nāran waqūduhā l-nāsu wal-ḥijāratu ʿalayhā malāikatun ghilāẓun shidādun lā yaʿṣūna l-laha mā amarahum wayafʿalūna mā yu'marūna
O you those who(believe) believe Protect yourselves and your families (from) a Fire whose fuel (is) people and stones over it (are) Angels stern severe not they disobey Allah (in) what He Commands them but they do what they are commanded

item.title: At-Tahrim:7
item.description:
At-Tahrim:7 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
yāayyuhā alladhīna kafarū lā taʿtadhirū l-yawma innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna
O (you) who disbelieve (Do) not make excuses today Only you will be recompensed (for) what you used to do

item.title: At-Tahrim:8
item.description:
At-Tahrim:8 - يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا تُوبُوْۤا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا عَسٰۤی رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū tūbū ilā l-lahi tawbatan naṣūḥan ʿasā rabbukum an yukaffira ʿankum sayyiātikum wayud'khilakum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru yawma lā yukh'zī l-lahu l-nabiya wa-alladhīna āmanū maʿahu nūruhum yasʿā bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-igh'fir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
O you those who(believe) believe Turn to Allah (in) repentance sincere Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your evil deeds and admit you (into) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers (on the) Day not will be disgraced (by) Allah the Prophet and those who believed with him Their light will run before their hands and on their right they will say Our Lord Perfect for us our light and grant forgiveness to us Indeed, You (are) over every thing All-Powerful

item.title: At-Tahrim:9
item.description:
At-Tahrim:9 - يَاأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
yāayyuhā l-nabiyu jāhidi l-kufāra wal-munāfiqīna wa-ugh'luẓ ʿalayhim wamawāhum jahannamu wabi'sa l-maṣīru
O Prophet Strive (against) the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be stern with them And their abode (is) Hell and wretched is the destination

item.title: At-Tahrim:10
item.description:
At-Tahrim:10 - ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ ḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna kafarū im'ra-ata nūḥin wa-im'ra-ata lūṭin kānatā taḥta ʿabdayni min ʿibādinā ṣāliḥayni fakhānatāhumā falam yugh'niyā ʿanhumā mina l-lahi shayan waqīla ud'khulā l-nāra maʿa l-dākhilīna Presents Allah an example for those who disbelieved (the) wife (of) Nuh (and the) wife (of) Lut They were under two [slaves] of Our slaves righteous but they both betrayed them so not they availed both of them from Allah (in) anything and it was said Enter the Fire with those who enter
  • [1] That is, Noah and Lot.
  • [2] That is, the wives.

item.title: At-Tahrim:11
item.description:
At-Tahrim:11 - وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
waḍaraba l-lahu mathalan lilladhīna āmanū im'ra-ata fir'ʿawna idh qālat rabbi ib'ni lī ʿindaka baytan fī l-janati wanajjinī min fir'ʿawna waʿamalihi wanajjinī mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna
And presents Allah an example for those who believed (the) wife (of) Firaun when she said My Lord Build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Firaun and his deeds and save me from the people the wrongdoers

item.title: At-Tahrim:12
item.description:
At-Tahrim:12 - وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِیْهِ مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ
wamaryama ib'nata ʿim'rāna allatī aḥṣanat farjahā fanafakhnā fīhi min rūḥinā waṣaddaqat bikalimāti rabbihā wakutubihi wakānat mina l-qānitīna
And Maryam (the) daughter (of) Imran who guarded her chastity so We breathed into it of Our Spirit And she believed (in the) Words (of) her Lord and His Books and she was of the devoutly obedient

item.title: 67. الملك (Al-Mulk)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the statement "Blessed is He in whose hands is all sovereignty". It takes its name from Divine sovereignty (mulk) mentioned in verse 1. The surah challenges the disbelievers with declarations of God's total power over them, and everything else, in this world and the next. It describes the regret the disbelievers will express on the Day of Resurrection (verse 9 ff. and verse 27).
The surah is also known as Control, The Dominion, The Kingdom

67:1
تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
Blessed is He in Whose Hand (is) the Dominion and He (is) over every thing All-Powerful

67:2
اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ
alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūru
The One Who created death and life that He may test you which of you (is) best (in) deed And He (is) the All-Mighty the Oft-Forgiving

67:3
اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا مَا تَرٰی فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرٰی مِنْ فُطُورٍ
alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūrin
The One Who created seven heavens one above another Not you see in (the) creation (of) the Most Gracious any fault So return the vision can you see any flaw

item.title: Al-Mulk:1
item.description:
Al-Mulk:1 - تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun
Blessed is He in Whose Hand (is) the Dominion and He (is) over every thing All-Powerful

item.title: Al-Mulk:2
item.description:
Al-Mulk:2 - اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ
alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalan wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūru
The One Who created death and life that He may test you which of you (is) best (in) deed And He (is) the All-Mighty the Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Al-Mulk:3
item.description:
Al-Mulk:3 - اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا مَا تَرٰی فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ تَفَاوُتٍ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرٰی مِنْ فُطُورٍ
alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan mā tarā fī khalqi l-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūrin
The One Who created seven heavens one above another Not you see in (the) creation (of) the Most Gracious any fault So return the vision can you see any flaw

item.title: Al-Mulk:4
item.description:
Al-Mulk:4 - ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-an wahuwa ḥasīrun
Then return the vision twice (again) Will return to you the vision humbled while it (is) fatigued

item.title: Al-Mulk:5
item.description:
Al-Mulk:5 - وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِلشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ
walaqad zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūman lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba l-saʿīri
And certainly We have beautified the heaven nearest with lamps and We have made them (as) missiles for the devils and We have prepared for them punishment (of) the Blaze

item.title: Al-Mulk:6
item.description:
Al-Mulk:6 - وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ
walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīru
And for those who disbelieved in their Lord (is the) punishment (of) Hell and wretched is the destination

item.title: Al-Mulk:7
item.description:
Al-Mulk:7 - إِذَا أُلْقُوْۤا فِيهَا سَمِعُوْۤا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqan wahiya tafūru
When they are thrown therein they will hear from it an inhaling while it boils up

item.title: Al-Mulk:8
item.description:
Al-Mulk:8 - تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīrun
It almost bursts from rage Every time is thrown therein a group (will) ask them its keepers Did not come to you a warner

item.title: Al-Mulk:9
item.description:
Al-Mulk:9 - قَالُوْا بَلَى قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ
qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīrin
They will say Yes indeed came to us a warner but we denied and we said Not has sent down Allah any thing Not you (are) but in error great

item.title: Al-Mulk:10
item.description:
Al-Mulk:10 - وَقَالُوْۤا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi l-saʿīri
And they will say If we had listened or reasoned not we (would) have been among (the) companions (of) the Blaze

item.title: Al-Mulk:11
item.description:
Al-Mulk:11 - فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ
fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qan li-aṣḥābi l-saʿīri
Then they (will) confess their sins so away with (the) companions (of) the Blaze

item.title: Al-Mulk:12
item.description:
Al-Mulk:12 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratun wa-ajrun kabīrun
Indeed those who fear their Lord unseen for them (is) forgiveness and a reward great

item.title: Al-Mulk:13
item.description:
Al-Mulk:13 - وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوْۤا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِیْمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri
And conceal your speech or proclaim it Indeed, He (is the) All-Knower of what (is in) the breasts

item.title: Al-Mulk:14
item.description:
Al-Mulk:14 - أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīru
Does not know (the One) Who created And He (is) the Subtle the All-Aware

item.title: Al-Mulk:15
item.description:
Al-Mulk:15 - هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوْۤا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْۤا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū min riz'qihi wa-ilayhi l-nushūru
He (is) the One Who made for you the earth subservient so walk in (the) paths thereof and eat of His provision and to Him (is) the Resurrection

item.title: Al-Mulk:16
item.description:
Al-Mulk:16 - ءَأَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
a-amintum man fī l-samāi an yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūru
Do you feel secure (from Him) Who (is) in the heaven not He will cause to swallow you the earth when it sways

item.title: Al-Mulk:17
item.description:
Al-Mulk:17 - أَمْ أَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ أَنْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
am amintum man fī l-samāi an yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīri
Or do you feel secure (from Him) Who (is) in the heaven that He will send against you a storm of stones Then you would know how (was) My warning

item.title: Al-Mulk:18
item.description:
Al-Mulk:18 - وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīri And indeed denied those from before them and how was My rejection
  • [1] Or, 'how was My requital.'

item.title: Al-Mulk:19
item.description:
Al-Mulk:19 - أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ
awalam yaraw ilā l-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātin wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā l-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīrun
Do not they see to the birds above them spreading (their wings) and folding Not holds them except the Most Gracious Indeed, He (is) of every thing All-Seer

item.title: Al-Mulk:20
item.description:
Al-Mulk:20 - أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ دُونِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ
amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundun lakum yanṣurukum min dūni l-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūrin
Who is this the one he (is) an army for you to help you from besides the Most Gracious Not (are) the disbelievers but in delusion

item.title: Al-Mulk:21
item.description:
Al-Mulk:21 - أَمَّنْ هَذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ بَلْ لَجُّوْۤا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwin wanufūrin
Who is this the one to provide you if He withheld His provision Nay they persist in pride and aversion

item.title: Al-Mulk:22
item.description:
Al-Mulk:22 - أَفَمَنْ يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَى أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
afaman yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā amman yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin
Then is he who walks fallen on his face better guided or (he) who walks upright on (the) Path Straight

item.title: Al-Mulk:23
item.description:
Al-Mulk:23 - قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ
qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna
Say He (is) the One Who produced you and made for you the hearing and the vision and the feelings Little (is) what you give thanks

item.title: Al-Mulk:24
item.description:
Al-Mulk:24 - قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna
Say He (is) the One Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be gathered

item.title: Al-Mulk:25
item.description:
Al-Mulk:25 - وَيَقُولُونَ مَتٰی هَذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna
And they say When (is) this promise if you are truthful

item.title: Al-Mulk:26
item.description:
Al-Mulk:26 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrun mubīnun
Say Only the knowledge (is) with Allah and only I am a warner clear

item.title: Al-Mulk:27
item.description:
Al-Mulk:27 - فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا وَقِيلَ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ
falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūna
But when they (will) see it approaching (will be) distressed (the) faces (of) those who disbelieved and it will be said This (is) that which you used to for it call

item.title: Al-Mulk:28
item.description:
Al-Mulk:28 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ مَعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَنْ يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu waman maʿiya aw raḥimanā faman yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīmin
Say Have you seen if destroys me Allah and whoever (is) with me or has mercy upon us then who (can) protect the disbelievers from a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Mulk:29
item.description:
Al-Mulk:29 - قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ
qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīnin
Say He (is) the Most Gracious we believe in Him and upon Him we put (our) trust So you will know who (is) it (that is) in error clear

item.title: Al-Mulk:30
item.description:
Al-Mulk:30 - قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِمَاءٍ مَعِينٍ
qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīnin
Say Have you seen if becomes your water sunken then who could bring you water flowing

item.title: 68. القلم (Al-Qalam)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the single discrete Arabic letter Nūn and the oath of the Divine One swearing by the instrument of The Pen, as well as all knowledge that people are able to preserve and communicate thereby. It takes its name from "the pen" (al-qalam) mentioned in verse 1. The surah deals with the accusation that Muḥammad was not God's Messenger but merely mad (verse 2 ff.). The arrogance of those who assume that, because they have some of the good things in this life, they can reject the Revelation, is rebutted (verse 10 ff.). Examples are given of those who came to regret their arrogance (verse 17 ff.). The Prophet is urged to remain steadfast (verse 48 ff.).

68:1
ن وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
noon wal-qalami wamā yasṭurūna
Nun By the pen and what they write

68:2
مَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
mā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bimajnūnin
Not you (are) by (the) Grace (of) your Lord a madman

68:3
وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
wa-inna laka la-ajran ghayra mamnūnin
And indeed for you surely (is) a reward without end

item.title: Al-Qalam:1
item.description:
Al-Qalam:1 - ن وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
noon wal-qalami wamā yasṭurūna
Nun By the pen and what they write

item.title: Al-Qalam:2
item.description:
Al-Qalam:2 - مَا أَنْتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
mā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bimajnūnin
Not you (are) by (the) Grace (of) your Lord a madman

item.title: Al-Qalam:3
item.description:
Al-Qalam:3 - وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
wa-inna laka la-ajran ghayra mamnūnin
And indeed for you surely (is) a reward without end

item.title: Al-Qalam:4
item.description:
Al-Qalam:4 - وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَى خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
wa-innaka laʿalā khuluqin ʿaẓīmin
And indeed, you surely (are) (of) a moral character great

item.title: Al-Qalam:5
item.description:
Al-Qalam:5 - فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
fasatub'ṣiru wayub'ṣirūna
So you will see and they will see

item.title: Al-Qalam:6
item.description:
Al-Qalam:6 - بِأَيِّيكُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ
bi-ayyikumu l-maftūnu
Which of you (is) the afflicted one

item.title: Al-Qalam:7
item.description:
Al-Qalam:7 - إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīna
Indeed your Lord He (is) most knowing of (he) who has strayed from His way and He (is) most knowing of the guided ones

item.title: Al-Qalam:8
item.description:
Al-Qalam:8 - فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ
falā tuṭiʿi l-mukadhibīna
So (do) not obey the deniers

item.title: Al-Qalam:9
item.description:
Al-Qalam:9 - وَدُّوْۤا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
waddū law tud'hinu fayud'hinūna
They wish that you should compromise so they would compromise

item.title: Al-Qalam:10
item.description:
Al-Qalam:10 - وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَهِينٍ
walā tuṭiʿ kulla ḥallāfin mahīnin
And (do) not obey every habitual swearer worthless

item.title: Al-Qalam:11
item.description:
Al-Qalam:11 - هَمَّازٍ مَشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ
hammāzin mashāin binamīmin
Defamer going about with malicious gossip

item.title: Al-Qalam:12
item.description:
Al-Qalam:12 - مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin athīmin
A preventer of (the) good transgressor sinful

item.title: Al-Qalam:13
item.description:
Al-Qalam:13 - عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
ʿutullin baʿda dhālika zanīmin
Cruel after (all) that utterly useless

item.title: Al-Qalam:14
item.description:
Al-Qalam:14 - أَنْ كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
an kāna dhā mālin wabanīna
Because (he) is a possessor (of) wealth and children

item.title: Al-Qalam:15
item.description:
Al-Qalam:15 - إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna
When are recited to him Our Verses he says Stories (of) the former (people)

item.title: Al-Qalam:16
item.description:
Al-Qalam:16 - سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ
sanasimuhu ʿalā l-khur'ṭūmi
We will brand him on the snout

item.title: Al-Qalam:17
item.description:
Al-Qalam:17 - إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوْۤا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ innā balawnāhum kamā balawnā aṣḥāba l-janati idh aqsamū layaṣrimunnahā muṣ'biḥīna Indeed, We have tried them as We tried (the) companions (of) the garden when they swore to pluck its fruit (in the) morning
  • [1] That is, the people of Makkah, through famine and hunger.

item.title: Al-Qalam:18
item.description:
Al-Qalam:18 - وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ walā yastathnūna And not making exception
  • [1] That is, for Allah's will, by saying, for instance, 'God willing.' See (Q 18:24).

item.title: Al-Qalam:19
item.description:
Al-Qalam:19 - فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَائِفٌ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāifun min rabbika wahum nāimūna So there came upon it a visitation from your Lord while they were asleep
  • [1] That is, the garden.

item.title: Al-Qalam:20
item.description:
Al-Qalam:20 - فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيمِ fa-aṣbaḥat kal-ṣarīmi So it became as if reaped
  • [1] Or 'like a sand dune,' or 'like a gloomy night,' or 'like black ashes.'

item.title: Al-Qalam:21
item.description:
Al-Qalam:21 - فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِينَ
fatanādaw muṣ'biḥīna
And they called one another (at) morning

item.title: Al-Qalam:22
item.description:
Al-Qalam:22 - أَنِ اغْدُوْۤا عَلَى حَرْثِكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَارِمِينَ
ani igh'dū ʿalā ḥarthikum in kuntum ṣārimīna
That Go early to your crop if you would pluck (the) fruit

item.title: Al-Qalam:23
item.description:
Al-Qalam:23 - فَانْطَلَقُوا وَهُمْ يَتَخَافَتُونَ
fa-inṭalaqū wahum yatakhāfatūna
So they went while they lowered (their) voices

item.title: Al-Qalam:24
item.description:
Al-Qalam:24 - أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِسْكِينٌ
an lā yadkhulannahā l-yawma ʿalaykum mis'kīnun
That Not will enter it today upon you any poor person

item.title: Al-Qalam:25
item.description:
Al-Qalam:25 - وَغَدَوْا عَلَى حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ
waghadaw ʿalā ḥardin qādirīna
And they went early with determination able

item.title: Al-Qalam:26
item.description:
Al-Qalam:26 - فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوْا إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ
falammā ra-awhā qālū innā laḍāllūna
But when they saw it they said Indeed, we (are) surely lost

item.title: Al-Qalam:27
item.description:
Al-Qalam:27 - بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
bal naḥnu maḥrūmūna
Nay We (are) deprived

item.title: Al-Qalam:28
item.description:
Al-Qalam:28 - قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
qāla awsaṭuhum alam aqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūna
Said (the) most moderate of them Did not I tell you 'Why not you glorify (Allah)?'

item.title: Al-Qalam:29
item.description:
Al-Qalam:29 - قَالُوْا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
qālū sub'ḥāna rabbinā innā kunnā ẓālimīna
They said Glory be (to) our Lord Indeed, we [we] were wrongdoers

item.title: Al-Qalam:30
item.description:
Al-Qalam:30 - فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ يَتَلَاوَمُونَ
fa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatalāwamūna
Then approached some of them to others blaming each other

item.title: Al-Qalam:31
item.description:
Al-Qalam:31 - قَالُوْا يَاوَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا طَاغِينَ
qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ṭāghīna
They said O woe to us Indeed, we [we] were transgressors

item.title: Al-Qalam:32
item.description:
Al-Qalam:32 - عَسٰۤی رَبُّنَا أَنْ يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا إِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا رَاغِبُونَ
ʿasā rabbunā an yub'dilanā khayran min'hā innā ilā rabbinā rāghibūna
Perhaps our Lord that will substitute for us a better than it Indeed, we to our Lord turn devoutly

item.title: Al-Qalam:33
item.description:
Al-Qalam:33 - كَذٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُوْۤا يَعْلَمُونَ
kadhālika l-ʿadhābu walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna
Such (is) the punishment And surely the punishment (of) the Hereafter (is) greater if they know

item.title: Al-Qalam:34
item.description:
Al-Qalam:34 - إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
inna lil'muttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti l-naʿīmi
Indeed for the righteous with their Lord (are) Gardens (of) Delight

item.title: Al-Qalam:35
item.description:
Al-Qalam:35 - أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ
afanajʿalu l-mus'limīna kal-muj'rimīna
Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals

item.title: Al-Qalam:36
item.description:
Al-Qalam:36 - مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
mā lakum kayfa taḥkumūna
What (is) for you How (do) you judge

item.title: Al-Qalam:37
item.description:
Al-Qalam:37 - أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِیْهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
am lakum kitābun fīhi tadrusūna
Or (is) for you a book wherein you learn

item.title: Al-Qalam:38
item.description:
Al-Qalam:38 - إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِیْهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ inna lakum fīhi lamā takhayyarūna Indeed for you in it what you choose
  • [1] That is, in the next world.

item.title: Al-Qalam:39
item.description:
Al-Qalam:39 - أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūna
Or for you oaths from us reaching to (the) Day (of) the Resurrection indeed for you (is) what you judge

item.title: Al-Qalam:40
item.description:
Al-Qalam:40 - سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
salhum ayyuhum bidhālika zaʿīmun
Ask them which of them for that (is) responsible

item.title: Al-Qalam:41
item.description:
Al-Qalam:41 - أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِنْ كَانُوْۤا صَادِقِينَ
am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīna
Or (are) for them partners Then let them bring their partners if they are truthful

item.title: Al-Qalam:42
item.description:
Al-Qalam:42 - يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūna (The) Day will be uncovered from the shin and they will be called to prostrate but not they will be able
  • [1] Literally, 'when the shank is uncovered,' an idiom implying the occurrence of a calamity, or a disclosure and denouement.

item.title: Al-Qalam:43
item.description:
Al-Qalam:43 - خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ وَقَدْ كَانُوْۤا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ
khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūna
Humbled their eyes will cover them humiliation And indeed they were called to prostrate while they (were) sound

item.title: Al-Qalam:44
item.description:
Al-Qalam:44 - فَذَرْنِي وَمَنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna
So leave Me and whoever denies this Statement We will progressively lead them from where not they know

item.title: Al-Qalam:45
item.description:
Al-Qalam:45 - وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ
wa-um'lī lahum inna kaydī matīnun
And I will give respite to them Indeed My plan (is) firm

item.title: Al-Qalam:46
item.description:
Al-Qalam:46 - أَمْ تَسْءَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ
am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna
Or you ask them a payment so they from (the) debt (are) burdened

item.title: Al-Qalam:47
item.description:
Al-Qalam:47 - أَمْ عِنْدَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna
Or (is) with them the unseen so they write it

item.title: Al-Qalam:48
item.description:
Al-Qalam:48 - فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَى وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun So be patient for (the) decision (of) your Lord and (do) not be like (the) companion (of) the fish when he called out while he (was) distressed
  • [1] That is, Jonah. See (Q 21:87).

item.title: Al-Qalam:49
item.description:
Al-Qalam:49 - لَوْلَا أَنْ تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmun
If not that overtook him a Favor from his Lord surely he would have been thrown onto (the) naked shore while he (was) blamed

item.title: Al-Qalam:50
item.description:
Al-Qalam:50 - فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
fa-ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fajaʿalahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna
But chose him his Lord and made him of the righteous

item.title: Al-Qalam:51
item.description:
Al-Qalam:51 - وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوْۤا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ
wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnun
And indeed would almost those who disbelieve surely make you slip with their look when they hear the Message and they say Indeed, he (is) surely mad

item.title: Al-Qalam:52
item.description:
Al-Qalam:52 - وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
wamā huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna
And not it (is) but a Reminder to the worlds

item.title: 69. الحاقة (Al-Haaqqa)
item.description:
The surah that opens by proclaiming one of the names of the Day of Resurrection, The Inevitable reality or hour, so named because in the matter of truth shall forever be decided then and all truth shall prevail regarding every affair. It takes its name from the Inevitable or Besieger (al-Ḥāqqah) mentioned in verse 1. The surah describes punishment in this life (verse 4 ff.) and the next (verse 13 ff.). The bliss to be enjoyed by the believers is eloquently contrasted with the torments of hell (verse 19 ff.). From verse 38 onwards, God affirms the Truth of the Quran and the Prophet.
The surah is also known as Reality, The Catastrophe, The Concrete Reality, The Indubitable, The Inevitable Hour, The Inevitable Reality, The Sure Occurrence, The Sure Reality, The Undeniable

69:1
اَلْحَاقَّةُ
al-ḥāqatu
The Inevitable Reality

69:2
مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
mā l-ḥāqatu
What (is) the Inevitable Reality

69:3
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
wamā adrāka mā l-ḥāqatu
And what will make you know what (is) the Inevitable Reality

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:1
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:1 - اَلْحَاقَّةُ al-ḥāqatu The Inevitable Reality
  • [1] Or 'the Inevitable.' That is, the Day of Resurrection.

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:2
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:2 - مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
mā l-ḥāqatu
What (is) the Inevitable Reality

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:3
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:3 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ
wamā adrāka mā l-ḥāqatu
And what will make you know what (is) the Inevitable Reality

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:4
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:4 - كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌ بِالْقَارِعَةِ
kadhabat thamūdu waʿādun bil-qāriʿati
Denied Thamud and Aad the Striking Calamity

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:5
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:5 - فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ
fa-ammā thamūdu fa-uh'likū bil-ṭāghiyati
So as for Thamud they were destroyed by the overpowering (blast)

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:6
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:6 - وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
wa-ammā ʿādun fa-uh'likū birīḥin ṣarṣarin ʿātiyatin
And as for Aad they were destroyed by a wind screaming violent

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:7
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:7 - سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرٰی الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَى كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ sakharahā ʿalayhim sabʿa layālin wathamāniyata ayyāmin ḥusūman fatarā l-qawma fīhā ṣarʿā ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin khāwiyatin Which He imposed upon them (for) seven nights and eight days (in) succession so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were trunks (of) date-palms hollow
  • [1] Or 'successive.'

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:8
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:8 - فَهَلْ تَرٰی لَهُمْ مِنْ بَاقِيَةٍ
fahal tarā lahum min bāqiyatin
Then do you see of them any remains

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:9
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:9 - وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ
wajāa fir'ʿawnu waman qablahu wal-mu'tafikātu bil-khāṭi-ati
And came Firaun and (those) before him and the overturned cities with sin

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:10
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:10 - فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَابِيَةً
faʿaṣaw rasūla rabbihim fa-akhadhahum akhdhatan rābiyatan
And they disobeyed (the) Messenger (of) their Lord so He seized them (with) a seizure exceeding

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:11
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:11 - إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ
innā lammā ṭaghā l-māu ḥamalnākum fī l-jāriyati
Indeed, We when overflowed the water We carried you in the sailing (ship)

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:12
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:12 - لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ
linajʿalahā lakum tadhkiratan wataʿiyahā udhunun wāʿiyatun
That We might make it for you a reminder and would be conscious of it an ear conscious

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:13
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:13 - فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri nafkhatun wāḥidatun
Then when is blown in the trumpet a blast single

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:14
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:14 - وَحُمِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً waḥumilati l-arḍu wal-jibālu fadukkatā dakkatan wāḥidatan And are lifted the earth and the mountains and crushed (with) a crushing single
  • [1] Or 'crumbled with a single crumbling.'

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:15
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:15 - فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ fayawma-idhin waqaʿati l-wāqiʿatu Then (on) that Day will occur the Occurrence
  • [1] Cf. (Q 56:1) - (Q 56:6).

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:16
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:16 - وَانْشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
wa-inshaqqati l-samāu fahiya yawma-idhin wāhiyatun
And will split the heaven so it (is on) that Day frail

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:17
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:17 - وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَى أَرْجَائِهَا وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ
wal-malaku ʿalā arjāihā wayaḥmilu ʿarsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-idhin thamāniyatun
And the Angels (will be) on its edges and will bear (the) Throne (of) your Lord above them that Day eight

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:18
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:18 - يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَى مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
yawma-idhin tuʿ'raḍūna lā takhfā minkum khāfiyatun
That Day you will be exhibited not will be hidden among you any secret

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:19
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:19 - فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوْۤا كِتَابِيَهْ
fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi fayaqūlu hāumu iq'raū kitābiyah
Then as for (him) who is given his record in his right hand will say Here read my record

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:20
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:20 - اِنِّیْ ظَنَنْتُ أَنِّي مُلَاقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
innī ẓanantu annī mulāqin ḥisābiyah
Indeed, I was certain that I (will) meet my account

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:21
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:21 - فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ
fahuwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyatin
So he (will be) in a life pleasant

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:22
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:22 - فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
fī jannatin ʿāliyatin
In a Garden elevated

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:23
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:23 - قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
quṭūfuhā dāniyatun
Its clusters of fruits hanging near

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:24
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:24 - كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ
kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā aslaftum fī l-ayāmi l-khāliyati
Eat and drink (in) satisfaction for what you sent before you in the days past

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:25
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:25 - وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ
wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu bishimālihi fayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ūta kitābiyah
But as for (him) who is given his record in his left hand will say O! I wish not I had been given my record

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:26
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:26 - وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
walam adri mā ḥisābiyah
And not I had known what (is) my account

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:27
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:27 - يَا‎لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ
yālaytahā kānati l-qāḍiyata
O! I wish it had been the end

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:28
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:28 - مَا أَغْنَى عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ
mā aghnā ʿannī māliyah
Not has availed me my wealth

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:29
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:29 - هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ
halaka ʿannī sul'ṭāniyah
Is gone from me my authority

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:30
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:30 - خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
khudhūhu faghullūhu
Seize him and shackle him

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:31
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:31 - ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
thumma l-jaḥīma ṣallūhu
Then (into) the Hellfire burn him

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:32
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:32 - ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ
thumma fī sil'silatin dharʿuhā sabʿūna dhirāʿan fa-us'lukūhu
Then into a chain its length (is) seventy cubits insert him

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:33
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:33 - إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
innahu kāna lā yu'minu bil-lahi l-ʿaẓīmi
Indeed, he was not believing in Allah the Most Great

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:34
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:34 - وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīni
And (did) not feel the urge on (the) feeding (of) the poor

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:35
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:35 - فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
falaysa lahu l-yawma hāhunā ḥamīmun
So not for him today here any devoted friend

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:36
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:36 - وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
walā ṭaʿāmun illā min ghis'līnin
And not any food except from (the) discharge of wounds

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:37
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:37 - لَا يَأْكُلُهُ إِلَّا الْخَاطِءُونَ
lā yakuluhu illā l-khāṭiūna
Not will eat it except the sinners

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:38
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:38 - فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
falā uq'simu bimā tub'ṣirūna
But nay I swear by what you see

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:39
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:39 - وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
wamā lā tub'ṣirūna
And what not you see

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:40
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:40 - إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin
Indeed, it (is) surely (the) Word (of) a Messenger noble

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:41
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:41 - وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ
wamā huwa biqawli shāʿirin qalīlan mā tu'minūna
And not it (is the) word (of) a poet little (is) what you believe

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:42
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:42 - وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
walā biqawli kāhinin qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna
And not (it is the) word (of) a soothsayer little (is) what you take heed

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:43
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:43 - تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
tanzīlun min rabbi l-ʿālamīna
(It is) a revelation from (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:44
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:44 - وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ
walaw taqawwala ʿalaynā baʿḍa l-aqāwīli
And if he (had) fabricated against Us some sayings

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:45
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:45 - لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ
la-akhadhnā min'hu bil-yamīni
Certainly We (would) have seized him by the right hand

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:46
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:46 - ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ
thumma laqaṭaʿnā min'hu l-watīna
Then certainly We (would) have cut off from him the aorta

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:47
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:47 - فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
famā minkum min aḥadin ʿanhu ḥājizīna
And not from you any one from him (who could) prevent (it)

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:48
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:48 - وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
wa-innahu latadhkiratun lil'muttaqīna
And indeed, it (is) surely a reminder for the Allah-fearing

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:49
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:49 - وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُكَذِّبِينَ
wa-innā lanaʿlamu anna minkum mukadhibīna
And indeed, We surely know that among you (are) deniers

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:50
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:50 - وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
wa-innahu laḥasratun ʿalā l-kāfirīna
And indeed, it (is) surely a regret upon the disbelievers

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:51
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:51 - وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ
wa-innahu laḥaqqu l-yaqīni
And indeed, it (is) surely (the) truth (of) certainty

item.title: Al-Haaqqa:52
item.description:
Al-Haaqqa:52 - فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ
fasabbiḥ bi-is'mi rabbika l-ʿaẓīmi
So glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most Great

item.title: 70. المعارج (Al-Ma'aarij)
item.description:
The surah that proclaims God to be the Lord of the heavenly ascents, Lofty Stations, the points of rising from which the angels ascend to God. It takes is named after the phrase "of lofty stations" (dhi al-ma'ārij) in verse 3. The surah describes the Day of Judgement (verse 8 ff.). One of the opponents of the Prophet challenged him to hasten the punishment they had been threatened with (verse 1), so the foolishness of the disbelievers in denying the Resurrection (verse 6) is exposed (verse 36 ff.). The people who will be granted the Garden are described (verse 22 ff.).
The surah is also known as Elevations, Staircases Upward, The Ascending Steps, The Heavenly Ascents, The Ladders, The Stairways, The Steps, The Ways of Ascent

70:1
سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿin
Asked a questioner about a punishment bound to happen

70:2
لِلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ
lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿun
To the disbelievers not of it any preventer

70:3
مِنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ
mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿāriji
From Allah Owner (of) the ways of ascent

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:1
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:1 - سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
sa-ala sāilun biʿadhābin wāqiʿin
Asked a questioner about a punishment bound to happen

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:2
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:2 - لِلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ lil'kāfirīna laysa lahu dāfiʿun To the disbelievers not of it any preventer
  • [1] Or 'bound to befall the faithless—which none can avert—from Allah…'

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:3
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:3 - مِنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ
mina l-lahi dhī l-maʿāriji
From Allah Owner (of) the ways of ascent

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:4
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:4 - تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanatin
Ascend the Angels and the Spirit to Him in a Day is its measure (is) fifty thousand year(s)

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:5
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:5 - فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
fa-iṣ'bir ṣabran jamīlan
So be patient a patience good

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:6
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:6 - إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا
innahum yarawnahu baʿīdan
Indeed, they see it (as) far off

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:7
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:7 - وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا
wanarāhu qarīban
But We see it near

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:8
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:8 - يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ
yawma takūnu l-samāu kal-muh'li
(The) Day will be the sky like molten copper

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:9
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:9 - وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ
watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni
And will be the mountains like wool

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:10
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:10 - وَلَا يَسْءَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
walā yasalu ḥamīmun ḥamīman
And not will ask a friend (about) a friend

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:11
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:11 - يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ
yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīhi
They will be made to see each other Would wish the criminal if he (could be) ransomed from (the) punishment (of) that Day by his children

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:12
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:12 - وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ
waṣāḥibatihi wa-akhīhi
And his spouse and his brother

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:13
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:13 - وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُءْوِيهِ
wafaṣīlatihi allatī tu'wīhi
And his nearest kindred who sheltered him

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:14
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:14 - وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ
waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīhi
And whoever (is) on the earth all then it (could) save him

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:15
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:15 - كَلَّا إِنَّهَا لَظَى
kallā innahā laẓā
By no means Indeed, it (is) surely a Flame of Hell

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:16
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:16 - نَزَّاعَةً لِلشَّوَى
nazzāʿatan lilshawā
A remover of the skin of the head

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:17
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:17 - تَدْعُوْۤا مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّى
tadʿū man adbara watawallā
Inviting (him) who turned his back and went away

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:18
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:18 - وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَى
wajamaʿa fa-awʿā
And collected and hoarded

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:19
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:19 - إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
inna l-insāna khuliqa halūʿan
Indeed the man was created anxious

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:20
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:20 - إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
idhā massahu l-sharu jazūʿan
When touches him the evil distressed

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:21
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:21 - وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
wa-idhā massahu l-khayru manūʿan
And when touches him the good withholding

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:22
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:22 - إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ
illā l-muṣalīna
Except those who pray

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:23
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:23 - اَلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ
alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim dāimūna
Those who they at their prayer (are) constant

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:24
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:24 - وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَعْلُومٌ
wa-alladhīna fī amwālihim ḥaqqun maʿlūmun
And those who in their wealth (is) a right known

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:25
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:25 - لِلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ
lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi
For the one who asks and the deprived

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:26
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:26 - وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
wa-alladhīna yuṣaddiqūna biyawmi l-dīni
And those who accept (the) truth (of the) Day (of) the Judgment

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:27
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:27 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūna
And those who they of (the) punishment (of) their Lord (are) fearful

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:28
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:28 - إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
inna ʿadhāba rabbihim ghayru mamūnin
Indeed (the) punishment (of) your Lord (is) not to be felt secure (of)

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:29
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:29 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna
And those who they their modesty (are) guardians

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:30
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:30 - إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna
Except from their spouses or what they possess rightfully then indeed, they (are) not blameworthy

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:31
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:31 - فَمَنِ ابْتَغَى وَرَاءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ
famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna
But whoever seeks beyond that then those they (are) the transgressors

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:32
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:32 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna
And those who they of their trusts and their promise (are) observers

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:33
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:33 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum bishahādātihim qāimūna
And those who they in their testimonies stand firm

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:34
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:34 - وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūna
And those who they on their prayer keep a guard

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:35
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:35 - اُولٰٓئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُكْرَمُونَ
ulāika fī jannātin muk'ramūna
Those (will be) in Gardens honored

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:36
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:36 - فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
famāli alladhīna kafarū qibalaka muh'ṭiʿīna
So what is with those who disbelieve before you (they) hasten

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:37
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:37 - عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli ʿizīna
On the right and on the left (in) separate groups

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:38
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:38 - أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmin
Does long every person among them that he enters a Garden (of) Delight

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:39
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:39 - كَلَّا إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُمْ مِمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ kallā innā khalaqnāhum mimmā yaʿlamūna By no means Indeed, We [We] have created them from what they know
  • [1] That is, from a drop of sperm.

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:40
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:40 - فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ
falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūna
But nay I swear by (the) Lord (of) the risings and the settings that We (are) surely Able

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:41
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:41 - عَلَى أَنْ نُبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ʿalā an nubaddila khayran min'hum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna
On to [We] replace (with) better than them and not We (are) to be outrun

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:42
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:42 - فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوْۤا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتّٰی يُلَاقُوْۤا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna
So leave them (to) converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:43
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:43 - يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūna
(The) Day they will come out from the graves rapidly as if they (were) to a goal hastening

item.title: Al-Ma'aarij:44
item.description:
Al-Ma'aarij:44 - خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوْۤا يُوعَدُونَ
khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūna
Humbled their eyesights will cover them humiliation That (is) the Day which they were promised

item.title: 71. نوح (Nooh)
item.description:
That surah that opens with the story of the ancient Prophet Noah, the unrelenting Messenger of Resolve, and his obstinately unbelieving people. It is named after Noah (Nūḥ) whose account is related in the surah and further gives details of the life of Noah before the Flood, to encourage the Prophet and warn the disbelievers.

71:1
إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmun
Indeed, We [We] sent Nuh to his people that Warn your people from before that comes to them a punishment painful

71:2
قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun
He said O my people Indeed, I am to you a warner clear

71:3
أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni
That Worship Allah and fear Him and obey me

item.title: Nooh:1
item.description:
Nooh:1 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَى قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmun
Indeed, We [We] sent Nuh to his people that Warn your people from before that comes to them a punishment painful

item.title: Nooh:2
item.description:
Nooh:2 - قَالَ يَاقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun
He said O my people Indeed, I am to you a warner clear

item.title: Nooh:3
item.description:
Nooh:3 - أَنِ اعْبُدُوْۤا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni
That Worship Allah and fear Him and obey me

item.title: Nooh:4
item.description:
Nooh:4 - يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūna
He will forgive for you of your sins and give you respite for a term specified Indeed (the) term (of) Allah when it comes not is delayed if you know

item.title: Nooh:5
item.description:
Nooh:5 - قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāran
He said My Lord Indeed, I invited my people night and day

item.title: Nooh:6
item.description:
Nooh:6 - فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَاءِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا
falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāran
But not increased them my invitation except (in) flight

item.title: Nooh:7
item.description:
Nooh:7 - وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْۤا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي اٰذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا
wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāran
And indeed, I every time I invited them that You may forgive them they put their fingers in their ears and covered themselves (with) their garments and persisted and were arrogant (with) pride

item.title: Nooh:8
item.description:
Nooh:8 - ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāran
Then indeed, I invited them publicly

item.title: Nooh:9
item.description:
Nooh:9 - ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāran
Then indeed, I announced to them and I confided to them secretly

item.title: Nooh:10
item.description:
Nooh:10 - فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran
Then I said Ask forgiveness (from) your Lord Indeed, He is Oft-Forgiving

item.title: Nooh:11
item.description:
Nooh:11 - يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِدْرَارًا
yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran
He will send down (rain from) the sky upon you (in) abundance

item.title: Nooh:12
item.description:
Nooh:12 - وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهَارًا
wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāran
And provide you with wealth and children and make for you gardens and make for you rivers

item.title: Nooh:13
item.description:
Nooh:13 - مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāran
What (is) for you not you attribute to Allah grandeur

item.title: Nooh:14
item.description:
Nooh:14 - وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
waqad khalaqakum aṭwāran
And indeed He created you (in) stages

item.title: Nooh:15
item.description:
Nooh:15 - أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا
alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan
Do not you see how did create Allah (the) seven heavens (in) layers

item.title: Nooh:16
item.description:
Nooh:16 - وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirājan
And made the moon therein a light and made the sun a lamp

item.title: Nooh:17
item.description:
Nooh:17 - وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabātan
And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth (as) a growth

item.title: Nooh:18
item.description:
Nooh:18 - ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rājan
Then He will return you into it and bring you forth (a new) bringing forth

item.title: Nooh:19
item.description:
Nooh:19 - وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭan
And Allah made for you the earth an expanse

item.title: Nooh:20
item.description:
Nooh:20 - لِتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
litaslukū min'hā subulan fijājan
That you may go along therein (in) paths wide

item.title: Nooh:21
item.description:
Nooh:21 - قَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَنْ لَمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāran
Said Nuh My Lord Indeed, they disobeyed me and followed (the one) who (did) not increase him his wealth and his children except (in) loss

item.title: Nooh:22
item.description:
Nooh:22 - وَمَكَرُوْۤا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
wamakarū makran kubbāran
And they have planned a plan great

item.title: Nooh:23
item.description:
Nooh:23 - وَقَالُوْۤا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasran And they said (Do) not leave your gods and (do) not leave Wadd and not Suwa and not Yaguth and Yauq and Nasr
  • [1] Names of Babylonian gods worshipped by the polytheists.

item.title: Nooh:24
item.description:
Nooh:24 - وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوْۤا كَثِيرًا وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا
waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālan
And indeed they have led astray many And not increase the wrongdoers except (in) error

item.title: Nooh:25
item.description:
Nooh:25 - مِمَّا خَطِيءَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوْۤا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوْۤا لَهُمْ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنْصَارًا
mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāran
Because of their sins they were drowned then made to enter (the) Fire and not they found for themselves from besides Allah any helpers

item.title: Nooh:26
item.description:
Nooh:26 - وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāran
And said Nuh My Lord (Do) not leave on the earth any (of) the disbelievers (as) an inhabitant

item.title: Nooh:27
item.description:
Nooh:27 - إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوْۤا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوْۤا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāran
Indeed, You if You leave them they will mislead Your slaves and not they will beget except a wicked a disbeliever

item.title: Nooh:28
item.description:
Nooh:28 - رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā tabāran
My Lord Forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and the believing women And (do) not increase the wrongdoers except (in) destruction

item.title: 72. الجن (Al-Jinn)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the revelation that a group of The Jinn listened to the Prophet reciting the Quran, believed in it, and so admonished their own race. It is names after the jinn-kind, whose account is given in its first part. The surah begins with the account of what a group of jinn said when they overheard a recitation of the Quran and realized its truth (verse 1 ff.). This is a lesson to the Meccan Arabs, who are also told that the Prophet can help them only by delivering the Message—God is the All Powerful One (verse 16 ff.). The disbelievers are threatened with what they will meet on the Day of Judgement (verse 23 ff).
The surah is also known as Jinn-kind, Sprites, The Jinn's, The Spirits

72:1
قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا
qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaban
Say It has been revealed to me that listened a group of the jinn and they said Indeed, we heard a Quran amazing

72:2
يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا
yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥadan
It guides to the right way so we believe in it and never we will associate with our Lord anyone

72:3
وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā waladan
And that He Exalted is (the) Majesty (of) our Lord not He has taken a wife and not a son

item.title: Al-Jinn:1
item.description:
Al-Jinn:1 - قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaban Say It has been revealed to me that listened a group of the jinn and they said Indeed, we heard a Quran amazing
  • [1] Or 'recital.'

item.title: Al-Jinn:2
item.description:
Al-Jinn:2 - يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَءَامَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا
yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥadan
It guides to the right way so we believe in it and never we will associate with our Lord anyone

item.title: Al-Jinn:3
item.description:
Al-Jinn:3 - وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā waladan
And that He Exalted is (the) Majesty (of) our Lord not He has taken a wife and not a son

item.title: Al-Jinn:4
item.description:
Al-Jinn:4 - وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا
wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭan
And that he used to speak the foolish among us against Allah an excessive transgression

item.title: Al-Jinn:5
item.description:
Al-Jinn:5 - وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ تَقُولَ الْإِنْسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
wa-annā ẓanannā an lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban
And that we thought that never will say the men and the jinn against Allah any lie

item.title: Al-Jinn:6
item.description:
Al-Jinn:6 - وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
wa-annahu kāna rijālun mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqan
And that (there) were men among mankind who sought refuge in (the) men from the jinn so they increased them (in) burden

item.title: Al-Jinn:7
item.description:
Al-Jinn:7 - وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْۤا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنْ لَنْ يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum an lan yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadan And that they thought as you thought that never will raise Allah anyone
  • [1] That is, the humans who invoked the protection of jinns.

item.title: Al-Jinn:8
item.description:
Al-Jinn:8 - وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا wa-annā lamasnā l-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuban And that we sought to touch the heaven but we found it filled (with) guards severe and flaming fires
  • [1] Or 'meteors.'

item.title: Al-Jinn:9
item.description:
Al-Jinn:9 - وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَنْ يَسْتَمِعِ الْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَصَدًا
wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi faman yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihāban raṣadan
And that we used to sit there in positions for hearing but (he) who listens now will find for him a flaming fire waiting

item.title: Al-Jinn:10
item.description:
Al-Jinn:10 - وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadan
And that we not we know whether evil is intended for (those) who (are) in the earth or intends for them their Lord a right path

item.title: Al-Jinn:11
item.description:
Al-Jinn:11 - وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا
wa-annā minnā l-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadan
And that [we] among us (are) the righteous and among us (are) other than that We (are on) ways different

item.title: Al-Jinn:12
item.description:
Al-Jinn:12 - وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَنْ لَنْ نُعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَنْ نُعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
wa-annā ẓanannā an lan nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan nuʿ'jizahu haraban
And that we [we] have become certain that never we will cause failure (to) Allah in the earth and never we can escape Him (by) flight

item.title: Al-Jinn:13
item.description:
Al-Jinn:13 - وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَى اٰمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqan
And that [we] when we heard the Guidance we believed in it And whoever believes in his Lord then not he will fear any loss and not any burden

item.title: Al-Jinn:14
item.description:
Al-Jinn:14 - وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadan And that we among us (are) Muslims and among us (are) unjust And whoever submits then those have sought (the) right path
  • [1] Or 'unjust.'

item.title: Al-Jinn:15
item.description:
Al-Jinn:15 - وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوْۤا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭaban
And as for the unjust they will be for Hell firewood

item.title: Al-Jinn:16
item.description:
Al-Jinn:16 - وَأَلَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُمْ مَاءً غَدَقًا
wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā l-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqan
And that if they had remained on the Way surely We (would) have given them to drink water (in) abundance

item.title: Al-Jinn:17
item.description:
Al-Jinn:17 - لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ وَمَنْ يُعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
linaftinahum fīhi waman yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadan
That We might test them therein And whoever turns away from the Remembrance (of) his Lord He will make him enter a punishment severe

item.title: Al-Jinn:18
item.description:
Al-Jinn:18 - وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْۤا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا
wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadan
And that the masjids (are) for Allah so (do) not call with Allah anyone

item.title: Al-Jinn:19
item.description:
Al-Jinn:19 - وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوْۤا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadan And that when stood up (the) slave (of) Allah calling (upon) Him they almost became around him a compacted mass
  • [1] That is, the Prophet.

item.title: Al-Jinn:20
item.description:
Al-Jinn:20 - قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُوْۤا رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا
qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadan
Say Only I call upon my Lord and not I associate with Him anyone

item.title: Al-Jinn:21
item.description:
Al-Jinn:21 - قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarran walā rashadan
Say Indeed, I (do) not possess for you any harm and not right path

item.title: Al-Jinn:22
item.description:
Al-Jinn:22 - قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَنْ يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِنْ دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا
qul innī lan yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥadun walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadan
Say Indeed I never can protect me from Allah anyone and never can I find from besides Him any refuge

item.title: Al-Jinn:23
item.description:
Al-Jinn:23 - إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا
illā balāghan mina l-lahi warisālātihi waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadan
But (the) notification from Allah and His Messages And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger then indeed for him (is the) Fire (of) Hell (they will) abide therein forever

item.title: Al-Jinn:24
item.description:
Al-Jinn:24 - حَتّٰی إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadadan
Until when they see what they are promised then they will know who (is) weaker (in) helpers and fewer (in) number

item.title: Al-Jinn:25
item.description:
Al-Jinn:25 - قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا
qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadan
Say Not I know whether is near what you are promised or (whether) will appoint for it my Lord a (distant) term

item.title: Al-Jinn:26
item.description:
Al-Jinn:26 - عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَى غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا
ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadan
(The) All-Knower (of) the unseen so not He reveals from His unseen (to) anyone

item.title: Al-Jinn:27
item.description:
Al-Jinn:27 - إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَى مِنْ رَسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا
illā mani ir'taḍā min rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadan
Except whom He has approved of a Messenger and indeed, He makes to march from before him and from behind him a guard

item.title: Al-Jinn:28
item.description:
Al-Jinn:28 - لِيَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ أَبْلَغُوْۤا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا
liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadan
That He may make evident that indeed they have conveyed (the) Messages (of) their Lord and He has encompassed what (is) with them and He takes account (of) all things (in) number

item.title: 73. المزمل (Al-Muzzammil)
item.description:
The surah that opens by addressing the mantled Prophet as the Enwrapped Messenger. It takes its name from the word "wrapped in mantle" (muzzammil) in verse 1. The surah describes how God relaxed the early regime of devotion first imposed on the Prophet (verse 1 ff.) to prepare him for the weighty message. The Prophet is urged to be patient (verse 10 ff.), told of the punishment that awaits the disbelievers in Hell (verse 12 ff.), and reminded of the punishment that befell Pharaoh in this life (verse 15 ff.).
The surah is also known as Bundled up, Enfolded, Folded in Garments, The Enwrapped Messenger, The Enwrapped One, The Mantled One, Wrapped in Mantle

73:1
يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ
yāayyuhā l-muzamilu
O you who wraps himself

73:2
قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
qumi al-layla illā qalīlan
Stand (in) the night except a little

73:3
نِصْفَهُ أَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
niṣ'fahu awi unquṣ min'hu qalīlan
Half of it or lessen from it a little

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:1
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:1 - يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ
yāayyuhā l-muzamilu
O you who wraps himself

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:2
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:2 - قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
qumi al-layla illā qalīlan
Stand (in) the night except a little

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:3
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:3 - نِصْفَهُ أَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
niṣ'fahu awi unquṣ min'hu qalīlan
Half of it or lessen from it a little

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:4
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:4 - أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا
aw zid ʿalayhi warattili l-qur'āna tartīlan
Or add to it and recite the Quran (with) measured rhythmic recitation

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:5
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:5 - إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
innā sanul'qī ʿalayka qawlan thaqīlan
Indeed, We will cast upon you a Word heavy

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:6
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:6 - إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
inna nāshi-ata al-layli hiya ashaddu waṭan wa-aqwamu qīlan
Indeed (the) rising (at) the night it (is) very hard and most potent and more suitable (for) Word

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:7
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:7 - إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
inna laka fī l-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlan
Indeed for you in the day (is) occupation prolonged

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:8
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:8 - وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīlan And remember (the) name (of) your Lord and devote yourself to Him (with) devotion
  • [1] Or 'supplicate with your forefinger pointed towards heaven' (see al-Tafsīr al-Burhān for traditions relating to tabattul).

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:9
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:9 - رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-ittakhidh'hu wakīlan
(The) Lord (of) the east and the west (there is) no god except Him so take Him (as) Disposer of Affairs

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:10
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:10 - وَاصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-uh'jur'hum hajran jamīlan
And be patient over what they say and avoid them an avoidance gracious

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:11
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:11 - وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
wadharnī wal-mukadhibīna ulī l-naʿmati wamahhil'hum qalīlan
And leave Me and the deniers possessors (of) the ease and allow them respite a little

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:12
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:12 - إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنْكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
inna ladaynā ankālan wajaḥīman
Indeed with Us (are) shackles and burning fire

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:13
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:13 - وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
waṭaʿāman dhā ghuṣṣatin waʿadhāban alīman
And food that chokes and a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:14
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:14 - يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَهِيلًا
yawma tarjufu l-arḍu wal-jibālu wakānati l-jibālu kathīban mahīlan
(On the) Day will quake the earth and the mountains and will become the mountains a heap of sand pouring down

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:15
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:15 - إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
innā arsalnā ilaykum rasūlan shāhidan ʿalaykum kamā arsalnā ilā fir'ʿawna rasūlan
Indeed, We [We] have sent to you a Messenger (as) a witness upon you as We sent to Firaun a Messenger

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:16
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:16 - فَعَصَى فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
faʿaṣā fir'ʿawnu l-rasūla fa-akhadhnāhu akhdhan wabīlan
But disobeyed Firaun the Messenger so We seized him (with) a seizure ruinous

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:17
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:17 - فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا
fakayfa tattaqūna in kafartum yawman yajʿalu l-wil'dāna shīban
Then how will you guard yourselves if you disbelieve a Day (that) will make the children gray-haired

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:18
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:18 - اَلسَّمَاءُ مُنْفَطِرٌ بِهِ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا
al-samāu munfaṭirun bihi kāna waʿduhu mafʿūlan
The heaven (will) break apart therefrom is His Promise to be fulfilled

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:19
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:19 - إِنَّ هَذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlan
Indeed this (is) a Reminder then whoever wills (let him) take to his Lord a way

item.title: Al-Muzzammil:20
item.description:
Al-Muzzammil:20 - إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَى مِنْ ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ عَلِمَ أَنْ لَنْ تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْءَانِ عَلِمَ أَنْ سَيَكُونُ مِنْكُمْ مَرْضَى وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَاٰتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
inna rabbaka yaʿlamu annaka taqūmu adnā min thuluthayi al-layli waniṣ'fahu wathuluthahu waṭāifatun mina alladhīna maʿaka wal-lahu yuqaddiru al-layla wal-nahāra ʿalima an lan tuḥ'ṣūhu fatāba ʿalaykum fa-iq'raū mā tayassara mina l-qur'āni ʿalima an sayakūnu minkum marḍā waākharūna yaḍribūna fī l-arḍi yabtaghūna min faḍli l-lahi waākharūna yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi fa-iq'raū mā tayassara min'hu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aqriḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan wamā tuqaddimū li-anfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayran wa-aʿẓama ajran wa-is'taghfirū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun
Indeed your Lord knows that you stand (a little) less than two-thirds (of) the night and half of it and a third of it and (so do) a group of those who (are) with you And Allah determines the night and the day He knows that not you count it so He has turned to you so recite what is easy of the Quran He knows that there will be among you sick and others traveling in the land seeking of (the) Bounty (of) Allah and others fighting in (the) way (of) Allah So recite what is easy of it and establish the prayer and give the zakah and loan Allah a loan goodly And whatever you send forth for yourselves of good you will find it with Allah It (will be) better and greater (in) reward And seek forgiveness (of) Allah Indeed Allah (is) Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful

item.title: 74. المدثر (Al-Muddaththir)
item.description:
The surah that opens by addressing the enwrapped Prophet as the Shrouded Messenger. It takes its name from the word "wrapped in mantle" (muddaththir) in verse 1. The first verses of this surah (verse 1 ff.) were revealed after one of the Prophets first encounter with the Angel of Revelation in the Cave of Ḥirā'. The surah goes on, in a section from a later period, to remind the obstinate disbelievers of their fate on the Day of Judgement (verse 8 ff.) and a specific opponent of the Prophet is singled out (verse 11 ff.). The end of the surah (verse 39 ff.) exposes the foolishness of the disbelievers" attitude to the Revelation and the Day of Resurrection.
