The surah is also known as The Cloaked One, The Enfolded, The Enfolded One, The Enveloped, The Man Wearing a Cloak, The Mantled Messenger, Wrapped in his Cloak

74:1
يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ
yāayyuhā l-mudathiru
O you who covers himself

74:2
قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ
qum fa-andhir
Stand up and warn

74:3
وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
warabbaka fakabbir
And your Lord magnify

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:1
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:1 - يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ
yāayyuhā l-mudathiru
O you who covers himself

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:2
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:2 - قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ
qum fa-andhir
Stand up and warn

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:3
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:3 - وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
warabbaka fakabbir
And your Lord magnify

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:4
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:4 - وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
wathiyābaka faṭahhir
And your clothing purify

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:5
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:5 - وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ
wal-ruj'za fa-uh'jur
And uncleanliness avoid

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:6
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:6 - وَلَا تَمْنُنْ تَسْتَكْثِرُ
walā tamnun tastakthiru
And (do) not confer favor (to) acquire more

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:7
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:7 - وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ
walirabbika fa-iṣ'bir
And for your Lord be patient

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:8
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:8 - فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ
fa-idhā nuqira fī l-nāqūri
Then when is blown in the trumpet

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:9
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:9 - فَذٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
fadhālika yawma-idhin yawmun ʿasīrun
That Day (will be) a Day difficult

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:10
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:10 - عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
ʿalā l-kāfirīna ghayru yasīrin
For the disbelievers not easy

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:11
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:11 - ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
dharnī waman khalaqtu waḥīdan
Leave Me and whom I created alone

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:12
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:12 - وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَمْدُودًا
wajaʿaltu lahu mālan mamdūdan
And I granted to him wealth extensive

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:13
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:13 - وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
wabanīna shuhūdan
And children present

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:14
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:14 - وَمَهَّدْتُ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا
wamahhadttu lahu tamhīdan
And I spread for him ease

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:15
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:15 - ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
thumma yaṭmaʿu an azīda
Then he desires that I (should) add more

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:16
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:16 - كَلَّا إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِءَايَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا
kallā innahu kāna liāyātinā ʿanīdan
By no means Indeed, he has been to Our Verses stubborn

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:17
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:17 - سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا
sa-ur'hiquhu ṣaʿūdan
Soon I will cover Him (with) a laborious punishment

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:18
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:18 - إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
innahu fakkara waqaddara
Indeed, he thought and plotted

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:19
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:19 - فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
faqutila kayfa qaddara
So may he be destroyed how he plotted

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:20
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:20 - ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
thumma qutila kayfa qaddara
Then may he be destroyed how he plotted

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:21
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:21 - ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
thumma naẓara
Then he looked

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:22
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:22 - ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
thumma ʿabasa wabasara
Then he frowned and scowled

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:23
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:23 - ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ
thumma adbara wa-is'takbara
Then he turned back and was proud

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:24
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:24 - فَقَالَ إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'tharu Then he said Not (is) this but magic imitated
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān.
  • [2] That is, from the magicians of old. Or 'traditional magic.'

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:25
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:25 - إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ
in hādhā illā qawlu l-bashari
Not (is) this but (the) word (of) a human being

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:26
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:26 - سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ sa-uṣ'līhi saqara Soon I will drive him (into) Hell
  • [1] Saqar is another name for hell or a part of it.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:27
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:27 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ
wamā adrāka mā saqaru
And what can make you know what (is) Hell

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:28
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:28 - لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ
lā tub'qī walā tadharu
Not it lets remain and not it leaves

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:29
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:29 - لَوَّاحَةٌ لِلْبَشَرِ
lawwāḥatun lil'bashari
Scorching the human (skin)

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:30
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:30 - عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
ʿalayhā tis'ʿata ʿashara
Over it (are) nine teen

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:31
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:31 - وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا إِيمَانًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَذَا مَثَلًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٰی لِلْبَشَرِ wamā jaʿalnā aṣḥāba l-nāri illā malāikatan wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum illā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū liyastayqina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wayazdāda alladhīna āmanū īmānan walā yartāba alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-mu'minūna waliyaqūla alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-kāfirūna mādhā arāda l-lahu bihādhā mathalan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika illā huwa wamā hiya illā dhik'rā lil'bashari And not We have made keepers (of) the Fire except Angels And not We have made their number except (as) a trial for those who disbelieve that may be certain those who were given the Scripture and may increase those who believe (in) faith and not may doubt those who were given the Scripture and the believers and that may say those in their hearts (is) a disease and the disbelievers What (does) intend Allah by this example Thus does let go astray Allah whom He wills and guides whom He wills And none knows (the) hosts (of) your Lord except Him And not it (is) but a reminder to (the) human beings
  • [1] That is, the statement that there are nineteen wardens in charge of hell.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:32
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:32 - كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ
kallā wal-qamari
Nay By the moon

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:33
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:33 - وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
wa-al-layli idh adbara
And the night when it departs

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:34
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:34 - وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ
wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā asfara
And the morning when it brightens

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:35
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:35 - إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ
innahā la-iḥ'dā l-kubari
Indeed, it (is) surely one (of) the greatest

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:36
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:36 - نَذِيرًا لِلْبَشَرِ
nadhīran lil'bashari
A warning to (the) human being

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:37
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:37 - لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhara
To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:38
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:38 - كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
kullu nafsin bimā kasabat rahīnatun
Every soul for what it has earned (is) pledged

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:39
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:39 - إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ
illā aṣḥāba l-yamīni
Except (the) companions (of) the right

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:40
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:40 - فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
fī jannātin yatasāalūna
In Gardens asking each other

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:41
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:41 - عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
ʿani l-muj'rimīna
About the criminals

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:42
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:42 - مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ
mā salakakum fī saqara
What led you into Hell

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:43
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:43 - قَالُوْا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ qālū lam naku mina l-muṣalīna They will say Not we were of those who prayed
  • [1] Or 'We were not among followers of the leaders (or forerunners, mentioned in (Q 56:10)).' (See Tafsīr al-Qummī, Tafsīr Furāt al-Kūfī, al-Kāfī, i, 484, ''Kitāb al-Ḥujjah," bāb 108 (bāb fīhi nukat wa nutaf min al-tanzīl fī al-wilāyah), no. 38.

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:44
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:44 - وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ
walam naku nuṭ'ʿimu l-mis'kīna
And not we used to feed the poor

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:45
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:45 - وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ
wakunnā nakhūḍu maʿa l-khāiḍīna
And we used to indulge in vain talk with the vain talkers

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:46
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:46 - وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ wakunnā nukadhibu biyawmi l-dīni And we used to deny (the) Day (of) the Judgment
  • [1] Or 'the Day of Judgement.'

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:47
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:47 - حَتّٰی أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ
ḥattā atānā l-yaqīnu
Until came to us the certainty

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:48
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:48 - فَمَا تَنْفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ
famā tanfaʿuhum shafāʿatu l-shāfiʿīna
Then not will benefit them intercession (of) the intercessors

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:49
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:49 - فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
famā lahum ʿani l-tadhkirati muʿ'riḍīna
Then what (is) for them (that) from the Reminder they (are) turning away

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:50
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:50 - كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُسْتَنْفِرَةٌ
ka-annahum ḥumurun mus'tanfiratun
As if they (were) donkeys frightened

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:51
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:51 - فَرَّتْ مِنْ قَسْوَرَةٍ
farrat min qaswaratin
Fleeing from a lion

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:52
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:52 - بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يُؤْتٰی صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً
bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharatan
Nay Desires every person of them that he may be given pages spread out

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:53
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:53 - كَلَّا بَلْ لَا يَخَافُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ
kallā bal lā yakhāfūna l-ākhirata
Nay But not they fear the Hereafter

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:54
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:54 - كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ
kallā innahu tadhkiratun
Nay Indeed, it (is) a Reminder

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:55
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:55 - فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
faman shāa dhakarahu
So whoever wills (may) pay heed to it

item.title: Al-Muddaththir:56
item.description:
Al-Muddaththir:56 - وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirati
And not will pay heed except that wills Allah He (is) worthy to be feared and worthy to forgive

item.title: 75. القيامة (Al-Qiyaama)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the emphatic oath of the Divine One swearing by the looming day of Resurrection. It takes its name from verse 1, which mentions the Day of Resurrection. The surah dealing with the Day of Resurrection and man's denial of that Day. God's power is convincingly described in several vignettes (verse 3 ff., verse 26 ff. and verse 34 ff.). The third paragraph instructs the Prophet on appropriate reception of the revelation (verse 16 ff.), and thereby serves to emphasize that the Quran is indeed God's word.
The surah is also known as Day of Resurrection, The Rising

75:1
لَا أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
lā uq'simu biyawmi l-qiyāmati
Nay I swear by (the) Day (of) the Resurrection

75:2
وَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ
walā uq'simu bil-nafsi l-lawāmati
And nay I swear by the soul self-accusing

75:3
أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ
ayaḥsabu l-insānu allan najmaʿa ʿiẓāmahu
Does think [the] man that not We will assemble his bones

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:1
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:1 - لَا أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
lā uq'simu biyawmi l-qiyāmati
Nay I swear by (the) Day (of) the Resurrection

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:2
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:2 - وَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ
walā uq'simu bil-nafsi l-lawāmati
And nay I swear by the soul self-accusing

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:3
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:3 - أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَلَّنْ نَجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ
ayaḥsabu l-insānu allan najmaʿa ʿiẓāmahu
Does think [the] man that not We will assemble his bones

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:4
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:4 - بَلَى قَادِرِينَ عَلَى أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ
balā qādirīna ʿalā an nusawwiya banānahu
Nay (We are) Able on that We can restore his fingertips

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:5
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:5 - بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنْسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ
bal yurīdu l-insānu liyafjura amāmahu
Nay Desires [the] man to give (the) lie (to) what is before him

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:6
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:6 - يَسْءَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ
yasalu ayyāna yawmu l-qiyāmati
He asks When (is the) Day (of) the Resurrection

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:7
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:7 - فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ
fa-idhā bariqa l-baṣaru
So when is dazzled the vision

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:8
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:8 - وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ
wakhasafa l-qamaru
And becomes dark the moon

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:9
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:9 - وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ
wajumiʿa l-shamsu wal-qamaru
And are joined the sun and the moon

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:10
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:10 - يَقُولُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ
yaqūlu l-insānu yawma-idhin ayna l-mafaru
Will say [the] man that Day Where (is) the escape

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:11
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:11 - كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
kallā lā wazara
By no means (There is) no refuge

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:12
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:12 - إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ
ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-mus'taqaru
To your Lord that Day (is) the place of rest

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:13
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:13 - يُنَبَّؤُا الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
yunabba-u l-insānu yawma-idhin bimā qaddama wa-akhara
Will be informed [the] man that Day of what he sent forth and kept back

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:14
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:14 - بَلِ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ
bali l-insānu ʿalā nafsihi baṣīratun
Nay [The] man against himself (will be) a witness

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:15
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:15 - وَلَوْ أَلْقَى مَعَاذِيرَهُ
walaw alqā maʿādhīrahu
Even if he presents his excuses

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:16
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:16 - لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ
lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bihi
Not move with it your tongue to hasten with it

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:17
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:17 - إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْءَانَهُ
inna ʿalaynā jamʿahu waqur'ānahu
Indeed upon Us (is) its collection and its recitation

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:18
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:18 - فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُ
fa-idhā qaranāhu fa-ittabiʿ qur'ānahu
And when We have recited it then follow its recitation

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:19
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:19 - ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ
thumma inna ʿalaynā bayānahu
Then indeed upon Us (is) its explanation

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:20
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:20 - كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ
kallā bal tuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata
No But you love the immediate

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:21
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:21 - وَتَذَرُونَ الْاٰخِرَةَ
watadharūna l-ākhirata
And leave the Hereafter

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:22
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:22 - وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاضِرَةٌ
wujūhun yawma-idhin nāḍiratun
Faces that Day (will be) radiant

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:23
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:23 - إِلَى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
ilā rabbihā nāẓiratun
Towards their Lord looking

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:24
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:24 - وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ
wawujūhun yawma-idhin bāsiratun
And faces that Day (will be) distorted

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:25
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:25 - تَظُنُّ أَنْ يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
taẓunnu an yuf'ʿala bihā fāqiratun
Thinking that will be done to them backbreaking

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:26
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:26 - كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ
kallā idhā balaghati l-tarāqiya
No When it reaches the collar bones

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:27
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:27 - وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ waqīla man rāqin And it is said Who (will) cure
  • [1] That is, by the angels of mercy and the angels of wrath present at the side of the dying person, as to which of them will take charge of him. Or those who are present by the side of the dying person say, 'Where is the medicine man?'

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:28
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:28 - وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ
waẓanna annahu l-firāqu
And he is certain that it (is) the parting

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:29
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:29 - وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ wal-tafati l-sāqu bil-sāqi And is wound the leg about the leg
  • [1] An idiom suggesting a time of great hardship, or, metaphorically, death throes.

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:30
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:30 - إِلَى رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ
ilā rabbika yawma-idhin l-masāqu
To your Lord that Day (will be) the driving

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:31
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:31 - فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّى
falā ṣaddaqa walā ṣallā
And not he accepted (the) truth and not he prayed

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:32
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:32 - وَلَكِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى
walākin kadhaba watawallā
But he denied and turned away

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:33
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:33 - ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّى
thumma dhahaba ilā ahlihi yatamaṭṭā
Then he went to his family swaggering

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:34
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:34 - أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى
awlā laka fa-awlā
Woe to you and woe

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:35
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:35 - ثُمَّ أَوْلَى لَكَ فَأَوْلَى
thumma awlā laka fa-awlā
Then woe to you and woe

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:36
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:36 - أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
ayaḥsabu l-insānu an yut'raka sudan
Does think man that he will be left neglected

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:37
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:37 - أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَى
alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'nā
Was not he a semen-drop of semen emitted

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:38
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:38 - ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّى
thumma kāna ʿalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwā
Then he was a clinging substance then He created and proportioned

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:39
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:39 - فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى
fajaʿala min'hu l-zawjayni l-dhakara wal-unthā
Then made of him two kinds (the) male and the female

item.title: Al-Qiyaama:40
item.description:
Al-Qiyaama:40 - أَلَيْسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَى أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰی
alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā
Is not that (He) Able over to give life (to) the dead

item.title: 76. الإنسان (Al-Insaan)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a question posed to arrogant Man about his utter nothingness before God brought him into existence. It takes its name from the word "man" (al-insān) mentioned in verse 1. The surah speaks of how man is tested (verse 2 ff.) and what the results will be for the evildoers (verse 4) and for the righteous (verse 5 ff.). The Prophet is urged to persevere in his devotion and to bear with patience (verse 23 ff.).
The surah is also known as Every (Man)

76:1
هَلْ أَتٰی عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ حِينٌ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْئًا مَذْكُورًا
hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnun mina l-dahri lam yakun shayan madhkūran
Has (there) come upon man a period of time not he was a thing mentioned

76:2
إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا
innā khalaqnā l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin amshājin nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīran
Indeed, We [We] created man from a semen-drop a mixture (that) We test him so We made (for) him hearing and sight

76:3
إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
innā hadaynāhu l-sabīla immā shākiran wa-immā kafūran
Indeed, We guided him (to) the way whether (he) be grateful and whether (he) be ungrateful

item.title: Al-Insaan:1
item.description:
Al-Insaan:1 - هَلْ أَتٰی عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ حِينٌ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْئًا مَذْكُورًا
hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnun mina l-dahri lam yakun shayan madhkūran
Has (there) come upon man a period of time not he was a thing mentioned

item.title: Al-Insaan:2
item.description:
Al-Insaan:2 - إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا innā khalaqnā l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin amshājin nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīran Indeed, We [We] created man from a semen-drop a mixture (that) We test him so We made (for) him hearing and sight
  • [1] That is, from the mixing of sperm and ovum.

item.title: Al-Insaan:3
item.description:
Al-Insaan:3 - إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
innā hadaynāhu l-sabīla immā shākiran wa-immā kafūran
Indeed, We guided him (to) the way whether (he) be grateful and whether (he) be ungrateful

item.title: Al-Insaan:4
item.description:
Al-Insaan:4 - إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلَاسِلَا وَأَغْلَالًا وَسَعِيرًا
innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālan wasaʿīran
Indeed, We [We] have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a Blazing Fire

item.title: Al-Insaan:5
item.description:
Al-Insaan:5 - إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِنْ كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا inna l-abrāra yashrabūna min kasin kāna mizājuhā kāfūran Indeed the righteous will drink from a cup is its mixture (of) Kafur
  • [1] Lit., camphor.

item.title: Al-Insaan:6
item.description:
Al-Insaan:6 - عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
ʿaynan yashrabu bihā ʿibādu l-lahi yufajjirūnahā tafjīran
A spring will drink from it (the) slaves (of) Allah causing it to gush forth abundantly

item.title: Al-Insaan:7
item.description:
Al-Insaan:7 - يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا
yūfūna bil-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mus'taṭīran
They fulfill the vows and fear a Day (which) is its evil widespread

item.title: Al-Insaan:8
item.description:
Al-Insaan:8 - وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَى حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
wayuṭ'ʿimūna l-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi mis'kīnan wayatīman wa-asīran
And they feed the food in spite of love (for) it (to the) needy and (the) orphan and (the) captive

item.title: Al-Insaan:9
item.description:
Al-Insaan:9 - إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
innamā nuṭ'ʿimukum liwajhi l-lahi lā nurīdu minkum jazāan walā shukūran
Only we feed you for (the) Countenance (of) Allah Not we desire from you any reward and not thanks

item.title: Al-Insaan:10
item.description:
Al-Insaan:10 - إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
innā nakhāfu min rabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīran
Indeed, we fear from our Lord a Day harsh and distressful

item.title: Al-Insaan:11
item.description:
Al-Insaan:11 - فَوَقَاهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
fawaqāhumu l-lahu sharra dhālika l-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍratan wasurūran
But will protect them Allah (from the) evil (of) that Day and will cause them to meet radiance and happiness

item.title: Al-Insaan:12
item.description:
Al-Insaan:12 - وَجَزَاهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
wajazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannatan waḥarīran
And will reward them because they were patient (with) a Garden and silk

item.title: Al-Insaan:13
item.description:
Al-Insaan:13 - مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki lā yarawna fīhā shamsan walā zamharīran
Reclining therein on couches Not they will see therein sun and not freezing cold

item.title: Al-Insaan:14
item.description:
Al-Insaan:14 - وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
wadāniyatan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīlan
And near above them (are) its shades and will hang low its cluster of fruits dangling low

item.title: Al-Insaan:15
item.description:
Al-Insaan:15 - وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِءَانِيَةٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا
wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim biāniyatin min fiḍḍatin wa-akwābin kānat qawārīrā
And will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups (that) are (of) crystal

item.title: Al-Insaan:16
item.description:
Al-Insaan:16 - قَوَارِيرَا مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا qawārīrā min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīran Crystal-clear of silver They will determine its measure
  • [1] According to Tafsīr al-Qummī, vol. 2, p. 399, the silver will be transparent.

item.title: Al-Insaan:17
item.description:
Al-Insaan:17 - وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِيلًا wayus'qawna fīhā kasan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīlan And they will be given to drink therein a cup is its mixture (of) Zanjabil
  • [1] Lit., ginger.

item.title: Al-Insaan:18
item.description:
Al-Insaan:18 - عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّى سَلْسَبِيلًا
ʿaynan fīhā tusammā salsabīlan
A spring therein named Salsabil

item.title: Al-Insaan:19
item.description:
Al-Insaan:19 - وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَنْثُورًا
wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna idhā ra-aytahum ḥasib'tahum lu'lu-an manthūran
And will circulate among them young boys made eternal When you see them you would think them (to be) pearls scattered

item.title: Al-Insaan:20
item.description:
Al-Insaan:20 - وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
wa-idhā ra-ayta thamma ra-ayta naʿīman wamul'kan kabīran
And when you look then you will see blessings and a kingdom great

item.title: Al-Insaan:21
item.description:
Al-Insaan:21 - عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوْۤا أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
ʿāliyahum thiyābu sundusin khuḍ'run wa-is'tabraqun waḥullū asāwira min fiḍḍatin wasaqāhum rabbuhum sharāban ṭahūran
Upon them (will be) garments (of) fine silk green and heavy brocade And they will be adorned (with) bracelets of silver and will give them to drink their Lord a drink pure

item.title: Al-Insaan:22
item.description:
Al-Insaan:22 - إِنَّ هَذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَشْكُورًا
inna hādhā kāna lakum jazāan wakāna saʿyukum mashkūran
Indeed this is for you a reward and has been your effort appreciated

item.title: Al-Insaan:23
item.description:
Al-Insaan:23 - إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ تَنْزِيلًا
innā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna tanzīlan
Indeed, We We [We] revealed to you the Quran progressively

item.title: Al-Insaan:24
item.description:
Al-Insaan:24 - فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ min'hum āthiman aw kafūran
So be patient for (the) Command (of) your Lord and (do) not obey from them any sinner or disbeliever

item.title: Al-Insaan:25
item.description:
Al-Insaan:25 - وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan
And remember (the) name (of) your Lord morning and evening

item.title: Al-Insaan:26
item.description:
Al-Insaan:26 - وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
wamina al-layli fa-us'jud lahu wasabbiḥ'hu laylan ṭawīlan
And of the night prostrate to Him and glorify Him a night long

item.title: Al-Insaan:27
item.description:
Al-Insaan:27 - إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
inna hāulāi yuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata wayadharūna warāahum yawman thaqīlan
Indeed these love the immediate and leave behind them a Day grave

item.title: Al-Insaan:28
item.description:
Al-Insaan:28 - نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
naḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā asrahum wa-idhā shi'nā baddalnā amthālahum tabdīlan
We created them and We strengthened their forms and when We will We can change their likeness[es] (with) a change

item.title: Al-Insaan:29
item.description:
Al-Insaan:29 - إِنَّ هَذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا
inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlan
Indeed this (is) a reminder so whoever wills let him take to his Lord a way

item.title: Al-Insaan:30
item.description:
Al-Insaan:30 - وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman
And not you will except that wills Allah Indeed Allah is All-Knower All-Wise

item.title: Al-Insaan:31
item.description:
Al-Insaan:31 - يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَالظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimīna aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban alīman
He admits whom He wills into His mercy but (for) the wrongdoers He has prepared for them a punishment painful

item.title: 77. المرسلات (Al-Mursalaat)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the Emissaries as those sent forth in succession. It takes its name from the "emissaries" (mursalāt) mentioned in verse 1. The surah describes the Day of Decision: its inevitability, arguments for its coming, and the events that will presage the Judgement, as well as the fates of believers and disbelievers.
The surah is also known as (Winds) Sent Forth, The Loosed Ones, Those Sent Forth, Those Sent Forth in Succession, Those That Are Sent Forth

77:1
وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا
wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fan
By the ones sent forth one after another

77:2
فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا
fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfan
And the winds that blow violently

77:3
وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا
wal-nāshirāti nashran
And the ones that scatter far and wide

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:1
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:1 - وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا
wal-mur'salāti ʿur'fan
By the ones sent forth one after another

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:2
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:2 - فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا
fal-ʿāṣifāti ʿaṣfan
And the winds that blow violently

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:3
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:3 - وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا
wal-nāshirāti nashran
And the ones that scatter far and wide

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:4
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:4 - فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا
fal-fāriqāti farqan
And those who separate (by the) Criterion

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:5
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:5 - فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا
fal-mul'qiyāti dhik'ran
And those who bring down (the) Reminder

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:6
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:6 - عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
ʿudh'ran aw nudh'ran
(As) justification or warning

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:7
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:7 - إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ
innamā tūʿadūna lawāqiʿun
Indeed, what you are promised will surely occur

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:8
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:8 - فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
fa-idhā l-nujūmu ṭumisat
So when the stars are obliterated

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:9
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:9 - وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ
wa-idhā l-samāu furijat
And when the heaven is cleft asunder

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:10
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:10 - وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ wa-idhā l-jibālu nusifat And when the mountains are blown away
  • [1] Or 'blown away.'

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:11
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:11 - وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
wa-idhā l-rusulu uqqitat
And when the Messengers are gathered to their appointed time

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:12
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:12 - لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
li-ayyi yawmin ujjilat
For what Day are (these) postponed

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:13
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:13 - لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ
liyawmi l-faṣli
For (the) Day (of) Judgment

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:14
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:14 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ
wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-faṣli
And what will make you know what (is the) Day (of) the Judgment

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:15
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:15 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:16
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:16 - أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
alam nuh'liki l-awalīna
Did not We destroy the former (people)

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:17
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:17 - ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْءَاخِرِينَ
thumma nut'biʿuhumu l-ākhirīna
Then We follow them up (with) the later ones

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:18
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:18 - كَذٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ
kadhālika nafʿalu bil-muj'rimīna
Thus We deal with the criminals

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:19
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:19 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:20
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:20 - أَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ
alam nakhluqkkum min māin mahīnin
Did not We create you from a water despicable

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:21
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:21 - فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ
fajaʿalnāhu fī qarārin makīnin
Then We placed it in an abode safe

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:22
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:22 - إِلَى قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ
ilā qadarin maʿlūmin
For a period known

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:23
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:23 - فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ
faqadarnā faniʿ'ma l-qādirūna
So We measured and Best (are We to) measure

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:24
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:24 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:25
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:25 - أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
alam najʿali l-arḍa kifātan
Have not We made the earth a receptacle

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:26
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:26 - أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا
aḥyāan wa-amwātan
(For the) living and (the) dead

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:27
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:27 - وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا
wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsiya shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum māan furātan
And We made therein firmly set mountains lofty and We gave you to drink water sweet

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:28
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:28 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:29
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:29 - اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
inṭaliqū ilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
Proceed to what you used to in it deny

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:30
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:30 - اِنْطَلِقُوا إِلَى ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ
inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿabin
Proceed to a shadow having three columns

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:31
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:31 - لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ
lā ẓalīlin walā yugh'nī mina l-lahabi
No cool shade and not availing against the flame

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:32
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:32 - إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ innahā tarmī bishararin kal-qaṣri Indeed, it throws up sparks as the fortress
  • [1] Or 'like castles,' or 'like the trunks (of huge trees).'

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:33
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:33 - كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ
ka-annahu jimālatun ṣuf'run
As if they (were) camels yellow

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:34
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:34 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:35
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:35 - هَذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ
hādhā yawmu lā yanṭiqūna
This (is) a Day not they will speak

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:36
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:36 - وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
walā yu'dhanu lahum fayaʿtadhirūna
And not will it be permitted for them to make excuses

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:37
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:37 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:38
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:38 - هَذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ
hādhā yawmu l-faṣli jamaʿnākum wal-awalīna
This (is the) Day (of) Judgment We have gathered you and the former (people)

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:39
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:39 - فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
fa-in kāna lakum kaydun fakīdūni
So if is for you a plan then plan against Me

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:40
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:40 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:41
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:41 - إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ
inna l-mutaqīna fī ẓilālin waʿuyūnin
Indeed the righteous (will be) in shades and springs

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:42
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:42 - وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
wafawākiha mimmā yashtahūna
And fruits from what they desire

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:43
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:43 - كُلُوْۤا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna
Eat and drink (in) satisfaction for what you used to do

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:44
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:44 - إِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna
Indeed, We thus reward the good-doers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:45
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:45 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:46
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:46 - كُلُوْۤا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ
kulū watamattaʿū qalīlan innakum muj'rimūna
Eat and enjoy yourselves a little indeed, you (are) criminals

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:47
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:47 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:48
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:48 - وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوْۤا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
wa-idhā qīla lahumu ir'kaʿū lā yarkaʿūna
And when it is said to them Bow not they bow

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:49
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:49 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mursalaat:50
item.description:
Al-Mursalaat:50 - فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ
fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿdahu yu'minūna
Then in what statement after it will they believe

item.title: 78. النبأ (An-Naba)
item.description:
The surah that mentions The [Great] Tiding of the coming of the Day og Judgment, the truth of which people yet dispute. It takes its name from the expression "the great tiding" (al-naba' al-'aẓīm). The disbelievers often asked incredulously about the Resurrection. This surah gives evidence of God's power, then explains what will happen on the Day of Resurrection, and the respective fates of believers and disbelievers.
The surah is also known as The Announcement, The Great News, The Important News, The News

78:1
عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
ʿamma yatasāalūna
About what are they asking one another

78:2
عَنِ النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ
ʿani l-naba-i l-ʿaẓīmi
About the News the Great

78:3
اَلَّذِي هُمْ فِیْهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
alladhī hum fīhi mukh'talifūna
(About) which they (are) concerning it (in) disagreement

item.title: An-Naba:1
item.description:
An-Naba:1 - عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
ʿamma yatasāalūna
About what are they asking one another

item.title: An-Naba:2
item.description:
An-Naba:2 - عَنِ النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ
ʿani l-naba-i l-ʿaẓīmi
About the News the Great

item.title: An-Naba:3
item.description:
An-Naba:3 - اَلَّذِي هُمْ فِیْهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
alladhī hum fīhi mukh'talifūna
(About) which they (are) concerning it (in) disagreement

item.title: An-Naba:4
item.description:
An-Naba:4 - كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
kallā sayaʿlamūna
Nay (soon) they will know

item.title: An-Naba:5
item.description:
An-Naba:5 - ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
thumma kallā sayaʿlamūna
Then Nay (soon) they will know

item.title: An-Naba:6
item.description:
An-Naba:6 - أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا
alam najʿali l-arḍa mihādan
Have not We made the earth a resting place

item.title: An-Naba:7
item.description:
An-Naba:7 - وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
wal-jibāla awtādan
And the mountains (as) pegs

item.title: An-Naba:8
item.description:
An-Naba:8 - وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا wakhalaqnākum azwājan And We created you (in) pairs
  • [1] Or 'as sexes.'

item.title: An-Naba:9
item.description:
An-Naba:9 - وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
wajaʿalnā nawmakum subātan
And We made your sleep (for) rest

item.title: An-Naba:10
item.description:
An-Naba:10 - وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
wajaʿalnā al-layla libāsan
And We made the night (as) covering

item.title: An-Naba:11
item.description:
An-Naba:11 - وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
wajaʿalnā l-nahāra maʿāshan
And We made the day (for) livelihood

item.title: An-Naba:12
item.description:
An-Naba:12 - وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
wabanaynā fawqakum sabʿan shidādan
And We constructed over you seven strong

item.title: An-Naba:13
item.description:
An-Naba:13 - وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
wajaʿalnā sirājan wahhājan
And We placed a lamp burning

item.title: An-Naba:14
item.description:
An-Naba:14 - وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا
wa-anzalnā mina l-muʿ'ṣirāti māan thajjājan
And We sent down from the rain clouds water pouring abundantly

item.title: An-Naba:15
item.description:
An-Naba:15 - لِنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
linukh'rija bihi ḥabban wanabātan
That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

item.title: An-Naba:16
item.description:
An-Naba:16 - وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا
wajannātin alfāfan
And gardens (of) thick foliage

item.title: An-Naba:17
item.description:
An-Naba:17 - إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا
inna yawma l-faṣli kāna mīqātan
Indeed (the) Day (of) the Judgment is an appointed time

item.title: An-Naba:18
item.description:
An-Naba:18 - يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fatatūna afwājan
(The) Day (in which) shall be blown in the trumpet and you will come forth (in) crowds

item.title: An-Naba:19
item.description:
An-Naba:19 - وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا
wafutiḥati l-samāu fakānat abwāban
And is opened the heaven and becomes gateways

item.title: An-Naba:20
item.description:
An-Naba:20 - وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
wasuyyirati l-jibālu fakānat sarāban
And are moved the mountains and become a mirage

item.title: An-Naba:21
item.description:
An-Naba:21 - إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
inna jahannama kānat mir'ṣādan
Indeed Hell is lying in wait

item.title: An-Naba:22
item.description:
An-Naba:22 - لِلطَّاغِينَ مَءَابًا
lilṭṭāghīna maāban
For the transgressors a place of return

item.title: An-Naba:23
item.description:
An-Naba:23 - لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا
lābithīna fīhā aḥqāban
(They will) be remaining therein (for) ages

item.title: An-Naba:24
item.description:
An-Naba:24 - لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
lā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan walā sharāban
Not they will taste therein coolness and not any drink

item.title: An-Naba:25
item.description:
An-Naba:25 - إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
illā ḥamīman waghassāqan
Except scalding water and purulence

item.title: An-Naba:26
item.description:
An-Naba:26 - جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا
jazāan wifāqan
A recompense appropriate

item.title: An-Naba:27
item.description:
An-Naba:27 - إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْۤا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
innahum kānū lā yarjūna ḥisāban
Indeed, they were not expecting an account

item.title: An-Naba:28
item.description:
An-Naba:28 - وَكَذَّبُوا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ كِذَّابًا
wakadhabū biāyātinā kidhāban
And they denied Our Signs (with) denial

item.title: An-Naba:29
item.description:
An-Naba:29 - وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا
wakulla shayin aḥṣaynāhu kitāban
And every thing We have enumerated it (in) a Book

item.title: An-Naba:30
item.description:
An-Naba:30 - فَذُوقُوْۤا فَلَنْ نَزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
fadhūqū falan nazīdakum illā ʿadhāban
So taste and never We will increase you except (in) punishment

item.title: An-Naba:31
item.description:
An-Naba:31 - إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
inna lil'muttaqīna mafāzan
Indeed for the righteous (is) success

item.title: An-Naba:32
item.description:
An-Naba:32 - حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا
ḥadāiqa wa-aʿnāban
Gardens and grapevines

item.title: An-Naba:33
item.description:
An-Naba:33 - وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
wakawāʿiba atrāban
And splendid companions well-matched

item.title: An-Naba:34
item.description:
An-Naba:34 - وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
wakasan dihāqan
And a cup full

item.title: An-Naba:35
item.description:
An-Naba:35 - لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا
lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāban
Not they will hear therein any vain talk and not any falsehood

item.title: An-Naba:36
item.description:
An-Naba:36 - جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا jazāan min rabbika ʿaṭāan ḥisāban (As) a reward from your Lord a gift (according to) account
  • [1] Or 'abounding,' or 'well-deserved,' or 'well-earned.'

item.title: An-Naba:37
item.description:
An-Naba:37 - رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāban
Lord (of) the heavens and the earth and whatever (is) between both of them the Most Gracious not they have power from Him (to) address

item.title: An-Naba:38
item.description:
An-Naba:38 - يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
yawma yaqūmu l-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban
(The) Day will stand the Spirit and the Angels (in) rows not they will speak except (one) who permits [for] him the Most Gracious and he (will) say (what is) correct

item.title: An-Naba:39
item.description:
An-Naba:39 - ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ مَءَابًا
dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāban
That (is) the Day the True So whoever wills let him take towards his Lord a return

item.title: An-Naba:40
item.description:
An-Naba:40 - إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَالَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban Indeed We [We] have warned you (of) a punishment near (the) Day will see the man what have sent forth his hands and will say the disbeliever O I wish I were dust
  • [1] Or 'consider.'

item.title: 79. النازعات (An-Naazi'aat)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by The Wresters, the angelic pullers, who shall harshly wrest out the souls of the unbelievers at their appointed time of death. It takes its name from "the wresters" (al-nāzi'āt) mentioned in verse 1. The main theme of the surah is the possibility and inevitability of the Resurrection, its results, and its timing. The story of Moses and Pharaoh acts as encouragement to the Prophet and a warning to the disbelievers.
The surah is also known as (Soul-)Snatchers, Extractors, The Angelic Pullers, The Forceful Chargers, The Pluckers, The Soul-Snatchers, Those That Rise, Those Who Pull and Withdraw, Those Who Tear Out

79:1
وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا
wal-nāziʿāti gharqan
By those who extract violently

79:2
وَالنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطًا
wal-nāshiṭāti nashṭan
And those who draw out gently

79:3
وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا
wal-sābiḥāti sabḥan
And those who glide swimming

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:1
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:1 - وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا
wal-nāziʿāti gharqan
By those who extract violently

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:2
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:2 - وَالنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطًا
wal-nāshiṭāti nashṭan
And those who draw out gently

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:3
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:3 - وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا
wal-sābiḥāti sabḥan
And those who glide swimming

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:4
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:4 - فَالسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقًا
fal-sābiqāti sabqan
And those who race each other (in) a race

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:5
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:5 - فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا
fal-mudabirāti amran
And those who arrange (the) matter

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:6
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:6 - يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ
yawma tarjufu l-rājifatu
(The) Day will quake the quaking one

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:7
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:7 - تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ tatbaʿuhā l-rādifatu Follows it the subsequent
  • [1] Apparently, 'the Quaker' and 'the Successor' refer to the first and the second blasts of the Trumpet sounded by Isrāfīl on the Day of Resurrection. Cf. (Q 39:68); (Q 73:14).

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:8
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:8 - قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
qulūbun yawma-idhin wājifatun
Hearts that Day will palpitate

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:9
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:9 - أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ
abṣāruhā khāshiʿatun
Their eyes humbled

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:10
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:10 - يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ
yaqūlūna a-innā lamardūdūna fī l-ḥāfirati
They say Will we indeed be returned to the former state

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:11
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:11 - أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَخِرَةً
a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman nakhiratan
What! When we are bones decayed

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:12
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:12 - قَالُوْا تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
qālū til'ka idhan karratun khāsiratun
They say This then (would be) a return losing

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:13
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:13 - فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun
Then only it (will be) a shout single

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:14
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:14 - فَإِذَا هُمْ بِالسَّاهِرَةِ
fa-idhā hum bil-sāhirati
And behold They (will be) awakened

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:15
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:15 - هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ مُوسٰی
hal atāka ḥadīthu mūsā
Has (there) come to you (the) story (of) Musa

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:16
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:16 - إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
idh nādāhu rabbuhu bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwan
When called him his Lord in the valley the sacred (of) Tuwa

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:17
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:17 - اِذْهَبْ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَى
idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā
Go to Firaun Indeed, he (has) transgressed

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:18
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:18 - فَقُلْ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَى أَنْ تَزَكَّى
faqul hal laka ilā an tazakkā
And say Would [for] you to that purify yourself

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:19
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:19 - وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشٰی
wa-ahdiyaka ilā rabbika fatakhshā
And I will guide you to your Lord so you would fear

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:20
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:20 - فَأَرَاهُ الْاٰیَةَ الْكُبْرٰی
fa-arāhu l-āyata l-kub'rā
Then he showed him the sign the great

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:21
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:21 - فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَى
fakadhaba waʿaṣā
But he denied and disobeyed

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:22
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:22 - ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَى
thumma adbara yasʿā
Then he turned his back striving

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:23
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:23 - فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَى
faḥashara fanādā
And he gathered and called out

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:24
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:24 - فَقَالَ أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْاَعْلٰی
faqāla anā rabbukumu l-aʿlā
Then he said I am your Lord the Most High

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:25
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:25 - فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ نَكَالَ الْاٰخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَى
fa-akhadhahu l-lahu nakāla l-ākhirati wal-ūlā
So seized him Allah (with) an exemplary punishment (for) the last and the first

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:26
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:26 - إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشٰی
inna fī dhālika laʿib'ratan liman yakhshā
Indeed in that surely (is) a lesson for whoever fears

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:27
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:27 - ءَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ بَنَاهَا
a-antum ashaddu khalqan ami l-samāu banāhā
Are you a more difficult creation or the heaven He constructed it

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:28
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:28 - رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا
rafaʿa samkahā fasawwāhā
He raised its ceiling and proportioned it

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:29
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:29 - وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا
wa-aghṭasha laylahā wa-akhraja ḍuḥāhā
And He darkened its night and brought out its brightness

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:30
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:30 - وَالْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ دَحَاهَا
wal-arḍa baʿda dhālika daḥāhā
And the earth after that He spread it

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:31
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:31 - أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَاءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا
akhraja min'hā māahā wamarʿāhā
He brought forth from it its water and its pasture

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:32
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:32 - وَالْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا
wal-jibāla arsāhā
And the mountains He made them firm

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:33
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:33 - مَتَاعًا لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
matāʿan lakum wali-anʿāmikum
(As) a provision for you and for your cattle

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:34
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:34 - فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ الْكُبْرٰی
fa-idhā jāati l-ṭāmatu l-kub'rā
But when comes the Overwhelming Calamity the great

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:35
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:35 - يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا سَعَى
yawma yatadhakkaru l-insānu mā saʿā
(The) Day will remember man what he strove (for)

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:36
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:36 - وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَنْ يَرٰی
waburrizati l-jaḥīmu liman yarā
And will be made manifest the Hellfire to (him) who sees

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:37
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:37 - فَأَمَّا مَنْ طَغَى
fa-ammā man ṭaghā
Then as for (him) who transgressed

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:38
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:38 - وَءَاثَرَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
waāthara l-ḥayata l-dun'yā
And preferred the life (of) the world

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:39
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:39 - فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَى
fa-inna l-jaḥīma hiya l-mawā
Then indeed the Hellfire it (is) the refuge

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:40
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:40 - وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَى
wa-ammā man khāfa maqāma rabbihi wanahā l-nafsa ʿani l-hawā
But as for (him) who feared standing (before) his Lord and restrained his soul from the vain desires

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:41
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:41 - فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَى
fa-inna l-janata hiya l-mawā
Then indeed Paradise it (is) the refuge

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:42
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:42 - يَسْءَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا
yasalūnaka ʿani l-sāʿati ayyāna mur'sāhā
They ask you about the Hour when (is) its arrival

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:43
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:43 - فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرَاهَا
fīma anta min dhik'rāhā
In what (are) you of (to) mention it

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:44
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:44 - إِلَى رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهَاهَا
ilā rabbika muntahāhā
To your Lord (is) its finality

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:45
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:45 - إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ مَنْ يَخْشَاهَا
innamā anta mundhiru man yakhshāhā
Only you (are) a warner (for him) who fears it

item.title: An-Naazi'aat:46
item.description:
An-Naazi'aat:46 - كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوْۤا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
ka-annahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathū illā ʿashiyyatan aw ḍuḥāhā
As though they (the) Day they see it not they had remained except an evening or a morning thereof

item.title: 80. عبس (Abasa)
item.description:
The surah that opens with admonishing the Prophet and refers to him as He [who] Frowned and turned away. While the Prophet was speaking to some unbelieving nobles of Quraysh, hoping to convert them, a blind Muslim man came up to learn from him, but in his eagerness to attract the disbelievers to Islam, the Prophet frowned at him. The Prophet is then reproached and told not to concern himself with the disbelievers. It takes its name from the word "he frowned" ('abasa) in verse 1. The surah also deals with the condemnation of man's ingratitude: man becomes self-satisfied and forgets his origin and his final return to God.
The surah is also known as He Made a Wry Face, He Who Frowned

80:1
عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّى
ʿabasa watawallā
He frowned and turned away

80:2
أَنْ جَاءَهُ الْأَعْمَى
an jāahu l-aʿmā
Because came to him the blind man

80:3
وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّى
wamā yud'rīka laʿallahu yazzakkā
But what would make you know that he might purify himself

item.title: Abasa:1
item.description:
Abasa:1 - عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّى
ʿabasa watawallā
He frowned and turned away

item.title: Abasa:2
item.description:
Abasa:2 - أَنْ جَاءَهُ الْأَعْمَى
an jāahu l-aʿmā
Because came to him the blind man

item.title: Abasa:3
item.description:
Abasa:3 - وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّى
wamā yud'rīka laʿallahu yazzakkā
But what would make you know that he might purify himself

item.title: Abasa:4
item.description:
Abasa:4 - أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنْفَعَهُ الذِّكْرٰی
aw yadhakkaru fatanfaʿahu l-dhik'rā
Or be reminded so would benefit him the reminder

item.title: Abasa:5
item.description:
Abasa:5 - أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَى
ammā mani is'taghnā
As for (him) who considers himself free from need

item.title: Abasa:6
item.description:
Abasa:6 - فَأَنْتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّى
fa-anta lahu taṣaddā
So you to him give attention

item.title: Abasa:7
item.description:
Abasa:7 - وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّى
wamā ʿalayka allā yazzakkā
And not upon you that not he purifies himself

item.title: Abasa:8
item.description:
Abasa:8 - وَأَمَّا مَنْ جَاءَكَ يَسْعَى
wa-ammā man jāaka yasʿā
But as for (he) who came to you striving

item.title: Abasa:9
item.description:
Abasa:9 - وَهُوَ يَخْشٰی
wahuwa yakhshā
While he fears

item.title: Abasa:10
item.description:
Abasa:10 - فَأَنْتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّى
fa-anta ʿanhu talahhā
But you from him (are) distracted

item.title: Abasa:11
item.description:
Abasa:11 - كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
kallā innahā tadhkiratun
Nay Indeed, it (is) a reminder

item.title: Abasa:12
item.description:
Abasa:12 - فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
faman shāa dhakarahu
So whosoever wills may remember it

item.title: Abasa:13
item.description:
Abasa:13 - فِي صُحُفٍ مُكَرَّمَةٍ
fī ṣuḥufin mukarramatin
In sheets honored

item.title: Abasa:14
item.description:
Abasa:14 - مَرْفُوعَةٍ مُطَهَّرَةٍ
marfūʿatin muṭahharatin
Exalted purified

item.title: Abasa:15
item.description:
Abasa:15 - بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ bi-aydī safaratin In (the) hands (of) scribes
  • [1] Or 'scribes.'

item.title: Abasa:16
item.description:
Abasa:16 - كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ
kirāmin bararatin
Noble dutiful

item.title: Abasa:17
item.description:
Abasa:17 - قُتِلَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا أَكْفَرَهُ
qutila l-insānu mā akfarahu
Is destroyed [the] man how ungrateful is he

item.title: Abasa:18
item.description:
Abasa:18 - مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ
min ayyi shayin khalaqahu
From what thing He created him

item.title: Abasa:19
item.description:
Abasa:19 - مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ
min nuṭ'fatin khalaqahu faqaddarahu
From a semen-drop He created him then He proportioned him

item.title: Abasa:20
item.description:
Abasa:20 - ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ
thumma l-sabīla yassarahu
Then the way He made easy for him

item.title: Abasa:21
item.description:
Abasa:21 - ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ
thumma amātahu fa-aqbarahu
Then He causes him to die and provides a grave for him

item.title: Abasa:22
item.description:
Abasa:22 - ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنْشَرَهُ
thumma idhā shāa ansharahu
Then when He wills He will resurrect him

item.title: Abasa:23
item.description:
Abasa:23 - كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ
kallā lammā yaqḍi mā amarahu
Nay Not he has accomplished what He commanded him

item.title: Abasa:24
item.description:
Abasa:24 - فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ إِلَى طَعَامِهِ falyanẓuri l-insānu ilā ṭaʿāmihi Then let look the man at his food
  • [1] Or 'consider.'

item.title: Abasa:25
item.description:
Abasa:25 - أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا
annā ṣababnā l-māa ṣabban
That [We] [We] poured the water (in) abundance

item.title: Abasa:26
item.description:
Abasa:26 - ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
thumma shaqaqnā l-arḍa shaqqan
Then We cleaved the earth splitting

item.title: Abasa:27
item.description:
Abasa:27 - فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
fa-anbatnā fīhā ḥabban
Then We caused to grow therein grain

item.title: Abasa:28
item.description:
Abasa:28 - وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
waʿinaban waqaḍban
And grapes and green fodder

item.title: Abasa:29
item.description:
Abasa:29 - وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
wazaytūnan wanakhlan
And olive and date-palms

item.title: Abasa:30
item.description:
Abasa:30 - وَحَدَائِقَ غُلْبًا
waḥadāiqa ghul'ban
And gardens (of) thick foliage

item.title: Abasa:31
item.description:
Abasa:31 - وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
wafākihatan wa-abban
And fruits and grass

item.title: Abasa:32
item.description:
Abasa:32 - مَتَاعًا لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
matāʿan lakum wali-anʿāmikum
(As) a provision for you and for your cattle

item.title: Abasa:33
item.description:
Abasa:33 - فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ
fa-idhā jāati l-ṣākhatu
But when comes the Deafening Blast

item.title: Abasa:34
item.description:
Abasa:34 - يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
yawma yafirru l-maru min akhīhi
(The) Day will flee a man from his brother

item.title: Abasa:35
item.description:
Abasa:35 - وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ
wa-ummihi wa-abīhi
And his mother and his father

item.title: Abasa:36
item.description:
Abasa:36 - وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ
waṣāḥibatihi wabanīhi
And his wife and his children

item.title: Abasa:37
item.description:
Abasa:37 - لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
likulli im'ri-in min'hum yawma-idhin shanun yugh'nīhi
For every man among them that Day (will be) a matter occupying him

item.title: Abasa:38
item.description:
Abasa:38 - وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُسْفِرَةٌ
wujūhun yawma-idhin mus'firatun
Faces that Day (will be) bright

item.title: Abasa:39
item.description:
Abasa:39 - ضَاحِكَةٌ مُسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
ḍāḥikatun mus'tabshiratun
Laughing rejoicing at good news

item.title: Abasa:40
item.description:
Abasa:40 - وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
wawujūhun yawma-idhin ʿalayhā ghabaratun
And faces that Day upon them (will be) dust

item.title: Abasa:41
item.description:
Abasa:41 - تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
tarhaquhā qataratun
Will cover them darkness

item.title: Abasa:42
item.description:
Abasa:42 - اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ ulāika humu l-kafaratu l-fajaratu Those they (are) the disbelievers the wicked ones
  • [1] Or 'vicious ingrates.'

item.title: 81. التكوير (At-Takwir)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a riveting description of The Winding Up of the sun at the end of earthly life and the dawn of eternity. It takes its name from "the winding up", "the enfolding" or "the darkening" (takwīr) of the sun as mentioned in verse 1. The surah stress the fact that people will be confronted by their deeds on Judgement Day, asserting the truth of the Quran, and calling people to the right path. It opens with a powerful description of events on that Day.
The surah is also known as Shrouded in Darkness, The Cessation, The Compacting, The Darkening, The Enfolding, The Folding up, Wrapping Things Up

81:1
إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
idhā l-shamsu kuwwirat
When the sun is wrapped up

81:2
وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ
wa-idhā l-nujūmu inkadarat
And when the stars fall, losing their luster

81:3
وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
wa-idhā l-jibālu suyyirat
And when the mountains are moved away

item.title: At-Takwir:1
item.description:
At-Takwir:1 - إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ idhā l-shamsu kuwwirat When the sun is wrapped up
  • [1] Or 'turns dark.'

item.title: At-Takwir:2
item.description:
At-Takwir:2 - وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ wa-idhā l-nujūmu inkadarat And when the stars fall, losing their luster
  • [1] Or 'fall down.'

item.title: At-Takwir:3
item.description:
At-Takwir:3 - وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
wa-idhā l-jibālu suyyirat
And when the mountains are moved away

item.title: At-Takwir:4
item.description:
At-Takwir:4 - وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
wa-idhā l-ʿishāru ʿuṭṭilat
And when the full-term she-camels (are) left untended

item.title: At-Takwir:5
item.description:
At-Takwir:5 - وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
wa-idhā l-wuḥūshu ḥushirat
And when the wild beasts are gathered

item.title: At-Takwir:6
item.description:
At-Takwir:6 - وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
wa-idhā l-biḥāru sujjirat
And when the seas are made to overflow

item.title: At-Takwir:7
item.description:
At-Takwir:7 - وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ wa-idhā l-nufūsu zuwwijat And when the souls are paired
  • [1] That is, separated into different groups according to their character; cf. (Q 56:7); (Q 37:22). Or 'mated;' cf. (Q 52:20).

item.title: At-Takwir:8
item.description:
At-Takwir:8 - وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
wa-idhā l-mawūdatu su-ilat
And when the female infant buried alive is asked

item.title: At-Takwir:9
item.description:
At-Takwir:9 - بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ
bi-ayyi dhanbin qutilat
For what sin she was killed

item.title: At-Takwir:10
item.description:
At-Takwir:10 - وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
wa-idhā l-ṣuḥufu nushirat
And when the pages are laid open

item.title: At-Takwir:11
item.description:
At-Takwir:11 - وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ
wa-idhā l-samāu kushiṭat
And when the sky is stripped away

item.title: At-Takwir:12
item.description:
At-Takwir:12 - وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
wa-idhā l-jaḥīmu suʿʿirat
And when the Hellfire is set ablaze

item.title: At-Takwir:13
item.description:
At-Takwir:13 - وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
wa-idhā l-janatu uz'lifat
And when Paradise is brought near

item.title: At-Takwir:14
item.description:
At-Takwir:14 - عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ
ʿalimat nafsun mā aḥḍarat
Will know a soul what it has brought

item.title: At-Takwir:15
item.description:
At-Takwir:15 - فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ
falā uq'simu bil-khunasi
But nay I swear by the retreating planets

item.title: At-Takwir:16
item.description:
At-Takwir:16 - اَلْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ
al-jawāri l-kunasi
Those that run (and) disappear

item.title: At-Takwir:17
item.description:
At-Takwir:17 - وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
wa-al-layli idhā ʿasʿasa
And the night when it departs

item.title: At-Takwir:18
item.description:
At-Takwir:18 - وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
wal-ṣub'ḥi idhā tanaffasa
And the dawn when it breathes

item.title: At-Takwir:19
item.description:
At-Takwir:19 - إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ innahu laqawlu rasūlin karīmin Indeed, it (is) surely a word (of) a Messenger noble
  • [1] Cf. (Q 69:40).

item.title: At-Takwir:20
item.description:
At-Takwir:20 - ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
dhī quwwatin ʿinda dhī l-ʿarshi makīnin
Possessor of power with (the) Owner of the Throne secure

item.title: At-Takwir:21
item.description:
At-Takwir:21 - مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
muṭāʿin thamma amīnin
One to be obeyed and trustworthy

item.title: At-Takwir:22
item.description:
At-Takwir:22 - وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
wamā ṣāḥibukum bimajnūnin
And not (is) your companion mad

item.title: At-Takwir:23
item.description:
At-Takwir:23 - وَلَقَدْ رَاٰهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ
walaqad raāhu bil-ufuqi l-mubīni
And certainly he saw him in the horizon the clear

item.title: At-Takwir:24
item.description:
At-Takwir:24 - وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
wamā huwa ʿalā l-ghaybi biḍanīnin
And not he (is) on the unseen a withholder

item.title: At-Takwir:25
item.description:
At-Takwir:25 - وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ
wamā huwa biqawli shayṭānin rajīmin
And not it (is the) word (of) Shaitaan accursed

item.title: At-Takwir:26
item.description:
At-Takwir:26 - فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
fa-ayna tadhhabūna
So where are you going

item.title: At-Takwir:27
item.description:
At-Takwir:27 - إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīna
Not it (is) except a reminder to the worlds

item.title: At-Takwir:28
item.description:
At-Takwir:28 - لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ liman shāa minkum an yastaqīma For whoever wills among you to take a straight way
  • [1] Or 'for those of you who wish to walk straight.'

item.title: At-Takwir:29
item.description:
At-Takwir:29 - وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna
And not you will except that wills Allah Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: 82. الإنفطار (Al-Infitaar)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a riveting description of The Rending open of the sky at the onset of the Day of Resurrection and assets that every human is being watched by angels and shall stand accountable before God in the Hereafter. It takes its name from "the renting" or "torn apart" (infiṭār) of the sky mentioned in verse 1. The surah deals with man's ingratitude and his failure to concede that the Day of Judgement will come.
The surah is also known as Bursting Apart, Cleft Asunder, The Cataclysm, The Cleaving Asunder, The Splitting, Torn Apart

82:1
إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْفَطَرَتْ
idhā l-samāu infaṭarat
When the sky (is) cleft asunder

82:2
وَإِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انْتَثَرَتْ
wa-idhā l-kawākibu intatharat
And when the stars scatter

82:3
وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
wa-idhā l-biḥāru fujjirat
And when the seas are made to gush forth

item.title: Al-Infitaar:1
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:1 - إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْفَطَرَتْ
idhā l-samāu infaṭarat
When the sky (is) cleft asunder

item.title: Al-Infitaar:2
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:2 - وَإِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انْتَثَرَتْ
wa-idhā l-kawākibu intatharat
And when the stars scatter

item.title: Al-Infitaar:3
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:3 - وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
wa-idhā l-biḥāru fujjirat
And when the seas are made to gush forth

item.title: Al-Infitaar:4
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:4 - وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
wa-idhā l-qubūru buʿ'thirat
And when the graves are overturned

item.title: Al-Infitaar:5
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:5 - عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ʿalimat nafsun mā qaddamat wa-akharat
Will know a soul what it has sent forth and left behind

item.title: Al-Infitaar:6
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:6 - يَاأَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ yāayyuhā l-insānu mā gharraka birabbika l-karīmi O man What has deceived you concerning your Lord the Most Noble
  • [1] Or 'noble.'

item.title: Al-Infitaar:7
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:7 - اَلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
alladhī khalaqaka fasawwāka faʿadalaka
Who created you then fashioned you then balanced you

item.title: Al-Infitaar:8
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:8 - فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
fī ayyi ṣūratin mā shāa rakkabaka
In whatever form what He willed He assembled you

item.title: Al-Infitaar:9
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:9 - كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ
kallā bal tukadhibūna bil-dīni
Nay But you deny the Judgment

item.title: Al-Infitaar:10
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:10 - وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
wa-inna ʿalaykum laḥāfiẓīna
And indeed over you (are) surely guardians

item.title: Al-Infitaar:11
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:11 - كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ
kirāman kātibīna
Noble recording

item.title: Al-Infitaar:12
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:12 - يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
yaʿlamūna mā tafʿalūna
They know whatever you do

item.title: Al-Infitaar:13
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:13 - إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِیْ نَعِيمٍ
inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmin
Indeed the righteous (will be) surely in bliss

item.title: Al-Infitaar:14
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:14 - وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِیْ جَحِيمٍ
wa-inna l-fujāra lafī jaḥīmin
And indeed the wicked (will be) surely in Hellfire

item.title: Al-Infitaar:15
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:15 - يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ yaṣlawnahā yawma l-dīni They will burn (in) it (on the) Day (of) the Judgment
  • [1] Or 'the Day of Judgement.'

item.title: Al-Infitaar:16
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:16 - وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَائِبِينَ
wamā hum ʿanhā bighāibīna
And not they from it (will be) absent

item.title: Al-Infitaar:17
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:17 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
wamā adrāka mā yawmu l-dīni
And what can make you know what (is the) Day (of) the Judgment

item.title: Al-Infitaar:18
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:18 - ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
thumma mā adrāka mā yawmu l-dīni
Then what can make you know what (is the) Day (of) the Judgment

item.title: Al-Infitaar:19
item.description:
Al-Infitaar:19 - يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
yawma lā tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan wal-amru yawma-idhin lillahi
(The) Day not will have power a soul for a soul anything and the Command that Day (will be) with Allah

item.title: 83. المطففين (Al-Mutaffifin)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a dire divine warning of a debasing punishment awaiting in the Hereafter for those who practice cheating as a norm in commerce, and whom is calls The Defrauders because they insist on receiving a full amount in return for the partial measure that they themselves give. It takes its name from verse 1, which condemns the tradesmen who cheat customers by using short weights and measures (muṭaffifūn). It appears that the practice of cheating have been prevalent in Mecca, and is strongly condemned here and elsewhere in the Quran (e.g. 11: 84 ff.; 7: 85).
The surah is also known as The Cheats, The Dealing in Fraud, The Defrauders, The Stinters, The Unjust, Those who Give Short Measure

83:1
وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
waylun lil'muṭaffifīna
Woe to those who give less

83:2
اَلَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوْۤا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūna
Those who when they take a measure from the people they take in full

83:3
وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
wa-idhā kālūhum aw wazanūhum yukh'sirūna
But when they give by measure (to) them or they weigh (for) them they give less

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:1
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:1 - وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
waylun lil'muṭaffifīna
Woe to those who give less

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:2
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:2 - اَلَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوْۤا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūna
Those who when they take a measure from the people they take in full

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:3
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:3 - وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
wa-idhā kālūhum aw wazanūhum yukh'sirūna
But when they give by measure (to) them or they weigh (for) them they give less

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:4
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:4 - أَلَا يَظُنُّ اُولٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ
alā yaẓunnu ulāika annahum mabʿūthūna
Do not think those that they (will be) resurrected

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:5
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:5 - لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
liyawmin ʿaẓīmin
For a Day Great

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:6
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:6 - يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
yawma yaqūmu l-nāsu lirabbi l-ʿālamīna
(The) Day will stand mankind before (the) Lord (of) the worlds

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:7
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:7 - كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِیْ سِجِّينٍ
kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīnin
Nay Indeed (the) record (of) the wicked (is) surely in Sijjin

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:8
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:8 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
wamā adrāka mā sijjīnun
And what can make you know what (is) Sijjin

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:9
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:9 - كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ
kitābun marqūmun
A book written

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:10
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:10 - وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
waylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna
Woe that Day to the deniers

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:11
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:11 - اَلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
alladhīna yukadhibūna biyawmi l-dīni
Those who deny (the) Day (of) the Judgment

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:12
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:12 - وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmin
And not can deny [of] it except every transgressor sinful

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:13
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:13 - إِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna
When are recited to him Our Verses he says Stories (of) the former (people)

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:14
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:14 - كَلَّا بَلْ رَانَ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَكْسِبُونَ kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūna Nay But (the) stain has covered over their hearts (for) what they used to earn
  • [1] Or 'overcast.'

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:15
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:15 - كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ
kallā innahum ʿan rabbihim yawma-idhin lamaḥjūbūna
Nay Indeed, they from their Lord that Day surely will be partitioned

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:16
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:16 - ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوْۤا الْجَحِيمِ
thumma innahum laṣālū l-jaḥīmi
Then indeed, they (surely) will burn (in) the Hellfire

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:17
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:17 - ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna
Then it will be said This (is) what you used to of it deny

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:18
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:18 - كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِیْ عِلِّيِّينَ
kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīna
Nay Indeed (the) record (of) the righteous (will be) surely in Illiyin

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:19
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:19 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
wamā adrāka mā ʿilliyyūna
And what can make you know what (is) Illiyun

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:20
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:20 - كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ
kitābun marqūmun
A book written

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:21
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:21 - يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
yashhaduhu l-muqarabūna
Witness it those brought near

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:22
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:22 - إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِیْ نَعِيمٍ
inna l-abrāra lafī naʿīmin
Indeed the righteous (will be) surely in bliss

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:23
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:23 - عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ
ʿalā l-arāiki yanẓurūna
On thrones observing

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:24
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:24 - تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ
taʿrifu fī wujūhihim naḍrata l-naʿīmi
You will recognize in their faces (the) radiance (of) bliss

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:25
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:25 - يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَحِيقٍ مَخْتُومٍ
yus'qawna min raḥīqin makhtūmin
They will be given to drink of a pure wine sealed

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:26
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:26 - خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
