khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūna
Its seal (will be of) musk And for that let aspire the aspirers

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:27
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:27 - وَمِزَاجُهُ مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ
wamizājuhu min tasnīmin
And its mixture (is) of Tasneem

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:28
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:28 - عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ʿaynan yashrabu bihā l-muqarabūna
A spring will drink from it those brought near

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:29
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:29 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوْۤا كَانُوْۤا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا يَضْحَكُونَ
inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūna
Indeed those who committed crimes used to at those who believed laugh

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:30
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:30 - وَإِذَا مَرُّوْۤا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
wa-idhā marrū bihim yataghāmazūna
And when they passed by them they winked at one another

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:31
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:31 - وَإِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلَى أَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ
wa-idhā inqalabū ilā ahlihimu inqalabū fakihīna
And when they returned to their people they would return jesting

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:32
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:32 - وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوْا إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ
wa-idhā ra-awhum qālū inna hāulāi laḍāllūna
And when they saw them they said Indeed these surely have gone astray

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:33
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:33 - وَمَا أُرْسِلُوْۤا عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
wamā ur'silū ʿalayhim ḥāfiẓīna
But not they had been sent over them (as) guardians

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:34
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:34 - فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
fal-yawma alladhīna āmanū mina l-kufāri yaḍḥakūna
So today those who believed at the disbelievers they will laugh

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:35
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:35 - عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ
ʿalā l-arāiki yanẓurūna
On the thrones observing

item.title: Al-Mutaffifin:36
item.description:
Al-Mutaffifin:36 - هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوْۤا يَفْعَلُونَ
hal thuwwiba l-kufāru mā kānū yafʿalūna
Have (not) been rewarded the disbelievers (for) what they used to do

item.title: 84. الإنشقاق (Al-Inshiqaaq)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a riveting description of The Splitting of the sky and the levelling of the earth as a sign of the commencement of the Day of Resurrection. It is named after the "splitting open" (inshiqāq) of the sky mentioned in verse 1. The surah deals with the inevitability of man's meeting with his Lord on the Day of Judgement. The obedience of the sky and earth is contrasted with the disobedience of the disbelievers. The reaction of the believers and of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgement is described.
The surah is also known as Bursting Asunder, Ripped Apart, Splitting Open, The Bursting, The Cleaving, The Rending, The Rending Asunder

84:1
إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
idhā l-samāu inshaqqat
When the sky is split asunder

84:2
وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqat
And has listened to its Lord and was obligated

84:3
وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
wa-idhā l-arḍu muddat
And when the earth is spread

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:1
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:1 - إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
idhā l-samāu inshaqqat
When the sky is split asunder

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:2
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:2 - وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqat
And has listened to its Lord and was obligated

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:3
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:3 - وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
wa-idhā l-arḍu muddat
And when the earth is spread

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:4
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:4 - وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
wa-alqat mā fīhā watakhallat
And has cast out what (is) in it and becomes empty

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:5
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:5 - وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
wa-adhinat lirabbihā waḥuqqat
And has listened to its Lord and was obligated

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:6
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:6 - يَاأَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ
yāayyuhā l-insānu innaka kādiḥun ilā rabbika kadḥan famulāqīhi
O mankind Indeed, you (are) laboring to your Lord (with) exertion and you (will) meet Him

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:7
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:7 - فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi
Then as for (him) who is given his record in his right (hand)

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:8
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:8 - فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
fasawfa yuḥāsabu ḥisāban yasīran
Then soon his account will be taken an account easy

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:9
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:9 - وَيَنْقَلِبُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
wayanqalibu ilā ahlihi masrūran
And he will return to his people happily

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:10
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:10 - وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ
wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu warāa ẓahrihi
But as for (him) who is given his record behind his back

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:11
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:11 - فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوْۤا ثُبُورًا fasawfa yadʿū thubūran Then soon he will call (for) destruction
  • [1] Cf. (Q 25:13) - (Q 25:14), (Q 78:40).

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:12
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:12 - وَيَصْلَى سَعِيرًا
wayaṣlā saʿīran
And he will burn (in) a Blaze

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:13
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:13 - إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
innahu kāna fī ahlihi masrūran
Indeed, he had been among his people happy

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:14
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:14 - إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ يَحُورَ
innahu ẓanna an lan yaḥūra
Indeed, he (had) thought that never he would return

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:15
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:15 - بَلَى إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا
balā inna rabbahu kāna bihi baṣīran
Yes Indeed his Lord was of him All-Seer

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:16
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:16 - فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ
falā uq'simu bil-shafaqi
But nay I swear by the twilight glow

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:17
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:17 - وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
wa-al-layli wamā wasaqa
And the night and what it envelops

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:18
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:18 - وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ
wal-qamari idhā ittasaqa
And the moon when it becomes full

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:19
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:19 - لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ
latarkabunna ṭabaqan ʿan ṭabaqin
You will surely embark (to) stage from stage

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:20
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:20 - فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
famā lahum lā yu'minūna
So what (is) for them not they believe

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:21
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:21 - وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْاٰنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ
wa-idhā quri-a ʿalayhimu l-qur'ānu lā yasjudūna
And when is recited to them the Quran not they prostrate

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:22
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:22 - بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا يُكَذِّبُونَ
bali alladhīna kafarū yukadhibūna
Nay Those who disbelieved deny

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:23
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:23 - وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
wal-lahu aʿlamu bimā yūʿūna
And Allah (is) most knowing of what they keep within themselves

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:24
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:24 - فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
fabashir'hum biʿadhābin alīmin
so give them tidings of a punishment painful

item.title: Al-Inshiqaaq:25
item.description:
Al-Inshiqaaq:25 - إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin
Except those who believe and do righteous deeds For them (is) a reward never ending

item.title: 85. البروج (Al-Burooj)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a three-part oath of the Divine One, who swears by the sky studded with The Houses, by the assurance that the Day of Resurrection shall come, and by His Own Universal Witness, which beholds all, that the believers shall have their reward, and the unbelievers their punishment, in the Hereafter. It takes is name from "the houses" (burūj) mentioned in verse 1, normally understood in conjunction to the constellations. The surah strengthened the heart of the Prophet Muḥammad and his followers by referring to the fate of those who tortured earlier believers. The title expresses God's power over the whole universe, from the stars in the sky to the evildoers referred to in this surah. Indeed, His all-encompassing power is a recurring theme throughout the surah.
The surah is also known as: Signs of the Zodiac, The Constellations, The Houses of the Zodiac, The Towering Constellations, Zodiacal Signs.

85:1
وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ
wal-samāi dhāti l-burūji
By the sky containing the constellations

85:2
وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ
wal-yawmi l-mawʿūdi
And the Day Promised

85:3
وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
washāhidin wamashhūdin
And (the) witness and what is witnessed

item.title: Al-Burooj:1
item.description:
Al-Burooj:1 - وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ
wal-samāi dhāti l-burūji
By the sky containing the constellations

item.title: Al-Burooj:2
item.description:
Al-Burooj:2 - وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ
wal-yawmi l-mawʿūdi
And the Day Promised

item.title: Al-Burooj:3
item.description:
Al-Burooj:3 - وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ washāhidin wamashhūdin And (the) witness and what is witnessed
  • [1] That is the Prophet (ṣ); cf. (Q 2:143); (Q 4:41); (Q 16:89); (Q 33:45).
  • [2] That is, the Day of Judgement; cf. (Q 11:103).

item.title: Al-Burooj:4
item.description:
Al-Burooj:4 - قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ
qutila aṣḥābu l-ukh'dūdi
Destroyed were (the) companions (of) the pit

item.title: Al-Burooj:5
item.description:
Al-Burooj:5 - اَلنَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ
al-nāri dhāti l-waqūdi
(Of) the fire full (of) the fuel

item.title: Al-Burooj:6
item.description:
Al-Burooj:6 - إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
idh hum ʿalayhā quʿūdun
When they by it (were) sitting

item.title: Al-Burooj:7
item.description:
Al-Burooj:7 - وَهُمْ عَلَى مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
wahum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bil-mu'minīna shuhūdun
And they over what they were doing to the believers witnesses

item.title: Al-Burooj:8
item.description:
Al-Burooj:8 - وَمَا نَقَمُوْۤا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوْۤا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
wamā naqamū min'hum illā an yu'minū bil-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi
And not they resented [of] them except that they believed in Allah the All-Mighty the Praiseworthy

item.title: Al-Burooj:9
item.description:
Al-Burooj:9 - اَلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun
The One Who for Him (is) the dominion (of) the heavens and the earth and Allah on every thing (is) a Witness

item.title: Al-Burooj:10
item.description:
Al-Burooj:10 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوْۤا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوْۤا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ
inna alladhīna fatanū l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti thumma lam yatūbū falahum ʿadhābu jahannama walahum ʿadhābu l-ḥarīqi
Indeed those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women then not they repented then for them (is the) punishment (of) Hell and for them (is the) punishment (of) the Burning Fire

item.title: Al-Burooj:11
item.description:
Al-Burooj:11 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ
inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru dhālika l-fawzu l-kabīru
Indeed those who believe and do the righteous deeds for them (will be) Gardens flow from underneath it the rivers That (is) the success the great

item.title: Al-Burooj:12
item.description:
Al-Burooj:12 - إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
inna baṭsha rabbika lashadīdun
Indeed (the) Grip (of) your Lord (is) surely strong

item.title: Al-Burooj:13
item.description:
Al-Burooj:13 - إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
innahu huwa yub'di-u wayuʿīdu
Indeed He He originates and repeats

item.title: Al-Burooj:14
item.description:
Al-Burooj:14 - وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ
wahuwa l-ghafūru l-wadūdu
And He (is) the Oft-Forgiving the Most Loving

item.title: Al-Burooj:15
item.description:
Al-Burooj:15 - ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ dhū l-ʿarshi l-majīdu Owner (of) the Throne the Glorious
  • [1] Or 'Lord of the Glorious Throne,' in accordance with an alternate reading.

item.title: Al-Burooj:16
item.description:
Al-Burooj:16 - فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ
faʿʿālun limā yurīdu
Doer of what He intends

item.title: Al-Burooj:17
item.description:
Al-Burooj:17 - هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ الْجُنُودِ
hal atāka ḥadīthu l-junūdi
Has come to you (the) story (of) the hosts

item.title: Al-Burooj:18
item.description:
Al-Burooj:18 - فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
fir'ʿawna wathamūda
Firaun and Thamud

item.title: Al-Burooj:19
item.description:
Al-Burooj:19 - بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ
bali alladhīna kafarū fī takdhībin
Nay Those who disbelieve (are) in denial

item.title: Al-Burooj:20
item.description:
Al-Burooj:20 - وَاللَّهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ مُحِيطٌ
wal-lahu min warāihim muḥīṭun
But Allah from behind them encompasses

item.title: Al-Burooj:21
item.description:
Al-Burooj:21 - بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَجِيدٌ
bal huwa qur'ānun majīdun
Nay It (is) a Quran Glorious

item.title: Al-Burooj:22
item.description:
Al-Burooj:22 - فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ
fī lawḥin maḥfūẓin
In a Tablet Guarded

item.title: 86. الطارق (At-Taariq)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the sky of the world and The Nightly Visitor so called because it comes by night and leaves by day. It takes its name from verse 1 which mentions "the night-comer" or "nightly visitor" (ṭāriq). The surah focuses on a series of examples of things coming out: the piercing night-star, spurting semen, the baby that bursts out of the womb, and plants that sprout out of the ground. All of these are used to illustrate resurrection from the grave.
The surah is also known as: The Night Star, The Night-Comer, The Night-Visitant, The Nightcomer, The Nightly Visitant, The Piercing Star.

86:1
وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ
wal-samāi wal-ṭāriqi
By the sky and the night comer

86:2
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ
wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriqu
And what can make you know what the night comer (is)

86:3
اَلنَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ
al-najmu l-thāqibu
(It is) the star the piercing

item.title: At-Taariq:1
item.description:
At-Taariq:1 - وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ
wal-samāi wal-ṭāriqi
By the sky and the night comer

item.title: At-Taariq:2
item.description:
At-Taariq:2 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ
wamā adrāka mā l-ṭāriqu
And what can make you know what the night comer (is)

item.title: At-Taariq:3
item.description:
At-Taariq:3 - اَلنَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ
al-najmu l-thāqibu
(It is) the star the piercing

item.title: At-Taariq:4
item.description:
At-Taariq:4 - إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓun Not (is) every soul but over it (is) a protector
  • [1] Or 'watcher.'

item.title: At-Taariq:5
item.description:
At-Taariq:5 - فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
falyanẓuri l-insānu mimma khuliqa
So let see man from what he is created

item.title: At-Taariq:6
item.description:
At-Taariq:6 - خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ
khuliqa min māin dāfiqin
He is created from a water ejected

item.title: At-Taariq:7
item.description:
At-Taariq:7 - يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ
yakhruju min bayni l-ṣul'bi wal-tarāibi
Coming forth from between the backbone and the ribs

item.title: At-Taariq:8
item.description:
At-Taariq:8 - إِنَّهُ عَلَى رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ
innahu ʿalā rajʿihi laqādirun
Indeed, He to return him (is) Able

item.title: At-Taariq:9
item.description:
At-Taariq:9 - يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ
yawma tub'lā l-sarāiru
(The) Day will be tested the secrets

item.title: At-Taariq:10
item.description:
At-Taariq:10 - فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣirin
Then not (is) for him any power and not any helper

item.title: At-Taariq:11
item.description:
At-Taariq:11 - وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ wal-samāi dhāti l-rajʿi By the sky which returns
  • [1] Or 'by the sky endowed with rains.'

item.title: At-Taariq:12
item.description:
At-Taariq:12 - وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ
wal-arḍi dhāti l-ṣadʿi
And the earth which cracks open

item.title: At-Taariq:13
item.description:
At-Taariq:13 - إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
innahu laqawlun faṣlun
Indeed, it (is) surely a Word decisive

item.title: At-Taariq:14
item.description:
At-Taariq:14 - وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ
wamā huwa bil-hazli
And not it (is) for amusement

item.title: At-Taariq:15
item.description:
At-Taariq:15 - إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
innahum yakīdūna kaydan
Indeed, they are plotting a plot

item.title: At-Taariq:16
item.description:
At-Taariq:16 - وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
wa-akīdu kaydan
But I am planning a plan

item.title: At-Taariq:17
item.description:
At-Taariq:17 - فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا
famahhili l-kāfirīna amhil'hum ruwaydan
So give respite (to) the disbelievers Give respite to them little

item.title: 87. الأعلى (Al-A'laa)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the command to highly exalt God, the Divine One who is The Most Exalted, far above all that is unworthy that people wrongly attribute to Him. It is named after "the Most Exalted" (al-a'lā), mentioned in verse 1. The surah reassures the Prophet Muḥammad that God will help him and urging him to continue with his mission. The temporary nature of this world is highlighted through mention of the short life of green pasture (cf. verse 10:24 and verse 18: 45).
The surah is also known as Glory to Lord in the Highest, The Highest, The Most High

87:1
سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلٰی
sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿlā
Glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most High

87:2
اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّى
alladhī khalaqa fasawwā
The One Who created then proportioned

87:3
وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَى
wa-alladhī qaddara fahadā
And the One Who measured then guided

item.title: Al-A'laa:1
item.description:
Al-A'laa:1 - سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْاَعْلٰی
sabbiḥi is'ma rabbika l-aʿlā
Glorify (the) name (of) your Lord the Most High

item.title: Al-A'laa:2
item.description:
Al-A'laa:2 - اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّى
alladhī khalaqa fasawwā
The One Who created then proportioned

item.title: Al-A'laa:3
item.description:
Al-A'laa:3 - وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَى
wa-alladhī qaddara fahadā
And the One Who measured then guided

item.title: Al-A'laa:4
item.description:
Al-A'laa:4 - وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَى
wa-alladhī akhraja l-marʿā
And the One Who brings forth the pasture

item.title: Al-A'laa:5
item.description:
Al-A'laa:5 - فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَى
fajaʿalahu ghuthāan aḥwā
And then makes it stubble dark

item.title: Al-A'laa:6
item.description:
Al-A'laa:6 - سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنْسٰی
sanuq'ri-uka falā tansā
We will make you recite so not you will forget

item.title: Al-A'laa:7
item.description:
Al-A'laa:7 - إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَى
illā mā shāa l-lahu innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra wamā yakhfā
Except what wills Allah Indeed, He knows the manifest and what is hidden

item.title: Al-A'laa:8
item.description:
Al-A'laa:8 - وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَى
wanuyassiruka lil'yus'rā
And We will ease you to the ease

item.title: Al-A'laa:9
item.description:
Al-A'laa:9 - فَذَكِّرْ إِنْ نَفَعَتِ الذِّكْرٰی
fadhakkir in nafaʿati l-dhik'rā
So remind if benefits the reminder

item.title: Al-A'laa:10
item.description:
Al-A'laa:10 - سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَنْ يَخْشٰی
sayadhakkaru man yakhshā
He will pay heed (one) who fears (Allah)

item.title: Al-A'laa:11
item.description:
Al-A'laa:11 - وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى
wayatajannabuhā l-ashqā
And will avoid it the wretched one

item.title: Al-A'laa:12
item.description:
Al-A'laa:12 - اَلَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرٰی
alladhī yaṣlā l-nāra l-kub'rā
The one who will burn (in) the Fire [the] great

item.title: Al-A'laa:13
item.description:
Al-A'laa:13 - ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَى
thumma lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥyā
Then not he will die therein and not will live

item.title: Al-A'laa:14
item.description:
Al-A'laa:14 - قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّى
qad aflaḥa man tazakkā
Certainly has succeeded (one) who purifies (himself)

item.title: Al-A'laa:15
item.description:
Al-A'laa:15 - وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّى
wadhakara is'ma rabbihi faṣallā
And remembers (the) name (of) his Lord and prays

item.title: Al-A'laa:16
item.description:
Al-A'laa:16 - بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
bal tu'thirūna l-ḥayata l-dun'yā
Nay You prefer the life (of) the world

item.title: Al-A'laa:17
item.description:
Al-A'laa:17 - وَالْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى
wal-ākhiratu khayrun wa-abqā
While the Hereafter (is) better and everlasting

item.title: Al-A'laa:18
item.description:
Al-A'laa:18 - إِنَّ هَذَا لَفِیْ الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَى
inna hādhā lafī l-ṣuḥufi l-ūlā
Indeed this surely (is) in the Scriptures [the] former

item.title: Al-A'laa:19
item.description:
Al-A'laa:19 - صُحُفِ اِبْرَاهِیْمَ وَمُوسٰی
ṣuḥufi ib'rāhīma wamūsā
(The) Scriptures (of) Ibrahim and Musa

item.title: 88. الغاشية (Al-Ghaashiya)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the edifying question regarding human awareness of the coming of a sure cataclysmic event it calls The Enveloper. It takes its name from "the enveloper" (al-ghāshiyah) mentioned in verse 1. The surah serves to warn the disbelievers, encourage the Prophet Muḥammad and the believers, and absolve him of responsibility for the disbelievers.
The surah is also known as: The Overpowering, The Overwhelmer, The Overwhelming, The Overwhelming Event, The Pall, The Whelming.

88:1
هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ
hal atāka ḥadīthu l-ghāshiyati
Has (there) come to you (the) news (of) the Overwhelming

88:2
وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ
wujūhun yawma-idhin khāshiʿatun
Faces that Day (will be) humbled

88:3
عَامِلَةٌ نَاصِبَةٌ
ʿāmilatun nāṣibatun
Laboring exhausted

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:1
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:1 - هَلْ أَتَىكَ حَدِیْثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ
hal atāka ḥadīthu l-ghāshiyati
Has (there) come to you (the) news (of) the Overwhelming

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:2
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:2 - وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ
wujūhun yawma-idhin khāshiʿatun
Faces that Day (will be) humbled

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:3
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:3 - عَامِلَةٌ نَاصِبَةٌ
ʿāmilatun nāṣibatun
Laboring exhausted

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:4
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:4 - تَصْلٰی نَارًا حَامِيَةً
taṣlā nāran ḥāmiyatan
They will burn (in) a Fire intensely hot

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:5
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:5 - تُسْقَى مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
tus'qā min ʿaynin āniyatin
They will be given to drink from a spring boiling

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:6
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:6 - لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِیْعٍۙ
laysa lahum ṭaʿāmun illā min ḍarīʿin
Not is for them food except from a bitter thorny plant

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:7
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:7 - لَا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ
lā yus'minu walā yugh'nī min jūʿin
Not it nourishes and not it avails from hunger

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:8
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:8 - وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاعِمَةٌ
wujūhun yawma-idhin nāʿimatun
Faces that Day (will be) joyful

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:9
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:9 - لِسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
lisaʿyihā rāḍiyatun
With their effort satisfied

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:10
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:10 - فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
fī jannatin ʿāliyatin
In a garden elevated

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:11
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:11 - لَا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً
lā tasmaʿu fīhā lāghiyatan
Not they will hear therein vain talk

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:12
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:12 - فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
fīhā ʿaynun jāriyatun
Therein (will be) a spring flowing

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:13
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:13 - فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَرْفُوعَةٌ
fīhā sururun marfūʿatun
Therein (will be) thrones raised high

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:14
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:14 - وَأَكْوَابٌ مَوْضُوعَةٌ
wa-akwābun mawḍūʿatun
And cups put in place

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:15
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:15 - وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
wanamāriqu maṣfūfatun
And cushions lined up

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:16
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:16 - وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
wazarābiyyu mabthūthatun
And carpets spread out

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:17
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:17 - أَفَلَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الْاِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ afalā yanẓurūna ilā l-ibili kayfa khuliqat Then do not they look towards the camels how they are created
  • [1] Or 'consider.'

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:18
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:18 - وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
wa-ilā l-samāi kayfa rufiʿat
And towards the sky how it is raised

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:19
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:19 - وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
wa-ilā l-jibāli kayfa nuṣibat
And towards the mountains how they are fixed

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:20
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:20 - وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
wa-ilā l-arḍi kayfa suṭiḥat
And towards the earth how it is spread out

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:21
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:21 - فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
fadhakkir innamā anta mudhakkirun
So remind only you (are) a reminder

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:22
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:22 - لَسْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
lasta ʿalayhim bimuṣayṭirin
You are not over them a controller

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:23
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:23 - إِلَّا مَنْ تَوَلَّى وَكَفَرَ
illā man tawallā wakafara
But whoever turns away and disbelieves

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:24
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:24 - فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ
fayuʿadhibuhu l-lahu l-ʿadhāba l-akbara
Then will punish him Allah (with) the punishment greatest

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:25
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:25 - إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ
inna ilaynā iyābahum
Indeed to Us (will be) their return

item.title: Al-Ghaashiya:26
item.description:
Al-Ghaashiya:26 - ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ
thumma inna ʿalaynā ḥisābahum
Then indeed upon Us (is) their account

item.title: 89. الفجر (Al-Fajr)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by The Dawn, and other natural occurrences and sacred designations, as a means of categorical affirmation to mankind that God shall, indeed, hold all people accountable. It is names after "the dawn" (al-fajr) mentioned in verse 1. A surah in which God emphasizes that the tyrants of the Prophet's time will be like those He dealt with in the past. The surah compares the destiny of the ungrateful with that of the souls at peace.
The surah is also known as: The Daybreak.

89:1
وَالْفَجْرِ
wal-fajri
By the dawn

89:2
وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
walayālin ʿashrin
And the nights ten

89:3
وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ
wal-shafʿi wal-watri
And the even and the odd

item.title: Al-Fajr:1
item.description:
Al-Fajr:1 - وَالْفَجْرِ wal-fajri By the dawn
  • [1] Interpreted as the month of Muḥarram, which marks the beginning of the year. (Ṭabarī, Ta'rīkh, ii, 390, from Ibn 'Abbās)

item.title: Al-Fajr:2
item.description:
Al-Fajr:2 - وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
walayālin ʿashrin
And the nights ten

item.title: Al-Fajr:3
item.description:
Al-Fajr:3 - وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ
wal-shafʿi wal-watri
And the even and the odd

item.title: Al-Fajr:4
item.description:
Al-Fajr:4 - وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
wa-al-layli idhā yasri
And the night when it passes

item.title: Al-Fajr:5
item.description:
Al-Fajr:5 - هَلْ فِي ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذِي حِجْرٍ
hal fī dhālika qasamun lidhī ḥij'rin
Is in that (not) an oath for those who understand

item.title: Al-Fajr:6
item.description:
Al-Fajr:6 - أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿādin
Did not you see how dealt your Lord with Aad

item.title: Al-Fajr:7
item.description:
Al-Fajr:7 - إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ
irama dhāti l-ʿimādi
Iram possessors (of) lofty pillars

item.title: Al-Fajr:8
item.description:
Al-Fajr:8 - اَلَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ
allatī lam yukh'laq mith'luhā fī l-bilādi
Which not had been created like them in the cities

item.title: Al-Fajr:9
item.description:
Al-Fajr:9 - وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوْۤا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ
wathamūda alladhīna jābū l-ṣakhra bil-wādi
And Thamud who carved out the rocks in the valley

item.title: Al-Fajr:10
item.description:
Al-Fajr:10 - وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ wafir'ʿawna dhī l-awtādi And Firaun owner of stakes
  • [1] See the note at (Q 38:12).

item.title: Al-Fajr:11
item.description:
Al-Fajr:11 - اَلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ
alladhīna ṭaghaw fī l-bilādi
Who transgressed in the lands

item.title: Al-Fajr:12
item.description:
Al-Fajr:12 - فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ
fa-aktharū fīhā l-fasāda
And (made) much therein corruption

item.title: Al-Fajr:13
item.description:
Al-Fajr:13 - فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
faṣabba ʿalayhim rabbuka sawṭa ʿadhābin
So poured on them your Lord scourge (of) punishment

item.title: Al-Fajr:14
item.description:
Al-Fajr:14 - إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ
inna rabbaka labil-mir'ṣādi
Indeed your Lord (is) surely Ever Watchful

item.title: Al-Fajr:15
item.description:
Al-Fajr:15 - فَأَمَّا الْإِنْسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ
fa-ammā l-insānu idhā mā ib'talāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbī akramani
And as for man when does try him his Lord and is generous to him and favors him he says My Lord has honored me

item.title: Al-Fajr:16
item.description:
Al-Fajr:16 - وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ
wa-ammā idhā mā ib'talāhu faqadara ʿalayhi riz'qahu fayaqūlu rabbī ahānani
But when does He try him and restricts for him his provision then he says My Lord (has) humiliated me

item.title: Al-Fajr:17
item.description:
Al-Fajr:17 - كَلَّا بَلْ لَا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ
kallā bal lā tuk'rimūna l-yatīma
Nay But not you honor the orphan

item.title: Al-Fajr:18
item.description:
Al-Fajr:18 - وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
walā taḥāḍḍūna ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīni
And not you feel the urge to feed the poor

item.title: Al-Fajr:19
item.description:
Al-Fajr:19 - وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَمًّا
watakulūna l-turātha aklan lamman
And you consume the inheritance devouring altogether

item.title: Al-Fajr:20
item.description:
Al-Fajr:20 - وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
watuḥibbūna l-māla ḥubban jamman
And you love wealth (with) love immense

item.title: Al-Fajr:21
item.description:
Al-Fajr:21 - كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا kallā idhā dukkati l-arḍu dakkan dakkan Nay When is leveled the earth pounded (and) crushed
  • [1] Or 'crumbled into fragments.'

item.title: Al-Fajr:22
item.description:
Al-Fajr:22 - وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
wajāa rabbuka wal-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffan
And comes your Lord and the Angels rank (upon) rank

item.title: Al-Fajr:23
item.description:
Al-Fajr:23 - وَجِاىءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ وَأَنَّى لَهُ الذِّكْرَى
wajīa yawma-idhin bijahannama yawma-idhin yatadhakkaru l-insānu wa-annā lahu l-dhik'rā
And is brought that Day Hell That Day will remember man but how (will be) for him the remembrance

item.title: Al-Fajr:24
item.description:
Al-Fajr:24 - يَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي
yaqūlu yālaytanī qaddamtu liḥayātī
He will say O I wish I had sent forth for my life

item.title: Al-Fajr:25
item.description:
Al-Fajr:25 - فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ
fayawma-idhin lā yuʿadhibu ʿadhābahu aḥadun
So that Day not will punish (as) His punishment anyone

item.title: Al-Fajr:26
item.description:
Al-Fajr:26 - وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ
walā yūthiqu wathāqahu aḥadun
And not will bind (as) His binding anyone

item.title: Al-Fajr:27
item.description:
Al-Fajr:27 - يَاأَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
yāayyatuhā l-nafsu l-muṭ'ma-inatu
O soul who is satisfied

item.title: Al-Fajr:28
item.description:
Al-Fajr:28 - اِرْجِعِي إِلَى رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً
ir'jiʿī ilā rabbiki rāḍiyatan marḍiyyatan
Return to your Lord well pleased and pleasing

item.title: Al-Fajr:29
item.description:
Al-Fajr:29 - فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي
fa-ud'khulī fī ʿibādī
So enter among My slaves

item.title: Al-Fajr:30
item.description:
Al-Fajr:30 - وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي
wa-ud'khulī jannatī
And enter My Paradise

item.title: 90. البلد (Al-Balad)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the emphatic oath of the Divine One swearing by The City, that mankind us under the absolute power and watchfulness of God. It takes its name after the "city" or "town" (balad) mentioned in verse 1. The essential point of this surah is that man is created to work and be judged. He should therefore seek to do good deeds rather than indulge in arrogance and wastefulness.
The surah is also known as (This) Countryside, The Earth, The Land, The Town

90:1
لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَذَا الْبَلَدِ
lā uq'simu bihādhā l-baladi
Nay I swear by this city

90:2
وَأَنْتَ حِلٌّ بِهَذَا الْبَلَدِ
wa-anta ḥillun bihādhā l-baladi
And you (are) free (to dwell) in this city

90:3
وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
wawālidin wamā walada
And the begetter and what he begot

item.title: Al-Balad:1
item.description:
Al-Balad:1 - لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَذَا الْبَلَدِ
lā uq'simu bihādhā l-baladi
Nay I swear by this city

item.title: Al-Balad:2
item.description:
Al-Balad:2 - وَأَنْتَ حِلٌّ بِهَذَا الْبَلَدِ
wa-anta ḥillun bihādhā l-baladi
And you (are) free (to dwell) in this city

item.title: Al-Balad:3
item.description:
Al-Balad:3 - وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
wawālidin wamā walada
And the begetter and what he begot

item.title: Al-Balad:4
item.description:
Al-Balad:4 - لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ
laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī kabadin
Certainly We have created man (to be) in hardship

item.title: Al-Balad:5
item.description:
Al-Balad:5 - أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَنْ يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
ayaḥsabu an lan yaqdira ʿalayhi aḥadun
Does he think that not has power over him anyone

item.title: Al-Balad:6
item.description:
Al-Balad:6 - يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُبَدًا
yaqūlu ahlaktu mālan lubadan
He will say I have squandered wealth abundant

item.title: Al-Balad:7
item.description:
Al-Balad:7 - أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ
ayaḥsabu an lam yarahu aḥadun
Does he think that not sees him anyone

item.title: Al-Balad:8
item.description:
Al-Balad:8 - أَلَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ عَيْنَيْنِ
alam najʿal lahu ʿaynayni
Have not We made for him two eyes

item.title: Al-Balad:9
item.description:
Al-Balad:9 - وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
walisānan washafatayni
And a tongue and two lips

item.title: Al-Balad:10
item.description:
Al-Balad:10 - وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ
wahadaynāhu l-najdayni
And shown him the two ways

item.title: Al-Balad:11
item.description:
Al-Balad:11 - فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ
falā iq'taḥama l-ʿaqabata
But not he has attempted the steep path

item.title: Al-Balad:12
item.description:
Al-Balad:12 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ
wamā adrāka mā l-ʿaqabatu
And what can make you know what the steep path (is)

item.title: Al-Balad:13
item.description:
Al-Balad:13 - فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
fakku raqabatin
(It is) freeing a neck

item.title: Al-Balad:14
item.description:
Al-Balad:14 - أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ
aw iṭ'ʿāmun fī yawmin dhī masghabatin
Or feeding in a day of severe hunger

item.title: Al-Balad:15
item.description:
Al-Balad:15 - يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
yatīman dhā maqrabatin
An orphan of near relationship

item.title: Al-Balad:16
item.description:
Al-Balad:16 - أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
aw mis'kīnan dhā matrabatin
Or a needy person in misery

item.title: Al-Balad:17
item.description:
Al-Balad:17 - ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ
thumma kāna mina alladhīna āmanū watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri watawāṣaw bil-marḥamati
Then he is of those who believe and enjoin (each other) to patience and enjoin (each other) to compassion

item.title: Al-Balad:18
item.description:
Al-Balad:18 - اُولٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ
ulāika aṣḥābu l-maymanati
Those (are the) companions (of) the right (hand)

item.title: Al-Balad:19
item.description:
Al-Balad:19 - وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْءَمَةِ
wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyātinā hum aṣḥābu l-mashamati
But those who disbelieve in Our Verses they (are the) companions (of) the left (hand)

item.title: Al-Balad:20
item.description:
Al-Balad:20 - عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُؤْصَدَةٌ
ʿalayhim nārun mu'ṣadatun
Over them (will be the) Fire closed in

item.title: 91. الشمس (Ash-Shams)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by The Sun as it shines out with morning's radiance. It is named after "the sun" (al-shams), mentioned in verse 1. The central theme of the surah touch upon purifying or corrupting the soul, with the tribe of Thamūd given as an example of corruption.
The surah is also known as Sol

91:1
وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا
wal-shamsi waḍuḥāhā
By the sun and its brightness

91:2
وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا
wal-qamari idhā talāhā
And the moon when it follows it

91:3
وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا
wal-nahāri idhā jallāhā
And the day when it displays it

item.title: Ash-Shams:1
item.description:
Ash-Shams:1 - وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا
wal-shamsi waḍuḥāhā
By the sun and its brightness

item.title: Ash-Shams:2
item.description:
Ash-Shams:2 - وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا
wal-qamari idhā talāhā
And the moon when it follows it

item.title: Ash-Shams:3
item.description:
Ash-Shams:3 - وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا
wal-nahāri idhā jallāhā
And the day when it displays it

item.title: Ash-Shams:4
item.description:
Ash-Shams:4 - وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا
wa-al-layli idhā yaghshāhā
And the night when it covers it

item.title: Ash-Shams:5
item.description:
Ash-Shams:5 - وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا
wal-samāi wamā banāhā
And the heaven and (He) Who constructed it

item.title: Ash-Shams:6
item.description:
Ash-Shams:6 - وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا
wal-arḍi wamā ṭaḥāhā
And the earth and by (He) Who spread it

item.title: Ash-Shams:7
item.description:
Ash-Shams:7 - وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا
wanafsin wamā sawwāhā
And (the) soul and (He) Who proportioned it

item.title: Ash-Shams:8
item.description:
Ash-Shams:8 - فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا
fa-alhamahā fujūrahā wataqwāhā
And He inspired it (to distinguish) its wickedness and its righteousness

item.title: Ash-Shams:9
item.description:
Ash-Shams:9 - قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا
qad aflaḥa man zakkāhā
Indeed he succeeds who purifies it

item.title: Ash-Shams:10
item.description:
Ash-Shams:10 - وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا
waqad khāba man dassāhā
And indeed he fails who buries it

item.title: Ash-Shams:11
item.description:
Ash-Shams:11 - كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا
kadhabat thamūdu biṭaghwāhā
Denied Thamud by their transgression

item.title: Ash-Shams:12
item.description:
Ash-Shams:12 - إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا
idhi inbaʿatha ashqāhā
When (was) sent forth (the) most wicked of them

item.title: Ash-Shams:13
item.description:
Ash-Shams:13 - فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
faqāla lahum rasūlu l-lahi nāqata l-lahi wasuq'yāhā
But said to them (the) Messenger (of) Allah (It is the) she-camel (of) Allah and her drink

item.title: Ash-Shams:14
item.description:
Ash-Shams:14 - فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāhā But they denied him and they hamstrung her So destroyed them their Lord for their sin and leveled them
  • [1] Or 'destroyed them,' or 'crushed them,' or 'brought down His punishment (or wrath) upon them.'
  • [2] That is, razed their city to the ground.

item.title: Ash-Shams:15
item.description:
Ash-Shams:15 - وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا
walā yakhāfu ʿuq'bāhā
And not He fears its consequences

item.title: 92. الليل (Al-Lail)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the whelming of The Night that swathes the world in darkness. It is named after "the night" (al-layl), mentioned in verse 1. The surah shows the consequences of the paths people choose and emphasizing God's guidance and warning.

92:1
وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشٰی
wa-al-layli idhā yaghshā
By the night when it covers

92:2
وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى
wal-nahāri idhā tajallā
And the day when it shines in brightness

92:3
وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى
wamā khalaqa l-dhakara wal-unthā
And He Who created the male and the female

item.title: Al-Lail:1
item.description:
Al-Lail:1 - وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشٰی
wa-al-layli idhā yaghshā
By the night when it covers

item.title: Al-Lail:2
item.description:
Al-Lail:2 - وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى
wal-nahāri idhā tajallā
And the day when it shines in brightness

item.title: Al-Lail:3
item.description:
Al-Lail:3 - وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى
wamā khalaqa l-dhakara wal-unthā
And He Who created the male and the female

item.title: Al-Lail:4
item.description:
Al-Lail:4 - إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّى
inna saʿyakum lashattā
Indeed your efforts (are) surely diverse

item.title: Al-Lail:5
item.description:
Al-Lail:5 - فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى
fa-ammā man aʿṭā wa-ittaqā
Then as for (him) who gives and fears

item.title: Al-Lail:6
item.description:
Al-Lail:6 - وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى
waṣaddaqa bil-ḥus'nā
And believes in the best

item.title: Al-Lail:7
item.description:
Al-Lail:7 - فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَى
fasanuyassiruhu lil'yus'rā
Then We will ease him towards [the] ease

item.title: Al-Lail:8
item.description:
Al-Lail:8 - وَأَمَّا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَى
wa-ammā man bakhila wa-is'taghnā
But as for (him) who withholds and considers himself free from need

item.title: Al-Lail:9
item.description:
Al-Lail:9 - وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَى
wakadhaba bil-ḥus'nā
And denies the best

item.title: Al-Lail:10
item.description:
Al-Lail:10 - فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَى
fasanuyassiruhu lil'ʿus'rā
Then We will ease him towards [the] difficulty

item.title: Al-Lail:11
item.description:
Al-Lail:11 - وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّى
wamā yugh'nī ʿanhu māluhu idhā taraddā
And not will avail him his wealth when he falls

item.title: Al-Lail:12
item.description:
Al-Lail:12 - إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَى
inna ʿalaynā lalhudā
Indeed upon Us (is) the guidance

item.title: Al-Lail:13
item.description:
Al-Lail:13 - وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَى
wa-inna lanā lalākhirata wal-ūlā
And indeed for Us (is) the Hereafter and the first (life)

item.title: Al-Lail:14
item.description:
Al-Lail:14 - فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّى
fa-andhartukum nāran talaẓẓā
So I warn you (of) a Fire blazing

item.title: Al-Lail:15
item.description:
Al-Lail:15 - لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى
lā yaṣlāhā illā l-ashqā
Not will burn (in) it except the most wretched

item.title: Al-Lail:16
item.description:
Al-Lail:16 - اَلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى
alladhī kadhaba watawallā
The one who denied and turned away

item.title: Al-Lail:17
item.description:
Al-Lail:17 - وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى
wasayujannabuhā l-atqā
But will be removed from it the righteous

item.title: Al-Lail:18
item.description:
Al-Lail:18 - اَلَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّى
alladhī yu'tī mālahu yatazakkā
The one who gives his wealth (to) purify himself

item.title: Al-Lail:19
item.description:
Al-Lail:19 - وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَى
wamā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿ'matin tuj'zā
And not for anyone with him any favor to be recompensed

item.title: Al-Lail:20
item.description:
Al-Lail:20 - إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْاَعْلٰی
illā ib'tighāa wajhi rabbihi l-aʿlā
Except seeking (the) Countenance (of) his Lord the Most High

item.title: Al-Lail:21
item.description:
Al-Lail:21 - وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَى
walasawfa yarḍā
And soon, surely he will be pleased

item.title: 93. الضحى (Ad-Dhuhaa)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the The Morning Brightness and the night when all falls still. It is named after "the morning brightness" (ḍūḥā), mentioned in verse 1. The surah is an address to the Prophet Muḥammad, to reassure him, when he had not received revelation for some time, that his Lord had not forsaken him.
The surah is also known as Daylight, Early Hours of Morning, Morning Bright, Morning Light, The Forenoon, The Glorious Morning Light, The Morning

93:1
وَالضُّحَى
wal-ḍuḥā
By the morning brightness

93:2
وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَى
wa-al-layli idhā sajā
And the night when it covers with darkness

93:3
مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى
mā waddaʿaka rabbuka wamā qalā
Not has forsaken you your Lord and not He is displeased

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:1
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:1 - وَالضُّحَى
wal-ḍuḥā
By the morning brightness

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:2
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:2 - وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَى
wa-al-layli idhā sajā
And the night when it covers with darkness

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:3
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:3 - مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَى
mā waddaʿaka rabbuka wamā qalā
Not has forsaken you your Lord and not He is displeased

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:4
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:4 - وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنَ الْأُولَى
walalākhiratu khayrun laka mina l-ūlā
And surely the Hereafter (is) better for you than the first

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:5
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:5 - وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَى
walasawfa yuʿ'ṭīka rabbuka fatarḍā
And soon will give you your Lord then you will be satisfied

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:6
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:6 - أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فءَاوَى
alam yajid'ka yatīman faāwā
Did not He find you an orphan and give shelter

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:7
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:7 - وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَى
wawajadaka ḍāllan fahadā
And He found you lost so He guided

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:8
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:8 - وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَى
wawajadaka ʿāilan fa-aghnā
And He found you in need so He made self-sufficient

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:9
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:9 - فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
fa-ammā l-yatīma falā taqhar
So as for the orphan then (do) not oppress

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:10
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:10 - وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
wa-ammā l-sāila falā tanhar
And as for one who asks then (do) not repel

item.title: Ad-Dhuhaa:11
item.description:
Ad-Dhuhaa:11 - وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
wa-ammā biniʿ'mati rabbika faḥaddith
But as for (the) Favor (of) your Lord narrate

item.title: 94. الشرح (Ash-Sharh)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a reassurance to the Prophet Muḥammad that his divine appointment to receive God's revelation has been nothing less than the Opening of the breast to sacred wisdom and guidance, and that thereby he has been honoured for all time, made well-able to bear the mantle of prophethood, and that ultimately and inevitably he shall be eased unto success. It is named "opening" after the phrase "did We not open" (a lam nashraḥ) in verse 1. The surah is a continuation of the reassurance and encouragement given in the previous surah.
The surah is also known as: Broadened Breast, Comfort, Consolation, Relief, The Expanding, The Expansion, The Opening Up, The Opening of The Heart, The Opening-Up of the Heart.

94:1
أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
alam nashraḥ laka ṣadraka
Have not We expanded for you your breast

94:2
وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ
wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wiz'raka
And We removed from you your burden

94:3
اَلَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
alladhī anqaḍa ẓahraka
Which weighed upon your back

item.title: Ash-Sharh:1
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:1 - أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
alam nashraḥ laka ṣadraka
Have not We expanded for you your breast

item.title: Ash-Sharh:2
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:2 - وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ
wawaḍaʿnā ʿanka wiz'raka
And We removed from you your burden

item.title: Ash-Sharh:3
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:3 - اَلَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
alladhī anqaḍa ẓahraka
Which weighed upon your back

item.title: Ash-Sharh:4
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:4 - وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
warafaʿnā laka dhik'raka
And We raised high for you your reputation

item.title: Ash-Sharh:5
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:5 - فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
fa-inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran
So indeed with the hardship (is) ease

item.title: Ash-Sharh:6
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:6 - إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
inna maʿa l-ʿus'ri yus'ran
Indeed with the hardship (is) ease

item.title: Ash-Sharh:7
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:7 - فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ fa-idhā faraghta fa-inṣab So when you have finished then labor hard
  • [1] Or 'when you are finished [with prayer], exert yourself [in supplicating to Allah].'

item.title: Ash-Sharh:8
item.description:
Ash-Sharh:8 - وَإِلَى رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ
wa-ilā rabbika fa-ir'ghab
And to your Lord turn your attention

item.title: 95. التين (At-Tin)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by The Fig and the olive, and other signs, representing the Holy Land in which God revealed the Evangel, the Torah, and the Quran, and thereby guided all mankind. It is named after "the fig" (al-tīn) mentioned in verse 1. The surah questions how man can deny the Judgement, and emphasizing the importance of faith and good deeds.
The surah is also known as The Figtree

95:1
وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ
wal-tīni wal-zaytūni
By the fig and the olive

95:2
وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
waṭūri sīnīna
And (the) Mount Sinai

95:3
وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ
wahādhā l-baladi l-amīni
And this [the] city [the] secure

item.title: At-Tin:1
item.description:
At-Tin:1 - وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ
wal-tīni wal-zaytūni
By the fig and the olive

item.title: At-Tin:2
item.description:
At-Tin:2 - وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
waṭūri sīnīna
And (the) Mount Sinai

item.title: At-Tin:3
item.description:
At-Tin:3 - وَهَذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ wahādhā l-baladi l-amīni And this [the] city [the] secure
  • [1] That is, the holy city of Makkah.

item.title: At-Tin:4
item.description:
At-Tin:4 - لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmin
Indeed We created man in (the) best mould

item.title: At-Tin:5
item.description:
At-Tin:5 - ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ
thumma radadnāhu asfala sāfilīna
Then We returned him (to the) lowest (of the) low

item.title: At-Tin:6
item.description:
At-Tin:6 - إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin
Except those who believe and do righteous deeds then for them (is a) reward never ending

item.title: At-Tin:7
item.description:
At-Tin:7 - فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ
famā yukadhibuka baʿdu bil-dīni
Then what causes you to deny after (this) the judgment

item.title: At-Tin:8
item.description:
At-Tin:8 - أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ
alaysa l-lahu bi-aḥkami l-ḥākimīna
Is not Allah (the) Most Just (of) the Judges

item.title: 96. العلق (Al-Alaq)
item.description:
The surah that contains the first revealed verses of the Quran, reminding the human being of The Clinging Mass, a stage that reflects the miracle of human creation in the womb of the mother. The surah is also known by the first Quranic instruction: Read. It is named after "the clining mass" ('alaq) mentioned in verse 2. The first five verses are known to be the first revelation of the Quran when the Prophet Muḥammad was instructed to read. The second part came later to show that man transgresses when he becomes self-satisfied.
The surah is also known as Clots of Blood, Proclaim, Read, Recite, The Blood-clot, The Clinging Clot, The Clinging Form, The Clot, The Embryo

96:1
اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ
iq'ra bi-is'mi rabbika alladhī khalaqa
Read in (the) name (of) your Lord the One Who created

96:2
خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
khalaqa l-insāna min ʿalaqin
He created man from a clinging substance

96:3
اِقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ
iq'ra warabbuka l-akramu
Read and your Lord (is) the Most Generous

item.title: Al-Alaq:1
item.description:
Al-Alaq:1 - اِقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ
iq'ra bi-is'mi rabbika alladhī khalaqa
Read in (the) name (of) your Lord the One Who created

item.title: Al-Alaq:2
item.description:
Al-Alaq:2 - خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
khalaqa l-insāna min ʿalaqin
He created man from a clinging substance

item.title: Al-Alaq:3
item.description:
Al-Alaq:3 - اِقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ
iq'ra warabbuka l-akramu
Read and your Lord (is) the Most Generous

item.title: Al-Alaq:4
item.description:
Al-Alaq:4 - اَلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ
alladhī ʿallama bil-qalami
The One Who taught by the pen

item.title: Al-Alaq:5
item.description:
Al-Alaq:5 - عَلَّمَ الْاِنْسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
ʿallama l-insāna mā lam yaʿlam
Taught man what not he knew

item.title: Al-Alaq:6
item.description:
Al-Alaq:6 - كَلَّا إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَى
kallā inna l-insāna layaṭghā
Nay Indeed man surely transgresses

item.title: Al-Alaq:7
item.description:
Al-Alaq:7 - أَنْ رَاٰهُ اسْتَغْنَى
an raāhu is'taghnā
That he sees himself self-sufficient

item.title: Al-Alaq:8
item.description:
Al-Alaq:8 - إِنَّ إِلَى رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَى
inna ilā rabbika l-ruj'ʿā
Indeed to your Lord (is) the return

item.title: Al-Alaq:9
item.description:
Al-Alaq:9 - أَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَى
ara-ayta alladhī yanhā
Have you seen the one who forbids

item.title: Al-Alaq:10
item.description:
Al-Alaq:10 - عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّى
ʿabdan idhā ṣallā
A slave when he prays

item.title: Al-Alaq:11
item.description:
Al-Alaq:11 - أَرَءَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى
ara-ayta in kāna ʿalā l-hudā
Have you seen if he is upon [the] guidance

item.title: Al-Alaq:12
item.description:
Al-Alaq:12 - أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَى
aw amara bil-taqwā
Or he enjoins [of the] righteousness

item.title: Al-Alaq:13
item.description:
Al-Alaq:13 - أَرَءَيْتَ إِنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى
ara-ayta in kadhaba watawallā
Have you seen if he denies and turns away

item.title: Al-Alaq:14
item.description:
Al-Alaq:14 - أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرٰی
alam yaʿlam bi-anna l-laha yarā
Does not he know that Allah sees

item.title: Al-Alaq:15
item.description:
Al-Alaq:15 - كَلَّا لَئِنْ لَمْ يَنْتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ
kallā la-in lam yantahi lanasfaʿan bil-nāṣiyati
Nay If not he desists surely We will drag him by the forelock

item.title: Al-Alaq:16
item.description:
Al-Alaq:16 - نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ
nāṣiyatin kādhibatin khāṭi-atin
A forelock lying sinful

item.title: Al-Alaq:17
item.description:
Al-Alaq:17 - فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ
falyadʿu nādiyahu
Then let him call his associates

item.title: Al-Alaq:18
item.description:
Al-Alaq:18 - سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ
sanadʿu l-zabāniyata
We will call the Angels of Hell

item.title: Al-Alaq:19
item.description:
Al-Alaq:19 - كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِبْ
kallā lā tuṭiʿ'hu wa-us'jud wa-iq'tarib
Nay (Do) not obey him But prostrate and draw near (to Allah)

item.title: 97. القدر (Al-Qadr)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the moment in which God first revealed the Quran, calling it The Ordainment. It is named after the phrase "the night of ordainment" (laylay al-qadr), mentioned in verse 1. The surah celebrates the night when the first revelation of the Quran was sent down.
The surah is also known as: Determination, Honour, Power, The Glory, The Night of Empowering Decree, The Night of Glory, The Night of Power.

97:1
إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
innā anzalnāhu fī laylati l-qadri
Indeed, We revealed it in (the) Night (of) Power

97:2
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ
wamā adrāka mā laylatu l-qadri
And what can make you know what (the) Night (of) Power (is)

97:3
لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
laylatu l-qadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
(The) Night (of) Power (is) better than a thousand month(s)

item.title: Al-Qadr:1
item.description:
Al-Qadr:1 - إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ innā anzalnāhu fī laylati l-qadri Indeed, We revealed it in (the) Night (of) Power
  • [1] That is, the Qur'ān. See (Q 44:2) - (Q 44:5).

item.title: Al-Qadr:2
item.description:
Al-Qadr:2 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ
wamā adrāka mā laylatu l-qadri
And what can make you know what (the) Night (of) Power (is)

item.title: Al-Qadr:3
item.description:
Al-Qadr:3 - لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
laylatu l-qadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
(The) Night (of) Power (is) better than a thousand month(s)

item.title: Al-Qadr:4
item.description:
Al-Qadr:4 - تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
tanazzalu l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu fīhā bi-idh'ni rabbihim min kulli amrin
Descend the Angels and the Spirit therein by (the) permission (of) their Lord for every affair

item.title: Al-Qadr:5
item.description:
Al-Qadr:5 - سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتّٰی مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ
salāmun hiya ḥattā maṭlaʿi l-fajri
Peace it (is) until (the) emergence (of) the dawn

item.title: 98. البينة (Al-Bayyina)
item.description:
The surah that mentions the advent of the message of the Quran and its Messenger as The Proof of a decisive revelation for both the disputing People of the Scripture and the unbelievers unlettered in God's word. It is named after "the proof" (al-bayyinah) mentioned in verse 1 and verse 4. The surah spells out the basic tenets of faith, and contrasts the Fire of Hell with the lasting bliss that will be enjoyed by the faithful.
The surah is also known as: The Clear Evidence, The Clear Proof, The Clear Sign, The Evidence.

98:1
لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنْفَكِّينَ حَتّٰی تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
lam yakuni alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna munfakkīna ḥattā tatiyahumu l-bayinatu
Not were those who disbelieved from (the) People of the Book and the polytheists to be abandoned until (there) comes to them the clear evidence

98:2
رَسُولٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُوْۤا صُحُفًا مُطَهَّرَةً
rasūlun mina l-lahi yatlū ṣuḥufan muṭahharatan
A Messenger from Allah reciting pages purified

98:3
فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
fīhā kutubun qayyimatun
Wherein (are) writings correct

item.title: Al-Bayyina:1
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:1 - لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنْفَكِّينَ حَتّٰی تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
lam yakuni alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna munfakkīna ḥattā tatiyahumu l-bayinatu
Not were those who disbelieved from (the) People of the Book and the polytheists to be abandoned until (there) comes to them the clear evidence

item.title: Al-Bayyina:2
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:2 - رَسُولٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُوْۤا صُحُفًا مُطَهَّرَةً
rasūlun mina l-lahi yatlū ṣuḥufan muṭahharatan
A Messenger from Allah reciting pages purified

item.title: Al-Bayyina:3
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:3 - فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
fīhā kutubun qayyimatun
Wherein (are) writings correct

item.title: Al-Bayyina:4
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:4 - وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوْۤا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
wamā tafarraqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba illā min baʿdi mā jāathumu l-bayinatu
And not became divided those who were given the Book until from after what came (to) them (of) the clear evidence

item.title: Al-Bayyina:5
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:5 - وَمَا أُمِرُوْۤا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوْۤا الصَّلاةَ وَيُؤْتُوْۤا الزَّكَاةَ وَذٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ
wamā umirū illā liyaʿbudū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna ḥunafāa wayuqīmū l-ṣalata wayu'tū l-zakata wadhālika dīnu l-qayimati
And not they were commanded except to worship Allah (being) sincere to Him (in) the religion upright and to establish the prayer and to give the zakah And that (is the) religion the correct

item.title: Al-Bayyina:6
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:6 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوْۤا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ
inna alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna fī nāri jahannama khālidīna fīhā ulāika hum sharru l-bariyati
Indeed those who disbelieve from (the) People (of) the Book and the polytheists (will be) in (the) Fire (of) Hell abiding eternally therein Those they (are the) worst (of) the creatures

item.title: Al-Bayyina:7
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:7 - إِنَّ الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ
inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika hum khayru l-bariyati
Indeed those who believe and do righteous deeds those they (are the) best (of) the creatures

item.title: Al-Bayyina:8
item.description:
Al-Bayyina:8 - جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوْۤا عَنْهُ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ
jazāuhum ʿinda rabbihim jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu dhālika liman khashiya rabbahu
Their reward (is) with their Lord Gardens (of) Eternity flow from underneath them the rivers will abide therein forever (will be) pleased Allah with them and they (will be) pleased with Him That (is) for whoever feared his Lord

item.title: 99. الزلزلة (Az-Zalzala)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the mention of The Quake of the earth in utter destruction at the end of the world. It takes its name from "the quake" (al-zalzalah) mentioned in verse 1. The surah deals with scenes from the Day of Judgement.
The surah is also known as The Convulsion, The Earthquake, The Quaking, The Shaking, The Shock

99:1
إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālahā
When is shaken the earth (with) its earthquake

99:2
وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālahā
And brings forth the earth its burdens

99:3
وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا
waqāla l-insānu mā lahā
And says man What (is) with it

item.title: Az-Zalzala:1
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:1 - إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
idhā zul'zilati l-arḍu zil'zālahā
When is shaken the earth (with) its earthquake

item.title: Az-Zalzala:2
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:2 - وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
wa-akhrajati l-arḍu athqālahā
And brings forth the earth its burdens

item.title: Az-Zalzala:3
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:3 - وَقَالَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا لَهَا
waqāla l-insānu mā lahā
And says man What (is) with it

item.title: Az-Zalzala:4
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:4 - يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
yawma-idhin tuḥaddithu akhbārahā
That Day it will report its news

item.title: Az-Zalzala:5
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:5 - بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَى لَهَا
bi-anna rabbaka awḥā lahā
Because your Lord inspired [to] it

item.title: Az-Zalzala:6
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:6 - يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahum That Day will proceed the mankind (in) scattered groups to be shown their deeds
  • [1] Or 'separate groups.'

item.title: Az-Zalzala:7
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:7 - فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarahu
So whoever does (equal to the) weight (of) an atom good will see it

item.title: Az-Zalzala:8
item.description:
Az-Zalzala:8 - وَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarahu
And whoever does (equal to the) weight (of) an atom evil will see it

item.title: 100. العاديات (Al-Aadiyaat)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the mention of galloping war steeds that it calls The Chargers, whose very hoofs strike sparks upon the rocky earth as they carry their riders furiously into the midst of the fray life. It takes its name from "the chargers" (al-'adiyāt) mentioned in verse 1. The surah touch upon Gods swearing by the warhorses He has subjected to man's use that man is ungrateful and misguided.
The surah is also known as: Snorting Steeds, The Charging Mares, The Charging Steeds, The War Steeds, Those That Run, Those Who Run.

100:1
وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا
wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥan
By the racers panting

100:2
فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا
fal-mūriyāti qadḥan
And the producers of sparks striking

100:3
فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا
fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥan
And the chargers (at) dawn

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:1
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:1 - وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا
wal-ʿādiyāti ḍabḥan
By the racers panting

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:2
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:2 - فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا
fal-mūriyāti qadḥan
And the producers of sparks striking

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:3
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:3 - فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا
fal-mughīrāti ṣub'ḥan
And the chargers (at) dawn

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:4
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:4 - فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا
fa-atharna bihi naqʿan
Then raise thereby dust

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:5
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:5 - فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا
fawasaṭna bihi jamʿan
Then penetrate (in the) center thereby collectively

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:6
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:6 - إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ
inna l-insāna lirabbihi lakanūdun
Indeed mankind to his Lord (is) surely ungrateful

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:7
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:7 - وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
wa-innahu ʿalā dhālika lashahīdun
And indeed, he on that surely (is) a witness

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:8
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:8 - وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
wa-innahu liḥubbi l-khayri lashadīdun
And indeed he in (the) love (of) wealth (is) surely intense

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:9
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:9 - أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ
afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūri
But does not he know when will be scattered what (is) in the graves

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:10
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:10 - وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ
waḥuṣṣila mā fī l-ṣudūri
And is made apparent what (is) in the breasts

item.title: Al-Aadiyaat:11
item.description:
Al-Aadiyaat:11 - إِنَّ رَبَّهُمْ بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَخَبِيرٌ
inna rabbahum bihim yawma-idhin lakhabīrun
Indeed their Lord about them that Day (is) surely All-Aware

item.title: 101. القارعة (Al-Qaari'a)
item.description:
The surah that opens with this single world, al-Qāri'ah, meaning The Catastrophe, for that is the repeated sound that shall resound through all the earth as it is being pulverized in the cataclysm at the end of time, levelled utterly for the Resurrection Day and the ultimate Judgment of every human soul. It takes its name from "the catastrophe" (al-qāri'ah) mentioned in verse 1 ff. The surah gives some scenes from the Resurrection and Judgement.
The surah is also known as: The Calamity, The Clatterer, The Crashing Blow, The Day of Noise and Clamour, The Disaster, The Great Calamity, The Great Pounding, The Smiter, The Stunning (Blow).

101:1
اَلْقَارِعَةُ
al-qāriʿatu
The Striking Calamity

101:2
مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
mā l-qāriʿatu
What (is) the Striking Calamity

101:3
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
wamā adrāka mā l-qāriʿatu
And what will make you know what (is) the Striking Calamity

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:1
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:1 - اَلْقَارِعَةُ
al-qāriʿatu
The Striking Calamity

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:2
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:2 - مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
mā l-qāriʿatu
What (is) the Striking Calamity

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:3
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:3 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
wamā adrāka mā l-qāriʿatu
And what will make you know what (is) the Striking Calamity

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:4
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:4 - يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ
yawma yakūnu l-nāsu kal-farāshi l-mabthūthi
(The) Day will be the mankind like moths scattered

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:5
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:5 - وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنْفُوشِ
watakūnu l-jibālu kal-ʿih'ni l-manfūshi
And will be the mountains like wool fluffed up

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:6
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:6 - فَأَمَّا مَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ
fa-ammā man thaqulat mawāzīnuhu
Then as for (him) whose (are) heavy his scales

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:7
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:7 - فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ
fahuwa fī ʿīshatin rāḍiyatin
Then he (will be) in a life pleasant

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:8
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:8 - وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ
wa-ammā man khaffat mawāzīnuhu
But as for (him) whose (are) light his scales

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:9
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:9 - فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ
fa-ummuhu hāwiyatun
His abode (will be the) Pit

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:10
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:10 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا هِيَهْ
wamā adrāka mā hiyah
And what will make you know what it is

item.title: Al-Qaari'a:11
item.description:
Al-Qaari'a:11 - نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌ
nārun ḥāmiyatun
A Fire intensely hot

item.title: 102. التكاثر (At-Takaathur)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the mention of the Rivalry as mentioned in verse 1 ff. The surah criticizes man's preoccupation with worldly wealth and stresses that he will be brought to account on the Day of Resurrection.
The surah is also known as Competition, Competition for Gain, Plenitude, Striving for More, The Piling Up, Vying for More and More, Worldly Abundance, Worldly Gains

102:1
أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ
alhākumu l-takāthuru
Diverts you the competition to increase

102:2
حَتّٰی زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ
ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābira
Until you visit the graves

102:3
كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
kallā sawfa taʿlamūna
Nay Soon you will know

item.title: At-Takaathur:1
item.description:
At-Takaathur:1 - أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ
alhākumu l-takāthuru
Diverts you the competition to increase

item.title: At-Takaathur:2
item.description:
At-Takaathur:2 - حَتّٰی زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ
ḥattā zur'tumu l-maqābira
Until you visit the graves

item.title: At-Takaathur:3
item.description:
At-Takaathur:3 - كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
kallā sawfa taʿlamūna
Nay Soon you will know

item.title: At-Takaathur:4
item.description:
At-Takaathur:4 - ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūna
Then nay Soon you will know

item.title: At-Takaathur:5
item.description:
At-Takaathur:5 - كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ
kallā law taʿlamūna ʿil'ma l-yaqīni
Nay If you know (with) a knowledge (of) certainty

item.title: At-Takaathur:6
item.description:
At-Takaathur:6 - لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ
latarawunna l-jaḥīma
Surely you will see the Hellfire

item.title: At-Takaathur:7
item.description:
At-Takaathur:7 - ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ
thumma latarawunnahā ʿayna l-yaqīni
Then surely you will see it (with the) eye (of) certainty

item.title: At-Takaathur:8
item.description:
At-Takaathur:8 - ثُمَّ لَتُسْءَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ
thumma latus'alunna yawma-idhin ʿani l-naʿīmi
Then surely you will be asked that Day about the pleasures

item.title: 103. العصر (Al-Asr)
item.description:
The surah that opens with the oath of the Divine One swearing by the decline of Time and humankind's absolute loss of every single thing but righteousness, truth, patience, and faith. It takes its name from the phrase "by time" (wal- 'āṣr) as mentioned in verse 1. The surah shows the way to salvation. The image of a declining day suggests the stage in the day, or in life, when only a short while is left for those wishing to make up for lost time.
The surah is also known as: Afternoon, The Decline of Time, The Declining Day, The Epoch, The Late Afternoon, Time and Age, Time through the Ages.

103:1
وَالْعَصْرِ
wal-ʿaṣri
By the time

103:2
إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَفِیْ خُسْرٍ
inna l-insāna lafī khus'rin
Indeed mankind (is) surely, in loss

103:3
إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣaw bil-ḥaqi watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri
Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and enjoin (each other) to the truth and enjoin (each other) to [the] patience

item.title: Al-Asr:1
item.description:
Al-Asr:1 - وَالْعَصْرِ
wal-ʿaṣri
By the time

item.title: Al-Asr:2
item.description:
Al-Asr:2 - إِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَفِیْ خُسْرٍ
inna l-insāna lafī khus'rin
Indeed mankind (is) surely, in loss

item.title: Al-Asr:3
item.description:
Al-Asr:3 - إِلَّا الَّذِينَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوْۤا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣaw bil-ḥaqi watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri
Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and enjoin (each other) to the truth and enjoin (each other) to [the] patience

item.title: 104. الهمزة (Al-Humaza)
item.description:
The surah that opens with a threat of impending affliction and grief to The Scandal-monger or the slanderous reviler, one who, in greediness of wealth and acclaim, defames others. It takes its name from "the slanderer" (humazah) mentioned in verse 1. The surah condemns the greedy backbiter and gives a description of Hell.
The surah is also known as: The Backbiter, The Gossipmonger, The Slanderer, The Slanderous Reviler.

104:1
وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُمَزَةٍ
waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin
Woe to every slanderer backbiter

104:2
اَلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ
alladhī jamaʿa mālan waʿaddadahu
The one who collects wealth and counts it

104:3
يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ
yaḥsabu anna mālahu akhladahu
Thinking that his wealth will make him immortal

item.title: Al-Humaza:1
item.description:
Al-Humaza:1 - وَيْلٌ لِكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُمَزَةٍ
waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin
Woe to every slanderer backbiter

item.title: Al-Humaza:2
item.description:
Al-Humaza:2 - اَلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ
alladhī jamaʿa mālan waʿaddadahu
The one who collects wealth and counts it

item.title: Al-Humaza:3
item.description:
Al-Humaza:3 - يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ
yaḥsabu anna mālahu akhladahu
Thinking that his wealth will make him immortal

item.title: Al-Humaza:4
item.description:
Al-Humaza:4 - كَلَّا لَيُنْبَذَنَّ فِي الْحُطَمَةِ
kallā layunbadhanna fī l-ḥuṭamati
Nay Surely he will be thrown in the Crusher

item.title: Al-Humaza:5
item.description:
Al-Humaza:5 - وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ
wamā adrāka mā l-ḥuṭamatu
And what will make you know what the Crusher (is)

item.title: Al-Humaza:6
item.description:
Al-Humaza:6 - نَارُ اللَّهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ
nāru l-lahi l-mūqadatu
A Fire Allah kindled

item.title: Al-Humaza:7
item.description:
Al-Humaza:7 - اَلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْأَفْئِدَةِ
allatī taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā l-afidati
Which mounts up to the hearts

item.title: Al-Humaza:8
item.description:
Al-Humaza:8 - إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِمْ مُؤْصَدَةٌ
innahā ʿalayhim mu'ṣadatun
Indeed, it (will be) upon them closed over

item.title: Al-Humaza:9
item.description:
Al-Humaza:9 - فِي عَمَدٍ مُمَدَّدَةٍ
fī ʿamadin mumaddadatin
In columns extended

item.title: 105. الفيل (Al-Fil)
item.description:
The surah that tells of the destruction of the armed force that came to be known as the company of The Elephant, after the animal they intended to use to destroy the Ka'bah, in the generation before the advent of Islam. This surah is a reference to events that happened in 570 CE, the year of the Prophet Muḥammads birth. It takes its name from "the elephant" (al-fīl) mentioned in verse 2, which refers to the force dispatched by Abrahah (a Christian ruler of Yemen) to Mecca, that is "the men of the elephant" (aṣḥāb al-fīl). The destruction of this army is cited here to encourage the believers and warn the disbelievers.

105:1
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi l-fīli
Have not you seen how dealt your Lord with (the) Companions (of the) Elephant

105:2
أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِي تَضْلِيلٍ
alam yajʿal kaydahum fī taḍlīlin
Did not He make their plan go astray

105:3
وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
wa-arsala ʿalayhim ṭayran bAbyl#(105:3:4)">abābīla
And He sent against them birds (in) flocks

item.title: Al-Fil:1
item.description:
Al-Fil:1 - أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ
alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi l-fīli
Have not you seen how dealt your Lord with (the) Companions (of the) Elephant

item.title: Al-Fil:2
item.description:
Al-Fil:2 - أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِي تَضْلِيلٍ
alam yajʿal kaydahum fī taḍlīlin
Did not He make their plan go astray

item.title: Al-Fil:3
item.description:
Al-Fil:3 - وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
wa-arsala ʿalayhim ṭayran bAbyl#(105:3:4)">abābīla
And He sent against them birds (in) flocks

item.title: Al-Fil:4
item.description:
Al-Fil:4 - تَرْمِيهِمْ بِحِجَارَةٍ مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ
tarmīhim biḥijāratin min sijjīlin
Striking them with stones of baked clay

item.title: Al-Fil:5
item.description:
Al-Fil:5 - فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَأْكُولٍ
fajaʿalahum kaʿaṣfin makūlin
Then He made them like straw eaten up

item.title: 106. قريش (Quraish)
item.description:
The surah that admonishes the first recipients of the Quran, the Meccan tribe of Quraysh, to give thanks to the One God alone who had long bequeathed to them, in their desert surroundings, abundant provision and security. It takes its name from verse 1, which mentions the Quraysh, the tribe to which the Prophet Muḥammad belonged.
The surah is also known as: Koraish, The Quraish, The Quraish (Custodians of the Ka'ba), The Tribe of Quraysh.

106:1
لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ
liīlāfi qurayshin
For (the) familiarity (of the) Quraish

106:2
إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ
īlāfihim riḥ'lata l-shitāi wal-ṣayfi
Their familiarity (with the) journey (of) winter and summer

106:3
فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ
falyaʿbudū rabba hādhā l-bayti
So let them worship (the) Lord (of) this House

item.title: Quraish:1
item.description:
Quraish:1 - لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ liīlāfi qurayshin For (the) familiarity (of the) Quraish
  • [1] That is, the team spirit and concord amongst clans of the tribe of Quraysh, who conducted the trade caravans between Yemen and Syria in summer and winter.

item.title: Quraish:2
item.description:
Quraish:2 - إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ
īlāfihim riḥ'lata l-shitāi wal-ṣayfi
Their familiarity (with the) journey (of) winter and summer

item.title: Quraish:3
item.description:
Quraish:3 - فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ
falyaʿbudū rabba hādhā l-bayti
So let them worship (the) Lord (of) this House

item.title: Quraish:4
item.description:
Quraish:4 - اَلَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُمْ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُمْ مِنْ خَوْفٍ
alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waāmanahum min khawfin
The One Who feeds them from (against) hunger and gives them security from fear

item.title: 107. الماعون (Al-Maa'un)
item.description:
The surah that chastises as irreligious and mean all those who withhold from the helpless and needy of the most basic forms of Aid. It takes its name from verse 7, in which "the aid" (al-mā'ūn) occurs. The surah describes some characteristics of a person who denies the Judgement.
The surah is also known as: Alms, Almsgiving, Charity, Common Kindnesses, Helping Others, Needs, Neighbourly Needs, The Neighbourly Assistance, Things of Common Use.

107:1
أَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِالدِّينِ
ara-ayta alladhī yukadhibu bil-dīni
Have you seen the one who denies the Judgment

107:2
فَذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ
fadhālika alladhī yaduʿʿu l-yatīma
Then that (is) the one who repulses the orphan

107:3
وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīni
And (does) not feel the urge to feed the poor

item.title: Al-Maa'un:1
item.description:
Al-Maa'un:1 - أَرَءَيْتَ الَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِالدِّينِ
ara-ayta alladhī yukadhibu bil-dīni
Have you seen the one who denies the Judgment

item.title: Al-Maa'un:2
item.description:
Al-Maa'un:2 - فَذٰلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ
fadhālika alladhī yaduʿʿu l-yatīma
Then that (is) the one who repulses the orphan

item.title: Al-Maa'un:3
item.description:
Al-Maa'un:3 - وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَى طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
walā yaḥuḍḍu ʿalā ṭaʿāmi l-mis'kīni
